The restrictions rest on the three grounds listed in Article 15, first paragraph, of the Archives Act.
De beperkingen berusten op de drie gronden die zijn opgenomen in artikel 15, eerste lid, van de Archiefwet.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven, Timmermans, Pechtold, Ormel en Voordewind over Chinese deportaties van Noord-Koreaanse vluchtelingen naar hun vaderland

Six MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China continues to deport North Korean refugees and what the government is doing about it, including pressing China, supporting South Korea at the UN Human Rights Council, and pursuing arbitration with UNHCR. The minister answered that the government is concerned and has raised non-refoulement with China, but China rejects the refugee label and treats the matter as bilateral, so no concrete change is expected.
Both the Netherlands and the EU have previously raised with China the principle of non-refoulement and advocated UNHCR access.
Zowel Nederland als de EU heeft China eerder aangesproken op het principe van non-refoulement en toegang van UNHCR bepleit.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over de verkiezingen van 6 mei aanstaande in Armenië

An MP asked the minister about EU and Dutch efforts to promote fair elections in Armenia, including funding, electoral law reform and media freedom. The minister answered that the EU, OSCE and UNDP run programmes on elections, that the Netherlands supports civil society observation and funds one long-term and four short-term OSCE observers, and that electoral law was recently revised with OSCE and Venice Commission recommendations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over ophef, verontwaardiging en onzekerheid binnen het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken n.a.v. de casus-Haspels en zijn persoonlijke facebook pagina

An MP asked the foreign minister about internal unrest at the foreign ministry over her public criticism of officials, including a case involving an ambassador's personal Facebook page, and asked whether the works council's letter and the secretary-general's replies would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that social media use is governed by the civil servants' freedom-of-expression rules with the usual criteria, that a staff meeting was held on 5 March, and that the internal response follows those lines with no real difference between online and offline expression, without sending the internal letters to parliament.
Are you willing to send the secretary-general's replies to the works council's letter to the House?
Bent u bereid de antwoorden van de secretaris-generaal op de brief van de Ondernemingsraad naar de Kamer te sturen
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Timmermans over een inval van Syrische troepen bij een NGO

MPs Pechtold and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister how the government would respond to a Syrian raid on an NGO that reportedly detained human rights defenders, and whether it would raise the incident at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister replied that the government was deeply concerned, that EU High Representative Ashton had already issued a statement calling for release, and that the EU Council had discussed Syria on 27 February.
Expressing our concerns through the EU is the most effective approach in this case.
Het uiten van onze zorgen via de EU is in dit geval het meest effectief.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Hachchi over uitspraken HRW over Nederlands mensenrechtenbeleid

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister to respond to Human Rights Watch criticism that the Netherlands has become inconsistent on human rights, including toward friendly countries such as Israel, and to explain the government's position on appointing an EU Special Representative for Human Rights. The minister rejected the criticism, said friendly countries are also addressed on rights issues (with examples to follow in the 2011 human rights report), and stated the government is in principle opposed to such an EU special representative, pending internal EU discussions.
As promised to the House, I will include examples of this in the 2011 human rights report.
Zoals toegezegd aan de Kamer zal ik in de mensenrechtenrapportage 2011 daarvan voorbeelden opnemen.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold, Hachchi, Schouw en Dijkstra over Kamervragen Oeganda anti-homoseksualiteitswet

D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest to Uganda over a renewed anti-homosexuality bill that proposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps would follow if it passed. The minister said the bill is unacceptable, that Nederland and the EU have raised objections with Uganda, that the Ugandan premier distanced himself from it, and that further steps are premature.
I do not consider the proposed private member's bill acceptable.
Ik acht het voorliggende initiatiefwetsvoorstel niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over het bericht dat Nederland een EU-verklaring over Israël aanpaste

MP Pechtold asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands had intervened to remove references to an EU diplomatic report and to soften critical language on Israel in an EU Council statement. The minister denied that Dutch positions were pressed to avoid criticism of Israel, said the final text reflects EU consensus, and called the Dutch input constructive.
The Netherlands and many other EU member states made suggestions for the drafting of the Council conclusions.
Nederland en veel andere EU-lidstaten hebben suggesties gedaan voor de redactie van de Raadsconclusies

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Israëlisch wetsvoorstel ten aanzien van inkomsten van organisaties die donaties ontvangen van buitenlandse statelijke e

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli bill restricting foreign state-funded NGOs, including whether the Netherlands pressed Israel and whether a 45% tax would cut donor funding. The minister said the government raised concerns about democratic rights, that the legislative process is complex and uncertain so details cannot be judged now, and that the Netherlands will await the final law before assessing its effect on Dutch subsidies.
The government follows the Israeli debate closely, but refrains from commenting on individual statements made in that context in Israel.
De regering volgt het Israëlische debat aandachtig, maar onthoudt zich van commentaar op individuele uitspraken die in dat kader in Israël worden gedaan.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ontbieden van de nuntius van de Heilige Stoel om een reactie te verkrijgen op het rapport-Deetman (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the papal nuncio should be summoned to obtain the Holy See's formal reaction to the Deetman report on sexual abuse in the Catholic Church, and raised related questions on follow-up and the nuncio's role. The minister answered that the Catholic Church has embraced the report's recommendations, that a formal reaction from the Holy See is not needed at this point, and that existing diplomatic contact suffices.
The Cabinet considers the initial reaction from the highest Roman Catholic authority in the Netherlands sufficient for now and is awaiting further steps.
Het Kabinet acht de eerste reactie van het hoogste Rooms-Katholieke gezag in Nederland voor dit moment voldoende en wacht vervolgstappen af.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi (beiden D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks), en Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bevordering van politieke vrouwenparticipatie in

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would back a gender quota for Libya's new constitution-making body, and how it funds women's political participation in the MENA region. The minister said the Netherlands supports women's participation, will remind the NTC of its commitments, has earmarked EUR 2 million for 2011 and 2012, and will take a lead role within the EU, but did not commit to requesting a quota.

I follow developments in Libya closely and where necessary I remind the NTC and the interim government of their commitments in the draft Constitutional Charter regarding the democratic transition, including women's rights.

Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Libië nauwgezet en waar nodig herinner ik de NTC en de interim-regering aan hun toezeggingen in the draft Constitutional Charter ten aanzien van de democratische transitie inclusief vrouwenrechten.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over de dochter van Mensenrechtentulpwinnares Ni Yulan

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention of Ni Yulan's daughter at Beijing airport while travelling to receive the Human Rights Tulip, and whether the ambassador would be summoned and what steps the government would take. The minister confirmed the detention and release, said China regards it as a domestic matter, reported that the embassy has requested explanation, and said he would speak at the ceremony.
I immediately asked the Chinese Ambassador in The Hague and in Beijing for an explanation of this situation.
Ik heb onmiddellijk bij de Chinese Ambassadeur in Den Haag en in Peking om tekst en uitleg gevraagd over deze situatie.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het bericht dat de rol van wijlen prins Bernhard bij de Lockheed-affaire groter was dan verwacht (ingezonden 21 december 2011)

An MP asked the Prime Minister about reports that Prince Bernhard's role in the Lockheed affair was larger than thought, whether the 1976 Donner commission had minimised it, and whether undisclosed archive documents should be released early or transferred to the National Archives. The government answered that the 2011 court-ordered disclosure decision stands, that the Royal House Archive is a private archive outside the Archiefwet, and that it sees no grounds for a new historians' inquiry.
The Royal House Archive is a private archive. The Archiefwet does not apply to private archives.
Het Koninklijk Huisarchief is een particulier archief. De Archiefwet is niet van toepassing op particuliere archieven.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ontbieden van de nuntius van de Heilige Stoel om een reactie te verkrijgen op het rapport-Deetman (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the nuncio of the Holy See should be summoned to react to the Deetman report on sexual abuse, and whether the Pope's reaction should inform policy. The government answered on dual-use export controls, internet freedom and corporate human rights responsibility, without addressing the nuncio request.
Furthermore, the Netherlands also works through forums to encourage companies to take responsibility for respecting human rights online.
Daarnaast zet Nederland zich er ook via fora voor in om bedrijven te stimuleren hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor respect voor mensenrechten online.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks), van Bommel (SP), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse zaken over de gerechtelijke uitspraak die de Staat

MPs from several parties asked whether the government would drop cassation against the Hague appeals court ruling holding the State liable for the deaths of three men during the Srebrenica genocide, and whether it would apologise to the victims' relatives. The minister answered that the ruling is an interim judgment so cassation is not yet possible, and reaffirmed the 2002 Kok cabinet statement on Dutch political co-responsibility rather than apologising.
The appeals court ruling is, technically speaking, an interim judgment.
De uitspraak van het hof is juridisch-technisch gezien een tussenarrest.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het mogelijk niet uitreiken van een prominente mensenrechtenprijs (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the Foreign Minister whether the government postponed announcing and presenting the 2011 Human Rights Tulip prize, after an independent jury chose a detained Chinese activist, and whether this politicised the award. The minister answered that the postponement was requested by the laureate's family for her own interest, that the jury's choice was accepted, and that there was no political interference.
To avoid unnecessarily harming the laureate's interests, I prefer not to say anything further at this time about the arguments her relatives used for the postponement.
Om de belangen van de laureaat niet onnodig te schaden geef ik er de voorkeur aan om over de argumenten die zij daarvoor hebben gehanteerd op dit moment geen verdere uitspraken te doen.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een oproep van 11 EU ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands was asked to co-sign a December 2011 article by eleven EU foreign ministers on EU-Turkey relations, why it did not, and whether it supports the EU positive agenda and Turkey's accession path. Minister Rosenthal answered that the Netherlands would not have co-signed the article as written because it wanted more emphasis on fundamental rights and on political reform keeping pace with individual freedoms, while reaffirming Turkey's accession perspective and welcoming the positive agenda.
The Netherlands would therefore not have signed the letter in its current form, had it been invited to do so.
Nederland had de brief in zijn huidige vorm, indien daartoe uitgenodigd, daarom ook niet ondertekend.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Recourt (PvdA) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de gedragingen van bewindsperson

MPs Pechtold, Recourt and Dibi asked whether ministers pressured Geert Wilders not to broadcast Fitna, whether intelligence services were used against him or Parliament members, and related conduct shown in the HUMAN documentary. The minister answered that conversations with Wilders are public, declined to disclose Council of Ministers deliberations or the Landsadvocaat advice, denied AIVD involvement in a decision, and confirmed that the Wiv 2002 bars surveillance of parliamentarians absent serious threat grounds.
As is known, no statements may be made about the deliberation and decision-making in the Council of Ministers.
Zoals bekend mogen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de beraadslaging en de besluitvorming in de Raad van Ministers.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister-president en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hun werkbezoek aan de Amerikaanse president Obama (ingezonden 28 november 2011).

An MP asked the prime minister and foreign minister whether they would press the US government on ratifying the Rome Statute during their working visit to President Obama, and why the topic would not be raised. The minister answered that there was no suitable opening for it, that the Dutch position was already known, and that raising it again would add little value given Congress's unwillingness to ratify.
During this visit there is no suitable opportunity to promote ratification of the Rome Statute by the American Congress.
Tijdens dit bezoek is er geen geschikte mogelijkheid om ratificatie van het Statuut van Rome door het Amerikaanse Congres te bevorderen.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Defensie over de brief inzake het CTIVD-onderzoek (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

MP Pechtold (D66) asked the Defence Minister for an immediate substantive response to the CTIVD report on the role of the MIVD and AIVD in the Libya evacuation mission, and how its findings relate to the minister's earlier letter and factual account. The government's reply, sent by Ministers Hillen and the Interior Minister, is a notice that the written questions were answered in a separate letter on the CTIVD report.
Can you, preferably immediately but in any case by 20:30 this evening, respond substantively to the CTIVD report?
Kunt u liefst per ommegaande – maar in ieder geval voor 20:30 uur hedenavond – inhoudelijk reageren op het rapport van de CTIVD?
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Nederland een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt over het Midden-Oosten blokkeert (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the Netherlands blocked a joint EU statement on the Middle East, whether it was instructed personally, and why it objected to certain wording such as the two-state solution, the arrest of activists and house demolitions. The minister answers that the Netherlands proposed balanced text, denies personal instruction and early notice, and states that the two-state solution remains Dutch policy while the draft was unbalanced.
No, instructions were given through regular official channels.
Nee, instructieverlening vond plaats langs reguliere ambtelijke lijnen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ruim driehonderd geloofsgemeenschappen in Hongarije niet langer erkend dreigen te worden (ingezonde

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Dutch government about Hungary's new church law, which would deregister 348 of 362 religious communities from 2012 and may conflict with the ECHR, EU values and the EU Charter. The government answered that registration regimes are not inherently unlawful, shared concern about ECHR compatibility, raised the issue with Hungarian parliamentarians, and stated the EU Charter does not apply to this law.
I first note that a registration regime for religious communities as such is not unusual and does not necessarily conflict with any norm of international law.
Ik stel voorop dat een registratieregeling voor kerkgenootschappen als zodanig niet ongebruikelijk is en niet bij voorbaat strijdig hoeft te zijn met enige internationaalrechtelijke norm.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over ophoging van de Palestijnse VN-status (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would support an upgraded UN status for the Palestinians that Netanyahu reportedly accepted, and whether it would block EU consensus or had been too quick to oppose unilateral statehood. The minister answered that the government will support steps that bring negotiations closer, works with the EU and all parties, and says it has played a constructive role, without committing to a specific vote.
The cabinet will support proposals that bring the resumption of negotiations closer and can therefore count on the cooperation of all parties involved.
Het kabinet zal voorstellen steunen die de hervatting van de onderhandelingen dichterbij brengen en dus op medewerking van alle betrokken partijen kunnen rekenen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Hachchi (D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Israëlische antiboycotwet (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli anti-boycott bill, which would make calling for boycotts a civil wrong and allow damages without proof of harm, conflicts with freedom of expression and whether it shields settlements. The minister said the law may conflict with freedom of expression, that the Israeli Supreme Court is reviewing it, that settlements are contrary to international law, and that the Dutch government opposes boycott calls in this context while noting Israel's democratic debate.
I am not anticipating the judgment of the Court.
Ik loop niet op het oordeel van het Hof vooruit.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over onjuiste informatie in debat met de Kamer, met name over onderwijsuitgaven (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

D66 MPs Pechtold and Van der Ham asked Prime Minister Rutte whether his claim that the Netherlands ranks fifth on the Global Competitiveness Index for education spending was correct, given that the GCI ranks it eighth and contains few education indicators. Rutte answered that his statements were based on the GCI and OECD data, that the Kennisinvesteringsagenda is not a better basis, and that the cabinet will keep drawing on multiple sources.
No. The statements were supported by the cited GCI and OECD figures.
Nee. De uitspraken waren onderbouwd door de genoemde cijfers van GCI en OESO.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een olie-embargo tegen Syrië (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about Italy's reported delay of an EU oil embargo on Syria, whether the government would back categorical oil sanctions, and whether Shell had been asked about its responsibility during the Syrian crisis. The minister answered that the government has consistently pushed for broad sanctions that hit the regime but spare the population, that an import ban on Syrian crude is central, and that the government has intensified contacts with Shell on the situation and possible steps, without committing to a specific action on Shell.
the cabinet has consistently worked within the EU for sanctions against the Syrian regime that are as broad as possible
heeft het kabinet zich in EU-verband voortdurend ingespannen voor zo breed mogelijke sancties tegen het Syrische regime
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse bijdrage aan de toekomst van Libië (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister about the Dutch role in Libya's transition, a stepwise plan for a post-conflict political settlement, cooperation with the African Union and Arab League, unfreezing Libyan assets for humanitarian aid, ICC prosecution of Libyan suspects, and a 72-hour answer deadline. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs an inclusive democratic transition under the National Transitional Council with UN coordination, promised to inform parliament later when conditions allow, released 100 million euro of frozen assets at WHO's request, and confirmed support for ICC prosecutions and a prompt answer.
Given the fluid nature of the current situation, the intention is to inform the House further when circumstances and the state of international consultations allow.
Gezien het fluïde karakter van de huidige situatie bestaat het voornemen de Kamer nader te informeren wanneer de omstandigheden en de stand van het internationaal overleg dat mogelijk maken.
Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de door het Israëlische parlement aangenomen «antiboycotwet» (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether he knows of the Israeli anti-boycott law, how he assesses it, and whether he shares the US view that it violates fundamental democratic rights, and whether he will press Israel on it. The minister answered that the law is debated in Israel, that it can be challenged before the Supreme Court, that he agrees free expression is a basic right, but that he sees no reason to act.
I see no reason to do so, see answers 2 and 3.
Ik zie hiertoe geen aanleiding, zie antwoorden 2 en 3.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over antihomo-uitspraken van een Indiase minister (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

Two MPs from D66 asked the Dutch foreign and education ministers how they would respond to a report that an Indian health minister called homosexuality a disease, and whether they would raise concerns with India and seek an EU condemnation. The minister answered that such statements would be unacceptable, that the Indian minister said his words were misquoted and meant HIV/AIDS, and that the issue of discrimination based on sexual orientation was raised during a visit to India.
If the person concerned had made the statements in question, that would have been unacceptable to the government.
Indien betrokkene bedoelde uitspraken had gedaan, was dat voor de regering onacceptabel geweest.

Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks), Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mediasituatie in Arabische landen, en

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and PvdA asked the government about internet and media restrictions in Yemen and Bahrain during protests, including whether the Netherlands would condemn these as strongly as Libya, and what it would do to secure internet access. The government answered that it condemns the restrictions wherever they occur, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU, supports media projects, and declined to answer the questions before the scheduled debate.
This has unfortunately not proved possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het onderzoek naar de vliegramp in Tripoli (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

MP Pechtold asks the foreign minister whether international rules bar the investigation bodies from publishing anything without Libya's consent, how this fits earlier promises to publish partial reports, why next of kin have heard little since May 2011, and what is being done to speed up the Tripoli crash investigation. The minister confirms ICAO rules require Libyan consent for independent publication, says contact with next of kin runs through Slachtofferhulp Nederland with a meeting planned, and states that Nederland will press for faster completion while depending on the Libyan situation.
Unfortunately, since my speech on 12 May no information has become available to share with the next of kin.
Helaas zijn er sinds mijn toespraak op 12 mei nog geen gegevens beschikbaar gekomen om te delen met de nabestaanden.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de verklaring van de ingenieur van Royal Haskoning aangaande de mislukte helikopterevacuatie in Sirte, Libië (ingezonden 20 j

Pechtold (D66) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about an engineer's Nieuwsuur interview claiming he was unaware his helicopter evacuation from Sirte was secret, that he waited with luggage on the beach, and that his account conflicts with the crew's reconstruction. The ministers replied that the engineer was asked not to talk about the operation, that the government stands by its earlier documents, and that they did not advise or forbid him from speaking publicly.
Whether the engineer also spoke with others about it is not known.
Of de ingenieur hier ook met anderen over heeft gesproken is niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het uitgevaardigde arrestatiebevel voor Kadaffi (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

MP Pechtold asked the foreign minister for the government's reaction to the ICC arrest warrant for Gaddafi and its plan to enable his prosecution, as requested in a motion. The minister welcomed the warrants, said primary responsibility for arrest and surrender lies with Libya under UNSC resolution 1970, and said the Netherlands would support enforcement and press Libya through the EU and international community.
The Netherlands will support the efforts to carry out the arrest warrants.
Nederland zal de inspanningen om de aanhoudingsbevelen uit te voeren steunen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een VN-onderzoek naar de vliegramp in Tripoli (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the ministers whether they would ask ICAO to start an investigation into the 2010 Tripoli air crash, since Libyan authorities had not finished their inquiry after a year. The state secretary replied that ICAO rules put the investigation under Libyan lead, that ICAO can only act with Libya's explicit consent, which seems unlikely given the situation, and that the Netherlands will press for a swift conclusion.
The ICAO Convention provides no possibility to take independent action without consent or a request from the member state responsible for the investigation.
Het ICAO-verdrag kent geen mogelijkheid om zonder toestemming of zonder verzoek van de voor het onderzoek verantwoordelijke lidstaat, eigenstandig acties te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie en verdwijning van de Chinese kunstenaar Ai Weiwei (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about the detention and disappearance of Chinese artist Ai Weiwei, whether the government would protest, whether it saw a broader crackdown on dissidents, and how it supports human rights and media freedom in China. Minister Rosenthal answered that the Netherlands expressed concern, raised the case with Chinese authorities and through the EU, monitors the human rights situation, and supports media freedom projects, without committing to new specific actions beyond existing diplomacy.
I have taken note with concern of the arrest of Ai Weiwei.
Ik heb met bezorgdheid kennisgenomen van de aanhouding van Ai Weiwei.

Vragen van de leden Roemer (SP), Cohen (PvdA), Wilders (PVV), Sap (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Blok (VVD), Slob (ChristenUnie), Thieme (PvdD), Pechtold (D66) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van V

MPs from ten parties asked the state secretary of Security and Justice why Germany refused to extradite the fugitive war criminal Klaas-Carel Faber, whether German nationality obtained through a Hitler decree was the reason, and whether the Netherlands would press Germany to enforce the sentence. The minister answered that a Munich court refused extradition because Faber is a German national who did not consent, that German authorities also consider him German without the decree, and that letters were sent to the Bavarian and federal German justice ministers asking that the sentence be enforced in Germany.
By letter of 31 May 2011 I made known to the Minister of Justice of the German state of Bavaria the importance I attach to the law taking its course in this case.
Bij brief van 31 mei 2011 heb ik het belang dat ik eraan hecht dat in deze zaak het recht zijn loop krijgt kenbaar gemaakt aan de Minister van Justitie van de Duitse deelstaat Beieren.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Nederlandse optreden ten aanzien van de huidige situatie in Syrië (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands responded to Syrian security forces' violence against protesters and what concrete steps were taken, including EU sanctions, arms embargo, UN action and access for international observers and journalists. The minister said the government was shocked, backed suspension of the EU aid programme and association talks, supported EU sanctions and an arms embargo, backed UN Human Rights Council action, and would keep pressing Syria on media access.
I am shocked by the violent conduct of the Syrian authorities against demonstrators.
Ik ben geschokt over het gewelddadige optreden van de Syrische autoriteiten tegen betogers.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitwet in Oeganda (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands would respond to a possible revival of Uganda's anti-homosexuality bill that imposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps it would take with the EU, the Ugandan authorities and local NGOs. Minister Rosenthal answered that the Netherlands, the EU and donors had repeatedly raised concerns at the highest levels, that the bill was unlikely to pass before parliament's term ended, and that NGO funding would continue for now.
This private member's bill dates from 2009.
Dit initiatiefwetsvoorstel van een individueel parlementslid dateert van 2009.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het personeelsbeleid op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (ingezonden

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi (D66) asked about staff policy at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, including reassignment practices, retention of young staff, trainee prospects, age-neutral cuts and HDPO conflict of interest. Minister Rosenthal answered that the ministry disagrees with the critics, cites staff departure and promotion figures, and says the reassignment system is being reviewed with the works council and unions.
It is foreseen that proposals for adjustments will be the subject of consultation with the works council and the unions within a few months.
Voorzien is dat voorstellen voor aanpassingen over enkele maanden onderwerp van overleg met de Ondernemingsraad en de vakbonden zullen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

MPs asked whether the cabinet's speed-limit increase to 130 km/h could be measured by kilometres of road where 130 km/h is allowed, what the targets and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The minister confirmed the plan, described an eight-stretch dynamic-speed experiment (about 330 km) and a goal of at least a third of motorways at 130 km/h this term, and said accountability would be given during budget debates without fixed annual targets.
The cabinet will account for this during the budget debate.
Het kabinet zal bij de begrotingsbehandeling verantwoording afleggen.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de escalatie van de Nederlands-Iraanse betrekkingen. (Ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch-Iranian relationship was escalating and whether a mediator should be appointed to de-escalate it. The minister denied escalation, said existing communication channels were sufficient for now, and said consultations with the recalled ambassador were ongoing.
The government does not consider that there is currently a further escalation of tensions in the bilateral relations.
De regering is niet van mening dat thans sprake is van een verdergaand proces van escalatie van spanning in de bilaterale betrekkingen.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het terughalen van de Nederlandse ambassadeur uit Teheran (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister why the Dutch ambassador was recalled from Tehran, whether it is for consultation or indefinitely, and how the Netherlands' diplomatic support for detained Dutch nationals is safeguarded. Minister Rosenthal answered that the ambassador was recalled for consultations after the funeral of Mrs Baahrami, that diplomatic contacts with Iran should continue, and that embassy staff continue consular work in his absence.
I have decided to recall the Dutch ambassador to The Hague for consultations this week.
Ik heb besloten de Nederlandse ambassadeur deze week naar Den Haag terug te roepen voor consultaties.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the cabinet measures Dutch knowledge-economy position, what the baseline and interim targets are for reaching the global top 5, and how it will be held accountable. The minister answered that the position is based on the Global Competitiveness Index, that sub-targets with concrete benchmarks will follow in the 2012 budget, and that annual reporting will occur through the departmental annual report.
The chosen sub-targets for education, science and innovation will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De gekozen subdoelstellingen voor onderwijs, wetenschap en innovatie zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD), aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister to specify measurable, enforceable CO2 targets for 2020, including Mton limits inside and outside the ETS, interim targets, foreign allowance purchases and accountability. The state secretary confirmed the 20% target, explained the EU ETS and non-ETS split, said the exact Dutch non-ETS figure awaits a PBL analysis and a spring 2011 letter, and promised such clarity then.
Due to uncertainties it is too early to draw conclusions, but the Netherlands appears to be on track with current policy to achieve sufficient reduction in the non-ETS sectors.
Door onzekerheden is het te vroeg conclusies te trekken, maar Nederland lijkt met het huidig ingezette beleid goed op weg om voldoende reductie in de niet-ETS sectoren te realiseren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable targets, indicators, baselines, interim goals, instruments and accountability for the government's inland shipping investments meant to relieve roads and the environment. The minister listed indicators (lock passage times, waterway norm compliance, emissions, incidents), pointed to the annual report and planned targets for 2012 onward, and referred the jeugdzorg budget question to another minister.
For the accessibility of waterways, annual target values are formulated.
Voor de bereikbaarheid van vaarwegen worden jaarlijkse streefwaarden geformuleerd.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable, verifiable government targets on backlog maintenance of flood defences and on how the government will report on progress each year. The state secretary answered that the existing 6-yearly assessment cycle sets the framework, that a new flood-protection programme (HWBP3) and an integral safety programme will be presented before the 2012 budget, and that progress will be reported through the budget cycle and separate programme reports.

As I promised in a Second Chamber debate on 13 December 2010, I will present an integral safety programme before the 2012 budget, giving insight into the flood-safety task in the coming years and the costs involved.

Zoals, tijdens een debat in de Tweede Kamer op 13 december 2010 door mij is toegezegd, zal ik vóór de begroting 2012 een integraal veiligheidsprogramma aanbieden dat inzicht zal bieden wat de waterveiligheidsopgave de komende jaren zal zijn en welke kosten daarmee gepaard zullen gaan.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de executie van de Nederlands-Iraanse Zahra Bahrami (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the execution of Dutch-Iranian Zahra Bahrami, including the adequacy of diplomatic efforts, the refusal to give a fuel guarantee to Iran's foreign minister, and remarks linking the fuel issue to the execution. The minister answered that diplomatic channels were used, that the fuel decision was not linked to the execution, and that a factual account would be provided.
Yes. See the letter to parliament dated 3 February 2011.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen over

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the cabinet targets a quarter less asylum inflow, 30% less regular inflow and 50% less non-Western inflow by 2015, and how it will be accounted for. The minister confirmed the package aims at a very substantial decline, but said no intermediate targets exist, that the effects cannot be quantified precisely, and that inflow will be reported to parliament twice a year.
No intermediate targets have been set, other than the annual savings and investment amounts included in the financial section of the coalition agreement.
Er zijn geen tussendoelen vastgesteld, anders dan de in de financiële paragraaf van het regeerakkoord opgenomen jaarlijks te besparen en te investeren bedragen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

Opposition MPs asked the cabinet how performance pay for teachers would be defined, measured, funded and accounted for, and when the goals would be met. The state secretary answered that experiments with performance pay will be set up with CPB and Erasmus University from 2012, structural introduction from 2014-2015 at the earliest, and accountability via the departmental annual report, while leaving the criteria, the size of the pay rise and the number of teachers affected undecided.
The starting point in designing the various experiments is that they provide sufficiently objectifiable information for the eventual design of the measure.
Het uitgangspunt bij de uitwerking van de verschillende experimenten is dat zij voldoende objectiveerbare informatie leveren voor de uiteindelijke vormgeving van de maatregel.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over internationale beleidsbeïnvloeding op het gebied van LHBT-emancipatie en LHBT-men

MPs Pechtold and Dijkstra asked about Dutch support for LGBT organisations such as COC in international fora and whether the programme subsidy would continue after 31 December 2010. The minister said LGBT emancipation remains a priority, that the COC subsidy request will be assessed alongside others after 31 March 2011 without a bridging arrangement, and that maintaining expertise is the COC's own responsibility.

In the short term you will receive a memorandum from the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, setting out this cabinet's intentions regarding the promotion of, among other things, homo-emancipation.

Op korte termijn ontvangt u een notitie van de minister van OCW, mede namens de minister van BZ, waarin de voornemens van dit kabinet op het gebied van de bevordering van onder andere homo-emancipatie nader uiteen worden gezet.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

Six opposition MPs asked the Interior Minister how the government's planned wage freeze in the public sector would be measured, what milestones apply, how it would be achieved and how it would be accounted for. The minister answered that the target is the budgetary yield (EUR 870 million structurally by 2015), that the measure is legally feasible, that wage talks with unions start when existing collective agreements expire, and that accountability occurs in the spring budget cycle, giving little measurable detail.
The goal is the budgetary yield of structurally 870 million.
Het doel is de budgettaire opbrengst van structureel 870 mln.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet will progressively restrict social rental allocation to lower-income groups and for measurable targets, definitions, interim goals, instruments and accountability. The minister confirmed the policy, pointed to the temporary regulation requiring at least 90% of low-rent homes go to households below a set income, and said he will assess housing corporations annually from 2012 against these rules.
Failure to meet these requirements may lead to withholding of compensation (state aid).
Het niet voldoen aan deze eisen kan leiden tot onthouden van compensatie (staatssteun).

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs asked the government to define measurable, accountable targets, baselines, interim goals and reporting for the planned Randstad Infrastructure Authority, and whether powers over transport and infrastructure would transfer from national, provincial and municipal government to it. The minister deferred substantive answers to a vision note due in March 2011, noting the Randstad plan is one of 17 reforms that will be accounted for in the policy agenda.

During the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior on 1 December 2010, I promised you that in March 2011 I would present a vision note on the organisation and functioning of domestic governance.

Tijdens de behandeling van de begroting voor Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties op 1 december 2010 zegde ik u toe in maart 2011 te komen met een visienota inzake de inrichting en functioneren van het binnenlands bestuur.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the education minister whether the cabinet's target of cutting early school leavers to at most 25,000 covers all leavers, what interim targets and instruments exist, and how progress will be reported. The minister confirmed the 25,000 target for 2014/2015, set 35,000 for 2010/2011, promised a letter by March 2011 and a shift to a percentage norm, and pointed to budgeted funds and annual reporting to parliament.

By March 2011 at the latest I will send a letter to the House of Representatives with the results for school year 2009/2010, in relation to the current early school leaving covenants with municipalities, schools and institutions.
Uiterlijk maart 2011 stuur ik een brief naar de Tweede Kamer met het resultaat van het schooljaar 2009/2010, in relatie tot de huidige vsv-convenanten met gemeenten, scholen en instellingen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs asked the education minister which performance targets, indicators, baselines and milestones the cabinet will use to meet its promise that education performance will rise, and how it will act and report. The minister answered that targets and indicators will be specified in the 2012 budget, that a baseline is the September 2010 value, and that progress will be reported through the departmental annual report and OCW monitoring publications.
The sub-objectives and associated effect and performance indicators will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De subdoelstellingen en bijbehorende effect- en prestatie indicatoren zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the cabinet aims to reach more children through early childhood education (vve), what the baseline is, and how targets, selection, instruments and annual accountability will be set. The minister confirmed the aim, cited about 28,000 children in preschool and 25,000 in early primary education, and deferred detailed targets, measures and planning to a letter in spring 2011, while stating annual accountability via the departmental annual report.
In that letter I will make the objectives of the vve policy more concrete and add a planning of the actions I undertake.
In die brief maak ik de doelstellingen van het vve-beleid concreter en voeg daar een planning bij van de acties die ik onderneem.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbar

Six opposition MPs asked the state secretary for health how the government's planned reform of youth care would be measured, including baseline, interim targets, and how a €300 million cut fits with improving effectiveness. The state secretary said the reform aims at integrated care, stronger self-reliance and less bureaucracy, with municipalities made responsible, and that accountability would follow the regular cycle, without giving concrete measurable indicators or targets.
The cabinet will account for this within the regular cycle.
Het kabinet zal binnen de reguliere cyclus verantwoording afleggen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

MPs from several parties asked the minister whether the cabinet's target of 12,000 extra nurses is measurable and accountable, including its exact definition, baseline, interim targets and reporting. The state secretary answered that the target is about enabling 12,000 extra staff in care, that no other measurable indicators or interim targets exist yet, and that a visiejbrief and a joint labour market agenda will follow with annual reporting.
Annual reports will be published under the Labour Market Care and Welfare Research Programme, containing overviews of the number of nursing, care and social pedagogical staff.

Wel worden in het kader van het Onderzoeksprogramma Arbeidsmarkt Zorg en Welzijn jaarlijks rapporten gepubliceerd, waarin overzichten zijn opgenomen over het aantal verplegend, verzorgend en sociaal agogisch personeel.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

Seven opposition MPs asked the Health Minister whether the government's goal of improving elderly care quality has measurable targets, indicators, a baseline, interim goals, and a plan with accountability. The state secretary answered that no measurable indicators or interim targets were set, that existing sector quality indicators are used, and referred to the coalition agreement and an upcoming vision letter for measures.
The exact goal is not expressed in measurable indicators.
Het exacte doel is niet uitgedrukt in meetbare indicatoren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabine

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister for measurable, accountable targets for narrowing the AWBZ eligibility group, including indicators, baselines, interim goals, measures and annual accountability. The state secretary answered that no measurable indicators, baseline or interim targets exist beyond financial figures, and referred to the coalition agreement and a forthcoming policy letter for measures and timing.
The exact goal is not expressed in measurable indicators. No effect or performance indicators are used.
Het exacte doel is niet uitgedrukt in meetbare indicatoren. Er worden geen effect- en prestatie-indicatoren gehanteerd.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister for measurable, verifiable targets behind the government's plan to freeze the group eligible for the health care allowance (zorgtoeslag). The minister answered that only the budgetary targets in the coalition agreement's financial annex apply, that eligibility figures for 2011 can only be established later, and that accountability will follow the regular cycle.
There is no target in the coalition agreement regarding the number of health care allowance users.
Er staat geen doel in het regeerakkoord ten aanzien van het aantal zorgtoeslaggebruikers.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the health minister whether the cabinet intends to expand market competition in curative care, and for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, milestones and accountability arrangements for that goal. The minister confirmed a package of measures (wider free pricing, uniform product definitions, abolishing functional funding, profit distribution under conditions, the Wet Marktordening Gezondheidszorg) and promised letters in early 2011, with half-yearly progress reports to parliament.
I aim to address, in early 2011 letters, the goals, instruments and means regarding the cabinet agenda on market forces in curative care and performance-based funding.
Ik streef er naar om begin 2011 in genoemde brieven in te gaan op de doelen, instrumenten en middelen met betrekking tot de kabinetsagenda rondom marktwerking in de cure en prestatiebekostiging.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afrekenbare en controleerbare

MPs asked the economics minister for measurable, checkable targets, baselines and milestones for the government's plan to concentrate business subsidies on top sectors. The minister confirmed the plan but deferred concrete indicators, instruments and budgets to a business policy letter and a mid-2011 update, and pointed to the annual report for accountability.
The House of Representatives will be informed around mid-2011 about the concrete elaboration of business policy, particularly regarding the top sectors.
De Tweede Kamer zal medio 2011 worden geïnformeerd over de concrete uitwerking van het bedrijfslevenbeleid, in het bijzonder met betrekking tot de topgebieden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Six MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines and interim milestones for improving SME access to government tenders. The minister confirmed the goal but deferred measurable indicators and milestones to a later memorandum, citing measures in the new Procurement Act and an evaluation after four years.
The cabinet will go into this further in the memorandum in response to the report on the bill for the new Procurement Act.
Het kabinet zal hier verder op ingaan bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag bij het wetsvoorstel voor de nieuwe Aanbestedingswet.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

Six opposition MPs asked ministers for measurable, checkable targets for abolishing the numerus fixus in medicine, including student numbers, interim goals and accountability. The government confirmed the coalition agreement's five-year abolition plan but deferred the concrete indicators, targets and instruments to a later response to the advisory council's report.
The response to the RVZ advice will further address the elaboration of the coalition agreement.
In de reactie op het advies van de RVZ zal nader worden ingegaan op de uitwerking van het regeerakkoord.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs for measurable, enforceable targets for 14% renewable energy by 2020, including baselines, interim milestones and how the government will be held accountable. The minister confirmed the 14% target (about 290 PJ), stated no interim targets will be set, deferred a fuller assessment and promised an SDE+ evaluation in 2014 and an annual accountability letter in May.
The cabinet does not set interim targets for the individual years.
Het kabinet hanteert geen tussendoelstelling voor de afzonderlijke jaren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabine

Six opposition MPs asked the health minister whether the cabinet will move conditions with low disease burden out of the basic health insurance package, and asked for measurable, accountable targets, definitions, baselines, interim goals and accountability arrangements. The minister confirmed removal from the basic package to save 1.3 billion euros from 2015, said the government does not decide what supplementary insurers cover, and promised a plan of action in early 2012 while giving no interim targets and only general accountability through the regular cycle.
Not at this moment. The low-disease-burden approach requires further elaboration.
Op dit moment niet. De benadering via het lage-ziektelastcriterium vereist nadere uitwerking.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs from several parties asked the minister whether the cabinet aims for 2% annual energy savings until 2020 and requested measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim goals, actions and accountability. The minister answered that the cabinet has no separate energy-saving target, that targets are EU climate and renewable goals, and that existing covenants will continue alongside a planned Green Deal, with a letter on the Green Deal promised for February 2011.

As indicated in the answer to question 1, this cabinet has no separate target for energy saving. There will therefore be no baseline measurement, interim targets, measurable indicators or progress reports.

Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven, heeft dit kabinet geen separate doelstelling voor energiebesparing. Van nulmeting, tussendoelen, meetbare indicatoren en voortgangsrapportages zal dan ook geen sprake zijn.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs asked the Interior Minister for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim milestones and accountability arrangements for the planned reduction of elected and executive political office holders in municipalities, provinces, water boards and the national parliament. The minister confirmed a reduction of at least 25% for local and provincial bodies and one-third for each chamber of parliament, with the baseline set at current membership and constitutional and statutory amendments to follow in 2011, but gave no interim targets or detailed reporting schedule.
A constitutional amendment is required to reduce the number of members of the States General. The cabinet will bring a proposal for such an amendment into procedure in 2011.
Voor de vermindering van het aantal leden van de Staten-Generaal is grondwetswijziging vereist. Het kabinet zal daartoe in 2011 een voorstel tot grondwetswijziging in procedure brengen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the cabinet aims to cut administrative burden for businesses by 10% by 2012 and 5% yearly thereafter, and how this target would be measured, achieved, verified and accounted for. The minister answered that all seven questions, including the measurability and accountability of the targets, will be addressed separately in a regulatory burden letter to be sent in February 2011.
The question on the accountability and verifiability of cabinet targets regarding administrative burden and regulatory pressure will be answered separately in the Regulatory Burden letter.
De vraag over omtrent de afrekenbaarheid en controleerbaarheid van kabinetsdoelen met betrekking tot administratieve lasten en regeldruk, zal separaat beantwoord worden in de Regeldrukbrief

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the economics minister for measurable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and reporting timelines for the government's aim to strengthen links between knowledge, research and innovation policy. The minister confirmed the aim but deferred concrete indicators, targets and budgets to a forthcoming business policy letter and topic-area agendas, with accountability via the annual report.
The House of Representatives will be informed around mid-2011 about the concrete elaboration of business policy, particularly regarding the top sectors.
De Tweede Kamer zal medio 2011 worden geïnformeerd over de concrete uitwerking van het bedrijfslevenbeleid, in het bijzonder met betrekking tot de topgebieden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

Seven opposition MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet's right-to-buy goal for corporation tenants has measurable targets, annual sales figures, interim milestones, legal obstacles and instruments. The Minister confirmed the intention, but said detailed answers would come in a spring 2011 elaboration and it was premature to answer the specifics now.
As indicated, your House will receive an elaboration of the passage in the Coalition Agreement in spring 2011. It is premature to go into parts of that elaboration now.
Zoals aangegeven ontvangt uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2011 een uitwerking van de passage in het Regeerakkoord. Het is prematuur om nu al op onderdelen van die uitwerking in te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked the Minister of Interior how the cabinet's plan to allow rent increases of inflation plus 5% for tenants of regulated homes with incomes above 43,000 euro would be made measurable and accountable, including targets, indicators, milestones, instruments and reporting. The Minister confirmed the coalition agreement policy as the starting point and referred all the measurement and target questions to a forthcoming housing vision.
For the answers to these questions I refer to the housing vision I promised to send to your House.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen verwijs ik naar de door mij aan Uw Kamer toegezegde woonvisie.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the cabinet how it will measure and achieve measurable quality targets for higher education linked to the social loan system, including criteria, benchmarks, milestones, instruments and accountability. The State Secretary answered that the money will be invested in higher education quality, that criteria and targets will be set out in the cabinet response to the Veerman commission and the Strategic Agenda, and that accountability runs through the regular departmental annual report.

For the answer to this question I refer you to the cabinet response to the Veerman commission report, which you will receive in February, and to the Strategic Agenda for Higher Education and Research (June 2011).

Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord op deze vraag naar de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de commissie-Veerman die u in februari a.s. ontvangt en naar de Strategische Agenda voor het Hoger Onderwijs en Onderzoek (juni 2011).

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over afrekenbare en controleerbare

MPs asked whether the cabinet will pursue a substantial cut in Dutch EU contributions and a structural 1 billion euro reduction, and for measurable targets, baselines, milestones and accountability. The state secretary confirmed the aim, explained that the current 1 billion rebate continues until 2013 with no savings booked, and that a substantial reduction is pursued from 2014, but gave no measurable indicators, milestones or accountability arrangements, deferring details to later letters.
You will be informed in due course about the cabinet's precise position on the new financial perspectives.
U zult te zijner tijd worden geïnformeerd over de precieze inzet van het kabinet ten aanzien van de nieuwe financiële perspectieven.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoele

MPs asked the state secretary whether the cabinet will cut development aid from 0.8% to 0.7% of GNI, which missions, reception of unaccompanied minors and the World Broadcasting Service will be paid from the development budget, and what measurable, time-bound goals and accountability apply. The answers confirm the cut and the financing of DAC-eligible parts, defer goals and indicators to the 2012 budget, and promise accountability through the annual report.

During the elaboration of the policy review along the lines set out in the basic letter of 26 November 2010, the goals will be further specified and, where possible, accompanied by effect and performance indicators, baseline measurements and interim targets.

Tijdens de uitwerking van de herziening van het beleid langs de lijnen zoals uiteengezet in de basisbrief dd 26 november 2010, zullen de doelen nader gepreciseerd worden en daar waar mogelijk worden vergezeld van effect- en prestatie-indicatoren, nulmetingen en tussentijdse doelen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afrekenbare en controleer

MPs asked the Justice minister whether the national police is under ministerial responsibility, what measurable indicators, interim targets, steps, timing and annual accountability apply to forming a national police force. The minister confirmed ministerial responsibility, cited goals such as less bureaucracy and more effective investigation, but deferred timing and interim targets to the pending police law amendment, promising indicators where possible and reporting through the annual report.

The pace of forming the national police and the interim steps to be taken are first determined by the process of legally regulating the national police through an amendment to the police bill previously submitted to the House.

Het tempo van de vorming van de nationale politie en de te zetten tussenstappen worden allereerst bepaald door het proces om nationale politie wettelijk te regelen via een wijziging van het eerder bij de Kamer ingediende wetsvoorstel

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Defensie over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen met betrekking t

MPs from several parties asked the defence minister whether the cabinet's structural defence cuts of 635 million euros (possibly reaching one billion) are correct, what the JSF cost overrun means, and what measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and accountability arrangements exist for these cuts. The minister confirmed the phased cut and the possible one billion euro total, said a policy letter next spring will set out measures including a review of the F-16 replacement project, and deferred the measurable-target and accountability questions to the 2012 budget, pointing to existing progress reports.
On Budget Day I will inform the House further in the 2012 budget about the measurability of objectives and results and how Defence can (further) account for them.
Met Prinsjesdag zal ik in de begroting 2012 de Kamer nader informeren over de meetbaarheid van doelstellingen en resultaten en de manier waarop Defensie (verder) verantwoording kan afleggen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afrekenbare en controleer

MPs asked whether the cabinet will raise the detection rate for serious crimes by 25%, double convictions for robbery, and speed up simple criminal cases, and asked for measurable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and reporting arrangements. The minister confirmed the three targets, said progress will be monitored and reported in the annual report from 2011 and in a letter to parliament, and described general means but gave no specific indicators, baselines or interim targets.
The cabinet will monitor progress towards the targets based on figures from, among others, the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the Council for the Judiciary.
Het kabinet zal de voortgang van realisatie van de doelstellingen monitoren op basis van cijfermateriaal van onder meer de politie, het Openbaar Ministerie en de Raad voor de Rechtspraak.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over afrekenbare en controleer

Seven MPs from across the opposition asked the Minister of Security and Justice for measurable targets, indicators, yearly milestones, funding adequacy and reporting for the planned 3,000 additional police officers. The minister referred to a letter of 14 December 2010 for most questions and said the 1 January 2011 operational strength baseline was not yet known, to be reported in June.
For answering these questions I refer for brevity to my letter to the House of Representatives of 14 December 2010.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik kortheidshalve naar mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 14 december 2010
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de Tsjechische homotest (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

MP Pechtold asked whether the Czech phallometric test used on gay asylum seekers, which the EU fundamental rights agency found violates privacy, has stopped and what the government will do at EU level. The minister agreed the test is incompatible with European and international treaties, confirmed it is no longer used, and saw no need for further measures beyond existing Council of Europe recommendations.
I therefore see no need for additional measures.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak tot aanvullende maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Financiën over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen met betrekking

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister for measurable, accountable targets on sound public finances, including indicators, baselines, interim targets, actions and reporting. The minister confirmed the goal of restoring the budget, pointed to the Startnota expenditure and revenue frameworks and an 18 billion euro package in 2015, but declined separate effect and performance indicators and gave only general reporting through budget documents.
Apart from the stated objective, using separate effect and performance indicators is not under consideration.
Naast genoemde doelstelling is het hanteren van separate effect- en prestatie-indicatoren niet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een kerosinestrijd met Iran (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

Pechtold (D66) asks the foreign minister about reports that fuel suppliers at Schiphol stopped supplying kerosene to IranAir after the Iranian foreign minister cancelled his OPCW visit to The Hague, and whether the government advised or pressured fuel suppliers. Minister Rosenthal answers that the government gave no advice to the US or other governments, applies EU sanctions which allow kerosene supply, attributes supplier decisions to individual companies, and says the EU sanctions deliberately exclude fuel supply.
No. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs only contacted the US to learn the precise scope of the US sanctions legislation CISADA.
Nee. Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft enkel contact opgenomen met de VS om de precieze reikwijdte van de Amerikaanse sanctiewetgeving CISADA te vernemen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afrekenbare en controleerbar

MPs ask the Minister of Interior Affairs for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim milestones, instruments and accountability arrangements for the cabinet's plan to scale up provincial government in the Randstad. The minister replies that a vision memo on internal governance will follow in March 2011, that the Randstad plans are one of 17 cabinet reforms, and that progress will be reported in the policy agenda and annual report.
In this memo I will also address the cabinet's intentions regarding the scaling up of provincial government in the Randstad.
In deze nota zal ik ook in gaan op de kabinetsvoornemens inzake de opschaling van het provinciaal bestuur in de Randstad.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over afreke

MPs asked whether the cabinet aims to reduce civil servants across all government tiers, and asked for measurable targets, interim goals, instruments and annual accountability. The minister replied that the goal is a smaller state expressed as a financial cut of EUR 6.6 billion structurally (EUR 1.8 billion for central government), not in headcount, with an implementation programme to be sent to parliament before March 2011 and annual accountability on Accountability Day.
It concerns a financial target that has not been translated into numbers of persons or fte's.
Het betreft een financiële taakstelling die niet is vertaald in aantallen personen of in fte's.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Social Affairs whether the cabinet is cutting childcare allowance, what the effects, measurable goals, indicators, baselines and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The objectives of the cabinet policy based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

Opposition MPs asked the Social Affairs minister for measurable, checkable targets for phasing out the transferable general tax credit in the reference minimum wage and for its effects on benefits, purchasing power and budget. The minister gave brief answers, mostly referring to future budget indicators, and confirmed a bill for 2012 without giving baseline or interim targets.
The cabinet's policy objectives based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments, income and budget effects for a unified regime for the lower labour market (Wajong, Wsw, WWB).
