Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of diensten die worden aangeboden op websites als coronaverlies.nl legitiem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Justitie wil coronahoesters verplicht laten testen of ze willen of niet'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice whether suspects who spit or cough on victims while claiming to have COVID-19 can be compelled to submit to testing, and whether the Besluit bloedtest in strafzaken should be amended. Minister Grapperhaus answered that COVID-19 was not yet listed, that he is willing and intends to amend the decree to allow compulsory testing, and that the charge depends on the circumstances.
For this reason, the relevant laws and regulations, including the Besluit bloedtest in strafzaken in geval van een ernstige besmettelijke ziekte, will be amended accordingly.
Daarom wordt de relevante wet- en regelgeving, waaronder het Besluit bloedtest in strafzaken in geval van een ernstige besmettelijke ziekte, hierop aangepast.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Dam en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker: we moeten meer begrip hebben voor ‘morele verwondingen’ bij ex-militairen’

MPs Van Dam and Van Raak asked the Justice and Security Minister about moral injury among police and ex-military and about PTSD compensation for police officers, including restschade procedures, the Beroepsincidenten Regeling, and volunteer police. The minister answered in detail on the current compensation and procedural framework, acknowledged difficulties in the process and promised a reform of the system, while not addressing moral injury beyond a definition.

Within the framework of improving the system for occupational diseases, occupational incidents and service accidents, the system of compensation for pain and suffering and residual damage is being revised.
In het kader van de verbetering van het stelsel beroepsziekten, beroepsincidenten en dienstongevallen wordt het systeem van smartengeld en restschade herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Getraumatiseerde agenten die schade claimen jarenlang ‘juridisch tegengewerkt’ door de politie’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that police-officer PTSS claimants were legally obstructed by the police, including the role of the 'Buitensporigheid' commission, its composition and funding, and why few cases were judged excessive. The minister answered that the commission advises the insurer (and the police) on whether incidents are excessive under case law, that it has few mandates or formal rules beyond that, and that the police and insurer share a law firm and no difference in treatment has been found.
Within the framework of improving the system for occupational diseases, occupational incidents and service accidents, the position of the commission is being examined.
In het kader van de verbetering van het stelsel beroepsziekten, beroepsincidenten en dienstongevallen wordt de positie van de commissie bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Toegang tot politieopleiding te krap afgesteld’

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that access to police training is too restricted, given the plan to recruit 17,000 officers, and about entry routes, a pilot evaluation and a transitional career-path rule. The Minister says the training is being shortened and reviewed, the entry test for candidates without a regular vooropleiding is still in force but barely used, the pilot report is still a draft, and the transitional rule is aimed at serving staff rather than returners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Neergestoken taxichauffeur knokt voor gerechtigheid'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how a suspect released after an assessment by the Opvang Verwarde Personen (OVP) could later stab a taxi driver while fully insane, who was responsible, whether the driver received compensation, and whether the taxi driver was warned. The Minister answered that the OVP found insufficient grounds for detention, that police cannot inform taxi drivers about passengers for privacy reasons, and that the victim may apply to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, without discussing the individual case in detail.
I cannot go into an individual case. Civil proceedings are also still ongoing.
Ik kan niet op een individuele zaak ingaan. Ook lopen de civiele procedures nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de tolkcontactapp

MP Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the Tolkcontact app enabling deaf and hard-of-hearing people to reach 112, covering costs, tourists, chat options and a UK silent-solution system. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the app and Total Conversation software are available, insurance may cover costs, the police are developing a free 112 app expected in autumn 2020, and no UK-style system is planned.
I regard good accessibility and availability of emergency communication between emergency services and citizens as an important task.
Ik zie goede bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van noodhulpcommunicatie tussen de hulpdiensten en burgers als een belangrijke taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Agressie tegen verkeersregelaars in Twente neemt toe: we zijn tandeloze tijgers’

An MP asked ministers whether aggression against traffic controllers is rising and whether they fall under the joint police-prosecution agreements on violence against public-task workers, and whether they should get enforcement powers. The minister answers that no registration data exists, that traffic controllers are covered by the agreements, but that giving them special investigative-officer status is not appropriate under the current division of tasks.
There are no registration figures available for the occupational group of traffic controllers on aggression and violence in their sector.
Er zijn geen registratiecijfers beschikbaar van de beroepsgroep verkeersregelaars over agressie en geweld in hun branche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'OM: verdachten alleen nog aangehouden bij ernstige feiten'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's temporary decision to arrest suspects only for serious offences during the coronavirus crisis, and whether crimes exploiting the crisis require tougher enforcement. The minister explains the scaled-back but continuing operations, stresses that prosecution is postponed rather than dropped, and commits to firm action and fast-track procedures against crisis-related fraud.
The Public Prosecution Service emphasises that this is a temporary working method and that it does not mean prosecution of criminal offences is cancelled, but postponed.
Het OM benadrukt dat het gaat om een tijdelijke werkwijze en dat het niet gaat om afstel van de vervolging van strafbare feiten, maar om uitstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Exclusief: Interview Citrix CISO, Fermín Sera, waar ging het mis?'

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice minister whether the Citrix vulnerability could have been prevented by timely application of the interim fix, why Dutch government bodies were affected, and whether a legal standoff period before public disclosure should be set. The minister answered that the NCSC advised quickly, government bodies were advised to apply mitigations, no misapplication by government was found, the case is being evaluated, and that a 60-day guideline exists but policy is left to vendors and organisations.
This case is being evaluated on the instructions of the Minister of Justice and Security.
Deze casus wordt geëvalueerd in opdracht van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Contractors lay off 80 workers at Statia’s oil storage terminal’

Mr Van Dam (CDA) asked about reports that around 80 contract workers were laid off at the Statia oil terminal, its effect on the island's economy, and the ILT's enforcement against GTIS. The government answered that about 115 people were dismissed mostly by subcontractors for cost reasons, that the ILT started enforcement over late tank inspections and fire-fighting systems, and that the government is developing an economic strategy for the island.
Statistics Netherlands (CBS) cannot provide specific figures on GTIS for reasons of confidentiality.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) kan om redenen van vertrouwelijkheid geen specifieke cijfers over GTIS geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Dam over het voornemen van de Nationale Politie tot sluiting van de arrestantencomplexen van de politiebureaus van Doetinchem, Deventer, Ede en Tiel

MPs Van der Graaf and Van Dam asked whether the minister would send the external consultancy's future scenarios for closing police cell complexes in Eastern Netherlands and what the latest decision status is. The minister declined to send the scenarios, saying the decision process is still ongoing with local mayors and stakeholders, and that the current cells remain in use until a decision at a regional meeting in Q2 2020.
Because the decision-making process has not yet been completed, I do not consider it opportune at this stage to send the study with future scenarios.
Omdat het besluitvormingsproces nog niet is afgerond, acht ik het toesturen van het onderzoek met toekomstscenario’s in dit stadium niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over een ‘Decision on interim measure’ van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

An MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about a European Court of Human Rights interim measure concerning a suspect held beyond 10 days in the Philipsburg police cells, and about detention conditions on Sint Maarten. The minister answered that the detainee was transferred to Point Blanche prison, that Sint Maarten lacks prison capacity and has adjusted its procedure, and that the Netherlands is concerned but Sint Maarten must act, with container cells offered as support.
It is up to Sint Maarten to take measures to improve the situation.
Het is aan Sint Maarten om maatregelen te nemen om de situatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Minister Grapperhaus pleit bij Europese Unie voor achterdeur in encryptie’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that he urged the EU to create a backdoor in encryption, including the technical options for WhatsApp, Telegram and criminal platforms and whether encryption key length could be legally limited. The minister answered that broader encryption hampers investigations, that options for lawful access are being examined in consultation with public and private parties within the 2016 cabinet position, and that lawful interception of specific communications is being explored.
The options for lawful access to communications and their advantages and disadvantages are currently being examined.
De mogelijkheden om rechtmatige toegang tot communicatie te verkrijgen en de voor- en nadelen daarvan worden momenteel bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Doofpot A.R. duurt voort. Hoe de politie voorkomt dat maatregelen tegen agenten uitgevoerd worden’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about a case of alleged ethnic profiling by police in Enschede, including a premature police press release naming the officer, the handling of internal and criminal investigations, and whether the case is used in police training. The minister declines to discuss individual casuistry given an ongoing criminal case, acknowledges the press release was premature, and promises an external evaluation of internal investigation processes with results expected in autumn 2020.
I do not go into individual casuistry. In addition, a criminal case is still ongoing, so as usual I cannot comment on it.
Ik ga niet in op individuele casuïstiek. Daarnaast loopt er op dit moment nog een strafzaak waardoor ik hier zoals gebruikelijk geen uitspraken over kan doen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over Officieren van Justitie die in de fout zijn gegaan

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice about prosecutors (OM) who made errors, the adequacy of judicial review under article 359a Sv, disciplinary oversight and the Ombudsman complaint figures. The Minister replied that article 359a has a limited purpose, that a reflection chamber on OM quality was set up, that a letter on OM oversight and the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure will follow.
The article therefore has a limited purpose and does not aim to regulate comprehensive supervision of the OM.
Het artikel heeft derhalve een beperkt doel en beoogt geen alomvattend toezicht op het OM te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van Dam en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Overheid sponsort eigen verzet’

MPs asked whether government-subsidised legal aid for environmental and other organisations suing the state, including squatter-type groups, is appropriate and whether the practice is being evaluated. The minister answered that subsidised legal aid can cover administrative cases, that stacking of procedures is possible but no business model is evident, that eligibility rules apply, and that the long-overdue evaluation of the reduced environmental-organisation contribution will be shared with parliament in the first half of 2020.
This evaluation, however, never took place and is now being carried out after all.
Deze evaluatie heeft evenwel nooit plaatsgevonden en wordt nu alsnog uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Misdaadregistratie loopt vast’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the OM's case-registration system GPS is unstable and slow, its consequences for prosecution and the criminal chain, and the digitisation plans. The Minister confirmed performance problems since August 2019, said a fallback to the older Compas system exists and is used selectively, and that capacity has been freed to fix the issues, while digital document exchange with police is not yet operational.
The College of Procurators-General has freed up capacity and budget to resolve the problems.
Door het College van procureurs-generaal is capaciteit en budget vrijgemaakt om de problemen op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Gratis deurbellen tegen criminaliteit: het twijfelachtige effect en de privacyzorgen'

An MP from CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about privacy and effectiveness concerns around free digital doorbell cameras used against burglary, including how pilot projects select suppliers, handle data retention and third-party access, inform participants, and protect privacy. The Minister answered that pilots are run by municipalities under the GDPR with a Programme of Requirements, data is viewable only by the user, footage is kept at most 28 days, and privacy compliance is the responsibility of municipalities and the Data Protection Authority.
For the pilot, all parties involved must comply with the General Data Protection Regulation.
Voor de pilot geldt dat alle betrokken partijen moeten voldoen aan de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Weer hoofdofficier weg bij OM'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice about complaints concerning members of the College of Procureurs-Generaal and the procedure for handling them, following a press report on a prosecutor leaving the OM. The Minister answered that two complaints were filed since the Fokkens report, each handled by a separate ad hoc complaints committee, describing the committee's fact-gathering and the general complaints procedure while declining to discuss individual case details.
Since the publication of the Fokkens committee report, two complaints about conduct of members of the College have been filed with my ministry.
Sinds het verschijnen van het rapport van de commissie Fokkens zijn twee klachten tegen gedragingen van leden van het College bij mijn ministerie aanhangig gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Nederland draait op voor Antilliaanse douanefraude'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands is liable for customs fraud by the Antilles (Curaçao and Aruba), including the case's timeline, the Kingdom's legal status as an EU member, LGO status, and the division of competences within the Kingdom. The government explained the liability under the EU's Court of Justice ruling, stated that the ruling does not change obligations of the Caribbean countries, and said that the implications are being examined under a parliamentary motion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Weer hoofdofficier weg bij het OM'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about a complaint over undesirable conduct filed by CVOM staff against a chief prosecutor, shortly after the Fokkens commission report. The minister confirmed the complaint, its handling via two separate advisory-committee procedures, and the appointment process, but declined to discuss its content because of the ongoing complaint procedure.
Regarding the nature and content of this complaint, I will not make any statements, given its confidentiality.
Over de aard en inhoud van deze klacht doe ik, in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid daarvan, geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Gevangenis Pointe Blanche: The Devil’s Rock van Sint Maarten'

An MP asked about reports on the Pointe Blanche prison in Sint Maarten, progress on improvement measures, the status of Council of Europe supervision after the Corallo judgment, and whether TBS (ter beschikking stelling) can be imposed and executed in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The Minister reported slow progress on prison improvements, marine assistance in late October and November, periodic monitoring with Sint Maarten, that Council of Europe assessment is awaited in early 2020, and that TBS is executed by the countries themselves with no facilities in the Netherlands.
With Sint Maarten, progress on the agreed improvement measures is reviewed every 2 weeks.
Met Sint Maarten wordt elke 2 weken gekeken naar de voortgang van de afgesproken verbetermaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Harddrugs gevonden bij een militair op marineschip Curaçao’

Members of parliament asked whether cocaine was found on a navy ship in Curaçao, about the zero-tolerance drug policy, drug seizures from Curaçao, and the working of drug scanners at Curaçao's airport and port. The government confirmed about 11 kg of suspected cocaine found with a soldier, explained its zero-tolerance policy and seizure figures, and said border controls on Curaçao are an autonomous matter, with Schiphol applying 100% Customs checks on arrivals.
Two incidents are still under criminal investigation and no further information can be given on them at this time.
Twee incidenten worden nog strafrechtelijk onderzocht en daarover kan op dit moment geen nadere informatie worden gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Dam over het voornemen van de nationale politie tot sluiting van de arrestantencomplexen van de politiebureaus van Deventer, Doetinchem, Ede en Tiel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the national police's plan to close the custody facilities at four police stations in Eastern Netherlands, citing longer transport times and reduced police capacity. The Minister replied that the police and the local authority are responsible for how operations are organised, that an external study is ongoing with a decision not yet taken, and that the police will consult local authorities without committing to preserving the cells.
It is up to the police and the local authorities to ensure that, with proposed changes to operations, basic police care remains in order.
Het is aan de politie en het lokale gezag om er bij voorgenomen wijzigingen ten aanzien van de bedrijfsvoering voor te zorgen dat de basispolitiezorg op orde blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het fenomeen ‘voorgenomen beslissing’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the 'voorgenomen beslissing' practice and whether suspects are generally given a chance to present their view before a summons is issued. The minister answered that a suspect is usually heard (verhoor) before summons across nearly all criminal investigations, with exceptions such as an unfindable suspect, and clarified that 'zienswijze' refers to a response to the facts underlying the suspicion.
Following these questions, the OM has again informed me that it is customary that, in (nearly) all criminal investigations, the suspect is heard before the summons is issued.

Naar aanleiding van onderhavige vragen heeft het OM mij nogmaals laten weten dat het gebruikelijk is dat ten aanzien van (vrijwel) alle strafrechtelijke onderzoeken voorafgaand aan het uitbrengen van de dagvaarding de verdachte wordt verhoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Kabinet geeft groen licht voor volledig vuurwerkverbod in Apeldoorn, maar Raad van State twijfelt’

An MP asked whether the Raad van State's advice on the Vuurwerkbesluit allows municipalities to impose a full fireworks ban, and how this squares with its reported doubts. The government answered that the Vuurwerkbesluit is not exhaustive, so municipalities can use their autonomous ordinance powers to ban fireworks in zones or their whole territory, citing the 2016 Raad van State ruling.
The Vuurwerkbesluit does not stand in the way of such a municipal fireworks ban.
Het Vuurwerkbesluit staat niet in de weg aan een dergelijk gemeentelijk vuurwerkverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Jagers: voorlopig geen e-screening voor wapenvergunning’

MPs Van Dam and Von Martels (CDA) asked Minister Grapperhaus about the suspension of the e-screener for hunters and sport shooters, the seizure of weapons after negative results, and the legal protection available to licence holders. The minister said only new applicants will be screened with the e-screener for two years, that weapons will be returned case by case under a three-category approach, and that objection and appeal procedures remain available, while declining to meet the one-week deadline.
As I indicated in my letter of 29 October, it is being examined promptly, case by case, whether weapons are returned.
Zoals ik aangaf in mijn brief van 29 oktober wordt voortvarend van geval tot geval bekeken of wapens worden teruggegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Von Martels en Palland over het bericht 'Brandweer dreigt alle vrijwilligers kwijt te raken'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports that the volunteer fire service risks losing its volunteers due to the Wnra civil service law, and about recruitment, diversity and the working group. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Wnra does not itself threaten volunteerism, that a working group and recruitment programme are underway, and that the Wnra's entry into force for fire services is postponed pending clarity.
It is not correct that the Wnra civil service law causes the fire service to risk losing its volunteer character.
Het klopt niet dat de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra) ervoor zorgt dat de brandweer haar vrijwillige karakter dreigt te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over foto’s gemaakt kort na de moordaanslag op Kelvin Maynard op 18 september 2019 in Amsterdam

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice and Security about photos of the dying Kelvin Maynard, taken by firefighters and circulated in the media, and about police exclusion of press. The Minister acknowledged the photos were taken by fire service personnel and are being investigated by an external bureau, with measures to follow, and explained the police's press policy and cautions for responders.
On the region's instruction, an external bureau is conducting an investigation into the making and distribution of the photos taken at the crime scene.
In opdracht van de veiligheidsregio voert een extern bureau een onderzoek uit naar het maken en het verspreiden van de foto's die op de plaats delict zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Ik heb een paar mannen pissed off gemaakt , interview Fatima Aboulouafa teamchef politie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police team chief's interview, requested an overview of the current police top leadership with names and appointment dates, and asked about the Strategic Positions leadership programme. The minister confirmed knowledge of the interview, provided a full list of the police top with appointment dates, and described the programme's start, duration and participant outcomes.
Attached to this you will find an overview of this public information.
Hierbij treft u een overzicht aan van deze openbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Wapenopslagplaatsen vol: Nederland voldoet niet aan wapenregels EU’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Dutch firearms storage was full and that the country was not meeting EU weapons rules on deactivated firearms. The minister said he was unaware of full storage, that the police became the competent authority on 23 July and began issuing certificates from 1 October, and that the Verona system and extra funding were in place.
I am not aware that weapons storage facilities are full.
Mij is niet bekend dat wapenopslagplaatsen vol zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Taakstrafverbod voor geweld tegen agenten is onzinnig’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether police figures show rising violence against police officers, whether the claim of one incident per hour is accurate, whether the rise is a registration effect, and how such incidents are recorded. The Minister confirms the reported figures, says a registration effect cannot be established on available information, explains the recording systems and provides incident counts, while noting that the breakdown by occupational group is not possible.
Whether there is a registration effect and whether it explains the increase in GTPA registrations (wholly or partly) cannot be established on the basis of the available information.
Of er sprake is van een registratie-effect en of dit de toename in GTPA registraties (geheel, of gedeeltelijk) verklaart, is op basis van de beschikbare informatie niet vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht “Fraudehelpdesk in Apeldoorn moet miljoenen gegevens van fraudeurs vernietigen”

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens refusing a data-processing permit to the Fraudehelpdesk, forcing destruction of fraud data, and whether a statutory basis for cross-sector fraud data sharing is needed. The minister answered that the permit was refused as insufficiently substantiated, that the existing GDPR/UAVG framework already permits such sharing with a permit, that no new legislation is yet warranted, and that the AP is responsible for the permit decision.

I have heard that the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) did not grant the permit requested by foundation Safecin for the Fraudehelpdesk because the application did not yet meet requirements and must be further completed and substantiated in parts.

Ik heb vernomen dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (hierna: AP) de door de stichting Safecin ten behoeve van de Fraudehelpdesk aangevraagde vergunning niet heeft verleend omdat die aanvraag nog niet voldeed en op onderdelen nader ingevuld en onderbouwd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Bosman over de politieke situatie op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Dam and Bosman asked whether the Sint Maarten premier's description of ungovernability, lack of integrity and disregard for the constitution is accepted, what the Kingdom can do under the Statute to restore a functioning democratic rule of law, and whether unorthodox measures are considered. The State Secretary expressed concern and said the Kingdom must stay alert and use available instruments, but stressed Sint Maarten's autonomy, the need for great restraint, and a preference for cooperation over intervention.
That is why the Dutch government is closely monitoring this situation, all the more given our involvement in reconstruction and strengthening the rule of law in Sint Maarten.
Daarom houdt de Nederlandse regering deze situatie wel nauwlettend in de gaten, temeer gelet op onze betrokkenheid bij wederopbouw en het versterken van de rechtsstaat in Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Oud-studenten op Curaçao in financiële problemen door DUO’

CDA MPs Van Dam and Van der Molen asked the Education Minister about reports that at least a hundred former students on Curaçao got into financial trouble through DUO's communication and collection practices, including a Curaçao minister's claim of a non-integrous approach with a local bailiff. The minister said DUO had not received concrete cases, rejected the claim as unsupported, promised to examine specific cases, and committed to a joint meeting with the Curaçao minister and on-site DUO staff to help debtors.
DUO has asked the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sport for concrete cases in which something would have gone wrong, but has not yet received them.
DUO heeft het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Wetenschap, Cultuur en Sport (OWCS) gevraagd naar concrete zaken waarin iets zou zijn misgegaan, maar deze nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Apple deelde herleidbare, persoonlijke gegevens bij opnames Siri-gebruikers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether Apple's sharing of identifiable Siri recordings violated privacy, what the Dutch privacy regulator AP had done, which law applies and where citizens should complain, and what the government would do about privacy risks in tech. The ministers answered that the AP is a concerned authority while the Irish regulator leads, that AVG complaint routes exist, that current law is largely adequate with the AVG evaluation to address data volume and profiling, and that a public campaign on privacy will start in spring 2020.
It is up to the competent privacy supervisors in the EU to start an investigation into Apple's conduct.
Het is aan de bevoegde privacytoezichthouders in de EU om een onderzoek te starten naar het handelen van Apple.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Gedode Albanees Lato had eigen leger in Gelders dorp’

MPs Van Dam and Van Wijngaarden asked whether Festim Lato, shot dead in the Netherlands, had a private army, whether authorities ignored signals, and whether residents were endangered. The minister denied the private-army characterisation, said police monitored the address and seized weapons, and that no action was needed against a private army absent evidence of one.
I share the view that it would be an unacceptable situation if someone were to maintain an (armed) private army there.
Ik deel de mening dat het een onacceptabele situatie zou zijn indien iemand er een (bewapend) privéleger op zou nahouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over advocaten die stoppen met rechtsbijstand

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers quitting legal aid, especially youth criminal duty (piket) work, due to low fees and the new juvenile suspect rules. The Minister acknowledged the signals, reported declining registered lawyers and piket participation, and pointed to a fee measure, a €10 million innovation fund and the ongoing system reform as responses.
As Minister for Legal Protection I bear responsibility for a sufficient supply of lawyers, including by providing reasonable remuneration for the work to be performed.

Als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming draag ik een verantwoordelijkheid voor een voldoende aanbod van advocaten, onder meer door het bieden van een redelijke vergoeding voor te verrichten werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Oekraïne laat belangrijke MH17 verdachte vrij”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Dam asked whether an MH17 suspect released by a Ukrainian court could still be held available for the Dutch investigation and what the government had done to prevent his release and transfer in a prisoner exchange. The minister answered that the Ukrainian court released him in an unrelated case, that diplomatic efforts were made at the highest level, and that after the exchange the Public Prosecution Service requested his detention with a view to extradition from Russia.
The Dutch Public Prosecution Service has indicated it wants Mr Tsemach kept available for the investigation into the downing of flight MH17.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft aangegeven de heer Tsemach beschikbaar te willen houden voor het onderzoek naar het neerhalen van vlucht MH17.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over de berichten ‘Verkeerde afslag politie’ en ‘OV-bedrijven gaan boerkaverbod niet handhaven’

CDA MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked the ministers how enforcement of the face-covering ban in public transport and public buildings is working after police statements suggested reluctance to prioritise it. The minister replied that the ban must be enforced, that police have aligned their communication with the law, that police can be called in via escalation, and that the law will be evaluated three years after entry into force.
De wet dient te worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Sneek calls for speed-up of road-building project'

An MP asked about reports that the Cherry Tree Road renovation on Sint Eustatius is delayed and whether the road network will be maintained long-term. The government confirms a delay caused by a dispute over cement type, sets a new completion date of March 2020, and says a maintenance plan for 2020-2023 will follow in autumn.

Between the public body and the contractor, new agreements have also been made on the conditions under which the contractor may still complete the project, with a delayed completion date of March 2020 at the latest.

Tussen het openbaar lichaam en de aannemer zijn daarnaast nieuwe afspraken gemaakt over de voorwaarden waaronder de aannemer het project alsnog, met een vertraagde opleverdatum van uiterlijk maart 2020, mag afmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Dagelijks rechten geschonden’ inzake het gevangeniswezen op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the government about reports of daily rights violations in Sint Maarten's prison, including cell confinement, lack of rehabilitation and psychiatric care, and suspects being sent home instead of held in pre-trial detention. The State Secretary answered that prisons are a country matter, cited the minimum two hours outdoor time and limited reclassering capacity, referred the release policy to Sint Maarten authorities, and said the Corallo supervision and 11 transferred containers cells are being monitored.
It is not for me to assess the factual findings presented in the article.
Het is niet aan mij om de in het artikel weergegeven constateringen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over de gevolgen van de problemen bij het Sehos-ziekenhuis in Willemstad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Dam asked about the consequences of the Sehos hospital problems in Curaçao for Bonaire patients, including referrals, waiting lists, costs and the hospital's finances. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao is responsible for hospital care, that few Bonaire patients go to Sehos for non-urgent surgery, that reimbursement of travel costs applies, and that the financial supervisor monitors the situation.
Curaçao, as an autonomous country, is itself responsible for (hospital) care.
Curaçao is als autonoom land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de (ziekenhuis)zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilliger in ruil voor een weekje aan zee’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police capacity shortages in holiday areas, including reports that municipalities rent holiday accommodation for volunteer police officers. The minister answered that seasonal peaks are common across holiday regions, that police units support each other and mayors can request assistance, and that the municipal arrangements are an innovative solution he praised, while promising to explore further cooperation with partners such as DJI for prisoner transport.
If local cooperation partners see options for more intensive cooperation, I will investigate what is legally possible.
Indien lokale samenwerkingspartners opties voor intensievere samenwerking zien, dan zal ik onderzoek doen naar wat er wettelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Politie jaagt nabestaanden onnodig op kosten na een overlijden: Bedragen lopen op tot zeshonderd euro'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police pass costs of transporting bodies to mortuaries on to bereaved families when death proves natural. The minister explained the cost-allocation scheme, the 2017 tender for transport, and that the next tender is planned for 2025 under the then-current scheme.
I understand that bereaved families may find this unpleasant in some cases.
Ik begrijp dat de nabestaanden dit in sommige gevallen als vervelend kunnen ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘De voorzitter van moskeekoepel CMO houdt er alweer mee op’

MPs Van Dam and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government engages with the Contactorgaan Moslims en Overheid (CMO), its membership, representativeness and agenda, after reports that its chairman was stepping down. The ministers answered that the CMO is the government's contact body for Muslim communities, lists its member organisations, and state that the government has no specific agenda with the CMO and that representation is up to the organisations themselves.
The cabinet has no specific agenda in advance for contact with the CMO.
Het kabinet heeft op voorhand geen specifieke agenda voor het contact met de CMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de berichten 'Sint Maarten niet ver verwijderd van een blokkade internationaal betalingsverkeer' en 'FATF geeft Sint Maarten ervan langs'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked whether FATF pressure could block international payments for Sint Maarten and affect the BES islands, and about the status of anti-money-laundering laws and the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The State Secretary answered that a public warning would bring extra due diligence or, at worst, transaction refusals, that Sint Maarten has adopted some laws with others still pending, and that the government will report on BES banking by year end.
At the end of this year, your House will be informed about the progress.
Eind dit jaar wordt uw Kamer over de voortgang geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over  het  bericht 'Nederland stuurt Yezidi’s terug naar de tentenkampen en dat is tegen eigen regels zeggen advocaten'

CDA MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the Netherlands is returning Yazidis to camps in northern Iraq, whether the policy changed, and how many genocide victims received protection and perpetrators are prosecuted. The State Secretary answered that individual asylum assessments apply, that Yazidis who lived in the Kurdistan Region after fleeing other parts of Iraq are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, and that the Netherlands prosecutes international crimes while leading international evidence mechanisms, though the government does not register asylum grounds by group and gave no case figures.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pay extra attention to the Yazidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Politieacademie past fitheidstest aan na klachten'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister whether adjusting the police Professioneel Fit test relates to the police recruitment shortage, whether the VU study will be shared, which changes were made, and whether rejected candidates will be re-invited. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the changes aim at fairness and objectivity rather than easing the test, that the full VU report is expected after summer 2019, and that previously rejected candidates will not be re-invited, though they may retake the test.
Yes, the full research report is expected after the summer of 2019 and will be made available to you as soon as it is ready.
Ja, het volledige onderzoekrapport wordt na de zomer van 2019 verwacht en u ter beschikking gesteld zodra gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Koppen rollen door crisis Politieacademie'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a press report on leadership turmoil at the Police Academy, whether governance gaps contributed, and how candidates can contest recruitment decisions. The minister confirmed the governance gaps contributed, said a new mandate arrangement is being prepared, and explained that candidates cannot appeal selection decisions but can object and request reconsideration.
The identified lack of integrality did indeed influence the situation within the management team of the Police Academy.
Het geconstateerde gebrek aan integraliteit is inderdaad beïnvloedend geweest op de ontstane situatie binnen het directieteam van de Politieacademie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Vuurwerk afgestoken bij ArenA ondanks verbod'

Member Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police did not intervene when fireworks were set off at the ArenA despite a ban, and how the football fireworks programme and enforcement procedures work. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police weigh escalation risks against direct intervention, that the mayor chose not to act in this crowd situation, and that clubs, KNVB, police and prosecutors follow set procedures and stadium bans.
At every police intervention a weighing is made between the importance of direct and visible action and the risk of escalation.
Bij elk politieoptreden wordt een afweging gemaakt tussen het belang van direct en zichtbaar optreden en het risico op escalatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van der Molen en Van Dam over de inzet van een gebarentolk bij crisiscommunicatie door de overheid en bij persconferenties van de overheid

CDA MPs asked whether sign-language interpreters should be used in government crisis communication and press conferences, after the Utrecht attack gave deaf people no interpretation. The ministers answered that a plan of action will be sent to parliament after the summer, that transcripts of post-cabinet press conferences are published, and that the government does not consider the UN disability convention breached.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Nieuwe procedure voor benoemingen topstructuur OM’

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about a new OM procedure for appointing top prosecution posts, including whether it opens recruitment from outside and promotes diversity and rotation. The minister answered that the procedure was agreed with the central works council, that vacancies are opened more widely with external advisory committees, and that the Fokkens report was sent to parliament on 25 April.
A new element is that the committees are supported by an external process facilitator.
Een nieuw element is dat de commissies worden begeleid door een externe procesbegeleider.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Venezuela belangrijk thema op Koninkrijksoverleg’

An MP asked the government about Aruba's push for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, the Caribbean visa framework, alleged visa fraud by Dominicans and overstay figures. The minister said no common Kingdom position exists yet, that Aruba will first exhaust national measures, and that the government sees no organised visa abuse but will keep monitoring.
Neither the Ministry of Foreign Affairs nor the Aruban authorities have any knowledge of organised abuse of Caribbean visas for Aruba.
Er is bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noch bij de autoriteiten van Aruba iets bekend over georganiseerd misbruik van Caribische visa voor Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het onderzoek ‘Naar een efficiëntere noodhulp’ van Politie en Wetenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Police and Science study on more efficient emergency response, including the leadership role of operational coordinators and whether there is structural overcapacity in police basic teams. The Minister agreed there is room for more efficient deployment, said the study is too small for general conclusions, and pointed to ongoing police work on the GGP development agenda and a leadership review.
I do point out that the study was limited in scope and is therefore less suitable for drawing general conclusions about organising more efficient emergency response.
Ik wijs er wel op dat het onderzoek een beperkte omvang had, en daarom minder geschikt is voor het trekken van algemene conclusies over de organisatie van een efficiëntere noodhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het statement gemaakt door de (werkgroep Legal Affairs en Human Rights van de) Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Council of Europe PACE working group statement on prosecutions facing Laura Codruța Kövesi, a candidate for European Public Prosecutor, and whether the government would seek clarification from Romania and condemn it. The minister replied that the government greatly values her anti-corruption work and wants all candidates treated fairly, that it is closely following the case, and that the Romanian courts must first rule on the cases.
However, it is first and foremost for the Romanian judge to rule on the cases brought against Ms Kövesi.
Het is nu echter allereerst aan de Roemeense rechter om zich uit te spreken over de zaken die zijn aangespannen tegen mevrouw Kövesi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bunker van nazikopstuk uit foute handen houden’

CDA MPs asked whether the government would halt the sale of Seyss-Inquart's former Nazi command bunker in Wassenaar, which is a rijksmonument, and whether specific conditions should apply given its wartime heritage character. The state secretary confirmed awareness and the rijksmonument status, and said a Nota van Uitgangspunten setting planning conditions and a pre-selection of qualified buyers would govern the sale, without halting it.
The outcome of close cooperation with the municipality of Wassenaar, the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is a Nota van Uitgangspunten to be drawn up.
Uitvloeisel van de nauwe samenwerking met de gemeente Wassenaar, de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed en het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is een op te stellen Nota van Uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Heel zuur dat er door de politie niets aan gedaan wordt’

MPs Van Dam and Van den Berg asked the Justice Minister why police in Zeeland do not pursue thefts of farmers' GPS systems, and how often and where such thefts occur. The minister answered that theft of GPS systems is not separately registered, that investigations follow prioritisation under the Public Prosecution Service and depend on evidence, and that farmers may rely on insurance.
Theft of GPS systems is not registered under a separate code.
Diefstal van GPS-systemen wordt niet onder een aparte code geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Laan-Geselschap, Groothuizen en Van Dam over de procedure en de capaciteit bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

MPs asked about budget problems at the Council of Europe and the European Court of Human Rights, the reopening of Dutch criminal cases after a unilateral state acknowledgement of a Convention breach, and extra staff for Dutch cases at the Court. The minister said the Netherlands must meet its payment obligations and wants the Court spared from cuts, that the government will examine whether the reopening rules need amending, and that talks are underway on extra support for the Court's registry.

In view of this, I will examine whether amending the statutory provisions is necessary and desirable to ensure that revision is possible on the basis of a decision by the ECtHR following a unilateral government declaration that the Convention has been breached.

Gelet hierop zal ik bezien of aanpassing van de wettelijke regeling nodig en gewenst is om te verzekeren dat herziening mogelijk is op grond van de beslissing door het EHRM na een eenzijdige verklaring van de regering dat het verdrag is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Toezegging van minister voor volwaardig politiebureau in Noordwijk’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police team office in Noordwijk would close, whether this conflicts with the 2025 housing list and the 2012 implementation plan, and what it means for response times and service. The Minister confirmed the office will close once a smaller replacement with public counter opens, stated the housing list is not binding and that merging three basic teams into two is a management matter agreed with local authorities, with the Chamber's role limited to later budget scrutiny.
Police housing locations are closed only in agreement with the local authority, taking into account police accessibility as well as the quality of police work and service.

Het sluiten van huisvestingslocaties gebeurt uitsluitend in overeenstemming met het gezag, daarbij wordt rekening gehouden met de bereikbaarheid van de politie alsook de kwaliteit van het politiewerk en de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Gezaghebber over vertraging verkiezingen: ‘Dit mag nooit meer gebeuren’’

Mr. Van Dam (CDA) asked about reports of long queues, identification problems and 47 missing ballots during the March 2019 elections on Bonaire. The minister answered that all voters in line were able to vote, identification caused no problems, the ballot discrepancies have several possible causes, and the elections will be evaluated with an OAS observer report and possible expert support for the island.
The public body has been asked to fill in a questionnaire on the organisation and course of the elections.
Het openbaar lichaam is daartoe gevraagd een vragenlijst in te vullen over de organisatie en het verloop van de verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het commentaar 'Analyse: Curaçao staat voor kantelpunt'

An MP asks whether Curaçao requested the Council of Ministers to apply Article 25 of the financial supervision law, what other options exist, and whether the Kingdom will inform parliament of its decision. The State Secretary confirms a letter was sent, promises to share it after deliberation, lists the available instruments, and says he cannot yet give a timeline for the decision.
I am willing to send the letter to your House after it has been discussed in the Council of Ministers.
Ik ben bereid na behandeling in de Rijksministerraad de brief aan uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘OM Eist 45 maanden cel tegen corrupte aspirant-agent‘

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a case in which a corrupt police trainee accessed confidential criminal investigation information, and how access, logging and new police systems are controlled. The minister answered that authorisation follows screening and role-based access, that logging and a pilot to detect atypical use exist, and that new systems will be logged centrally, while pointing to a bill to expand screening.
The authorisation policy was renewed several years ago and applies to the entire police organisation.
Het autorisatiebeleid is een aantal jaren geleden vernieuwd en geldt voor de gehele politieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Zelfstandige tolken met uitsluiting bedreigd'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that independent interpreters are being excluded by a shift to tendered, intermediary-based interpreting services, and whether interpreters can bid directly. The minister confirmed the process, said direct contracting is no longer permitted under EU procurement rules, and promised quality requirements and monitoring in the new tenders.
Clear quality requirements will be formulated in the tender, and quality weighs more heavily than price in the award.
Er worden heldere kwaliteitseisen geformuleerd bij de aanbesteding en kwaliteit weegt zwaarder dan prijs bij gunning.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politiegeweld in zicht: zijn nieuwe geweldsmiddelen nodig?’ en het onderzoeksrapport van Olga Timmer ‘Een onderzoek naar hoe de politie Amsterdam omgaat in GGZ-ins

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police lack a clear power to use force in compulsory mental health care and about a report on police handling of confused persons in Amsterdam GGZ institutions. The Minister answered that police may use force only to end an immediate serious danger to persons, not to assist compulsory care, that the legal framework is known to police, and that the new Ambtsinstructie reporting rules apply.
The authority of the police to use force in a GGZ institution is in the above case limited to ending a serious and immediate danger to persons and is not aimed at assisting compulsory care.

De bevoegdheid tot het gebruik van geweld door de politie in een GGZ-instelling is in vorenstaand geval beperkt tot het beëindigen van een ernstig en onmiddellijk gevaar voor personen en niet gericht op hulp aan gedwongen hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Het nieuwe bekostigingssysteem van het Openbaar Ministerie'

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the new funding system for the Public Prosecution Service, covering how TGO teams are financed, whether a time-recording study is planned, how surplus or shortfall in output is handled, open-ended budgets and innovation costs. The minister answered in detail, explaining the lump-sum versus product funding split, that a time-recording study may be considered, the reserve mechanism, and that special budgets are monitored closely.

For that reason, the OM and I will certainly consider whether a time-recording study – weighing the necessary costs and time burden for those involved – has sufficient added value for the price negotiations.

Om die reden zullen het OM en ik zeker bezien of een tijdschrijfonderzoek – daarbij meewegend de noodzakelijke kosten en tijdbeslag van betrokkenen – voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft voor de prijsonderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Taskforce drugsbestrijding wil legitimatieplicht voor afzender postpakket'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the anti-drug taskforce wants an identification requirement for parcel senders and an end to letter secrecy for PostNL parcels. The minister answers that an ID requirement is disproportionate and would be easily circumvented, and that abolishing letter secrecy would add limited value under current law, while noting an ongoing draft reform and international efforts.
I consider an identification requirement disproportionate for combating drug crime, given the total volume of parcel post, the privacy intrusion and the added administrative burden.
acht ik een legitimatieplicht gelet op het totale volume aan pakketpost, de inbreuk op de privacy en de verzwaring van de administratieve lasten niet proportioneel om drugscriminaliteit tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Onverbeterlijke criminele asielzoeker heeft vrij spel’

CDA MPs asked whether criminal asylum seekers move between reception centres without follow-up or shared records, and whether a national database should be created, citing police criticism. The State Secretary said existing registration and information-sharing have been improved and that a new database would take long, so existing structures will be used in the short term, and he denied that transfers merely shift the problem.
At the JBZ committee meeting on 6 March I indicated that I am willing to examine whether an additional database would add value.
Tijdens het AO JBZ op 6 maart jl. heb ik aangegeven dat ik bereid ben te kijken of een additionele databank meerwaarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Aruba op zwarte lijst EU belastingontwijking’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether Aruba was placed on the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why it was moved from the grey list, what measures Aruba must take, and whether the Netherlands supported Aruba. The State Secretary confirmed the listing, said Aruba committed to repeal its transparency regime and is expected to be delisted at the 16 May Ecofin, and stated no figures are available on Dutch persons using Aruban tax arrangements and that Aruba bears responsibility for its own tax rules.
No figures are known about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het Landelijk Meldpunt Misstanden bij de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the internal whistleblower body (LMM) of the National Police: how many cases it handled in 2017 and 2018, what kinds of matters it receives, how it relates to the Huis voor Klokkenluiders, and how reporters are involved and satisfied. The minister answered in detail, confirming the 31 cases of 2017 (20 in 2018), explaining the procedure and that most matters were individual labour disputes rather than misstanden, and committing to report 2018 figures in the annual report.
The annual report of the police for 2018 will show the number of reports and advice requests for 2018.
In de Jaarverantwoording politie 2018 zullen het aantal meldingen c.q. adviesaanvragen over 2018 worden weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Den Boer, Van der Graaf en Laan-Geselschap over leren van geweld

MPs asked whether the attacks on mosques in New Zealand warranted revising protection policy for mosques and religious institutions, and whether threat levels had changed. The Minister answered that there are no concrete indications the threat to religious institutions has risen, that existing policy and local measures are sufficient, and pointed to guidance documents and his letter of 21 March 2019.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to revise the existing policy.
Op dit moment zie ik daarom geen aanleiding om het bestaande beleid te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het artikel 'Behoefte aan echte reflectie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a newspaper interview with a police officer and about how the national objection and advisory committee (BAC) advice on disciplinary measures against police officers is handled by the police chief. The minister confirmed the facts, gave objection counts for 2016-2018, and reported that in a review of 66 BAC cases the authority departed fully from the advice in six and partly in eight, while declining full statistics without manual file review.
Answering questions 4, 5 and 6 requires manual file research.
Het beantwoorden van de vragen 4, 5 en 6 vergt handmatig dossieronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Twee Amsterdammers aangehouden na reeks plofkraken'

MPs Van Dam and Laan-Geselschap asked the Justice Minister about the trend in ATM explosive robberies (plofkraken), clearance rates, bank and government prevention, pilot approaches, and risks from the new Geldmaat ATM rollout. The minister reported the Dutch count rose in 2015-2016, fell in 2017-2018, and recent data show 13 cases in early 2019, with stricter prosecution guidelines, bank-police-prosecution cooperation, and pilots extended to end 2019.
Because of the large number of ongoing investigations in which further arrests are expected, the number of solved cases will still rise.
Vanwege het grote aantal lopende onderzoeken waarin nog aanhoudingen zijn te verwachten, zal het aantal opgeloste zaken nog stijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Cyberaanval kopen lijkt kattenkwaad, maar is een misdaad’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about cybercrime-as-a-service platforms selling malware, exploit kits and DDoS attacks, including their legal status, enforcement, the difficulty of tracing anonymous providers, and sentencing of providers versus users. The Minister answered that offering and using such services is punishable under the Criminal Code, that police and prosecutors investigate them with international partners, that the Computercriminaliteit III law enables takedown of such services, and that the prosecution guideline allows heavier sentences for providers, while no obligation exists for data centres to keep customer registers.
Criminal action is possible through investigation and prosecution, and by making online marketplaces, websites or parts of them inaccessible.
Strafrechtelijk optreden is mogelijk door opsporing en vervolging, en door het ontoegankelijk maken van online marktplaatsen, websites of delen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security to explain why the price police pay for ammunition is withheld, after a report about costly ammunition at the training range. The minister confirmed the price is commercially confidential, given an ongoing tender, but offered to make it available to the House confidentially under usual conditions.
I am willing to make the information you requested available for confidential inspection by your House under the usual conditions.
Ik ben bereid de door u gevraagde informatie – volgens de gebruikelijke voorwaarden – vertrouwelijk bij uw Kamer ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Krol over het bericht 'Raadslid: Jongeren gooiden mij in de sloot'

MPs Van Dam and Krol asked the Justice Minister why a councillor reporting an assault had to wait two weeks to file a complaint, and whether such delays hinder investigations. The minister answered that police aim for fast, low-threshold reporting, offer aangifte within 48 hours, and that the individual case cannot be discussed while the service is being improved.
I cannot go into the circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en lid Groothuizen over ‘het nieuwe bekostigingssysteem van het Openbaar Ministerie’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the new funding system for the Public Prosecution Service (OM), including the output/lump-sum split, treatment of innovation and overtime costs, whether a time-recording study was done, and evaluation plans. The minister answered that about 43% of the OM budget is output-funded, that no time-recording study underpinned the system, and that a periodic evaluation including staff input will be carried out.
The system provides for periodic evaluation. This will be taken up jointly by the OM and the department.
Het systeem voorziet in een periodieke evaluatie. Dit zal door het OM en het departement gezamenlijk worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het artikel 'Doe altijd aangifte! Maar waarom doen hulpverleners het zelf dan niet?'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that police officers do not file reports when assaulted during New Year's Eve, and whether they fear reprisals. The minister said no data supports the claim, the fear-of-reprisals claim is not recognised, and that all public-service workers should file reports, while noting that assault incidents against police rose from 38 to 58 and total incidents from 51 to 59.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Dief gaat in Duindorp met een auto aan de haal'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether publishing stolen-car plates is usual, how the police share information with citizens and neighbourhood watch groups, and why practice varies between municipalities. The minister answered that such disclosure is not standard, that information sharing is a case-by-case local judgement under the Wet Politiegegevens, and that a national framework for citizen initiatives is being developed.
The police do not routinely provide such data to the media, unless there is a need to do so, for example for establishing the truth.
De politie verstrekt dergelijke gegevens niet standaard aan de media, tenzij hier een noodzaak toe is met het oog op bijvoorbeeld waarheidsvinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Dutch police waste millions on expensive special bullets during training instead of cheaper practice ammunition. The Minister defended the special police ammunition on technical grounds, stated that lead-free practice ammunition would cost much less than the article claimed, and said the current policy of using operational ammunition for training will remain in the new tender, while withholding exact prices as commercially confidential.
The price the police pays for its ammunition is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public, partly in light of the ongoing tender.
De prijs die de politie betaalt voor haar munitie is commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom, mede in het licht van de lopende aanbesteding, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het expertisecentrum CBRN-explosieven binnen de Landelijke Eenheid van de Politie

The MP asks about police encounters with explosives and CBRN hazards, how police CBRN expertise is organised, and whether the CENTREX CBRN-Explosives expertise centre will be dissolved. The minister confirms growing explosives use in ram and blast robberies, notes no rise in CBRN incidents, describes the CENTREX pilot as functioning as a multidisciplinary centre, and says a more durable organisational form is being worked on.
Securing the current tasks of the pilot project is the next important step in the process.
Borging van de huidige taken van het pilotproject is de volgende belangrijke stap in het proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked whether differences in unusual-transaction reporting between banks, and ING's sharp rise in 2017, prompted DNB to check other banks' monitoring systems. The minister answered that reports are not comparable across banks, that DNB conducts risk-based AML supervision and thematic investigations (2016 and 2018) that found weaknesses at several institutions, and that enforcement follows where violations occur.
DNB continuously conducts risk-based Wwft supervision of banks, including the effectiveness of transaction monitoring.
DNB houdt doorlopend risicogebaseerd Wwft-toezicht op banken, met inbegrip van de effectiviteit van de transactiemonitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Aanpak illegaal vuurwerk in gevaar’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about reports that the police were not arranging for seized illegal fireworks to be removed or guarded before the new year, and whether controls at parcel services had stalled. The minister answered that a robust storage and transport process is being designed with safety as the priority, that controls at parcel services do take place, and that the approach depends on the circumstances and quantity found.
In my letter of 14 November I informed your House of how the work process for storage and transport of illegal fireworks is being given a robust and sustainable form.
In mijn brief van 14 november jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop het werkproces met betrekking tot opslag en vervoer van illegaal vuurwerk robuust en duurzaam wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Van Dam over het bericht ‘So werden Erdogan-Kritiker in Deutschland per App denunziert’

MPs Heerma and Van Dam asked whether a Turkish police reporting app used to denounce Erdogan critics in Germany is also used in the Netherlands and whether it can be banned from app stores. The government said it is unknown whether the app is used this way in the Netherlands, that such use would be unacceptable, that Turkey would be addressed if it encouraged it, and that app store vetting is primarily the providers' responsibility.
If the app is indeed used for this purpose, it is totally undesirable.
Als de app inderdaad voor dit doeleinde wordt gebruikt, dan is dit volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘DELA gebruikt vingerafdruk overledenen voor commerciële doeleinden’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked whether funeral company DELA's use of deceased persons' fingerprints for commercial products was acceptable, and about legal protection of the dead and the remedies available to relatives. The minister answered that fingerprints taken with consent are a personal choice and part of business operations, that taking them without consent is unacceptable, and that relatives can complain to the company, the funeral complaints institute, the police or a civil court.
That a funeral organisation, such as DELA, sells products bearing the fingerprint of a deceased person for whom consent was given falls within the business operations of that organisation.

Dat een uitvaartorganisatie, zoals DELA, producten verkoopt met daarop de vingerafdruk van een overledene waarvoor toestemming is gegeven, behoort tot de bedrijfsvoering van de betreffende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked about the ING money-laundering settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, DNB's supervision of ING's remediation plan, IFI system use, unusual-transaction reporting figures by major bank, accountants' comments, and criminal liability of managers for omissions. The government answered that DNB monitors ING's remediation closely and will use supervisory tools if needed, withheld DNB information on ING's IFI use citing confidentiality, provided reporting statistics, and rejected the view that the criminal law is too focused on active conduct, declining a scientific study.
If it appears that ING has not implemented the imposed improvements in a timely and complete manner, DNB will use its supervisory instruments.
Indien blijkt dat ING niet tijdig en volledig de opgelegde verbeteringen heeft doorgevoerd, zal DNB haar toezichtinstrumentarium benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de verdeling van extra politiecapaciteit binnen de politie-eenheid Midden-Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the extra police capacity for the Midden-Nederland unit was really going to strengthen neighbourhood teams, as the minister had said, and who decides on the allocation. The minister replied that the extra capacity is targeted at neighbourhood work, organised crime and cybercrime, that mayors and the chief public prosecutor decide the allocation under the Police Act, and that he has no formal power to order a reallocation unless a mayor appeals and the threshold of unacceptable harm is met.
Because formal decision-making has not been completed in most units, I do not yet have a precise overview of the allocation of this extra operational strength.
Omdat formele besluitvorming in de meeste eenheden nog niet is afgerond heb ik nog geen precies overzicht van de verdeling van deze extra operationele sterkte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politiebureau Leidschenveen-Ypenburg sluit voor onbepaalde tijd’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Brigantijnlaan police station in The Hague would close, why, and how this fits the 2015 housing plan and a motion on easy access to reporting crimes. The minister answered that the station is not permanently closing but will be renovated, that the 2015 plan lists it, that any deviation from the location list requires alignment with local authorities, and that alternative policing arrangements during renovation are being explored.
There is no question of a definitive closure of the station.
Er is geen sprake van definitieve sluiting van het bureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Seksofficier werkt nu bij advocatenkantoor'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether it is acceptable that a former public prosecutor linked to fraud cases and a sex-offence suspicion moved to a law firm handling similar cases, and whether rules or personnel policy should change. The minister said the confidentiality duty binds former prosecutors indefinitely, that no non-compete applies, and that he sees no reason to change rules or policy.
This confidentiality duty always applies, so also after leaving the OM (public prosecution service).
Deze geheimhoudingsplicht geldt altijd, dus ook na het vertrek bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het onderzoek van de commissie Fokkens naar mogelijke integriteitsschendingen binnen de top van het openbaar ministerie

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the delayed completion of the independent Fokkens inquiry into alleged integrity violations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service, and whether new facts or a wider circle of subjects explained the delay. The minister confirmed the delay is due to new documents and new reports prompting more interviews, but said the inquiry is independent and he will relay the parliament's wish for completion by year-end to the College of Procurators-General.
I will relay the wish of your House to the College.
Ik zal de wens van uw Kamer doorgeleiden naar het College.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de politieperskaart

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press card access to crime scenes, press alarm failures and police publication of their own photos, citing reports of many unanswered complaints. The Minister said police do not keep figures, that automatic press alarm paging is being introduced, and that police social media use is discussed with the NVJ, while noting the Rotterdam Persmonitor model.
The police do not keep figures on this subject, so I cannot say how often a journalist is refused access to a crime scene.
De politie houdt zelf geen cijfers bij over dit onderwerp, dus ik kan niet zeggen hoe vaak het voorkomt dat een journalist de toegang tot een plaats delict wordt geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opmars No Cure, No Pay bureaus bij WOZ-bezwaren’

MPs asked about the growing share of WOZ property-valuation objections filed by no-cure-no-pay agencies, including calls for independent research, consumer protection, association sponsorship practices, municipal valuation quality, and an OZB inspection counter under the Omgevingswet.
