The ministers say they will commission research into the volume of such objections and related cost reimbursements before deciding on solutions, but decline to intervene in agency-association arrangements and point to existing Waarderingskamer oversight and the WOZ waardeloket.
My colleagues and I will have the development of the number of objections by no cure no pay companies and the related cost reimbursements examined.
Mijn ambtgenoten en ik zullen de ontwikkeling van de aantallen bezwaren door no cure no pay bedrijven en de in verband daarmee toegekende kostenvergoedingen laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Kopje onder in Nijmegen? Dan heb je pech'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a newspaper report on the lack of fire brigade diving teams in some regions, and about the survival window for people in the water. The minister answered that diving teams serve both rescue and recovery, that the regional safety boards decide on their deployment within the Wet veiligheidsregio's, and that the reduction of teams reflects regional organisation and occupational safety rules.
The board of the safety region sets the response time of a diving team based on, among other things, the risk profile.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio stelt op basis van onder andere het risicoprofiel de opkomsttijd van een duikteam vast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Staat aansprakelijk voor uitlatingen bewindspersoon over downloaden uit illegale bron’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling that the State acted unlawfully toward film producers by statements about downloading from illegal sources, asking about consequences, damages, and why the government long held downloading from illegal sources was not punishable and what enforcement followed. The Minister said the ruling is still being studied and appeal is possible, no damages have yet been claimed, and that since the 2014 CJEU ruling downloading from illegal sources was never permitted, with enforcement left largely to private collective action by Stichting Brein.
No statements can yet be made about the consequences of the judgment.
Over de gevolgen van het vonnis kunnen nog geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten en Van der Graaf over de verklaring (nr. 2) van het bestuur van de Stichting Vliegramp MH17 inzake meldingen en publiciteit over lichamelijke resten op MH17-crashsite

MPs asked whether recent YouTube videos and a foundation statement about bone fragments found at the MH17 crash site show that remains were planted to undermine the JIT investigation, and what action the government has taken. The minister answered that remains may still be found but the claimed location is unlikely, that no reports of new finds came in to official contacts, that the JIT has no concrete evidence of planting, and that Nederland has asked the OVSE and Grieving Nations to press the de facto authorities to hand over remains.
Contact will be made with the journalist with an urgent request to hand over all bone fragments to the authorities.
Er zal contact met de journalist worden opgenomen met het dringende verzoek alle botfragmenten aan de autoriteiten over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het boek ‘Dagboek van een getuige’ en ‘Slachtoffer mislukte liquidatie Breda krijgt geen huurwoning’

An MP asked whether the promised letter on the protection system (stelsel bewaken en beveiligen) would address the budget and cost registration, and whether the steering group should be tasked with mapping costs and the 1% norm. The Minister answered that the 5 June 2018 letter is the promised letter, that costs are funded from the police budget with routine planning and control, and that he will await the steering group's findings before adding tasks.
I want to first await the outcomes and recommendations of this assignment before adding assignments.
Ik wil de uitkomsten en aanbevelingen van deze opdracht eerst afwachten voordat ik opdrachten toevoeg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Arno Rutte en Bisschop over het bericht ‘Leren van geweld’

MPs Van Dam, Rutte and Bisschop asked whether police officers acquitted of criminal charges for use of force can be denied a VOG certificate and travel to the US, whether the new use-of-force rules apply retroactively, and whether protections can be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus said he does not recognise the described case, received no other signals of such problems, and that the new investigation framework could in principle apply to earlier cases while no change to VOG rules is planned.
I have received no other signals indicating that police officers face obstacles in obtaining a VOG because of a previous use of force.
Mij hebben geen andere signalen bereikt waaruit blijkt dat politieambtenaren vanwege een eerdere geweldsaanwending hinder ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van een VOG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van Dam over de Amerikaanse steun voor het Joint Investigation Team (JIT) onderzoek naar de daders van MH17

MPs from VVD, CU, D66 and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US State Department went silent or softened its MH17 statement after the Trump-Putin summit, and whether MH17 was discussed there. The minister replied that the US fully supports the JIT and the Dutch approach, reaffirmed in the G7 statement of 16 July, while declining to share confidential allied information and calling Russia's criticism unfounded.
As the House is aware, on the basis of alliance agreements no statements can be made about information confidentially shared by allies.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over door bondgenoten vertrouwelijk gedeelde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam, Ten Broeke en Arno Rutte over terreurvlaggen Hezbollah bij de Tweede Kamer

MPs asked whether Hezbollah flags shown at a June 2018 Quds Day demonstration outside parliament were punishable and why police did not act, and whether the OM enforcement framework or local coordination should change. The minister answers that the flag is punishable under article 131 Sr (incitement) in principle, that no arrest was made for lack of hard investigative indications, and that current frameworks suffice, with each case judged on its own.
Displaying the Hezbollah flag would in principle constitute a punishable offence under article 131 of the Criminal Code, incitement, an offence against public order.
Het tonen van de Hezbollah-vlag zal in beginsel strafbaarheid op grond van artikel 131 Sr, opruiing, opleveren, een misdrijf tegen de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Wapens niet meer onklaar gemaakt’

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the EU firearms directive has not yet been implemented, whether arms dealers are no longer accepting weapons for destruction, and who will be responsible for deactivating weapons. The minister replied that the implementing bill was submitted on 29 June 2018, that the police will be the central supervisory body with budget reserved, and that it does not track what happens to surrendered firearms.
It is not recorded what has happened to firearms when they were offered to be deactivated.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden wat er met vuurwapens is gebeurd als deze aangeboden zijn om onklaar te worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht '’Ik kan wel huilen’, Delft schrikt van weer een geweldsincident'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether recent violent and shooting incidents in Delft and elsewhere form a trend of extortion of hospitality businesses, and on what basis and purpose premises are closed after such incidents. The Minister said the cases are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, that mayors decide case by case on order-maintenance grounds, that closure is not standard policy, and that alternatives such as extra supervision or camera surveillance are considered first.

The mayor will have to motivate each decision separately; generally, considerations concerning the restoration of public order and fear of further disruption of public order will underlie his decision-making.

De burgemeester zal ieder besluit afzonderlijk moeten motiveren; doorgaans zullen overwegingen rondom het herstel van de openbare orde en vrees voor verdere verstoring van de openbare orde aan zijn besluitvorming ten grondslag liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht "Omstreden dienstreis voedt vertrouwenscrisis bij OM"

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice whether he was aware of press reports on a disputed business trip fuelling a trust crisis at the Public Prosecution Service, and whether he would order an independent fact-finding inquiry into undisclosed private relationships in the OM leadership and how the then leadership handled them. The Minister answered that the College of Procurators-General has already commissioned an independent inquiry, which will also examine the appointment of the Rotterdam chief prosecutor and possibly earlier events, and that he will discuss the outcome with the College after it is published.
As already indicated, the College of Procurators-General has commissioned an independent inquiry.
Zoals reeds aangegeven heeft het College van procureurs-generaal opdracht gegeven tot het uitvoeren van een onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ´Start nu met het opleiden van de politie van de toekomst’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a former police education council chair's call for the Police Academy to act as an education broker, and how police units can source training outside the Academy, including who pays and whether police staff may teach privately. The Minister answered that the Police Academy is the sole provider of police education, units can buy non-police training from their own budgets, and private teaching by staff is not allowed, with DSI instructors temporarily trained to fill a shortage.
Because these are public funds, these trainings may not be provided privately by teachers acting as private individuals.
Omdat het hierbij gaat om publieke gelden, mogen deze opleidingen niet privaat door docenten als privépersonen worden verzorgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Wijkagent als gatenvuller’

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police norm that neighbourhood officers spend at least 80% of their time in their neighbourhood is being met, and whether they are routinely diverted to other tasks. The Minister confirmed the norm and acknowledged such signals, but pointed to the development agenda for area-based policing and said the norm leaves room for practical implementation, without committing to a specific enforcement step.
In general terms, the signal that neighbourhood officers are also deployed for other tasks is known to me.
In algemene zin is het signaal dat wijkagenten ook voor andere werkzaamheden worden ingezet mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Van Dam en Voordewind over de persconferentie van het JIT over de ramp met MH17

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the JIT press conference on MH17, in particular Russia's failure to share information on the Buk missile's origin and whether Russia breaches UN resolution 2166. The minister agreed that the Buk belonged to the Russian military, that Russia must cooperate fully, and that he raised the matter in the UN Security Council.
In the Security Council I called on Russia to take its responsibility, to engage with Australia and the Netherlands on this, and to cooperate fully as demanded by UN Security Council Resolution 2166.

In de Veiligheidsraad heb ik Rusland opgeroepen zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, met Australië en Nederland daarover in gesprek te gaan en volledig mee te werken zoals wordt geëist door VNVR-resolutie 2166.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Verouderde strafwet BES hindert veroordeling seksuele delicten’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an outdated Penal Code for the Caribbean Netherlands (BES) caused an acquittal in a sexual offence case and why it was not modernised like the Caribbean Kingdom countries' codes. The minister confirmed one acquittal, admitted that articles 249 and 253 were mistakenly not updated in 2010, and said a bill to fix this will be submitted before the summer recess.
Correction of the omissions in articles 249 and 253 of the BES Penal Code will take place in the bill amending the BES Code of Criminal Procedure.
Herstel van de omissies in de artikelen 249 en 253 Wetboek van Strafrecht BES vindt plaats in het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van het Wetboek van Strafvordering BES
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Drie mishandelaars Praag veroordeeld en Tsjechië uitgezet’

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that three Dutch men were convicted in Prague for assault and expelled, including questions on reputational harm, prosecution in the Netherlands, police-officer involvement and compensation for the victim. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the case is individual, the Czech authorities handle it, the Netherlands will not investigate under Article 68 Sr, a Dutch police investigation has started, and compensation is not for the Dutch government.
I do not make statements about the individuals involved.
Over de betrokken individuen doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de ondersteuning van nabestaanden van vliegramp MH17 bij de afwikkeling van schade

An MP asked the government how it can support relatives of MH17 victims in pursuing civil damages claims, given confusing advice and competing lawyers, and whether 'no cure no pay' fees suit the case. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, said the government cannot yet give unambiguous advice, referred emotional support to Slachtofferhulp Nederland, and said the deken supervises no-cure-no-pay arrangements.
Given the existing uncertainties, it is currently not possible to provide next of kin with unambiguous advice and assistance.
Gelet op de bestaande onduidelijkheden en onzekerheden is het echter op dit moment niet goed mogelijk om nabestaanden met eenduidige raad en daad terzijde te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over de uitzending van Zembla “Zakendoen met justitie”

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice about high and special transactions by the Public Prosecution Service (OM) in 2016-2017, including prosecution of individuals, secrecy, fiscal treatment, equality and judicial review. The ministers answered that the OM prosecutes individuals in many cases, gave figures for 2016-2017, acknowledged that the Rabobank non-admission wording was unfortunate, and said the current practice is being reviewed.
At this moment the current practice is being reviewed.
Op dit moment wordt de huidige praktijk tegen het licht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bizarre oproep: ’Maak lawaai tijdens dodenherdenking’

MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked whether a online call to make noise during the Dutch national Remembrance Day two-minute silence should be prevented, and whether the minister would engage Amsterdam. The minister condemned the call as disrespectful but said the local security triangle has full attention and is responsible for deciding how to respond.
It is up to them to decide how to deal with this call.
Het is aan hen om te beslissen hoe met deze oproep moet worden omgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het boek 'Dagboek van een getuige' en het bericht 'Slachtoffer mislukte liquidatie Breda krijgt geen huurwoning'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a book and a news report concerning a failed liquidation victim, including whether the 1% budget-threshold policy for protective security (bewaken en beveiligen) still applies and whether the police track its costs. The minister answered that the policy rule no longer applies since the national police was formed, that costs are not uniformly registered, and that a letter on the protection system will follow before summer.
The costs of deployment and measures in this context, such as personnel and resources, are currently not uniformly registered by the police.
De kosten van de inzet en maatregelen in dit kader, zoals personeel en middelen, worden op dit moment niet door de politie eenduidig geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam en Omtzigt over de aangenomen resolutie van de parlementaire assemblee van de Raad van Europa “Prosecuting and punishing the crimes against humanity or even possible g

MPs Van Helvert, Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the government will act on a Council of Europe resolution calling ISIS crimes genocide, including whether to appoint a specialised prosecutor and enable handover of evidence. The government confirmed its support for the resolution, described existing investigative cooperation, and promised to study the specialised prosecutor proposal and report back.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Over de resultaten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Mister Cloud’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked the Justice Minister about a Blauw interview with police academy director Kuijs on a 'Kenniscloud' knowledge platform, its relation to the earlier PKN/KomPol, its business model, validation of knowledge, and police case-file quality. The minister answered that the Kenniscloud complements KomPol, that no commercial interests are involved, that validation rests with the responsible police portfolio holder, and that police and prosecutors are jointly implementing a file-quality standard.
There is no question of commercial interests.
Er is geen sprake van commerciële belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dam over onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwillige verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dam asked about burdensome rules for volunteer traffic controllers, including the annual e-learning requirement and rising costs for events. The minister answered that eligibility was simplified from October 2017, that annual refresher training is kept for quality reasons, and that the matter of extra professional controllers is for municipalities to decide.
The trade-off has certainly been considered to extend this period, but insufficient justification was found for it.
De afweging is zeker gemaakt om deze periode op te rekken, maar daar is onvoldoende onderbouwing voor gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Blussen? Dat doen we straks met een robot!’

Mr Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a newspaper report on firefighting robots, whether robot firefighting is a new specialism, which specialisms exist beyond basic fire service tasks and who decides them, and whether every regional fire service has a dive team. The Minister answered that robots are not a national specialism, that specialisms are set by safety regions under the Wvr and a national programme, and that 23 of 25 safety regions have their own dive team, with the rest leaving this to regional discretion.
It is up to the board of a safety region to determine how, within the existing legal framework, this task is implemented.
Het is aan het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio om te bepalen op welke wijze, binnen het vigerend kader van wet- en regelgeving, daaraan invulling wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ´Geruïneerd door het faillissement van iemand anders.’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a broadcast on a victim ruined by someone else's bankruptcy fraud, and about enforcing the civil bankruptcy director ban, cooperation among enforcement parties, and a person-focused approach. The minister answered that no civil director bans are yet final, that evaluation is planned for 2021, and that existing cooperation channels and prevention measures are in place, with ongoing consultation rather than a new targeted study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorg over groei geweld door verwarde mensen in Rotterdam’

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising incidents involving confused persons in Rotterdam and the police's role, training and the Schakelteam approach. The minister confirmed rising registered incidents (12% in 2017), said data cannot show unique persons or offences, and pointed to prevention, police training and Rotterdam's existing programmes without committing to new steps.
The police registration does not show the number of persons who committed or are suspected of a criminal offence while in a confused state.
Bij de politie is uit de registratie niet het aantal personen af te leiden dat in verwarde toestand een strafbaar feit heeft gepleegd of daarvan wordt verdacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de YouTube-film ‘Vacature Politievlieger’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a police YouTube recruitment video for helicopter pilots and whether internal-only recruitment and costly in-house training of police pilots is a wise use of budget. The minister confirmed the vacancies, explained the 36-month, roughly 400,000 euro training path, and justified training internal officers for their operational experience.
The police choose to train two pilots from their own ranks because their executive background increases the quality of the work.
De politie kiest ervoor om twee vliegers uit eigen gelederen op te leiden, omdat hun executieve achtergrond de kwaliteit van de werkzaamheden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie heeft Utrechtse verdachten plofkraak Friesland in het vizier’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the status of an experimental approach to ram and explosive robberies (plofkraken), including how cases are coordinated and how many investigations were launched in 2017. The minister answered that pilots started in autumn 2017 in Midden-Nederland and Rotterdam, that Amsterdam applies the Top-600 method, that 87 explosive robberies were reported in 2017, and that the national tactical team had 45 officers, though staffing from regional units varies with operational pressure.
Since these are ongoing operational matters, I cannot make statements about the nature and scope of the number of cases being handled.
Aangezien het gaat om lopende operationele zaken, kan ik geen uitspraken over de aard en omvang van het aantal in behandeling zijnde cases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het artikel 'CDA wil wijkagent inkopen'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister whether municipalities should be allowed to buy extra police capacity such as neighbourhood officers for their own area. Minister Grapperhaus welcomed municipal willingness to invest in safety but rejected purchasing extra police strength, since funding decisions belong to Parliament via the budget and deployment must stay under the authority of mayors and the public prosecutor.

Municipalities buying existing or additional police capacity, including as neighbourhood officers, does not fit the principle of the police system that the States General, through the budget law of my ministry, decides on the level of funding for sufficient and adequately equipped police.

Het inkopen door gemeenten van bestaande of aanvullende politiesterkte, al dan niet in de vorm van wijkagenten, verhoudt zich echter niet met het uitgangspunt van het politiebestel dat de Staten-Generaal – via de begrotingswet van mijn ministerie – besluit over de omvang van de financiering van voldoende en voldoende geëquipeerde politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het boek ‘Dagboek van een getuige’ en ‘Slachtoffer mislukte liquidatie Breda krijgt geen huurwoning’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about Astrid Holleeder's book and a report that a victim of a failed Breda assassination could not get rental housing, including how protection under Bewaken en Beveiligen and the witness protection programme works, and how costs and responsibilities are divided. The minister answered all five questions in substance, explaining eligibility, the limits on forcing protected persons to cooperate, the separation of protection from criminal investigation, and that protection costs fall mainly on the police budget, while withholding exact cost figures for security reasons.
For security risks, these expenditures are not further broken down, because information about the protection of persons could be derived from them.
Vanwege veiligheidsrisico’s worden deze uitgaven niet nader toegerekend, omdat daar informatie over de beveiliging van personen aan zou kunnen worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Drugstest wassen neus’

An MP asked whether police only conduct blood testing for serious traffic accidents with fatalities or serious injuries, and why, after a drug-driving law took effect on 1 July 2017. The minister confirmed a temporary measure limiting blood analyses to the most serious cases because demand exceeded NFI capacity, with capacity to be expanded and a letter promised for late January.
It concerns a temporary management measure aimed at limiting blood analyses to the most serious cases.
Het betreft een tijdelijke beheersmaatregel gericht op beperking van analyses van bloed tot de ernstigste gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Niemand vertelt ons wat’

MPs Van Helvert and Van Dam asked how the government supports relatives of Dutch citizens who die abroad, how it supports the Malaysian police investigation into Ivana Smit's death, and why there is no dedicated contact person for such relatives. The minister replied that the ministry provides consular assistance on request, keeps contact with relatives and local authorities, and that Slachtofferhulp Nederland can offer support after return, while noting that the Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign police investigation.
The Netherlands cannot interfere in a police investigation by foreign authorities into a case that took place abroad.
Nederland kan zich niet mengen in een politieonderzoek door buitenlandse autoriteiten naar een zaak die zich in het buitenland heeft afgespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opslag politie in beslag genomen vuurwerk onveilig’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security how police store, transport and destroy seized illegal fireworks and how officers' safety is guaranteed, and whether private firms could take over. The minister answered that police are intensifying direct ADR transport to a national storage facility, that specialists handle examination and destruction, and that options for a structural role for non-police parties will be reported in spring 2018.
I will inform your House further about this in spring 2018.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier in het voorjaar van 2018 nader over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over het pleidooi van gemeenten om meer soorten van de wietproef toe te staan

The MPs asked whether the government would allow several kinds of cannabis cultivation experiments as municipalities requested, rather than only one centrally supplied model, and whether they would consult the VNG. The minister said the experiments are still being designed in consultation with partners including municipalities and an independent evaluation committee, and aimed to submit the legislation in the second quarter of 2018.
We aim to submit the necessary legislation and regulations to your House in the second quarter of 2018.
Wij streven ernaar om de benodigde wet- en regelgeving in het tweede kwartaal van 2018 bij uw Kamer in te dienen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Diertens en Voortman over de inzet van de politie in instellingen voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ), in het bijzonder het gebruik van het stroomstootwapen in GGZ-instellin

MPs Van Dam, Diertens and Voortman asked the Justice Minister about police use of stun guns inside GGZ mental health institutions, including whether the stun mode is effective given manufacturer warnings and how this was handled in the pilot. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the taser was used 15 times in care institutions (11 in GGZ settings, one in stun mode), that the stun mode has limited effect on persons unresponsive to pain, that an extra training and a final evaluation will follow, and that Parliament will be consulted before any decision on standard issue.
As promised in my letter, I will first give your House the opportunity to discuss this before a definitive decision is taken.
Zoals in mijn reeds genoemde brief is toegezegd zal ik uw Kamer eerst in de gelegenheid stellen hier over te spreken voordat een definitief besluit wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie heeft Utrechtse verdachten plofkraak Friesland in het vizier’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports on a coordinated, person-focused approach to armed robbery and ram/explosive raid suspects, including why suspects arrested in Friesland were released after interview and how national coordination works. The Minister confirmed the pilot approach, the involved partners, the coordination structure and that national coordination applies in each relevant case, but declined to comment on individual cases for investigative reasons.
In every case that fits this phenomenon there is national coordination and investigation.
In elke zaak die past binnen dit fenomeen is sprake van landelijke coördinatie en opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Tellegen over het bericht 'Politie begint tóch met stopformulieren'

Two MPs asked whether the Den Haag police are joining a national pilot requiring officers to record why they stop people, how it works, and whether the government still opposes stop forms. The Minister says the pilot uses the MEOS app to log checks in the police system, runs December 2017 to May 2018 across nine teams, that stop forms remain excluded, and that results will be reported before autumn 2018.
I will inform your House before autumn 2018 about the outcomes of the pilots.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het najaar van 2018 informeren over de uitkomsten van de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Dementie vaak niet herkend: opeens was moeder getrouwd en waren zij onterfd'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report on a dementia patient who remarried and disinherited her children, despite a living will and a dementia diagnosis, and asked how notaries assess testamentary capacity, what medical information they can access, and when a void marriage takes effect. The minister answered that a testament by someone lacking capacity is void, that notaries have the duty to assess capacity themselves with optional VIA-doctor advice and a KNB step plan, that medical confidentiality prevents automatic sharing of diagnoses, and that a marriage annulled in good faith takes effect retroactively only once final.
Medical professional confidentiality prevents a doctor from automatically sharing a dementia diagnosis with a notary.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim staat eraan in de weg dat een arts een diagnose dementie automatisch deelt met een notaris.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dam over gerechtelijke secties die noodgedwongen in België worden uitgevoerd

MPs Kuiken and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about autopsies of suspected crime victims being carried out in Belgium because of a staffing shortage at the Netherlands Forensic Institute after a forensic pathologist died. The minister defended the arrangement as a professional, temporary solution with the Antwerp University Hospital, consistent with prior policy, and declined to say the Chamber should have been informed beforehand.
I assess it as a good solution by the NFI to enter into constructive cooperation with Belgian experts.
Ik beoordeel het als een goede oplossing van het NFI om een constructieve samenwerking met Belgische deskundigen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten, Groothuizen en Segers over het bericht ‘Grote strafzaken verhuizen van rechtbank Almelo naar Zwolle’

MPs asked whether the move of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases from Almelo to Zwolle follows from the Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart and whether Almelo keeps enough work. The minister confirmed the move follows from 2012 agreements, that Almelo remains a main location, and gave hour figures showing fewer multi-judge hearings in Almelo in 2018.
The shift of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases to Zwolle from 1 January 2018 flows directly from agreements made in 2012 within the framework of the Judicial Map Revision Act (HGK).

De verschuiving van meervoudige strafzaken van het Functioneel Parket per 1 januari 2018 naar Zwolle, zijnde de vestigingsplaats van het Functioneel Parket in Overijssel, vloeit direct voort uit afspraken die in 2012 het kader van de Wet Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart (HGK) zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en van Dam over het artikel ‘Ik hoop dat je gepakt wordt’; De Turkse Kliklijn’

MPs Knops and Van Dam asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Turkish consulate 'click line' for reporting Turkish Dutch citizens and threats of reporting them to Turkish intelligence. The minister said there is no evidence of a current reporting line in the Netherlands, condemned such practices, and said the government raises the issue with Turkey and will act directly if a reporting line exists.
If a click line were to exist, the Dutch government will therefore act directly.
In het geval van het bestaan van een kliklijn zal de Nederlandse overheid dus direct optreden.
Antwoord op van vragen van de leden Van Dam en Knops over het bericht ‘Stop leningen aan politieagenten voor afkopen dienstplicht Turkije’

MPs Van Dam and Knops asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers could borrow up to 6,000 euro interest-free to buy out Turkish military service, and whether this and the similar Defence scheme should be ended, as previously requested in a 2011 motion. The minister answered that 24 police officers used the scheme from 2013 to 2017, that the scheme will be abolished soon because Turkish rules were relaxed in 2016, and that the Defence scheme is under discussion with the public sector unions.
This scheme will therefore be abolished soon.
Deze regeling wordt daarom binnenkort afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over ICT bij de Nationale Politie

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Review Board's warning that the police ICT programme would reach only about 45% of its realisation plan by end 2017, creating an imbalance between maintaining the base and renewing ICT, and whether the programme and Review Board should continue after 2017. The Minister acknowledged the warning, said the focus was deliberately on putting the basic systems in order, promised a final report and Review Board report after the programme ends on 31 December 2017, and said the programme would be handed over to the standing organisation with a transition plan advised by the Review Board, which was reinstated and extended to end 2017.
I will send your House a final report after the Attack Programme ends (31 December 2017), as well as the final report of the Review Board.
Ik zal uw Kamer na afloop van het Aanvalsprogramma (31 december 2017) een eindrapportage doen toekomen, evenals het eindverslag van de Review Board.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht “Jongeren met een nepwapen uit metro gehaald”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report of youths removed from the Rotterdam metro carrying a toy gun, and whether the government still opposes a national ban on toy firearms and considers carrying them in public restrictable under the Weapons and Ammunition Act. The state secretary answered that EU toy safety rules permit possession, that carrying is only punishable case by case under the existing limited carrying ban, that a general carrying ban is not warranted, and that police awareness campaigns are preferred.
Given the target group of the product, namely children, it is not reasonable to introduce a general carrying ban on toy weapons.
Gezien de doelgroep van het product, te weten kinderen, ligt het niet in de rede een algemeen draagverbod voor speelgoedwapens in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ´Stampvolle stad feest uitbundig’

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister about fireworks incidents during the Rotterdam celebrations, including a man losing a hand, dangerous explosions near crowds, the categories and penalties for illegal fireworks, enforcement capacity, cross-border smuggling, and combining answers with a promised letter. The minister confirmed the incidents, stated that incident numbers have not risen compared with other years, described penalties (up to six years for storing or supplying heavy fireworks) and enforcement capacity, and said the cross-border measures are being pursued at EU level, though the combined letter could not be produced.
The Public Prosecution Service publishes annually the number of kilos of seized fireworks on its website.
Het Openbaar Ministerie publiceert jaarlijks het aantal kilo's inbeslaggenomen vuurwerk op zijn website
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Gouda is een onveilige gemeente’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a press report labelling Gouda an unsafe municipality with high burglary rates, asking about police staffing shortfalls, offender origins, recidivism and measures in the justice chain. The minister confirmed the figures, declined to comment on local staffing as it is a matter for the local tripartite, provided local data and recidivism context, and listed existing measures such as the Top60 approach and burglary prevention campaigns.
I therefore do not comment on this specific case.
Over deze specifieke casus doe ik dan ook geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie te ver doorgeslagen’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police station of the Twente-West basic unit was moved from Rijssen to Nijverdal, on what criteria, and whether this neglects villages without a station. The minister confirmed the reorganisation follows an agreed 2025 housing plan, cited business cases with response times as criteria, and said the local authorities are jointly responsible, without committing to keep multiple active posts open.
In this specific case, the Twente-West police unit, in close consultation with local authorities, is responsible for the choices made regarding housing.
In dit specifieke geval is de politie-eenheid Twente-West in nauw overleg met het lokaal gezag verantwoordelijk voor de gemaakte keuzes inzake de huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht “cocaïnebaron knipt enkelband door en vlucht”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a cocaine trafficker cut his ankle monitor and fled, including when the authorities learned of it, how the tag was defeated, how often tags are removed, and whether suspects of serious crime should be held in custody instead of at home with a tag. The Minister answered that police and prosecutors were notified in November 2016 and that a search was started, that 35 tags out of about 2,700 wearers were deliberately removed since early 2016, that the tag remains an effective instrument, and that the independent judge decided against the prosecution and advisory position, referring to earlier answers and a letter to parliament for the rest.
Because of future investigative interests, I cannot make further statements about specific investigative actions.
Vanwege toekomstige opsporingsbelangen kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over concrete opsporingshandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Dam over het bericht ´Politie bood zwijgdeal’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Telegraaf report that police offered a 'silence deal' on data about asylum seekers and criminal suspects, and about how many asylum seekers and status holders came into contact with criminal law in 2014-2016. The minister denied any silence deal, said police do not routinely record residence status and that a WOB request is being reassessed, and provided 2015-2016 figures while admitting 2014 figures were not available.
On which analyses and/or monitors are or are not kept in which units, I will inform the House after the WOB request has been processed.
Over de vraag welke analyses en/of monitors in welke eenheden nu wel of niet worden bijgehouden zal ik uw Kamer informeren nadat het wob-verzoek is afgehandeld.

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about a 2021 petition on behalf of Sint Maarten's parliament and citizens alleging neo-colonial, racist treatment and failure to promote self-government, covering financial oversight, reconstruction funds, social welfare, the prison and independence. I am therefore not willing to take the lead in this.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Bosman over het bericht 'regering Hongarije wil Grondwet aanpassen: ouder zijn altijd een vrouw en een man'

MPs El Yassini and Bosman asked the Dutch government how Hungary's planned constitutional change on parental definitions and adoption rules fits with EU rule-of-law conditionality, what steps it will take at EU level, and how it will promote equal treatment of LGBTI people. The minister answered that the conditionality mechanism is tied to EU budget interests, that Hungary's concerns will be raised in the Article 7 procedure and bilaterally, and that the Netherlands is building coalitions and funding LGBTI NGOs.
The Netherlands will actively point out to the Commission the need to uphold the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.
Nederland zal de Commissie actief wijzen op de noodzaak om het EU Handvest voor de Grondrechten te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over bepaalde Britse banken die rekeningen van klanten in Nederland opheffen

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the Finance Minister why British banks are closing accounts of Dutch customers after Brexit, whether this can be prevented, and why retail customers have less protection than professional market parties. The government answers that UK institutions must manage their own transition under UK supervision, that existing preparation is considered sufficient so no additional legislation is needed, and that EU rules protect retail clients by requiring proper authorisation for cross-border services.
It is up to British institutions themselves to determine which steps they take in response to the end of the transition period.
Het is aan Britse instellingen zelf om te bepalen welke stappen zij ondernemen in reactie op het aflopen van de overgangsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Kuiken over een BIGregistratie voor personen die een opleiding hebben genoten op een van de eilanden van Caribisch Nederland

MPs Bosman and Kuiken asked whether nursing diplomas from the Caribbean Netherlands are recognised in Europe, whether nurses from there can get BIG registration, and how to treat these diplomas as equivalent. The minister confirmed that the Bonaire nursing programme is equivalent to the Dutch mbo-4 programme and announced a practical workaround for Bonaire diploma holders, with the issue to be addressed in a future BIG amendment.
I intend to apply a practical approach, ahead of a definitive legal arrangement, to the diplomas issued by Fundashon Mariadal
Ik ben voornemens om, vooruitlopend op een definitieve wettelijke regeling, een praktische werkwijze te hanteren met betrekking tot de door Fundashon Mariadal afgegeven diploma's
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over financiering onder het Europees Defensiefonds

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether co-financing for European Defence Fund projects could come from member states and how much Dutch co-financing would be needed, including whether Economic Affairs could contribute. The minister answered that the co-financing rule does not specify who pays, that no specific budget line exists yet, that options are being mapped in an interdepartmental group, and that Dutch firms received limited EDF funding.
The amount of the co-financing and the distribution within the consortia are commercially confidential.
De hoogte van de cofinanciering en de verdeling binnen de consortia zijn commercieel vertrouwelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het rapport "Digitalisering aan de grens; Cybersecurity van het grenstoezicht door de Koninklijke Marechaussee op Schiphol" van de Algemene Rekenkamer (20

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about the Court of Audit's report on cybersecurity of border control at Schiphol, covering approval procedures, security testing, critical systems, crisis exercises and transfer of the self-service system to Schiphol. The government answered that approvals and added security measures are underway with full implementation expected by end 2020, that annual testing is not feasible given staffing, that not all critical systems are yet connected to the SOC, that an exercise and an update of guidelines will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before any transfer of the self-service system.
The cabinet will inform the Chamber further about the intended decision and the conditions under which it takes place before the transfer takes place.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer nader informeren over het voorgenomen besluit en de voorwaarden waaronder dit gebeurt voordat overdracht plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Bosman over het bericht ‘Defensie laat veteranen met klachten veel te lang wachten’

MPs Van den Bosch and Bosman (VVD) asked the Defence Minister about reports that the National Ombudsman found veterans with complaints waiting too long for compensation claims, and what Defence would do about it. The minister acknowledged the complaints in general terms, said delays are partly inherent and partly due to other parties, and listed existing measures (RVS evaluation, doubled legal staff) plus detailed claim statistics, while pointing to the ombudsman's pending investigation.
I am aware that the processing time is experienced as too long.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat de afhandelingsduur als te lang wordt ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Bosman over het bericht ‘Lagere ticketprijzen tussen eilanden laten nog wel even op zich wachten’

MPs Kuiken and Bosman asked why no concrete measures had been taken on the expert group's advice to partly compensate inter-island ticket prices in the Caribbean Netherlands, and when measures would follow. The government answered that a proposal is being developed with the Caribbean islands and ministries, to be tested for legal, financial and organisational feasibility, but it cannot yet give a timeline.
Therefore, at this stage it cannot yet be stated within what timeframe measures can be taken.
Er kan daarom in dit stadium nog niet aangegeven worden binnen welke termijn er maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Koopmans over het bericht  ‘U.S. can’t continue’ tolerating Russian ‘noncompliance’ on Open Skies, Esper says’

MPs Bosman and Koopmans asked whether Defence Minister Esper's concerns about Russian non-compliance with the Open Skies treaty had been shared with allies and whether the Netherlands shares them and is acting on them. Minister Blok answered that the US concerns were raised bilaterally, in NATO and the OSCE, that the Netherlands shares them, has raised them with Moscow and in the OSCC, and has pressed for compliance and the treaty's value without joining any formal joint pressure beyond NATO questionnaires.
The Netherlands, like the US, is of the view that all parties must comply with the obligations under the treaty.
Nederland is net als de VS van mening dat alle partijen zich aan de verplichtingen onder het verdrag dienen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht ‘Koraal Curaçao vernield door olieplatform’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that an oil platform damaged coral reef off Curaçao, and about the extent of damage, responsibility, recovery and prevention. The government acknowledged the irreversible damage, said Curaçao's ministry is investigating the cause, noted coral planting is possible but limited, and stated Curaçao itself is responsible for shipping safety rules.
Curaçao is itself responsible for making and enforcing regulations on shipping safety to prevent such incidents.
Curaçao is zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken en handhaven van voorschriften met betrekking tot de scheepvaartveiligheid om dergelijke incidenten te voorkomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bosman over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb: kapotte drugsscanners Curaçao gevaarlijk voor Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that most drug scanners at Curaçao's port and airport have been broken for years, and what this means for drug flows to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the port scanners have been defective for about two years, that the airport has a working but not fully deployable body scanner, that Schiphol keeps 100% checks on passengers from Curaçao, and that the issue will be raised at the January 2020 Justice Four-Party Consultation, and provided seizure statistics from 2015 to 2019.
The Curaçao authorities state they cannot share operational information about when the scanner is or is not deployed and the reasons for this.
Tevens geven Curaçaose autoriteiten aan geen operationele informatie te kunnen delen over wanneer de scanner al dan niet wordt ingezet en wat de redenen daarvan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Bestuurscollege Bonaire huurt journalisten in voor communicatiebeleid’

Rep. Bosman asked the State Secretary for the Interior about a report that the Bonaire executive council hired a journalist as communications adviser, and about that journalist's independence and the effect of his critical writing. The State Secretary answered that such dual roles are not normal under central government guidance, but that the hiring was a sovereign decision of the Bonaire executive council, a local matter it must account for to its island council.
I regard this as a local matter in which the executive council can account for itself in the public debate and (when asked) to the island council of Bonaire.
Ik beschouw dit als een lokale zaak waarbij het bestuurscollege in het publieke debat en (desgevraagd) richting de eilandsraad van Bonaire verantwoording kan afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Bosman over de politieke situatie op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Dam and Bosman asked whether the Sint Maarten premier's description of ungovernability, lack of integrity and disregard for the constitution is accepted, what the Kingdom can do under the Statute to restore a functioning democratic rule of law, and whether unorthodox measures are considered. The State Secretary expressed concern and said the Kingdom must stay alert and use available instruments, but stressed Sint Maarten's autonomy, the need for great restraint, and a preference for cooperation over intervention.
That is why the Dutch government is closely monitoring this situation, all the more given our involvement in reconstruction and strengthening the rule of law in Sint Maarten.
Daarom houdt de Nederlandse regering deze situatie wel nauwlettend in de gaten, temeer gelet op onze betrokkenheid bij wederopbouw en het versterken van de rechtsstaat in Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het dekolonisatieproces van de voormalig Nederlandse Antillen

An MP (Bosman, VVD) asked the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, through 19 questions, about decolonisation of the former Netherlands Antilles, the free choice behind the Statute, and the legal status of the 2018 ICJ written statement, including whether Article 73 UN Charter still applies. The State Secretary (Knops) answered that the Antilles reached full self-government in 1954 by free acceptance of the Statute, that the post-colonial self-determination right remains, and that the 2018 position merely clarifies the legal basis without changing the status of the islands.
This clarification, however, has no material legal consequences for the islands concerned.
Deze precisering heeft overigens geen wezenlijke juridische gevolgen voor de betreffende (ei)landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Bosman en van Gent over het bericht ‘Afschieten honderden damherten op Haringvreter had voorkomen kunnen worden’

MPs from the VVD asked the minister whether an overpopulation of fallow deer on the Haringvreter, which has reduced breeding birds and orchids, could have been prevented by earlier culling permits and why population recovery needs several winters. The minister confirmed the permit history and damage, said several winters of culling are needed, and committed to including such cases in the review of wildlife management.
Yes, it is my intention to include practical situations such as those on the Haringvreter in the evaluation of wildlife management, as requested in the Von Martels motion.
Antwoord 9 Ja, het is mijn voornemen bij de evaluatie van het faunabeheer, zoals gevraagd in de motie-Von Martels 2 , praktijksituaties als die op de Haringvreter, mede te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van de defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman ask the government to reconcile its support for the domestic defence industry with its strict arms-export policy and with the FMO exclusion list that bars firms earning 10% or more from weapons from trade-promotion and financing instruments such as DTIF. The ministers confirm the policy tension, state that generic trade instruments are now open to defence firms, and say the government will review remaining aspects of defence trade support by Prinsjesdag 2019 while denying any intent to penalise the sector.
At present, however, the cabinet is considering whether trade support for the defence sector can be adjusted on this point in light of the DIS.
Op dit moment beziet het kabinet echter of de handelsinzet voor de defensiesector op dit punt in het licht van de DIS kan worden aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de impact van het eenzijdig aangescherpte wapenexportbeleid voor de concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked about the impact of the Dutch tightened arms export policy toward the UAE, Egypt and Saudi Arabia on the competitiveness of the Dutch defence industry, including comparisons with German, French, Spanish and Czech practice, the Dutch military presence in the UAE, and whether defence firms can join trade missions. The government answered that the Netherlands is not acting alone since Germany and Finland also restricted exports, that the policy is justified by international obligations and humanitarian law, and that it regrets the negative effects on Dutch defence firms while pursuing harmonisation within the EU and opening trade missions to defence firms.
Arms export control is a national competence. EU member states are themselves responsible for assessing arms export applications against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position on arms exports.

Wapenexportcontrole is een nationale bevoegdheid. EU-lidstaten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de toetsing van wapenexportaanvragen aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over discriminatie van de defensie-industrie door het kabinet tegen de achtergrond van de Defensie Industrie Strategie

MP Bosman asks the government why the defence industry was excluded from trade missions and Dutch trade instruments, whether this fits the Defence Industry Strategy, and why earlier written questions remained unanswered. The government replies that generic trade instruments such as trade missions and Partners In Business are now open to defence firms with over 10% of activity in weapons or ammunition, while the Dutch Trade and Investment Fund remains under review and the delay was due to interdepartmental coordination.
The cabinet has instructed the implementers of its generic trade promotion instruments to make this adjustment.
Het kabinet heeft de uitvoerders van zijn generieke handelsbevorderende instrumenten opgedragen om deze aanpassing door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de inzet van Defensie in het ruimtevaartdomein

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Netherlands' role in the space domain, including NATO's space policy, investments, cooperation with Norway, the Brik-II military satellite and the Defence Space Security Centre. The minister answered at length on NATO's space policy, investment levels and cooperation, but gave largely descriptive, policy-restating answers without new commitments or oversight-related information.
Defence recognises the military importance of space and space capabilities.
Defensie onderkent het militair belang van de ruimte en ruimtecapaciteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over de berichten ‘Sint Maarten heeft nog paar maanden voor wetgeving rond witwassen’ en ‘Sint Maarten weigert strijd tegen witwassen en terrorismefinanciering aan

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the government about reports that Sint Maarten was lagging on anti-money-laundering legislation and about the scale of the problem and possible political obstruction. The State Secretary answered that AML is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, that several laws were recently adopted, that a CFATF public statement was withheld as a confidential draft, and that Dutch support and monitoring continue.
The statement in question concerns a confidential internal draft of an international body that was not adopted after CFATF deliberation and therefore was not published.
De genoemde verklaring betreft een vertrouwelijk intern concept van een internationaal orgaan, dat na besluitvorming in de CFATF niet is vastgesteld en daarom niet is gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over de Arctische Raad

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about the failure of the Arctic Council ministerial meeting in Rovaniemi, the US Secretary of State's speech on Chinese and Russian activity in the Arctic, and Russian plans for the Northern Sea Route. The government confirmed no Ministerial Declaration was adopted, said Dutch Arctic policy would be addressed in a forthcoming letter, and gave only general or deferred answers on the substantive questions.
You will receive this letter next summer.
Deze brief zult u komende zomer ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het stilzetten van nieuwe gepantserde SUV’s van de Marechaussee

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the grounding of 18 newly armoured SUVs for the Royal Marechaussee, covering the procurement process, the supplier's expertise and other clients, who bears the costs, safety guarantees, and the six additional vehicles. The government answered that the vehicles were procured through a regular tender, the supplier is in default and must bear repair costs, the repaired vehicles will be safety-checked by an independent third party, and delivery of six extra vehicles is suspended.
The supplier has now been placed in default. The costs of repairing the defects are entirely for the supplier's account.
De leverancier is inmiddels in gebreke gesteld. De kosten voor het herstellen van de gebreken komen geheel voor rekening van de leverancier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht 'Vlaketunnel uren dicht door storing: lange files'

MPs Dijkstra and Bosman asked the minister about a failure that closed the Vlaketunnel for hours, causing long traffic jams, and whether Zeeland's access and tunnel closures could be avoided. The minister explained the SCADA power-supply fault during maintenance, outlined detour routes and planned replacement of the control system, and said a change to the Tunnelwet is not needed.
Currently various actions are being taken. Among other things, replacement of the SCADA system is being prepared.
Momenteel worden er verschillende acties ondernomen. Onder andere wordt vervanging van het SCADA systeem voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Gent over de mogelijkheid tot ‘politiek verlof’ voor militairen

Two VVD MPs asked whether soldiers deployed abroad can temporarily give up their municipal council seat via 'political leave', and whether the law should allow this. The government answers that the Constitution offers no basis for replacing councillors deployed abroad, the only substitution being for pregnancy, childbirth or long-term illness, and it sees no need to introduce a replacement option.
The Constitution provides no basis for replacing councillors who are sent abroad for their profession, whether voluntarily or not.
De Grondwet biedt geen grondslag voor vervanging van raadsleden die voor hun beroep al dan niet vrijwillig worden uitgezonden naar het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over het bericht ‘Rusland: buitenlandse marineschepen niet meer zomaar langs kust Siberië‘

MPs Koopmans and Bosman asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reported Russian plans to require notification before foreign naval ships use the Northern Sea Route, and related Arctic military developments. The government said the scope of the reported measure is unknown, that notification requirements would conflict with innocent passage and freedom of navigation outside Russian internal waters, and that it will send an update on the security part of the Arctic strategy in mid-2019.
Nothing is known about the precise content and scope of the (possibly planned) measure.
Over de precieze inhoud en reikwijdte van de (mogelijk voorgenomen) maatregel is niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de modernisering van de ODA-definitie en de toerekening van hulp voor de Nederlandse Bovenwindse eilanden aan ODA

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked whether the UK's push to count disaster aid to richer territories as ODA could apply to the Dutch Caribbean islands, and why the Netherlands opposed the UK proposal. The minister answered that Saba, Sint Eustatius and Sint Maarten cannot count as ODA because they are not on the DAC list, and that the Netherlands opposes raising the income threshold while DAC support for the UK proposal is negligible.
Saba and Sint Eustatius are, as special municipalities, part of the Dutch state.
Saba en Sint-Eustatius zijn – als bijzondere gemeenten – onderdeel van de staat Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel 'Minister Ollongren is wél voor Europees leger'

MP Bosman asked the Interior Minister whether her remarks in Denmark supporting a European army contradict the cabinet position against one, and whether she informed colleagues or the ministry publicly announced her speech. The minister answered that her remarks on strengthened European defence cooperation match the cabinet line, that there is no plan to amend article 100 of the Constitution, and that she did not inform colleagues or publicly announce the speech.
This is in line with the cabinet position, which I share, as stated by the Prime Minister and the Minister of Defence.
Dit sluit aan op het kabinetsstandpunt, dat ik deel, zoals verwoord door de Minister-President en de Minister van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de zaak van VDL-RUAG Shelters B.V. tegen de Staat der Nederlanden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about a court ruling in the VDL-RUAG Shelters kort geding and about CBRN, electromagnetic and climate-control certification of the containers in a procurement. The government answered yes to all questions, referred to the tender evidence and the Programma van Eisen, and agreed to hold off irreversible purchase steps until the Chamber has considered the D-brief.
As usual, Defence will not take irreversible steps until the Chamber has considered this D-brief.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal Defensie geen onomkeerbare stappen zetten totdat de Kamer deze D-brief heeft behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Premier Sint Maarten mengt zich in strafzaak Theo Heyliger'

MP Bosman asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the Sint Maarten Prime Minister's public remarks on the Heyliger criminal case, which called for oversight of the public prosecutor and raised concerns about political influence. The State Secretary answered that such remarks are highly unusual and inappropriate in a rule-of-law state, and that he had conveyed this to the Prime Minister directly.

I share the view that it is highly unusual and inappropriate for a prime minister in a constitutional state to make this kind of statement, and I conveyed this to Prime Minister Leona Marlin-Romeo during my visit to Sint Maarten on 4 September.
Ik deel de mening dat het hoogst ongebruikelijk en ongepast is dat een premier in een rechtsstaat dit soort uitlatingen doet en heb Minister-President Leona Marlin-Romeo dit ook zo laten weten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Kustwacht Bonaire niet versterkt'

MP Bosman asked ministers whether the coast guard presence around Bonaire should be expanded amid Venezuelan migration, and what the Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving report implies. The government answers that the Kustwachtcommissie presidium found extra deployment not currently needed, that the coast guard already operates about 309 presence days in 2017 and intercepted 99 illegal migrants in early 2018, and that a contingency plan exists.
The presidium of the Kustwachtcommissie discussed the governor's letter at two of its meetings and concluded that additional deployment is currently not necessary.
Het presidium van de Kustwachtcommissie heeft in twee van zijn vergaderingen over de brief van de gezaghebber gesproken en geconcludeerd dat extra inzet thans niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over gezamenlijke productie van S500-raketten door Turkije en Rusland

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked whether Turkey proposed joint production of S-500 missiles with Russia, whether NATO had reacted, and whether Turkey's S-400 purchase would be integrated with NATO systems and operated by Russian personnel. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that neither NATO nor the Netherlands had been formally informed, that arms procurement is a sovereign matter, and that integration of the S-400 with NATO systems is nearly ruled out.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm these reports and does not wish to speculate about them.
Het kabinet kan deze berichten daarom niet bevestigen en wil hier niet over speculeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de vrees van de Arubaanse premier dat Aruba een tweede Syrië aan het worden is als gevolg van de instroom van Venezolanen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Aruban Prime Minister's claim that Aruba is becoming a second Syria due to Venezuelan inflows, and about related figures on migrants, weapons smuggling and Kustwacht interceptions. The State Secretary answered that the government sees no imminent mass migration, disputed the quoted statements, gave interception figures, and said cost-sharing from Curaçao for the Kustwacht was still outstanding.
I am not aware of any concrete figures on the number of Venezuelans who have left for the Leeward Islands in recent years.
Mij zijn geen concrete cijfers bekend over het aantal Venezolanen dat de laatste jaren naar de Benedenwindse Eilanden is vertrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Remco Dijkstra over een werkbezoek aan Schouwen-Duiveland

MPs Bosman and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about tractor restrictions on the N59 on Schouwen-Duiveland, including why only part of the road is closed and whether the safety risks of alternative routes will be independently investigated. The Minister confirmed awareness of the municipality's concerns, explained the criteria in the Zeeland agricultural traffic network, and said she is willing to support a new, additional independent study if needed.
If necessary, I am willing to cooperate in a new and additional independent study.
Indien het nodig is ben ik bereid om mee te werken aan een nieuw en aanvullend onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de opvang van Venezolanen op Aruba en Curaçao en de Nederlandse bijstand daarbij

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the reception of Venezuelans on Aruba and Curaçao and Dutch assistance, including requests for support, UNHCR's call for prima facie refugee status, the emergency plan for Bonaire, official counts of Venezuelans, and onward travel to the Netherlands. The government answered that Curaçao has requested support for a possible emergency, that asylum admission and expulsion is a national (country-level) matter with Dutch expertise offered, that protection claims are assessed individually, that official figures on undocumented Venezuelans are unavailable while registered numbers are given, and that Venezuelans need a temporary residence permit to stay in the Netherlands beyond 90 days.
I have informed the government of Curaçao that the Netherlands will, should such a case arise, provide support where possible, for example in the form of knowledge and expertise on migration.

Ik heb de regering van Curaçao laten weten dat Nederland – mocht zo’n geval zich voordoen – waar mogelijk ondersteuning zal bieden, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van kennis en expertise op bijvoorbeeld het terrein van migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de steun van Nederland ten behoeve van detentie en uitzetting van ongedocumenteerden op Curaçao

An MP asked whether the Netherlands offered Curaçao 100,000 euro for detention of undocumented migrants, what aid was offered, whether it is voluntary, how many migrants await removal, and whether Venezuelan migrants are registered. The government confirmed a voluntary contribution of 132,000 euro for additional detention capacity plus expert support, and gave detention and registration figures from Curaçao and Aruba authorities.
The support mentioned under answer 2 is not an obligation but a voluntary contribution.
De onder antwoord 2 genoemde steun betreft geen verplichting, maar een vrijwillige bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de proefboringen naar olie en gas op Aruba

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the start of exploratory oil and gas drilling on Aruba, questioning whether a sustainable budget should come before creating funds for such revenues, and the role of the College Aruba Financieel Toezicht. The State Secretary answered that the use of possible oil and gas revenue is for Aruba to decide, shared concerns about Aruba's public finances and debt, and said he had asked the Aruban Finance Minister for a budget compliant with CAft recommendations, while the CAft advises on the financial implications of such policy choices.

In my conversation with the Aruban Minister of Finance, Ms. Ruiz-Maduro, on 22 March, I expressed these concerns and asked her to come as quickly as possible with a 2018 budget that complies with the recommendations of the College Aruba Financieel Toezicht (CAft).

In mijn gesprek met de Minister van Financiën van Aruba, mevrouw Ruiz-Maduro, op 22 maart jl. heb ik deze zorgen ook kenbaar gemaakt en heb ik haar gevraagd zo snel mogelijk te komen met een begroting 2018 welke voldoet aan de aanbevelingen van het College Aruba financieel toezicht (CAft).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over een gesprek met Professionalisering L.V.V. Bonaire

An MP asked the state secretary about the project to professionalise the agriculture service (L.V.V.) on Bonaire, its contribution to economic development, obstacles raised by the island authority, and available Dutch support. The government replied that the project would help reduce food import dependence, that a 2015 Memorandum of Understanding stalled after the island executive approved a different plan, and that it will consult the island authority and consider alternative initiatives.
The Ministry of LNV now wants first, together with my ministry, to consult the public body to examine how the LVV domain can be developed in the original sense of the MoU.

Het Ministerie van LNV wil nu eerst, samen met mijn ministerie, in overleg met het openbaar lichaam treden om te bezien op welke wijze het LVV terrein kan worden ontwikkeld in de oorspronkelijke zin van het MoU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de begroting van het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire voor het dienstjaar 2017, inzake de Landbouw, Veeteelt en Visserij (L.V.V.)

Bosman (VVD) asked about the Bonaire budget for agriculture (LVV) for 2017, including the effect of spending, the reasons for flat revenues, whether maintenance funds were spent, which partners are involved, and agricultural development since 2010. The State Secretary answered that the funds are reserved, the spending will be checked in the 2017 accounts by the auditor, and questions on results are for the island government and the island council to assess.
