The reliability and lawfulness of the budget expenditures will be established during the audit of the 2017 annual accounts by the accountant.
De betrouwbaarheid en rechtmatigheid van de bestedingen van de begroting zal tijdens de controle van de jaarrekening 2017 door de accountant worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de begroting van het openbaar lichaam Bonaire voor het dienstjaar 2018

An MP asks the State Secretary whether a flat 13.25% subsidy cut in the 2018 Bonaire budget reflects good governance and whether it affects projects important to Bonairians. The State Secretary says the public body must present a balanced budget and that policy choices are its own, but acknowledges insufficient early informing of affected parties and reports that the island executive is reconsidering subsidy amounts for seven social institutions.
Given the great public outcry, my view is that this has now not been done sufficiently.
Getuige de grote maatschappelijke commotie, is mijn beeld dat dit nu onvoldoende is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Nijkerken-de Haan en Bosman over het bericht ‘Voorbereiding op kernramp kan beter’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about an OVV report finding that Dutch nuclear-disaster preparedness is largely on paper and little exercised, and about cooperation, iodine tablet distribution and evacuation planning with Belgium and Germany. The State Secretary answered that cooperation is constructive, that joint exercises are a priority (including a planned exercise with Belgium), that iodine rules were harmonised but differ in practice, and that regional safety boards will be consulted on cross-border risks.
The Dutch Safety Board finds in its report that the approach to a possible nuclear crisis is largely set down on paper but has been exercised only to a limited extent.

De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) stelt in haar rapport vast dat de aanpak van een eventuele nucleaire crisis goeddeels vastligt op papier maar dat de aanpak slechts in beperkte mate is geoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Deal in Nederland onder de radar”

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Bosman asked about reports that a Dutch administration office became shareholder in a large Venezuelan oilfield, whether this breaches Venezuelan law and EU sanctions, and what risks and oversight apply. The government declined to discuss the specific case citing tax secrecy, stated the EU sanctions do not restrict oil-sector transactions, noted firms must self-check compliance, and said the OECD guidelines research by the National Contact Point will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
Under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual taxpayers cannot, as is well known, be discussed.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan zoals bekend niet worden ingegaan op individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Interim gezaghebber stapt per onmiddellijk op’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior about reports that the interim governor of Bonaire resigned immediately, whether this breaks trust, its consequences for governability, and what will be done to ensure stable governance. The State Secretary confirmed the resignation, said the relationship was disrupted but the governor agreed to serve until 1 February, saw no direct consequences for governability, and committed to a broadly supported action plan with the Bonaire executive after a visit.
I have called on the Bestuurscollege to improve this.
Het Bestuurscollege opgeroepen om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de berichten omtrent de nieuwbouw van het Sint Elisabeth Hospitaal (Sehos) op Curaçao

An MP asked about press reports on the Sehos hospital rebuild on Curaçao, including financial mismanagement, an inspection order, and risks to the new HNO hospital and the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that financial responsibility lies with Curaçao, that the Cft monitors and can advise, and that the loan was taken under the Kingdom financial supervision framework with no separate Dutch risk identified.
It is up to the country of Curaçao to keep its own financial household in order.
Het is aan het land Curaçao om de eigen financiële huishouding op orde te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “CFT: Opschorten terugbetalingen Saba”

MP Bosman (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about a news report that repayments of Saba's loans would be suspended, and whether the College Financieel Toezicht (Cft) should give political advice. The State Secretary confirmed the report, explained that the Cft advised suspending 2018 loan repayments to keep Saba's budget balanced on a cash basis, and said he has not yet received Saba's budget and will decide on approval by 15 November.
I have not yet received Saba's budget including the advice addressed to me.
De begroting van Saba inclusief het aan mij gerichte advies heb ik nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bosman over het bericht ‘Sint-Maarten wijst voorwaarden hulp af’

MPs Van den Berg and Bosman asked whether Sint Maarten rejects the Dutch conditions attached to hurricane Irma reconstruction funds, how the lawful and efficient use of funds will be ensured, and whether conditions unrelated to transparency should be dropped. The State Secretary replied that Sint Maarten's parliament backed the conditions (an integrity chamber and stronger border control) on 2 November, that further safeguards will be elaborated, and that the conditions are directly related to integrity and effective use of funds.
The conditions set relate to the integrity of the use of financial resources for reconstruction.
De gestelde randvoorwaarden zien op een integere benutting van de financiële middelen voor de wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Azmani over het bericht ‘NAM erkent (gedeeltelijke) overschrijding, maar ontkent overtreding’

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about reports that NAM exceeded its gas extraction uncertainty margin at Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk, and how supervision and penalties work. The minister explained the 20% margin is a planning assumption, said SodM is still assessing NAM's response, promised to clarify winning plans and permit conditions, and described the EUR 2 million as a coercive measure rather than a fine.
SodM is currently assessing that response, including whether the overrun could have been prevented.
SodM is op dit moment bezig met de beoordeling van die zienswijze, waarbij ook wordt bekeken in hoeverre de overschrijding was te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Raak over het landsbesluit van Curaçao nr. 17/1922 van 5 september 2017

MPs Bosman and Van Raak asked the minister about a Curaçao decree creating a ministerial regisseur and supervisor for the new hospital project and its rising costs. The minister said the Curaçao hospital is a country matter, that Curaçao must cover any overruns itself, and that the Cft will assess the budget effects, while leaving the funding and staffing questions to Curaçao.
This is not known to me, but that is also not necessary since it concerns a country matter.
Dit is mij niet bekend, maar dat hoeft ook niet aangezien het een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over een speech van de minister-president van Aruba

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about a YouTube video and a speech by Aruba's Prime Minister promising passports within three years, asking when passports are available, what requirements apply, and whether passports could be given as a re-election gift. The Minister confirmed knowing the video, explained that nationality and passport are distinct and that Dutch nationality requirements (five years legal residence, three years for stateless persons, three years marriage for partners) cannot be waived, so a passport cannot be handed out as a gift.
These requirements prevent a passport of the Kingdom of the Netherlands from being provided as a gift.
Deze eisen staan eraan in de weg dat een paspoort van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden als cadeautje kan worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Premier Sint-Maarten: mariniers deden niks tegen plunderingen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Sint Maarten premier's claim that Dutch marines did nothing against looting was accurate and whether that claim undermines the relief effort. The minister answered that the premier expressed regret, that military assistance was requested and limited to shelters, damage assessment and police support under local civil authority, and that Dutch aid remains needed.
The assistance approved concretely involved staffing shelters, carrying out damage assessments and supporting the police in maintaining public order.
De geaccordeerde bijstand betrof concreet het bemannen van shelters, uitvoeren van damage assessment en ondersteunen van de politie bij het handhaven van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Camelia Romer boos op SONA en de pers'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about press reports of Curaçao's minister criticising SONA and the business case for the Hospital Nobo Otrobanda, and about SONA's conduct and financial risks for the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Cft monitors the project, responsibility for execution lies with Curaçao/SONA, the business case is provisionally sound pending an update, and Curaçao bears any cost overruns under its own budget.
Responsibility for executing the business case lies with the country Curaçao/SONA.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de business case ligt bij het land Curaçao/SONA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Stoelendans binnen Eilandsraad en BC nog niet voorbij’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of the Interior about frequent changes in the Bonaire Island Council and Executive Council, their effect on governance, the relationship with the Netherlands and the island's finances. The minister answered that the changes are a point of concern that weakens stable policy and public service, may widen the gap with citizens and affects trust with the Netherlands, while no signs yet show a worsened financial position, though financial management must improve.
So far I have no signals that the many changes are leading to a worsened financial position of the island.
Tot nu heb ik geen signalen dat de vele wisselingen leiden tot een verslechterde financiële positie van het eiland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Hoofd toelatingsorganisatie aangehouden om ambtelijke corruptie'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that the head of Curaçao's admission organisation was arrested for official corruption, including how residence permits were manipulated, whether Dutch passports could wrongly be issued, and Dutch involvement. The minister replied that details beyond press reports are unknown, that naturalisation on Curaçao is assessed by the Dutch IND after a five-year legal stay requirement, and that the criminal investigation is a matter for Curaçao with no Dutch involvement.
The criminal investigation currently underway is a matter for the Country of Curaçao.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat nu loopt is een aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over het modelcontract voor de energiemarkt

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the model energy contract is confusing, sometimes not actually available, and not offered by four of 26 suppliers. The minister said he had no further signals beyond the report, passed the concerns to the ACM regulator, and noted the model contract has not been formally evaluated.
I have therefore passed the signal about the model contract on to the ACM.
Het signaal over het modelcontract heb ik dan ook aan de ACM doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'CAft adviseert opnieuw algehele verplichtingen- en vacaturestop'

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about the CAft advice for an immediate hiring and spending freeze in Aruba, the government's stance on that advice, and consequences if Aruba does not follow it. The minister said Aruba decides its own measures, CAft will test them later in the year, and he has no grounds to assume Aruba will not heed the advice.
CAft will later in the year check whether the measures taken are sufficient.
Het CAft zal later in het jaar toetsen of de getroffen maatregelen voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Laatste bezoek vertrekkend voorzitter CAft'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the end of the Caribbean financial oversight board's term, whether permanent financial oversight for the former Netherlands Antilles limits Dutch financial risk, and how the Chamber will be involved in the 2018 evaluation. The minister defended the oversight as beneficial, said responsibility for public finances lies with the countries, and said the 2018 evaluation timing and content still need to be set, with the Chamber to be informed in time.
The Chamber will of course be informed in good time about developments in this area.
De Kamer zal uiteraard tijdig worden geïnformeerd over de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Patstelling postcoderoos tussen energieleveranciers en coöperaties'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is undesirable that customers of some energy suppliers cannot take part in the postcoderoos scheme, and whether the minister will oblige suppliers to participate or address the issue in the evaluation. The minister says all suppliers should participate ideally, will look at administrative burdens in the evaluation, but does not currently plan to make participation mandatory, leaving initiative with suppliers.
I am currently not considering obliging the energy suppliers.
Ik overweeg op dit moment niet om de energieleveranciers te verplichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Minister ontkent vertraging en onzekerheid rehabilitatie CITGO-raffinaderij'

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about reports that reopening of the CITGO refinery on Aruba was delayed, and about the effects on Aruba's finances, unemployment, debt and the Netherlands. The minister confirmed media reports of a delay of several months, said it may reduce growth and tax revenue for Aruba to be taken into account in its 2018 budget, and said a delay has no effect on the Netherlands.
Figures on the consequences for employment are not known to me.
Cijfers over de gevolgen voor werkgelegenheid zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “Problemen olieraffinaderij loodsen Aruba richting krimp”

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about refinery delays on Aruba, their effect on growth, employment, the PdVSA/CITGO financing, possible Rosneft involvement, and Chinese interest in Curaçao's refinery. The minister answered most questions by pointing to Aruban responsibility, the Centrale Bank and CAft, and by saying the government monitors developments without committing to new steps.
This question concerns a subject that falls under the responsibility of the country of Aruba.
Deze vraag heeft betrekking op een onderwerp dat tot de verantwoordelijkheid behoort van het land Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Curaçaose kust gaat dicht”

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked the government about a report that Curaçao was closing its coast to stem Venezuelan migration, and about the scope of the Kustwacht's tasks and the Dutch role in any investigation. The minister answered that the report rests partly on misinterpretation, that border control is Curaçao's own responsibility, that no concrete signs of a large refugee flow exist, and that the Kustwacht's border-guarding task is not new.
Border control is an autonomous matter of the country Curaçao.
Grensbewaking is een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis Curaçao bezorgt NL strop'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations whether the Netherlands faces a financial burden from its loan for the Curaçao hospital, and about the loan terms and a PwC report. The minister replied that Curaçao is autonomously responsible for the hospital's business case, that loan repayments are on schedule, and that he has no knowledge of a PwC report and no role in project management.
For the project management, Curaçao as an autonomous country is fully responsible itself.
Voor het projectmanagement is Curaçao als autonoom land volledig zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Totale vernietiging van zeer groot oppervlakte gezond koraal'

MP Bosman asked the Minister of the Interior about the destruction of nearly 3.7 hectares of healthy coral near Curaçao's port works, how it fits the permit's coral-saving obligation, its effects on research, tourism and liability, and Dutch support. The minister answered that the damage is still under investigation, that some planned damage was budgeted with 4 million ANG compensation, that liability is a matter for Curaçao, and that the Netherlands is open to cooperation on coral protection.
Nature protection is a responsibility of the countries.
Natuurbescherming is een verantwoordelijkheid van de landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Na vijf jaar aardbevingsellende staat Jannie met lege handen’

MPs Bosman and Rutte asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that entrepreneurs affected by Groningen gas-extraction damage receive no compensation for lost income or property value. The minister explained that business damage and lost income are compensable via NAM's business desk if causation is proven, with no advance payments, and listed NCG support measures such as an advice point for businesses.
Compensation takes place only after agreement has been reached on the existence and amount of damage, causation and the amount of compensation.
Vergoeding vindt plaats nadat overeenstemming is bereikt over bestaan en hoogte van schade, causaliteit en de hoogte van de vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het Paleis op de Dam symposium “Caribische koraalriffen”

Parliamentarian Bosman asked the Interior Minister about the state of Caribbean coral reefs, their value, whether enough attention is paid to them within the Kingdom, and whether the issue can be put on the agenda of the next Kingdom Conference. The minister acknowledged the reefs are in worrying condition, said natural protection is mainly a responsibility of the constituent countries and the Ministry of Economic Affairs rather than the Interior Ministry, offered to discuss a task force, and agreed to put the topic on the Kingdom Conference agenda and the Caribbean Sustainable Development Forum.
Nature protection is a responsibility of the countries, not of the Kingdom and not of the Minister of the Interior.
Natuurbescherming is een verantwoordelijkheid voor de landen, en geen verantwoordelijkheid van het Koninkrijk en evenmin van de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Bosman over het bericht "Op Sint Eustatius spoelen koelkasten de zee in"

An MP asked the minister about press reports that refrigerators were washing into the sea on Sint Eustatius and about the waste separation installation built by the central government. The minister denied large-scale washing-out, said the island's government lacks funds to staff and operate the installation, and listed the investment of over EUR 1.3 million paid by the ministry.
The image that large amounts of waste, including refrigerators, have been washed into the sea is not correct.
Het beeld dat er op grote schaal afval, inclusief koelkasten, in de zee zijn weggespoeld, klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het dispuut rondom Oyster Pond

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether French authorities inspected a construction site on the Dutch side of Oyster Pond, whether the border there is settled, and whether this is a territorial dispute and what its consequences are. The minister confirms a disagreement over the land border, says the status quo agreed in 2014 was breached by the French inspection, notes that border negotiations will start soon, and says relations with France are not affected.
The land border negotiations will be started as soon as possible.
De landgrensonderhandelingen zullen zo spoedig mogelijk worden aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Advies van wijzen voor Groningen’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a commission of wise persons should analyse the Groningen earthquake problem, and about a court ruling holding EBN jointly liable for earthquake damage. The minister said the National Coordinator Groningen will be strengthened and no new commission is needed, and that the State and EBN will decide their own response to the ruling while the case is pending.
Against this background, I see no reason to have a new commission examine the approach to the earthquake problem caused by gas extraction.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik geen aanleiding om een nieuwe commissie zich te laten buigen over de aanpak van de aardbevingsproblematiek als gevolg van de gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'SODM: aantal overtredingen door mijnbouwbedrijven stijgt'

An MP asked the minister whether the rise in SodM warning letters to mining companies (from four to ten) is undesirable, whether it reflects measurement changes, and what role the minister sees in reducing incidents. The minister answered that violations are unwanted, explained the warning letters concerned missing documents and late notifications, attributed the rise partly to a risk-based inspection method, and pointed to pending legislation strengthening offshore and mining safety and SodM's independence.
As a result of the proposed amendments to the Mining Act, SodM's tasks will increase.
Als gevolg van de voorgenomen wijzigingen van de Mijnbouwwet zullen de taken van SodM toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Bosma en Bosman over een nieuwe graaftechniek voor kabels

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new cable-laying techniques, the standard 60 cm burial depth, who can authorise other depths, and liability for damage to cables. The minister replied that no statutory depth exists, that NEN norms are advisory, that municipalities can prescribe depths under the Telecommunicatiewet, and that liability is for the courts to decide under the WION.
There is no statutorily prescribed depth for laying cables.
Voor de aanleg van kabels bestaat geen wettelijk voorgeschreven diepte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de aangekondigde sluiting van de Windward Island Bank (WIB) op Saba

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked whether the Windward Island Bank will close its Saba branch, what the consequences are, and whether the resulting single-bank situation and the stricter BES financial regulation are justified. The minister confirmed the closure, said the remaining bank RBC would hold a de facto monopoly that may be undesirable, attributed the decision mainly to poor financial results rather than regulation, and committed to ongoing consultation with the island government and supervisors to keep ATMs and at least one bank operating.
I am considering, in consultation with the parties involved, whether there are options to keep this ATM operational next year as well.
Ik bezie, in overleg met betrokken partijen, of er mogelijkheden bestaan om deze geldautomaat ook volgend jaar operationeel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Acuut behoefte aan meer bewakers en cellen'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that the Pointe Blanche prison on Sint Maarten urgently needs more guards and cells, and about who is responsible for the situation. The minister says the conditions match the Voortgangscommissie picture, that the Sint Maarten government must implement improvement plans with Dutch help conditional on effectiveness, and that the Sint Maarten government is responsible for the prison while he will press for compliance with the agreed plans.
Once the new government of Sint Maarten is installed, I will speak with them about progress on the action plans for the police and the prison.
Zodra de nieuwe regering van Sint Maarten is geïnstalleerd, zal ik met hen spreken over de voortgang inzake de plannen van aanpak voor de politie en de gevangenis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “parlement krijgt ‘slechts enkele dagen’ voor goedkeuring Citgo-deal’’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of the Interior whether Aruba's parliament had enough room to scrutinise the Citgo/Valero refinery purchase, and whether the purchase was submitted to the CAft oversight college. The minister said the parliament's role is a matter for Aruba's own Staten, that the purchase is a national affair not submitted to CAft, and that CAft will assess the budget effects later.
Based on the Aruba Financial Supervision Ordinance, the CAft has the authority to advise on Aruba's budget and budget amendments.
Het CAft heeft op basis van de Landsverordening Aruba financieel toezicht (LAft) de bevoegdheid om te adviseren op de begroting en begrotingswijzigingen van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Jacobi, Bosman en over een onderhoud met schippers uit de binnenvaart

MPs asked why commercial shipping was barred from the Krammer recreational lock, whether this and deferred maintenance cause delays and safety concerns, and about weekend closure of the Middensluis. The minister replied that the lock's structures cannot safely bear commercial use, that the maintenance is planned rather than overdue, and that weekend closure reflects low demand pending a new lock.
When commercial shipping uses the Krammer recreational lock, the structural capacity of the scaffolding and fenders is insufficient, so safety cannot always be guaranteed.

Bij gebruik van de Krammerjachtensluis door de beroepsvaart is de constructieve capaciteit van de steigers en remmingwerken niet voldoende, waardoor de veiligheid dan niet te allen tijde kan worden gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘’Isla werkt aan concept gaspijp vanuit Venezuela’’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports on a planned gas pipeline from Venezuela to Curaçao, including its costs, public financing, dependence on Venezuela and risks. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to answer the detailed questions by referring to Curaçao's responsibility as a national matter of that country, and stated that the Netherlands should not pay for the pipeline.
The subject at hand concerns a national affair of the country of Curaçao.
Onderhavig onderwerp betreft een landsaangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Vuijk en Bosman over het bericht “Venezuela beschuldigt Nederland en VS opnieuw van agressie”

MPs Ten Broeke, Vuijk and Bosman asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Venezuela's accusations against the Netherlands and the US of airspace violation and aggression, and whether the government would respond. The minister answered that Venezuela did not accuse the Netherlands of airspace violation, that the government has no information on any airspace breach, and that he voiced concern to the Venezuelan foreign minister and urged that such statements be avoided.
In a conversation with the Venezuelan Minister of Foreign Affairs, I expressed my surprise and concern about these unjustified and public accusations directed at Venezuela.
In een gesprek met de Venezolaanse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken heb ik mijn verbazing en zorg over deze onterechte en publieke beschuldigingen uitgesproken richting Venezuela.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en De Caluwé over het artikel ’Disrepair causes Statia court session to move’’

MPs Bosman and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that a courthouse building on Sint Eustatius was too dilapidated to use, and about responsibility for maintenance, affected hearings, costs and other closed state buildings. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that ownership was unclear for years, said repair works are ordered and funded, and answered that hearings were moved to other venues while other buildings are not closed.
The Ministry of BZK has also ordered repair works to be carried out, for which funds have also been made available.
Ook heeft het Ministerie van BZK opdracht gegeven om herstelwerkzaamheden te verrichten, waarvoor ook middelen ter beschikking zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ’Aruba en Valero sluiten definitief akkoord voor overname raffinaderij’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Aruba's purchase of the Valero refinery is financially sound, whether it resembles Curaçao's 1985 ISLA purchase, what economic gains and costs it brings, and whether it was submitted to the CAft financial supervisor. The Minister answers that it is a national matter, that no business case is known to him, that the CAft will assess the budget and multi-year financial effects later, and that costs must never fall on the Netherlands.

The CAft will, from its legally assigned task, therefore test the financial consequences for the (multi-year) budget of the concluded agreements on the takeover and reopening of the refinery against the norms of the Aruba Financial Supervision Ordinance.

Het CAft zal vanuit haar wettelijk toegewezen taak dan ook de financiële gevolgen voor de (meerjaren) begroting van de gesloten overeenkomsten ten aanzien van de overname en heropening van de raffinaderij toetsen aan de normen van de Landsverordening Aruba financieel toezicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Bosman over het bericht "Ministerie overweegt kwijtschelding subsidiefraude bij Movimientu Antiano i Arubano pa Provomé Partisipashon MAAPP (beweging ter bevordering van

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Bosman (VVD) asked why a 2010 subsidy to MAAPP was not recovered or fined after a former chair misappropriated funds, and how the ministry controls subsidy spending. The minister answered that only EUR 47,934 of EUR 159,608 was accounted for, the ministry holds a claim of EUR 79,752, no legal basis exists for a fine, and the claim was written off under the 2014 remission rules.
The chair did not spend this amount on behalf of MAAPP, so the foundation could account for only EUR 47,934.
Dit bedrag heeft de voorzitter niet ten behoeve van MAAPP besteed waardoor de stichting slechts een bedrag van € 47.934 heeft kunnen verantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de berichten “Antilliaanse verzekeraar leeg getrokken”, “Balletje-balletje op de Antillen met reserves van verzekeraar Ennia” en “Spin in het Antilliaanse web

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Finance and Interior Ministers about press reports on insurer Ennia on Curaçao, supervision by the Dutch and local central banks, and Dutch liability for failing Caribbean financial institutions. The ministers answered that prudential supervision of Ennia lies with the Curaçao central bank, that DNB's powers over BES branches are limited, that DNB's 2015 report is confidential so details cannot be given, and that the Dutch state is not guarantor for Caribbean financial institutions.

Because of, among other things, DNB's duty of confidentiality, which aims to limit possible harmful consequences for the institution concerned, and because of my systemic responsibility as Minister, under which in principle I do not receive information on individual supervised institutions from DNB, it is not possible for me to answer the questions about the content of the report and about any earlier warnings and actions.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht van DNB – die als doel heeft om eventuele schadelijke gevolgen voor de betrokken instelling te beperken – en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het voor mij niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van het rapport en over eventuele eerdere waarschuwingen en acties te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het nieuwsbericht “Ongeplande centrale-uitval plus veel wind vergen uiterste van TenneT”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the July 2016 market restrictions TenneT imposed due to grid congestion, and whether such problems will increase with renewables. The minister explained the combination of wind feed-in, unplanned plant outages and high imports/exports caused a rare congestion, that TenneT used market restrictions as a regular tool, and that a planned grid expansion by end 2018 should reduce the need, while acknowledging more flexibility may be needed later.
Applying market restrictions is in itself a regular activity for TenneT to resolve an N-1 exceedance in parts of the grid.
Het toepassen van marktrestricties is op zich een reguliere activiteit voor TenneT om een N-1 overschrijding in delen van het net op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over oproep van een Arubaanse minister om een visumplicht voor Venezolanen in te voeren

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior about an Aruban minister's call for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, and whether the issue had been discussed among the Kingdom countries. The government answered that there is currently no reason or request from Aruba for a temporary Caribbean visa requirement, that the issue has been raised in consultations and videoconferences, and that screening measures are preferred.
There is currently no request to that effect from the Aruban government or other Kingdom countries.
Er ligt op dit moment geen verzoek daartoe van de Arubaanse regering of andere Koninkrijkslanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de aankoop van een olieraffinaderij door het land Aruba

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior Affairs and Kingdom Relations about Aruba's purchase of the Citgo refinery, including who signs, Dutch involvement, liability for debts, environmental clean-up and gas supply. The minister answered that the purchase is an Aruban national matter with no Dutch involvement, that Nederland cannot be held liable, and promised a letter before the recess with the available information.
The purchase of the refinery by the government of Aruba is a matter for the country. For that reason the Netherlands has no involvement in it.
De aankoop van de raffinaderij door de regering van Aruba is een landsaangelegenheid. Om die reden heeft Nederland hierbij geen betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht Aanleg gasleiding Venezuela door internationaal consortium

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports of a Venezuelan gas pipeline and the reopening of the Citgo refinery on Aruba, covering timing, fuel supply, contracts and Aruban expertise. The minister said Aruban affairs are a national matter with no Dutch involvement, promised a letter with available information on the Aruban agreements, and referred the contract question to that letter.
The purchase of the refinery is a national affair of the country of Aruba. The Netherlands has had no involvement in this.
De aankoop van de raffinaderij betreft een landsaangelegenheid van het land Aruba. Nederland heeft hierbij geen betrokkenheid gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht Aruba schikt met Valero over milieuschade

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that Aruba settled with Valero over environmental damage at the refinery, Nederland's role in the negotiations, Valero's liability for decommissioning, a timeline of the purchase, and whether Aruba had sufficient expertise. The minister replied that the refinery purchase is a matter for Aruba, that Nederland was not involved, and that the negotiations with Valero are not concluded and details are unknown to him.
The purchase of the refinery by the government of Aruba is a country matter.
De aankoop van de raffinaderij door de regering van Aruba is een landsaangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Gevangenen Curaçao in de val’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about reports that prisoners on Curaçao were trapped by welded-shut fire doors, whether the evacuation plan works, who is responsible for injuries, and when the doors will be replaced. The minister said a fire-brigade inspection found the evacuation plan adequate, replacement quotes have been requested, and responsibility for prison safety lies with Curaçao's justice minister as an autonomous matter.
The management of the prison on Curaçao is an autonomous matter for the country of Curaçao.
Het beheer van de gevangenis van Curaçao betreft een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Arubaanse delegatie in Caracas voor Citgo-deal”

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch ambassador played a formal role in an Aruban trade delegation's visit to Venezuela tied to a lease of the San Nicolas refinery. The minister answered that the ambassador only received and accompanied the Aruban delegation as is customary, and that the Dutch government has no formal role because the matter is Aruba's autonomous responsibility.
This concerns an autonomous competence and responsibility of Aruba.
Dit betreft een autonome bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat een Curaçaose loterij het ook goed doet in Nederland

MPs Bosman and Van Wijngaarden asked whether illegal sales of Curaçao lottery tickets in the Netherlands are undesirable, whether kansspelbelasting should be paid, and what enforcement exists and is used. The government agrees the sales are undesirable and that tax should be paid, describes administrative and criminal enforcement tools, says the Kansspelautoriteit so far used only informal measures such as warnings because cases were not large-scale, and says the minister will raise internet gambling oversight with Curaçao at the JVO.
The investigation by the Kansspelautoriteit led to intervention and to the ending of the violations.
Het onderzoek van de Kansspelautoriteit heeft geleid tot interventie en tot het beëindigen van de overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Zowel bajes van Curaçao als Sint Maarten afgekeurd’

MP Bosman (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that prisons on Curaçao and Sint Maarten failed inspection and whether the Kingdom should help them meet CPT standards. The minister said enforcement is primarily the responsibility of the countries themselves, that the Netherlands supports detention facilities only on request, and that he has no reason to think the evaluation report does not reflect reality.
On that basis, it is primarily up to the governments of the countries to act.
Op basis daarvan is het primair aan de regeringen van de landen om te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Aruba koopt Valero raffinaderij met vervuilde grond en al’

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that Aruba is buying the Valero refinery with contaminated soil, including the business case, costs, cleanup, dependence on Venezuela, sustainability and fiscal risk. The minister answered that the purchase is a national Aruban matter, that the CAft oversight body will assess fiscal consequences, and that the cleanup fund and other details are not known to the Kingdom government.

About the business case for the purchase and lease structure of the refinery and the economic value of reopening it, I have no further information beyond media reports, as this is a national Aruban matter.

Over de businesscase voor de aankoop en leaseconstructie van de raffinaderij en de economische meerwaarde van de heropening van de raffinaderij is mij geen nadere informatie dan uit mediaberichtgeving bekend, aangezien het hier een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht dat de noodstroomvoorziening van kerncentrale Borssele ondermaat is

An MP asked the minister about reports that the emergency power supply of the Borssele nuclear plant is inadequate, and whether the claims by Wise and Greenpeace and by the plant's owner are correct. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, referred to an earlier letter, and stated that the claim about loss of the second grid connection is factually incorrect because that connection through the coal plant remains in use until a replacement in 2017.

The claim by Greenpeace and Wise that, due to the decommissioning of the nearby Borssele coal plant in November 2015, this second connection to the grid of the KCB running via that coal plant has also lapsed, is factually incorrect.

De bewering van Greenpeace en Wise dat door het uit gebruik nemen van de nabijgelegen Kolencentrale Borssele in november 2015 ook deze tweede verbinding met het elektriciteitsnet van de KCB die via deze kolencentrale loopt is vervallen klopt feitelijk niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over niet meer internationaal bellen vanuit Venezuela

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether Venezuela's mobile operators stopping international calling, the end of international post, and its effects on opposition and migration reflect a repressive escalation affecting the Kingdom. The government answered that the cut stems from foreign-currency shortages linked to the economic crisis, that opposition risks are not shown to rise, and that it monitors migration closely without expecting large-scale flows.
The government closely monitors developments in Venezuela.
De regering monitort de ontwikkelingen in Venezuela nauw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Bosman over de berichtgeving over het Vlaamse voornemen om tol te heffen op personenauto’s

MPs Visser and Bosman asked the minister about Flemish plans to levy road tolls on passenger cars, Belgian truck tolls, the Eurovignette, and German car tolls. The minister said there are no concrete Flemish plans yet, that discrimination is not allowed under EU law, that Flemish roads are a Flemish responsibility, and that she will raise kilometre charging with her Flemish counterpart.
At my next meeting with Minister Weyts, which is not yet scheduled, I will certainly put the kilometre charge on the agenda.
Ik zal bij het eerstkomend gesprek met Minister Weyts, dat nog niet gepland is, zeker het onderwerp kilometerheffing agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “Shell in je elektromotor”

An MP asked the government about hydrogen fuelling infrastructure, the number of hydrogen vehicles, and a low-pressure hydrogen technology by H2Fuel, including whether research on its efficiency would be conducted. The answers give current and planned counts of tanking points and vehicles, state the technology is at an early stage requiring further validation, and say the ministry is considering how to do so.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment is currently considering how this can best be carried out.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu beziet momenteel op welke manier dit het beste kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘ACM wil structurele ruimte voor aansluiting smart grids’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the energy transition needs more room in laws and regulations, citing ACM's position on smart grid connections. The minister answered that no concrete legal obstacles are currently known, that ACM can only grant exemptions from its own codes and chose a code change instead, and that the new Electricity and Gas Act will broaden experimentation rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Bosman inzake samenwerking tussen scholen in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen die worden geconfronteerd met leerlingendaling

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary about cooperation between secondary schools in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen facing declining pupil numbers, including whether a full range of school types should be maintained. The state secretary said schools' boards are primarily responsible for provision and coordination, that OCW supports cooperation through a regional process facilitator and earlier advisory support, and that the boards must intensify cooperation.
The starting point is that school boards in the region are themselves responsible for the educational provision and its mutual coordination.
Uitgangspunt daarbij is dat schoolbesturen in de regio zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het onderwijsaanbod en de onderlinge afstemming daarvan.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Mishandeling Surinamer in vreemdelingenbarak’

MP Bosman (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether he knew of similar abuses in Curaçao's prison, whether he agreed they were unacceptable, and whether the Netherlands risked UN criticism over the situation. The Minister replied that the matter falls within Curaçao's autonomy, that Curaçao is responsible for preventing abuses, that the Netherlands gives only incidental, limited support, and that the Kingdom is legally responsible under international treaties.
The prison in Curaçao is an autonomous matter of the country of Curaçao.
De gevangenis van Curaçao betreft een autonome aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het onderzoek ‘Sluiting van kolencentrales’ van SEO in opdracht van Natuur & Milieu

An MP asked the minister about an SEO study commissioned by Natuur en Milieu on closing coal plants, including criticism from Uniper and TNO and whether the study's emission figures from 1990s plants are outdated. The minister acknowledged the study relies on old emission data, presented actual emission figures for the new plants showing they are often lower than SEO assumed, and expected the social benefits to be considerably lower than reported.
In the report, SEO itself notes that the emissions it uses to calculate social benefits are based on emission figures of two coal plants from the 1990s.
In het rapport benoemt SEO zelf dat de emissies die zij hanteert om de maatschappelijke baten te berekenen gebaseerd zijn op de uitstootcijfers van de twee kolencentrales uit de jaren »90.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Visser en De Boer over het bericht ‘Naar een duurzame energiehuishouding met LNG’ in het NEN magazine van februari 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article on building an EU-wide LNG refuelling network, who is responsible for it, who pays, and how the Netherlands can use LNG opportunities. The minister answered that the market should build alternative fuel stations with government setting conditions, that the Netherlands supports the internal energy market, and that various LNG safety, Green Deal and promotion efforts are underway.
In principle the market is responsible for realising the networks of alternative fuel and charging stations.
In principe is de markt aan zet om de netwerken van alternatieve tank- en laadstations te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht dat EVnetNL laadpalen wil overdragen aan gemeenten

The MP Bosman asks whether the transfer of EV charging points from EVnetNL to municipalities is market-distorting, whether managing charging points is a municipal task, and whether the transfer can be reversed. The minister answers that the transfer is a matter between EVnetNL and the municipalities, consistent with the Green Deal, that market parties already operate such points, and that no reversal is planned.
No, this is a matter between municipalities and EVnetNL, see also answer 2.
Nee, dit is een zaak tussen gemeenten en EVnetNL zie ook antwoord 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bosman over het verschil in schuldpositie van Aruba tussen de rapportages van de Centrale Bank van Aruba en de rapportages van het College Aruba financieel toezicht

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about differences between the Central Bank of Aruba and the CAft figures on Aruba's deficit and debt, and about Aruba's financial management and borrowing. The minister answered that the CAft advised approval of an Aruban foreign loan which the Kingdom Council of Ministers approved, reported a 2015 deficit of AWG 98 million (2.0% of GDP) with incidental factors, and explained the figure differences by different accounting bases.
Het CAft zal hier op toezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het behoud van de gasinfrastructuur op de Noordzee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether offshore platforms in the North Sea should be kept for future wind farms and whether gas must remain available for extraction. The minister found reuse of existing infrastructure interesting, said fossil fuels and Dutch gas remain needed, supports keeping the option to extract remaining reserves within the energy agreement, and promised to keep talking with industry and inform the House.
I am willing to remain in consultation with the parties involved and to explore the advantages and disadvantages of the various options.
Ik ben bereid met de betrokken partijen in overleg te blijven en te verkennen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van de verschillende opties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bosman over mogelijke betrokkenheid van KPMG bij (illegale) gokpraktijken op Curaçao en Sint Maarten

MPs Van Raak and Bosman asked about reports of illegal online sports betting on Curaçao, possible links to the US market, and KPMG's alleged role auditing casino owner Francesco Corallo on Sint Maarten. The minister replied that gambling oversight is primarily a local matter for the Public Prosecution Services, pointed to a 2015 protocol and the Bientu conviction, and declined to comment on individual companies.
The gambling world and the handling of possible abuses within it is primarily a local matter.
De gokwereld en de aanpak van mogelijke misstanden daarbinnen is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht dat een drugskoerier uit Curaçao, Curaçao niet meer in mag

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether it is undesirable that a convicted drug courier from Curaçao, a Dutch-resident woman, is barred from returning to Curaçao, shifting the problem to the Netherlands, and whether she should serve her prison sentence. The minister answered that the entry ban is a supplementary penalty imposed under Curaçao law to protect potential couriers, denied that it burdens the Netherlands, said enforcement of the sentence is for Curaçao's justice minister, and noted the Dutch law has no equivalent provision.
Enforcement of the sentence imposed by the court in Curaçao falls under the responsibility of the Minister of Justice there.
De tenuitvoerlegging van de door de rechter op Curaçao opgelegde straf valt onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van justitie aldaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Jan Vos over de waardevermeerderingsregeling

MPs Bosman and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Groningen value-increase compensation scheme budget (about 125 million euro) had been exceeded and whether applicants would be refused. The minister answered that 85 million euro had been paid on approved claims, that the cap will likely be substantially exceeded if all pending claims are approved, and that the government will address the motion on the scheme in the spring memorandum.
If all submitted applications and applications that may still follow on the basis of damage reports are approved, the subsidy ceiling will be substantially exceeded.
Als alle ingediende aanvragen en aanvragen die op basis van schademeldingen nog kunnen volgen worden goedgekeurd zal het subsidieplafond ruim worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘PAR fractie eist duidelijkheid over begroting HNO’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports of a cost overrun at the Curaçao hospital HNO and whether the Financial Supervision Office (Cft) had overstepped its role in the loan, and who pays the overrun. The minister answered that the hospital is an autonomous matter for Curaçao, that the Cft acts only as executor of the consensus law with safeguards, and that he stands by his earlier letter.
The construction of the hospital is and remains an autonomous matter of the country Curaçao.
De bouw van het ziekenhuis is en blijft een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curacao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Visumplicht Venezuela

Two MPs asked whether a visa requirement for Venezuelans, floated by Aruba's tourism minister, should be considered, and about risks to Bonaire. The minister confirmed the remarks, said visa requirements affect bilateral relations and reduce bona fide tourism, noted Aruba and Curaçao's stricter entry controls, and said a visa requirement is not currently warranted but would be decided jointly for all Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
Aruba and/or Curaçao cannot unilaterally decide to introduce the visa requirement.
Aruba en/of Curaçao kunnen niet eenzijdig beslissen tot het instellen van de visumplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Plasterk deelt kritiek De Telegraaf niet'

An MP asked Minister Plasterk whether a newspaper article quoting him on criticism of De Telegraaf's reporting on Aruba's government was accurate, and about allegations against Aruban ministers. The minister confirmed the opening remark but declined to take a position on the substance, stating that the matters fall outside the Kingdom's competence and are for Aruba's prosecutor and courts.

Having established this, I can only point out in general terms that the cabinet is known to be very active in the area of integrity in government, both in the Netherlands and elsewhere in the Kingdom.

Dit vastgesteld hebbende, resteert mij er in algemene zin op te wijzen dat bekend is dat het kabinet zeer actief is op het terrein van integriteit in het bestuur in Nederland en elders in het Koninkrijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het sluiten van elektriciteitscentrales

The MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs what the reported closure of gas-fired power plants by GDF Suez means for long-term security of electricity supply, including TenneT's sensitivity variant C, possible solutions and implementation times. The minister answers that the closures were already largely accounted for, that a worst-case shortfall of 1.3 GW by 2022 is covered by 6.2 GW of temporarily idled capacity and interconnection, and that supply security is adequately guaranteed.
It is important to carefully monitor the security of the electricity supply.
Het is belangrijk om de leveringszekerheid van de elektriciteitsvoorziening zorgvuldig te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Moors over de hulp van een netbeheerder betreffende het betalen van de energienota

MPs Bosman and Moors asked whether netbeheerder Alliander's infrastructure arm contributes staff to a new charity, Energiebank Nederland, and whether a public company with a statutory task should fund poverty policy. The minister answered that Alliander provides about three full-time equivalents until 1 April 2016, costs borne by the infrastructure company rather than passed to tariffs, and left the choice to the company and its public shareholders within legal limits.
It is therefore a decision for the shareholders whether they consider such spending desirable.
Het is dan ook een afweging van de aandeelhouders of zij een dergelijke besteding wenselijk vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Venezolanen die Curaçao weigeren te verlaten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Venezuelan holidaymakers refusing to leave Curaçao were a problem, whether Curaçao's controls at sea and on arrival were adequate, and whether the Kingdom government had pressed for monitoring under a motion, plus what it knew of a Curaçao taskforce. The minister confirmed a modest rise in overstays, said Curaçao has autonomous control over entry and that sea controls were tightened, and stated that close contact with Aruba and Curaçao is maintained without giving precise figures.
Admission is a competence of Curaçao. It is up to Curaçao to organise the process of entry and exit.
Toelating is een bevoegdheid van Curaçao. Het is aan Curaçao om het proces rondom in- en uitreis in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over drugssmokkel van Venezuela naar het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a July 2015 interception of 125 kilos of cocaine on a Venezuelan boat, the scale of drug smuggling from Venezuela to the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, and whether Aruba and Curaçao have enough capacity to fight it. The government confirmed the interception (later put at 150 kilos, handed to the Venezuelan navy), said reliable data on the scale of smuggling do not exist, and stated that the Caribbean authorities have adequate tools and cooperate with international partners.
There are no reliable data on the scale and origin of drug smuggling in or via the Caribbean region.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare gegevens over de omvang en herkomst van drugssmokkel in of via het Caribisch gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het Rapport van bevindingen Jaarrekening 2013 Curaçao van de Algemene Rekenkamer Curaçao

An MP asked the minister about the Curaçao Audit Chamber's finding of seriously deficient financial management in 2013, the status of Cft reports, and the risks to Dutch loans such as to the hospital. The minister answered that the next Cft inventory comes after summer, that Cft reviews loans partly using Audit Chamber reports, that debt risks exist, and that financial management still needs development.
The inventory on the 2013 annual accounts, the 2014 budget execution and the 2015 budget preparation will become available after the summer.
De inventarisatie over de jaarrekening 2013, de begrotingsuitvoering 2014 en de begrotingsvoorbereiding 2015 komt na de zomer beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Bosman en Visser over het strandvissen met kleine fuiken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether the ban on recreational eel fyke-netting in Zeeland's beach fishing could be reconsidered given its heritage status and the Waddeneilanden exception. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies nationwide, enforcement would be disproportionate, and the eel stock remains critical, so there is no reason to reopen the ban or consult again.
I therefore see no reason to revisit the position of my predecessors or to enter into consultation on this again.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op het standpunt van mijn ambtsvoorgangers terug te komen en hierover opnieuw in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Leegte en Veldman over de gevolgen van windenergiegebieden op zee voor de visserij

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the economic damage to fishing from the Borssele offshore wind zones, including detours, fishing-ground loss, and passage for vessels up to 42 metres. The State Secretary answered that impacts will be assessed in the final environmental report, that a decision on passage for vessels up to 24 metres is planned for end-2015, and that the fishing sector remains involved.
At this moment it therefore cannot yet be indicated what the effects will be.
Op dit moment is dan ook nog niet aan te geven wat de effecten zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de bespreking van de zeebaars bij de Landbouw- en Visserijraad

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the sea bass recovery measures discussed at the December 2014 Agriculture and Fisheries Council, including the outcome, minimum landing size, bag limits for sport fishers and proportional contributions. The State Secretary answered that the outcome was disappointing, no EU-wide measures were agreed, the Commission only issued a call for effort reduction, and recreational catch limits and a minimum size increase were discussed with partial national measures already in place.
I find the outcomes disappointing, given the need to take urgent measures.
Ik vind de uitkomsten teleurstellend, gelet op de noodzaak om dringend maatregelen te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het voornemen van het vliegveld Princess Juliana International Airport en het havenbedrijf The Harbour Group of Companies van Sint Maarten om casino’s te bouwen

An MP asked the Interior Minister about casino plans by Sint Maarten's airport and harbour companies, alleged licensing despite a moratorium, integrity failures, and whether the Kingdom should intervene under Article 43 of the Statute. The minister denied a moratorium existed, said the integrity reports are taken seriously, and declined to order intervention now, pointing to a Sint Maarten action plan with Dutch assistance available.
Taking a measure becomes a consideration when the duty each country has under Article 43(1) of the Statute, including good governance, is structurally neglected and no internal remedy is provided.

Het nemen van een maatregel komt in overweging wanneer de zorgtaak die elk der landen op grond van het eerste lid van artikel 43 Statuut heeft met betrekking tot onder andere het deugdelijk bestuur, structureel verwaarloosd wordt en er intern geen redres wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Staatsraden oneens met aanwijzing’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the legal basis for the Governor of Aruba's directive on the 2014 budget is sound, after three Council of State members publicly questioned it, and whether such public opinions undermine independent advice. The Minister replies that the royal decree is lawful under the Governor's Reglement as a Kingdom organ safeguarding the Kingdom's interests, that the directive does not infringe Aruban autonomy, and that he will not comment on individual media statements, while noting advisory bodies are expected to act prudently.
If desired, they can and will be called to account on this by the chair of the Advisory Division.
Desgewenst kunnen en zullen zij hierop worden aangesproken door de voorzitter van de Afdeling advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over duurzame energie in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands, including reported postponement of geothermal energy on Saba and the Sint Maarten green energy strategy. The government answered that it supports renewable investment, funds Saba and Sint Eustatius utilities for wind or solar, consulted Saba's government on geothermal, and says it does not block geothermal exploration but has no budget for multi-year losses.
Furthermore, it must be noted that the cabinet does not place any obstacle in the way of any party setting up geothermal energy in the Caribbean.
Voorts moet opgemerkt worden dat het kabinet geen enkele partij iets in de weg legt om geothermie in de Caribben op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de staking Kustwacht

MP Bosman asked the Defence Minister about a strike by Curaçao Coast Guard patrol staff, its effects on regional security, threats to local staff, drug seizure trends and decentralisation of coast guard command. The minister replied that the strike lasted about 36 hours, did not compromise border security, that threat reports were unfounded or unrecorded, that seizures fluctuate, and that a pilot decentralisation is under evaluation with the director remaining responsible.
The strike has had no consequences for security in the region.
De staking heeft geen gevolgen gehad voor de veiligheid in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Ten Broeke en Verheijen over de Sanctiewet van Curaçao

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers how the Curaçao parliament's rejection of the Kingdom sanctions law affects implementation of EU sanctions against Russia and whether a national Kingdom sanctions law (Rijkssanctiewet) is needed. The government answered that EU sanctions must apply across the Kingdom, that Aruba and Sint Maarten have adapted their rules, that work on a national law continues because Curaçao has not yet adapted its ordinance, and that Curaçao's autonomous legislative competence cannot be overridden.
The draft national sanctions law does allow each country to determine separately which parts of the law enter into force.
De concept Rijkssanctiewet voorziet overigens in de mogelijkheid om voor elk Land afzonderlijk te bepalen welke onderdelen van de wet in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over de recente ontwikkelingen omtrent de arrestatie van de Venezolaanse consul op Aruba

Two VVD MPs asked how the accreditation of Venezuelan consul-general Carvajal on Aruba went wrong, who grants consular approval, and whether the US contacted Dutch ministries before requesting his arrest. Minister Timmermans answered that the nota was not sent through proper diplomatic channels, so no exequatur was granted, that Venezuela could reasonably assume provisional admission and immunity, that only the Foreign Minister decides on such matters, and that the US did not inform the Netherlands and the reason is unknown.
It is not known why the US did not inform the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend waarom de VS Nederland niet heeft ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Harbers over een leningsverzoek van Curaçao ter grootte van 60 miljoen Antilliaanse Guldens

MPs Bosman and Harbers asked the Finance Minister about Curaçao's 60 million ANG loan request, the CFT's advice, whether the Rijkswet's conditions were met, why the Netherlands subscribes despite CFT concerns about financial management, and transparency of state-owned enterprises. The Minister answered that the CFT found the requirements met and advised positively, that Dutch subscription is mandatory under the Rijkswet, and that Aruba's protocol is not currently active.
On the basis of this assessment, the CFT gave positive advice on Curaçao's loan request.
Het Cft heeft op basis van deze toets positief geadviseerd over het leningverzoek van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over de toekomst van het Openbaar Ministerie en de landsrecherche op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about Dutch responsibility for the Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten, the temporary reinforcement of the Landsrecherche, mediation with the Rijksrecherche, the Aruba/Curaçao cooperation convenant, and whether prosecution capacity is sufficient. The government answered that law enforcement is an autonomous competence of the countries, that the temporary capacity boost has ended, that Sint Maarten's request for extra capacity is under review, and that capacity is considered adequate.
The Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten falls under the consensus national ordinance on the public prosecution services of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Sint Maarten valt onder de consensus-Rijkswet «Rijkswet openbare Ministeries van Curaçao, van Sint Maarten en van Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba».

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Bosman en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat de aanleg van glasvezel in Caribisch Nederland twee keer duurder is dan begroot en volledig door de Nederlandse belastingbetaler wo

MPs from the VVD asked why the Caribbean Netherlands submarine fibre cable cost roughly double its budget, why the state took on extra costs, and why it became a shareholding in SSCS B.V. without prior parliamentary approval. The minister replied that costs exceeded the original estimate by about EUR 8.9 million (not a doubling), that the extra funds covered redundancy and protection, that the shareholding was a transitional choice under the Comptabiliteitswet, and that the company is non-profit with cost-based tariffs.
With my letter of 9 December I aimed to align as closely as possible, albeit retrospectively, with the normal procedure of Article 34.
Met mijn brief van 9 december jl. heb ik beoogd zoveel mogelijk, zij het achteraf, aan te sluiten bij de normale procedure van artikel 34.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Dijkhoff, Elias en Litjens over het artikel ‘Onderzoek naar corruptie KLM werd vroegtijdig gestaakt’

MPs from the VVD asked whether a Caribbean corruption investigation into KLM-linked bribery was stopped early after a judge-commissioner imposed a four-month time limit, and why. The minister answered that the time limit was set under the reasonable-time rules, the prosecution prioritised two of eight files, the Oil Trading Bonaire file was dropped, and a later court complaint was only partly upheld.
The Public Prosecution Service on Bonaire has informed me that neither the Oil Trading Bonaire file nor other investigation has shown any free business-class flights.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Bonaire heeft mij bericht dat noch uit het dossier «Oil Trading Bonaire», noch uit overig onderzoek, is gebleken over gratis businessclassvluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over het advies van de SER van Sint Maarten om de Antilliaanse Gulden in te ruilen voor de US Dollar

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about the Sint Maarten SER advice to dollarize the Antillean guilder, including the Curaçao-Sint Maarten current account deficit, devaluation risks, and effects on BES islands. The government replied that dollarization is not currently planned, that the matter is for the countries themselves, and that it will share Dutch experience with Sint Maarten.
The peg between the Antillean guilder and the US dollar is a matter for the countries themselves.
De koppeling tussen de Antilliaanse gulden en de US Dollar is een aangelegenheid van de landen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over Visserij Partnerschapsakkoorden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how many EU fisheries partnership agreements have been concluded in the past ten years, what framework guides Dutch positions on them, how Dutch fishers' interests are weighed, and how the Netherlands handles agreements where it has no direct interest. The State Secretary answered that most of the 20 agreements predate ten years, that Dutch positions are tested against EU external fisheries standards including sustainability, human rights clauses and local benefit, and that the same framework applies regardless of Dutch direct interest, with a parliamentary reservation used on new protocols.
When discussing a new protocol or a new negotiating mandate, the Netherlands routinely enters a parliamentary reservation.
Nederland tekent bij de bespreking van een nieuw protocol of een nieuw onderhandelingsmandaat standaard een parlementair voorbehoud aan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Azmani en Van der Linde over signalen dat Sint Maarten zich bij het verlenen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit niet houdt aan de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs Bosman, Azmani and Van der Linde asked whether signals exist that Sint Maarten grants Dutch nationality in breach of the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap, and whether the Sint Maarten Justice Minister wants to ease passport grants for immigrants, along with related questions. The state secretary answered that such signals are unknown, that the Sint Maarten minister disavowed the newspaper report and said only the Kingdom government may grant nationality, and that the rules should remain uniform across the Kingdom.
Signals as referred to in the first question are not known to us.
Signalen als bedoeld in de eerste vraag zijn ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en De Boer over het bericht «Uitstel aanleg Seine-Nord-kanaal domper voor havens Zeeland»

MPs Bosman and De Boer asked the Infrastructure minister whether the postponement of the Seine-Nord canal, a TEN-T priority project, harms Zeeland ports, whether France can delay it alone, and whether the Netherlands can recover financial losses or pressure France. The minister answered that France decides on timing, EU coordination is limited, financial consequences are hard to state, and Dutch contacts with France continue without a formal demand.
The Netherlands supports France's subsidy application, but the construction remains a French matter.
Nederland steunt de subsidieaanvraag van Frankrijk, maar de aanleg blijft verder een Franse aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Bosman, De Liefde en Rudmer Heerema over nationale koppen ten aanzien van Europese regelgeving op het gebied van landbouw, natuur en visserij

MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs for an overview of stricter-than-EU national rules (nationale koppen) affecting farmers, growers and fishers, including their regulatory-burden effects and planned reductions under the coalition agreement. The government answered that the overview was sent in September 2013 and a sector-specific regulatory-burden approach for agro and food is underway, with a table of measures and their burden effects, and no full list of nationale koppen per directive was given beyond the inventory of current rules.
Progress on the ambition to reduce regulatory burden by 2.5 billion euro by 2017 is reported to the House twice a year.
Over de voortgang ten aanzien van de ambitie om de regeldruk per 2017 met 2,5 miljard euro te verminderen wordt uw Kamer twee maal per jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Ark over het op het laatste moment verplaatsen van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

Two VVD MPs asked why the Curaçao Gay Pride venue was changed at the last moment, whether this affects freedom of assembly, and how LGBT safety and expression are guaranteed on Curaçao. The minister answered that public order is an autonomous Curaçao matter whose considerations are unknown to him, that only one MP's letter was received, and that no signals of unsafety were received.
It is up to the Curaçao government to weigh whether additional requirements for organizing the Gay Pride are necessary to maintain public order and safety.

Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride om daarmee de openbare orde en veiligheid te handhaven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman en De Boer over het artikel ‘Havenbaronnen kapen onze bedrijven weg’

MPs Bosman and De Boer asked whether Belgian ports receive state subsidies that disadvantage Dutch ports and whether this breaches a level playing field in Europe. The minister acknowledged Flemish funding for Flemish seaports, said Dutch ports are not on a level playing field in harbour-internal costs, and said existing EU rules are insufficient but she supports the proposed EU Port Regulation and state-aid guidelines.
That is why I am in principle positive about the proposed EU Port Regulation.
Daarom sta ik in beginsel positief tegenover de voorgestelde EU Havenverordening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “minister wil maatregelen tegen sensatiejournalistiek’

Dutch MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about a Sint Maarten minister's plan for phased press accreditation rules that could restrict press freedom, and whether this conflicts with the constitution's free-expression guarantee. The minister answered that press freedom is a very high good, that any restriction must respect the constitution and treaties, and that fundamental rights are a matter for Sint Maarten's own government, which is accountable to its Staten.
Compliance with fundamental rights is a matter for the country.
De naleving van grondrechten is een landsaangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het evaluatierapport over Aruba van het IMF

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about the IMF evaluation of Aruba, including the 8.5% deficit, rising debt, and whether Aruba should cut its deficit and who is responsible if its finances fail. The minister replied that Aruba is autonomous and responsible for its own fiscal policy, that the Dutch PM raised concerns during a visit, and that Aruba plans to anchor budget rules in its constitution and create an advisory college.
It is therefore the responsibility of the Aruban government to ensure sustainable public finances, with the Staten as the controlling body.
Het is daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid van de Arubaanse regering om toe te zien op houdbare overheidsfinanciën, met de Staten als controlerend orgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de begroting van Sint Maarten

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about Sint Maarten's budget, including whether a deficit of 2-3% should be tolerated and who is responsible if its finances are not brought in order. The minister rejected any flexibility beyond the zero-deficit norm, acknowledged the late budget and the CFT's concerns, and stated that responsibility lies with Sint Maarten itself while noting the Kingdom could intervene if governance is jeopardised.
It is the responsibility of Sint Maarten itself. That responsibility cannot be shifted onto others.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van Sint Maarten zelf. Die verantwoordelijkheid kan niet worden afgeschoven op anderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de stormvloedkering

An MP asked the minister about large scour holes near the Oosterschelde storm surge barrier, whether they were anticipated at construction, whether they have grown beyond design assumptions, and what structural maintenance and costs follow. The minister answered that safety was never at risk, that scour was anticipated and monitored, that slides near the Noordbeveland dikes were not foreseen and have been stabilised, and that tightened management with a costed programme through 2014 is in place, while withholding cost figures due to an ongoing tender.
I endorse the thrust of these articles; safety is and was not at stake.
Ik onderschrijf de strekking van deze artikelen, de veiligheid is en was niet in het geding.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Leegte en Litjes naar aanleiding van berichten in de media over de overname van energieproducent Ecopower op Bonaire door het Amerikaanse energiebedrijf Contour
