MPs Bosman, Leegte and Litjens asked the ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about the electricity price rise on Bonaire caused by the dispute between Ecopower and the utility WEB, including subsidies, integrity investigations, and the role of the island government. The minister replied that prices are now cost-covering, payments are per invoice, an audit was done, the island executive is commissioning a governance review, and the Onderzoeksraad Integriteit Overheid does not cover these bodies.
I will ask the island executive of Bonaire to include this subject in that investigation.
Ik zal aan het bestuurscollege van Bonaire verzoeken om dit onderwerp bij dit onderzoek te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ’Schuld Aruba enorm’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about a report that Aruba's public debt is rising to 71.2%, whether the Netherlands should subscribe to Aruban bond loans, and whether the Netherlands is financially ultimately responsible under the Statute. The minister acknowledged the worrying financial trend, said Aruba's autonomy means oversight lies with Aruban institutions, noted a 2013 protocol under which the Netherlands may refuse subscription if Aruba fails sustainability criteria, and denied that the Netherlands bears ultimate financial responsibility.
The Netherlands reserves the right not to subscribe if Aruba does not meet the criteria.
Nederland behoudt zich het recht voor niet in te schrijven indien Aruba niet voldoet aan de criteria.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over de laatste politieke ontwikkelingen op Sint Maarten

An MP asks the Dutch minister about political developments on Sint Maarten, including alleged vote-buying by the UP leader, the integrity of proposed ministers, and the status of a vote-buying investigation. The minister says Sint Maarten's judiciary and ministerial screening are autonomous matters, declines to comment on individuals' integrity, and states that strict integrity screening is desirable.
Law enforcement falls under the autonomous powers of the countries.
Rechtshandhaving valt onder de autonome bevoegdheden van de landen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Bosman over de kwaliteit van rechtspraak in Zeeland

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of quality concerns at the prosecution service and courts in Zeeland, whether he shares them, their causes and remedies, and whether budget cuts and reorganisation could worsen matters. The minister acknowledges the problems, attributes them to several factors including the 2013 court-map merger of the Breda and Middelburg prosecution offices, says he sees no structural signs and expects quick resolution, and refers to a separate letter on budget effects.
There is intensive monitoring. I have no indications that the identified problems are structural in nature and I expect them to be resolved soon.
Er is sprake van intensieve monitoring. Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de geconstateerde problemen structureel van aard zijn en ga ervan uit dat zij spoedig worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Houwers, Bosman, Litjens, De Boer, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over ruimtelijke ordening op zee

VVD MPs asked the government for an overview of all plans, visions and directives touching on spatial planning at sea, their relationships, their national or EU origin, and the timing of answers before a committee debate. The minister answered that the National Water Plan and the North Sea policy note with the Integraal Beheerplan Noordzee form the integrated framework, described how EU directives are implemented nationally, and provided a schematic overview and a commitment to update the spatial framework in 2015.
The cabinet intends to adopt spatial protection measures for the seabed of the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden, to be reflected in the National Water Plan in 2015.
Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om ruimtelijke beschermingsmaatregelen te nemen voor de bodem van het Friese Front en Centrale Oestergronden, die neerslaan in het Nationaal Waterplan in 2015.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Litjens, en Aukje de Vries over mosselkweek en natuur op de Waddenzee

MPs Bosman, Litjens and Aukje de Vries asked about the Produs research on mussel farming and Wadden Sea nature, including the withdrawn press release and whether mussel seed fishing should continue until harm is proven. The state secretary said the findings will feed into the convenant evaluation due spring 2014, that the government will not prejudge policy decisions, and that a spring fishing permit was granted on 7 May.
I want to give the covenant parties the room to reach agreements based on the evaluation.
Ik wil de convenantspartijen de ruimte geven om op basis van de evaluatie tot afspraken te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over hulp van Nederland bij de herfinanciering van de staatsschuld van Aruba

MP Bosman (VVD) asks the minister whether the Netherlands should subscribe to Aruba's sovereign bond issues, citing concerns about Aruba's deficits and debt, and asks about oversight, the advisory college and why Aruba is not under financial supervision. Minister Plasterk answers that any subscription will be assessed against sustainability and repayment criteria, that Aruba bears responsibility for its own finances and oversight, and that the detailed procedure is still being worked out.

The Netherlands will (have) assess(ed) the possibilities for a subscription requested by Aruba against criteria of sustainable public finances and repayment capacity used in the Kingdom and internationally.

Nederland zal de mogelijkheden voor een door Aruba gevraagde inschrijving (laten) beoordelen op in het Koninkrijk en internationaal gehanteerde criteria van houdbare overheidsfinanciën en terugbetalingcapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heijnen en Bosman over berichten dat de politiek op Sint Maarten corruptieonderzoek torpedeert

MPs Heijnen and Bosman asked whether Sint Maarten's government would cut the police, prosecution and criminal investigation services, potentially disrupting the corruption probe into a Member of Parliament and a minister, and whether MPs' salaries were rising. Minister Plasterk answered that Sint Maarten is financially autonomous and its budget is not yet final, that the prosecution has sufficient capacity so the probe can continue, that he will raise the cuts and the action plans with Sint Maarten's Prime Minister, and that MPs' allowances are about 30% higher than in Aruba and Curaçao, which he has objected to informally.
I would however consider it worrying if the announced cuts were indeed to affect the quality of law enforcement, investigation and prosecution of (cross-border) crime

Ik zou het echter zorgelijk achten als de aangekondigde bezuinigingen inderdaad gevolgen zouden hebben voor de kwaliteit van de rechtshandhaving, onderzoek en vervolging van (grensoverschrijdende) criminaliteit
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bosman over het vangstverbod voor wolhandkrab

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the ban on catching Chinese mitten crab in Dutch waters, citing reports suggesting limited health risk and the export potential of clean crab, and asking whether the ban should be reconsidered. The government answered that the latest risk assessment still shows elevated risks from high-dioxin brown meat in closed areas, that the ban stays, and that it declined to give a full opinion on some questions pending interdepartmental coordination.
The most recent analysis results for the mitten crab and the risk assessment by the bureau give me no reason to reconsider this catch ban.
De meest recente analyseresultaten van de wolhandkrab en de risicobeoordeling door bureau geven mij geen aanleiding op dit vangstverbod terug te komen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Raak en Heijnen over het artikel “Patrick Illidge seen in tape apparently accepting bribe”

Three MPs asked the Interior Minister whether a reported video showing a Sint Maarten official apparently accepting a bribe linked to prostitution, and whether the Kingdom's guarantee function should be invoked. The minister replied that the Sint Maarten Public Prosecutor is investigating and has seized material, that the Dutch Rijksrecherche can only act on Sint Maarten at its request, and that the guarantee function does not apply.
It is for the Public Prosecutor's Office of Sint Maarten to conduct further investigation and determine whether and who should be prosecuted.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie van Sint Maarten om nader onderzoek te verrichten en te bepalen of en zo ja wie vervolgd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het fuikenverbod in de recreatieve visserij

An MP asks the State Secretary why a 2011 ban on recreational fishing with fyke nets along the coast was imposed, whether fishers were informed, and whether the ban will be lifted given its cultural and limited scale. The State Secretary answers that the ban implements the EU-mandated Dutch eel management plan, was widely communicated, and will not be reversed, as the alternative proposal conflicted with the plan.
I see no reason to reconsider this position.
Ik zie geen reden om op dit standpunt terug te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ‘Overleg over regeling interlandelijk verkeer blijkt nooit te zijn begonnen’

Mr. Bosman (VVD) asked whether the Koninkrijk working group on inter-island movement of persons and goods, agreed at the 2011 conference, has ever met, and how Curaçao and Sint Maarten's refusal to participate should be handled. The minister replied that only Aruba responded to repeated invitations, that Curaçao and Sint Maarten gave no reason, and that the matter is left to the incoming cabinet.
So far, only Aruba has responded to the invitations.
Tot nu toe heeft alleen Aruba op de uitnodigingen gereageerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over de vervolging door het Hof van Justitie van de Bonairiaanse gedeputeerde El Hage en de oud-bestuurder Booi voor hypotheekfraude en valsheid in geschrifte

An MP asked the minister whether the prosecution of Bonaire's deputy El Hage and former official Booi for mortgage fraud and forgery should lead to his suspension, whether corruption exists elsewhere on Bonaire, and what the status is of strengthening local government. The minister confirmed awareness of the case, declined to judge on suspension (leaving it to the island council), said he knows of no other OM investigations into Bonaire's administration, and described training and support initiatives including the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's general duty for good governance.
It is not appropriate for me as minister of BZK to pass judgment on this. That judgment rests with the island council, and with him as well.
Het past mij niet als minister van BZK hierover een oordeel te vellen. Dat oordeel is aan de eilandsraad, alsook aan hemzelf.
Antwoord vragen Bosman en Leegte over de artikelen ‘10 miljoen extra in rioleringsproject’ en ‘Atsma: “Bonaire niet alleen laten opdraaien voor energieprobleem’”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about press reports of an extra 10 million euro for the Bonaire sewerage project and about the state secretary's statement that Bonaire should not be left alone with the energy problem. The state secretary confirmed the Dutch contribution, explained that energy and water tariffs would otherwise rise sharply and that bridging contributions and the 10 million would come from delayed programme budgets without extra cuts in the Netherlands.

At the request of the Bonaire executive council, the Representative of the Crown and the Ministry of the Interior, my colleague and I were asked to lay down in law that energy and drinking water tariffs and the sewerage levy are set in an efficient, cost-covering and affordable way.

Door het bestuurscollege van Bonaire, Rijksvertegenwoordiger en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken is aan mijn collega van EL&I en mij verzocht om in de wet vast te leggen dat de energie- en drinkwatertarieven en rioolheffing op een efficiënte, kostendekkende en betaalbare wijze tot stand komen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte over het bericht ‘Desastreuze stroomprijs Bonaire’?

Two VVD MPs asked ministers whether WEB on Bonaire had deliberately underpaid Ecopower for electricity, whether the island government shares responsibility, and how tariffs, transparency and cross-subsidies work. Minister Verhagen answered that the dispute was settled via arbitration, that the island executive council sets tariffs and has not adjusted them since July 2010, and that an audit and a new tariff proposal are pending.
Under the Electricity Concessions BES Act, the island executive council is authorised to set tariffs for the supply of electricity.
Het bestuurscollege is op grond van de wet Elektriciteitsconcessies BES bevoegd om de tarieven voor de levering van elektriciteit vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ‘Geld gratis onderwijs is ‘lening’ RdK' (Refineria di Kòrsou)

An MP asked whether Curaçao is funding free education through a dividend advance from a state-owned company, and whether this undermines public finances and Dutch-financed debt relief. The minister answered that the Cft has asked the Curaçao government for information three times without response, that the arrangement would appear to breach the Rijkswet and national rules, and that the Cft did not advise on it because it falls outside its legal scope.

The Cft itself indicates that the financial position of state-owned companies, and perhaps even more pressingly of the social funds, gives it reason to take these institutions into account more explicitly when assessing the countries' budgets.

Het Cft zelf geeft aan dat de financiële positie van overheidsvennootschappen, maar misschien nog wel actueler, van de sociale fondsen, voor het Cft aanleiding zijn om bij het beoordelen van de begrotingen van de landen deze instellingen nog nadrukkelijker mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

An MP asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families, including in Curaçao, have their child benefit reduced under the residence-country principle, and whether they should be exempt given they pay Dutch premiums. The minister confirmed benefits are indexed to the cost level of the child's country of residence and rejected an exemption for deployed soldiers, since the rule applies to all exported benefits without special categories.
The residence-country principle means the amount of a benefit is aligned with the cost level of the country in which the beneficiary or the child lives.
Het woonlandbeginsel houdt in dat de hoogte van een uitkering wordt afgestemd op het kostenniveau van het land waarin de belanghebbende of het kind woont.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ‘27 weken zwangere toeriste niet welkom’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a 27-week pregnant Dutch tourist was refused entry to Curaçao over fears of a birth burdening the island, whether Dutch citizens with valid passports are refused entry, and whether the Curaçao minister should be addressed. The minister said an individual immigration officer erred, the woman was then admitted, the incident is regrettable, no reason exists to address the Curaçao minister, and he lacks data on uninsured Curaçao users of Dutch healthcare.
Due to an error by an individual immigration officer at Hato Airport, a Dutch woman was not immediately granted access to Curaçao, although she held a valid passport.
Door een fout van een individuele immigratiefunctionaris op Hato Airport heeft een Nederlandse vrouw niet direct toegang gekregen tot Curaçao, terwijl zij wel in bezit was van een geldig paspoort.
Antwoord vragen Bosman over het bericht ‘Defensie worstelt met zijn mensen’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Defence struggles with its personnel, including the scarcity of vacancies, outdated listings on the vacancy bank, business partnerships and placement numbers. The minister explained that vacancies are withheld during reorganisation, that listing procedures are being improved, that convenants with industry exist, and that about 2000 staff found new posts via the vacancy bank.
During this year, as the reorganisation progresses, more and more vacancies will be opened and listed in the vacancy bank.
In de loop van dit jaar zullen, door de vordering van het reorganisatieproces, steeds meer vacatures worden opengesteld en opgenomen in de vacaturebank.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over zelfdoding onder veteranen

MPs Bosman, Van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence minister whether suicide among veterans is tracked and whether a higher suicide rate among Balkan veterans is suspected. The minister answered that only CBS records causes of death without veteran status, that a RIVM study found no significant excess suicide among Balkan veterans, and that Defence is studying periodic CBS-based research and may include veteran suicide data in the Veteranennota from 2013.
Defence is studying whether it is possible to carry out periodic research into suicide among veterans based on CBS information.
Defensie bestudeert of het mogelijk is om aan de hand van de informatie van het CBS periodiek onderzoek uit te voeren naar zelfdoding bij veteranen.
Antwoord vragen Bosman over het artikel ‘Emissie op Sint Maarten succesvol’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about a reported Sint Maarten port bond issue, whether Dutch oversight or CFT played a role, and whether Curaçao's planned loan would require Dutch purchase. The minister answered that the port is a private company outside the Rijkswet Financieel Toezicht, so neither Dutch government nor CFT had a role, and that the Curaçao road fund is not a budget fund so the Dutch standing facility cannot be used.
The port is a private-law company and therefore does not fall under the provisions of the Rijkswet financieel toezicht.
De haven is een privaatrechtelijke onderneming en valt hierdoor niet onder de bepalingen van de Rijkswet financieel toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord vragen Bosman over het artikel “Uitbrander voor landmachtbaas”

An MP asks the Defence Minister whether the Land Forces commander was reprimanded over quality-based selection in personnel cuts, and about frozen promotions and union agreements. The minister says contact with commanders was discussed, that quality and experience criteria are used, that promotions are limited but not frozen, and that a clarifying letter will follow.
The commander of the CLAS will remove the misunderstandings in a new letter.
De commandant van het CLAS zal in een nieuwe brief de misverstanden wegnemen.

Vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het conflict tussen het energiedistributiebedrijf WEB e

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Interior about the unresolved payment dispute between utility WEB and supplier Ecopower on Bonaire, including whether binding arbitration had been completed by the agreed 7 November 2011 deadline. The minister replied that talks between the parties continue, the dispute persists, arbitration has not been concluded because the timetable was deliberately set aside, and no party is obstructing a solution.
However, the parties have also agreed between themselves that, with the consent of both, the planned timetable could be deviated from if negotiations toward a solution required it.

Partijen zijn echter ook onderling overeengekomen dat met beider instemming van het voorgenomen tijdsschema zou kunnen worden afgeweken indien onderhandelingen om te komen tot een oplossing dat zou noodzaken.

Vragen van de leden Leegte en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht Zorgen om energievoorziening Saba en Stati

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Interior about the energy supply on Saba and Sint Eustatius after the splitting of utility Gebe, including concrete plans for new companies, cross-subsidies from Sint Maarten, the risk of doubled energy prices, and eligibility for EU Connecting Europe funding. The government replied that SEO research indicates cheaper supply is feasible, that support from the ministry for new companies has been arranged, that regulation is being worked on with results expected in 2012, and that it opposes using the EU facility for these islands.
With the executive councils of Saba and Sint Eustatius it has meanwhile been agreed that they will receive support from my department in forming the intended new companies.
Met de bestuurscolleges van Saba en Sint Eustatius is intussen afgesproken dat zij bij de vorming van de beoogde nieuwe bedrijven ondersteuning krijgen van mijn departement.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Luchtvaartsector Curaçao krijgt Nederlandse hulp» (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP asks whether Curaçao asked the Netherlands for help reviewing its outdated aviation law to meet FAA and ICAO safety standards, and whether the Netherlands will assist and who pays. The minister confirms a request from Curaçao, explains the Kingdom's responsibility under the Chicago Convention, agrees to assist with an action plan at Curaçao's cost, and says two officials were deployed with travel costs borne by the ministry.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment responded positively to Minister Cooper's request to assist in drawing up an action plan to remedy the findings.
Het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu heeft positief gereageerd op het verzoek van minister Cooper om te assisteren om een actieplan op te stellen teneinde de bevindingen te redresseren.

Vragen van de leden Bosman en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de minister Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Staatssecretaris geschoffeerd op Curaçao» (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

MPs Bosman and Neppérus asked whether a Dutch state secretary of Finance was slighted when the Curaçao finance minister would not receive him, and how this fits with Dutch-Curaçao relations. The minister answered that the failed meeting was due to poor relations with other interlocutors, not the secretary's position, that a meeting is now promised, and that relations are generally improving.
In the meantime, the Curaçao minister of Finance has agreed to hold the meeting with the state secretary after all.
Inmiddels heeft de minister van Financiën van Curaçao zich bereid verklaard om het gesprek met de staatssecretaris alsnog te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Defensie over het artikel «Marine Curaçao siddert voor criminelen» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP asks ministers whether threats and theft against Dutch military families on Curaçao are rising, whether the local police are failing, and whether Dutch funding should stop. The minister denies rising threats, describes Defence's security measures and Kmar patrols, and says the police implementation plan is still being monitored with a report to follow.
After receiving the report, I will inform your House about this.
Na ontvangst van de rapportage zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het tekort op de betalingsbalans van Curaçao en Sint-Maarten (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the current account deficit of Curaçao and Sint Maarten, the IMF's warning, possible Dutch guarantees of their public debt, and the means available to protect Dutch taxpayers. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not guarantee their debt, that a strict borrowing framework applies via the Rijkswet Financieel Toezicht, and that the islands' current account deficit is addressed through spending restraint and monetary measures overseen by the financial supervisor.
The Netherlands does not guarantee the public debt of Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
Nederland staat niet garant voor de staatsschuld van Curaçao en Sint Maarten.
Vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat er nog steeds niet voldoende kleding voor militairen is (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the defence minister why military clothing and equipment remained insufficient, after a union had begun distributing clothes because Defence could not. The minister acknowledged shortages, attributed them to financial problems, procurement delays and KPU company problems, and promised improvement by end 2012, though he declined to commit to a full evaluation of the KPU company for now.
Vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over het artikel «Bestuur en administratie bij Defensie niet op orde» (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the defence minister about press reports that Defence is poorly prepared for upcoming budget cuts, including claims of weak governance, backlog in personnel files, and Court of Audit concerns about business operations. The minister answered that reorganisation and an internal improvement programme are underway, that personnel file checks are behind schedule with completion expected mid-2012, and that he will report on budget cuts and operational improvements in the annual report.
In addition, I will inform you about the progress of improvements in business operations.
Daarnaast zal ik u informeren over de voortgang van de verbeteringen in de bedrijfsvoering.

Vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Bonaire zonder stroom» (ingezonden 26 aug

MPs Bosman and Leegte (VVD) asked ministers about a payment dispute between utility WEB and generator Ecopower that left Bonaire without reliable electricity, asking who is responsible, whether people and firms were harmed, and whether supply will be guaranteed. The minister answered that the dispute is private-law based with a mediation and possible binding arbitration by 7 November, that the island government has primary responsibility while the national government has no direct role in generation, and that he will examine whether further regulation can help.
The local government has a primary responsibility for the electricity supply.
Het lokale bestuur heeft een primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor de stroomvoorziening.

Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «Curaçao wil gevangenen uit Bonaire terugsturen» (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

The MP asks how many prisoners from Bonaire are held in Curaçao, why they have not been moved to Bonaire, and whether transfer arrangements existed around the 2010 constitutional change. The state secretary answers that 22 Bonaire detainees are held in Curaçao on temporary arrangements, with five moved to the Netherlands and the rest to be transferred to Bonaire, citing security and the new prison due around 2015.
Once the new prison on Bonaire is completed (2015) and the necessary security measures are guaranteed, these detainees will be transferred to Bonaire.
Zodra de nieuwbouw van de gevangenis op Bonaire gereed is (2015) en daarmee de noodzakelijke veiligheidsmaatregelen gegarandeerd zijn, zullen deze gedetineerden naar Bonaire worden overgebracht.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over Servische veteranen (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

An MP from the VVD asks the Defence Minister whether the Veterans Institute or a private individual is funding help for Serbian veterans, whether Serbia is primarily responsible, and whether the Institute should restrict itself to Dutch veterans. The minister replies that a Matra-funded project by Kontakt der Kontinenten is involved, costs do not fall on the Defence or Veterans Institute budgets, Serbia bears primary responsibility, and the Institute serves Dutch veterans while maintaining international knowledge exchange.
Costs are not charged to the budget of Defence or the Veterans Institute.
Kosten komen niet ten laste van de begroting van Defensie of het Veteraneninstituut.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat legertrucks al twee jaar vaststaan door plantjes

Two VVD MPs asked why army trucks sat for two years on a site with protected fern (blaasvaren) growing under them, and what would be done to move them. The state secretary answered that the ferns were transplanted under a Flora and Fauna Act exemption, most trucks are gone, and the remaining population will be decided after an evaluation in September.
With the Ministry of Defence it has been agreed that, before the last ferns are removed, the project plan will first be evaluated.
Met het ministerie van Defensie is de afspraak gemaakt dat, voordat de laatste varens worden verwijderd, eerst het projectplan wordt geëvalueerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat het conceptwetsvoorstel Rijkswet Personenverkee

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the draft Rijkswet Personenverkeer had been shelved and why it must be withdrawn and renegotiated, given Curaçao's reluctance and the need for reciprocity. The minister confirmed a new approach in close consultation with the Caribbean countries, with the aim of informing the Tweede Kamer by year-end.
My aim is to inform the House of Representatives by the end of the year about the main lines of a regulation.
Mijn streven is om de Tweede Kamer eind van het jaar te informeren over de hoofdlijnen van een regeling.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bijstand bij sporenonderzoek (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Defence and Interior ministers about the deployment of Hr. Ms. Rotterdam sailors to assist a crime-scene investigation on Sint Maarten, including the legal basis, duration, training, command, funding and police staffing shortfall. The minister answered in detail: the deployment was unarmed, under police and prosecutor direction, based on a 1987 royal decree, funded from FNIK, and due to a temporary police shortage.
The House will be informed about the progress of the implementation of the action plans.
Over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de plannen van aanpak zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over problemen omtrent het aanvragen van een DigiD op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MPs Van der Burg and Bosman asked why Dutch residents of the Caribbean Netherlands cannot obtain a DigiD account, whether a GBA-PIVA link exists, whether they agree such residents should have DigiD, and when this will be fixed. The minister explained that DigiD depends on the BSN, which does not exist in the Caribbean Netherlands, rejected the wish for DigiD for now to keep Antillean systems, and promised a counter-based issuance pilot in the first half of 2012.

In addition, I expect that by early 2012, in consultation with (border) municipalities and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, one or more suitable locations will have been found for a counter-issuance pilot.
Daarnaast verwacht ik begin 2012, in overleg met (grens)gemeentes en het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken, één of meerdere geschikte locaties te hebben gevonden voor een proef met balieuitgifte.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het afkeuren van de begroting van Sint Maarten (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

An MP asks whether the financial supervisor (Cft) rejected Sint Maarten's amended 2011 budget, whether it asked for binding policy rules, and how the government will respond, including on monitoring, reserves and the territory's objections to financial supervision. The minister confirms the Cft found the budget not balanced under the Kingdom Act, that the Cft requested policy rules, that a monitoring commission is planned by Sint Maarten, and that he will not yet speak of improper administration pending information on reserves.
I would therefore not at this moment want to speak of improper administration.
Ik zou dus op dit moment niet willen spreken van onbehoorlijk bestuur.

Vragen van de leden Straus, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bosman en De Boer (allen VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid door centralisatie overheidsdiensten (inge

MPs of the VVD asked whether preserving administrative employment in shrinking regions is crucial and what measures the government takes so that central government reorganisations strengthen the economic structure and jobs in those regions. Minister Donner answered that regional authorities are responsible for regional economic vitality, that location choices weigh efficiency and service above regional employment, and that earlier analysis showed no disproportionate regional job effects.
The initiative for successful cooperation between these parties lies with governments at the regional level.
Het initiatief voor een succesvolle samenwerking tussen deze partijen ligt bij de overheden op regionale schaal.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de begroting van Curaçao en Sint Maarten (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations why Sint Maarten's 2011 budget was approved only on 23 December 2010, after the statutory deadline, and what the consequences and government response are. The minister replies that the budget was approved in time for a workable interim arrangement, that the Cft is still reviewing it, and that intensified consultation is planned to avoid similar problems in 2012.
The Cft informed me on 15 December that Sint Maarten did not yet have an adopted budget.
Het College financieel toezicht (Cft) heeft mij op 15 december bericht dat Sint Maarten nog geen vastgestelde begroting had
Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Defensie over de inzetbaarheid van F16’s (ingezonden 8 november 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the defence minister whether two-thirds of Dutch F-16s are unavailable for maintenance, whether parts are cannibalised, and whether stabilisation missions can still be supported. The minister confirmed periods of only one-third availability due to ageing, parts and maintenance staff shortages, said NRF and Afghanistan commitments are unaffected, and promised measures in a spring 2011 policy letter.
In spring 2011 the House will be informed by a policy letter on defence policy for the duration of the cabinet period.
In het voorjaar van 2011 wordt de Kamer met een beleidsbrief geïnformeerd over het defensiebeleid gedurende de kabinetsperiode.

m: Motie van de leden Voordewind en Servaes over leefbaar loon als voorwaarde binnen een aangescherpt inkoopbeleid van de overheid
Asks the government to make a living wage a condition in tightened public procurement and in all IMVO covenants, and to encourage local authorities to do the same.
a time-bound 'living wage' plan to be a condition within a tightened government procurement policy
een tijdgebonden plan «leefbaar loon» een voorwaarde te laten zijn binnen een aangescherpt inkoopbeleid van de overheid
Motie van de leden Servaes en Voordewind over wetgeving ter bestrijding van dwangarbeid en moderne slavernij
Asks the government to prepare legislation against forced labour and modern slavery in line with an ILO protocol and SDG target 8.7.
requests the government to prepare legislation aimed at combating forced labour and modern slavery
verzoekt de regering, wetgeving voor te bereiden die is gericht op de bestrijding van dwangarbeid en moderne slavernij
Motie van het lis Servaes c.s. over het facultatief protocol bij het ESC-verdrag
Motion asks the government to submit the Optional Protocol to the ICESCR to the Tweede Kamer as soon as possible so it can be debated this term.
requests the government to submit the optional protocol to the ICESCR to the House of Representatives as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om het facultatief protocol bij het Internationaal Verdrag inzake economische, sociale en culturele rechten zo spoedig mogelijk aan de Tweede Kamer voor te leggen
Motie van de leden Servaes en Kerstens over het WK voetbal in Qatar en de situatie van arbeidsmigranten
Asks the government to discuss joining an ILO complaint on forced labour in Qatar and to support a criminal case against FIFA.
requests the government to consult Dutch trade unions and discuss how the Netherlands can still join the complaint against Qatar
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg te treden met de Nederlandse vakbonden en te bespreken hoe Nederland zich alsnog kan aansluiten bij de klachtzaak tegen Qatar
Amendement van het lid Servaes over budget ter bescherming en bevordering van mensenrechten
Moves €2 million within the budget from consular affairs to the human rights budget item, for social rights and trade union freedom.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by €2,000 (x €1,000)
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 2.000 (x € 1.000)
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een rapport over het gebruik van de term genocide door politici
Asks the government to seek advice from the external international law adviser and the advisory committee CAVV on a joint report about politicians' use of the term genocide.
requests the government to seek advice from the External International Law Adviser (EVA) and the Advisory Committee on International Legal Issues (CAVV)
verzoekt de regering, advies in te winnen bij de Extern Volkenrechtelijk Adviseur (EVA) en de Commissie van advies inzake volkenrechtelijke vraagstukken (CAVV)
Motie van het lid Sjoerdsma en Servaes over het overnemen van de Noorse positie inzake het Internationaal Strafhof
Asks the government to adopt Norway's position on prioritising genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes in the International Criminal Court's exercise of jurisdiction.
requests the government to adopt the Norwegian position on prioritisation in the exercise of jurisdiction by the International Criminal Court
verzoekt de regering, de Noorse positie over prioriteitstelling in de uitoefening van de rechtsmacht door het Internationaal Strafhof over te nemen
Motie van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het behouden van draagvlak voor het Internationaal Strafhof
Asks the government to take a leading role in maintaining support for the International Criminal Court, especially among African states.
requests the government to play a leading role in maintaining support for the International Criminal Court
verzoekt de regering, een voortrekkersrol te spelen bij het behouden van draagvlak voor het Internationaal Strafhof
Motie van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over bezwaren tegen Nord Stream 2
Asks the government to talk with EU member states and the Commission about their objections to Nord Stream 2 and report to the House.
requests the government to enter into talks with these member states and the European Commission
verzoekt de regering, in gesprek te treden met deze lidstaten en de Europese Commissie
Motie van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over zachte leningen en handelspreferenties voor eerste opvanglanden
Asks the government to offer soft loans and trade preferences on a structural basis to Middle Eastern and North African first host countries of refugees.
requests the government, together with other donor countries, to ensure that soft loans and trade preferences can also be offered structurally
verzoekt de regering om, er in samenwerking met andere donorlanden voor te zorgen dat zachte leningen en handelspreferenties ook op structurele wijze kunnen worden geboden
Motie van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke over een nieuw Nederlands Fonds voor Regionale Partnerschappen
Asks the government to develop a new Dutch fund for regional partnerships with extra funds up to 40 million euros and submit a proposal to the House by spring 2016.
requests the government, building on those experiences, to develop a new Dutch Fund for Regional Partnerships
verzoekt de regering, voortbouwend op die ervaringen, een nieuw Nederlands Fonds voor Regionale Partnerschappen te ontwikkelen
Motie van de leden Grashoff en Servaes over duidelijkheid over herkomst van producten uit alle bezette gebieden
Motion asking the government to press the European Commission for clear origin labelling of products from all occupied territories and to enforce the rules.
Requests the government to press the European Commission for the clarification desired by consumers and business.
verzoekt de regering, bij de Europese Commissie aan te dringen op de door consumenten en bedrijfsleven gewenste verduidelijking
Amendement van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke ter vervanging van nr. 14 dat beoogt om een bedrag van € 3,2 miljoen toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma
Amendment shifting 3.2 million euro from the consular and Dutch values article to the MATRA programme within the foreign affairs budget.
This amendment aims to allocate 3.2 million euro to the MATRA programme.
Dit amendement beoogt om een bedrag van € 3,2 miljoen toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma
Motie van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over schuiven in de vrijwillige afdrachten aan internationale organisaties
Asks the government to shift Dutch voluntary contributions to international organisations toward UNHCR and regional refugee aid by specified amounts for 2017.
considering that voluntary contributions to international organisations should reflect the stated priorities of foreign policy
overwegende dat vrijwillige afdrachten aan internationale organisaties een reflectie dienen te zijn van de gestelde prioriteiten in het buitenlands beleid
Motie van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over een effectievere Europese aanpak van mensensmokkel
Asks the government to work for broader UN mission mandates covering migrant smuggling and for a more effective European approach to smuggling and border control, with active Dutch contribution.

Amendement van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes dat een verschuiving beoogt van de vrijwillige bijdrage aan minder goed presterende of non-prioritaire VN-fondsen en andere internationale organisaties na
Shifts voluntary contributions between UN funds and international organisations across budget articles, favouring refugee-related and better-performing funds.
This amendment aims to shift voluntary contributions from less well-performing or non-priority UN funds
Dit amendement beoogt een verschuiving van de vrijwillige bijdrage aan minder goed presterende of non-prioritaire VN-fondsen
Amendement van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke dat beoogt om een bedrag van € 3,2 miljoen toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma
Proposes shifting EUR 3.2 million within the foreign affairs budget from consular affairs to the MATRA programme for security and stability.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by EUR 3,200 thousand
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 3.200
Motie van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over een meer toekomstbestendige financiering van missies
Asks the government to map more flexible budgeting methods for military missions and to inform the House on them as soon as possible.
to inform the House about this as soon as possible
de Kamer hierover op zo kort mogelijke termijn te informeren
Motie van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke over het waterscheidingsmoment in de relatie met Rusland
Asks the government to elaborate the long-term consequences of the 'watershed moment' in relations with Russia and inform the House by spring.
also requests the government to inform the House about this by this spring at the latest
verzoekt de regering tevens, de Kamer uiterlijk dit voorjaar hierover te informeren

Amendement van het lid Van Ojik c.s. dat regelt dat er in 2015 8 miljoen euro extra beschikbaar komt voor de intensieve en geïntegreerde inzet van diplomatieke capaciteit ter bevordering van de intern
Adds 8 million euro in 2015 for intensive diplomatic capacity by shifting funds from contingency to the apparatus article in the foreign affairs budget.
With this amendment the aim is that 8 million extra becomes available in 2015 for that intensive and integrated deployment
Met dit amendement wordt beoogd dat er in 2015 voor die intensieve en geïntegreerde inzet 8 miljoen extra beschikbaar komt
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes ter vervanging van nr. 19 over gelden bestemd voor het Matra-programma

Moves 2 million euro from operational goal 4.4 to the MATRA programme for civil society, political parties and NGOs in Eastern Partnership, pre-accession and Arab priority countries, with an evaluation in 2014.
This amendment aims to allocate an amount of 2 million euro to the MATRA programme.
Dit amendement beoogt om een bedrag van € 2 miljoen euro toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma
Motie van het lid Servaes c.s. over opnemen van mensenrechtennormen in reglementen van internationale sportfederaties
Motion asking the government to work for inclusion of human rights and workers' rights norms in international sports federations' rules for major events.
requests the government to work, both internationally and with national sports bodies, for the inclusion of human rights norms
verzoekt de regering, zich zowel in internationaal verband als in samenwerking met nationale sportkoepels in te zetten voor de opname van mensenrechtennormen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes ter vervanging van nr. 18 over gelden bestemd voor het MATRA-programma
Moves 2 million euro from operational objective 4.4 of the foreign affairs budget to the MATRA programme for civil society in partner countries.
This amendment aims to allocate an amount of 2 million euro to the MATRA programme.
Dit amendement beoogt om een bedrag van € 2 miljoen euro toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma
Amendement van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over gelden bestemd voor het MATRA-programma
Shifts 2 million euro within the foreign affairs budget from consular and international values spending to security and stability, reserving it for the MATRA programme.
This amendment aims to reserve an amount of 2 million euro for the Eastern Partnership
Dit amendement heeft als doel een bedrag van 2 miljoen euro te reserveren voor het Oostelijk Partnerschap
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. dat  een halvering van de voorgenomen bezuiniging op het postennetwerk in het jaar 2014 bewerkstelligt
Shifts 10 million euro from the non-policy Nominaal en onvoorzien article to the Apparaat article to halve a planned cut to the diplomatic post network in 2014, keeping consulates open.
Coverage is found in non-policy article 6: Nominal and unforeseen.
Dekking wordt gevonden op niet-beleidsartikel 6: Nominaal en onvoorzien.
Motie van het lid Servaes c.s. over waar mogelijk ondersteunen van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek
Asks the government to support the criminal investigation into the attack on a Dutch diplomat in Moscow and keep the House continuously informed.
requests the Dutch government to support the criminal investigation where possible and to keep the House continuously informed about it
verzoekt de Nederlandse regering, het strafrechtelijk onderzoek waar mogelijk te ondersteunen en de Kamer hierover voortdurend te informeren
Motie Servaes en Ten Broeke over vragen van opheldering over de ontwikkelingen in Turkije

Asks the government to seek clarification from a Turkish government representative on the crackdown on protesters and the army threat, and via the EU High Representative press for a swift investigation into excessive force.
requests the government, at the first opportunity, to seek clarification from a representative of the Turkish government
verzoekt de regering, bij een eerstvolgende mogelijkheid opheldering te vragen bij een vertegenwoordiger van de Turkse regering
Motie van het lid Servaes over het nog niet opzeggen van de overeenkomst
Asks the government not to terminate the 1955 Benelux interparliamentary consultative agreement while the future of the Benelux parliament is under discussion.
for now not to terminate this pending the discussion in the Benelux parliament
hangende deze discussie in het Benelux-parlement vooralsnog niet op te zeggen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse verzekeraars die nog steeds investeren in wapenfabrikanten

MPs Sjoerdsma, Servaes and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch insurers' investments in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, which may be used in the Yemen conflict, fit export restrictions, the insurance sector's sustainable investment code and international responsible business standards, and what the government has done since 2015. Minister Ploumen answered that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, that insurers themselves decide which companies to invest in, that a sector IMVO covenant is being negotiated, and that the insurers named were contacted.
Subject to these conditions, it is up to insurers themselves to decide which companies they invest in; the government in principle does not regulate this.
Met in achtneming van deze voorwaarden is het aan verzekeraars zelf om te bepalen in welke bedrijven zij investeren, de overheid reguleert dit in beginsel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over de mensenrechtensituatie in Marokko

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Morocco, including limited NGO access, the death of fishmonger Mohsin Fikri, police handling of protests, and Dutch projects supporting fair justice. The minister acknowledged remaining shortcomings, said the case is before Moroccan courts and the embassy will monitor it, and listed Dutch-supported training projects, without committing to a new independent inquiry.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor developments and regularly stress the importance of respecting the right to freedom of demonstration in bilateral contacts and within the EU.

Nederland zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en met regelmaat het belang van de eerbiediging van het recht op vrijheid van demonstratie blijven benadrukken in de bilaterale contacten, alsmede in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de mensenrechtensituatie van de Rohingya-bevolking in Myanmar

Labour MP Servaes asks the Foreign Minister about alleged serious human rights violations against the Rohingya in Myanmar, including army conduct after the 9 October attacks, and urges pressure on Myanmar. The minister answers that the Netherlands presses for independent investigation and humanitarian access, reports disciplinary action against police, notes an EU resolution at the UN Human Rights Council, and says the government has no evidence that IS is recruiting among the Rohingya.

The Netherlands, together with other EU member states, calls for an independent and credible investigation into the 9 October attacks and the army's conduct, and for an adequate government response to the findings.

Nederland pleit met andere EU lidstaten voor een onafhankelijk en geloofwaardig onderzoek naar de aanvallen van 9 oktober en het optreden van het leger en een adequaat antwoord van de regering op de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de bouw van nederzettingen in Oost-Jeruzalem na aantreden van Trump

MP Servaes (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli settlement construction in East Jerusalem after Trump's inauguration, including the 566 homes, the US embassy move, and possible EU measures such as suspending cooperation agreements. Minister Koenders condemned settlements as contrary to international law, said the government would keep pressing Israel and the EU, declined to pre-empt EU options, and said recognition of a Palestinian state would be used only at a strategic moment.
The government continues, both bilaterally and through the EU, an active policy to preserve and achieve the two-state solution.
Het kabinet blijft, zowel bilateraal als via de band van de EU, een actief beleid voeren ten behoeve van het behoud en de totstandkoming van de twee-statenoplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie op de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about alleged extrajudicial killings of suspected drug users and dealers in the Philippines under President Duterte, and whether the Netherlands would support UN and EU calls for due process and an independent UN investigation. The minister replied that the government is seriously concerned, has raised these concerns bilaterally, in EU and UN channels, and supports rule-of-law programmes, but that other bodies have their own mandates and the government's answers on further steps were largely general.
The Netherlands is concerned about the Philippine approach to drug crime and the rising number of victims linked to it.
Nederland is bezorgd over de Filipijnse aanpak van drugscriminaliteit en het stijgend aantal slachtoffers dat daarmee in verband wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat Wit-Rusland weer begonnen is met het uitspreken en uitvoeren van de doodstraf

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Belarus has resumed death sentences and executions after EU sanctions were lifted, and about the OSCE critique of the 2016 parliamentary elections. The minister expresses concern, says Belarus keeps execution figures secret, defends critical engagement over reinstated sanctions, and reports dialogue on a moratorium through UN bodies.
The cabinet is of the view that critical engagement can ultimately achieve more than new sanctions measures.
Het kabinet is van mening dat met kritisch engagement uiteindelijk meer kan worden bereikt dan met nieuwe sanctiemaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de terugtrekking van Afrikaanse landen uit het Internationaal Strafhof

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the announced withdrawal of Burundi, Gambia and South Africa from the International Criminal Court, and what the government was doing to implement the Servaes/Sjoerdsma motion on support for the ICC. The minister replied with a detailed account of diplomatic efforts, EU and UN action, planned ministerial meetings at the Assembly of States Parties, and Security Council coordination with Italy, while not committing to a specific new formal step beyond those efforts.
The cabinet fully implements the Servaes/Sjoerdsma motion.
Het kabinet voert de motie Servaes/Sjoerdsma onverkort uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes  en Kerstens over Uitbuiting van personeel bij de Qatarese ambassade

MPs Servaes and Kerstens asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about reported labour exploitation of staff at the Qatari embassy and how the government supervises working conditions at embassies. The minister said privacy prevents discussing individual cases, described a monitoring system for domestic staff and a mediation practice for local staff, noted that embassies cannot be forced to comply with court rulings, and said staff can access legal aid.
Due to privacy considerations, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot address individual cases.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen kan het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked ministers to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on unintended loss of Dutch nationality, including whether government informed citizens adequately and whether nationality law should change. The government largely rejects the claim of inadequate information, pointing to past campaigns and its website, promises to examine how outreach can be more active, and says it cannot yet judge the report's findings on nationality law.
On the basis of the recommendations in this report, I will examine whether that information can be made even more active and targeted.
Aan de hand van de aanbevelingen van dit rapport zal ik onderzoeken of die voorlichting nog actiever en gerichter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over een uitnodiging aan Saoedi-Arabië voor een Nederlandse wapenbeurs

MPs asked whether the Royal Netherlands Navy invited a Saudi delegation to the MAST 2016 defence fair, why the first question was not fully answered, and how an invitation squares with a strict arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia given the situation in Yemen and human rights. The government confirmed invitations went to 23 countries including Saudi Arabia, that no Saudi delegation attended (reason unknown), maintained its strict export licensing, and said it could not provide a central overview of past defence-fair invitations.
The Ministry of Defence does not keep a central registration of defence fairs.
Het Ministerie van Defensie voert geen centrale registratie van defensiebeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de implementatie van de Terezin Verklaring over de compensatie van Holocaust-slachtoffers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands is doing enough to implement the 2009 Terezin Declaration on compensating Holocaust survivors, and whether the EU could take concrete steps such as appointing a special envoy. The minister replied that the Netherlands does not recognise the described shortfall, points to its existing social laws and post-war restitution commissions, and rejects an EU envoy in favour of sharing best practices through the IHRA.
Given the importance of the subject, the Netherlands is willing to share national best practices within the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA).
Nederland is gezien het belang van het onderwerp wel bereid om binnen de International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) nationale best practices te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het rapport van Amnesty International aangaande ontvoeringen en martelingen door de Egyptische veiligheidsdiensten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Amnesty report on enforced disappearances and torture by Egyptian security services, whether anti-terror law silences dissent, what the EU has done since 2014, and whether Egypt breaches the EU Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged the report as a credible source and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights in the EU, but did not confirm the figures independently and did not commit to placing the issue on the July Foreign Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet cannot confirm the findings on the numbers and timing of the increase from its own sources, but regards the Amnesty International report as an authoritative source.
Het kabinet kan de bevindingen over de aantallen en het moment van toename niet op basis van eigen bronnen bevestigen, maar beschouwt het rapport van Amnesty International als een gezaghebbende bron.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk en Servaes over een Saoedische delegatie die op uitnodiging van de Koninklijke Marine een Nederlandse wapenbeurs bezoekt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk and Servaes asked whether a Saudi delegation was invited by the Royal Netherlands Navy to the MAST arms fair, and how such an invitation fits with the motion on Saudi arms exports, the EU Parliament resolution and alleged humanitarian law violations in Yemen. The ministers replied that no Saudi delegation attended MAST 2016, and that the government maintains a very strict case-by-case arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia, with no export licences granted in 2016 so far.
No, no Saudi delegation was present at the Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Neen, er is geen Saoedische delegatie aanwezig geweest op de Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over het bericht dat de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties (VN) is gechanteerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Saudi Arabia pressured the UN Secretary-General into removing its coalition from the children and armed conflict blacklist, and whether the Netherlands would press the UN to restore it. The minister called the findings on child casualties in Yemen very concerning, said the listing was removed pending further fact-finding, condemned any political pressure as unacceptable, and said the Netherlands is coordinating with the EU and the Group of Friends on a joint response supporting the independence of the Special Representative.

The cabinet is consulting within the EU and with partners in the Group of Friends on Children and Armed Conflict on how to respond jointly to this situation and to publicly express support for the independent mandate of the UN Special Representative.

Het kabinet overlegt binnen de EU en met partners binnen de Group of Friends on Children and Armed Conflict op welke wijze gezamenlijk op deze situatie te reageren en publiekelijk steun uit te spreken voor het onafhankelijke mandaat van de Speciaal Vertegenwoordiger van de SGVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over de moord en inbraak bij een Oegandese mensenrechtenorganisatie

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the Foreign Minister about the murder and break-in at a Ugandan human rights organisation, the status of the NGO Bill, and support for the LGBT community in Uganda. The minister said the perpetrators are not yet arrested, that the EU will raise the break-in in a political dialogue and seek better protection for human rights groups, and that the NGO Bill is not yet applied, with no current grounds for further measures.
During this dialogue the EU will raise the violent break-in and press for measures to better protect human rights organisations against such break-ins.
Tijdens deze dialoog zal de EU de gewelddadige inbraak aan de orde stellen en aandringen op maatregelen om mensenrechtenorganisaties beter te beschermen tegen dergelijke inbraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat dertien EU-landen wapens leveren aan Egypte

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked whether thirteen EU states exported arms to Egypt despite the 2013 Council agreement to suspend licences for goods usable for internal repression, and whether the government would press for enforcement and harmonisation. The government answered that no formal embargo exists, that it lacks full export data, that EU states decide licences nationally, and that it will keep pushing for harmonisation without committing to new EU action.
However, the cabinet does not have exact information on the goods exported to Egypt, since within the EU only refusals and not approvals of export licences are shared.

Het kabinet beschikt echter niet over exacte informatie betreffende de goederen die naar Egypte uitgevoerd zijn, aangezien binnen de EU alleen de afwijzingen en niet de toewijzingen van uitvoervergunningen gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops en Grashoff over de vernietiging van Palestijnse waterbronnen door Israël

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, CDA and GroenLinks asked whether Israel plans to destroy water cisterns in Kusra built with Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands could recover damages. The government answered that the cisterns are subject to stop-work orders that owners are contesting legally, that nothing has yet been destroyed so no compensation arises, and that the Dutch representation is intensifying dialogue with Israeli authorities and following legal developments closely.
In this context the Representation has lodged a protest against the latest stop-work orders and will continue to follow the legal developments very actively.
In dit kader heeft de Vertegenwoordiging protest aangetekend tegen de laatste stop-work-orders en zal het de juridische ontwikkelingen zeer actief blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over Burundese vluchtelingen en het voortdurend vermoorden van (vermeende) tegenstanders van president Nkurunziza in en buiten Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about escalating violence in Burundi, refugees being attacked in camps abroad, shortages in refugee camps, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers answered that Dutch and EU pressure, sanctions, suspended direct budget aid and support for a regional dialogue continue, and that Dutch humanitarian funding and a 1 million euro contribution for the Mahama camp were provided, while the AU observer deployment is delayed.
Because of the violence and the poorly conducted elections, the Netherlands suspended direct aid to Burundi in 2015.
Vanwege het geweld en de slecht verlopen verkiezingen heeft Nederland in 2015 de directe hulp aan Burundi opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Servaes over het Amnesty-rapport 'WK Voetbal Qatar: FIFA negeert uitbuiting arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Van Dekken and Servaes asked the ministers about Amnesty's report on exploitation of migrant workers building Qatar 2022 World Cup venues, FIFA's inaction, and Qatar's sponsorship system. The ministers acknowledged serious abuses remain, pointed to EU-level pressure on FIFA and Qatar, the ILO mission and complaint process, and the EU Presidency's integrity agenda, without committing to new binding steps.
The cabinet will therefore continue to press for improvements in the position of migrant workers in talks with Qatar and business.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom in de gesprekken met Qatar en het bedrijfsleven blijven inzetten voor de verbetering van de positie van arbeidsmigranten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de mishandeling van twee homoseksuele mannen in Marokko

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the government about the assault on two gay men in Morocco, the status of the perpetrators, and whether the government would raise the issue with Moroccan authorities. The minister confirmed shock at the footage, corrected the reported sentences, described the criminalisation of same-sex acts in Morocco as incompatible with international human rights obligations, said the EU had raised the case with Morocco's National Human Rights Council, and described ongoing support for LGBT rights through civil society, but did not commit to a new specific demand to Moroccan authorities.
The cabinet will therefore continue to unreservedly commit itself to the rights of this vulnerable minority.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom onverkort blijven inzetten voor de rechten van deze kwetsbare minderheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het hoge tempo waarin Palestijnse gebouwen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever worden gesloopt

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked about the rapid pace of Israeli demolitions of Palestinian buildings in the West Bank, including the number destroyed, displacement, donor-funded losses, recourse for damages, and EU action. The ministers confirmed the situation is very serious, reported 539 buildings demolished in Area C by 8 April 2016 versus 453 in all of 2015, cited €77,000 and €416,000 in damage to Dutch and EU-funded projects, and said the matter is raised in the EU and that Israel does not pay compensation.
In the case of demolition orders or confiscations, the Netherlands raises compensation.
Nederland stelt in geval van slooporders of confiscaties schadevergoeding aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over de executie van een Palestijn door een Israëlische soldaat

MPs Sjoerdsma and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about a video showing an Israeli soldier executing a wounded Palestinian, and about reports of extrajudicial killings, asking whether the government had raised this bilaterally and in the EU and would press for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the government was shocked, that the EU consistently urges Israel to ensure responses are necessary and proportionate, and that Israel's Ministry of Defence has opened an investigation which the Netherlands will follow closely.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the progress of Israeli investigations into its own conduct.
Nederland zal het verloop van Israëlische onderzoeken naar eigen optreden nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over de nalatigheid van de Europese Commissie bij het uitvoeren van mensenrechtenanalyses bij handelsverdragen

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about the European Commission's failure to carry out a human rights analysis for trade agreements, including the delayed TiSA impact study and the EU-Vietnam FTA. The ministers answered that the Commission has committed to including human rights in future Sustainability Impact Assessments, that the Netherlands will push this during its EU presidency, and that the EU-Vietnam agreement already contains human rights links.
Following the Ombudsman's call, one of these ambitions concerns including a human rights analysis in the usual Sustainability Impact Assessments.
In navolging van de oproep van de Ombudsman betreft één van deze ambities het opnemen van een mensenrechtenanalyse in de gebruikelijke Sustainability Impact Assessments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over het bericht dat mensenrechtenactiviste Berta Cáceres is vermoord in Honduras

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers how the government would respond to the murder of Honduran activist Berta Cáceres, how it would monitor Honduras's human rights efforts, what steps it had taken regarding FMO's involvement in a dam project, and how it would address the protection of human rights defenders. The ministers answered that the government condemned the killing, had the ambassador raise investigation demands with Honduran authorities, pressed FMO on land rights and transparency, and outlined existing human rights defender protection programmes.
The government regularly speaks with FMO about its investment policy.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met FMO over haar investeringsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Eijsink over Bescherming scholen en universiteiten tegen militair gebruik tijdens gewapend conflict

MPs Servaes and Eijsink asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about implementing guidelines protecting schools and universities from military use in armed conflict, and about the #WatchOurSchools campaign. The government answered that Dutch forces already follow the spirit of the guidelines through humanitarian law training, though they are not part of Rules of Engagement, and that Nederland has urged other states to endorse the Safe Schools initiative and recorded 52 supporting countries.
The guidelines are not part of the Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for operations, as ROEs are not a suitable instrument for including provisions of the law of armed conflict.
De richtlijnen maken geen deel uit van de Rules of Engagement (ROE's) voor operaties, aangezien ROE's geen geschikt instrument zijn voor het opnemen van oorlogsrechtelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over kritische rapporten over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de verbreding van het Egyptische Suezkanaal
