MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers about critical reports (SOMO and One World) alleging that Dutch dredging firms and the state-backed export credit insurer Atradius DSB failed to apply due-diligence standards to the Suez Canal widening, and whether commercial interests outweighed human and environmental rights. The government rejects the conclusion that economic interests prevailed, says it gathered sufficient information for an environmental and social assessment, and explains the differing findings of the SOMO report and the Witteveen & Bos study.
The cabinet has taken good note of the SOMO report in question and takes its observations and findings seriously.
Het kabinet heeft goede nota genomen van het betreffende SOMO-rapport en de observaties en bevindingen nemen wij serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over tegenwerken door Israël van de Speciale VN-gezant voor mensenrechten in de bezette Palestijnse gebieden

MP Servaes asked whether the UN Special Rapporteur Wibisono's resignation over Israel blocking access to the Palestinian territories is accurate, and whether the government will press Israel on access and on the UN criticism of his mandate. The minister confirmed the resignation and reason, said the Netherlands and the EU repeatedly call on Israel to grant access, and gave a general answer on concern for Palestinian victims and on the next rapporteur, without committing to a new bilateral or Council action.
The Netherlands attaches great importance to free access for Special Rapporteurs.
Nederland hecht grote waarde aan vrije toegang voor Speciaal Rapporteurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Marcouch en Servaes over het bericht dat Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland zich uit breidt

PvdA MPs asked whether Eritrean regime-linked intimidation and extortion of diaspora members in the Netherlands is known, what action is taken, and whether the Eritrean embassy was confronted and funds traced. The minister answered that the government knows of the reports, has not found evidence of Eritrean support to Al-Shabaab, held a warning meeting with the Eritrean ambassador, and that police and prosecutors investigate concrete suspicions of crimes, while no overview of incidents exists.
There is no overview of the number of incidents in relation to the Eritrean regime.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal incidenten in relatie tot het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het opheffen van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

Servaes (PvdA) asks why the EU lifted sanctions on 170 individuals and 3 companies in Belarus despite concerns about the 2015 elections and human rights, and whether unanimity was needed and what the Dutch position was. Minister Koenders answers that only part of the sanctions was lifted, that Nederland argued for maintaining pressure, that human rights concerns remain, and that renewed sanctions would require unanimity, without committing to specific future steps.
During the discussions the Netherlands argued against full suspension and pointed to the importance of maintaining sufficient pressure on Belarus.
Nederland heeft tijdens de discussies gepleit tegen volledige opschorting en gewezen op het belang van het houden van voldoende druk op Wit-Rusland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over gebrekkige arbeidsomstandigheden in Qatar bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal van 2022

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the foreign and trade ministers about poor labour conditions for migrant workers in Qatar ahead of the 2022 World Cup, including Amnesty's report of stalled reforms, the concrete steps taken on the Parliament's June motion, and FIFA's transparency. The ministers answered that Qatar has taken some positive steps but reforms are incomplete, that the Netherlands is pressing Qatar bilaterally, in the EU and through the ILO (including a high-level ILO mission), and that FIFA integrity questions await ongoing investigations.
Various (criminal) investigations into the awarding of these World Cups are currently underway. The cabinet is awaiting the outcomes of these investigations before taking a position.

Momenteel worden er diverse (strafrechtelijke) onderzoeken verricht naar de toewijzing van deze Wereldkampioenschappen. Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken af alvorens een standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Servaes over een nieuw vredesinitiatief en mogelijke erkenning van de Palestijnse staat door Frankrijk

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about France's plan for an international peace conference and possible recognition of a Palestinian state, and about Israeli settlement expansion. The minister says the Netherlands will weigh recognition at a strategic moment in consultation with EU partners, supports the French initiative in principle, and condemns settlement expansion as contrary to international law while reaffirming support for a two-state solution.
The cabinet wants to deploy recognition at a strategic moment when it is effective, real and opportune in the peace process.
Het kabinet wil erkenning inzetten op een strategisch moment als het effectief, reëel en opportuun is in het vredesproces.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat de Russische president een wet heeft bekrachtigd om uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) niet te hoeven navolgen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister how he views Russia's law letting its Constitutional Court declare ECHR judgments unenforceable, and what diplomatic steps are being taken. The minister called it very worrying, said Russia is bound to implement ECtHR judgments, and said Russia is being raised in the Council of Europe, while stating the Netherlands wants Russia to remain a member.
All member states of the Council of Europe are obliged to implement judgments of the European Court of Human Rights.
Alle lidstaten van de Raad van Europa zijn verplicht tot het ten uitvoer leggen van uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de schrijnende situatie in Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about Burundi's suspension of ten civil society organisations, its prosecution of them, Dutch links to those groups, conditions for resuming aid, the recall of Burundian EALA members, US sanctions, and support for refugees in neighbouring countries. The government answered that it had raised its concern about the measures with Burundian ministers, that three of the ten organisations receive Dutch funding, that aid resumes only after conditions such as a peaceful climate and media independence are met, and that it added funds for refugee relief.
Naturally, the Netherlands also expects the Burundian government to give civil society sufficient room to function, without fear of persecution.
Uiteraard verwacht Nederland eveneens dat de Burundese regering het maatschappelijk middenveld voldoende ruimte geeft om te kunnen functioneren, zonder angst voor vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Servaes over het vervolgen van vrouwen voor vermeende abortus

MPs Arib and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the 30-year sentence of Teodora del Carmen Vasquez in El Salvador for alleged abortion and whether women prosecuted after miscarriages should be protected. The minister agreed that women have bodily autonomy and access to care, and said the Netherlands will raise the issue in El Salvador's next Universal Periodic Review and in bilateral contacts.
Are you willing to raise the case of Ms Del Carmen Vasquez in international forums and convey your concerns to the El Salvadoran government?
Bent u bereid de zaak van mevrouw Del Carmen Vasquez in internationaal verband aan te kaarten en uw zorgen hieromtrent over te brengen aan de El Salvadoraanse regering?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Volp en Servaes over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de United Nations General Assembly Special Session (UNGASS) on the World Drug Problem die in 2016 zal plaatsvinden

Four MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch policy for the 2016 UN drugs special session had changed, whether the Netherlands should back regulated cannabis cultivation, and how death penalty cases for drug offences would be handled. The government answered that the Dutch position has not changed, that it opposes regulated cannabis cultivation and mayors' calls for it, and that it works to end the death penalty for drug offences while noting three Dutch nationals face such sentences.
Regulation/legalisation of cannabis cultivation is not cabinet policy, so it is not appropriate for the Netherlands to take the leading role the questioners propose at the UNGASS.
Regulering/legalisering van de hennepteelt is geen kabinetsbeleid en het ligt daarom niet voor de hand bij de UNGASS een door de vragenstellers beoogde voortrekkersrol op dit vlak te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over gasdeals van Gasunie en Shell met Russisch staatsbedrijf Gazprom, alsmede over de politieke onafhankelijkheid van gasproductie in de Noordzee

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked whether the Gasunie and Shell/BASF gas deals with Gazprom comply with EU sanctions, public interest duties and efforts to reduce Russian energy dependence. The minister answered that the government is not party to private deals, sees no conflict with sanctions in principle, that Gasunie must still weigh public interest in concrete projects, and that no separate impact study is planned.
The cabinet does not consider this necessary.
Het kabinet acht dit niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het opschorten van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the EU suspended Belarus sanctions for four months, shortly after flawed presidential elections, and what human rights conditions apply. The minister answered that the partial suspension rewards released prisoners and Belarus's constructive stance on Ukraine, that the government remains critical on human rights, and that no formal criteria will be set in advance.
However, the Cabinet does not consider it useful to define in advance criteria that Belarus would have to meet for further easing or lifting of the sanctions regime.
Het Kabinet acht het echter niet nuttig om op voorhand criteria uit te werken waaraan Wit-Rusland zou moeten voldoen voor verdere verlichting of opheffing van het sanctieregime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het verloop van de aankomende verkiezingen in Birma/Myanmar

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares UN rapporteur Lee's concerns about restrictions on free expression and assembly, exclusion of voters and minorities, and police violence ahead of Myanmar's November 2015 elections, and whether he will raise human rights with Myanmar's authorities. The minister acknowledges shortcomings but says the elections are a significant step, that Dutch diplomacy has raised human rights concerns, that the EU observer mission is adequately equipped, and that a Dutch embassy will be opened.
The cabinet shares the concerns of Special Rapporteur Lee about the use of police force in ending the student protests this spring.
Het kabinet deelt de zorgen van Speciaal Rapporteur Lee over het gebruik van geweld door de politie bij het beëindigen van de studentenprotesten dit voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de recente escalatie van geweld in Israël en in de door Israël bezette Palestijnse gebieden

The MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the escalation of violence in Israel and the occupied Palestinian territories, including the EU's role and Mogherini's engagement. The minister condemned violence on both sides, described diplomatic efforts and EU initiatives, and acknowledged underlying causes while promising continued EU engagement.
The cabinet condemns the violent actions and such attacks.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de gewelddadige acties en dergelijke aanslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over martelingen in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report on torture in Morocco, including risks for complainants, Dutch projects supporting human rights there, and whether counter-terrorism cooperation considered abuse risks. The minister answered that torture is taken seriously, describes ongoing human rights projects, and says Morocco's reaction is being monitored.
The cabinet takes all allegations of human rights violations worldwide seriously.
Het kabinet neemt alle aantijgingen van mensenrechtenschendingen, wereldwijd, serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de aanstelling van een Saoediër als hoofd van de VN Mensenrechtenraad

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister whether Saudi ambassador Faisal Trad was appointed head of the UN Human Rights Council, and whether the Netherlands opposed it and would condemn it. The minister answered that the report is factually incorrect: Trad was chosen by the Asian group as a member of the Consultative Group on special procedures, where he was later elected chair, without Dutch involvement, and that the Council remains a key forum for raising human rights abuses.
Reports that the Permanent Representative of Saudi Arabia to the United Nations in Geneva was appointed head of the Human Rights Council are factually incorrect.
Berichten dat de Permanent Vertegenwoordiger van Saoedi-Arabië bij de Verenigde Naties in Geneve is aangesteld als hoofd van de Mensenrechtenraad zijn feitelijk onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over Saoedi-Arabië in de VN-mensenrechtenraad

The MP asked whether the UK and Saudi Arabia struck a vote-swap deal to secure Human Rights Council seats, whether the Netherlands has similar deals, and whether such deals harm credibility. The minister said the government is unaware of any such UK-Saudi deal, weighs human rights records in candidacies without publicly endorsing countries, and that voting is confidential so it cannot judge other states' votes.
The cabinet is not aware of deals between other member states about their voting behaviour. The vote itself is also confidential.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met deals van andere lidstaten over hun stemgedrag. Ook de stemming zelf is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de veroordeling van journalisten in Egypte

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister how the government pressed Egypt to release jailed Al Jazeera journalists, including Rena Netjes, and about a mass conviction case and the counter-terrorism law. The minister answered that Sisi pardoned two journalists after international pressure, that Netjes's pardon is being discussed with her, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally and at the UN and EU.
For the sake of the effectiveness of any follow-up steps, it is not appropriate to disclose details.
Omwille van de effectiviteit van eventuele vervolgstappen is het niet opportuun details bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over pestboetes voor Palestijnse boeren in bezette gebieden

An MP asked whether Dutch aid money was used to pay Israeli fines to recover seized farm equipment in the occupied West Bank, and whether other Dutch-funded projects were frustrated or destroyed. The minister confirmed that in three cases Dutch partners paid fines as a condition for release of equipment, that Dutch missions protested, and that about 91,000 euro of damage to Dutch-funded projects occurred in 2010-2015, while promising continued advocacy but giving no firm new commitment.
In three cases Israel imposed a fine as a condition for returning the seized materials.
In drie gevallen legde Israël een boete op, als voorwaarde voor teruggave van de inbeslaggenomen materialen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over groeiende militaire steun van Rusland aan het Assad-regime en toenemende verdeeldheid binnen de anti-ISIS coalitie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about growing Russian military support for the Assad regime and divisions within the anti-ISIS coalition, including calls to pressure Russia and convene coalition talks. The government acknowledged Russian military deliveries and concern about them, said it raises the issue with Russia and in the UN, and stated the coalition is united against ISIS while promising no specific new initiative beyond existing consultations.
The Netherlands raises Russia's responsibilities with Russia wherever possible.
Nederland spreekt waar mogelijk Rusland aan op zijn verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over burgerslachtoffers, oorlogsmisdaden en dreigende hongersnood in Jemen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the government about civilian casualties, alleged war crimes by the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, and famine risk, including whether the Netherlands would raise these at the UN Human Rights Council and General Assembly and support an international inquiry. The ministers answered that the Netherlands will raise violations with all parties, intends to include an inquiry in its Yemen resolution, and has granted 10 million euro in additional humanitarian aid on top of earlier contributions.
The cabinet is very concerned about allegations of violations of international humanitarian law in Yemen and is committed to investigating them.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over beschuldigingen van schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht in Jemen en maakt zich sterk voor onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over twee omstreden wetsvoorstellen in Oeganda

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the government about Ugandan bills restricting NGOs and anti-homosexuality legislation, including Dutch aid resumption. The ministers answered that the NGO bill threatens NGO freedom if adopted unamended, that the anti-homosexuality bill has not been formally submitted, and that the EU is handling the dialogue.
If the law is adopted without substantial changes, its application could significantly restrict the freedom of NGOs.
Wordt de wet zonder substantiële wijzigingen aangenomen, dan zal de toepassing ervan de vrijheid van ngo's flink kunnen inperken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Van Bommel, Teeven en Taverne over het bericht dat zes Russische leden van de OVSE Parlementaire Assemblee vanwege de voor hen geldende EU-inreisverboden geen visum voor Finland h

MPs asked whether Finland's refusal of visas to six sanctioned Russian OSCE Parliamentary Assembly members, who were barred by EU travel bans, and the absence of a clear exemption for interparliamentary meetings was acceptable and whether the government would seek a formal exception. The minister answered that Finland only had to inform other member states, that the EU travel-ban rules contain only limited exceptions, and that the government values parliamentary dialogue in the OSCE but offered no commitment to seek a new formal exception.
The cabinet cannot comment on any reactions other member states may have given within the confidential Council framework.
Op (eventuele) reacties die overige lidstaten in vertrouwelijk Raadskader hebben gegeven, kan het kabinet niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes inzake de homohatende songteksten van de Surinaamse band Hakuna Matata Gang

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked ministers about homophobic lyrics by the Surinamese band Hakuna Matata Gang, whether they would be prosecuted during Dutch tours, and whether Suriname's government would be pressed to withdraw support and promote LGBT rights. The minister replied that the Dutch concerts were cancelled, the video removed, the band dropped the song, and the OM is reviewing a complaint, while Suriname denies financial support and the embassy has raised concerns and funded LGBTI rights work.
The Public Prosecution Service can decide to pursue criminal prosecution if it would turn out that during an event there was incitement to hatred
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan besluiten om tot strafrechtelijke vervolging over te gaan indien zou blijken dat tijdens een evenement sprake is geweest van het aanzetten tot haat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat Rusland uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens negeert

MPs Maij and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia's Constitutional Court allowed Russia to ignore European Court of Human Rights rulings conflicting with its constitution, and what this means for Russia's Council of Europe membership and human rights obligations. The minister answered that such non-implementation violates the ECHR, that Russia remains bound to implement rulings, that Russia's relations with the Council of Europe are strained but there are no signs of withdrawal, and that the Netherlands will continue to raise the issue.
The Netherlands shares this concern and will continue to raise this issue.
Nederland deelt deze bezorgdheid en zal aandacht blijven vragen voor deze kwestie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over oorlogsmisdaden van Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's findings that Hamas-linked forces abducted, tortured and summarily killed Palestinians during the 2014 Gaza conflict, and how the government would press Hamas and the Palestinian Authority to cooperate with independent investigators and accountability. The minister acknowledged the report, called for impartial investigation by both sides, and said the Netherlands has no direct leverage over Hamas, with political pressure on the Palestinian Authority the main option.
The cabinet calls on both sides to conduct credible and transparent investigations into alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
Het kabinet roept beide zijden op geloofwaardig en transparant onderzoek te doen naar vermeende schendingen van humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de doodstraf voor oud-president Morsi en 105 aanhangers van de Moslimbroederschap

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentences against former president Morsi and 105 Muslim Brotherhood supporters in Egypt and what the government would do about them. The minister condemned the sentences, said Dutch and EU protests were made bilaterally and multilaterally, and gave estimates of arrests and death sentences in Egypt since 2013 while noting that exact figures cannot be verified.

The EU-Egypt subcommittee on democratisation, human rights and good governance is expected to take place around the summer, with European concerns about the death penalty on the draft agenda, among other things.
Naar verwachting vindt rond de zomer het EU-Egypte subcomité voor democratisering, mensenrechten en goed bestuur plaats, waarbij o.a. de Europese zorgen over de doodstraf op de concept-agenda staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over de handelsmissie naar India en het verzoek van een aantal NGO’s om te pleiten voor de vrijheid van organisatie en meningsuiting

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the Prime Minister and ministers whether the government would press India during the trade mission to protect freedom of association and expression, given reported restrictions on NGOs such as Greenpeace and visa refusals. The minister answered that the government shares concern about shrinking space for international NGOs in India, raised it with Indian officials and agreed to discuss NGO cooperation in coming months, but left constitutional judgments to Indian courts and only promised reporting in the quarterly letter.

During my meeting with Minister of State Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary I emphasised that a free, independent, active and critical civil society, through dialogue with businesses and governments, can contribute greatly to inclusive growth and development.

Ik benadrukte tijdens mijn onderhoud met Minister of State, Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary dat een vrij, onafhankelijk, actief en kritisch maatschappelijk middenveld via een dialoog met bedrijven en overheden veel kan bijdragen aan inclusieve groei en ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over de voortdurende schending van arbeidsrechten bij de voorbereidingen voor het WK voetbal in Qatar

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the government about continued labour rights abuses of migrant workers in Qatar linked to World Cup preparations, including Amnesty's findings, journalist detentions, union rights, Dutch company monitoring and FIFA corruption. The Minister answered that the government shares concerns, sees early steps by Qatar, pressed for ratification of ILO conventions 87 and 98, and engages bilaterally, through the EU, with business and the NCP, while declining to pre-judge ongoing FIFA investigations.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the various investigations currently being conducted by the Swiss and American authorities.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op de verschillende onderzoeken door de Zwitserse en Amerikaanse autoriteiten die momenteel lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over Kindermisbruik door militairen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the foreign and development ministers about child sexual abuse by French troops in the Central African Republic, the suspension of UN official Anders Kompass for leaking a report, UN protection of whistleblowers, and measures against sexual abuse by UN-mandated soldiers. The minister said the government lacks the facts to judge the Kompass case, supports an independent UN inquiry, and noted the UN Secretary-General announced an external independent investigation.
The cabinet considers it important that an independent investigation be carried out covering all relevant aspects, and will therefore follow this case closely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd waarin alle relevante aspecten aan de orde komen en zal deze zaak daarom op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de Burundezen die uit vrees voor mogelijk verkiezingsgeweld naar Rwanda vluchten

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about reports of Burundians fleeing to Rwanda over fear of election-related violence, the role of the Imbonerakure, threats to journalists and activists, police and military involvement, the Cibitoke investigation, a possible third term for President Nkurunziza, and possible suspension of cooperation programmes. The government answers that the questions were already answered in a separate letter to the House (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163), so no new substantive answer is given here.

The written questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes (both PvdA), question number 2015Z07291, have been answered by means of the letter 'Reaction to committee request regarding the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary Paper 29 237, no. 163).

Antwoord 1 t/m 7 De schriftelijke vragen van leden Van Laar en Servaes (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2015Z07291 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over het bericht dat Engeland ruim vijf miljard pond heeft uitgegeven aan wapenexport naar landen die op de zwarte lijst staan wegens mensenrechtenschendingen

Two Dutch MPs asked the ministers about a UK parliamentary report criticising British arms exports to countries of human rights concern, and about how EU member states can hold each other to account on arms export policy. The government answered that licensing decisions are national competences, that the UK report lacks end-use data, and that it will consult partners on the D66/PvdA proposals for an EU arms export authority and a right to challenge, which it considers constrained by EU-national competence division.
The cabinet will nevertheless consult European partners on this idea, starting with the most like-minded on further EU harmonisation.
Het kabinet zal de Europese partners evenwel over dit idee consulteren, om te beginnen de meest gelijkgestemden op het gebied van verdere EU-harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over zware straffen voor journalisten in Egypte

MP Servaes asks the Foreign Minister about death and life sentences for journalists in Egypt, the EU and Dutch protest, and the number of jailed journalists. The minister condemns prosecution of journalists and the death penalty, says the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Universal Periodic Review, and gives estimates of detained journalists that vary by source and cannot be verified.
The Dutch cabinet is of the view that counter-terrorism and respect for human rights must go hand in hand.
Het Nederlandse kabinet is van mening dat terreurbestrijding en respect voor mensenrechten hand in hand moeten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Servaes, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en De Roon over het nucleair akkoord met Iran

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the framework nuclear deal with Iran, covering its assessment, the timing of sanctions relief, regional effects, human rights, EU and Dutch contributions, and prospects before the 30 June deadline. The minister welcomed the framework, said sanctions relief will be tied to Iranian steps and reinstated if Iran breaches the deal, and answered several questions only in general terms while leaving the concrete sequencing and any full assessment for later.
The cabinet will send a written response on the various aspects of the comprehensive agreement to the House once it is definitively concluded.
Het kabinet zal een schriftelijke reactie op de verschillende deelaspecten van het alomvattend akkoord naar de Kamer sturen als dit definitief is gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de illegale buitenpost-nederzettingen in bezet gebied

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about roughly 100 unauthorised 'outposts' in occupied Palestinian territory, some of which Israel is authorising retroactively, and whether the EU and the Prime Minister have pressed Israel on this. The minister confirmed the outposts are illegal under international and Israeli law, said the government consistently raises settlement policy with Israel and opposed the Levy report, and described EU statements and Council conclusions condemning the outposts.
The government consistently raises settlement policy with the Israeli government and points out that this policy undermines the two-state solution.
Het kabinet spreekt de Israëlische regering consequent aan op het nederzettingenbeleid en wijst erop dat dit beleid de twee-statenoplossing ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Servaes en Van Laar over de uitkomst van de VN-commissie over vrouwenrechten van 13 maart 2015

MPs Yücel, Servaes and Van Laar asked about the outcome of the 2015 UN Commission on the Status of Women, including concerns that the political declaration weakened women's rights, that conservative states blocked references to harmful practices and sexual and reproductive rights, and that NGOs were excluded. The minister acknowledges difficult negotiations and the absence of specific references but argues there is no regression from Beijing, describes Dutch efforts and dialogue with conservative actors, and commits to continued advocacy.
However, with this political declaration there is no regression compared with the commitments made in 1995, because all member states reaffirmed the full Beijing agenda.
Echter, met deze politieke verklaring is geen sprake van achteruitgang ten opzichte van de afspraken gemaakt in 1995, omdat alle lidstaten de volledige Beijing agenda hebben herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Servaes over het militaire optreden van onder meer Saudi-Arabië in Jemen

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about civilian deaths from Saudi-led airstrikes in Yemen, including an attack on a UN refugee camp, and whether these may violate international humanitarian law. The minister acknowledged serious concern and casualty figures, said there is insufficient information to judge legal compliance, and called for a political solution and a return to UN-led negotiations, without committing to a concrete new step beyond raising the issue in EU channels.
There is currently insufficient information available to give a balanced judgment on whether the airstrikes were carried out in accordance with applicable international humanitarian law.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende informatie beschikbaar om een afgewogen oordeel te geven of de luchtaanvallen in overeenstemming met het toepasselijke humanitair oorlogsrecht zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie in Gaza, een half jaar na het staakt-het-vuren

An MP asked the ministers about the humanitarian and reconstruction situation in Gaza six months after the ceasefire, including building-material imports, the Rafah crossing, Palestinian Authority role, donor shortfalls and the Cairo pledges. The government acknowledged serious concern, described the Gaza Reconstruction Mechanism as adequate for housing materials, and said it raises the issues bilaterally and multilaterally, though it gave no comprehensive list of unfulfilled pledges.
The cabinet itself does not have a detailed overview of all pledges.
Het kabinet heeft zelf geen gedetailleerd overzicht van alle toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes en Sjoerdsma over De ontvoering van tenminste 150 Syrische christenen

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the reported abduction of at least 150 Syrian Christians by ISIS, about Dutch military and material support to Kurdish forces in Iraq, how minority protection is built into the anti-ISIS strategy, and how the international community could secure the hostages' release. The minister answered that Dutch support (helmets, vests, instructor teams, humanitarian aid) is aimed at training Peshmerga who protect all civilians, that inclusiveness and minority protection are addressed in training and EU policy, and that no ground options exist for freeing the hostages, while about twenty had been released.
Yes. Question 2: What material and military support has the Netherlands by now given to the Kurds in Iraq?
Ja. Vraag 2 Welke materiële en militaire steun heeft Nederland inmiddels gegeven aan de Koerden in Irak?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Kerstens en Servaes over het bericht ‘FIFA: Welzijn arbeiders Qatar niet onze zaak’

PvdA MPs asked whether the government would press the KNVB, the ITUC and FIFA's president to take responsibility for migrant worker conditions building World Cup 2022 stadiums in Qatar. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, wants FIFA to publish its bid report, and considers the KNVB proactive and the ITUC capable of acting itself, but said it cannot compel FIFA's president to explain publicly.
I note a proactive attitude from the KNVB regarding the position of migrant workers and will remain in discussion with them about it.
Ik constateer een pro-actieve houding van de KNVB over de positie van arbeidsmigranten en blijf hierover met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over slavernij en de arrestatie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the arrest and imprisonment of anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid in Mauritania and about slavery there, and whether the government will raise these issues with Mauritanian authorities and in international fora. The minister confirms Abeid's two-year sentence, says the EU, UN and US have urged a fair trial and an end to repression, and states the Netherlands raises slavery through EU channels and the ILO-based Universal Periodic Review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de misstanden bij de aanleg van de bouw- en infraprojecten voor het WK 2022 in Qatar

MPs Servaes, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Foreign Minister about serious labour abuses, including deaths, in preparations for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, and what the government has done about them. The minister answered that the government remains concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, plans a human rights ambassador visit to Qatar in 2015 with a report to parliament, supports the ILO investigation, and has contact with the KNVB without detailing outcomes.
In 2015 a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador to Qatar is envisaged, where labour rights will also be discussed. A report of this visit will be provided to the House of Representatives.
In 2015 wordt een bezoek van de Mensenrechtenambassadeur aan Qatar beoogd waar het onderwerp arbeidsrechten ook besproken zal worden. Van dit bezoek zal verslag worden gedaan aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Oeganda nieuwe anti-homowetgeving voorbereidt

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a new, stricter Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill and how the Netherlands would respond, including whether it would support an EU blacklist of officials and fund legal challenges. The minister said the draft's status is unclear but that the Netherlands opposes it, is pressing Uganda diplomatically with donors, funds human rights defenders and the Democratic Governance Facility, and is open to reconsidering legal aid if the issue returns.
The cabinet does share the view that it would be highly undesirable if such a bill were adopted.
Wel deelt het kabinet de opvatting dat het zeer onwenselijk zou zijn als een dergelijk wetsvoorstel zou worden aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat een Iraanse mensenrechtenactiviste weer is opgepakt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the temporary arrest of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh and other demonstrators protesting acid attacks on women, and whether the government would raise this with Iran. The minister regretted the arrests, said the Dutch embassy would raise the case with Iranian authorities, and noted a recommendation at the UN on freedom of expression.
The Dutch embassy in Tehran will raise this issue with the Iranian authorities where possible in its contacts.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Teheran zal in contacten met de Iraanse autoriteiten deze kwestie waar mogelijk aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de berichten dat Koerdische strijders ISIS-strijders zouden executeren

MPs Van Bommel and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Kurdish fighters executed captured ISIS fighters and destroyed the Arab town of Barzan, and whether an independent inquiry into possible war crimes should be pressed for. The minister said the executions could not be confirmed, that executing hors de combat fighters is prohibited, that no further information on Barzan is known, and that the primary duty to investigate lies with Iraqi authorities, with calls already made to Iraqi and Kurdish authorities to treat prisoners humanely.
The duty to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law lies in the first instance with the Iraqi authorities.
De plicht tot het doen van onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht ligt in eerste instantie bij de Iraakse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat Palestijnen geweerd worden uit Israëlische bussen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Palestinians would be barred from Israeli buses in the West Bank and whether this breaches non-discrimination principles and harms peace talks. The minister said Israel as occupying power must respect humanitarian law and non-discrimination, that the government is awaiting Israel's Defence Minister's answer to a request for clarification, and that the embassy has asked Israeli authorities for an explanation.
The cabinet is awaiting the Israeli Defence Minister's response to the Attorney General's request for clarification in order to obtain more clarity about the announced measure.

Het kabinet is in afwachting van het antwoord van de Israëlische Minister van Defensie op het verzoek om opheldering van de procureur-generaal teneinde meer duidelijkheid te verkrijgen over de aangekondigde maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over misdaden van ISIS tegen Yezidi’s in Irak (nieuwe versie)

MPs Ten Broeke and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS crimes against Yezidis in Iraq, including reported killings, rape, slavery and mustard gas use, and whether the government confirms UN figures. The minister said the government has no independent information to confirm these reports, referred to UN OHCHR/UNAMI figures on killings and detention, and described the Dutch military and humanitarian contributions.
The cabinet does not have independent information that can confirm such reports.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die dergelijke berichten kan bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het rapport van Human Rights Watch ‘Israël: in depth look at Gaza school attacks’ en de aankondiging van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar een aantal incidenten door het Israë

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about a Human Rights Watch report finding Israeli strikes on Gaza schools lacked military purpose, were disproportionate and indiscriminate, and about Israel's criminal probes into some incidents conducted under military responsibility. The minister said the government takes the report seriously, backs an independent international investigation, and noted that Israeli military-led investigations can be acceptable if impartial and independent, with the Netherlands pressing Israel to strengthen its internal review mechanism.
The cabinet cannot yet confirm a criminal investigation into the two other attacks examined by HRW.
Het kabinet kan een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de twee andere door HRW onderzochte aanvallen nog niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Gambia

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about Gambia's anti-gay bill and deteriorating human rights, including whether he would raise it with Gambia, in the EU and at the UN, and the effect on EU aid. The minister answered that the bill passed parliament and awaits presidential assent, expressed concern, said the EU and the Dutch ambassador have raised it with Gambian authorities, and that Gambia will be reviewed at the UN Universal Periodic Review, with EU aid decisions to be reassessed later.
The cabinet considers that dialogue on the bill can be conducted most effectively at EU level.
Het kabinet vindt dat een dialoog over het wetsvoorstel het meest effectief in EU-verband gevoerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie in Gaza

MP Servaes asked the government whether its view on Israeli strikes on schools and hospitals in Gaza had changed, whether it still expects Israel to respect necessity and proportionality, and how it judges US, UN and EU statements and its own contacts with Israel. The government condemned the strike on a UNRWA school, said it lacks facts for a firm judgement, called for an independent international investigation, and noted its contacts with Israeli leaders.
The cabinet does not have the necessary factual information about attacks on schools and hospitals to give a well-founded judgement on the circumstances of these attacks.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie over aanvallen op scholen en ziekenhuizen om een gefundeerd oordeel te kunnen geven over de toedracht van deze aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht in The Washington Post van 5 juni jl. "Dutch aerospace company Fokker hit with $ 21 million fine in sanctions case."

MP Servaes asked the minister about reports that Fokker faced a $21 million US sanctions fine, whether the Dutch parent company was involved in exports to Iran, Sudan and Burma, whether the company deliberately evaded US restrictions, and whether the government had contacted the parent. The minister confirmed US requests for legal assistance and said the 2005-2010 violations occurred under a predecessor parent, that the subsidiary self-disclosed and cooperated, and that the matter is not part of a broader evasion strategy, while the court has yet to rule on the settlement.
Importantly, Fokker Services BV itself reported the violation of US sanctions to the US authorities through a voluntary self-disclosure and fully cooperated with the subsequent investigation.

Van belang is dat Fokker Services BV de overtreding van de Amerikaanse sancties zelf aanhangig heeft gemaakt bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten via een «voluntary self disclosure» en volledig heeft meegewerkt bij het daaropvolgende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Tanamal en Van Bommel over gevangenschap van politieke activisten in Indonesië

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about political prisoners in Indonesia, including Johan Teterissa, arrests at a 25 April demonstration, and whether the government would press for their release or transfer closer to family. The minister confirmed awareness of the cases, noted Dutch concerns raised bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and committed to raising transfers of Moluccan prisoners with Indonesia and in the EU.

At the human rights debate on 30 June it was promised that the cabinet will raise the placement of Moluccan prisoners closer to home with the Indonesian government, and that this will also be pursued at EU level.

Tijdens het nota-overleg mensenrechten op 30 juni is toegezegd dat het kabinet de plaatsing van Molukse gevangenen dichter bij huis met de Indonesische regering zal opnemen, en dat dit ook in EU-verband zal worden opgepakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de Global Summit to End Sexual Violence in Conflict

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would attend the 2014 London summit on ending sexual violence in conflict, what steps and budget the government commits to, and whether sexual violence outside conflict is covered. The minister answered that the Netherlands will push accountability and comprehensive services, commits to existing multi-channel policy and possibly more funding, and confirms that policy covers sexual violence outside conflict as well.
At the Global Summit to End Sexual Violence in Conflict, the Netherlands mainly pushed for accountability for sexual violence as a weapon of war.
Nederland heeft tijdens de Global Summit to End Sexual Violence in Conflict Nederland vooral ingezet op het belang van accountability voor de misdaad van seksueel geweld als oorlogswapen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Servaes, Van Ojik over de Egyptische strafeis tegen een Nederlandse journaliste

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Egypt seeking maximum prison terms against about 20 journalists, including Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether Egypt kept its promise of a fair trial. The minister answered that the Netjes sentence of ten years in absentia is not a fair process, that the Netherlands raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and referred to a separate letter for further measures.
The Netherlands informed the Egyptian authorities that it deeply regrets that, due to the course of events in Egypt, Ms. Netjes is denied the possibility of returning safely and doing her work there.
Nederland heeft de Egyptische autoriteiten geïnformeerd dat het zeer betreurt dat mw. Netjes door de gang van zaken in Egypte de mogelijkheid wordt ontzegd om veilig te kunnen terugkeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Servaes over de repressie die zou zijn ingezet tegen straatkinderen in Rio de Janeiro in de aanloop naar het WK voetbal en de Olympische Spelen

MPs Omtzigt and Servaes asked the government about alleged repression of street children in Rio de Janeiro ahead of the World Cup and Olympics, including reports of unlawful detention, child killings and disappearances, and whether Brazilian authorities withheld information. The Minister answered that the government does not see a systematic repression strategy or systematic child-rights violations, that the cited IBGE report could not be verified, that no Brazilian data was found to have been deleted, and that no international investigation is warranted, while committing to raise human rights bilaterally, supporting NGOs, and pursuing sport-federation human rights clauses.
The Cabinet currently sees no reason for an international investigation, because the Brazilian government recognises the problem
Het Kabinet ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een internationaal onderzoek, omdat de Braziliaanse regering de problematiek onderkent

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven indirect betrokken zijn bij schendingen van de arbeidsrechten bij de bouw van faciliteiten voor het WK 2022 in Qa

MPs asked whether Dutch banks, pension funds and companies invest in firms accused of labour rights abuses in building Qatar's 2022 World Cup facilities, and what the government will do about it. The government said it lacks such investment data, will raise labour rights in the ILO and OECD frameworks and with Qatar, and reported on sports-human rights steps.
The government does not have this kind of information and therefore cannot make statements about it.
De regering beschikt niet over dit soort informatie en kan derhalve geen uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht “Israël schoot schooljongens dood”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that Israeli forces shot two schoolboys dead, whether an independent investigation should follow, whether this fits a wider pattern of excessive force by Israeli security forces, and whether he would raise concerns with Israel and the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, called for thorough investigation, noted Israel's announced inquiry, said the government watches a rise in violent incidents with concern, and that the Netherlands regularly urges Israel to improve its internal military investigation mechanism.

The cabinet will, together with EU partners, continue to closely follow this issue and keep holding Israel to its international legal obligations on the use of force and on investigating its own military conduct.

Het kabinet zal, samen met EU-partners, dit onderwerp nauw blijven volgen en Israël blijven aanspreken op zijn internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen bij het gebruik van geweld en het onderzoeken van het eigen militair handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over het voorkomen van witwassen van Russische vermogens

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked how the government implemented a motion calling for heightened vigilance against money laundering of Russian officials' and oligarchs' assets, and about Navalny's claims that Western police obstructed investigations and that 90% of Russian corruption money is laundered in the West. The minister replied that the Wwft's risk-based regime already requires heightened vigilance, that supervisors issued guidance and circulars, that FIUs cooperated on Ukraine and Russia, and that the government could not verify Navalny's claims, with the OM reporting no contact from Navalny's foundation.
Ultimately it is up to the institutions themselves to determine the degree of risk and which measures to take.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de instellingen zelf om de mate van het risico te bepalen en welke maatregelen men neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Nijboer over het bevriezen van Oekraïense tegoeden en het voorkomen van belastingontwijking via Nederland door de Oekraïense elite

MPs Servaes and Nijboer asked about the amount of Ukrainian assets frozen in the Netherlands and how the FIU reported only one suspicious transaction linked to Ukraine, and whether the government would investigate how the assets came to the Netherlands and improve supervision. The minister declined to give amounts or breakdowns citing secrecy rules, explained the separate legal procedures for freezing and reporting, and committed to examine the cases and feed the results into an anti-money-laundering policy monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat het Litouwse parlement stemt over een anti-homowet

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about a Lithuanian parliamentary amendment penalising public expression of non-traditional family values, asking whether it was discriminatory, whether the minister had raised it with Lithuania, and whether he would raise it in the EU. The minister answered that the amendment was withdrawn from the agenda, that the Netherlands has raised LGBT issues with Lithuania and in EU working groups, and that the government will monitor the situation closely.
This concerns a proposal from the parliament and not from the government.
Het gaat hier om een voorstel van het parlement en niet van de regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht “Colombia is geen democratie”

MP Servaes asks the Foreign Minister about political violence in Colombia, including an attack on presidential candidate Aida Avella, the state of the FARC peace talks, and what the Netherlands and the EU can do to protect the process before elections. The minister acknowledges elevated risks of political violence, describes gradual progress in the peace talks, and states Dutch and EU political support, OAS monitoring, and readiness to assist implementation on request.
The Netherlands is willing to support the implementation of the peace process if Colombia requests it.
Nederland is bereid de implementatie van het vredesproces te ondersteunen indien Colombia daarom verzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht “Veel misstanden bouw stadions Brazilië”

MPs Servaes, Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of labour violations, safety breaches and intimidation in building World Cup stadiums in Brazil, and whether the government would act, raise it with Brazil, and implement a motion on human rights in sports event awarding. The minister answered that the conclusions are FNV's responsibility, that Brazil is handling labour issues, that no direct talks are planned, and that the sports minister is pursuing human rights in sports awarding via NOC*NSF and a European letter.
The conclusions FNV draws from this research are FNV's own responsibility.
De conclusies die FNV trekt op basis van dit onderzoek zijn voor rekening van FNV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes over de anti-homowetgeving in Oeganda

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked whether the government knew of Uganda's anti-homosexuality law, whether it opposes it, and how Dutch development aid to Uganda relates to good governance and human rights. The minister confirmed the law, said President Museveni refused to sign it and that the Netherlands pressed for EU action, and described the roughly 23 million euro aid programme, including funds for human rights and the justice sector.
The Dutch cabinet pressed within the EU for joint pressure on the Ugandan government not to approve this law.
Het Nederlandse kabinet heeft binnen de EU aangedrongen op gezamenlijke druk op de Ugandese regering om niet met deze wet in te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over het bericht “India top court reinstates gay sex ban”

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about the Indian Supreme Court reinstating the ban on same-sex relations, and whether the Netherlands would raise abolition of the law with India. The minister answered that only parliament can amend the provision (or the government via ordinance with presidential consent), that the EU High Representative already expressed concern, and that the Supreme Court left repeal to parliament, so no concrete step was committed.
The Supreme Court indicated that it is for parliament to possibly revise this provision.
Het Hooggerechtshof heeft aangegeven dat het aan het parlement is om deze bepaling eventueel te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat het parlement in Libië stemde voor islamitisch recht

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Libya's transitional parliament (GNC) decided Islamic law should be the basis for legislation, and about its assessment and practical consequences. The minister said it is a matter for Libya, that the Netherlands will respond critically if human rights are violated, that the practical effects await the GNC's elaboration, and that the EU already discussed Libya's situation in November.
The choice of a legal system is a matter for the country concerned.
De keuze voor een rechtsstelsel is een zaak van het desbetreffende land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, van Bommel en van Ojik over Nederlandse steun voor bedrijven in nederzettingen

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP and GroenLinks asked whether Dutch support for Israeli companies in settlements, including a planned Dutch-Israeli business forum, conflicts with the Netherlands' discouragement policy and whether the forum's reach would extend to occupied territories. The government answered that the discouragement policy applies to the forum, that Israeli settlement firms are not invited and are monitored, that the Palestinian Authority and Israel were informed of the policy, and that a fully watertight system is not possible.
It is technically not feasible to set up a filter that excludes Israeli companies located in settlements.
Het is technisch niet haalbaar een filter in te stellen die Israëlische bedrijven gevestigd in nederzettingen uitsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de schending van de rechten van homo- en biseksuelen en transgenders (LGBT) in Iran

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about the rights of LGBT people in Iran, citing a report on discriminatory provisions in Iran's penal code and asking whether the Netherlands can directly support Iranian LGBT-rights NGOs. The minister agreed that the penal code discriminates and that it conflicts with international human rights norms, but said direct funding to Iranian NGOs is generally not possible due to Iranian state conditions, and listed indirect measures such as EU and UN diplomacy and project funding.

Providing a direct (financial) contribution to non-governmental organisations (NGOs) in Iran is usually not possible due to the controlling conditions the Iranian government imposes on NGOs that receive support from abroad.

Het leveren van een rechtstreekse (financiële) bijdrage aan niet-gouvernementele organisaties (NGO's) in Iran is meestal niet mogelijk vanwege de controlerende voorwaarden die de Iraanse overheid stelt aan NGO's die steun ontvangen uit het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke over het bericht "Syrian chemical weapons mission only funded until end of month

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the OPCW lacks funds to continue its Syrian chemical weapons programme after November. The minister denied any funding shortfall, listed donors and pledges, and said Syria bears responsibility for destruction costs.
As stated in the answer to question 2, there is currently no funding shortfall at the OPCW.
Zoals gesteld in het antwoord op vraag 2 is er op dit moment geen sprake van een financieringstekort bij de OPCW.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Van Bommel over het ongekende geweld tegen christenen in Egypte, zoals gedocumenteerd door Amnesty International

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's documentation of large-scale violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt, including trends, casualty figures, the interim government's protection efforts and possible international initiatives. The minister said the reports are troubling, that the government urges independent investigation bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, that no reliable casualty figures exist, and that Dutch initiatives include judicial training and interfaith contacts.
The cabinet advocates the need for such an impartial investigation with the Egyptian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU and UN.
Het kabinet bepleit de noodzaak van een dergelijk onpartijdig onderzoek bij de Egyptische autoriteiten, zowel bilateraal als in EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over misbruik van Syrische minderjarige vluchtelingen

Two MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about reports of child abuse and child marriage among Syrian refugee girls, whether the trend is confirmed, what international measures exist, and whether Dutch funding addresses it. The ministers confirmed that child marriage is a known and possibly rising problem but lacks reliable figures, described Dutch-backed UN initiatives and funding for UNHCR and UNICEF, and did not commit to new concrete action beyond existing policy.
The trend of child abuse, and in particular child marriage, is known.
De trend van kindermisbruik en met name kindhuwelijken is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Servaes over de arrestatie van journalist Ali Anouzla in Marokko

MPs Arib and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of journalist Ali Anouzla in Morocco for publishing a link to a terrorist group video, and whether this reflects wider press freedom problems and whether the Netherlands had raised it with Moroccan authorities. The minister answered that the case is a pending court matter, that the Netherlands monitors it and has discussed it with EU partners, and pointed to existing human rights and press freedom programmes with Morocco.
The Netherlands is following this case closely, but will not interfere in an ongoing court case.
Nederland volgt deze zaak nauwlettend, maar zal zich niet mengen in een lopende rechtszaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes over het Russische voornemen kinderen weg te halen bij homoseksuele ouders

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister about a Russian bill that would allow children to be removed from homosexual parents, and whether the Netherlands would act on it. The minister confirmed knowledge of the bill, called it objectionable, estimated possibly over 2 million children affected, and said the Netherlands would raise the issue in EU-Russia human rights channels.

At the next Foreign Affairs Council discussion where Russia is on the agenda, the Netherlands will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and the pending bill, whose adoption is still uncertain.

Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking in de RBZ waar Rusland op de agenda staat de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin en het voorliggende wetsvoorstel, waarvan nog onzeker is of het zal worden aangenomen, aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het EU-besluit het embargo tegen diamanten uit Zimbabwe op te heffen

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the ministers whether the EU lifting the Zimbabwe diamond embargo was justified, given conditions at the Marange mine and possible ZMDC financing of ZANU-PF, and whether the Kimberley Process should be strengthened. Minister Timmermans answered that the Marange mine met Kimberley Process requirements since late 2012, that ZMDC was delisted for lack of evidence of financing violence, and that broadening the Kimberley Process to human rights had no consensus.

On 25 September 2013 ZMDC was removed from the EU list of restrictive measures, because there are no indications that the company was involved in financing the (limited) violence during the July 2013 elections.

Op 25 september 2013 is ZMDC van de EU-lijst van beperkende maatregelen verwijderd, omdat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat het bedrijf betrokken is geweest bij het financieren van het (beperkte) geweld tijdens de verkiezingen van juli 2013.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel, Van Dekken en Servaes over berichten inzake de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen van 2014

MPs Yücel, Van Dekken and Servaes asked the government about reports of worsening human rights in Russia ahead of the 2014 Sochi Olympics, including LGBT rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it, and whether personal expression of sexual orientation is compatible with the Olympic Charter. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU fora including a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law, and that personal expression of sexual orientation is not a political statement and not contrary to the Olympic Charter.

The cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly at the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the half-yearly EU-Russia Summit, and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.
Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de halfjaarlijkse EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de Baltic Pride in Litouwen

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Vilnius authorities were effectively blocking the 2013 Baltic Pride march, whether he had raised it with Lithuania, and whether he would press the issue at EU level. The minister replied that the dispute concerned venue logistics rather than a ban, that the issue was raised in the EU human rights working group, and that the Netherlands supports LGBT rights through its embassy and EU policy without committing to a specific new step.

There is no ban by the Vilnius municipality on the planned Baltic Pride on 27 July, but there is a dispute between the municipality and the organisers of the Baltic Pride over the location where the Pride will take place.

Er is geen sprake van een verbod van de gemeente Vilnius op de geplande Baltic Pride op 27 juli, maar wel van een geschil tussen de gemeente en de organisatoren van de Baltic Pride over de locatie waar de Pride zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de arrestatie van tientallen mensen tijdens een Gay Pride demonstratie in Rusland

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the foreign minister about police ending a Gay Pride demonstration in St Petersburg and arresting dozens under Russia's new anti-propaganda law, and whether he had raised concerns with Russian counterparts and how Russian civil society could be supported. The minister confirmed the facts, condemned the dispersal, said the government raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and pledged continued support for projects on acceptance and free expression.
The government will keep repeating, in bilateral talks and at EU level, that the new legislation has a stigmatising effect.
Het kabinet zal blijven herhalen, in bilaterale gesprekken en in EU-verband, dat de nieuwe wetgeving een stigmatiserende werking heeft

Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over het bericht ‘Barrières terug van weggeweest. Nederlandse technologiebedrijven krijgen zelfs binnen EU met belemmeringen te maken’ zoals gepubliceerd in Trouw op 19 jun

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers whether they agree that trade barriers facing Dutch tech firms, both inside and outside the EU, are a bad development and what the government will do about them. The government agreed barriers are undesirable, said most reported obstacles concern non-EU export markets, and pointed to EU initiatives, Solvit, the trade barrier complaint point and diplomatic posts as support tools.
I am happy to consult with FME-CWM to further clarify the identified problems.
Ik ga graag in overleg met FME-CWM om de gesignaleerde problemen nader te duiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de gewelddadigheden rondom de opening van een “LGBT support center” in Skopje, Macedonië

An MP asks the foreign minister about an attack by anti-LGBT demonstrators on an LGBT support centre in Skopje during Pride Week, and whether the Dutch embassy and the minister raised it with Macedonian counterparts. The minister confirms the incident, says the embassy and ministry were in contact, reports that the ambassador raised concerns with the Macedonian foreign minister and in writing with the Macedonian embassy in The Hague and EU working groups, and that the EU will raise it at a Stabilisation and Association Council.
On 26 June the Dutch ambassador explained the Dutch concerns in a personal conversation with the Macedonian foreign minister.
Op 26 juni jl. heeft de Nederlandse ambassadeur de Nederlandse zorgen in een persoonlijk gesprek met de Macedonische minister van Buitenlandse Zaken nader toegelicht
Antwoord vragen Maij, Servaes en Bonis over voorgestelde wetgeving in Litouwen en Macedonië die de toegang tot abortus zal beperken

Three PvdA MPs asked the Dutch government whether it is aware of proposed abortion restrictions in Lithuania and North Macedonia, whether it considers this worrying for women's health and rights, and whether it will raise concerns with those governments. The minister replied that reproductive rights are fundamental human rights and that Dutch concern is noted, that a Lithuanian bill is pending in committee and a Macedonian law is said by its government not to be more restrictive, and that the Netherlands will raise reproductive health policy in human rights reporting forums.

The Netherlands will raise the policy on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, including abortion legislation and its implementation, in the appropriate forums during the review of human rights reports.

Nederland zal bij de behandeling van mensenrechtenrapportages het beleid omrent Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten, inclusief abortuswetgeving en de uitvoering daarvan aan de orde stellen in de daarvoor geëigende gremia.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes, Kuiken en Albert De Vries over het bericht “actie ANWB tegen tolvignet België

MPs asked the government about Belgium's planned toll vignette for Belgian roads, its effects on cross-border workers and Zeeland residents, and whether the minister had raised it with Belgium.
