An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about press reports that a long-COVID compensation scheme for healthcare workers excludes some deserving cases, such as those who returned to work before relapsing or faced long UWV assessment waits, and about the scheme's strict WIA-based conditions and budget. The minister acknowledged the reports, defended the WIA-based objective criteria as necessary for legal robustness and administrative control, described some simplifications and assistance from DUS-I and UWV, but refused to carry over unused budget to 2024 and offered no broad relaxation of the rules.
When assessing applications, these statutory four weeks are taken into account.
Bij de beoordeling van de aanvragen wordt rekening gehouden met deze wettelijke vier weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over de toegankelijkheid van het funderend onderwijs voor kinderen met long COVID

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether children with long COVID face obstacles in following education, whether schools lack knowledge and willingness to adapt teaching, and what schools' obligations are. The Minister answered that no hard figures exist, referred to a school-participation advice, stated that schools have a legal duty to organise education for sick pupils, and committed to further work on digital distance learning and continued dialogue with patient groups.
There are, however, no hard figures known on the number of pupils in the Netherlands who face this.
Er zijn echter geen harde cijfers bekend over het aantal leerlingen in Nederland dat hiermee te maken heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over de forse krimp van de Groningse economie door afbouw van de gaswinning

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the 13% contraction of the Groningen economy caused by phasing out gas extraction, the lower figures for Delfzijl, whether past statistics overstated Groningen's wealth, and how the economic recovery programme and monitoring will work. The State Secretary attributed the contraction to gas phase-out and high energy prices, rejected the premise that statistics misled, and committed to informing parliament in December and presenting the first Staat van Groningen in April.
I will inform your House in December in broad outline about how, among other things, the progress of the economic and social agenda will be monitored.
Ik zal uw Kamer in december op hoofdlijnen informeren over de manier waarop onder andere de voortgang van de economische en sociale agenda zal worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Ceder over de aanhoudende berichtgeving over de zorgelijke omgang met migranten aan de Tunesische grens

MPs Drost and Ceder asked the Prime Minister about reports of deaths and mistreatment of migrants at the Tunisian borders, the EU-Tunisia migration deal, Dutch responsibility, and the human rights safeguards in the deal. The government answered that the events are hard to verify and worrying, that it supports monitoring and human rights in the deal, will raise concerns in dialogue with Tunisia, and will inform parliament once details of EU support are known.
The Netherlands, in contacts with Tunisia, works for humane reception and protection with respect for human rights.
Nederland zet zich in contacten met Tunesië in voor humane opvang en bescherming met respect voor mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Drost over het bericht ‘Nieuwe functie Snapchat wil met kinderen afspreken: Zie ik je vanavond? Ik ben een echt persoon!’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about Snapchat's My AI chatbot, which presented itself as a real person, suggested meeting children, and retained messages for product improvement and advertising. The government answered that Snap has since changed the feature to identify itself as a chatbot, that privacy compliance is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority to assess, and that it will rely on the forthcoming AI Regulation and the Code Kinderrechten Online.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Drost, Bisschop, Pouw-Verweij, Beertema en Van der Plas over de antwoorden op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog al

Five MPs asked the minister about a school identity statement that was misquoted in earlier answers as rejecting homosexuality. The minister confirmed the statement does not address sexual orientation, apologised, rectified the record, and said a broader review of the motions on identity statements will be reported to parliament later this year.

In the wording of the parliamentary questions and in the answers to them, a link was unintentionally made between a passage from the Gomarus College identity document and views on marriage and sexual orientation.

In de vraagstelling van de Kamervragen en de beantwoording van de Kamervragen is onbedoeld de link gelegd tussen een passage uit het identiteitsdocument van het Gomarus College en opvattingen over het huwelijk en seksuele oriëntatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Partners Code voor Kinderrechten teleurgesteld in aanpak ministerie’

MPs Drost and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the State Secretary for Interior about the ministry's small, fragmented tender approach to the Code for Children's Rights online, versus a larger integral programme, and whether it would be revised. The State Secretary says the approach is content-driven, cites broader online child-rights policy and a planned letter, and declines to revise the approach while staying in dialogue with the original partners.
You will shortly receive a letter with an overview of all policy on children's rights online and its current status.
U ontvangt binnenkort een brief met het overzicht van al het beleid met betrekking tot kinderrechten online en de stand van zaken daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Drost over het bericht ‘Waarom Franse jongeren toestemming van ouders nodig hebben voor TikTok (en Nederlandse niet)’

The MP asks why French youth need parental consent for TikTok while Dutch youth do not, and whether the age limit should be raised to 15 with parental consent, plus measures on social media harms to youth. The government answers that the AVG/UAVG age limit is 16 with parental consent, that no official 13-year limit exists, that age verification must protect privacy, and that it will inform parliament before summer and discuss with platforms, while leaving enforcement to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and declining to lower the age to 15.
We do not consider it desirable to lower this age limit to 15 years.
Wij vinden het niet wenselijk deze leeftijdsgrens te verlagen naar 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over de afschaling van zorg in de Gelre ziekenhuizen

An MP asks the Health Minister about the proposed downgrading of the emergency department and the moving of acute obstetrics at Gelre Ziekenhuizen Zutphen, including financial motives, regional planning, citizen participation and whether the banks could give more room. The minister says the hospital board decides within the norms, the IGJ supervises, the NZa monitors, and that regional access is not under pressure, while declining further intervention.
It is the responsibility of the care provider, in this case Gelre Ziekenhuizen, to decide on the organisation of the care organisation, provided this is within the applicable norms.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder, in dit geval Gelre Ziekenhuizen, om te beslissen over de inrichting van de zorgorganisatie, mits dit binnen de geldende normen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Drost over de registratie van een levenloos geboren kind na een abortus

MPs Dik-Faber and Drost asked why a stillborn child after abortion could be registered in the Basisregistratie Personen, whether this was foreseen, and how it fits with the law on abortion and the legal status of unborn life. The State Secretary answered that registration follows parents' wishes without conditions, that no legal consequences attach, that the Waz framework is unchanged, and declined to launch a broader societal debate.
I have received similar questions from municipalities and will shortly look into what can be done about this.
Ik heb overigens vergelijkbare vragen ontvangen vanuit gemeenten en zal op korte termijn bekijken wat hieraan gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over het bericht ambtenaren steeds vaker en luxer in businessclass naar de Caraïben

An MP asked the State Secretary whether rising, more luxurious business-class travel by civil servants to the Caribbean is appropriate given the islands' size and financial oversight from The Hague, and whether the travel decision framework should be tightened. The government denies excessive spending, attributes the increase to reinforced support for Caribbean Netherlands and hurricane Irma aftermath, and declines to tighten the framework, leaving business-class choice to the civil servant under the six-hour rule.
For the breakdown per ministry I refer you to the published FOI request where this data is included.
Voor de opsplitsing per ministerie verwijs ik u naar het gepubliceerde WOB-verzoek waar deze gegevens in zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost, Voordewind en Segers over de berichten 'Iraans anti-Israëlprotest bereikt ook westerse steden' en 'CIDI: Stop haatdemonstraties Iraans regime in Nederland'

MPs Drost, Voordewind and Segers asked whether calls to destroy Israel and the United States at a demonstration in The Hague were incitement to hatred, whether police should have ended it, whether an interpreter was present, and whether Iran was behind it. The minister answered that the demonstration right allows offensive speech, police found no criminal offences, an interpreter was present, and the cabinet has no concrete indication of Iranian involvement.
The right to demonstrate also includes publicly expressing opinions or statements that may be experienced as annoying, offensive or shocking.
Het demonstratierecht omvat ook het publiekelijk uiten van meningen of uitlatingen die als hinderlijk, aanstootgevend of choquerend kunnen worden ervaren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Segers over het bericht ‘Ombudsman slaat alarm: 'Het centrum van Amsterdam is 's nachts een wetteloze jungle’ en daarbij het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman van Amsterdam

MPs Drost and Segers asked ministers about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's draft report on lawlessness, nightlife, ATMs, prostitution and tourism in the city centre. The government replied that these are mainly local matters, outlined police capacity increases, RIEC cooperation, ATM oversight limits, and exit programmes, while declining to take a national lead on most suggested measures.
The draft report of the Ombudsman metropolitan Amsterdam concerns a local matter.
Het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman metropool Amsterdam betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.

m: Motie van het lid Ellian over drones die een dreiging vormen voor militaire installaties en justitiële locaties op veilige wijze neerhalen (herdruk)
Asks the government to bring down drones that threaten military and judicial sites safely, a security operations request not bearing on checks on the executive.
requests the government to bring down safely drones that pose a threat to military installations and judicial locations
verzoekt de regering drones die een dreiging vormen voor militaire installaties en justitiële locaties op veilige wijze neer te halen
Motie van het lid Ellian over de uitvoeringsconsequenties van de Wet verval bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid openbaar ministerie nader in kaart brengen

Asks the government, with the Public Prosecution Service, to map out the implementation consequences of abolishing the ministerial special instruction power and inform both chambers within three weeks.
requests the government, together with the Public Prosecution Service, to further map the implementation consequences of this bill and inform both chambers within three weeks

verzoekt de regering in samenspraak met het Openbaar Ministerie de uitvoeringsconsequenties van dit initiatiefwetsvoorstel nader in kaart te brengen, en beide Kamers hierover binnen drie weken te informeren
Motie van het lid Ellian over de beveiliging van militaire objecten zichtbaar en onzichtbaar intensiveren
Asks the government to intensify visible and invisible security of military sites, prepare bans on Chinese smart vehicles near them, and report to the House half-yearly.
to immediately intensify the visible and invisible security of military objects
de beveiliging van militaire objecten zichtbaar en onzichtbaar per direct te intensiveren
Motie van de leden Ellian en Sneller over de beweging naar voren duidelijker verankeren
Asks the government to more firmly anchor the forward movement of criminal cases in the new Code of Criminal Procedure, with sanctions for late investigation requests.
to more clearly anchor the forward movement
de beweging naar voren duidelijker te verankeren
Motie van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het uitgangspunt dat misdaadgeld in beginsel altijd moet worden afgepakt
Asks that criminal proceeds in principle always be confiscated and that not confiscating unlawfully obtained gains may not be part of prosecution agreements.
requests the government, when elaborating the procedural agreements, to take as a starting point that not confiscating unlawfully obtained gains cannot form part of those agreements

verzoekt de regering bij de nadere uitwerking van de procesafspraken als uitgangspunt te hanteren dat het niet ontnemen van wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel geen onderdeel uit kan maken van procesafspraken
Motie van het lid Ellian over effectieve remedies of rechtsmiddelen voor slachtoffers in de tweede aanvullingswet
Asks the government to introduce effective remedies for victims in the second supplementary criminal procedure act, proportionate to the seriousness of non-compliance.
requests the government to introduce effective remedies or legal means for victims in the second supplementary act
verzoekt de regering om effectieve remedies of rechtsmiddelen voor slachtoffers te introduceren in de tweede aanvullingswet
Amendement van het lid Ellian over termijnoverschrijding bij onderzoekswensen
Requires the investigating judge to take account of late filing of investigation requests when deciding whether to grant them.
If a request or application is filed after a time limit set under the first paragraph, the investigating judge takes this delay into account in deciding on it.
Indien een vordering of verzoek wordt ingediend na verloop van een op grond van het eerste lid gestelde termijn, betrekt de rechter-commissaris deze overschrijding in zijn beslissing daarop.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellian ter vervanging van nr. 24 over het laten vervallen van de mogelijkheden voor specifiek beklag met betrekking tot gegevens
Removes the specific complaint (beklag) procedures for data taken over by investigators, so citizens lose a dedicated remedy against police and prosecution data handling.
Based on practical experience, dropping these specific complaint options reduces the workload for the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the judiciary.
Op basis van de ervaringen in de praktijk levert het laten vervallen van deze specifieke beklagmogelijkheden een afname op van de werklast voor, politie, het Openbaar Ministerie en de rechtspraak.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over vervangende taakstraf bij een onbetaalde geldboete
Lets criminal courts impose a substitute community sentence alongside a fine, reducing the substitute detention that follows if the fine is unpaid.
If the judge considers a substitute community sentence inappropriate, he orders that substitute detention will be applied.
Indien de rechter een vervangende taakstraf niet opportuun acht, beveelt hij dat vervangende hechtenis zal worden toegepast.
Amendement van het lid Ellian ter vervanging van nr. 22 over het slachtoffer ook bij niet-vervolging de mogelijkheid geven om kennis te nemen van processtukken
Allows victims, even when no prosecution is started, to request access to case documents while a complaint procedure against the non-prosecution decision is still open.
the third paragraph remains applicable as long as the period referred to in article 3.5.4, first paragraph, has not expired.
blijft het derde lid van toepassing zolang de termijn, genoemd in artikel 3.5.4, eerste lid, niet is verstreken.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellian ter vervanging van nr. 20 over een algemene onderzoeksbevoegdheid voor de rechter-commissaris

Adds a general investigative power letting the public prosecutor order police to carry out comparable investigative acts on judicial authorisation, with a deadline for codifying legislation within three years.
The submitter therefore proposes to include a general investigative power in the law that aims to offer the same scope as the current article 181 Sv.
Indiener stelt daarom voor om een algemene onderzoeksbevoegdheid in de wet op te nemen die dezelfde ruimte beoogt te bieden als het huidige artikel 181 Sv.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellian ter vervanging van nr. 28 over het gebruik van videoconferentie als hoofdregel bij verdachten in EBI's en AIT's

Makes video conferencing the default for detained suspects held in extra secure or intensive supervision units, unless the judge finds physical presence necessary for a proper trial, and extends this to transport security cases.
video conferencing is used, unless the judge considers the presence of the suspect necessary in the interest of a proper trial
wordt gebruik gemaakt van videoconferentie, tenzij de rechter de aanwezigheid van de verdachte in het belang van een behoorlijke behandeling van de zaak noodzakelijk acht
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellian ter vervanging van nr. 23 over schorsing van het onderzoek bij niet-verschijnen van de ouder
Restores the rule that a court must postpone a case when a parent fails to appear for a minor's trial, leaving the judge less room to proceed.
An important starting point of the existing Article 496a Sv is that parents who fail to appear are in principle summoned again by the judge.
Een belangrijk uitgangspunt van het bestaande artikel 496a Sv is echter dat ouders die in gebreke blijven te verschijnen ter zitting door de rechter in beginsel daartoe worden opgeroepen.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellian ter vervanging van nr. 25 over ontneming van wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel ook mogelijk te maken bij misdrijven waarvoor een boete van de vierde categorie

Expands the confiscation-related conservatory seizure powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure to suspicions of offences carrying a fourth-category fine, widening state coercive powers over suspects.
to no longer limit conservatory seizure to offences for which a fifth-category fine has been set
om het conservatoir beslag niet langer te beperken tot feiten waarop een geldboete van de vijfde categorie is gesteld
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over vervangende taakstraf bij een onbetaalde geldboete
Makes a substitute community service sentence the default for unpaid fines, with detention only as fallback, and sets rules on hours and conversion.
This amendment gives the criminal judge the option, when imposing a fine, to order a substitute community service sentence
Dit amendement geeft de strafrechter de mogelijkheid om bij oplegging van een geldboete een vervangende taakstraf te bevelen
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. over vervangende taakstraf bij een onbetaalde geldboete
Allows courts to impose a substitute community service order instead of substitute detention when a criminal fine is not paid, reducing short prison terms.
The submitters aim with this amendment to give the judge the option of imposing a substitute community service when a fine is not paid.
De indieners beogen met dit amendement de rechter de mogelijkheid te geven om een vervangende taakstraf op te leggen wanneer een geldboete niet wordt betaald.
Amendement van het lid Ellian over het gebruik van videoconferentie als hoofdregel bij verdachten in EBI's en AITs
Makes video conferencing the default for suspects held in intensive supervision or extra secure detention, unless the judge decides otherwise for special reasons.
video conferencing is used, unless the judge decides otherwise for special reasons.
wordt gebruik gemaakt van videoconferentie, tenzij de rechter wegens bijzondere redenen anders beslist.
Amendement van het lid Ellian over de noodzaak van een deugdelijke motivering als de rechter geen medebrenging van de ouder beveelt
Requires that a judge who decides not to order the parent's presence in a juvenile criminal case must give a reasoned decision.
If the judge does not order the parent to be brought along, this decision is reasoned adequately by the judge.
Indien de rechter geen medebrenging van de ouder beveelt, wordt deze beslissing door de rechter deugdelijk gemotiveerd.

Lowers the disclosure threshold for political party donations from 4,500 to 1,000 euro, expanding public transparency of donors.
This amendment provides that all donations from Dutch donors received in a calendar year above 1,000 euro must be made public.
Dit amendement regelt dat alle, in een kalenderjaar ontvangen, giften van Nederlandse gevers boven 1.000 euro openbaar moeten worden gemaakt.
Amendement van het lid Ellian over het bij BZK houden van de subsidies voor de instellingen voor buitenlandse activiteiten van politieke partijen
Keeps the subsidies for political parties' foreign activities at the Ministry of the Interior instead of transferring them to the Foreign Ministry.
that the subsidies for the foreign activities institutes of political parties are not transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
dat de subsidies voor de instellingen voor buitenlandse activiteiten van politieke partijen niet naar het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken worden overgeheveld
Amendement van het lid Ellian over de mogelijkheid de termijn voor toepassing van artikel 557 Sv steeds te verlengen met maximaal drie maanden
Allows the prosecutor, with a judge's authorisation, to extend repeatedly the three-month period for network searches of data stored elsewhere.
can, after authorisation from the investigating judge and if the investigation's interest urgently requires it, be repeatedly extended by the public prosecutor for up to three months

kan na een daartoe verkregen machtiging van de rechter-commissaris en indien het belang van het onderzoek dit dringend vordert, door de officier van justitie telkens verlengd worden voor een periode van ten hoogste drie maanden
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over de eindezaakverklaring na een geslaagde mediation

Amends criminal procedure so that after a successful mediation the court declares the case ended, with conditions, and bars re-prosecution for the same offence, replacing the prosecutor's non-admissibility finding.
After a declaration that the case has ended, no prosecution may be instituted or continued against the former suspect for the same offence
Na een verklaring dat de zaak is geëindigd kan tegen de gewezen verdachte geen vervolging worden ingesteld of voortgezet voor hetzelfde feit
Amendement van het lid Ellian over verduidelijking van de procedures en termijnen bij toepassing van artikel 557 Sv
Clarifies that the prosecutor may order network search after seized computers up to three days later, and extends the search period to three months with investigating-judge authorisation.
The public prosecutor may give this order up to three days after the seizure.
De officier van justitie kan dit bevel geven tot uiterlijk drie dagen na de inbeslagneming.
Amendement van het lid Ellian over de mogelijkheid de termijn voor toepassing van artikel 556 Sv steeds te verlengen met maximaal drie maanden
Lets the prosecutor extend, repeatedly by up to three months each time, the period in which investigators may access data on seized devices, with prior authorisation from the investigating judge.
may, after authorisation from the investigating judge and if the investigation's interest urgently requires it, be repeatedly extended by the public prosecutor for up to three months

kan na een daartoe verkregen machtiging van de rechter-commissaris en indien het belang van het onderzoek dit dringend vordert, telkens verlengd worden door de officier van justitie voor een periode van ten hoogste drie maanden
Amendement van het lid Ellian over verduidelijking van de procedures en termijnen bij toepassing van artikel 556 Sv
Clarifies that the prosecutor may order access to a seized computer after the first three days, with a later order requiring examining-judge authorisation and covering data stored for three months.
The submitter wants this amendment to clarify that there does not necessarily have to be an order within the first three days after the moment of seizure.
De indiener wil met dit amendement verduidelijken dat niet per se sprake hoeft te zijn van een bevel in de eerste drie dagen na het moment van inbeslagneming.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over de eindezaakverklaring na een geslaagde mediation
Replaces the prosecutor's inadmissibility finding after successful mediation with a court declaration that the case has ended, subject to conditions and a time limit, in the pilot regime.
declare that the case has ended
verklaren dat de zaak is geëindigd
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over de eindezaakverklaring na een geslaagde mediation

Replaces a court's declaration of inadmissibility of the prosecutor after successful mediation with a declaration that the case has ended, attached to conditions and a time limit, and bars re-prosecution for the same facts.
Motie van het lid Ellian over het monitoren van de gevolgen van de updateverplichting voor de administratievelastendruk voor ondernemers
Asks the government to monitor the administrative burden for businesses from the update obligation for digital content and inform the House one year after entry into force.
requests the government to carefully monitor the consequences of the update obligation for administrative burden on businesses
verzoekt de regering de gevolgen van de updateverplichting voor de administratievelastendruk voor ondernemers zorgvuldig te monitoren
Amendement van het lid Ellian over het schrappen van een kennelijk abusievelijke verwijzing
Removes an apparently erroneous cross-reference to article 7:23 BW from a proposed civil code provision on digital content supply.
in the proposed article 50ap paragraph 2 the words '23 paragraph 1 of title 7.1 and article' are removed
vervalt in het voorgestelde artikel 50ap lid 2 «23 lid 1 van titel 7.1 en artikel»
Amendement van het lid Ellian over een bewijsvermoeden van 6 maanden voor de consumentenkoop van levende dieren
Adds a six-month presumption that live animals sold to consumers did not conform to the contract at delivery.
it is presumed that it did not conform to the contract at delivery
vermoed dat deze bij aflevering niet aan de overeenkomst beantwoordt
Motie van het lid Bisschop c.s. over mogelijkheden onderzoeken om betaling van schade ook tijdens detentie af te dwingen
Asks the government to report on ways to enforce payment of damages to fraud victims, including during detention.
requests the government to inform the House by March 2022 about the possibilities to enforce payment of damages, also during detention
verzoekt de regering de Kamer voor maart 2022 te informeren over de mogelijkheden om betaling van schade, ook tijdens detentie, af te dwingen
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over slachtoffers beter bijstaan en verdragslanden aanspreken op naleving van het Haags Kinderontvoeringsverdrag
Asks the government to better assist Dutch parents whose children were abducted abroad and to press treaty states to comply with the Hague Abduction Convention.
requests the government to better assist Dutch nationals who are victims and to more actively call other treaty states to account
verzoekt de regering Nederlanders die het hier het slachtoffer van zijn beter bij te staan en andere verdragslanden actiever aan te spreken
Motie van het lid Ellian c.s. over recht doen aan het leed van Julio Poch
Asks the government, as a matter of goodwill, to make maximum efforts to redress the harm suffered by Julio Poch after data sharing led to his transfer to Argentina.
requests the government, out of goodwill, to make maximum efforts to redress the harm suffered by Julio Poch
verzoekt de regering, vanuit het oogpunt van coulance zich maximaal in te spannen om recht te doen aan het ontstane leed van Julio Poch
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht dat een beruchte moordmakelaar betrapt in cel met telefoon: ’Jomairo D. regelde extreem gewelddadige delicten’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a notorious contract-killing broker kept giving violent orders from a smuggled phone in prison, and why such inmates are not placed in stricter regimes and phone smuggling persists. The State Secretary said he will not discuss individual inmates, described layered controls and detection measures, promised a report in September 2026 on intensified checks, and said prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de opbrengsten van zoekacties in Justitiële Inrichtingen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the yield of searches for phones and contraband in prison facilities in 2025. The State Secretary answered with per-facility figures for phones found by the special assistance unit and sniffer dogs and for contraband found in Dutch detention facilities, explaining that monthly breakdowns are not registered and that the unit's searches are risk-driven and planned under deployment matrices.
It is not possible to break down the phones found by the LBB and by the sniffer dogs by month, as these are not recorded on a monthly basis.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevonden telefoons door de LBB en door de speurhonden uit te splitsen per maand, deze worden niet op maandelijkse wijze geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Burg en Ellian over oproepen tot geweld tijdens het concert van Bob Vylan in Paradiso Amsterdam

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers whether Bob Vylan's concert calls for violence (including cheering the killing of Charlie Kirk and calling for hunting Zionists) should be treated as criminal, how the concert was permitted, whether the UK prosecution affects visas or entry bans, and whether local authorities can prevent further calls to violence. The government answered that police and the Public Prosecution Service must establish what was said, that bans on performances require concrete serious disorder, that entry refusal is possible under the Schengen Borders Code on public order grounds, and that local mayors make their own assessments without commenting on individual cases.
Which statements Bob Vylan made will have to emerge from the police and Public Prosecution Service investigation.
Welke uitingen zijn gedaan door Bob Vylan zal uit het onderzoek van politie en het Openbaar Ministerie moeten blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat het Joods Politienetwerk tijdelijk uit het netwerkoverleg van de politie is gestapt

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Jewish Police Network temporarily leaving the police network consultation because members were repeatedly pressed about Gaza, and about whether Jews are held responsible for Israeli government actions and how police neutrality and protection of the Jewish community are ensured. The minister respects the members' decision, calls it regrettable, says he has no signals that police as a whole contribute to Jewish insecurity, and will investigate any signals of compromised neutrality, while referring to the antisemitism strategy and a debate on 23 September.
Should persons within the organisation be guilty of this, I assume the Chief of Police will address it firmly.
Mochten personen binnen de organisatie zich hier wel schuldig aan maken, dan ga ik er vanuit dat de Korpschef dit stevig aanpakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Ellian over mogelijke Nederlandse bijstand bij natuurbranden in Zuid-Europa

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence Minister about Dutch assistance for wildfires in Southern Europe, including why requests were not met and whether helicopters could be sent. The minister answered that two Chinook helicopters were deployed to Spain from 19 to 31 August, dropping nearly 3 million litres of water, and described Defence's general readiness for such requests.
Following the Spanish request, the cabinet decided to provide two Chinook transport helicopters to help fight the wildfires.
Naar aanleiding van het Spaanse verzoek heeft het kabinet besloten om twee Chinook-transporthelikopters te leveren om te helpen bij het bestrijden van de natuurbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Peter de Groot over militair-civiele samenwerking op Lelystad Airport

MPs Ellian and Peter de Groot asked about military-civil cooperation at Lelystad Airport, including whether passenger flights are needed for F-35 stationing, the timing of decisions, permits and regional support. The government answered that a decision on commercial flights and fighter jet stationing is expected later this year, that preparations continue in parallel, and that it recognises regional support would fall away without passenger flights, while committing to further work and a letter.
The cabinet aims to take a definitive decision by the end of this year on fighter aircraft capacity and the opening of Lelystad Airport to commercial traffic.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om eind dit jaar een definitief besluit te nemen over jachtvliegtuigcapaciteit en de openstelling van Lelystad Airport voor handelsverkeer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Verkuijlen en Kisteman over de storing bij de radiosystemen van de Kustwacht op 1 juli jl.

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a July 2025 radio system failure at the Kustwacht, its cause, whether lives were endangered, its link to the 2024 NAFIN outage, backup and cyber protection. The government answered that the radio systems are operational again, the cause was investigated with measures taken, no critical situations arose, but it withheld details on cyber protection for security reasons and gave limited detail on the causes.
For security reasons I cannot go into this any further.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik hierop verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de nieuwe persrichtlijn van de rechtspraak

MP Ellian asked the State Secretary about the Judiciary's new press guideline, which restricts pre-hearing summons access for accredited court journalists, and about declining press access and anonymity of judges and prosecutors. The State Secretary defended the guideline as balancing openness against privacy and safety, said he would await a study on securing openness of criminal hearings, and said he would discuss the matter with the Council for the Judiciary.
I have no indications that the openness of the judiciary is currently not guaranteed.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de openbaarheid van de rechtspraak op dit moment niet geborgd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over Holocausteducatie

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Holocaust education has not yet become a fixed part of civic integration (inburgering), including whether newcomers should visit sites like the National Holocaust Museum, and when a proposal would follow. The State Secretary answered that Holocaust knowledge is now an explicit part of the integration exam from 1 July 2025, that a feasibility study on museum visits and a teacher survey are underway, and that the Chamber will be informed in the third quarter of 2025.
I expect to inform the Chamber further in the third quarter of 2025 on strengthening Holocaust education in civic integration and the next steps.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2025 verder te informeren over het versterken van Holocausteducatie in de inburgering en de vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski over de capaciteit vreemdelingendetentie

Two VVD MPs asked how the government would create 50 to 100 extra immigration detention places, where they would be located, and whether this reduces prison capacity. The minister answers that 90 places will be created at Justitieel Complex Schiphol in phases (August and November 2025) and that staffing shortages may force some prison capacity offline.
We have decided to realise 90 places for immigration detention at Justitieel Complex Schiphol from 1 August 2025.
We hebben besloten om per 1 augustus 2025 90 plekken voor vreemdelingenbewaring te realiseren op het Justitieel Complex Schiphol (hierna: JCS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de situatie in de gemeente Zeist ten aanzien van Fivoor

MP Ellian asked the State Secretary about the situation in Zeist regarding the relocation of Fivoor's clinics from Den Dolder, including the alleged 2025 departure commitment, the lack of concrete relocation plans, safety measures, and continued dialogue with residents. The government answered that it has no competence over Fivoor's relocation, that no formal commitment on a departure date was made by the former minister, that Altrecht and Fivoor are responsible, and that it will explore Rijksvastgoed and discuss safety with the municipality and residents.
It is not for the Minister to close the clinic or to steer towards a timeline for the planned departure.
Het is niet aan de Minister om de kliniek te sluiten of aan te sturen op een tijdspad richting het voorgenomen vertrek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over drones die boven de PI Vught vliegen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why drones were able to fly over the high-security Vught prison for an extended period despite a no-fly zone, and why they were not shot down, asking about detection, counter-drone powers and detection of operators. The State Secretary answered that drones were detected, the operators are being sought, the airspace closure is being made permanent via the Minister of Infrastructure, DJI lacks power to neutralise drones and options are being explored with results to Parliament after the summer, and a planned budget is being allocated to counter drones.
I would like to see DJI able to take these drones out of the air. I am currently exploring the (legal) possibility of this.
Ik zou graag zien dat DJI deze drones uit de lucht kan halen. Ik verken momenteel de (juridische) mogelijkheid daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over “procesafspraken met grote criminelen”

An MP asks the Justice Minister about plea agreements with major international drug traffickers, whose sentences were reduced and who paid fines, and whether such deals are appropriate. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, defends plea agreements as efficient in complex cases, and says a statutory framework is being prepared with consultation advice still being processed.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Op individuele zaken kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder, Van Zanten, Eerdmans en Ellian over het weigeren van een Israëlische comedian door theaters in Amsterdam

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views Amsterdam theatres declining to host Israeli comedian Yohay Sponder after threats and reactions, whether local police and municipal bodies were consulted, and what follow-up is planned. The minister condemns the intimidation, says cultural institutions must be free to programme, notes Boom Chicago did not follow the sector protocol, and reports ongoing talks with the alderman and Kunsten '92 to find an alternative venue.
It is intolerable that a cultural institution receives such reactions or is threatened to such an extent that a performance is cancelled.
Het is onverteerbaar dat een culturele instelling zodanige reacties krijgt of zodanig wordt bedreigd dat een voorstelling wordt geannuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van Nispen over kluisverklaringen die mogelijk vernietigd worden

MPs Ellian and Van Nispen asked whether witness statements (kluisverklaringen) from a detained criminal, Goran K., should be destroyed when no cooperation deal with the Public Prosecution Service is reached, and how relevant information and imminent threats are handled. The Minister answers that statements are destroyed under statutory retention rules unless specific arrangements or serious interests justify earlier destruction, that information from non-agreed statements cannot be used for investigation, that threats are always acted upon, and declines to comment on the individual case.
It is not appropriate for me to go further into the substance of this individual case.
Het past mij niet om verder inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over gerechtelijke dwalingen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice about the wrongful conviction of Berry de R., how many miscarriages of justice occurred, how institutions reflect on and prevent them, and whether the case will be fully evaluated. The State Secretary acknowledged the gravity, cited eight known cases and twelve EUREX-registered exonerations, described existing reflection and training measures, and said the Reflectiekamer analysed the case and sent its advice to the involved bodies.
The advice of the Reflectiekamer was sent to the relevant OM unit, the police unit and the court that handled the case.
Het advies van de Reflectiekamer is gestuurd naar het desbetreffende OM-onderdeel, de politie-eenheid en de rechtbank die de zaak hebben behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elian en Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Te koop in Nederland: 7 Oktober, de game’ worden beantwoord zoals aangegeven

MPs Van Zanten and Ellian asked whether the game 'Fursan al-Aqsa' depicting the 7 October attack, sold on Steam in the Netherlands, violates criminal law and should be banned. The minister said criminal prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that the game was removed from Steam for EU member states after a French removal order, and that the national authority ATKM is monitoring the situation.
I have specifically brought this game to the attention of the Dutch ATKM to see whether it can be removed.
Ik heb deze game specifiek onder de aandacht gebracht van de Nederlandse ATKM om te bezien of deze verwijderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over Mohammed B. die een boek heeft geschreven in de gevangenis

An MP asked the State Secretary whether it is appropriate for a prison director to have a handwritten book by a detained terrorist sent by courier to ministers and MPs, and how the prison service controls the texts of detainees in terrorist wings. The State Secretary answered that privileged post may not be refused, that all correspondence of terrorist-wing detainees except privileged contacts is screened and may be refused for security reasons, and declined to comment on the individual case.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het contact dat Faissal T. mag hebben in de EBI

MP Ellian asks whether Faissal Taghi has been placed in a group with contact rights in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting, who decided it, and how the Taghi-group ban in the Ellian motion is implemented. The Secretary of State declines to discuss individual cases, describes the general placement procedure, says the directorate reviews group compositions periodically and was re-examined after the motion, and points to a confidential technical briefing for numbers.
I will not go into the situation of individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie van individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Paternotte over de aanbesteding van rechtsbijstand aan Nederlandse ter doodveroordeelden

MPs Ellian and Paternotte asked why the tender for legal aid to Dutch nationals facing the death penalty abroad was split into lots, why a English organisation could win, and whether a Dutch organisation should be required. Minister Veldkamp answered that the split aims at more expertise and redundancy, that local foreign lawyers are essential for death penalty cases, and that the Dutch-language support role lies with consular staff and Dutch-speaking subsidy partners.
Specific knowledge, experience and a network relating to that local legal area and good communication channels in the detention country were the primary considerations in this tender.
Specifieke kennis, ervaring en een netwerk met betrekking tot dat lokale rechtsgebied en een goede communicatielijn in het betreffende detentieland, hebben voorop gestaan bij deze aanbesteding.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over politieagenten die Joodse objecten of evenementen niet meer willen beveiligen

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers refuse to protect Jewish sites and events, and how this squares with a neutral police force. The minister replied that police report no known cases, that such refusal is unacceptable, that the cabinet is preparing an antisemitism strategy and funding anti-discrimination programmes, but gave no specific new oversight commitment.
Like the chief of police, I have no understanding for police officers who would not want to guard Jewish objects.
Evenals de korpschef, heb ik geen begrip voor politiemedewerkers die geen Joodse objecten zouden willen bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de nog uit te werken plannen om het capaciteitstekort in het gevangeniswezen op te lossen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the capacity shortage in prisons, including the number of self-reporters, the placement of prisoners in lower-security settings and abroad, and the alternatives considered. The State Secretary gave detailed answers, stating that the offender-level data on serious violence and sex offences are not available, that 44 prisoners have used capacity leave, and that exploratory talks with Estonia on renting cells are ongoing.
These figures are not available at the requested level, mainly because "serious" is a qualification that is insufficiently defined to be recorded in systems.
Deze cijfers zijn niet op het gevraagde niveau beschikbaar, met name omdat «ernstig» een kwalificatie betreft die onvoldoende gedefinieerd is om in systemen vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de plaatsing van criminele kopstukken zoals Piet Costa

An MP (Ellian, VVD) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the criminal leader Piet Costa was initially placed in a lightly secured regime, why he was later moved to an intensive supervision unit rather than the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting, and how placement decisions account for organised-crime risk, prison capacity and the separation of inmates. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described the placement process, improved information positions and planned capacity expansion, and said he could not disclose the exact number of D-ground applications for security reasons.
I will not go into the situations of individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op situaties van individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de overwegingen van het kabinet om Nederlandse gedetineerden naar Estland te sturen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Ellian) asked the State Secretary about the government's plan to send Dutch prisoners to Estland because of a cell shortage. The State Secretary confirmed an exploratory process, said Estonia is currently the only European country known to have surplus capacity, and promised that Parliament will be informed of the outcome before any irreversible steps are taken.
Your House will be informed of the outcome of the exploration.
Uw Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de situatie in de Oostvaarderskliniek

MP Ellian asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about repeated staff-patient relationships, the implementation of recommendations from a critical external report, supervision of the Oostvaarderskliniek and staff reporting channels. The State Secretary answered that relationships are not allowed, listed a verbeterplan with measures, said DJI and the inspectorates monitor implementation and will publish findings later, and pointed to internal and external reporting channels.
The inspectorates are currently analysing the information gathered. They will publish their findings at a later point and I will share the report with your House.
De inspecties zijn op dit moment bezig de opgehaalde informatie te analyseren. Zij zullen hun bevindingen op een later moment publiceren en ik zal het rapport met uw Kamer delen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de bezetting, capaciteit en spreiding in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting

An MP asked the State Secretary about the occupancy, capacity and spreading of detainees in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI), including whether criminal leaders and relatives can be kept apart. The government answered that separation and compartmentalisation are currently possible, that capacity will be expanded from 24 to 60 places by 2030, and that the Vught expansion is targeted for completion by end 2026.
It is currently entirely possible to compartmentalise within the EBI and to spread detainees.
Het is op dit moment goed mogelijk binnen de EBI te compartimenteren en gedetineerden te spreiden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Ellian over het voorkomen van een moordaanslag op een Iraanse dissident in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of an Iranian plot to assassinate a dissident in the Netherlands, the government's earlier denial of involvement in the Vidal-Quadra case, Iran's use of criminal networks, risks to Iranian dissidents, and listing the IRGC on the EU terror list. The minister answered that the Dutch authorities were not involved in the Spanish case, that an ongoing criminal investigation limits detail, that the government opposes foreign interference and uses a three-track approach, and that there is no EU consensus yet on listing the IRGC.
I cannot go further into the details of an ongoing criminal investigation because this could harm the ongoing investigation.
Ik kan niet verder ingaan op de details van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek omdat dit het lopende onderzoek zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over inzage in en onderzoek naar archieven met betrekking tot adopties uit Chili

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about access to and investigation of archives on adoptions from Chile, including documents now held by FIOM and whether they will be opened without restrictions. The minister said FIOM has opened dossier access, is discussing permanent archiving of non-personal material, and will review the scope of access in new adoption legislation, but declined to commission a separate investigation into the Chilean adoptions, citing an ongoing criminal investigation in Chile.
In the context of the new adoption legislation, I am examining the possibilities to make access to dossiers as unrestricted and complete as possible.
In het kader van de nieuwe adoptiewetgeving onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de inzage van dossiers zo onbeperkt en volledig mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over het artikel 'Politie beëindigt demonstratie pro-Palestijnse betogers op campus UvA’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a police-ended pro-Palestinian protest camp at the University of Amsterdam, including intimidation of Jewish students, journalists being hindered, and UvA publishing links with Israeli institutions. The Minister condemned intimidation and antisemitism, said he is in ongoing contact with universities and the local security triangle, pointed to a joint protest guideline and a forthcoming letter on safety and international cooperation criteria, and noted PersVeilig support for journalists.
Question 1: Are you aware of the article 'Police end demonstration by pro-Palestinian protesters on UvA campus'?
Vraag 1 Bent u bekend met het artikel «Politie beëindigt demonstratie pro-Palestijnse betogers op campus UvA»?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het al dan niet starten met re-integratie activiteiten door een levenslanggestrafte

An MP asked why relatives of life-sentenced prisoners cannot access the Pieter Baan Centrum report before being heard by the Adviescollege Levenslang Gestraften, and whether this makes the hearing illusory or secondarily victimising. The minister answered that no legal basis for access currently exists, that the government is examining whether one should be created, and that privacy and confidentiality interests must still be weighed.
There currently exists no legal basis for access to or copies of documents forming part of the Adviescollege levenslanggestraften's advice for victims and relatives.

Er bestaat op dit moment geen wettelijke grondslag voor inzage in of afschrift van stukken die onderdeel uitmaken van het advies van het Adviescollege levenslanggestraften voor slachtoffers en nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over Kamervragen over het artikel “Cultuursector wil veiligheidsprotocol na verstoring concert Lenny Kuhr”

MPs Martens-America and Ellian asked the State Secretary for Culture about the disruption of a Lenny Kuhr concert, the sector's call for a security protocol, and steps against antisemitism in culture. The State Secretary condemned antisemitism, agreed with the sector on a general guideline and specific protocols, and promised a letter to parliament soon, but gave no concrete security measures yet.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, arrive at a general guideline and specific protocols with a uniform directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian uitlevering door de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

An MP asks the Justice Minister about extradition requests to the UAE, the time needed for decisions, and steps taken after a motion that extradition treaties not become paper tigers. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, says extradition requests have risen since the treaty entered into force, and describes ongoing consultations with the UAE and other central authorities.
I cannot comment on individual ongoing procedures.
Over individuele lopende procedures kan ik mij niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over het bericht 'Aanpak stalking schiet vijf jaar na moord op Hümeyra nog altijd te kort'

MPs Becker and Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about stalking enforcement after the murder of Hümeyra, a femicide plan, a definition of femicide, a victim device for stalkers, the SASH risk tool, and whether serious domestic abuse could be handled via fast-track justice. The Minister answered that a femicide plan is due in April 2024, outlined a definition, reported on the victim device pilot, and rejected fast-track prosecution as unsuitable for domestic abuse cases.
I have asked the Research and Documentation Centre (WODC) to explore how we can routinely carry out such a structured analysis of cases in the Netherlands.
Ik heb het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC) gevraagd om te verkennen hoe we een dergelijke gestructureerde analyse van casussen standaard kunnen uitvoeren in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de banden tussen de Mocro Mafia en het Iraanse regime

The VVD MP Ellian asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Dutch authorities are investigating links between the Mocro Maffia and the Iranian regime, including reports on the attack on Alejo Vidal-Quadras and the proposal to list the IRGC as a terrorist organisation. The minister answered that Dutch investigators are not involved in the Spanish inquiry, do not actively pursue such links, will not comment on intelligence work, and that the government supports listing the IRGC but lacks the legal basis and EU consensus so far.

Moreover, as a general matter, should mutual legal assistance requests have been exchanged, it is not appropriate for me as Minister to provide information from an ongoing investigation in another country.

Overigens geldt hier in het algemeen dat, in een geval er over en weer rechtshulpverzoeken zouden zijn uitgegaan, het mij als Minister niet past om informatie te verstrekken uit een lopend onderzoek van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Ellian over woede over het besluit van de Hogeschool Utrecht om Holocaust-lezingen te schrappen

MPs Martens-America and Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister of Education about the Hogeschool Utrecht's reported cancellation of Holocaust lectures and about combating antisemitism in education. The Minister said the lecture series was postponed for security reasons, not cancelled, that Holocaust education is a curriculum requirement, and pointed to planned national antisemitism strategy and reporting channels.
The Utrecht University of Applied Sciences has stated that it does not let the content, form and implementation of its education be guided by interest groups or activists.
De Hogeschool Utrecht heeft aangegeven dat zij zich bij de inhoud, vorm en uitvoering van het onderwijs niet laat leiden door belangengroeperingen of activisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de rol van de deken van de Amsterdamse Orde van Advocaten bijeen kort-geding tegen een landelijk dagblad

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the Amsterdam bar dean intervened in a summary proceeding by advocate Royce de Vries against the Algemeen Dagblad, and whether this is acceptable given press freedom and source protection. The minister answered that assessing such interventions is up to the local dean and the courts, that the minister will not comment on a pending case, and declined to discuss with the bar association.
It is for the judge to assess the positions taken by a party to the proceedings, and not for me.
Het is aan de rechter om de door een procespartij ingenomen standpunten te beoordelen en niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het maken van procesafspraken met criminele kopstukken

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Public Prosecution Service made process agreements with a major drug trafficker, questioning whether such deals are appropriate, whether OFAC-listed persons should be eligible, whether a legal limit should apply, and how prison sentences and detention regimes are guaranteed. The Minister defended the agreements as effective for complex cases, said the Public Prosecution Service weighs the nature of the offence and the suspect, noted the courts retain independent review, and said a statutory framework is being prepared without committing to new limits.
The court has an independent responsibility for the outcome of the criminal case.
De rechter heeft een zelfstandige verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitkomst van de strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over corruptie bij DJI

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a DJI selection officer reportedly bribed, and about integrity complaints, investigations, sanctions and dismissals at DJI over five years, plus counts of contraband and information leaks. The minister confirmed the Rijksrecherche and DJI's Bureau Integriteit are investigating, declined substantive comment on ongoing probes, and provided yearly tables of complaints, investigations, measures, dismissals and integrity violations.
I cannot make any substantive statements about these investigations since they have not yet been concluded.
Ik kan verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over deze onderzoeken aangezien deze nog niet zijn afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Sneller over zorgen over de uitwerking van een Kamerbreed aangenomen motie voor de aanbesteding van tolkendiensten in Nederland en de grote zorgen over de toekomst va

Three MPs from SP, VVD and D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about concerns that the implementation of a House-adopted motion on tolk tenders (removing travel costs and raising the registration tariff by 15 euro) could leave court interpreters worse off. The Minister answered that the tariff increase is meant to compensate interpreters, that pay will be monitored, and that a full assessment of hourly rates will follow later.
Once service provision is fully implemented and the relevant data are available, the fees that intermediaries pay to self-employed interpreters will become transparent.
Zodra dienstverlening volledig is geïmplementeerd en de gegevens hierover beschikbaar zijn, worden de vergoedingen, die intermediairs aan zelfstandig ondernemende tolken betalen, inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over antisemitisme in Nederland

MPs Bikker and Ellian asked about rising antisemitism in the Netherlands after the Hamas attack on Israel, including Jewish pupils' safety, reporting channels and EU cooperation. The minister answered that the government is in close contact with the Jewish community, that the NCAB and police monitor the situation, and that schools are encouraged to hold dialogue, though the answers largely restate existing policy and do not give concrete numbers or new measures.
I have tried to comply with your request. However, gathering the necessary data took some time.
Ik heb getracht aan uw verzoek te voldoen. Met het verzamelen van de benodigde gegevens ging echter enige tijd gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van Nispen over inzage door geadopteerden in hun eigen adoptiedossier

MPs Ellian and Van Nispen asked why people adopted within the Netherlands still lack unhindered access to their adoption and separation files, which are held in fragmented places, and what interests could outweigh that access. The minister acknowledged the fragmentation and outlined transfers to the National Archives, noting that access rights are strong but not absolute and that private institutions fall outside government control.
An adoptee or relinquished person has the right to information about their origins.
Een afgestane of geadopteerde heeft het recht op afstammingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de risico’s en onregelmatigheden in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting

The MP asks about a SIM card found in a detainee's clothing at the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting, whether spreading of detainees in the EBI is still possible, how contact between Holleeder and Razzouki is allowed, and how unwanted communication between detainees is prevented. The minister says the SIM card was found in an incoming jacket in a non-detainee area, that spreading is currently possible, declines to discuss individual cases, and points to monitoring measures and a bill expanding powers to restrict communication.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de berichtgeving betreffende Lysander de R. die de dienst uitmaakte in de gevangenis en de motorclub MC Hardliners

An MP asked the ministers about reports that prisoner Lysander de R. enjoyed privileges and led the MC Hardliners from prison despite internal staff reports, and why he was not moved to a stricter regime or the club banned earlier. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, described general selection and transfer procedures, and said the OM has now filed for a ban on the club.
I do not go into the situation regarding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de plaatsing uit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting van een van de grootste criminele kopstukken van Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the transfer of a major criminal leader out of the Extra Secure Facility (EBI) and the risks of moving high-risk prisoners to less restrictive regimes. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the annual placement review and appeal route, and pointed to additional measures such as a bill expanding powers to restrict communications.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het re-integratie traject van Bennie S.

An MP (Ellian, VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the re-integration track of a life-sentenced prisoner, including a December 2022 letter to victims' relatives, unanswered correspondence from a relative, and how victims and relatives can be heard in the review procedure. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, acknowledged that communication with relatives needs improvement, and promised follow-up information in a progress letter in early 2024.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de detentie van Willem Holleeder en zijn ziekenhuisbezoek

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how security is arranged for a high-risk EBI detainee during hospital stays, including visits, post, and whether Willem Holleeder's EBI regime was maintained at Leiden UMC, and about his placement alongside another detainee. The minister answered in general terms, declining to discuss individual detainees or security details, while pointing to safety plans, LBB guards, a planned bill for further restrictions, and a study into temporary high-security cells.
I will not go into the situation surrounding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Ellian over het bericht 'Ambtenaar vervalste meerdere rapporten over beveiliging DigiD-aansluiting'

MPs Rahimi and Ellian asked about reports that an official at Justis falsified security audit reports for DigiD connections, including the 2020 Suwinet report. The minister answers that the official acted outside his assigned duties, four-eyes checks were introduced, digital signing and mandatory digital submission from 2024 were adopted, and a risk assessment and cause investigation are ongoing.
After the manipulation was discovered, the audit process at Justis was improved and tightened, for example by introducing the four-eyes principle.
Na de constatering van de manipulatie is bij Justis het auditproces verbeterd en aangescherpt, zo is bijvoorbeeld het vierogenprincipe ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht ‘Hells Angels zijn niet te stoppen, ze zijn het voor altijd’

An MP asks the Justice Minister how visible Hells Angels colors still circulate in public space, how enforcement and monitoring of continuation under other names work, and whether the instruments remain adequate after the Supreme Court colors ruling. The minister replies that local partners enforce and monitor, about 15 related court cases are pending, no figures on colors enforcement exist, the new instruments have not yet been used, and an evaluation is expected in spring 2024.
Exact figures on enforcement cannot be retrieved from the registration systems.
Exacte cijfers over de handhaving zijn in de registratiesystemen niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over toezicht op geprivilegieerde gesprekken in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether supervision of privileged (lawyer) communication with detainees in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting is justified, given family pressure on a lawyer-intermediary and the reach of Article 38(7) Pbw. The Minister replied that supervising the content of privileged contact is not permitted except in exceptional circumstances, and pointed to a bill allowing visual supervision and limiting detainees' legal assistants to two, without addressing the individual case.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het ontbreken van een keurmerk voor mediators

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why mediators lack a quality mark, following a news report on a divorce mediation gone wrong, and why implementation of a 2022 motion for a central mediator register is slow. The minister says the register is being developed in consultation with the field, a quality-mark option is among those explored, and he will inform parliament shortly after the summer recess.
I have taken up the implementation of that motion.
Ik heb de uitvoering van die motie ter hand genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het rapport van de ADR over eMates.

MP Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Auditdienst Rijk report on the eMates messaging service used by prisons, including why contact was sought despite a rejected motion, the limited audit depth, unlawful data processing risks, and oversight gaps. The Minister answered that DJI ended cooperation with eMates, that the audit gave sufficient insight for that decision, that data-breach and settlement questions are still under legal review, and that an in-house alternative is being studied.
Following the ADR's findings, DJI decided to permanently end its cooperation with the messaging service.
Naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van de ADR heeft DJI besloten de medewerking aan de berichtenservice definitief te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over antisemitische incidenten en bedreigingen in Limburg

An MP asked the Justice Minister about antisemitic threats against a Jewish teenager in Limburg, including why police did not record a complaint or treat the incidents as antisemitic. The minister said police acted quickly with school and family talks and expert input, that the complainant chose not to file a report for now, and that schools have statutory duties to ensure safety for all pupils.
The complainant told the police they currently see no reason to file a report, but this can always be done at a later moment.
De melder heeft bij de politie aangegeven daarom vooralsnog geen aanleiding te zien om aangifte te doen, maar dat kan altijd alsnog op een later moment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hil en Ellian over het bericht ‘Geef crisisdienst direct toegang tot hoger beveiligde bedden’

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government will give crisis services direct access to high-security psychiatric beds, how many such beds exist per province, and what it will do about shortages. The minister rejected direct access, citing the need for proper assessment and placement, reported 1737 secured beds in 2022 and pointed to a dashboard, a coordination point, regional inventories and a joint evaluation as measures.
We do not consider it desirable to give crisis services direct access to high-security care.
We vinden het niet wenselijk om crisisdiensten direct toegang te geven tot de (hoog) beveiligde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Ellian over het document ‘Bestuursrecht en verklaring omtrent het gedrag’

MPs Heerema and Ellian asked whether people with a history of sexual intimidation or abuse should be barred from coaching children, and why sport disciplinary rulings are not factored into VOG screening after the sport register was closed. The minister acknowledged the lack of data linkage, said the Ministry of Justice considers disciplinary rulings unsuitable for VOG screening because they fall outside criminal law, and said the sport register closure is under discussion toward a future integrity centre.
The Ministry of Justice and Security, responsible for VOG screening, considers it undesirable to include disciplinary rulings in VOG screening because disciplinary law falls outside criminal law.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, verantwoordelijk voor de VOG screening, acht het niet wenselijk tuchtrechtelijke uitspraken te betrekken bij de VOG screening omdat het tuchtrecht buiten het strafrecht valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over het bericht 'OM gaat ‘schokkend’ Hamas-filmpje bij De Kuip onderzoeken, CIDI doet aangifte'

MPs Ellian and Bikker asked about antisemitic chants at the Feyenoord-Ajax match and why stadium police and the club did not intervene immediately. The government condemns the chants, says the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and the club is cooperating, and promises to discuss stricter anti-discrimination measures with the KNVB.
No statements can be made about ongoing or newly initiated investigations.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over lopende of nieuw op te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de verblijfplaats van ‘Bolle Jos’

An MP from the VVD asked why a record reward was offered for information on fugitive Jos L. while he is believed to be in Turkey, whether he was briefly arrested there and released, and how Turkey could be made to arrest and extradite Dutch fugitives. The Minister of Justice explained the reward rules and the high severity of the suspicions, declined to comment on the individual case or the alleged Turkish arrest, and described the general extradition process under the European Convention on Extradition.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht ‘IS-vrouwen waren geen brave huismoeders – ze deden in wapens, explosieven en slaven, volgens het OM’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked why IS returnees, repatriated at their own request to attend their trials, are largely absent from substantive hearings, and whether Yazidi victims' rights are thereby harmed. The Minister says the victim-rights law's appearance duty is not yet in force, that courts can order attendance, that trial absence is for judges to decide, and that a new implementation date will be announced in April 2023.

In general terms, I would say it goes against my sense of justice if a suspect of terrorist offences, who deliberately travelled to ISIS territory and was then repatriated to the Netherlands by the Dutch State because they wish to be present in person at their criminal case, were then not present at the substantive hearing of the case.

In algemene zin wil ik aangeven dat het tegen mijn rechtvaardigheidsgevoel ingaat indien een verdachte van terroristische misdrijven, die bewust is uitgereisd naar ISIS-gebied en daarna door de Nederlandse Staat naar Nederland is gerepatrieerd omdat hij/zij in persoon aanwezig wil zijn bij de strafzaak, vervolgens niet bij de inhoudelijke behandeling van de strafzaak aanwezig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over kinderontvoeringen naar Polen en het negeren van een Europees Aanhoudingsbevel

An MP asked about a Dutch mother who allegedly abducted four children to Poland, Polish courts' use of Hague Convention refusal grounds, and Poland's refusal to execute a European Arrest Warrant. The government acknowledges some enforcement problems rooted in Polish national law, cites an EU Court ruling and a Commission infringement procedure, and promises a protocol on holding states accountable by summer 2023.
I cannot comment on a judicial decision of another EU member state in an individual case.
Op een rechterlijke beslissing van een andere lidstaat van de Europese Unie in een individuele zaak kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Ellian en Chris Simons over het artikel ‘Claims Conference reageert op kritiek’
