MPs Van den Hil, Ellian and Simons asked the state secretary about a Nieuw Israëlitisch Weekblad article on Claims Conference criticism, concerning declining Holocaust knowledge and support for the annual Nationale Kinderherdenking in Madurodam. The state secretary agreed the trends are worrying, said he is in talks with organisations including the Kinderherdenking and is funding a pilot, but ruled out structural subsidy for the Kinderherdenking for now.
However, I have indicated that structural subsidisation of the Nationale Kinderherdenking by the Ministry of VWS is not on the table for now.
Wel heb ik aangeven dat structurele subsidiering van de Nationale Kinderherdenking vanuit het Ministerie van VWS voor nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het vrijlaten van twee criminele kopstukken in Dubai

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why two Dutch criminal leaders were released in Dubai, whether they will be arrested and extradited quickly, and how the Netherlands will prevent the UAE from being a safe haven. The Minister declined to comment on ongoing criminal proceedings, said releases pending extradition are not unusual, and described close contact with UAE authorities and plans to deepen treaty cooperation.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings as Minister of Justice and Security.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Brekelmans over moorden in Nederland en de Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde

MPs Ellian and Brekelmans asked whether investigations into the 2015 Almere and 2017 The Hague killings of Iranian-origin Dutchmen could qualify for EU terrorist listing of the IRGC, and whether the government would act on Iranian involvement. The government said the AIVD had strong indications of Iranian involvement and expelled two embassy staff in 2018, but that criminal investigations contain no proof of Iranian involvement, so the IRGC cannot currently be listed, and it continues to press for listing where legally possible.
In public, the AIVD cannot go into the nature of these indications.
In het openbaar kan de AIVD niet ingaan op de aard van deze aanwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de communicatie tussen familieleden van en met AIT-en EBI gedetineerden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the prosecution's claim that relatives of Ridouan Taghi are part of his criminal organisation justifies restricting their communication with him, and why such contact is permitted. The minister declined to comment on individual detainees, stated that contact may be restricted when misuse is suspected, and said a bill tightening supervision under the Penitentiary Principles Act is expected in April 2023.
I will not go into the situation surrounding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het aansturen van een criminele organisatie vanuit detentie door Benaouf A.

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a criminal kingpin, Benaouf A., could direct a criminal organisation from detention and why he was not placed in the EBI high-security prison. The minister condemned the situation, said the government prioritises combating criminal conduct in detention, and pointed to a revised placement regulation and planned information-sharing and intensive-supervision measures, while declining to discuss individual cases.
I will not go into the situation surrounding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Chris Simons over de vertraging bij de realisatie van het Justitieel Complex Vlissingen

MPs Ellian and Chris Simons asked why the Justitieel Complex Vlissingen (EBI) is delayed to around eight years, whether Zeeland faces abandonment, how to provide high-security cells sooner, and whether tendering can be accelerated. Minister Weerwind answered that the delay is regrettable but the project is not cancelled, that an EBI-plus or mini-EBI is only being studied, and that EU tender rules and a switch to partly secret tendering cause the extra time.
The arrival of the JCV is absolutely not up for discussion.
De komst van het JCV staat absoluut niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ellian en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Adviescommissie stapt op omdat minister ongeschikte notarissen benoemt'

MPs Knops, Ellian and Van Nispen asked why the Minister for Legal Protection appointed candidate notaries against negative advice from the advisory committee, which resigned, and about delays and information to parliament. The minister confirmed the resignation and that he departed from negative advice in three cases in 2022, after hearing and objection procedures, and committed to clarifying the notion of personal suitability and informing parliament.
In all three cases, after inserting a comment phase with a view to the required care and legal obligation and in one case an objection phase, I concluded that appointment would be justified.

In alle drie de gevallen ben ik – na het inlassen van een zienswijzefase met het oog op de vereiste zorgvuldigheid en wettelijke verplichting en in een geval een bezwaarfase – tot de conclusie gekomen dat benoeming verantwoord zou zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rudmer Heerema over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam tussen de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) en de Koninklijke Nederlandse Lawn Tennis Bond (KNLTB)

MPs Ellian and Heerema asked the ministers about court rulings on the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and its fine on the KNLTB, including whether a European Commission letter criticising the AP's strict reading of 'legitimate interest' was withheld. The minister answered that the matter is pending before the courts and the CJEU, that the Commission letter was not shared with the cabinet and is confidential within court proceedings, and that the cabinet will not intervene in the independent AP.
Assessing which documents are necessary for resolving a dispute is for the judge, not the cabinet.
De beoordeling welke stukken voor de beslechting van een geschil noodzakelijk zijn, is aan de rechter, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Ellian en Bikker over het bericht 'Justitie Den Haag schrapt 53 zaken: Wietkwekers en drugsdealers ontlopen straf'

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Ellian and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Den Haag public prosecution service had requested inadmissibility in 53 old drug-related cases, and whether this signals impunity and why cases were left pending. The minister called it a bad signal, explained the cases were mostly confiscation and older drug cases with no direct victims, that the prosecution service had discretion, and that backlog and capacity measures are underway.
The prosecution service cannot state what the sentencing demand in the cases would have been.
Het OM kan niet aangeven wat de strafeis in de zaken zou zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over de bijeenkomst in Amsterdam waar David Icke zal spreken

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a planned Amsterdam event featuring David Icke, a known Holocaust denier, and what could be done to stop it. The Minister condemned antisemitism and Holocaust denial and urged the organisers to reconsider, noting that censorship is constitutionally barred while criminal speech can be prosecuted afterwards, and that IND was examining an entry ban.
I also support the municipality of Amsterdam in its request to the IND to investigate whether the person concerned can be denied entry to our country.
Ik steun ook de gemeente Amsterdam in de vraag aan de IND om te onderzoeken of betrokkene de toegang tot ons land kan worden geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het niet weigeren van de toegang tot de EBI aan de advocaat en neef van Ridouan T.

An MP asked why the EBI prison did not refuse access to lawyer Youssef Taghi, nephew of Ridouan Taghi, despite known criminal contacts, and why the Dean's investigation was given weight over police and prosecution information. The Minister explains access was granted after the Dean found no misuse of privileged status, that police and prosecution judged their information insufficient to justify refusal, and that family ties alone are not a legal ground to refuse.
The mere existence of a family relationship between detainee and lawyer is, under the regulations, not a ground for refusal.
Alleen het bestaan van een familierelatie tussen gedetineerde en advocaat is conform de regelgeving geen weigeringsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de mogelijk tweede open communicatielijn van Ridouan Taghi

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether Ridouan Taghi has a second open communication line that could be abused, and whether access to the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting can be denied when in doubt. The minister could not guarantee no misuse of privileged contacts, announced possible visual monitoring for a limited group in a legislative change, and explained that lawyer access can be refused only on a reasoned, fact-based decision such as a GRIP report, not on doubt alone.
For a limited group of detainees, I will, within the safeguards that apply, include the possibility of visual supervision of these conversations in the amendment of the Penitentiary Principles Act.

Voor een beperkte groep gedetineerden ga ik, binnen de waarborgen die hiervoor gelden, de mogelijkheid om visueel toezicht te houden op deze gesprekken meenemen in de wijziging van de Penitentiaire beginselenwet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht over gratieverlening aan Masmeijer

MP Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why clemency was granted to Frank Masmeijer, on what legal basis, whether advice from the prosecution and courts was obtained and what it said, and how victims and public interest were weighed. The Minister explained the Gratiewet criteria, that the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court advised positively while the OM advised negatively, that the Belgian conditional release rules were considered, and that individual clemency cases are not usually reported to Parliament, while promising partial publication of the advice.
It is not usual to inform the House about individual cases, in particular because of the protection of the privacy of the person(s) concerned.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om uw Kamer te informeren over individuele zaken, met name vanwege de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkene(n).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de mogelijkheid in het erfrecht dat de dader erft van een slachtoffer

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether a man found not criminally liable and sentenced only to TBS, who killed his wife, may inherit from her, and whether inheritance law should be tightened so perpetrators cannot benefit. The Minister acknowledged the outcome feels very unjust but declined substantive comment because the case is under appeal, explained the limited unworthiness grounds in Article 4:3 BW, and said he will await the procedure before considering broadening those grounds.
I first want to await the further procedure before examining whether it is necessary to expand the unworthiness grounds of Article 4:3 BW.
Ik wil nu eerst de verdere procedure afwachten voordat ik ga onderzoeken of het nodig is om de onwaardigheidsgronden van artikel 4:3 BW uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht 'Vrijheid voor leider Bende van Venlo lonkt na zeven moorden'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a press report that the life-sentenced Venlo gang leader could move toward release, including why a treatment placement was now allowed despite earlier negative advice and whether victims were consulted. The minister answered that the placement is for treatment on a waiting list, not a reintegration step, that the Advisory Board's negative advice was followed, and that victims were informed only when freedoms are involved.
The Advisory Board will issue another follow-up advice in P.'s case on the reintegration phase in 2023.
Het Adviescollege brengt in 2023 weer een vervolgadvies uit in de zaak P. omtrent de re-integratiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het uitblijven van de verkenning naar het gebruik maken van genealogische databanken bij het oplossen van cold case zaken

The MP Ellian asked why the promised exploration of using genealogical DNA databases to solve cold cases had not been shared with the House, and what prevents a small pilot. The Minister replies that the exploration found no technical obstacles but no clear legal basis and no evidence yet of added value in the Dutch context, and that the Public Prosecution Service will report by spring 2023.
The conclusion of my department and that of BZK, however, is that it cannot currently be well defended that there is an adequate legal basis for such an investigation.
De conclusie van mijn departement en dat van BZK is echter dat het op dit moment niet goed verdedigbaar is dat er een afdoende juridische grondslag is voor een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de detentie van Naoufal F.

MP Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection why Naoufal F., a senior figure in Ridouan Taghi's criminal network, is detained outside an intensive supervision unit, is not classed as extreme risk, and can have frequent contact with fellow inmates. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, answered in general terms on AIT placement and risk assessment, and said new rules are being prepared so that leaders of criminal networks can be placed in a stricter regime.
I will not go into the situation of individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht over de kennelijke aanstaande vrijlating van de Appie A.

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why life-sentenced prisoner Appie A. was being prepared for reintegration, whether a positive advisory opinion existed, how his dangerousness was assessed, whether he would be pardoned, and what role victims' relatives played. The minister answered that the Adviescollege Levenslanggestraften gave a positive advice on which he approved admission to the reintegration phase, that release was too early to discuss, that the pardon request was still in the advisory stage, and described the pardon criteria and victim involvement.
In the case of Appie A., on the basis of a positive advice from the ACL and the above-mentioned investigations, I decided to admit Appie A. to the reintegration phase.
In de zaak Appie A. heb ik op basis van een positief advies van het ACL en de hierboven genoemde onderzoeken besloten Appie A. toe te laten tot de re-integratiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de uitvoering van de motie ‘per direct nadere maatregelen invoeren in de EBI in Vught’

An MP (Ellian, VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a letter on implementing the motion for immediate additional measures in the Vught EBI had not been sent, when implementation would happen, and why an answer took seven weeks. The minister replied that the letter has since been sent, that a fourth placement ground (D-ground) is being added with automatic application of the motion's measures via house rules pending advice from the RSJ, and that the timing was delayed by the search for a workable approach.

Therefore the regulations will be amended with a fourth ground (the D-ground) so that placement in the EBI also becomes possible for the threat emanating from someone's role and position in a criminal network.
Daarom wordt de regelgeving aangepast met een vierde grond (de D-grond) zodat plaatsing in de EBI ook mogelijk wordt bij de dreiging die uitgaat van iemands rol en positie in een crimineel netwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked why the minister did not answer earlier questions about the dropping of 1,500 criminal cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, including a list of the cases and advance notice of such actions. The minister replied that the cases are mostly minor offences, that a detailed list would consume scarce capacity, that he would have informed parliament only when such a sweeping decision is repeated, and that all cases including those with victims are being reassessed.
For this reason I did not ask the Public Prosecution Service to draw up a detailed overview of all cases.
Om deze reden heb ik het OM niet gevraagd om een gedetailleerd overzicht van alle zaken op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht dat de Hoge Raad het colorverbod in de Algemene plaatselijke verordening (APV) onverbindend heeft verklaard

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the colour (club-patch) ban in municipal bylaws (APV) should be dropped after the Supreme Court ruled it invalid, how many municipalities had it, and how wearing banned clubs' colours is enforced. The minister confirmed the ruling, said wearing colours of banned clubs is undesirable and can be prosecuted under existing criminal and civil rules, and will ask the national expert consultation (LSO) whether existing powers suffice, with advice expected end 2022.
I will go into this further in answering question 4.
Ik ga hier nader op in bij de beantwoording van vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Van Nispen en Knops over de open communicatie vanuit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI)

MPs Ellian, Van Nispen and Knops asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that communication from the EBI high-security prison stayed open without oversight, and why authorities did not intervene despite warnings. The minister denied that unsupervised communication was possible, explained the handling of the lawyer-impersonation case and the FBI-sourced tip, and promised a letter on implementing the Ellian motion while withholding details of ongoing criminal investigations.
As is known, I can share little or no information publicly about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik zoals bekend geen tot weinig informatie (openlijk) delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over ongecontroleerd contact tijdens zittingsdagen door Ridouan Taghi

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether Ridouan Taghi could have uncontrolled contact with co-defendants on court days in the Marengo trial and what measures would prevent it, including implementing a motion on video-link hearings for EBI detainees. The Minister answered that the court is responsible for order in the courtroom, that supervision and security measures are in place, and that the WODC study on 41-bis elements is awaited, with a plan for four justice complexes and a planned amendment to the Besluit videoconferentie.
The precise content of the package of security measures cannot be specified due to security interests.
De precieze inhoud van het pakket veiligheidsmaatregelen kan vanwege veiligheidsbelangen niet worden gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht Woonadressen van advocaten duiken geregeld op in strafdossiers

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether lawyers' home addresses appearing in criminal case files, including unredacted addresses when other parties are anonymised, is acceptable and what will be done about it. The minister called this highly undesirable, said there is no reason to record such addresses or call metadata in case files, and stated that the parties, including the OM, are discussing with the bar how to prevent it.
There is no reason or necessity whatsoever to include the (shielded) private addresses of lawyers, or other confidants, in the criminal case file.
Er bestaat geen enkele reden of noodzaak om (afgeschermde) privéadressen van advocaten, of andere geheimhouders, in het strafdossier op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het ziekenhuisbezoek van een gedetineerde

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how leave decisions for detainees, including unguarded hospital visits, weigh offence type, addiction and flight risk, following a report of a detainee who fled during such a visit. The minister explained the Rtvi criteria, the director's risk assessment and possible guarding measures, but gave no commitment to change the framework.
When there is a serious suspicion that the detainee will try to evade detention, leave is refused.
Wanneer het ernstig vermoeden bestaat dat de gedetineerde zal proberen zich aan de detentie te onttrekken, wordt het verlof geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht “Nelson M. van verboden pedofielenclub Martijn met wapen en kinderporno opgepakt in Mexico’’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice Minister how suspect Nelson M. could travel abroad during a pending child-pornography case and why stricter travel restrictions were not imposed. The minister answered that the court suspended pre-trial detention without finding flight risk, outlined available travel-restriction tools, said choosing measures is for the judge, and declined to comment on the ongoing case.
Regarding an ongoing criminal case, I, as is known, make no statements.
Over een lopende strafzaak doe ik, zoals bekend, geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds vaker zelfgeprinte 3D-vuurwapens in onderwereld: ’Op korte afstand dodelijk’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the spread of 3D-printed firearms, extremist interest in them, and the lack of an explicit ban on publishing gun designs are being addressed. The Minister says police and prosecutors see a rise, that a phenomenon study and an international conference are underway, and that the Commission Wet wapens en munitie is examining a ban on distributing designs, with a final report due in October 2022.

That is why I have instructed the Commission on the Weapons and Ammunition Act to also map out the options for preventing the distribution and publication of 3D weapon designs, including banning them.

Daarom heb ik aan de door mij ingestelde Commissie Wet wapens en munitie de opdracht meegegeven om ook de mogelijkheden in kaart te brengen om het verspreiden en publiceren van ontwerpen van 3D-wapens te verhinderen, waaronder het verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de toepassing van de strafbeschikking op delicten waarop een maximumgevangenisstraf van meer dan zes jaar staat

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service imposed penal orders (strafbeschikkingen) for serious violent and sexual offences carrying more than six years' imprisonment, which the Code of Criminal Procedure does not allow, and how victims' interests are protected. The Minister says dagvaarden is the starting point, the cases are being examined through file research with results expected after summer, victims' wishes play a central role, and the Prosecution Service will be asked to ensure practice complies with the law.
After the summer I will receive the results of the file research from the Public Prosecution Service, after which I will inform the House of Representatives.
Na de zomer zal ik van het Openbaar Ministerie de resultaten van het dossieronderzoek ontvangen, waarna ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that about 1,500 criminal cases in Gelderland were dropped due to a shortage of judges, and whether similar sepots would occur in other districts. The Minister confirmed the reports, said the cases are light politierechter matters (no sex or youth cases, VPT cases screened as light), that about 90% will be seponeerd, and that similar large-scale decisions elsewhere are not expected.
The 1,500 cases concern so-called police-judge cases.
De 1.500 zaken betreffen zogenoemde politierechter zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en van der Staaij over het bericht 'Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Public Prosecution Service dropping about 1,500 cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, and its effects on victims, trust in justice, other districts and the appeal route. The minister regrets the situation, explains the capacity shortage and recruitment measures, and says victims can object to a dismissal only via article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure while cases are being reviewed.
Where victims relied on a judge making an independent ruling on the case they were involved in, this is now not happening.
Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de gijzeling in de lagere school in Bovensmilde, in 1977

Ellian (VVD) asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the 1977 Bovensmilde school hostage-taking, its surviving victims' lasting PTSD and unmet need for help, the state's past compensation and support, UWV disability assessments, and the neglected memorial. Minister Weerwind responds that he is willing to meet the victims, that support via Slachtofferhulp Nederland is available, and that he cannot assess 1977 government conduct in general, pending such a meeting.
I am happy to be willing, from the Ministry, if there is a need, to enter into conversation with the victims of this hostage-taking.
Ik ben graag bereid om vanuit het Ministerie, als daaraan behoefte bestaat, met de slachtoffers van deze gijzeling in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over een Wob-verzoek met een intimiderend karakter dat als antisemitisch wordt ervaren

MPs Ellian and Segers asked whether the government considers a Wob freedom-of-information request by The Rights Forum to Dutch universities, seeking contacts with Jewish organisations and Israel, to be intimidating and antisemitic, and whether it will tell universities and the group not to answer or to stop. The minister answered that the request is a legitimate right under the Woo, that universities must decide how to handle it under the law, that fourteen public universities have said they will not answer parts of it, and that the minister has received many reactions from the Jewish community viewing the request as antisemitic.
It is for the university's governing board to handle this request further along the lines of the law.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur van de universiteit dit verzoek langs de lijnen van de wet verder te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over een aangevallen Joods voetbalteam

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an attack on a Jewish futsal team, the Hitler salute at the incident, and the response to antisemitic incidents. The minister condemned antisemitism, pointed to ongoing criminal and KNVB investigations, and described existing reporting, expertise and prevention measures without committing to new concrete steps.
Because the case is still under investigation, I cannot comment on this specific case.
Omdat de zaak nog in onderzoek is, kan ik mij over dit specifieke geval niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over het bericht 'Geen open wetenschap over de rug van werknemers'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether universities require open access for nearly all publications, including works written outside employment, and whether this conflicts with article 25fa of the Copyright Act, which covers only short scientific works. The minister answered that open access is broader than article 25fa, that universities request but do not oblige staff, that the government sees open access as a shared responsibility and will keep consulting stakeholders, but made no concrete commitment to change the rules.
Article 25fa of the Copyright Act therefore grants creators of a short scientific work a right, not an obligation.
Artikel 25fa Aw verleent makers van een kort werk van wetenschap dus een bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski inzake het bericht ‘Ddos'er die fiscus, banken en Tweakers aanviel, krijgt 200 uur taakstraf’

MPs Rajkowski and Ellian asked about a news report on a DDoS attacker sentenced to 200 hours of community service, including whether such attacks on vital services are treated as aggravating, conviction numbers, recidivism, the Hack_Right intervention and delays in criminal cases. The Minister answered that attacks on vital infrastructure can raise the maximum sentence, gave limited conviction figures, said recidivism data are unavailable, described Hack_Right and planned funding, and declined to analyse published judgments on reasonable-time violations as too time-consuming.
Examining published judgments on rechtspraak.nl is very time-consuming and current capacity does not allow such research to be carried out.
Het onderzoeken van gepubliceerde uitspraken op rechtspraak.nl is zeer tijdrovend en de huidige capaciteit laat het momenteel niet toe een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over belangenbehartigers die betalen voor cliëntgegevens om zaken binnen te halen

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether the government will act against third parties paying for victims' personal data to win injury claims, and whether a fee ban should be considered. The minister acknowledged the practice, said existing rules and the sector's Nationaal Keurmerk Letselschade adequately protect victims, and declined to introduce a fee ban for now.
The existing rules and regulations provide sufficiently adequate protection for injury victims against dishonest practices, so a fee ban is, in my view, not currently on the agenda.

De bestaande norm- en regelgeving bieden voldoende adequaat bescherming aan slachtoffers met letselschade tegen malafide praktijken, waardoor een provisieverbod wat mij betreft nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Ondernemers sneller in problemen door uitzondering in faillissementswet’

MPs Ellian and Rahimi asked whether the WHOA out-of-court insolvency settlement scheme works in practice, and what the Supreme Court ruling that pension premiums fall under the employee exception means for restructurings. The minister reported about 200 declarations and 23 homologation decisions so far, said an evaluation is planned by end 2023, and promised to discuss the consultation results with the insolvency sector and social partners before summer and inform the House in autumn.
How often a WHOA process has led to a settlement before the court became involved is not known, because the vast majority of these processes take place in confidentiality.
Hoe vaak een WHOA-traject heeft geresulteerd in een akkoord nog voordat de rechter daarbij aan te pas kwam, is niet bekend omdat veruit de meeste van deze trajecten in beslotenheid plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht dat veel vandalen de forse schade van de coronarellen niet hoeven te vergoeden

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked whether perpetrators of damage during the 2021 COVID curfew riots are escaping paying compensation, and why enforcement differs between regions. The Minister acknowledges that offenders should pay, reports that about 55 perpetrators have compensation orders totalling roughly €551,000 with €36,700 collected so far, and says that cessation of claims to the state for the Regeling Bedrijvenschade is being examined with the OM, while noting that full recovery will not be possible in all cases.
Figures on criminal-procedure claims for damages orders are not recorded, so it cannot be shown whether there are large differences between regions.
Cijfers rondom het strafrechtelijk vorderen van de schademaatregelen worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

MPs Van der Woude and Ellian asked whether lecturers at Leiden University express pro-BDS views, whether funding of a student association promoting BDS is appropriate, and what is being done to protect Jewish students after a letter from them. The minister answered that academic freedom and a safe learning environment apply, described talks held with staff and students, noted the small funding amounts, and said the government uses the IHRA definition of antisemitism and that universities have complaint procedures.
Following the letter from Jewish students to the Executive Board, a meeting was organised between the chair of the board, the diversity officer and the students.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van Joodse studenten aan het College van Bestuur is er een gesprek georganiseerd tussen de voorzitter van het college, de diversiteitsofficier en de studenten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het feit dat advocatenkantoor Van Doorne N.V. door ITV is ingeschakeld om onderzoek te doen naar de ernstige situatie rondom de voormalig deelnemers van The Voice of Holland

MP Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about ITV hiring law firm Van Doorne to investigate abuses at The Voice of Holland, and whether victims approaching the firm, which acts for ITV, harms their legal position. The minister answered that the firm may investigate if it has the expertise, that victims should report to police, and that the WODC study on self-investigation will be awaited, with the minister promising to inform parliament.

I will inform your House after the WODC study is completed and will then consider whether, and if so which, steps should be taken regarding the current practice of companies having their own investigations carried out.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren na afronding van het WODC-onderzoek en ik zal dan bezien of en zo ja, welke stappen dienen te worden genomen met betrekking tot de huidige werkwijze waarin bedrijven zelf onderzoek laten verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht 'Moordenaar broer kroongetuige gaf tot moord Peter R. lezingen in gevangenis'

MP Ellian asked why a prisoner sentenced to up to 28 years for murder, described by the court as cold and ruthless, was allowed to give lectures to fellow inmates on resocialisation, and how selection for such activities is made. The minister regrets the impact on relatives, admits the decision-making underweighted the societal context and victim interests, explains the D&R-plan criteria (security, behaviour, victim interests), and says lessons will be used to improve future decisions.
The murder of Peter R. de Vries showed that the decision-making had insufficiently considered the societal context of the offence for which this prisoner was convicted.
De moord op Peter R. de Vries deed inzien dat bij de besluitvorming te weinig rekening was gehouden met de maatschappelijke context van het delict waarvoor deze gedetineerde is veroordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van den Hil over de weigering van gemeenten om onderzoek te doen naar roofhandel Joods vastgoed

MPs Ellian and Van den Hil asked the State Secretary about reports that 35 municipalities refuse to investigate the looting of Jewish property in WWII and whether they should be pressed to do so. The State Secretary said municipalities played no role in the centrally directed confiscations, encouraged voluntary research, and will consult the Ministry of BZK and VNG on encouraging municipalities.
I will check with the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the VNG what is possible in this regard.
Ik zal met het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) en de VNG nagaan wat daarin mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en El Yassini over het bericht dat het Albeda als eerste mbo in Nederland een studentenrechtbank krijgt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers about the Albeda college's new student court, questioning its legal basis, fair-trial safeguards, victims' reporting to police, and whether it clashes with criminal justice. The ministers answered that it is a voluntary, extrajudicial, preventive restorative process not subject to the Experimentenwet, that police are consulted on suspected crimes, and that the court is complementary and does not change reporting policy.
Parties are entirely free to choose this extrajudicial track.
Het staat partijen volledig vrij om te kiezen voor dit buitengerechtelijk traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het artikel ‘Oud-tbs’er Zouo A. vrijdag voorgeleid in Nederland voor dodelijke schietpartij’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a former tbs (forensic psychiatric) patient suspected of a fatal shooting, whether risk assessment tools and the reclassering were adequate, and whether the Inspectorate would investigate. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, defended the RISC/OXREC risk instruments and recidivism data, and said the Inspectorate is awaiting the reclassering's internal evaluation before deciding further action.
It does not befit me to go into an individual case.
Het past mij niet om op een individuele casus in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Segers en Bisschop over antisemitische incidenten en bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about antisemitic incidents and threats against Jewish students, including how trust in reporting could be restored and how police and prosecutors respond. The minister condemned the statements, said he is concerned, pointed to existing complaint channels and prosecution guidelines on discrimination, and referred to new antisemitism and anti-discrimination coordinators.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service pay considerable attention to properly addressing criminal offences with a possible discriminatory aspect.
Bij de politie en het OM is veel aandacht voor het op een correcte wijze aandacht geven aan strafbare feiten met een mogelijk discriminatoir aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het gebruik maken van particuliere genealogische DNA-databanken voor het oplossen van cold case zaken

MP Ellian asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the status of an exploration into using private genealogical DNA databases to solve cold cases, when results would be shared, and why Sweden has run a pilot while the Netherlands has not. The Minister said the exploration would conclude early 2022 with results shared in the first months of 2022, that no technical obstacles exist for a pilot, and that legal and ethical implications require a careful process before any pilot is decided.
The results will be shared with your House in the first months of 2022.
De resultaten zullen in de eerste maanden van 2022 worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het artikel 'Hoe een verkrachter opnieuw kon toeslaan alle alarmsignalen ten spijt'

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether the Inspectorate of Justice and Security will investigate a case in which a rapist under intensified supervision struck again despite warning signs, and why no further inquiry is planned. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found no reason for further investigation after questioning police and probation, that the information it received is confidential supervisory information and cannot be shared, and that no reason for a new inquiry has come to light.
That information cannot be shared. The Inspectorate of Justice and Security received this information from the police and probation service in the context of its supervisory duties.
Die informatie kan niet worden gedeeld. Deze informatie heeft de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid van de politie en de reclassering gekregen in het kader van haar taakuitoefening als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over GSM-detectie in gevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether serious criminals have too much freedom in prison and how mobile phone use by detainees can be restricted, including the status of a GSM jammer. The minister agreed phone possession should not be allowed, listed existing controls, and said the GSM jammer tender was stopped due to complexity, limited effectiveness and high cost, with DJI now researching GSM detection instead.
Strengthening the prevention of phone use remains an important part of the approach to tackling criminal conduct in detention.
Het versterken van het tegengaan van telefoongebruik is en blijft een belangrijk onderdeel van de aanpak om crimineel handelen in detentie tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over de bedreigingen aan het Joods restaurant Hacarmel

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Justice Minister about threats against the Jewish restaurant Hacarmel, which were initially registered only as insult, and whether antisemitic incidents are handled adequately. Minister Grapperhaus said both threat and insult reports were taken, outlined police and prosecutor measures on discrimination cases, and stated he sees no reason to conclude that handling is inadequate.
Because the criminal investigation in this case is still ongoing, I refrain from giving a substantive judgment on this case.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze zaak nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over "de langdurige digitale storing bij Dienst Justis”

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a multi-day digital outage at Dienst Justis that blocked VOG applications, why it was not resolved sooner and communicated late, and about reporting and prevention. The minister answered that a technical fault at the shared ICT service affected several government systems, that about 70,000 VOG applications could not be filed, that information was given via the website and letters, and that causes and preventive measures would be evaluated later.
After evaluation of the outage by SSC-ICT and by JenV, it will be considered which measures will be taken
Na evaluatie van de storing door SSC-ICT en door JenV zal bezien worden welke maatregelen worden getroffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Kathmann over internationale kinderontvoeringen

Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te vellen over de uitspraak van een onafhankelijke gerechtelijke instantie (in een ander land).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht 'Beruchte topgangster deelt lakens uit in bajes Zaanstad'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a press report that a prominent gang member inside Zaanstad prison was intimidating staff and steering criminal activity from her cell, and about prison safety and related measures. Indien het onderzoek tijdig is afgerond en het bekend maken van de onderzoeksresultaten geen negatieve invloed heeft op de orde en veiligheid in de penitentiaire inrichtingen of een lopend opsporingsonderzoek van OM en politie zal ik uw Kamer berichten over de uitkomsten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het aantal jeugdgevangenissen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ellian over het bericht inzake vertraging woningbouw door tekort aan capaciteit in rechtspraak

Minister Dekker answered that the reclassering was informed in time, that living with his mother was a justified temporary arrangement, that the reclassering's housing problem is broader and addressed via detention-reintegration plans, and that no independent investigation is warranted since the Inspectie saw no reason to investigate.

Given the information I have about the conduct of the reclassering and the other agencies involved in this case, I see no reason to characterise it as careless and to investigate the matter further (or have it investigated).

Gelet op de mij bekende informatie over het handelen van de reclassering en de andere betrokken instanties in deze casus zie ik geen aanleiding om dit als onzorgvuldig te bestempelen en de zaak nader te (laten) onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Ellian over stemmen door Nederlanders in het buitenland

Shifts funds from the rail and public transport article to the Investment Funds contribution article, covering a 40 million euro amendment for the Meppel rail hub from a surplus on the 2022 availability fee.
The necessary funds are made available via article 26 Contribution to Investment Funds for the budget of the Mobility Fund.
De benodigde middelen worden via artikel 26 «Bijdrage Investeringsfondsen» ter beschikking gesteld voor de begroting van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 24 over dekking voor middelen voor de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen

Amendment moves 6.6 million euro within the departmental budget from public transport and rail to the investment funds article, funded by expected repayments from the 2022 public transport availability payment, to finance the Ede-Wageningen transport hub.
Funding is found in the receipts from the 2022 public transport availability payment.
Dekking wordt gevonden in de ontvangsten uit de Beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV 2022.
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over alternatieve financiering onderzoeken voor de ov-verbinding Amsterdam-Haarlemmermeer
Asks the government to identify and examine alternative financing sources for the Amsterdam-Haarlemmermeer public transport link and inform the House before summer.
requests the government to identify alternative financing sources and examine alternative financing forms for this
verzoekt de regering hiervoor alternatieve financieringsbronnen in beeld te brengen en alternatieve financieringsvormen te onderzoeken
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel
Adds 40 million euro to the rail budget for the Zwolle-Meppel junction, funded from a windfall in the OV availability payment.
This amendment makes the required 40 million euro extra available to fully tackle the Zwolle-Meppel rail junction.
Dit amendement stelt de benodigde € 40 mln. extra beschikbaar om het spoorknooppunt Zwolle-Meppel goed en volledig aan te pakken.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over middelen voor de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen
Shifts 6.6 million euro within the rail budget to finish the OV-hub at Ede-Wageningen station, a budget reallocation without bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to fund completion of the OV-hub at Ede-Wageningen station.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om te voorzien in afronding van de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen.
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over in overleg treden met de provincie Overijssel over hoe het Rijk kan bijdragen aan het bespoedigen van de elektrificatie van de dieseltreinlijnen
Asks the government to consult the province of Overijssel on how the national state can help speed up electrification of diesel train lines.
requests the government to consult with the province of Overijssel to consider how the national government can contribute to speeding up electrification of these lines
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met de provincie Overijssel te treden om te bezien op welke wijze het Rijk kan bijdragen aan het bespoedigen van de elektrificatie van deze lijnen
Motie van de leden Grinwis en Vedder over de beleidsregels voor extern salderen op korte termijn zodanig verbeteren dat eventueel aanwezige dier- en fosfaatrechten niet meer los verkocht worden
Asks the government to quickly tighten rules on external netting so animal and phosphate rights can no longer be sold separately and the state buys them up.
requests the government to improve the policy rules on external netting in the short term so that any animal and phosphate rights are no longer sold separately
verzoekt de regering de beleidsregels voor extern salderen op korte termijn zodanig te verbeteren dat eventueel aanwezige dier- en fosfaatrechten niet meer los verkocht worden
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over aspecten van brede welvaart meewegen bij het afwegingskader van infrastructuurbeslissingen voor MIRT-investeringen
Asks the government to change the infrastructure decision framework for MIRT investments from 2025 so that broad-welfare aspects are weighed, beyond the cost-benefit analysis.
requests the government to adjust the decision framework for MIRT infrastructure investments from 2025 so that aspects of broad welfare are taken into account
verzoekt de regering het afwegingskader van infrastructuurbeslissingen voor MIRT-investeringen vanaf 2025 zodanig aan te passen dat aspecten van brede welvaart worden meegewogen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over in de komende periode de Lelylijn in het kernnetwerk van TEN-T opnemen
Asks the government to keep working hard to get the Lelylijn included in the core TEN-T network.
requests the government to keep making every effort to include the Lelylijn in the extended core TEN-T network
verzoekt de regering zich tot het uiterste te blijven inspannen om de Lelylijn in de komende periode op te nemen in het (uitgebreide) kernnetwerk van TEN-T
Motie van de leden De Hoop en Vedder over een plan van aanpak om de kwetsbare spoordijken aan de actuele normen te laten voldoen
Asks the government to present a plan to bring vulnerable railway embankments up to current standards and inventory the budgets needed before the 2025 budget.
requests the government to come quickly with a plan to bring the vulnerable railway embankments up to current standards
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn met een plan van aanpak te komen om de kwetsbare spoordijken aan de actuele normen te laten voldoen
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over dekking voor middelen voor de OV-hub bij station Ede-Wageningen
Covers funding for the Ede-Wageningen OV-hub by moving money within the transport budget, based on expected repayments of a transport availability fee.
Coverage is found in the receipts from the 2022 public transport availability fee.
Dekking wordt gevonden in de ontvangsten uit de Beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV 2022.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 over dekking voor middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel
Shifts 40 thousand euro within the departmental budget from rail/public transport to the investment fund contribution to cover the Mobiliteitsfonds amendment.
The required funds are made available via article 26 Contribution to Investment Funds for the budget of the Mobility Fund.
De benodigde middelen worden via artikel 26 «Bijdrage Investeringsfondsen» ter beschikking gesteld voor de begroting van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 22 over dekking voor middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel
Shifts 40 million euro within the departmental budget from rail and public transport to the investment funds article to fund the Mobility Fund.
The required funds are made available through article 26 Contribution to Investment Funds for the Mobility Fund budget.
De benodigde middelen worden via artikel 26 «Bijdrage Investeringsfondsen» ter beschikking gesteld voor de begroting van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel
Adds 40 million euro to the rail budget to fund the full rail hub upgrade at Meppel.
This amendment makes the required 40 million euro additionally available to fully tackle the Zwolle-Meppel rail hub.
Dit amendement stelt de benodigde € 40 mln. extra beschikbaar om het spoorknooppunt Zwolle-Meppel goed en volledig aan te pakken.
Amendement Grinwis c.s. over dekking voor middelen voor het spoorknooppunt bij Meppel
Increases the commitment and spending appropriations under article 26 of the departmental budget by 40 million euros to cover a Mobility Fund amendment on the Meppel rail hub.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 40,000 (x 1,000 euros).
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 40.000 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over middelen voor agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer
Amendment shifts funds in the budget to cover the shortfall in agricultural nature and landscape management payments for 2024.
From the still undistributed funds in article 51, this amendment transfers 12.6 million euros to article 22 for 2024
Vanuit de nog onverdeelde middelen op artikel 51 wordt met dit amendement voor het jaar 2024 € 12,6 miljoen overgeheveld
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over middelen voor agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer
Shifts budget within the departmental budget to fund agricultural nature and landscape management (ANLb) payments for 2024 and to keep existing management funded after 2024.
This amendment makes a start on resolving the shortfall in agricultural nature and landscape management (ANLb scheme).
Met dit amendement wordt een begin gemaakt om het tekort bij het agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer (ANLb-regeling) op te lossen.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over middelen voor agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer
Amendment shifts 12.6 million euro from undistributed budget and reallocates 7.772 million from the Versneld Natuurherstel scheme to fund agricultural nature and landscape management (ANLb) in 2024.
From the still undistributed funds in article 51, this amendment transfers 12.6 million euros for 2024 to article 22 of the budget.
Vanuit de nog onverdeelde middelen op artikel 51 wordt met dit amendement voor het jaar 2024 € 12,6 miljoen overgeheveld naar artikel 22 van de begroting.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de waardering van onderzaai als rustgewas

An MP asked why undersowing a cover crop in maize is recognised as an eco-activity under the CAP but not as a rest crop under manure rules, and whether the rules could be changed. The minister answered that the timing rules for rest crops reflect the CDM's classification, that undersowing is allowed as an alternative for the cover-crop obligation, and that the rest-crop list will be reviewed with new CDM advice, with any change possibly only from 2027.
As announced in the draft 8th Action Programme, I intend to ask the CDM for advice on an assessment framework for determining rest crops.
Zoals aangekondigd in het concept 8 e actieprogramma, ben ik voornemens de CDM advies te vragen over een afweegkader voor het vaststellen van rustgewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul, Vedder en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Geen demonstratie voor veilige kruising’

CDA MPs asked the ministers about traffic safety on the N9 near the vlotbruggen (floating bridges) in North Holland, including structural fixes, Defence-related traffic from Den Helder, and how residents are involved. The minister replied that small targeted measures were carried out in 2023/2024 at the Burgervlotbrug and Sint Maartensvlotbrug, that a review of a fixed crossing is the province's responsibility with results expected in 2027, and that no concrete further improvements are yet planned.
The previous cabinet invested roughly €4 million in traffic safety at the Sint Maartensvlotbrug and Burgervlotbrug.
Het voorgaande kabinet heeft voor ongeveer € 4 miljoen geïnvesteerd in de verkeersveiligheid in Sint Maartensvlotbrug en Burgervlotbrug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over mantelzorg- en familiewoningen bij woonwagens en op kampjes

Two CDA MPs asked whether residents of caravans (woonwagens) and kampjes can use the planned permit-free rules for mantelzorg and familiewoningen, and about housing shortages for caravan dwellers. The minister confirmed the permit-free option excludes woonwagens for ruimtelijke reasons, except for existing structures, and said the housing programmes must address caravan residents' needs.
The permit-free options for using outbuildings for housing related to mantelzorg and familiewoningen indeed do not apply to woonwagens.
De vergunningvrije mogelijkheden om bijgebouwen te gebruiken voor de huisvesting in verband met mantelzorg- en familiewoningen geldt inderdaad niet voor woonwagens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Inge van Dijk over consumentenbescherming bij erfpacht

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about a report claiming ground-lease (erfpacht) canon increases in Amsterdam are unjustified, including questions on independence of expert advice, consumer protection and a possible inquiry. The minister answered that the municipality has its own responsibility, that existing dispute routes (three-expert procedure, complaints commission, ombudsman, courts) are adequate, and that she will only informally raise consumer protection with Amsterdam.
I do not see a role for me to have a judgment on this.
Ik zie voor mij hier geen rol om hier een oordeel over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Vedder over de toepassing van module D in product-LCA’s voor milieuprestaties van bouwproducten

MPs Bontenbal and Vedder asked the housing minister whether the use of module D in product LCAs distorts building product environmental performance scores, punishing frontrunners and reducing incentives for direct decarbonisation. The minister acknowledged the criticism, announced an evaluation of module D, disagreed in part with the analysis and said adjustments would depend on that evaluation and on building costs and housing targets.
At present I am preparing an evaluation of module D. I will share its outcomes with your House.
Op dit moment bereid ik een evaluatie van module D voor. De uitkomsten daarvan zal ik met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Grinwis en Flach over de voortgang van het besluitvormingstraject rondom de natuurcompensatie Voordelta

MPs Vedder, Grinwis and Flach asked the State Secretary about the progress of the alternative nature compensation process for the Voordelta, including conditions for a proposal, EC approval, compensation funds, and impacts on the sand eel fishery. The State Secretary answered that stakeholders are working toward a broadly supported proposal, that the European Commission will test it against the 2003 compensation plan, that some correspondence with Brussels is confidential, and that about 27 million euro is available for flanking measures, though no impact estimate is yet possible.
Communication with member states from the institutions of the European Union is confidential.
Communicatie met lidstaten vanuit de instellingen van de Europese Unie is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 31 maart 2025 en dan specifiek het onderwerp 'Senioren geweigerd voor tijdelijke lening ondanks overwaarde'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked the Ministers of Finance and Housing about a Radar broadcast reporting that seniors with home equity were refused bridging mortgages. Minister Keijzer (Housing) said such refusals are undesirable, that she will consult ouderenorganisaties, banks, NVB and supervisors, and will raise bridging credit in the monitoring of the Convenant Ouderen & Toekomstbestendig Wonen.
Therefore I want to consult stakeholders to find out why seniors have difficulty obtaining a bridging mortgage.
Daarom wil ik in gesprek met stakeholders achterhalen waarom senioren moeilijk een overbruggingshypotheek kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Krul over de oplossing van natuurcompensatie voor de aanleg van de Tweede Maasvlakte en de gevolgen daarvan voor vissers in Noord-Holland

MPs Vedder and Krul asked the State Secretary about an alternative nature compensation plan for the Second Maasvlakte, its possible displacement effects on Noord-Holland fishers, the basis for a new Natura 2000 area, and compensation. The State Secretary confirmed the proposal is still under consultation with a final chance for stakeholders until mid-May, will avoid a final decision before Commission agreement, and states compensation is only possible after an irrevocable decision.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de combinatie box 3 en Wet betaalbare huur belangrijkste reden om uit te ponden

Two CDA MPs asked whether a survey of 368 property investors showing box 3 tax and the Affordable Rent Act as main reasons for selling rental homes reflects the real drivers, and whether ministries should urgently study the cumulative effects and tighten the box 3 counter-evidence rule. The minister replied that a mix of rent regulation, tax changes and a stronger owner-occupied market drives sales, promised a broader integrated assessment and a later report on middle-segment investment, and deferred the counter-evidence question to a separate state secretary letter.
We will inform the House later this year about the outcomes of this research.
Wij zullen uw Kamer later dit jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over een Nationaal Aanvalsplan Schimmelwoningen

MP Vedder (CDA) asked the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning, following a Kassa report, about a national action plan on mould in rental homes, dedicated mould teams for housing corporations, follow-up care, financing, enforcement of local agreements, and related policy. Minister Keijzer answered that existing national performance agreements, local agreements, an independent mould-expert arrangement under discussion, and the Huurcommissie instruments are the main tools, and that the government did not consider a separate national plan necessary.
No, I do not share this view. Damp and mould do not belong in a home, and I agree on the need to tackle this kind of problem.
Nee, ik deel deze opvatting niet. Vocht en schimmel horen niet in een huis en ik ben het dan ook eens met de noodzaak om dit soort problematiek aan te pakken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over de berichten 'Hypermoderne Tesla Cybertruck van rapper Kosso rijdt via omweg tóch op de Nederlandse weg' en 'Eerste legale Tesla Cybertruck in België rijdt rond: Ned

MPs Vedder and Boswijk asked whether Tesla Cybertrucks entering the Netherlands via loopholes (Albanian registration, Czech individual approval) pose road safety risks and what the government will do. The minister answered that the vehicle is registered abroad under the Vienna Convention, that the RDW has only a pending individual approval application for another Cybertruck, that enforcement tools exist but no new policy is planned, and that the government will push the European Commission to update individual approval rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW remain actively engaged in international forums where vehicle requirements affecting vehicle safety are further developed.

Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW blijven actief in gesprek in internationale gremia waar voertuigeisen, die van invloed zijn op de voertuigveiligheid, verder worden ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het verpachten van landbouwgrond door gemeenten en de eisen die daarbij worden gesteld

An MP asks whether the municipality of Teylingen's decision not to renew farm leases (ending nature-inclusive farming) and its use of price-weighted tendering for land leases should be followed by other authorities, and how to steer them toward sustainability criteria. The State Secretary says the municipality has autonomy, the Didam ruling requires objective selection criteria, he favours quality criteria like Staatsbosbeheer's 70/30 split, and he has written to the Teylingen council urging them to weigh social contributions more heavily.
I do not want to interfere in the autonomous competence of a subnational authority.
Ik wil niet treden in de autonome bevoegdheid van een medeoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de Afrikaanse varkenspest

MP Vedder (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture about the spread of African swine fever toward the Dutch border, its introduction routes, containment measures, access to affected areas, economic impact, provincial preparedness and wild boar management. Minister Wiersma answered at length that introduction risk remains small, outlined EU-based containment measures to be decided case by case, and described cooperation with provinces and EU partners, though no figures on damage were available.
Such insights are not known to me.
Dergelijke inzichten zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Grinwis over het spoortraject Emmen-Rheine

MPs Vedder and Grinwis asked whether the government will ensure the cross-border Emmen-Rheine rail link can open by December 2026, given that German trains lack Dutch approval for the last 0.5 km into Coevorden and a simplified vehicle-authorisation procedure has not yet been confirmed. The Secretary of State says the ILT, an independent regulator, decides on authorisation, that the government is facilitating talks with ILT and EU bodies, and that it will keep the House informed, but declines to intervene in the regulator's decision.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) ultimately assesses and decides whether to grant a Dutch vehicle authorisation.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) beoordeelt en besluit uiteindelijk over het al dan niet toekennen van een Nederlandse voertuigvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over verschillende vormen van woonegoïsme

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about residents who file objections or appeals against housing projects to extract buyouts, and about procedural delays in housing construction. The minister condemned appeals made purely for financial gain but said it cannot be measured, defended the right to appeal, and pointed to the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting to speed up housing-project litigation through single-instance appeal.
It is not possible to determine how many objections and appeals have been withdrawn in recent years on such suspicion.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel bezwaar- en beroepschriften de afgelopen jaren vanwege een dergelijk vermoeden zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de ondersteuning van gemeenten bij de beleidsvorming van het woonwagenbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning how many municipalities have adopted new mobile-home (woonwagen) pitch policy since 2018, why municipalities fail to meet targets, what role the national government plays, and how it will support municipalities. The minister replied that 105 of 273 responding municipalities have specific policy, that the national government supports municipalities through knowledge programmes, subsidies and monitoring, and that it will keep supporting them without binding targets.
I will continue to support municipalities in housing vulnerable groups, including mobile-home residents.
Ik zal gemeenten blijven ondersteunen bij de huisvesting van aandachtsgroepen, waaronder woonwagenbewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht «Vier maanden geen treinen tussen Goes en Vlissingen in 2029»

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about public concern over rail reliability in Zeeland, including the choice of Zeeland as the location for an ERTMS test section, communication with the province, and the impact on students. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, defended the stepwise ERTMS approach and the agreed mitigation package with the province, and committed to ongoing communication and replacement bus services, without giving a final date for the test section closure.
The exact timing of the track closure is not yet known at this moment.
Het exacte moment van de buitendienststelling is op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, De Hoop, Pierik, Postma, Stoffer en Vedder over de voortgang van de verruiming van het sluizencomplex bij Kornwerderzand

MPs asked about the delayed and costlier widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, including whether cost increases stem from tighter Rijk standards, the salinity problem, the bridges, and whether the Rijk should bear costs. The minister answered that the cost rise reflects a more realistic estimate rather than new norms, that the regional province must make a substantial contribution, and that talks with the region are being restarted, without firm commitments on financing.

In the consultation with the deputy it was indicated that if the region chooses to realise the project, IenW first expects a substantial contribution from the regional governments towards the identified cost increase.

In het overleg met de gedeputeerde is aangegeven dat als de regio ervoor kiest het project te willen realiseren, IenW eerst een substantiële bijdrage van de regionale overheden verwacht voor de geconstateerde kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over “de gevolgen van de uitzonderlijk natte weersomstandigheden voor boeren en tuinders”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture about the consequences of exceptionally wet weather for farmers and growers, covering damage, support schemes, manure rules, subsidy payments and water management. The Minister answered most questions in substance, pointing to extended manure spreading periods, flexibility in CAP eco-schemes, overmacht claims and the Brede weersverzekering, while declining to quantify damage or commit to new compensation.
The extent of the financial damage suffered by farmers is not known to me.
De omvang van de door boeren geleden financiële schade is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht “Overzicht eerste half jaar 2024” op www.hypotheekshop.nl

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about inconsistent treatment of student debt in mortgage capacity calculations after new DUO debt rules, and whether they would adopt clearer rules. The minister acknowledged the signals, said the 2025 amendment regulation will clarify how lenders calculate student loan payments (including temporary reductions), and that consultation responses will be considered.
I intend to include this point in the annual amendment regulation on mortgage credit.
Ik ben voornemens dit punt mee te nemen in de jaarlijkse wijzigingsregeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht ‘Een hypotheek voor een tiny house, Esther kreeg het voor elkaar: ‘Ik kan het nog steeds bijna niet geloven’’

CDA MPs asked the housing and finance ministers about difficulties obtaining mortgages for tiny houses and flexible homes and the resulting inequality. The minister said the government will study mortgage rules for movable homes with the Ministry of Finance, NHG and the market, and will discuss with the NVB, but defended current lender risk-based conditions and gave no data on tiny house mortgages.
There are no figures available on the owner-occupied sector.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de koopsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘Dringend advies na weer mogelijk incident met wolf: kom niet met kleine kinderen in bossen Utrechtse Heuvelrug’

MP Vedder (CDA) asks the State Secretary about wolf incidents on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, the province's advice to keep children out of the forests, and the permits for negative conditioning or culling of wolves. The State Secretary replies that the province is the competent authority for permits, that the government supports it, and that the state will explore faster permitting, a definition of problem wolves and a lower protection status, but gives no firm timeline for permits.
The provincial executive of the Province of Utrecht is the competent authority for granting or refusing permits.
De gedeputeerde staten van de Provincie Utrecht zijn bevoegd gezag voor het al dan niet verlenen van vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over Provincies die vragen om een generaal pardon voor PAS-melders

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she would pursue a general pardon (generaal pardon) for PAS-melders, farmers who notified nitrogen-permit activities, after several provinces requested it. The minister answered that a general pardon is not legally feasible in the short term according to the Landsadvocaat's advice, pointing to alternative tracks such as a broadened tailor-made approach and personal guidance, while not ruling out a pardon or comparable alternative.
I see leads for follow-up research and will commission this in the short term.
Ik zie aanknopingspunten voor vervolgonderzoek en zal dit op korte termijn in opdracht geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over “een project van 17 gangbare en biologische boeren voor zoetwateropslag dat vanwege een te laat toegekende subsidie in het water dreigt te vallen”

An MP asked why RVO took over twenty months to grant a subsidy for a 17-farmer water storage project and whether the 31 December 2024 completion deadline could be extended. The minister confirmed the delay, explained it by the crisis-regulation's structure and oversubscription, said RVO would seek tailored solutions within EU deadlines, and did not commit to a general extension.
In these cases RVO will think along as much as possible, aiming at tailored solutions for the entrepreneurs concerned.
In deze gevallen zal RVO zo veel mogelijk meedenken, gericht op maatwerkoplossingen voor de betreffende ondernemers.
Antwoord op de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Welzijn over het bericht ‘Erfpacht oneerlijk, CDA-Raadslid wil ACM dwingen naar systeem te kijken’

MPs asked whether municipalities should inform residents better about erfpacht (leasehold) formulas, whether general erfpacht conditions favour municipalities, and whether the guidance should be binding and supervised by the AFM. The minister replied that the existing guidance is voluntary and sufficient, that the ACM rightly declined an enforcement request, that erfpacht is a private-law matter, and that the AFM is not the appropriate supervisor.

Intervening in the local trade-offs, the local autonomy and contractual freedom of municipalities (within the general principles of good governance) are very far-reaching measures and I see no need for them at this time.

Ingrijpen in de lokaal te maken afwegingen, de lokale autonomie en contractvrijheid van gemeenten (uiteraard binnen de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur) zijn zeer vergaande maatregelen en ik zie daar op dit moment niet de noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 1 april jl. en artikelen inzake speculatieve grondhandel

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked ministers about speculative land trade in farmland shown on Radar, including misleading sales practices, the AFM and ACM supervisory roles, notary duties and the number of victims. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a Kadaster study of about 7,000 owners and 2,000 hectares split into investment plots, and said a working group is examining options such as a splitting ban, AFM supervision and notary obligations, with results due in autumn.
You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Grinwis en Bromet over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Vedder, Grinwis and Bromet asked whether the minister relaxed nitrogen rules for Schiphol against advice from senior officials, and why PAS-melders are treated differently. The minister denies overriding advice, says the same extern salderen policy was applied to private parties, acknowledges the Raad van State ruling now requires additionality checks, and commits to broadening the PAS-melder legalisation approach.
No, that is not the case. I want to emphasise that no exception was made when issuing the definitive nature permit for Schiphol.
Nee, dat is niet het geval. Ik wil benadrukken geen enkele uitzondering te hebben gemaakt bij afgifte van de definitieve natuurvergunning voor Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Bromet, Vedder en Holman over het rondetafelgesprek Wolf van 4 april 2024

MPs from four parties asked the ministers about LIFE and Regional Development Fund subsidy options for wolf coexistence measures raised at a round-table meeting, and whether these had been examined. The minister replied that LIFE and EFRO funding are possible in principle but no concrete study was done, provinces are responsible, and she will raise the options with the provinces and set up a long-term coexistence vision.
I will bring these options to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zaldeze mogelijkheden onder de aandacht brengen bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister.
