The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het intrekken van de subsidie voor een innovatief en kansrijk plan voor een paneerkaasmakerij in de provincie Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why a subsidy for a Utrecht cheese-making project was withdrawn after applicants self-reported a minor error, and whether the 'kennelijke fout' rule could help them. The minister answered that the rule does not apply, that the GLB policy rule has no retroactive effect, and that the province had to refuse subsidy because the activity started before the application, offering only a new application round.
In the present case there is no question of an obvious error.
In de voorliggende casus is geen sprake van een kennelijke fout
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Krul over dat in New Towns als Almere “het sociale cement het stenen cement nauwelijks kan bijbenen”

CDA MPs asked the government to respond to a report on social resilience in Almere and to reflect on how New Town problems such as debt, loneliness, teacher shortages and youth crime relate to rapid growth and national financing, and what action is needed. The minister replied that the report was commissioned by Almere and that the government points to existing programmes (NPLV, GALA, IZA, regional deals) and will await a broader WijkWijzer study before reflecting further.
For a reflection on the problems in the New Towns, the results of that study will be awaited.
Voor een reflectie op de problematiek in de New Towns, worden de resultaten van dat onderzoek afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de gebiedsbijdrage uit de oliewinning in Schoonebeek

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the central government would not contribute directly from its budget to the Schoonebeek area contribution from oil extraction, and why the amount fell short of earlier estimates. The State Secretary answered that the contribution, about 40 million euro, is channelled via state company EBN and NAM, that a direct budget contribution lacks a legal basis for now, and that talks with the province continue.
I have agreed that I will talk again with NAM about the level and form of the financial contribution.
Ik heb afgesproken dat ik nog eens met NAM in gesprek ga over de hoogte en de vorm van de financiële bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de Kamerbrief ‘voortgang emissiereductie veehouderij’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, about shortcomings of emission-reducing livestock barn systems, liability for farmers' investments, how to obtain nature permits for innovative barns, the status of the appropriate-assessment handbook, monitoring, timelines for a regieorgaan and pilots, and subsidies. The Minister answers at length, explaining the revamped barn-assessment programme, interim permit routes, and timelines of roughly three years, and generally gives substantive but often non-committal responses, while declining to settle liability questions definitively.
The research on securing the use of low-emission barn systems for permits with a Natura 2000 activity will be completed shortly.
Het onderzoek over de borging van het gebruik van emissiearme stalsystemen voor vergunningen met een Natura 2000-activiteit wordt binnenkort afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht 'Brug Maastricht dreigt in te storten na aanvaring losgeslagen woonboot'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Rijkswaterstaat handled the damaged Borgharen weir, the overflow dam and the Stuwweg before the Maastricht bridge and houseboat incident, and what it will do now. The minister replied that the overflow dam was inspected and repaired in 2021, that the risks were assessed as very small, that the November 2023 communication was adequate, and that repairs are planned before the 2024 high-water season.
Rijkswaterstaat has commissioned Deltares to investigate how the overflow dam could collapse suddenly. The results are expected in May 2024.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft opdracht gegeven aan Deltares om te onderzoeken hoe de overlaatdam acuut heeft kunnen bezwijken. De resultaten hiervan worden in mei 2024 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht 'Rendement particuliere verhuurders onder druk'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked about a study showing that the net return for private landlords falls sharply due to rising interest rates, the Wet betaalbare huur and tax measures, and whether this threatens rental supply. Minister De Jonge answered that the dataset is not representative, that the bill keeps investment in middle-rent attractive, and that the WWS will be made binding with stronger enforcement against overpriced rentals.
I will send the Wet betaalbare huur bill to your House shortly, so that it can take effect on 1 July 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur zal ik op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen, zodat de inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2024 kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Vedder en Grinwis over het sluiten van de nautische verkeerspost Ouddorp en het niet langer inzetten van vuurtorenwachters op vuurtoren Westhoofd

Three MPs (SGP, CDA, ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the nautical traffic post at Ouddorp and the Westhoofd lighthouse watch were closed, raising safety concerns for the Slijkgat channel. The Minister answered that the area is not a VTS zone, that replacing the radar and systems was too costly, that information remains available through other public channels, and that the Slijkgat depth commitments continue, but gave no commitment to restore the post.
Discussions are ongoing with parties about users' information needs and how these can be better served.
Er wordt verder overlegd met partijen over de informatiebehoefte van de gebruikers en hoe daar nog beter in kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘GLB-premie fors omlaag: voorlopig bedrag basispremie €150’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture why the budget for the CAP basic income support and eco-scheme was miscalculated, causing lower-than-announced provisional premiums, and what will be done for farmers. The minister acknowledges higher-than-expected participation, says the estimate was too low, states the definitive rates will be set in spring 2024 and that she is exploring ways to limit the reduction, but gives no guarantees.
It is not yet possible to make a more precise estimate of the shortfall, because the definitive picture still has to be determined.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om een nadere inschatting te maken van het tekort, omdat het definitieve beeld nog bepaald moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwacht megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs Inge van Dijk, Vedder and Van der Plas asked whether farmers who joined the set-aside scheme and planted fast-growing forest were wrongly denied the agricultural exemption and faced tax assessments after decades. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the Tax Authority's position is consistent, that no assurances were given about the agricultural exemption, and that the pending Supreme Court ruling will be awaited.
As with our answers of 5 September 2023 to the previous questions from your House on this subject, we note at the outset that the case is still before the courts.
Net als bij onze antwoorden van 5 september 2023 op de vorige vragen van uw Kamer over dit onderwerp stellen wij voorop dat de zaak nog onder de rechter is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht 'Wolven in Europa: Commissie roept lokale overheden op om bestaande uitzonderingen ten volle te gebruiken

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the European Commission's call to use existing derogations for wolves, the legal basis for deviations under the Habitats Directive, the data sent to the Commission, and the wolf's protected status. The minister answered that provinces are competent to grant derogations, no derogations for wolves have been granted, data was shared with the Commission, and the Netherlands will not prejudge the upcoming EU analysis or the Raad voor de Dierenaangelegenheden advice.
I do not want to prejudge this advice and the outcomes of the European Commission's analysis in my position and attitude towards the wolf.
Ik wil in mijn standpunt en houding jegens de wolf niet vooruitlopen op dit advies en de uitkomsten van de analyse van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘In november geen schoolfruit meer’

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that school fruit deliveries would stop in November because the per-portion subsidy was too low, and whether calculation errors by Wageningen Economic Research had caused this. The minister acknowledged calculation errors, raised the unit price from 18 to 20 cents for 2023/2024, and said any shortfall would be covered from the ministry's budget.
Following questions from market parties, it appeared that calculation errors were made in this study.
Naar aanleiding van vragen van marktpartijen is gebleken dat er in dit onderzoek berekeningsfouten zijn gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de uitzending van EenVandaag (d.d. 4 sept 2023) 'Fors financieel tekort dwingt NVWA tot bezuinigingen en personeelsstop, Kamerleden bezorgd: Wat betekent dit voor al die belangr

An MP asks the minister about reports that the NVWA food safety authority faces a financial shortfall, prompting spending cuts and a hiring freeze, and what this means for its duties and staff. The minister confirms a projected negative 2023 result due to inflation, new pay agreements and lower fee income, and says mitigation measures will close the gap without reducing supervision quality.
The financial situation of the NVWA is not a secret.
De financiële situatie van de NVWA is geen geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk en het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘Voor boer Piet dreigt halvering van de veestapel, want er stroomt een beek door zijn weilanden’

MPs Boswijk and Vedder asked about wide buffer strips along streams (100-250 m) under the 7th Nitrates Action Programme, their evidence base, effects on farmland, compensation costs, and unequal treatment of agriculture versus recreation under nature and nitrogen rules. The minister answered that broad stream-valley restoration is a regional, model-based measure within provincial programmes, funded from a 811 million euro transition fund, and that nature permitting applies equally across sectors.
Question 10: Is it true that, unlike the agricultural sector, the recreation sector in the Netherlands experiences little or no hindrance from nature and nitrogen policy?
Vraag 10 Klopt het dat in tegenstelling tot de agrarische sector de recreatiesector in Nederland geen of nauwelijks hinder ondervindt van het natuur- en stikstofbeleid?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Valstar, Bisschop en Grinwis ten aanzien van de garnalenvissers die per 1 oktober een nieuwe vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig hebben

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie, SGP and VVD asked about the shrimp fishing fleet needing new Wet natuurbescherming permits from 1 October, including catalyst subsidy uptake, the code of conduct, the nitrogen assessment model and a possible extension of the tolerance period. The minister answered that installation numbers are unknown, that a tolerance extension to permit issuance is planned, that a 15-month extension to 2025 is refused, and that talks with the sector on the model and permits are ongoing.
I intend to extend the existing tolerance period until the permit is issued and, within those permits, to give all permit applicants nitrogen space up to a specific date to be fixed.

Ik ben voornemens de bestaande gedoogperiode te verlengen tot de vergunning is afgegeven en binnen die vergunningen alle vergunningaanvragers tot een specifiek vast te leggen datum de stikstofruimte te bieden
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van der Plas en Vedder over de wolvenaanval op een hobbyboer in Wapse

MPs Van der Plas and Vedder asked the minister about a wolf attack on a hobby farmer in Wapse, the adequacy of information sharing with provinces, and whether the protected status of the wolf should be revised at EU level. The minister expressed regret, said the government would wait for the RDA advice and the EU analysis before taking a position, and noted that the attack is under criminal investigation.
It is not for me to judge while the investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet aan mij om erover te oordelen zolang het onderzoek loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Vedder over ‘Geen hulp van het Rijk voor ruim 250 boeren zonder stikstofvergunning'

MPs Boswijk and Vedder (CDA) asked the minister why 259 PAS-notifying farms cannot be legalised by the national government, why only part of the 2,488 applications have been assessed, what the legalisation criteria are, and how the government will restore trust after earlier promises. The minister replied that the competent authorities found 259 notifications failing the criteria, that these farms may still obtain permits by buying nitrogen space or reducing emissions, that the remaining dossiers should be assessed by year-end, and that the government considers it is keeping its commitments.
The provinces are asked to examine which solution routes exist for the 259 companies that cannot obtain a solution through the legalisation programme.
Aan de provincies wordt gevraagd om te bezien welke oplossingsrichtingen er zijn voor de 259 bedrijven die via het legalisatieprogramma niet een oplossing kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Van Campen over het bericht 'Uitspraak gebruik pesticiden bij lelieteelt slaat in als een bom'

MPs Vedder and Van Campen asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling restricting pesticide use at a lily farm near residents in Dwingeloo, and whether it undermines the Ctgb's authority. The minister answered that the appeal court overturned the injunction, that the precautionary principle leaves room for case-by-case restrictions, that the Ctgb remains a reputable authority, and that a brochure on good neighbourliness was sent to the House.

m: Amendement van het lid Vietsch c.s. over effectievere parlementaire betrokkenheid bij de delegatiebepaling van artikel 2 Woningwet
Requires that draft general administrative orders under the Housing Act be submitted to both chambers at least four weeks before they are adopted, giving parliament early involvement.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under the first paragraph shall not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het eerste lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Vietsch en Boelhouwer ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het door de architect geven van informatie over zijn relevante deskundigheid en vakbekwaamheid
Adds the word 'relevante' so architects must state only relevant expertise and competence in a quotation under the Architects' Title Act.
who asks him for a quotation about his relevant expertise and professional competence
die hem een offerte vraagt over zijn relevante deskundigheid en vakbekwaamheid
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Vietsch ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het invoegen in de wet van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds a provision requiring the minister to report to the States General within seven years on the effectiveness of the practical-experience rules.
sends to the States General within seven years of the entry into force of article I, part M, a report on the effectiveness and effects
zendt binnen zeven jaar na de inwerkingtreding van artikel I, onderdeel M, van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten
Amendement van het lid Vietsch ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het schrappen van de verplichting van de architect om een oprdrachtgever te informeren over zijn rechten en plichten jegens een derde die
Replaces an earlier amendment by deleting the architect's duty to inform the client about obligations toward a third-party designer of the work.
as well as about his rights and obligations towards a third party, where that third party designed the work
alsmede over diens rechten en plichten jegens een derde, ingeval die derde het werk heeft ontworpen

Amendement van de leden Vietsch en Boelhouwer over het schrappen van de verplichting van de architect om een oprdrachtgever te informeren over zijn rechten en plichten jegens een derde die het werk he
Removes the architect's duty to inform the client about rights and duties toward a third party who designed the work, under the Architect Title Act.
the phrase concerning the client's rights and duties toward a third party who designed the work is deleted
vervalt de zinsnede «, alsmede over diens rechten en plichten jegens een derde, ingeval die derde het werk heeft ontworpen
Amendement van het lid Vietsch betreffende het schrappen van de vermelding door de architect van zijn beroepsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering
Deletes the requirement for architects to state in their title-related communications that they hold professional liability insurance.
in article 27aa the words on coverage of work by professional liability insurance are deleted
vervalt in artikel 27aa «de dekking van de door hem te verrichten werkzaamheden door een beroepsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering,»
Amendement van de leden Vietsch en Boelhouwer over het door de architect slechts desgevraagd informatie geven over zijn relevante deskundigheid en vakbekwaamheid
Limits the architect's duty to inform clients about expertise to cases where the client asks, and to relevant expertise only.
informs upon request the person requesting a quote about his relevant expertise
informeert desgevraagd de persoon die hem een offerte vraagt over zijn relevante deskundigheid
Amendement van het lid Vietsch over het invoegen in de wet van een evaluatiebepaling
Amendment requiring the minister to report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness of the architect title experience period, with a possible bill to remove it.
within five years after entry into force sends the States General a report on effectiveness
zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van artikel I, onderdeel M, van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag
Amendement van het lid Poppe c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 om stijging van afvalstoffenheffing als gevolg van bestrijding van zwerfvuil te voorkomen
Deletes article I, part J of the waste-management bill, which would have shifted litter-clearing costs into the waste levy.
qa: Vragen van de leden Vietsch, Ten Hoopen en Van Bochove (allen CDA) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Wet kraken en leegstand (ingezon

CDA MPs asked ministers whether Utrecht's refusal to enforce the new squatting ban and the Public Prosecution Service's reluctance to prosecute squatters were acceptable, and how enforcement would be ensured. The minister replied that prosecution is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service under the opportunity principle and available capacity, that enforcement will proceed from 1 October with priority given to cases involving owner obstruction, nuisance or damage, and that there is no reason to think the ban will not be enforced.

m: Motie van de leden Blaauw en Wilders over geen deelname van mannen aan competities in de vrouwensport
Asks the government to ensure men may no longer take part in women's competitions in women's sport.
requests the government to ensure that men may no longer participate in women's competitions in women's sport
verzoekt de regering om ervoor te zorgen dat mannen niet meer mogen deelnemen aan vrouwencompetities in de vrouwensport
Motie van de leden Blaauw en Inge van Dijk over de regeldruk op het gebied van sport- en beweegbeleid verminderen
Asks the government to investigate how regulatory burden in sport and exercise policy can be reduced together with local authorities.
requests the government to investigate how, in cooperation with local authorities, the regulatory burden in sport and exercise policy can be reduced
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe in samenwerking met lokale overheden de regeldruk op het gebied van sport- en beweegbeleid verminderd kan worden
Amendement van het lid Paulusma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over 200.000 euro voor het herinneringscentrum Kamp Westerbork
Moves 200,000 euro within the culture budget (article 7, war victims and remembrance) to fund the Kamp Westerbork memorial centre for 2025.
This amendment provides a contribution of 200,000 euro for 2025.
Dit amendement regelt een bijdrage van 200.000 euro voor 2025.
Amendement van het lid Paulusma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over 200.000 euro voor het herinneringscentrum Kamp Westerbork
Moves 200,000 euro within the budget to the Westerbork memorial centre for 2025 to fund Holocaust education and its ambition to become an international heritage centre.
This amendment provides a contribution of 200,000 euro for 2025.
Dit amendement regelt een bijdrage van 200.000 euro voor 2025.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Wilders en Blaauw over de benoeming van de ambassadeurs van de vrijheid door het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

MPs Boon, Wilders and Blaauw asked whether the National Committee 4 and 5 May's choice of Freedom Ambassadors, including a performer alleged to have joined an antisemitic fundraiser, was acceptable and whether the government would intervene. The State Secretary answered that the Committee is independent, that the selection process was careful, and that the government respects its choices and will not intervene.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is independent and independently determines how the National Commemoration on 4 May and Liberation Day on 5 May are shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelfstandig hoe de Nationale Herdenking op 4 mei en Bevrijdingsdag op 5 mei worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Blaauw over het Project Nieuwbouw RIVM

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the WHO requirements behind the RIVM new-build delays, the influence of the WHO, consequences of non-compliance, whether the state can avoid paying 40.6 million euro to MEET Strukton, and how often the WHO sets similar requirements. The minister explained that the GAP poliovirus biosafety rules are needed for RIVM's accreditation as a polio reference laboratory, that the WHO has no direct influence on the project, that the dispute was settled by a settlement agreement so payment cannot be avoided, and that WHO guidance is generally not binding on building projects.
The dispute has thus been definitively settled.
Het geschil is daarmee definitief afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Blaauw over het bericht ''Supporters Vitesse onwel en afgevoerd naar ziekenhuis met hartritmestoornissen na derby de Graafschap''

An MP asked why illegal fireworks entered the stadium, why alarm was not raised during the match, whether the regional safety authority's escalation to GRIP-1 was a security concern, and whether costs would be recovered from those responsible. The minister answered that the club searches selectively, two EHBO cases were handled without escalation, a new plan on fireworks in football is in preparation, and escalation costs are publicly financed and not recovered.
The Regiegroep Voetbal en Veiligheid is currently working on a new action plan on fireworks in football as part of implementing reinforcement plan 2.
Momenteel werkt de Regiegroep Voetbal en Veiligheid – als onderdeel van de uitvoering van het versterkingsplan 2 – aan een nieuw plan van aanpak Vuurwerk in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Blaauw over antisemitische bezetting en veiligheid op de Gerrit Rietveld Academie

MPs Boon and Blaauw asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a months-long standoff between the Gerrit Rietveld Academie board and pro-Palestinian students, including a sit-in, antisemitic banners and a letter of concern from staff and alumni. The minister replied that the institution is responsible for safety, that the board tolerated the occupation under conditions, that banners have been removed and a complaint filed, and that existing antisemitism-related safety measures will continue.
I asked the Gerrit Rietveld Academie whether they could share with me the letter you refer to.
Ik heb de Gerrit Rietveld Academie benaderd met de vraag of zij de brief waar u aan refereert zouden kunnen delen met mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Blaauw en Boon over het bericht ‘Woede over besluit Hogeschool Utrecht om Holocaust-lezingen te schrappen’

MPs Blaauw and Boon asked the minister whether the Hogeschool Utrecht's cancellation of Holocaust lectures sends the wrong signal and what the government will do to ensure the lecture series goes ahead. The minister said Holocaust education is important, that the first lecture has already taken place after a postponement for safety reasons, and that how the lectures are made publicly available is for the organisers to decide.
This concerns a lecture series organised by the Hogeschool Utrecht in cooperation with CIDI.
Het betreft hier een lezingenreeks die is georganiseerd door de Hogeschool Utrecht in samenwerking met het CIDI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Blaauw en Faber-van de Klashorst over het bericht ‘Ramen Universiteitsbibliotheek vernield en beklad met pro-Palestinaleuzen’

PVV MPs Blaauw and Faber-van de Klashorst asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether he would condemn the vandalism and pro-Palestinian slogans at the Groningen university library and engage the university board. The minister condemned the vandalism as a crime, noted the university has already filed a police report and issued a statement, and said he sees no reason for a separate meeting with the board, while promising ongoing talks with the sector.
I currently see no reason to enter into talks with the Executive Board of the RUG about these events.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding om samen met het College van Bestuur van de RUG in gesprek te gaan over deze gebeurtenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het besluit van de voorzieningenrechter dat een zwembad in Hilversum voorlopig geen coronatoegangsbewijs hoeft te controleren voor zwemles

An MP asked the health and justice ministers whether the rules requiring parents to show a COVID pass at swimming pools should change after a court ruled that swimming lessons are not sport and a pool need not check passes for them. The minister answered that the CTB requirement for sports venues was lifted on 25 February, that swimming lessons remain sports-regime activities, and that the court ruling did not change the obligation, so no rule change was made.
I therefore saw no reason to give parents the option to enter swimming pools without a CTB, since the safety of other parents, staff and swimmers present is paramount.
Ik zag daarom geen aanleiding om ouders de mogelijkheid te geven om zonder CTB zwembaden te betreden, de veiligheid van de daar aanwezige andere ouders, personeel en zwemmers staat immers voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Kuik over het artikel 'In veel branches wordt werk geruild voor seks'

Two CDA MPs asked whether trading work for sex in various industries, reported by AD, falls under prostitution rules, whether it amounts to exploitation of vulnerable people, and what measures, reporting options and advertisement restrictions exist. The State Secretary answered that exchanging services for sex is not prostitution, is not prohibited but is condemned when it involves abuse, pointed to a pending bill on sexual offences, reporting options and branch self-regulation, and promised to draw branches' attention to the law.

The cabinet will ensure that the bill now with the Council of State, which makes it punishable to know or ought to know that the other person does not want sexual contact, is explicitly brought to the attention of the branches.

Het kabinet zal ervoor zorgen dat het wetsvoorstel dat bij de Raad van State ligt, waarmee geregeld wordt dat je strafbaar bent als je weet of had moeten weten dat de ander geen seksueel contact wil, uitdrukkelijk onder de aandacht wordt gebracht bij de branches.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het artikel 'Een rol bij de lijkschouw'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked whether task reallocation could let PAs and nurse specialists perform death inspections, easing shortages of elderly-care physicians and municipal inspectors. The minister replies that a careful study starting spring 2022 will assess whether such task shifting adds value, with results shared with the House around summer, and that temporary emergency solutions for municipal inspections are being discussed.
In spring 2022 the study will start, and around the summer the results will be shared with your House.
Voorjaar 2022 wordt gestart met het onderzoek en rond de zomer zullen de resultaten hiervan met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over digitale veiligheid

MP Leijten (SP) asked the government about the European and Dutch digital identity schemes, data storage and blockchain use, lobbying, ethics, cyber vulnerabilities and dependence on single providers. The state secretary answered at length, defending the planned EU framework and Dutch rules against data commercialisation, but gave largely general replies and deferred some matters to other bodies or future policy.
I agree with the experts that citizens' personal data are not a tradeable commodity and that providers' business models may not be based on it.
Ik ben het met de experts eens dat persoonsgegevens van burgers geen handelswaar zijn en dat verdienmodellen van aanbieders daarop ook niet gebaseerd mogen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over nijpende tekorten aan forensische artsen

An SP MP asks the health and justice ministers about acute shortages of forensic doctors, including reliance on temporary contractors, retirements, pay, and whether the EUR 20 million per year needed should be decided now or left to a new cabinet. The government acknowledges the acute and long-standing shortage, describes recruitment, training and reorganisation measures, and says the funding decision is for the new cabinet.
It is up to the cabinet to take a definitive decision on this, including securing the necessary funding.
Het is aan het kabinet om hierover een definitief besluit te nemen, waaronder ook het borgen van de benodigde dekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het artikel 'Juridische fuik overheid maakt burgers 'kansloos''

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the government about press reports that strict Awb deadlines leave citizens powerless when they file late objections, and about the 'bestuurlijke lus' and the citizen's ability to navigate the law. The minister says the Awb will be revised, citing a 2021 change in case law softening late-objection rules, and promises to examine a 'burgerlijke lus' and to consider more lenient handling of deadlines in two-party disputes.
In this context it is being examined whether to give administrative bodies more room to substantively handle an objection that was not filed within six weeks.
Hierbij wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheid om meer ruimte te bieden voor bestuursorganen om een niet binnen zes weken ingediend bezwaar alsnog inhoudelijk te kunnen behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de resultaten van de pilot vergoeding eigen risico zorgverzekering voor slachtoffers van seksueel geweld

An MP asked whether the government would scrap the health insurance deductible for sexual violence victims seeking help, after a pilot study found victims experience compensation as recognition and the seven-day cutoff is questioned. The minister answered that a policy response will follow in spring 2022 after consultation with stakeholders, explained the seven-day rationale (acute care and evidence collection), and pointed to a campaign and a new study on barriers to help-seeking.
A substantive policy response on the follow-up will be sent to the House of Representatives in spring 2022.
Een inhoudelijke beleidsreactie ten aanzien van het vervolg wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 naar de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de Amsterdamse taxichauffeurs betrokken was bij strafzaken in de afgelopen drie jaar

MPs Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to a report that over half of Amsterdam taxi drivers were involved in criminal cases in three years, including whether this occurs elsewhere, how drivers are made resilient, how supervision works, and whether large taxi platforms should be restricted. The minister answered that the report is noted, that a joint integral approach with multiple agencies is being explored, that licensing and VOG screening are in place, and that platform rules will be reviewed in the periodic taxi law evaluation due in 2023.

Together with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, the municipality of Amsterdam, the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport, the Public Prosecution Service, the police, the Regional Information and Expertise Centres and the Tax Authority, measures that could be taken in response to the Bureau Beke study are being explored.

Met het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, de gemeente Amsterdam, de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie, de Regionale Informatie en Expertise Centra en de Belastingdienst wordt naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Bureau Beke verkend welke maatregelen er kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geweld tegen anti-Zwarte Piet demonstranten in Volendam

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked why the cabinet did not condemn violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Volendam, whether perpetrators should be prosecuted, and how the mayor and local triangle handled the unannounced demonstration. The minister condemned the violence and the attempt to block the constitutional right to demonstrate, but said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that assessing the mayor's and local triangle's conduct is for the mayor, who answers to the municipal council.
Facilitating and properly managing demonstrations is the responsibility of the mayor, who is accountable to the municipal council.
Het faciliteren en in goede banen leiden van demonstraties is aan de burgemeester, die daarover verantwoording aflegt aan de gemeenteraad.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de vragen 'Litouwen adviseert consument geen Xiaomi-telefoons meer te kopen'

MPs Rajkowski asked the ministers about Chinese censorship software on Xiaomi phones, state use of such devices, and whether oversight could detect it. The government answered that Lithuanian and German investigations found the functionality disabled in the EU, pledged to consider amending the Telecommunications Act, and declined an additional independent investigation.

As long as the e-privacy regulation is not yet in force, a complicating factor is that article 11.2a of the Telecommunications Act, which transposes article 5 of the e-privacy directive, is directed only at providers of public electronic communication networks and services and not at third parties such as the phone supplier.

Zolang de e-privacyverordening nog niet van kracht is, is een complicerende factor dat artikel 11.2a van de Telecommunicatiewet waarin artikel 5 van de e-privacyrichtlijn is omgezet, zich alleen richt tot aanbieders van openbare elektronische communicatienetwerken en diensten en dus niet tot derden zoals de leverancier van de telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

MPs Van der Woude and Ellian asked whether lecturers at Leiden University express pro-BDS views, whether funding of a student association promoting BDS is appropriate, and what is being done to protect Jewish students after a letter from them. The minister answered that academic freedom and a safe learning environment apply, described talks held with staff and students, noted the small funding amounts, and said the government uses the IHRA definition of antisemitism and that universities have complaint procedures.
Following the letter from Jewish students to the Executive Board, a meeting was organised between the chair of the board, the diversity officer and the students.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van Joodse studenten aan het College van Bestuur is er een gesprek georganiseerd tussen de voorzitter van het college, de diversiteitsofficier en de studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en van Nispen over de “te slappe” aanpak van geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Kathmann and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecution service's handling of violence against care workers, including out-of-court OM penalty orders, undermines victims' sense of being taken seriously and their right to be heard. The Minister answered that OM penalty orders are a full legal equivalent of a court judgment, that the OM considers victims' interests and their right to be heard, and that victims can challenge a penalty order via a complaint to the appeals court under article 12 Sv.
The OM supports the victim as well as possible in obtaining compensation for their material and immaterial damage.
Het OM ondersteunt het slachtoffer zo goed als mogelijk bij het verkrijgen van een vergoeding van zijn materiële en immateriële schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemen geweld tegen ambulancepersoneel

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether penalties for violence against ambulance staff should be increased through administrative fines, loss of municipal privileges, eviction or benefit cuts, and why reported violence seems to have doubled and reporting appears to be declining. The minister rejected extra sanctions, pointing to the existing prosecution policy of tripling the sentence demand and the pending bill on banning community service, and said the rise in incidents is modest rather than doubled while the Taskforce and reporting measures address reporting barriers.
At present I see no need to tackle violence against care workers in any other way.
Op dit moment zie ik geen noodzaak om geweld tegen hulpverleners op andere wijze aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat veel ondernemers zich laten uitbetalen voor hun werkzaamheden door middel van ruilprostitutie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that many entrepreneurs in several sectors offer services in exchange for sex, and about the lack of measures, the number of complaints, sex-for-favours websites, and a possible ban. The government answered that such misuse of vulnerable people is reprehensible, that exchange of sex between consenting adults is not prohibited, and that it will raise awareness and rely on branch responsibility and a pending bill on sexual offences.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service have no insight into the phenomenon of exchanging sex for favours.
Er is bij de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geen zicht op het fenomeen ruilseks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Palland over het misbruik van militaire uniformen bij de coronademonstratie in Amsterdam van 2 januari jl.

CDA MPs asked whether soldiers and veterans in uniform at a 2 January 2022 Amsterdam COVID demonstration, including a violent attack on a police officer, breached rules, and asked for stronger enforcement of uniform misuse laws. The ministers said uniform rules apply, that Defence has instructed commanders that demonstrating in uniform is a disciplinary offence, and that existing criminal provisions are not shown to be causing enforcement problems, though enforcement is discussed with prosecutors and police.
The Commander of the Armed Forces instructed his subordinate commanders in writing in December 2021 on how to act when military personnel in uniform take part in protests or demonstrations.
De Commandant der Strijdkrachten heeft in december 2021 zijn ondercommandanten schriftelijk geïnstrueerd hoe zij kunnen handelen als militairen in uniform meedoen aan protesten/betogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over reddingsmiddelen bij het te water raken van auto’s

An MP asks ministers about drowning deaths when cars enter water, the adequacy of safety hammers, and the REGS automatic window-breaking system tested on police cars in 2012. The minister acknowledges the deaths and rising concern, notes the pilot was stopped due to spontaneous activations, and declines to pursue further research or implementation.
As indicated in answer 6, the experiences were not such that we would want to proceed to implementation.
Zoals aangegeven bij vraag 6 waren de ervaringen niet zodanig dat we over zouden willen gaan op implementatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uithaal van een VN-rapporteur

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a UN rapporteur's criticism of police conduct at protests, police understaffing and high workload, and how disproportionate force will be curbed. The minister defends police professionalism, says force is reported and reviewed, notes understaffing expected to ease by 2024-25, and promises to respond carefully to the UN letter and discuss any unlawful force with the police chief.
If cases of demonstrably unlawful use of force by the police give reason for it, I will discuss this with the chief of police.
Indien gevallen van gebleken niet rechtmatige geweldstoepassing door de politie daartoe aanleiding geven ga ik hierover met de korpschef in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over grootschalige rooftochten van Oost-Europese bendes

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about large-scale thefts of car catalytic converters by Eastern European gangs, including arrest and sentencing figures, asset recovery, cooperation with source countries, a task force, and fencing prevention. The minister answered with police reports figures, describes the barrier model, the Taskforce Mobiel Banditisme, international operations, and digital anti-fencing tools, while stating that court and prosecution data on specific sentences cannot be provided.

It is therefore not possible to provide an overview, from the registrations of the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the Council for the Judiciary, of the number of arrests, sentence demands and imposed sentences relating to mobile banditry.

Het is daarom niet mogelijk om uit de registratie van politie, Openbaar Ministerie en de Raad voor de Rechtspraak een overzicht te geven van het aantal arrestanten, de strafeisen en de opgelegde straffen met betrekking tot Mobiel Banditisme.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het bericht 'Ombudsman waarschuwt: Als het OM zelf straft, komen slachtofferrechten in het geding' en de brief over positie slachtoffers bij strafbeschikking O

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked about reports that the Public Prosecution Service imposes penal orders (strafbeschikking) even in serious cases where victims want to speak, and about the Ombudsman's warning on victims' rights. The Minister acknowledges that in 4 cases, including one sexual offence, penal orders were used despite the victim wishing to speak, says the OM will re-emphasise the contra-indication and that an evaluation of the new legal aid scheme and a fifth PG study are pending.
In 4 cases it turned out to be so. This involved 1 sexual offence case.
In 4 zaken bleek dat het geval. Het betrof daarbij 1 zedenzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het controleren en koppelen van data van onschuldige mensen

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why no privacy impact assessment was carried out for police project Athene, which automatically linked data from asylum seekers' phones to criminal information, and whether similar projects exist and how the Council of State's advice on phone reading would be followed. The Minister answers that the police overlooked the need for a privacy test after the GDPR transition, the test was done in November 2021 and the project ended, no data was shared, and the government will clarify the legal basis for reading digital data carriers and has amended rules to meet the Council of State's advice.
As a result, the assessment only took place in November 2021, after which the project was ended.
Hierdoor heeft de toets pas plaatsgevonden in november 2021, waarna het project is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Podt over het bericht dat de politie onschuldige asielzoekers aan strafrechtelijke informatie koppelde

MPs Van Ginneken and Podt asked whether police wrongly matched asylum seekers' phone data against criminal intelligence, whether the data still exists and whether it was used in criminal cases. The government admits the Athene project lacked a legal basis after the 2019 privacy law change, says the project was stopped and the data destroyed, and says the Raad van State advice on statutory safeguards is taken to heart, while several questions get only partial or general answers.
That realisation came through a Data Protection Impact Assessment carried out within AVIM in November 2021 as part of a force-wide programme.
Dat besef kwam dankzij de uitvoering van een Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) 2 die in november 2021 binnen AVIM als onderdeel van een korpsbreed programma is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het niet handhaven van het vuurwerkverbod

An MP asks the Justice and Interior ministers whether the government anticipated enforcement shortages before imposing a temporary fireworks ban, whether mayors and police warned of enforceability problems, and how the ban affected cross-border purchases, hospital figures and public trust. The minister replies that the ban was needed to relieve healthcare pressure, that police and prosecutors deliberately prioritised citizen safety over enforcing the ban, that casualty figures fell 40% compared with the last pre-COVID year, and that detailed hospital data will follow in a separate report.
Data on ICU admissions are not available. The report with an additional analysis of the injury figures for the past New Year's period will be sent to your House in the second quarter of 2022.

Gegevens over IC-opnamen zijn niet beschikbaar. De rapportage met een aanvullende analyse van de letselcijfers van afgelopen jaarwisseling zal in het tweede kwartaal van 2022 naar uw Kamer verzonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM het onderzoek naar fraude bij Pels Rijcken aan een commerciële partij heeft overgelaten

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service's top leadership blocked a prosecutor who wanted to escalate the criminal fraud investigation into Pels Rijcken, and whether the OM handed inquiries to a commercial party, Deloitte, and gave it access to seized devices. The minister answered that the OM decided to temporise the criminal probe pending supervisory investigations and the Deloitte report, denied that Deloitte obtained access to devices, said the OM determines investigation strategy, and pointed to a WODC study on self-investigation due in spring 2022.
It is for the OM, and not for me, to determine the approach to a criminal investigation.
Het is aan het OM, en niet aan mij, om de inzet op een strafrechtelijk onderzoek te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Technologieleverancier van Defensie en politie gehackt, losgeld geëist voor vertrouwelijke informatie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a ransomware attack on supplier Abiom, which serves the police and Defence, and whether oversight and security requirements for ICT suppliers are adequate. The government acknowledged the incident, described existing security rules (BIO, ABDO, procurement tools) and planned improvements, but said the risk of harm to citizens is limited and declined to give details of the ongoing police investigation.
Because of the ongoing police investigation, the case cannot be discussed in more detail at this time.
In verband met het lopende politieonderzoek kan er op dit moment niet nader in worden gegaan op de casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aansprakelijkheid van social media platforms bij wraakporno

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether social media platforms can be held liable for aiding and abetting image-based sexual abuse (revenge porn) despite the EU e-commerce liability exemption, and what the government's position is. The minister answered that platforms can lose the liability exemption once they know of unlawful content and fail to act, that the DSA revision is underway, and that the government will keep working on regulation and enforcement, without committing to a specific new liability rule for platforms.
My policy is aimed at undoing criminal offences and unlawful acts as quickly as possible.
Mijn beleid is erop gericht strafbare feiten en onrechtmatigheden zo snel mogelijk weer ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Banken en overheden zetten software af uit angst voor hacks’

An MP asked the Justice, Economic Affairs and Interior ministers about reports that banks and governments were disabling software over fears of Log4j hacks, asking about damage, affected organisations, municipalities, vital sectors, international practice and crisis coordination. The government answered that no large-scale damage had been reported, that the NCSC and DTC warned organisations widely, that updating is primarily each organisation's own responsibility, and that it sees no need to replace the software and will respond to the OVV report within the legal deadline.
There is no central overview of which software products use Log4J within the government.
Er bestaat geen centraal overzicht van welke softwareproducten Log4J gebruiken binnen de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rapport Kwetsbaar door software – Lessen naar aanleiding van beveiligingslekken door software van Citrix

MP Kathmann asked the ministers about the Safety Board's report on software vulnerabilities (Citrix) and whether software makers should bear responsibility, invest more, and face liability. The government says it is studying the report, points to existing measures such as the Roadmap for Digitally Secure Hardware and Software and EU certification efforts, and defers liability and quality-requirement questions to the European level, promising a full response before summer.
As stated in the letter to parliament of 16 December 2021, the cabinet will study the report carefully and respond in writing to the OVV within the statutory six-month period.
Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 16 december 2021 zal het kabinet het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen en binnen de wettelijke reactietermijn van zes maanden schriftelijk richting de OVV reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sneller over het bericht ‘Jongen (17) krijgt allereerste ‘online gebiedsverbod’ in Nederland, maar wat betekent dat eigenlijk?’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Utrecht mayor's order (last onder dwangsom) barring a 17-year-old from online incitement to riot, and whether it is lawful and what powers mayors have online. The minister said the measure is a local matter for the mayor and courts, that it cannot assess the decision, and that the government will provide guidance on online public-order monitoring for municipalities.
It is not for me to judge the mayor's conduct. That concerns a local matter.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over het optreden van de burgemeester. Dat betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over alternatieve (digitale) wijze waarop het recht op een eerlijk proces geëerbiedigd kan worden bij uitgereisde IS-vrouwen

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the right to a fair trial can be safeguarded for returned IS women, including via video-conferencing, and how the WODC study and ECtHR case law bear on this. The government answered that the study's comparative findings are noted, that a letter on video-conferencing is promised for early 2022, and that a verdragsbasis is needed for trial by video-conference of suspects abroad.
Before the summer recess, the House will receive further information on this.
Voor de zomer ontvangt uw Kamer hierover nadere informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de aanvallen op betogers van KOZP in Volendam en het politieoptreden

An MP asked the Justice Minister about violent attacks on a Kick Out Zwarte Piet demonstration in Volendam, the police response, investigations, and anti-violence policy for demonstrators and journalists. The government condemned the violence, said the local mayor and police are responsible for demonstrations and any independent inquiry, and pointed to existing de-escalation and journalist-protection frameworks.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om daar in te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het vuurwerkverbod

An MP from BBB asked the Justice Minister about the temporary fireworks ban, including cross-border fireworks purchases, enforcement capacity, injury figures, and compensation for the fireworks industry. The government answered that enforcement continues at borders, injury figures fell compared with the last year without a ban, compensation was increased, and it still considers the ban justified.
No information is known about the quantities of fireworks purchased abroad.
Over de hoeveelheden vuurwerk die aangeschaft zijn in het buitenland is geen informatie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Jonge agent uit de bocht’ en ‘Rode kaart voor groentje’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports of rising serious integrity violations by young police trainees, its causes, and whether ethnicity and home visits in selection should be examined. The minister answered that the number of investigations rose in line with intake, the share stayed around 1%, no trend exists, and home visits are not necessary and would intrude on privacy, while committing to more attention to motives in disciplinary investigations.
The police will therefore, in line with the recommendations, from now on pay more explicit attention to the motives for norm-violating behaviour in every disciplinary investigation.
De politie zal dan ook in lijn met de aanbevelingen voortaan in elk disciplinair onderzoek meer expliciete aandacht besteden aan de motieven van normoverschrijdend gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zaak Ivana Smit

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the government would press Malaysia harder on the case of Ivana Smit and what concrete progress had been made since earlier answers. The minister replied that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case and offered legal assistance, but that its room to act is very limited because Malaysia's prosecutor leads the investigation and interfering in foreign proceedings is unwanted.

The Netherlands' room to act is however very limited, since the criminal investigation is carried out by Malaysia's Public Prosecution Service and interference in a foreign legal process is undesirable.

Het handelingsperspectief van Nederland is echter zeer beperkt, aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek door het Maleisische Openbaar Ministerie wordt uitgevoerd en inmenging in een buitenlandse rechtsgang ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de uitreiking van de Big Brother Award Expertprijs 2021 aan demissionair Minister Grapperhaus op 13 december 2021

An MP asked the Justice Minister to respond to a Big Brother Award citing predictive policing that enables ethnic profiling, weak attention to legal protection, the NCTV's surveillance practices being legalised, a police facial-recognition database, and living labs with surveillance technology in public space. The minister denied that algorithms enable ethnic profiling, cited existing frameworks and laws, and argued that the NCTV and living-lab practices operate within legal bases while committing to no new concrete step beyond the pending NCTV bill.
In addition, the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights has clarified the legal framework on the use of ethnicity and nationality.
Daarnaast heeft het College voor de Rechten van de Mens het juridisch kader over het gebruik van etniciteit en nationaliteit helder in beeld gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over het artikel 'Waar blijft de toegezegde ruimhartige compensatie?'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers about news reports that promised generous flood compensation had not yet arrived, and about payout pace, the definition of generosity, affected areas in Brabant, and talks on turnover loss. The minister replies that payouts of 7.26 million euros had reached 296 recipients by 11 January 2022, that a one-off turnover loss scheme and a crop-plan compensation scheme are being prepared, and that the Dutch government's existing flood-relief measures apply.
It indicated, among other things, that the cabinet will publish a one-off turnover loss scheme for affected entrepreneurs in Limburg in early 2022.
Daarin is onder andere aangegeven dat het kabinet begin 2022 een eenmalige omzetdervingsregeling zal publiceren voor getroffen ondernemers in Limburg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de beschikbare informatie met betrekking tot afpakken van misdaadgeld, witwassen en Bibob

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for information on the effectiveness of confiscating criminal proceeds, money laundering policy and Bibob screening, including statistics on Bibob advice, confiscation orders and enforcement durations. The Minister answered that organised crime is hard to quantify, pointed to existing monitors, a WODC feasibility study, evaluations and Court of Audit reports due in 2022, and supplied tables covering 2014-2020 Bibob advice and 2010-2021 confiscation data.
To better map both organised undermining crime and the effectiveness of government action against it, the WODC is conducting a feasibility study on a monitor on my ministry's behalf.

Met het oog op het beter in kaart brengen van zowel georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit als de effectiviteit van het overheidsoptreden hiertegen, voert het WODC in opdracht van mijn ministerie een haalbaarheidsstudie uit voor een monitor
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische basis waarmee gemeentes gedwongen worden asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Secretary of State's December 2021 letters 'designating' emergency asylum reception sites for Enschede, Gorinchem and the Rotterdam region have any legal basis, and whether this amounts to an unlawful directive to municipalities. The government replied that the letters are not legal directions, have no grounding in Dutch law and no public-law effect, were a request driven by an acute shortage of about 2,000 places, and that it would not be repeated lightly; it also declined to release a decision memo, saying none was written.
The directions have no basis in Dutch statute or regulation, as I stated during the Justice and Security budget debate in the Senate on 21 December.
De aanwijzingen hebben geen grondslag in Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, zoals ik gemeld heb bij de begrotingsbehandeling JenV in de Eerste Kamer op 21 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de zorgelijke toestand van INTERPOL

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked ministers about the election of UAE general Al-Raisi as Interpol president, alleged human rights abuse, misuse of red notices and possible measures against Interpol and its members. The ministers answered that Interpol's rules prevent undue country influence, that the election followed the formal procedure, that reforms and corrective measures against misuse are ongoing, and that suspending funds or reconsidering membership is not currently warranted.
I condemn any attempt to misuse Interpol instruments.
Ik keur elke poging tot misbruik van Interpol-instrumenten af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het strafproces tegen een Nederlander voor zijn hulp aan vluchtelingen op Lesbos

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about the Greek criminal prosecution of a 73-year-old Dutch volunteer for rescuing and aiding refugees on Lesbos, including whether Nationally consular help was given and whether EU law forbids criminalising such aid. The State Secretary declined to judge the individual case, said the Netherlands will not interfere in Greek proceedings, outlined consular assistance, and argued that the Commission's guidance is not binding and that the government disagrees with its reading on NGO sea rescue.
The Netherlands cannot and will not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country, just as the Netherlands expects other countries not to do so in our legal proceedings.
Nederland kan en wil zich niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land mengen, net zoals Nederland verwacht dat andere landen dat niet doen in onze rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Segers en Bisschop over antisemitische incidenten en bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about antisemitic incidents and threats against Jewish students, including how trust in reporting could be restored and how police and prosecutors respond. The minister condemned the statements, said he is concerned, pointed to existing complaint channels and prosecution guidelines on discrimination, and referred to new antisemitism and anti-discrimination coordinators.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service pay considerable attention to properly addressing criminal offences with a possible discriminatory aspect.
Bij de politie en het OM is veel aandacht voor het op een correcte wijze aandacht geven aan strafbare feiten met een mogelijk discriminatoir aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onschuldigen die zich geïntimideerd voelen door undercoveragenten

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about innocent third parties intimidated by undercover officers, asking how far powers under article 126j Sv reach, how proportionality is checked, and whether rules should be tightened. The minister said that prosecutors and courts assess lawfulness case by case, that he will not comment on individual rulings, and that a new commission under Sorgdrager will advise on strengthening safeguards before any changes to rules are considered.
Going forward, a new commission will among other things examine which aspects of the undercover powers need further strengthening of safeguards.
Naar de toekomst toe zal een nieuwe commissie zich onder andere richten op de vraag op welke aspecten van de undercover bevoegdheden nadere versterking van de waarborgen nodig is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Hagen over drugsgebruik in het verkeer

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about drug driving enforcement, including THC thresholds, saliva tests, medicinal users, licence suspensions and possible discriminatory policing. Minister Grapperhaus defended the uniform per se limits, explained the saliva-then-blood procedure and licence rules, and said he would not comment on individual cases.
The NFI will re-evaluate the scientific insights on this in 2022.
Het NFI zal in 2022 de wetenschappelijke inzichten hieromtrent opnieuw evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de bezuinigingen op de brandweer

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about budget cuts to the fire service in the Noord-Holland Noord safety region, including whether safety is affected, the removal of vehicles and volunteers, and why earlier questions were answered late. The minister replies that regional boards set their own budgets and service levels, that cuts are efficiency measures without affecting fire service tasks, that the ministry does not register vehicle and team data, and that earlier questions were already answered.
The board of a safety region adopts the (multi-year) budget of the region.
Het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio stelt de (meerjaren)begroting van de regio vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Beelden van misbruik van Marcels dochter blijven rondgaan: ‘Mensen gaan hierdoor kapot’'

An MP asked the Justice minister about the spread of abuse images of a girl, the detectability of child sexual abuse material on the darkweb, the hosting share in the Netherlands, webhoster responsibilities, and EU action. The minister answered at length, describing police and sector measures, the TU Delft monitor, and EU plans, but did not commit to new concrete steps beyond existing reporting timelines.
For operational reasons, the investigative methods are not elaborated further.
Vanwege het operationeel belang wordt niet nader ingegaan op de opsporingsmethoden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over disproportioneel politiegeweld, de aanhouding van een journalist en rechtsongelijkheid bij een demonstratie van Extinction Rebellion

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of a Volkskrant journalist at an Extinction Rebellion demonstration, alleged disproportionate police force, and unequal treatment compared with farmers' protests in 2019. The minister declined to judge the police conduct, which is for the prosecutor, courts, and mayor, and gave no apology or independent investigation.
It is for other authorities – where applicable the judge – to assess whether the use of force was lawful.
Het is aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of het geweldsgebruik rechtmatig was.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over rechtsbescherming na Brexit

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked how legal protection in cross-border contract disputes with a British party has changed after Brexit, including the enforcement gap left by the Brussels I-bis and Rome I regimes, the 1967 bilateral treaty, and whether the UK should join the Lugano Convention. The minister replied that Dutch courts still apply Rome I, that enforcement now falls back on national rules and the 2019 Hague Judgments Convention (not yet in force for the UK), that the Commission opposes UK accession to Lugano, and that the government will push the Hague Convention and await an advisory report on article 431 Rv.
Finally, the Netherlands is working to reach a decision in the EU as quickly as possible to become a party to the 2019 Hague Conference Judgments Convention.
Ten slotte zet Nederland zich in om in de EU zo snel mogelijk tot een besluit te komen om partij te worden bij het Executieverdrag van de Haagse Conferentie van 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over ‘het nieuws dat de beveiliging van Schiphol zo lek is als een mandje’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister whether fake QR-code boarding passes allowing unauthorised access past Schiphol gates, and related security weaknesses, were known and whether they threaten passengers and staff. The minister answered that automated checks cannot fully exclude non-passengers, but that this is not a security gap since the separate weapons and explosives screening still applies, and that the airport is responsible for the access controls under KMar oversight.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about the form and frequency of testing of the access control systems.
Vanwege veiligheidsreden kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de vorm en frequentie van de testen van de toegangscontrolesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het gebruik maken van particuliere genealogische DNA-databanken voor het oplossen van cold case zaken

MP Ellian asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the status of an exploration into using private genealogical DNA databases to solve cold cases, when results would be shared, and why Sweden has run a pilot while the Netherlands has not. The Minister said the exploration would conclude early 2022 with results shared in the first months of 2022, that no technical obstacles exist for a pilot, and that legal and ethical implications require a careful process before any pilot is decided.
The results will be shared with your House in the first months of 2022.
De resultaten zullen in de eerste maanden van 2022 worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbescherming bij de NCTV

MP Van Nispen asks how the NCTV handles data-access and deletion requests, given a settlement with an imam over deleted data and reports that the NCTV's data processing lacks the access rights and oversight applicable to police, and whether the NCTV should be placed under supervision like an intelligence service. Minister Grapperhaus answers that individual cases are not discussed, that access requests follow a fixed AVG procedure with appeal possible, that the NCTV is not an intelligence or police service and is not subject to the WIV, and that a legislative proposal adding safeguards has been submitted.
Individual cases are not discussed, and therefore the substantive handling of the present case is not discussed either.
Op individuele zaken wordt niet ingegaan en dus ook niet op de inhoudelijke afhandeling van het onderhavige geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het gebruik van gezichtsherkenningssoftware door de politie van het omstreden bedrijf Clearview AI

MP Van Ginneken asks the Justice Minister to explain why an earlier answer denying any biometric real-time face recognition by police was reformulated, and whether police use of Clearview AI has occurred without authorization. The Minister says the reformulation clarifies that police do not currently authorize real-time face recognition for surveillance, that Clearview use is incompatible with law and fundamental rights, and that police internal procedures and impact assessments govern any future use.
For the use of biometric surveillance in public space by the police, in the sense of real-time facial recognition, no permission is currently given within the police organisation.
Voor het gebruik van biometrische surveillance in de publieke ruimte door de politie, in de zin van real time gezichtsherkenning, wordt op dit moment in de politieorganisatie geen toestemming gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Undercover naar de moskee: geheim onderzoek naar islamitische organisaties'

The MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that municipalities covertly commissioned NTA to analyse mosques and Islamic organisations, raising legality, privacy and NCTV responsibility. The Minister answered that the agreements were between municipalities and NTA so he cannot judge legality, that the NCTV had internal concerns in 2017 and it will strengthen guidance and conditions, and that he will restore trust with Islamic organisations.

Because the precise agreements on carrying out and delivering the power-field analyses were made between municipalities and NTA, I cannot make statements on whether unlawful investigative methods were used.

Omdat de precieze afspraken over de uitvoering en oplevering van de krachtenveldanalyses gemaakt zijn tussen gemeenten en NTA, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de vraag of er onrechtmatige onderzoeksmethodieken hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het publiceren van dronebeelden door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police publication of drone footage from a Rotterdam housing protest, questioning its purpose, legal basis, selective editing and whether it shapes political debate. The minister defended the release as exceptional, lawful under the Police Act and aimed at giving context, and said police have accounted for force use through the usual reporting and review procedures.
Use of force by the police must always be reported and reviewed by the assisting officer of justice.
Geweldsaanwending door de politie moet altijd worden gemeld en getoetst door de hulpofficier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Een primeur: in Utrecht mogen handhavers en toezichthouders voortaan een hoofddoek of keppel op’

The MP asks whether the government agrees that authority must be neutral and whether the uniform of municipal enforcement officers (boa's) should permit religious symbols, given motions in several cities. The Minister answers that police must remain lifestyle-neutral, that municipalities as employers decide on boa uniforms, and that he will await municipal consultations and the VNG evaluation before considering national rules, reporting to parliament in spring 2022.
I attach importance to first awaiting the discussions between municipalities and with the VNG and to following their outcomes, as well as the VNG evaluation of the model uniform.
Ik hecht er aan om eerst de gesprekken tussen gemeenten onderling en met de VNG af te wachten en de uitkomsten te volgen, als ook de evaluatie van de VNG inzake het modeluniform.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Kritiek op hoofddoek bij boa’s barst los: ‘Het vlaggenschip van politieke islam’’

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Justice whether religious headscarves for municipal enforcement officers (boa's) should be allowed, and whether the government would stand for neutrality by banning them. The minister replied that uniform rules for boa's are a local matter for municipalities as employers, that the VNG model uniform excludes religious expression, and that he will await municipal consultations and a VNG evaluation before considering national regulation, reporting to parliament in spring 2022.
I therefore attach importance to first awaiting the conversations between municipalities and with the VNG and following the outcomes.
Ik hecht er daarom aan om eerst de gesprekken tussen gemeenten onderling en met de VNG af te wachten en de uitkomsten te volgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over openbaarheid van het onderzoek naar afluisterapparatuur

MP Van Nispen asked why the police research into interception equipment was not public, whether the police ignored a Bits of Freedom objection despite a court-imposed penalty of 15,000 euros, and how often the police respond late to complaints and objections. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the report was partly published and sent to parliament on 29 October, that the objection was decided that day, that the police admits the late response and is working to improve, and that six court cases in five years resulted in 35,700 euros in penalties; he did not answer the question on late responses in general, saying no central record exists.
The police is aware that this is an undesirable situation.
De politie is zich ervan bewust dat dit een onwenselijke situatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de veiligheid van registertolken- en vertalers en anonimiteit

Van Nispen (SP) asked why certified interpreters' and translators' personal details appear on translations while other case participants are anonymised, how threatened interpreters are protected, how intercept interpreters are shielded, and how confidential data is kept from third parties. Minister Grapperhaus replied that prosecutors and judges are not anonymised in general, that intercept interpreters now receive anonymous accounts, that intermediaries sign confidentiality agreements, and that interpreters in sensitive cases may choose to hide their contact details and anonymisation of interpreters can be considered when needed.
Interpreters and translators therefore have the option to choose whether their contact details can be found in the public part of the register or not.
Tolken en vertalers hebben daarom de mogelijkheid zelf te kiezen of hun contactgegevens via het openbare deel van het register te vinden zijn of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over suïcide onder agenten waarbij het dienstwapen is gebruikt

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about police suicides involving service weapons, whether officers with psychological problems may take their weapons home, the Rijksrecherche and Inspectorate investigations, the number of suicides and PTSS cases, and psychological support capacity. The minister answered that a uniform guideline now lets supervisors withdraw service weapons for psychological reasons, that no Rijksrecherche investigation was held because it falls outside its remit, that the Inspectorate handled the case within regular oversight without a report, and that 24 police suicides occurred 2016–2020, nine with service weapons.
Because of medically confidential information, no information is available on the number of police officers diagnosed with PTSD in the past five years.
Vanwege de medisch vertrouwelijke informatie is er geen informatie beschikbaar over het aantal politiemedewerkers waarbij in de afgelopen vijf jaar de diagnose PTSS is vastgesteld.
