Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over de aanhoudingen van journalisten tijdens demonstraties

Two SP MPs asked why three journalists were detained at climate demonstrations and what rules protect press identity during arrests. The Justice Minister answered that press cards carry rights but also duties, that the police apply internal rules, that the arrests were lawful and no prosecution followed, and that the issue will be raised in the PersVeilig steering group.
In the aforementioned cases it turned out that the arrest was lawful.
In de voornoemde zaken is gebleken dat de aanhouding rechtmatig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het strafontslag van een agente die grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een leidinggevende aankaartte

MP Van Nispen asked about the dismissal of a police officer who reported cross-border behaviour by a superior and about whether leaking to media breaches oath and confidentiality duties, plus questions on reporting procedures, whistleblower transfers, and the number of problem teams. Minister Grapperhaus answered that internal reporting, external channels and the AGFA advisory commission exist, that media disclosure of confidential information may breach the oath, gave limited figures, declined to comment on the individual case as an employer-employee matter, and said the question on the debate timetable could not be met.
However, I cannot make statements about this case because it concerns a matter between employer and employee.
Ik kan over deze casus echter geen uitspraken doen omdat het hier een aangelegenheid tussen werkgever en werknemer betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Enige politiebureau in Noord ‘s nachts gesloten’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a police station in Amsterdam-Noord had been closed at night due to staff shortages and whether other Amsterdam stations are no longer open 24 hours. The minister denied closure, saying a guard now admits night callers, and attributed capacity shortages mainly to retirements and rising workload, leaving prioritisation and reopening timing to local authorities.
It is up to the local authority to make choices in this regard.
Het is aan het lokaal gezag om hierin keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht "Water loopt politiechef Rotterdam over de schoenen - we pakken alleen de uitvoerders"

An MP (Helder, PVV) asked the Minister of Justice and Security why Rotterdam's police lack capacity for large-scale investigation teams after a violence wave, and why the police leadership prioritises a large staff surplus alongside a budget deficit, asking whether the minister would intervene. The minister acknowledges capacity pressures and points to planned investments and internal measures, but says further spending is for the next cabinet, and that intervention options are limited.

As previously stated in my letter of 29 June 2021 and the answers to parliamentary questions from Van Nispen (SP) and Michon (VVD), the police forecast of May 2021 showed the police may exceed its budget this year by 157 million.

Antwoord 4 en 5 Zoals reeds aangegeven in mijn verzamelbrief van 29 juni 2021 5 en de antwoorden op de Kamervragen van Van Nispen (SP) en Michon (VVD) 6 bleek uit de prognose van Politie van mei 2021 dat politie dit jaar (2021) haar budget mogelijk gaat overschrijden met 157 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over politie-ingrijpen bij demonstraties en de veiligheid van vreedzame demonstranten en journalisten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police intervention at the Rotterdam housing protest, police tactics, arrests of demonstrators and journalists, and the protection of peaceful protest. The minister mostly deferred to local authority and the public prosecutor, confirmed nine arrests in Rotterdam, rejected a pattern of misconduct and any need for a separate investigation, and gave no concrete commitment to prevent recurrence.
I cannot and will not weigh in on the assessment of this.
Ik kan en zal niet in de beoordeling hiervan treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over de berichten ‘Dwangsom asfaltfabriek Eindhoven als te hoge uitstoot kankerverwekkende stof benzeen niet stopt, ‘half miljard naar milieucontrole bedrijven, maar wat g

Two D66 MPs asked about benzene emissions from an Eindhoven asphalt plant exceeding limits, weak enforcement of environmental rules, the lack of data on sanctions and about 570 million euro spent by local environmental services, and continued ship degassing in Flevoland lakes. The state secretary answered that enforcement is the competence of local authorities and environmental services, denied any tolerance policy on degassing, and promised a status overview and a leading policy note by year end.
I do not have figures on how often companies are ultimately (partially) closed down.
Ik heb geen cijfers voorhanden hoe vaak bedrijven uiteindelijk (gedeeltelijk) worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over hardhandig politieoptreden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police use of force in The Hague on 31 October 2021, shown in circulated footage, including its cause and how excessive force will be addressed. The minister confirmed the incident, said ten arrests were made, that an officer is a suspect in an ongoing OM-led investigation, and that individual force cases cannot be discussed while proceedings continue, while arguing that most uses of force are lawful.
The police action visible in the footage took place on Sunday 31 October around the Paul Krugerplein in The Hague.
Het politieoptreden dat op de beelden is te zien vond plaats op zondag 31 oktober rond het Paul Krugerplein in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de intimidatie van MH-17-advocaten

An MP asked the government about reports that lawyers representing MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and about security measures, diplomatic responses, spying offences, a foreign agents register, and countering disinformation and cyberattacks. The government condemned all interference, said it monitors the security situation closely and takes measures where needed, but declined to discuss individual cases and said no diplomatic action is currently warranted, while noting a planned bill to extend espionage offences.
For security reasons I cannot address individual cases or comment on whether investigations are ongoing.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek en kan ik geen uitspraken doen over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, possibly by Russia, including being followed to their homes. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss individual cases or investigations for security reasons, described general counter-interference cooperation, and said the NCTV protects those involved while noting no information currently warrants diplomatic action.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en van Nispen over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

MPs Palland and Van Nispen asked whether lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and what the government would do about it. Minister Grapperhaus declined to confirm individual cases or attribution for security reasons, citing close cooperation with intelligence services and general awareness measures, and offered a confidential technical briefing to the House.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het vervolgen van een verdachte van moord die in India verblijft

An MP asked the Justice Minister why India refuses to extradite a murder suspect in the 'Haagse ijskastmoord' case, what steps have been taken, and whether India would prosecute domestically. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stressed the need to prevent impunity, and said Dutch authorities are seeking alternative ways to ensure prosecution.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and the way a foreign authority acts, I do not make statements.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het strafmaximum voor het onttrekken van een lijk aan nasporing

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the two-year maximum penalty for unlawfully removing a corpse from investigation (art. 151 Sr), which a court called too low, will be raised, and whether the Criminal Code gives enough room for intent and manner. The minister replied that WODC research on broader criminalisation of corpse desecration, including art. 151, is underway and he will report to the House after its results, without committing to a change.
I am awaiting the results of this research and will respond in due course, and will inform your House of that.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af en zal te zijner tijd met een reactie daarop komen, waarover ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Dealen op scholen heel normaal, harddrugs vaker op gymnasiums’

An MP asks the Justice, Health and Education ministers about reports that drug dealing at schools is becoming normal, and about normalisation of drug use, youth addiction numbers, and prevention such as the Icelandic model. The government says there is no clear trend in dealing or drug use among pupils, points to €82 million for prevention, the planned revival of the LADIS addiction database in 2022, and the Helder op School programme, while declining to expand the Preventie Akkoord for now.
There is no precise data on the number of cases of dealing at school.
Over het aantal gevallen van dealen op school zijn geen precieze gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan inzake de Arnhemse villamoord

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the Arnhem villa murder case, including alleged tunnel vision, coercive interrogation methods, paid junkie informant testimony, and calls for a new investigation and compensation. The Minister declines substantive comment because a new revision request is announced to the Supreme Court, notes that the police and prosecution will cooperate, and rejects a new investigation or additional capacity, citing the Supreme Court's role.
Given the announced new revision request in this case, it is appropriate for me as Minister to exercise restraint in answering the questions concerning the substance of the Arnhem villa murder case.

Gelet op het aangekondigde nieuwe herzieningsverzoek in deze zaak past mij als Minister terughoudendheid bij de beantwoording van de gestelde vragen die betrekking hebben op de inhoud van de Arnhemse Villamoord-zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen  over het bericht over veroordeelde criminelen die vrij rondlopen in Turkije

An SP MP asked why a man convicted in absentia for strangling his niece in 2004 has evaded justice for 17 years in Turkey, and what is being done about impunity for offenders abroad. The minister agreed the situation is unacceptable, explained that Turkey does not extradite nationals but may take over enforcement of sentences under the Wots framework, reported 16 open cases and reminders sent, and said the case remains a topic with Turkish authorities while declining to give case-specific details.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts on them, I make no statements.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de staat van de brandweer

MP Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister of Justice and Security about fire service coverage: the motion Van Raak on area-based response times, a station closure in Ede, falling volunteer numbers, the Rotterdam care-home fire report, Uitruk op Maat, and vanishing fire vehicles. The minister answers that service quality is the responsibility of the safety regions and their boards, that the regions are responsible for response times and capacity, and that some bylaw changes and a platform are still being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Machtsstrijd om aanpak van zware criminaliteit’

MP Helder asked the Justice Minister about reports of rivalry over the fight against serious crime, including the Taskforce ACM, a strategic knowledge centre, and claims that MIT members visited foreign services. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the taskforce is a reprioritisation of existing police capacity under the Public Prosecution Service, that MIT only gave presentations abroad rather than trips, and that integrated multidisciplinary cooperation is necessary.
As also stated in the newspaper correction, MIT has made no business trips abroad.
Zoals ook vermeld in de rectificatie in de krant zijn er door het MIT geen dienstreizen naar het buitenland gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het OVV onderzoek naar de moord op Peter R. de Vries

Omtzigt asks the Justice Minister whether the OVV investigation into the murder of Peter R. de Vries satisfies the state's procedural duty under ECHR Article 2, and how each effectiveness criterion applies. Minister Grapperhaus answers that the criminal investigation plus the supplementary OVV inquiry meet Article 2 requirements, citing the OVV's investigative powers, independence and family involvement, without committing to a further inquiry.

I am of the view that the criminal investigation instituted by the Public Prosecution Service and the investigation instituted by the OVV together satisfy the state's procedural obligations under Article 2 ECHR to investigate.

Ik ben van oordeel dat met het door het Openbaar Ministerie ingestelde strafrechtelijk onderzoek en het door de OVV ingestelde onderzoek wordt voldaan aan de procedurele verplichtingen van de Staat onder artikel 2 van het EVRM om onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de verwarring die ontstaan is over welke dienst er bij de politie verantwoordelijk is voor de aanpak van ondermijning

An MP asked the Justice Minister to clarify the responsibilities of the MIT, the Taskforce Aanpak Criminele Machtsstructuren and the new strategic knowledge centre against organised crime, and about inter-service rivalry, data sharing of encrypted chat data and statements by police leaders. The minister answered that the bodies are still being set up, outlined their roles, rejected turf competition, said the police leadership culture is being addressed and that the legal use of Encrochat/Sky data is under review.

It is currently being legally examined whether the data obtained from these criminal investigations can be used by the participating organisations in the MIT for joint analysis purposes, and under what conditions and safeguards within the existing frameworks.

Momenteel wordt juridisch onderzocht of de data verkregen uit de genoemde opsporingsonderzoeken door de deelnemende organisaties in het MIT kan worden gebruikt voor gezamenlijke analysedoeleinden, en onder welke voorwaarden en waarborgen binnen de bestaande kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht ‘Chef undercover unit moet het veld ruimen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reported distrust, high workload and leadership turnover at the police Dienst Speciale Operaties (DSO) undercover unit, and whether the head's departure endangers field safety. The minister said an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing with results expected early 2022, a leadership improvement programme is underway, the unit head is stepping down to hand over leadership, and he will not comment on individual officers' functioning.

The investigation is still ongoing. The Inspectorate has informed me that the investigation at the AO department is expected to be completed by the end of the year and can be presented to your House in early 2022.

Het onderzoek loopt op dit moment nog. De Inspectie heeft mij laten weten dat het onderzoek bij de afdeling AO naar verwachting voor het einde van het jaar zal worden voltooid en begin 2022 aan uw Kamer kan worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Kuiken over de aanpak van drugscriminaliteit in Utrecht

MPs Kathmann and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about drug crime in Utrecht, including whether police capacity is sufficient and whether the government will act on the mayor's concerns. The minister said crime has fallen overall but shifted in nature, that police staffing will recover around 2024-2025, and that he will ask the Strategic Council on Undermining for advice on funding allocation and will meet the mayor.
I speak with the mayor of Utrecht regularly.
Ik spreek de burgemeester van Utrecht regelmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over mogelijke dataverzameling van Chinese drones

Written questions from MP Kathmann asked whether data from Chinese DJI drones used by the police and Rijkswaterstaat could flow to Chinese servers, and why Defence avoids them. The government answered that risks are assessed per case, that data safeguards were applied, that police and Rijkswaterstaat will keep using the drones for non-confidential tasks, and that it sees no reason to change course.
Should we nonetheless see cause to discuss this with the police and/or Rijkswaterstaat, we will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Mochten wij alsnog aanleiding zien om hierover in gesprek te gaan met de politie en/of Rijkswaterstaat, dan zullen wij uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een ‘satirisch’ filmpje dat afgelopen vrijdag is uitgezonden door de NPO

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a satirical NPO broadcast showing unvaccinated people being shot was criminal, and whether the NPO should be acted against. The minister answered that broadcasters independently decide content, prior content control is not permitted, satire is protected speech, and whether a crime occurred is for the courts, not the minister.
Nor is it for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to take action against the makers and/or distributors of the video in question.
Evenmin is het aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, om actie te ondernemen tegen de makers en/of verspreiders van het onderhavige filmpje.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Segers over de bedreigingen aan het Joods restaurant Hacarmel

MPs Ellian and Segers asked the Justice Minister about threats against the Jewish restaurant Hacarmel, which were initially registered only as insult, and whether antisemitic incidents are handled adequately. Minister Grapperhaus said both threat and insult reports were taken, outlined police and prosecutor measures on discrimination cases, and stated he sees no reason to conclude that handling is inadequate.
Because the criminal investigation in this case is still ongoing, I refrain from giving a substantive judgment on this case.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze zaak nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tekorten bij de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the staffing shortages at the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen, including how many vacancies exist, why the problem persists despite earlier funding, and what the solution is. The Minister reported 49 open vacancies, outlined the recruitment results and additional investment, and pointed to the Commissie Bos report and planned structural reinforcement of the protection system.
There are currently 49 vacancies for carrying out personal protection tasks (as of September 2021) at the Dienst Koninklijke en Diplomatie Beveiliging (DKDB).
Er zijn momenteel 49 vacatures voor de uitvoering van persoonsbeveiligingstaken (peildatum: september 2021) bij de Dienst Koninklijke en Diplomatie Beveiliging (DKDB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Koerhuis over de brandveiligheid van zonnepanelen

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Koerhuis asked about fire safety of solar panels after a roof fire in Hoofddorp and whether building fire-safety rules for new homes are enforced. The minister answered that municipalities supervise compliance, that the Wkb quality-assurance law is planned for 1 July 2022, that NEN is reviewing standards, and that research on particle deposition from solar-panel fires is ongoing with results expected in early 2022.
It is up to the municipality as competent authority to supervise compliance with the fire-safety regulations that apply to new homes.
Het is aan de gemeente als bevoegd gezag toe te zien op de naleving van de brandveiligheidsvoorschriften die gelden voor nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Rajkowski over het bericht Hoe China met de Nederlandse politie meekijkt

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans and Rajkowski asked whether the Dutch police use Chinese DJI drones, whether this was preceded by a security and privacy risk analysis, and whether the government will act given Chinese cyber and data-access risks. The Minister answers that the police use DJI drones only for routine tasks and not for confidential operations, that a security check and data protection impact assessment were done, that mitigating measures are in place, and that no further investigation is planned.
Given the steps the police have already taken, I see no reason to order an investigation.
Ik zie, gezien de stappen die de politie al heeft gezet, geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese drones die gebruikt worden door de politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether police use Chinese DJI drones, why they were chosen, whether data could reach Chinese servers, and whether a Rijksbreed policy on foreign technology is needed. The minister confirmed police use DJI drones, said procurement law gave no basis to exclude them, acknowledged the data-leak reports could not be verified, and declined to commission further investigation or a government-wide overview of such technology use.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘OM sluit geheime deal met voormalige topaanklagers’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the Public Prosecution Service secretly settled lawsuits with former prosecutor-general Van Nimwegen and chief prosecutor Bloos, and sought to know the reasons, amounts, and whether the deal was funded from crime-fighting budget. The Minister confirmed he was informed during talks, said the agreement is a confidential employer-employee matter and gave no amounts, but denied it was paid from crime-fighting budget and rejected reversing it.
The agreements that Mr Van Nimwegen and Ms Bloos made with the OM concern the relationship between employee and employer.
De afspraken die de heer van Nimwegen en mevrouw Bloos met het OM gemaakt hebben, betreffen de relatie tussen werknemer en werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Onrust in Amersfoort over spirituele rituelen op begraafplaats’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether spiritual rituals at an Amersfoort cemetery without relatives' consent fall under the Dutch crime of grave desecration, and whether the law should be widened. The minister declined to prejudge the public prosecutor's assessment of the reported complaints, said WODC is studying widening the offence of desecration of corpses, and stated that conduct being unpunishable does not mean it is socially acceptable.
It is for the public prosecutor to judge whether it can be concluded without further ado that the conduct described in the news article would not fall under the offence of grave desecration.

Het is aan het OM om te oordelen of zonder meer kan worden geconcludeerd dat de gedragingen die worden beschreven in het nieuwsartikel waarnaar u verwijst, niet onder de strafbaarstelling van grafschennis zouden vallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over de berichten ‘Bedrijfsleven start eigen alarmsysteem tegen hackers: ‘overheid te traag’ & ‘Informatie over op handen zijnde hacks wordt grotendeels weggegooid’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked whether the government is aware of reports that business is setting up its own hack-alert system because government is too slow, and asked about the Digital Trust Center, the NCSC's legal limits, and evaluation of these bodies. The minister says the private initiative is positive, defends the DTC and NCSC, and points to a draft amendment to the Wbni and pilots while promising to report on DTC results in early 2022.
It is a positive development that private initiatives in the field of cybersecurity, such as the "alarm system", are emerging.
Het is een positieve ontwikkeling dat private initiatieven op het gebied van cybersecurity, zoals het «alarmsysteem», zich ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Daar sta je dan: mishandeld, vergeten en met lege handen’ en ‘Driekwart slachtoffers gelooft niet meer in aangifte doen’

A CDA MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that most victims no longer report crimes and about victims' rights when the Public Prosecution Service settles serious assault and sexual cases by penalty order without a judge. The ministers answered that reporting willingness depends on offence type, that the OM considers victims' interests but acknowledges delays in sending victim letters and is working to fix them, and that victims can claim damages and complain to the OM.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated it is working with priority on resolving these problems.
Het OM heeft aangegeven met prioriteit te werken aan het oplossen van deze problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Problemen met kwetsbare 112-meldkamers na zes jaar nog niet opgelost’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that vulnerable 112 emergency control rooms remain unresolved after six years, including staffing, responsibility fragmentation, ICT investigation and implementation of inspection recommendations. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the concerns are shared and a multi-year transition is underway, but largely defended the existing governance split, promised a WODC evaluation in 2022, periodic updates and a mobile coverage map by spring 2022.
I therefore do not share the supervisors' view on this point.
Ik deel het standpunt van de toezichthouders op dit punt dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Enquête: klant moet sekswerker vragen naar de leeftijd’

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked the government about an survey showing many sex workers say clients should check age and identity, the sentences in the Valkenburg case, and measures to deter clients. The Staatssecretaris answered that a client-focused package and campaign are coming, that the Penal Code will treat paid sex with minors as aggravating, and declined to discuss individual court sentences citing the separation of powers.
I attach great importance to the separation of powers and consider it inappropriate, from my position as Staatssecretaris of Justice and Security, to give an opinion on individual judicial rulings.

Ik hecht sterk aan de scheiding der machten en acht het vanuit mijn functie als de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid niet passend over individuele uitspraken van de rechter een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Kabinet werkt aan terughalen meer IS-vrouwen'

Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about reports that the cabinet is working to repatriate more IS women, whether the motion on this has been implemented, why there is no cabinet response to a WODC study on videoconferencing in criminal trials, how France, Italy and Switzerland use videoconferencing in terrorism cases, and whether suspects of terrorism offences can be tried by videoconference (citing ECtHR Dijkhuizen v. the Netherlands). Minister Grapperhaus answered that prosecution and accountability in court is the priority, that repatriation is weighed case by case, that the motion will be addressed in a letter of 4 November, that the WODC study is being discussed with stakeholders, and that whether physical presence can be waived is for the judge to decide in each individual case.
Whether the physical presence of a suspect can be waived in a particular individual case is for the judge to decide on the basis of the facts and circumstances of that individual case.

Of van de fysieke aanwezigheid van een verdachte in een bepaald individueel geval kan worden afgezien, is aan de rechter om te bepalen aan de hand van de feiten en omstandigheden van dat individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het overschrijven van een voertuig op een andere naam na overlijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether a vehicle can be re-registered after the owner's death using only the registration card and code, without checks on how these were obtained, and whether a blockade requiring a certificate of inheritance should be introduced. Minister Visser answered that the RDW does not check how the card and code were obtained, that a certificate of inheritance is required only when the code cannot be shown, and that a blockade would not fully solve the problem and would impose costs and delays on heirs.
I am not in favour of introducing a block on re-registration after death.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van om een blokkade voor overschrijving op te werpen na overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked about the COVID coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB) being required at a Deventer inloophuis, in lawyers' training, for journalists and officials, and whether the Van der Staaij amendment exempts public buildings. Minister Grapperhaus replied that CTB obligations apply only to specified venues, that buurt- en wijkcentra are largely exempt, that the occupational exemption in article 58ra covers journalists and officials when their work requires presence at a venue, and that no CTB applies at the town hall.
Buurt- and wijkcentra are exempt from the CTB requirement for events that form part of regular operations.
Voor buurt- en wijkcentra geldt een uitzondering op de CTB plicht voor evenementen die tot de reguliere exploitatie behoren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Grondwet, het coronatoegangsbewijs – en de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing daarvan – en lessen die Nederland kan trekken uit van de aanpak in Corona in Noorwegen, Zweden en D

An MP asked the ministers about constitutional review of COVID measures, the scientific basis for the corona access certificate, and lessons from Norway, Sweden and Denmark. The government replied that constitutional review is applied to new laws and measures, that the certificate is justified by vaccine effectiveness, that little scientific study exists yet and a research question has been set out, and that the OVV has sent no interim report.
It is not the cabinet's task to request an interim report from the OVV. It concerns independent research.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om een tussenrapportage bij de OVV op te vragen. Het gaat om onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Kuiken en De Hoop over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en China bij onderzoek naar DNA

MPs Kathmann, Kuiken and De Hoop asked whether Dutch scientists collaborated with Chinese researchers on DNA techniques that could predict appearance and whether results could be misused against Uyghurs and Tibetans, and asked about ethics review and risk screening. The minister said Erasmus MC and LUMC denied involvement in the specific China-linked studies, promised a meeting with institutions and an update in early 2022, and pointed to ongoing knowledge-security measures.
I will inform you in early 2022 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal u begin 2022 informeren over de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de voortgang afhandeling waterschade in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice and Security Minister about the progress of flood damage compensation in Limburg and Brabant, covering teeltplanschade interpretation, communication, helpdesks, processing times, turnover compensation, the Maas floodplains, EU solidarity funding, and climate resilience for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that productie loss is assessed per crop, outlined communication channels and a helpline, said turnover loss is not covered by the Wts and that a decision on compensation is still under exploration, and declined to set a timeline for some questions.
For determining crop plan damage, the production loss is assessed per company per production direction.
Voor de bepaling van de teeltplanschade wordt per bedrijf per productierichting gekeken naar het productieverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Rudmer Heerema en Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: riolen en bruggen kwetsbaar voor hackers’ in het Financieel Dagblad op 14 oktober 2021

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that sewer, bridge and lock control systems are vulnerable to hackers, including a case of a good-faith hacker taking over a city sewer system and delayed patching, and what the government has done on patching, procurement, threat sharing and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister acknowledges the vulnerabilities, reports no successful attacks or Wbni notifications at Rijkswaterstaat or ProRail in the past two years, and describes existing programmes, regulation and ongoing cooperation, while stating no specific case could be confirmed.
Inquiries show no further information is available about a case of a good-faith hacker who was able to take over the sewer system of a large municipality.
Uit navraag blijkt geen nadere informatie beschikbaar over een casus van een goedwillende hacker die het rioleringssysteem van een grote gemeente kon overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de inval in kalverslachterij Ekro door 269 Libération Animale

MP Van der Plas asked the Justice Minister about the September 2021 raid on veal slaughterhouse Ekro by 269 Libération Animale, including prior intelligence, whether the group should be classed as terrorist, and how such actions will be prevented. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no prior signals were received locally, that the actions are not terrorism under NCTV definitions, that existing tools will be used against lawbreaking, and that police and prosecutors have agreed a framework and closer information exchange with farm organisations.
I cannot make any statements about whether intelligence investigations are ongoing or not.
Over al dan niet lopende inlichtingenonderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht “Litouwen adviseert consument geen Xiaomi-telefoons meer te kopen”

Dutch MPs asked the government whether it knew of Lithuanian advice against buying Xiaomi phones over possible censorship software, whether Dutch authorities use Xiaomi devices, and whether risk analyses and investigations are planned. The government answered that it sees no reason for a similar warning now, that civil servants' procurement follows a risk-based framework with agencies responsible for their own choices, and that existing regulators could act if censorship were found to be active.
All government organisations are themselves responsible for their operations and for the security of information and information systems.
Alle overheidsorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering en de beveiliging van informatie en informatiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onduidelijkheid bij gemaakte afspraken door banken inzake het vergoeden van spoofingfraude

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about unclear bank commitments on compensating spoofing fraud, including the undefined term 'gross negligence' and possible differences between banks. The minister replied that banks use voluntary compensation criteria, that individual banks may be more generous, and that he will raise compensation with the banks again while working on an integrated approach to online fraud.
Given the customer confidentiality that applies to individual cases, I am not familiar with the details of individual spoofing cases and how the different banks have handled them.
Gezien de klantvertrouwelijkheid die geldt rondom individuele gevallen, ben ik niet bekend met de details van individuele spoofinggevallen en hoe deze door de verschillende banken zijn afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het manifest van Brabantse burgemeesters tegen ondermijnende criminaliteit

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a manifesto by Brabant mayors calling for a tougher approach to undermining crime, including softdrug legalisation and prevention of youth recruitment into crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government shares the urgency, cites new funding and a coffeeshop-chain experiment, and disagrees with legalising softdrugs before the experiment's results are known.
I am convinced that with these we contribute to strengthening our rule of law and making the Netherlands less attractive for organised drug crime.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat we hiermee bijdragen aan de versteviging van onze rechtsstaat en Nederland minder aantrekkelijk maken voor georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de digitale veiligheid onvoldoende is

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers whether they accepted findings that cybersecurity at hazardous-substance companies (Brzo) in Zuid-Holland is inadequate and what they would do. The ministers accepted that more attention to cybersecurity is needed, described shared responsibilities of companies, provinces and national departments, and listed existing measures such as NCSC support, Wbni designation and Digital Trust Center tools.
That is why it is important that companies get to work on this.
Daarom is het van belang dat bedrijven hier mee aan de slag gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Dierenbescherming haalt verwaarloosde paarden uit vieze stallen in gemeente Venlo’

An MP asked ministers about a 2021 case in Venlo where neglected horses were removed from a keeper who had earlier had 33 horses seized on Texel, and whether a longer or lifetime animal-keeping ban should apply. The government answered that it cannot discuss individual cases, defended the 10-year maximum ban in the pending bill as proportionate, and said enforcement would follow any new violation.
The bill provides that the criminal judge may, upon conviction for a criminal offence, impose an independent animal-keeping ban for a maximum duration of ten years.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de mogelijkheid voor de strafrechter om in geval van veroordeling wegens een strafbaar feit een zelfstandig houdverbod voor de maximale duur van tien jaar op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onrechtmatig handelen van de NCTV en de uitspraken van de minister dat dit niet het geval zou zijn

An SP MP asked whether internal legal advice showed that the NCTV acted unlawfully before the minister denied this in parliament, and why information and affected individuals were not handled earlier. The minister acknowledged that legal advice from March 2021 found the legal basis for certain NCTV data processing vulnerable, which led to suspending activities, while defending earlier practice and stating that a bill to strengthen the legal basis is being prioritised.

Through the Tasks and Legal Bases project, however, the NCTV itself came to the view that this general legal basis, given legal developments by current standards, must be classed as legally vulnerable.

Door het project Taken en Grondslagen kwam de NCTV echter zelf tot het inzicht dat die algemene rechtsgrondslag gezien de rechtsontwikkeling naar huidige maatstaven als juridisch kwetsbaar moet worden bestempeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het analyseren van data van de Proco-app

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the ProCo app data (police stop-and-check registrations) is used to analyse ethnic profiling, including retention, data detail, CBS collaboration and monitoring. The minister answered that the data is retained for five years, that the reason for checks is not recorded, that a joint study with CBS on ethnic profiling is in preparation, and that a monitoring instrument and further research are being developed.
As I informed the House in the first Police Half-Yearly Report 2021, further research into the use of the ProCo functionality will take place in 2022.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb bericht in het eerste Halfjaarbericht politie 2021zal er in 2022 nader onderzoek plaatsvinden naar het gebruik van de Proco-functionaliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekoek over juristen van de NCTV die oordeelden dat de eigen dienst onrechtmatig handelde bij het verzamelen van privacygevoelige gegevens over burgers

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why he did not act on signals from NCTV lawyers that the agency unlawfully collected and analysed privacy-sensitive data on citizens, and about the legal basis for that monitoring. The minister answered that internal legal discussion existed but a general legal basis was assumed, that the NCTV concluded the basis was legally vulnerable, that certain activities were suspended, and that a bill creating a specific statutory basis is forthcoming.
There is no list kept of that.
Daar is geen lijst van bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de noodzaak van consistent beleid ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid en het stellen van de juiste prioriteiten

An MP asks the Health and Justice ministers about the coronavirus entry pass, the government's protection of public health against pollution, pesticides, fast-food expansion and zoonotic risks from intensive livestock farming, and whether policy priorities are consistent. The minister defends the entry pass as a mitigating measure, says the government is strengthening zoonosis policy following an expert group report, and largely declines to characterise its own policy.
The cabinet is working on implementing the Clean Air Agreement.
Het kabinet werkt aan de uitvoering van het Schone Lucht akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over ‘een jaar stilte rond de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter’

PVV MPs asked why, a year after a Dutch navy ship inspected a merchant vessel for possible sanctions violations, the government still withholds the ship's name, flag and inspection location, and how long the prosecution will take. The Minister of Justice declined to give details of the individual criminal investigation, then said the case was closed without any sanctions violation found and that neither the EU nor the UN was involved.
As is known, I do not provide information of this kind from individual criminal investigations.
Over dergelijke informatie uit individuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik zoals bekend geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Problemen met kwetsbare 112-meldkamers na zes jaar nog niet opgelost'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that vulnerabilities in the 112 emergency call centres remain unresolved six years after inspection recommendations, including governance, staffing, risk management and ICT. The minister answers that the recommendations are endorsed and largely being implemented, that remaining issues are long-term and will be addressed, and points to a governance evaluation due in 2022 and planned consolidation of centres by 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de situatie van Jezidische slachtoffers

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Dutch government about the precarious situation of Yazidi victims of IS, including women with children from IS rapists, and whether the Netherlands should create an asylum programme like Germany, France and Canada. The government acknowledged likely genocide and described support programmes, explained that resettlement is UNHCR-led and that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission programme, and outlined revised asylum assessment practice for Yazidis; it did not answer the final question on timing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Tekort van ruim 150 miljoen bij politie: ‘Ontzettend pijnlijk juist nu te bezuinigen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported 150+ million euro police budget shortfall for 2021, its causes, the measures needed to stay within budget, and its link to planned investments. The minister answered that the overrun was projected at 80-157 million, a task force produced cost-cutting measures such as a vacancy freeze and purchasing freeze, and an independent follow-up study is due in November.
In November this independent report is expected to be delivered.
In november wordt deze onafhankelijke rapportage naar verwachting opgeleverd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid van Nispen over ‘de ernstige financiële tekorten bij de politie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a projected police budget overrun of 157 million euros, a vacancy and purchasing freeze, and whether cuts threaten police capacity and safety. The minister answered that the overrun has been reduced to about 80 million, a task force report was produced and published, an independent follow-up study was commissioned, and essential services are protected from cuts, but withheld the full timing of decisions pending that study.
The police and I have jointly commissioned an independent follow-up study into as objective a picture as possible, shared by all parties, of the police's current financial position.

De politie en ik hebben bovendien gezamenlijk opdracht gegeven tot een onafhankelijk vervolgonderzoek naar een zo objectief mogelijk en door alle betrokkenen gedeeld beeld van hoe de politie er nu financieel voor staat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misleidende praktijken van Multi-level Marketing (MLM)-bedrijven

An MP asked the government about misleading practices of multi-level marketing companies, including unrealistic income promises, medical claims, possible pyramid schemes, bogus self-employment and lack of transparency. The minister answered that MLM is a lawful sales method subject to consumer protection rules enforced by the ACM and NVWA, that existing law suffices and no amendment of the gambling law or new disclosure duties are planned.
I currently see no reason for additional information obligations.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende informatieverplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters kijken nog steeds uit naar coronasteun’

MPs asked the government about religious institutions such as monasteries, churches and mosques that reportedly struggle with lost income and get little corona support. The government answered that religious organisations can use the TVL and NOW schemes on the same terms as others, reported 79 religious TVL applications (66 granted, EUR 1,001,482), and said it had held talks with religious umbrella bodies.
For the NOW, it was not separately registered whether religious institutions made use of the NOW.
Voor de NOW is niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of religieuze instellingen gebruik hebben gemaakt van de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Erotisch ‘kinderboek’ Drs. P zorgt na vijftig jaar voor woede bij BN’ers’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a controversial erotic children's book by Drs. P and where the legal line lies between protected fiction and incitement to child abuse, and what priorities should be set against child sexual abuse. The minister answered that only incitement to a concrete offence crosses the criminal line, that the planned offence on preparatory acts targets instructional material rather than literary works, and that a broad, multi-pronged approach including internet regulation is being pursued.
The criminal boundary is crossed when artistic freedom is abused to deliberately incite, stir up or urge a concrete criminal offence, such as sexual child abuse.

De strafrechtelijke grens wordt overschreden wanneer artistieke vrijheid wordt misbruikt om opzettelijk aan te zetten, aan te hitsen of aan te sporen tot een concreet strafbaar feit, zoals seksueel kindermisbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de herpublicatie van het boek ‘Allerlei Ontucht’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the republication of the book 'Allerlei Ontucht', which may glorify or normalise child sexual abuse, should be banned or withdrawn, and what approach is needed on paedophilia and child abuse awareness. The minister answered that such texts are not per se criminal unless they incite a crime, that a planned offence on preparatory instructive material is coming to parliament, that literary works should not be censored, and listed prevention, public-private cooperation and enforcement measures.
It must be prevented that censorship is unintentionally imposed on books and other literary works, even when these works must be considered absolutely indecent and contrary to current moral views.

Voorkomen moet worden dat onbedoeld censuur wordt opgelegd op boeken en andere literaire werken, ook wanneer deze werken absoluut ontuchtig en in strijd met de huidige morele opvattingen moeten worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opmars van ondergronds bankieren

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the rise of underground hawala banking, its size, police capacity to trace it, and international action. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged the trend, said exact volumes are unknown, described police capacity and international cooperation efforts, and gave no concrete new commitment.
There are no exact figures on the size of underground banking in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen exacte cijfers over de omvang van ondergronds bankieren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Piri over de evacuatie uit Afghanistan

MPs Omtzigt and Piri asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuation, including embassy correspondence, meeting records, military protection, Council of Ministers decisions, EUPOL interpreters and a promised independent inquiry. The ministers answered most questions substantively, provided some documents with redactions, declined to provide phone-call records because none exist, and committed to establishing an independent inquiry commission.
The cabinet will establish an independent external temporary commission to investigate the crisis approach, including the evacuations of the recent period.
Antwoord 17 Een onafhankelijke externe commissie van tijdelijke aard om onderzoek toe doen naar de crisisaanpak inclusief de evacuaties van de afgelopen periode zal door het kabinet worden ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de mogelijkheid van vervolging van klanten van minderjarige cocaïnedealers

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice whether prosecution of buyers of cocaine from minors should be prioritised, whether legislation should raise penalties for such buyers, and what practical or legal obstacles exist. The Minister answered that buyers and sellers are already liable to prosecution, that local police set priorities, that capacity is the main constraint and is being addressed, and that existing law already allows heavier sentences for minor sellers so no legal change is needed.
I do not consider amending the law necessary for that reason.
Aanpassing van de wet acht ik om die reden niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de manier waarop verder uitvoering gegeven wordt aan de motie-Belhaj en het beleid ten aanzien van Afghaanse vluchtelingen en ontheemden

An MP asks ministers how they assess which Afghan applicants fall under the Belhaj motion categories, what is being done with thousands of emails, whether those stranded in neighbouring countries can seek Dutch protection, and related questions on NGO lists, coalition burden-sharing, Croatia Dublin transfers and aid. The government answers that a special scheme for two groups is planned, the mailbox was closed with about 20,000 unique addresses sorted, the Vreemdelingencirculaire will be amended, and it cites Dutch engagement with allies and aid organisations.
All persons who sent a message to kabul@minbuza.nl will be informed of this by email.
Alle personen die een bericht hebben gestuurd naar kabul@minbuza.nl zullen hierover per e-mail worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Bikker, Ceder en Segers aan over de Afghaanse heroïnehandel en de rol van Nederland

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Segers asked ministers about the Taliban's income from Afghan heroin trade and whether the Netherlands, as a Europe-wide transit hub, bears responsibility and can act. The government said the Netherlands plays an unintended role in the heroin market, that a causal link to Taliban financing is hard to establish, and that it is pursuing a joint EU and national approach through EMPACT, the drugs strategy and a security dialogue with Turkey.

Because of its infrastructure, its current role as a producing and transit country for drugs, and the role of Dutch criminals in the drug industry, the Netherlands unintentionally also plays a role in the European heroin market.

Nederland vervult vanwege haar infrastructuur, huidige rol als productie- en doorvoerland van drugs en de rol van Nederlandse criminelen in de drugsindustrie, ongewild ook een rol in de Europese heroïnemarkt.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het illegaal vangen van zwanen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about illegal capture of swans, including how many cases occur, how the ban on swan drives is enforced, and the number of reports received. The minister answered that the ministry lacks the data, that provinces and police are responsible for enforcement, and that reports to the NVWA and police are listed, while admitting a late reply on earlier questions.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) does not have this data.
Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het afwijzen van de asielaanvraag van MH17-getuigen

SP MPs asked why the IND rejected asylum applications from two witnesses in the MH17 case and whether they are adequately protected. The Secretary of State declined to discuss individual cases, explained that IND and witness-team assessments follow different frameworks, and said the OM handles relevance of witness testimony and protection.
I do not provide information about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid de mogelijkheden onderzoekt om verzekeraars te verbieden om losgeld te vergoeden bij slachtoffers van een ransomware

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether the ministry is studying a ban on insurers reimbursing ransom payments after ransomware attacks, and about the government's stance on paying ransom and prevention. The minister confirms that a ban on insurers covering ransoms is being investigated with no decision yet, maintains the advice not to pay, and says there is no plan to legally ban ransom payments, emphasizing prevention.
At this moment there is no intention to legally prohibit ransom payments.
Op dit moment is er geen voornemen om losgeldbetalingen wettelijk te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over het bericht dat verdachtenverhoor bij de politie tekortschiet

MP Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about a report that police interrogations of suspects fall short, and why the OM replaced its recording directive with a non-public instruction. Minister Grapperhaus rejected the claim of insufficient interrogator skill, explained that the directive was converted into an instruction under a broader OM policy cleanup, and defended not publishing instructions since they have no external effect.
Instructions as such have no external effect; third parties cannot derive rights from them.
Instructies hebben als zodanig geen externe werking; derden kunnen er geen rechten aan ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Woede om zoektocht Halsema naar ’waarnemers’ bij preventief fouilleren: ’Klap in gezicht agenten’’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about Amsterdam's use of citizen observers during preventive stop-and-search operations and whether this undermines trust in police, and asked about wapen-related youth violence and the evaluation of the measure. The minister explained the legal basis, said the local authority decides on observers, stated confidence in police professionalism, and committed to an evaluation including surveys of observers and residents.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kwaliteit en het opnemen van politieverhoren

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister about the quality of police suspect interviews, recording of interviews, withdrawal of the OM instruction on recording, and treatment of people with mild intellectual disabilities. The minister denies the quality problems, says recording is not feasible for all interviews, and defends the withdrawal of the OM directive as not weakening suspects' rights.
The importance of audiovisual recording lies mainly in the right to a fair trial, as laid down in Article 6 ECHR.
Het belang van audiovisuele registratie is met name gelegen in het recht op een eerlijk proces, zoals neergelegd in artikel 6 EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over ‘de trage voortgang van de onderzoeken naar de Deventer moordzaak’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why the Amsterdam cold case team had not finished its investigation into the Deventer murder case two years after it began, what steps had been taken since October 2020, and when the investigations would be concluded. The Minister, relaying the Procurator-General's reply, explained the sequence of the investigation, said the Procurator-General is independent and responsible for steering the work, and expected first results within four months and a second phase of a few months more.
The PG remains responsible for the investigation and it is for the PG and AG to steer the progress of individual cases.
De PG blijft verantwoordelijk voor het onderzoek en het is aan de PG en AG om te sturen op de voortgang van individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat de politie zonder wettelijke basis automobilisten en bijrijders heeft gefotografeerd voor opsporing

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked the Justice Minister about reports that police photographed drivers and passengers' faces without a legal basis for investigations, and how oversight, retention and evidence use are handled. Minister Grapperhaus disputes that faces were photographed without basis, explains the ANPR legal grounds and the decision to blur all personal images, notes three cases of unblurred photos being shared, and says the evaluation and oversight by the AP and internal bodies apply.
With regard to the question, I want to emphasise that there is by no means any unlawful surveillance.
Ten aanzien van de vraagstelling wil ik benadrukken dat geenszins sprake is van onrechtmatige surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over stropers

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a poaching network in Limburg, including the methods used, the seizures, detection rates and reports, and the number of animals killed. The minister condemned the practices but declined to share operational details, gave aggregated report and case figures, said animal totals cannot be reliably counted, and did not commit to a new national study.
I cannot share further information with your House, as I cannot go into individual cases or investigative information.
Meer informatie kan ik niet met uw Kamer delen aangezien ik niet in kan gaan op individuele gevallen of opsporingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er geen gerechtstolk Fries meer beschikbaar is om financiële redenen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the government was aware that Frisian court interpreters had stopped working over low pay and why it allowed this, and what it would do to restore access to justice in Frisian. Minister Dekker answered that the new tariff and contracting system will let interpreters negotiate rates with intermediaries, that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors provide access, and that a website and monitoring will follow, without committing to raise pay now.
I regret that the sworn interpreters and translators registered in the Register of Sworn Interpreters and Translators have decided to stop providing interpreting services for the judicial system.
Ik betreur het dat de in het Register beëdigde tolken en vertalers ingeschreven tolken Fries op dit moment hebben besloten geen tolkdiensten meer te verrichten ten behoeve van de rechtspleging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Personeel gevangenis Zaandam op dodenlijst´

An MP asked whether the government is aware of reports that staff of Zaandam prison appeared on a death list and what it will do to protect them and their families. The minister confirmed awareness, described a staff meeting, the ongoing police and prosecution investigation, individual talks and existing security measures, without announcing new concrete steps.
On Monday 23 August, all staff of the department where the list was found gathered with the prison management.
Op maandag 23 augustus jl. zijn alle medewerkers van de afdeling waar de lijst werd aangetroffen bij elkaar gekomen met de directie van de inrichting.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Geurts over het NOS bericht ‘Intern onderzoek Rijkswaterstaat: files sluiting Haringvlietbrug veel langer dan gedacht’ en de bijbehorende kamerbrieven ‘Extra reistijd Har

MPs De Groot and Geurts asked why the Haringvlietbrug closure causes longer delays than expected, what measures will reduce them, and why the two-lane variant and the bridge repair are not faster. The minister explains that the delay estimate was revised upward, that traffic management and enforcement were arranged quickly, and that the bridge replacement is already accelerated, while acknowledging no quick fix for the clamps exists yet.
Rijkswaterstaat aims to involve the region and stakeholders in a timely manner, depending on the nature of the works, the nuisance and urgency.
Rijkswaterstaat zet erop in om de regio en belanghebbenden al naar gelang de aard van de werkzaamheden, de hinder en urgentie steeds en tijdig te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de invoering van grenscontroles

An MP asked whether border checks for COVID certificates at the Dutch-Belgian border show that border controls can be introduced quickly, and about their costs and effect on other Marechaussee tasks. The government answered that these checks rest on the Public Health Act rather than Schengen border controls, cost about 550,000 euro until end 2021, were staffed by the KMar only until 31 August, and that controls against illegal migration are not currently needed given strict conditions for internal border controls.
These checks are not internal border controls within the legal framework of the Schengen Borders Code.
Deze controles zijn geen binnengrenscontroles in het juridisch kader van de Schengen-grenscode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het bericht 'Tweede Duitse coach weggestuurd uit Tokio na mishandeling paard'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a German coach's mistreatment of a horse at the Tokyo Olympics constitutes animal abuse, and about whipping, bit use, horse trade fraud, subsidies and a national horse welfare decree. The minister condemned the conduct, said whip use as punishment is not customary and that enforcement follows existing frameworks, but declined a dedicated horse welfare law and deferred answers on several points.
I am of the view that deploying specific, additional legislation on horse welfare does not contribute to better welfare for horses or to accelerating the process.
Ik ben van mening dat het inzetten van specifieke, aanvullende wetgeving voor paardenwelzijn niet bijdraagt aan beter welzijn voor paarden of versnelling van het proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het reinigen van de woning van een dierbare na een geweldsincident of zelfmoord

MP Van Nispen asks whether next of kin should be responsible for and bear the cost of cleaning a home after a violent incident or suicide, and whether a national policy or fund is needed. The ministers agree the situation is distressing and not reasonably expected of relatives, estimate about fifty cases a year, and commit to talks with Slachtofferhulp Nederland, police, the prosecution service and the Schadefonds to map practice before deciding on any extra measure.
Cleaning the home after such an incident can in principle not reasonably be expected of next of kin.
Het reinigen van de woning na een dergelijk incident kan in beginsel redelijkerwijs niet van nabestaanden verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het kabinet ondanks Kamermeerderheid nog geen verbod op homogenezing wil

An SP MP asks why the cabinet will not criminalise conversion therapy (homogenezing) despite a parliamentary majority, what concrete action it will take, and whether a code of conduct and support centres are enough. The minister replies that a broad exploration of effective measures, including a possible legal ban, will be carried out with results expected in early 2022, while a code of conduct and support points are being developed.
For that reason the cabinet will carry out a broad exploration of possible effective further measures, including the option of some form of legal ban.
Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, inclusief de optie voor enige vorm van wettelijk verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de toename van drugsgebruik onder studenten

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Justice and Health about rising student drug use, cocaine in particular, and how the care system and monitoring respond. The State Secretary answered that no national student-specific data exist yet, pointed to a monitor due in autumn 2021, acknowledged missing addiction-care data due to a stalled LADIS database, and described prevention programmes and funding.
There are currently no national figures on drug use specifically among the student population.
Er zijn op dit moment geen landelijke cijfers over het middelengebruik onder specifiek de studentenpopulatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Mokumse homohater vaak een allochtoon'

MP Eerdmans asked the ministers whether they acknowledge that anti-gay aggression in Amsterdam is often committed by young men of non-Dutch background, and what policy changes would follow. The government answered that the Amsterdam study is limited in scope, that an updated national study on perpetrators is underway, and that repression, prevention and municipal cooperation are part of the approach.
The cited action research, however, relates only to the Amsterdam situation and moreover has limited scope.
Het aangehaalde Actieonderzoek heeft echter alleen betrekking op de Amsterdamse situatie en het heeft bovendien een beperkte reikwijdte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat documentatie van woningen zeer gemakkelijk op te vragen is

An MP asked whether building drawings of homes, including those of public figures under protection, can be requested too easily and whether this enables burglaries. The minister answered that building files are public under the Wob and Archiefwet, that municipalities may restrict access via exclusion lists for risk objects, and that she will consult the VNG but sees no need for new identity checks.
Providing building drawings is a responsibility of municipalities.
Het verstrekken van bouwtekeningen is een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het toezicht op en van advocatenkantoor Houthoff op haar cliënten

The MP asked the ministers whether a major Dutch law firm, Houthoff, was adequately supervised for client due diligence and anti-money-laundering compliance after press reports of weak checks and profit over compliance. The government answered that the firm was inspected in 2019 with no irregularities found beyond administrative recommendations, that supervision lies with the local bar dean and the BFT, and that it is not for the minister to order further investigation.
Houthoff was inspected by the supervisor in 2019 as part of a thematic investigation into law firms' compliance with the Wwft.
Houthoff is in het kader van een thematisch onderzoek naar de naleving van de Wwft door advocatenkantoren in 2019 doorgelicht door de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Expert fileert kabinetsplan voor nieuw rechercheteam: ‘Blunder van jewelste’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether he had ignored expert criticism of the planned Multidisciplinary Intervention Team (MIT) against organised crime and whether the money would be better spent on existing police investigation capacity. The minister replied that the expert's concerns about overlapping tasks were considered in planning, that the MIT is a cooperation framework adding value without changing existing legal tasks, and that funding is justified as a shared overhead-wide need.
The MIT is not, as Prof. Dr. Fijnaut claims, a new investigation team/unit, but a multidisciplinary cooperation of six parties.
Het MIT is daarbij niet, zoals prof. Dr. Fijnaut stelt, een nieuw(e) rechercheteam/eenheid, maar een multidisciplinair samenwerkingsverband van zes partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de achterstanden bij de zedenrecherche en de gevolgen daarvan voor de slachtoffers

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about backlogs at the sex crimes police unit, including a child abuse report waiting 21 months, whether the suspect was interviewed, how priority is set, and recruitment of specialist investigators. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, acknowledged rising backlogs with 820 reports pending over six months, described priority rules and training and recruitment measures, and committed to a backlog reduction plan.
As your House knows, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Taliban veroveren Kandahar, tweede stad van Afghanistan’

MP Kuik asked the Justice Minister whether the Taliban's takeover of Kandahar could lead to Dutch jihadist travellers and what preparations exist, and how the pending bill criminalising stay in a terrorist-controlled area would help. The minister said no signals of Dutch travellers were known, outlined existing travel-blocking tools, and said it was too early to say whether Afghan areas would be designated, while the bill's handling was deferred and a separate exemption bill is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Achterstand van honderden zedenzaken bij politie Midden-Nederland’

MPs Bikker, Michon-Derkzen and Ellemeet asked about reported backlogs of sexual offence cases at the Midden-Nederland police, the progress of the motion-Klaver capacity funding, support for victims and police staff. Minister Grapperhaus answered that 820 cases nationally (233 in Midden-Nederland) have been pending over six months, that capacity expansion and shortened training are underway with full staffing targeted for 2023, and that victim support and staff welfare measures exist, while acknowledging the backlog persists.
Of course, I will inform your House about progress in this area.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer over de voortgang op dit terrein informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een vrouw wordt bedreigd door undercoveragenten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that an innocent woman was threatened by undercover police officers, asking about proportionality, legal basis, number of similar cases, and planned rules. The minister declined to comment on the individual case due to ongoing appeal proceedings, explained the legal framework for systematic information gathering, and said he could not provide figures on how often the method was used.
First of all, I want to emphasise that it is not appropriate for me as Minister to give opinions on individual criminal cases, especially when legal proceedings are still ongoing.
Allereerst hecht ik eraan te benadrukken dat het mij als Minister niet past oordelen te geven over individuele strafzaken, in het bijzonder wanneer er nog juridische procedures lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat Nederland op de vingers is getikt door Brussel vanwege het niet strafbaar stellen van ontkenning Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the Netherlands has not criminalised Holocaust denial after EU pressure, and whether a bill will be introduced to address it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that such denial is already punishable under Article 137c of the Criminal Code per Supreme Court case law, but that the Commission considers this insufficiently explicit, so a wording amendment via a re-implementation bill is being prepared.
In response, the Commission was informed that the Netherlands sees reason in the Commission's position to prepare a bill.
In reactie hierop is de Commissie bericht dat Nederland in het standpunt van de Commissie aanleiding ziet om een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Er woedt een machtsstrijd boven het euthanasiebed’

Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a dispute between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees (RTE) over how the Euthanasia Act should be interpreted, including the November 2020 euthanasia code, legal certainty, and the position of incapacitated patients. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged the lack of uniform interpretation as undesirable, stated the RTE and OM have distinct statutory roles, noted ongoing consultation and that the fourth evaluation will examine the issue, while showing restraint given the cabinet's caretaker status.
In view of this, I consider it important that the RTE and the OM interpret the Wtl unambiguously.
Gelet daarop acht ik het van belang dat de RTE en het OM de Wtl eenduidig uitleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onzekerheid voor getroffen Limburgse ondernemers, 'meer omzetverlies dan waterschade''

CDA MPs asked for an update on flood damage in Limburg and Brabant, including economic losses from revenue loss, the state of compensation, the EU Solidarity Fund, local helplines and the coordinating minister. Minister Grapperhaus answered that economic loss is still poorly understood, that the Wts compensation scheme entered into force on 9 September 2021 with 1,135 reports so far, that a decision on the EU Solidarity Fund will follow by end of September, and that the Justice Minister coordinates the response while other ministers handle their own areas.
The cabinet is in discussion with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives to get a better picture of the economic damage.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers om een beter beeld van de economische schade te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over de schadevergoeding na de wateroverlast in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked why the compensation area for the July 2021 flood damage in Limburg and North Brabant does not match the area actually affected, and whether businesses outside it should be compensated. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that compensation is limited to the legally defined damage area under the Wts, that businesses outside it cannot be covered under current law, and that the government will discuss turnover losses with the region in the fourth quarter.
Outside this area there is no disaster as referred to here.
Buiten dit gebied is er geen sprake van een ramp als hiervoor bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie harde kritiek heeft op de euthanasierichtlijn
