An SGP MP asked ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service's criticism of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees' revised code, and rising euthanasia notifications with few 'careless' rulings, were acceptable. The government answered that it will not publish the prosecutor-general's letter, that the RTE acted without the OM and IGJ, and that a new code, a fourth law evaluation and discussion with the OM are planned, though transparency and independent research were deferred.
It is not fitting for my colleague the Minister of Justice and Security to make public letters from the procurator-general addressed to him.
Het past mijn ambtgenoot van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om brieven van de procureur-generaal die aan hem zijn gericht, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Meerdere mensen overleden door zelfdoding-middel, verkoper uit Eindhoven (28) opgepakt’

An ChristenUnie MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about reports of deaths from a suicide agent (Middel X) sold via the Coöperatie Laatste Wil and an Eindhoven seller, and whether sale to individuals should be banned. The government answers that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that existing voluntary industry monitoring is kept, that a ban is not pursued because legal regulation is complicated and possibly counterproductive, and that the VWS ministry will consult the industry code parties again.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide any information on this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Van der Staaij over de verkoop van zelfmoordpoeder

Two MPs asked the health and justice ministers why suicide powder sold on Marktplaats and by a Eindhoven seller was not restricted despite deaths, and whether the ban or criminal law should be tightened. The minister answered that the industry code is being reviewed, that new legislation would be counterproductive and disproportionate, that the criminal penalty for assisting suicide is justified, and declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation into the Coöperatie Laatste Wil network.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, we cannot make any statements about this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kunnen wij hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de berechting in Nederland van verdachten van in het buitenland gepleegde strafbare feiten

MP Ellian asked the Justice Minister about the Spanish judge handing the Mallorca killing case of Carlo Heuvelman to the Dutch prosecution service, whether such decisions should be public, and whether the OM urged prosecution in the Netherlands. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such decisions are not normally public, that the OM did not push for Dutch prosecution, and declined to comment on the suspects' detention status.
The OM has confirmed to me that it did not push for prosecution of the suspects in the Netherlands.
Het OM heeft aan mij bevestigd dat het niet heeft aangestuurd op berechting van de verdachten in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Van Ginneken over een lek van privéadressen van volksvertegenwoordigers en politieke en maatschappelijke organisaties door de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Simons and Van Ginneken asked ministers about a leak of private home addresses of MPs and political and civil-society organisations via the Chamber of Commerce, in which a former lawyer had unlawfully retrieved about 1,785 addresses. The government answered that the lawyer's authorisation was revoked, a criminal complaint filed, the police investigate, and that authorisations are being audited and address protections expanded.
Following the unauthorised retrieval, the Chamber of Commerce filed a criminal complaint against the lawyer.
De KVK heeft naar aanleiding van de onbevoegde opvraging aangifte gedaan tegen de advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat Amsterdam een tekort aan rechters en officieren van justitie heeft

MP Van Nispen asked the ministers about reports that Amsterdam's courts and prosecution service face shortages of judges, prosecutors and funds, and about budget compensation for case complexity, experiments and digitalisation. The ministers answer that staffing shortages are tied to a tight labour market and turnover, that the problem affects all districts, that funding is set via price and volume agreements with the judiciary and prosecution, and that no new short-term funding is committed while the cabinet is caretaker.
The starting point is that the current caretaker cabinet does not anticipate decision-making on possible investments by a next cabinet.
Uitgangspunt hierbij is dat het huidige demissionaire kabinet niet vooruit loopt op besluitvorming over mogelijke investeringen door een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Onvoldoende steun voor gedragscode conversietherapie’

MPs Van der Woude and Van der Laan asked why a proposed code of conduct on conversion therapy for LGBTI people failed to gain support from religious umbrella bodies. The Minister says it is too early to speak of failure, reports that CIO and CMO declined to participate, and commits to a broader exploration of measures, including possible legal prohibition.
The cabinet will carry out a broad but targeted exploration of possible, effective further measures, including legislation and regulations.
Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede, maar gerichte verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, waaronder wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat criminelen een slaatje proberen te slaan uit oververhitte woningmarkt

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that criminals are exploiting the overheated housing market through fake rental sites, asking about complaint volumes, prevention, enforcement and the ACM investigation. The minister answered that fraud reports are stable, prevention campaigns were run, the ACM investigation is ongoing with results expected in spring 2022, and no additional criminal-law measures are deemed necessary now.

That is why it is very good that the national police Internet Fraud Reporting Point, the Fraud Helpdesk and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) each act from their own role against this problem.

Het is daarom heel goed dat het Landelijk Meldpunt Internetoplichting van de politie, de Fraudehelpdesk en de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) ieder vanuit hun eigen rol optreden tegen deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de tarieven, de kwaliteit en de aanbestedingen van tolk- en vertaaldiensten door politie en justitie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the emergency list of interpreters used by police and justice, interpreter tariffs, quality, and a gag clause preventing interpreters from discussing rates set by AVB. The minister explained the emergency list is limited to urgent situations under monitoring, denied any fine clause, and committed to reporting on monitoring in mid-2022.
This always happens in consultation and with approval from the client, and is recorded in writing with reasons given.
Dit gebeurt altijd in overleg en na goedkeuring met de opdrachtgever en wordt schriftelijk vastgelegd en met redenen omkleed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een familie die vermalen wordt in de molens van de overheid

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) asked why a family was harmed by government action over a small cannabis plantation, including Tax Authority estimates, closure of their home under article 13b Opiumwet, and denial of subsidised legal aid. The ministers declined to discuss the specific case, citing tax secrecy and the judge's role, defended the legal framework and noted ongoing evaluations and a planned legal-aid review.
A specific case cannot be discussed.
Er kan niet worden ingegaan op een specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het schietincident bij de ggz-locatie Parnassia

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers about a shooting at a mental health facility, whether the perpetrator's firearm permit had been revoked, whether such persons should be monitored, and how to protect mental health staff from violence. The government answered that the permit was withdrawn and weapons seized, that revoked-permit holders are not specifically monitored under the Firearms Act though past compulsory-care records are weighed in new applications, that no reliable violence statistics exist, and that it will work with sector partners on reporting and a police-mental health cooperation protocol.
Violence against care workers is not subject to a reporting obligation and is not recorded in a uniform way in police systems.
Geweld tegen hulpverleners is niet meldingsplichtig en wordt niet op een eenduidige manier vastgelegd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een lading onderschepte munitie op vliegveld Beek

MP Van Dijk asked the government about a shipment of 500,000 pistol cartridges intercepted at Maastricht Aachen Airport in January 2021 that lacked Dutch permits. The government answered the facts of the seizure and consent, but declined to say whether any criminal investigation exists, citing the Justice Minister's policy.
As you know, the Minister of Justice and Security makes no statements on whether criminal investigations (against certain persons) are ongoing.
Zoals u weet, doet de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen uitspraken over de vraag of er strafrechtelijke onderzoeken (tegen bepaalde personen) lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat het financieel steunen van IS niet wordt bestraft

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about the Limburg court's acquittal of two suspects on terrorism financing and participation in a terrorist organisation, and whether judges should be dismissed or elected. Minister Grapperhaus declined to comment on the specific case, said the public prosecution service will appeal, and rejected dismissing judges over a ruling or changing the law because the judiciary is independent.

In the Netherlands we have an independent judiciary; this means among other things that judges are not elected and that judges cannot be dismissed if the content of their ruling is unwelcome to parties or others.

In Nederland kennen we een onafhankelijke rechterlijke macht; dat betekent onder meer dat rechters niet worden gekozen en dat rechters niet kunnen worden ontslagen als de inhoud van hun uitspraak partijen of anderen onwelgevallig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries en de advocaten van de kroongetuige

An SP MP asked the Justice minister about the security arrangements for journalist Peter R. de Vries and the lawyers of the crown witness, including whether risks were known, why Joustra was chosen to lead an inquiry, and whether his independence was questioned. The minister answered that the Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid will take on the inquiry, that the independence of the investigation is protected, and that security measures were intensified after the attack.
Given the OVV's earlier-announced task and the importance of careful, adequate and independent investigation, the cabinet does not wish to anticipate any conclusions.
Gezien de eerder gemelde taak van de OVV en het belang van zorgvuldig, adequaat en onafhankelijk onderzoek, wil het kabinet niet op eventuele conclusies vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Verdachte chauffeur dodelijk ongeval Waalhaven reed eerder motoragent en fietsster aan’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Groot asked about reports that the suspect driver in a fatal Waalhaven crash had earlier struck a police motorcycle officer and a cyclist, and about prosecution, traffic-law classification, recidivism and police motorcycle safety. The Minister said the criminal investigation is ongoing and gave limited details, noting one earlier conviction, one case dismissed, and that police motorcycle training and evaluation are in place.
As there is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter in particular.
Aangezien er sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan ik over deze kwestie in het bijzonder geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Werf, Kuik, Bikker en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the investigation into protection of Peter R. de Vries should be broadened to earlier victims and whether the inquiry commission should be fully independent with an additional criminal-law expert. The minister answered that the Safety Board (OVV) will investigate lessons from protection of the brother, lawyer and confidant of the Marengo witness, and that the broader scope fits an OVV inquiry rather than the previously planned commission, while not doubting the commission members' suitability.

I have asked the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) to take on an investigation into the lessons that can be drawn from the security situations of the brother, the then lawyer and the confidant of the crown witness in the Marengo trial.

Ik heb de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid (OVV) gevraagd om het op zich te nemen in een onderzoek na te gaan welke lessen getrokken kunnen worden uit de beveiligingssituaties van de broer, de toenmalig advocaat en de vertrouwenspersoon van de kroongetuige in het Marengo-proces.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuiken en Kathmann inzake de mishandeling van een veertienjarig meisje

MPs Kuiken and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister how he views the assault on a 14-year-old girl, whether he will publicly condemn it and reach out to the victim, and whether a higher maximum sentence for discriminatory motive should be introduced. The minister condemns discrimination in general, declines to comment on the criminal case under investigation, and states that a statutory discriminatory-motive aggravating factor would bring clear benefits, pointing to a pending member's bill.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation in this case, I cannot make further statements about it.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek in deze casus kan ik daar verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over risico’s voor het MH17-onderzoek

MP De Roon asks the government whether reports of the dismissal of the Ukrainian prosecutor leading the MH17 investigation put the investigation at risk, and what it will do about it. The minister answers that cooperation with Ukraine remains good, that personnel changes have not affected the investigation's priority or progress, that the government will not interfere in Ukraine's internal personnel matters, but will keep stressing the importance of cooperation.
It is not for the cabinet to interfere in the internal personnel matters of the Ukrainian Public Prosecution Service.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om zich te mengen in de interne personele aangelegenheden van het Oekraïense Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de politie zich zorgen maakt over de toename van zelfgemaakte bommen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police concern over a rise in homemade bombs, whether further measures are planned, whether explosive precursors can be banned like drug precursors, whether police have enough capacity, and whether enough is done against illegal fireworks. The minister answered that the tightened EU precursor regulation took effect in February 2021, that enforcement is shared with the ILT, that police capacity is limited but priorities are set, and that illegal fireworks enforcement is being intensified with more seizures in 2020.
Activities involving serious danger, such as the possible production of explosives, are given priority.
Activiteiten met een ernstige gevaarzetting zoals het mogelijk produceren van explosieven krijgen prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over de verplichte acceptatie van een coffeeshop door ABN AMRO als klant

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked whether coffee shops buying cannabis in cash fall under the Dutch anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), how many unusual-transaction reports coffee shops filed, whether prosecutions followed, and why supervision differs from other traders. The minister says coffee shops may fall under the Wwft above EUR 10,000 but that Wwft supervision of their soft-drug purchases is not applied in line with the tolerance policy, no coffee shop reports appear in FIU data, and a regulated cannabis supply experiment is planned.
Wwft supervision of coffee shops is carried out in line with the tolerance policy.
Het Wwft-toezicht op coffeeshops wordt in lijn met het gedoogbeleid uitgeoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, De Neef en Valstar over de mishandeling en het dumpen van huisdieren

MPs Ellian, De Neef and Valstar asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about rising animal abuse and dumping of pets during the coronavirus crisis and what the government would do. The minister answered that reports rose in 2020 but shelters saw no national increase in intake, outlined existing reporting and expertise arrangements, and said the animal-abuse ownership ban bill had been submitted to parliament.
The bill was submitted to your House on 15 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 15 juli jl. bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het missen van een huwelijksplechtigheid door coronamaatregelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a Colombian couple's wedding guests, including the bride's parents and brother-in-law, could not enter the Netherlands under the EU entry ban despite full vaccination and negative tests, and whether rules would be made more uniform and an exception granted. The minister confirmed the rules, said weddings are not an exception category and that Colombia's high-risk status blocks vaccinated travellers, and answered the final question only by reference to earlier answers.
Attending a wedding by (third-country national) parents or a brother-in-law does not fall under the exception categories for the entry ban.
Het bijwonen van een huwelijk door (derdelander) ouders of een zwager valt niet onder de uitzonderingscategorieën op het inreisverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Dit ging mis met NL-Alerts bij de brand in Noordbergum: opnieuw was de computer met een update bezig’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aukje de Vries asked about a NL-Alert failure during a fire in Noardburgum, including whether a system update caused false alerts and how the alert system is protected against outages. The minister denied an update caused it, attributed it to a fault in a control link, explained fallback arrangements and a planned system renewal around 2022, and deferred the future of siren alarms to the next cabinet.
In addition, the control facilities at the control rooms will be checked more thoroughly.
Daarnaast zullen de aansturingsvoorzieningen op de meldkamers extra gecontroleerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over de verkeersondersteuning bij wielerwegwedstrijden

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether police shortages threaten cycling road races, whether volunteer or certified motorcycle traffic marshals could replace police escorts, whether a legal status for the race caravan is being considered, and about the timeline for measures. The ministers answer that police are willing to help find solutions, that a package of no-regret measures is being implemented with evaluation by the end of 2022, and that a study into the tolerated practice of traffic rule violations will be started.
The preparations for the study into the tolerated situation regarding traffic rule violations during cycling races will be started as soon as possible.
De voorbereidingen voor het onderzoek naar de gedoogsituatie omtrent verkeersregels tijdens wielerwedstrijden zetten we zo spoedig mogelijk in gang.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Ellian, Brekelmans en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker waarschuwde voor moordplan Iraanse geheime dienst'

VVD MPs asked whether the IND and AIVD were warned in advance about an Iranian-directed assassination plot and what Dutch and EU responses to Iran and to Iranian dissidents are. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases or on AIVD working methods, pointed to existing reporting structures and the sanctions and diplomatic measures already taken, and gave no concrete new commitment.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat Russen ten tijde van het MH17-onderzoek door een hack diep in de systemen van de politie zaten

MPs Kathmann and Van Ginneken asked whether Russian hackers accessed police systems during the MH17 investigation, how well police systems were secured, and about friction with the AIVD and the police's cybersecurity measures. Minister Grapperhaus answered that for state-security reasons he cannot comment on specific measures or incidents, said there is no friction with the AIVD, referred to general measures such as the BIO baseline and red teaming, and declined to answer questions on uncorrected security recommendations.
For reasons of state security, I cannot make statements about the specific measures taken by the services under my responsibility.
Vanwege staatsveiligheid kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de specifieke maatregelen die de onder mij ressorterende diensten treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het overlijden van een 28-jarige vrouw door het dodelijke poeder van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about the death of a 28-year-old woman who took a lethal powder recommended by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about the cooperative's activities, data on deaths, criminal liability and possible prohibition. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, that the NVIC data are only partially shared on advice, and that existing chemical-sale measures and a 2019 monitoring code remain in place, while noting that providing mere general information is not necessarily punishable.
Regarding this criminal investigation, I cannot make any further statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de wateroverlast in Limburg

An MP asked the government about end-June flooding in Limburg (Eygelshoven, Meerssen), whether it shares the cause of the mid-July disaster, and whether victims and entrepreneurs can get compensation when insurers do not pay. The minister answered that the June rains are not comparable to the July disaster, that the Wts does not apply, that no separate fund is planned, and that loss of turnover is excluded from Wts compensation but the government will discuss it with the region, pointing to the NOW 4 wage subsidy.
The cabinet does however want to discuss this with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives, paying attention to proportionality, feasibility and precedent.
Het kabinet wil evenwel het gesprek hierover met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers voeren, waarbij ook aandacht is voor proportionaliteit, uitvoerbaarheid en precedentwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over verzekeraars die wateroverlastschade van ondernemers in Valkenburg niet vergoeden

MP Ploumen asked ministers whether they would compensate Valkenburg business owners whose flood damage is not covered by their insurers, and whether they would press insurers such as Lloyd's to pay. The government answered that it is in contact with the insurers' association, that the Wts disaster compensation scheme can cover damage that is not reasonably insurable, that Lloyd's is mapping its exposure and will report back, and that other schemes are being examined.
Lloyd's will inform the Minister of Finance about the progress of this process.
Lloyd’s zal de Minister van Financiën informeren over de voortgang van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over tegemoetkoming gedupeerden wateroverlastschade Limburg

An MP asked the ministers whether flood victims in Limburg, many not sure their insurer will pay, should get generous support under the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen regardless of water source, and when the scheme's details and advance payments would be clarified. The minister answered that the Wts was declared applicable, that flood damage from the Maas is not reasonably insurable for private persons so they can claim compensation, that the RVO opened a damage reporting form on 9 August, and that advance payments were deferred because they would slow down assessments, with a regulation to follow as soon as possible.
The cabinet decided to declare the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) applicable to the disaster in Limburg.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) van toepassing te verklaren op de ramp in Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over een snelle tegemoetkoming voor gedupeerde ondernemers van de waterschade in Limburg

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about insurers refusing flood damage claims in Valkenburg and how quickly affected entrepreneurs in Limburg could receive compensation, including whether turnover loss and advances could be covered. The minister answered that the Wts compensation scheme and a ministerial regulation are being prepared, damage can already be reported to RVO, turnover loss from disasters is excluded from the Wts but will be discussed with the region, and advances would slow the process because they also require appraisals.
The ministerial regulation includes the damage area.
In de ministeriële regeling is het schadegebied opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de uitlatingen van een ambtenaar in de media over extreemrechts

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether it was acceptable that a ministry official (Sterkenburg, working under the NCTV) spoke publicly as a researcher about far-right extremism, and whether that conflicts with civil service rules. The minister answered that she spoke in a personal research capacity, that her opinions were not his to judge, that academic freedom and freedom of expression apply, and that the civil service norm on expression requires case-by-case weighing.
This concerns an interview in which it was made clear that the statements were made in the capacity of a researcher.
Het betreft hier een interview waarin kenbaar is gemaakt dat de uitspraken in de hoedanigheid als onderzoeker worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het handelen van het Openbaar Ministerie en de internationale samenwerking in de zaak Ivana Smit

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's handling of the death of Ivana Smit in Malaysia, including poor communication with the family, delays in sharing the autopsy report, unreturned phones, and cooperation with Malaysian authorities. The Minister said the investigation is under Malaysian authority, that the family was kept informed and a copy of the autopsy was provided in 2018, and that the phones remain under investigation.
The phones are still under investigation and for that reason cannot yet be returned to the next of kin.
De telefoons zijn nog in onderzoek en kunnen om die reden nog niet worden teruggeven aan de nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht dat een man uit zijn woning werd gezet nadat daar één wietplant was aangetroffen

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether mayors still use the Damocles-style closure power (art. 13b Opiumwet) as intended, how many evictions result, and what aftercare exists after a man was evicted over one cannabis plant. The Minister confirmed the report, said no overview of evictions exists, pointed to an ongoing evaluation and a Raad van State review, and stated that proportionality, subsidiarity and council accountability plus legal remedies safeguard those affected.
No overview exists of the number of evictions resulting from closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act.
Over het aantal uithuiszettingen naar aanleiding van sluiting van woningen op basis van artikel 13b Opiumwet bestaat geen overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de overstromingen in Limburg

PvdA MP Ploumen asked about the Limburg flood situation, adequacy of regional capacity, federal support, compensation under the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen, psychosocial care and future flood prevention. The minister described coordination and support by national bodies, announced application of the Wts compensation law with a ministerial regulation to follow, and said a policy table would evaluate the Limburg situation.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Jules de Kom: “Eerherstel opa Anton de Kom begint met intrekken vervolging”

Rep. Belhaj asked why Anton de Kom, dead for 76 years, has not been formally exonerated and whether the government will act on the Van Ojik motion calling for a gesture of recognition. The government answers that criminal liability lapsed at his death, that recognition has been given in various ways, and that a gesture of rehabilitation is being developed with the family under the motion.
This will be worked on, partly within the framework of implementing the motion, in consultation with the family.
Daar zal, mede in het kader van de uitvoering van de motie, aan worden gewerkt in samenspraak met de familie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over schadeclaims bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about how the police handle damage claims, including whether the rules are written down, whether there is an independent review, where complainants can turn, and for statistics on claims in 2020. The Minister answered that police follow written procedures and the law, that disputes go to the courts, that claims data cannot be broken down by incident, and gave 2020 figures showing about 51% of decided claims resulted in payment.
The police are currently exploring the possibility of having a periodic audit carried out.
De politie bekijkt op dit moment de mogelijkheden om periodiek een audit te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zonnepaneel stoort communicatie van hulpdiensten'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the Justice Minister, about reports that solar installations with non-compliant inverters interfere with the C2000 emergency communication network and aviation/maritime radio. The government acknowledged the problem, said it is being addressed urgently with the supplier and network manager, and explained that Agentschap Telecom supervises EMC compliance and has enforcement powers, including recalls and sanctions.
Agentschap Telecom assesses such situations and has the powers to intervene.
Agentschap Telecom beoordeelt dergelijke situaties en heeft de bevoegdheden om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Wuite over het opsporen van gestolen kunst

MPs Van der Werf and Wuite asked the Justice Minister about the capacity of the police Team Kunst en Antiek to investigate stolen art, the success rate of such investigations, and cooperation with private detectives. The minister said the existing 2012 framework still applies, that no reliable data exist on clearance rates or liability claims, and that victims should register artworks with photographs to aid investigation.
There is insufficient data available on the art theft phenomenon to make a concrete statement about the clearance rate based on a sound analysis.
Er zijn ter zake van het criminaliteitsfenomeen kunstdiefstal onvoldoende gegevens voorhanden om op basis van een gedegen analyse een concrete uitspraak te doen over de pakkans.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de bejegening van een journalist in de uitoefening van de journalistieke taak

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a demonstration location change linked to FDF leader Van den Oever, a tractor driving provocatively, and police advising a journalist not to speak with a farmer, asking whether this limits press freedom. The minister said the mayor decides locations on security grounds without infringing rights, police may advise journalists for safety, and the government is committed to press protection and has written letters on journalist threats.
In doing so, there was in no way any infringement on the right to demonstrate or the right to freedom of expression.
Daarbij is op geen enkele manier inbreuk gemaakt op het recht op demonstratie of het recht op vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de zeggenschap over veiligheidsregio’s

Two SP MPs asked how much say municipalities still have over safety regions, what happens if municipalities refuse higher contributions or cannot pay, whether funding is adequate, and about conditions and plans for merging safety regions. The minister replied that municipal mayors and councils retain governance and budget influence, that contributions are binding once adopted, that funding comes via the general municipal fund with some tension over priorities, and that no concrete merger request exists while the ministry will weigh boundary criteria and regional support if one arises.
My current policy is not to take any steps to push safety regions towards merging, but to consider any proposals from safety region boards to merge.
Mijn huidige beleid is geen activiteiten te ontplooien om veiligheidsregio’s tot fusie te bewegen, maar eventuele voorstellen van besturen van veiligheidsregio’s om te fuseren in overweging te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Volgens Olga Karatsj is geen Wit-Russische activist nog veilig: Het regime bereidt operaties voor binnen de EU'

MP Piri asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether they knew of reports that the Belarusian regime is preparing operations inside the EU against activists, and about the safety of Belarusians in the Netherlands. The government says it has no signals of such planned operations, has received some reports of insecurity that are being examined, points to existing contacts with the diaspora, diplomatic protest options and the OBI (unwanted foreign interference) approach, but sees no need for a special reporting point.
The cabinet has no signals that the Belarusian authorities are preparing to arrest Belarusian activists within the EU.
Bij het kabinet zijn geen signalen bekend dat de Belarussische autoriteiten voorbereidingen treffen om binnen de EU Belarussische activisten op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over seksueel geweld onder studenten

MP Ellian asked the Justice Minister about sexual violence among students, including a survey finding that one in nine students had been raped, and what the new sexual offences bill and prevention and support measures would do. The minister agreed the figures are unacceptable, said the bill is in consultation and funding of about 15 million euros is not yet secured, and pointed to campaigns and support services such as the Centrum Seksueel Geweld.
Implementing the bill requires structurally about 15 million euros. Currently there is no budget coverage in my department's budget; finding it is up to a new cabinet.
Voor de uitvoering van het wetsvoorstel is structureel zo’n 15 miljoen euro vereist. Thans bestaat geen dekking op de begroting van mijn departement; het vinden daarvan is aan een nieuw kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over besluiten die mede oorzaak zijn van het hoge aantal besmettingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about COVID-19 measures that contributed to high infection numbers, including BCO staffing, the 24/40-hour validity of tests, post-vaccination waiting periods, and the handling of the Delta variant. The minister answered that BCO capacity was reduced in the low-infection period, that the government deviated from OMT advice in places, that it published Catshuis documents for 9 July, and that a further Intra Action Review would await ongoing evaluations.
I have chosen that, after completion of vaccinations from 10 July for all vaccine types, the corresponding corona access certificates only become valid after 14 days.
Ik heb er voor gekozen om na afronding van vaccinaties vanaf 10 juli jl, voor alle type vaccins, de bijbehorende coronatoegangsbewijzen pas na 14 dagen geldig te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de fraudezaak bij het kantoor van Pels Rijcken

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the Pels Rijcken fraud case, covering court supervision of mass-claim settlements, notary and BFT oversight, the state's continued use of Pels Rijcken as landsadvocaat, and disclosure of ongoing investigations. The ministers answered that existing safeguards are sound in principle, that several investigations are ongoing so they cannot yet say whether the checks failed, and that Parliament will be informed when results are available, with an external advisory report due in September.
To get a complete picture of what went wrong in this case, we first want to await the outcomes of the various ongoing investigations.
Om een volledig beeld te krijgen van wat is misgegaan in de onderhavige casus, willen wij eerst de uitkomsten van de diverse lopende onderzoeken afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over Rotterdams brandweerpersoneel dat verplicht moet stoppen met werken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether it is wrong that experienced Rotterdam firefighters must stop working after twenty years due to budget cuts, and whether the minister would intervene with the safety region. The minister replied that the arrangement is not budget-driven, that safety regions are the employer responsible for second-career policy, and that he respects that division of responsibility.
I respect the division of responsibilities. The safety regions are the employer of firefighting personnel and therefore responsible for working conditions and second-career policy.
Ik respecteer de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling. De veiligheidsregio’s zijn de werkgever van het brandweerpersoneel en dus verantwoordelijk voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden en het tweede loopbaanbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'ISIDOOR 2021: NCTV en NCSC organiseren grootste cybercrisisoefening ooit'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the ISIDOOR 2021 national cyber crisis exercise, including its success, participant selection, participant evaluations, and whether it fits the structural exercise programme under the Weverling motion. The minister judged the exercise successful, described how participants were selected, said a COT evaluation would be shared after the summer, and committed to advising the next cabinet on exercise frequency.
The Institute for Safety and Crisis Management (COT) is writing an overarching evaluation report focused on the exercise goals of ISIDOOR 2021.
Door het Instituut voor Veiligheids- en Crisismanagement (COT) wordt een overkoepelend evaluatierapport geschreven, dat zich richt op de oefendoelen van ISIDOOR 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over onrecht in de jeugdbeschermingsketen en een verborgen gehouden onderzoek van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked about alleged injustice in the youth protection chain and an unpublished ministry review on a father's case. The Minister answers that complaint and appeal routes exist, the action plan on fact-finding continues, and the department did not share the review because the problem was already being addressed and it cannot judge individual cases.

Given the nature of the review and because it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was no reason to inform me about the review and therefore also not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en doordat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over fouten in de jeugdzorg stilgehouden’

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Rechtsbescherming about a 2018 internal exploration 'Incident of patroon?' that allegedly showed systematic errors in youth-care files and was withheld from the ministers and the father in a case. The minister answered that it was an exploration rather than a report, that the claim of hundreds of cases per year is not substantiated, that the ministers were not informed, and that the actionplan on fact-finding is in progress with evaluation in 2022.
I am of the view that the method chosen for this exploration is not the right way to answer a broader systemic question.
Ik ben van mening dat de methode, zoals die in deze verkenning is gekozen, niet de juiste manier is om tot beantwoording van een bredere stelselvraag te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat journalist Ans Boersma schuldig is aan valsheid in geschrifte, maar geen straf krijgt

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling finding journalist Ans Boersma guilty of forgery related to a visa for a Syrian militant figure but imposing no penalty, and about how terrorists obtain visas and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister declined to comment on the individual ruling and the damages, said the government opposes minimum sentences to protect judicial discretion, and explained visa screening rules without giving case numbers.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on a judicial ruling.
Het past mij niet om een oordeel te vellen over een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het artikel ‘Hoe een verkrachter opnieuw kon toeslaan alle alarmsignalen ten spijt’

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about a newspaper report on a rapist who reoffended despite warning signs while under reclassering supervision, including whether reports to the reclassering were timely, why he was allowed to live with his mother despite breached conditions, and whether an independent investigation should be ordered. Minister Dekker answered that the reclassering was informed in time, that living with his mother was a justified temporary arrangement, that the reclassering's housing problem is broader and addressed via detention-reintegration plans, and that no independent investigation is warranted since the Inspectie saw no reason to investigate.

Given the information I have about the conduct of the reclassering and the other agencies involved in this case, I see no reason to characterise it as careless and to investigate the matter further (or have it investigated).

Gelet op de mij bekende informatie over het handelen van de reclassering en de andere betrokken instanties in deze casus zie ik geen aanleiding om dit als onzorgvuldig te bestempelen en de zaak nader te (laten) onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de uitvoering van een motie waarin werd gevraagd om de oprichting van een meldpunt voor sektesignalen

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked why the government has not yet implemented the adopted motion to create a reporting point for cult victims and their families, and why it is linked to the separate inquiry into organised sadistic abuse of minors. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he is awaiting advice from the Commissie Hendriks on the most suitable position for such a point before acting, and that police and existing bodies can handle reports in the meantime.
I want to carry out the motion you submitted in line with your intention, so that the functions of the reporting point are placed in the most suitable location.
Ik wil gefundeerd de door u ingediende motie conform uw bedoeling uitvoeren, zodat de functies van het meldpunt op de meest geschikte plaats worden ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma over nieuwe ontwikkelingen rondom de zaak Julio Poch

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice about new developments in the Julio Poch case, including experts doubting Dutch lawfulness in sharing data with Argentina and the Machielse commission's lack of hearing the affected person. The minister largely refused to add to the commission's findings, defended its independence and procedural choices, and said the documents were returned to their originating organisations under agreed conditions.
For me, it is paramount that the report of the Commission Dossier J.A. Poch shows a thorough investigation along various lines.
Voor mij staat voorop dat het rapport van de Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch blijk geeft van een grondig onderzoek langs verschillende sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Brandweer ontbeert oefenruimte tunnel- en flatbranden: ‘Afreizen naar Zwitserland’

An MP asked whether Dutch firefighters can practise tunnel and high-rise fires domestically, given reports that some regions train in Switzerland. The minister answered that safety regions set their own training programmes, that some regions train abroad for specialist scenarios, and that he lacks data on the number and cost of foreign trainings.
The design of the training programmes is for the safety regions to determine.
De inrichting van de trainingsprogramma's is ter bepaling aan de veiligheidsregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wens om politieagenten een wettelijk vastgelegde veteranenstatus te laten krijgen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked why police officers still lack a statutory veteran status, whether the government recognises the trauma and PTSD care gaps they face, and what happens to legacy PTSD cases under the new scheme. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the veteran criterion does not fit police work, that the PTSD scheme is being reformed with commitments to simplify and speed up handling, and that legacy cases and transitional rules are being arranged with unions.
The scheme is being improved on the basis of the principles: simpler, less pressure on the employee, speed in handling and reintegration at the police.
Het stelsel wordt verbeterd aan de hand van de uitgangspunten: eenvoudiger, minder druk op de medewerker, tempo in de afhandeling en re-integratie bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over fraude met coronaverklaringen

An MP asked the health and justice ministers about fraud with forged COVID test certificates and how it is being tackled, including whether sites offering them can be taken offline and whether certification is needed. The minister acknowledged the fraud risk, said the IGJ supervises testing providers and that the Public Prosecution Service would assess concrete signals, and pointed to the EU Digital COVID Certificate as the main fix.

Fraud with test certificates is in a sense easy as long as a test result is a document without fixed form and it is not feasible for countries to verify the authenticity of a test certificate from another country.

Fraude met testverklaringen is in zekere zin eenvoudig zolang een testuitslag een vormvrij document is en het niet goed mogelijk is voor landen om de authenticiteit van een testbewijs uit een ander land vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de minimumtarieven voor tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the new statutory minimum rates for interpreters and translators in criminal cases also bind police and whether police pressure, delisting threats and geographic matching undermine them. The minister confirms the minimum rates apply, says interpreters may negotiate higher rates with intermediaries, and defers monitoring and evaluation of the new system to mid-2022.
It is not possible to have the assessment of the new system's functioning take place earlier than mid-2022 as currently committed.
Het is niet mogelijk de beoordeling van de werking van de nieuwe systematiek eerder plaats te laten vinden dan medio 2022 zoals nu is toegezegd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over het zonder opleiding, met een strafblad en onder valse titel verlenen van zorg

An MP asks how a youth-care director with a criminal record, no training and a misused psychotherapist title could obtain a certificate of conduct (VOG) and keep working, and what oversight failed. The government answers that the VOG was issued after a screening-profile error that is being corrected, that the inspectorate warned the director over the title, and that governance and declaration-fraud investigations are ongoing, with the inspectorate pursuing a new inspection visit.
Because the requested function combined unusually with the indicated screening profile, Justis requested the job description.
Doordat er sprake was van een ongebruikelijke combinatie van de beoogde functie en het aangegeven screeningsprofiel is de functieomschrijving door Justis opgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Paternotte en Van der Werf over het incident bij de corona-vaccinatielocatie Amsterdam

Four MPs asked the health and justice ministers about reported harassment of people queuing for COVID vaccination at a vaccination site in Amsterdam during a demonstration march, asking about police response, arrests, GGD instructions, reporting, and safety guarantees. The minister answered that police found no confirmed intimidation, no complaints or reports were registered, police urged victims to file complaints, and vaccination site safety is a decentralised responsibility under existing protocols and support networks.
The police are aware of a social media report that people were harassed. The police were visibly present but could not confirm this.
De politie is op de hoogte van een bericht op social media dat mensen zijn lastiggevallen. De politie was zichtbaar aanwezig, maar heeft dit niet kunnen constateren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de berichten ‘Herrie veroorzakende verkeersaso’s worden met een nieuwe techniek aangepakt’, ‘Rotterdam krijgt lawaaiflitser tegen aso-mobilisten’ en ‘Rotterdam wil flitspalen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Rotterdam pilot showing thousands of noise-limit violations by loud vehicles and about new noise-enforcement cameras being developed. The minister said existing noise rules and police enforcement apply, that acoustic cameras cannot yet be certified, and that a law change to share vehicle data with police may be needed, to be examined once the technology and funding are clearer.
Depending on the choices made, it will become clear whether a law change is necessary.
Afhankelijk van de keuzes die gemaakt worden, zal duidelijk worden of een wetswijziging noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat in Budel in Brabant inwoners de stelende asielzoekers uit het AZC zo zat zijn dat zij een burgerwacht hebben gevormd

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether residents forming neighbourhood patrols in Budel over nuisance by asylum seekers should be seen as proof of failed asylum policy, and whether the government would detain and deport offenders and reward the patrol volunteers. The State Secretary answered that these are neighbourhood prevention teams aimed at general safety, that the municipality supports them, that detention depends on legal grounds handled by prosecutors, police and courts, and that she visits municipalities regularly.
There is no question of a neighbourhood watch but of neighbourhood prevention teams.
Er is geen sprake van een buurtwacht maar van buurtpreventieteams.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Simons over ernstige misstanden in de politieorganisatie

MP Simons asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police misconduct, the culture within the police, and the suicide of a police officer amid bullying, and about the KPMG findings on the Dienst Landelijke Informatie Organisatie. The Minister answered that a family-level inquiry into the recent death is ongoing, that the Inspectie found leadership and culture problems to be addressed through a programmatic approach to the Landelijke Eenheid, and that he would inform parliament of outcomes where confidentiality allows.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of this investigation.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over de gruwelijke overval in de woning van PSV-spits Zahavi

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about a violent home robbery at PSV striker Zahavi's residence, including whether there was an anti-Jewish motive, the arrest and prosecution rates for home robberies, typical sentences and whether Parliament would be informed. The minister declined details on the ongoing criminal investigation and sentencing averages, provided national statistics on home robberies, and confirmed an anti-Jewish dimension is being investigated.
As long as the criminal investigation in this individual case is ongoing, I cannot provide further substantive information about it.
Zolang het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze individuele zaak loopt, kan ik daarover geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Fors lagere straf voor doodschieten Bas van Wijk’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court sentence of nine years for the fatal shooting of Bas van Wijk, which was far below the prosecution's demand, and whether a procedural error by the prosecution contributed to it. The minister defended judicial independence, said the court's sentence can still have deterrent effect, acknowledged a partial nullification of the indictment that may have lowered the sentence, noted that the prosecution has appealed, and saw no reason for further action.
The prosecution regrets the omission in this case.
Het OM betreurt de omissie in dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bikker en Pouw-Verweij over sterke toename van het aantal gevallen van euthanasie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bikker and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the sharp rise in euthanasia notifications in 2020 is worrying, whether the RTE commissions' ethical review is weak, whether video consultations and the RTE's narrowed 'questions-raising' selection undermine safeguards, and whether isolation in care homes is driving requests. The minister answered that the rise tracks the overall increase in deaths, that COVID-19 played only a minor direct role, that deviation from in-person consultations is allowed under the KNMG/ministry COVID arrangements, that no signals of rising euthanasia wishes in Dutch care homes were found, and that an evaluation will examine physician attitudes.
I see no reason for further investigation into the increase in the absolute number of euthanasia notifications to the RTE in 2020.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar de stijging van het absolute aantal euthanasiemeldingen bij de RTE in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over ‘buitenproportionele geweldstoepassing door de Rotterdamse politie’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about a Rotterdam police officer filmed using disproportionate force against a 17-year-old, the prosecution's dismissal of the case, and whether patterns of excessive force and racism exist. The Minister declines to judge the individual case, says excessive-force incidents are registered and reviewed case by case, and rejects the claim of a systemic pattern while promising more transparency reporting by the police chief.
It is for other authorities – where applicable the judge – to assess whether there is disproportionate use of force or not.
Het is aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of er wel of niet sprake is van buitenproportionele geweldsaanwending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "het bericht dat burgers opgejaagd worden en hun privacy wordt geschonden"

An SP MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports that municipalities monitor welfare recipients' privacy, including waste-pass use, and about the role of the Inlichtingenbureau in data-matching and fraud detection. The minister answered that municipalities may investigate individual cases within legal limits, that the Inlichtingenbureau acts on statutory tasks under ministerial oversight and does not itself investigate fraud, and that a fraud law overhaul is under way.
The decisions taken by the college are open to objection and appeal by the citizen.
De door het college genomen beslissingen zijn vatbaar voor bezwaar en beroep door de burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rol van de Landelijke Expertisegroep Bijzondere Zedenzaken (LEBZ) in het publieke debat omtrent hervonden herinneringen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the LEBZ expert group's role in the public debate on recovered memories, including reports that its coordinators tried to influence media coverage and criticism of a clinical guideline. The minister replied that external experts speak in a personal capacity, that the LEBZ assesses cases only after police investigation, that an independent WODC study is being prepared, and that police take victim concerns seriously.
I have registered the subject for research with the WODC.
Ik heb het onderwerp aangemeld voor onderzoek bij WODC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Werner over dynamische evenementenvergunningen

MPs from the CDA asked about the status of more flexible, phased event permit procedures (dynamic permits), why fairgrounds are classed as events rather than throughflow locations, differentiation by event category, municipal hesitancy, timelines, and a handreiking for municipalities. The Minister answered that permitting is primarily a municipal responsibility, that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that the government has communicated conditions for events to ease planning, and that answers were timed with the 11 June communication.
Issuing permits is primarily a local responsibility of the municipality, which is advised by the safety region, emergency services and other parties.
Het verstrekken van vergunningen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente, zij worden hierbij geadviseerd door de veiligheidsregio, hulpdiensten en andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Werf over politieke inmenging bij de NCTV

Two MPs from SP and D66 asked the Justice Minister whether the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security (NCTV) has been politically influencing threat assessments and prosecutorial matters, and how independent the NCTV is. The Minister answered that the NCTV is independent in drafting threat analyses, denied any NCTV involvement in OM prosecutions, and said the NCTV's role will be discussed in a forthcoming debate.
At the same time, the NCTV is independent in drafting threat analyses, and therefore free from political or administrative influence.
Tegelijkertijd is de NCTV onafhankelijk bij het opstellen van dreigingsanalyses, dus vrij van politieke of bestuurlijke invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de berichtgeving ‘Aantal online bedreigingen tegen agenten afgelopen jaar verdubbeld’

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported doubling of online threats against police officers and the practice of doxing, and what measures can curb them. The Minister acknowledges the problem, announces a bill before summer recess introducing a new criminal offence for doxing, and describes existing police, prosecutorial and civil-law tools and support protocols.
Following a motion by MP Michon-Derksen (VVD), I will put a bill out for consultation before the summer recess introducing an additional criminal offence for doxing.

Ik ga, mede naar aanleiding van een daartoe strekkende motie van het lid Michon-Derksen (VVD) 2 , 3 , vóór het zomerreces een wetsvoorstel in consultatie brengen waarmee een aanvullende strafbaarstelling rond het fenomeen doxing wordt geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de oproep van agenten om het dreigend vragen naar privégegevens strafbaar te stellen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police calls to criminalise threatening requests for officers' private data (doxing), and the effect on police work and recruitment. The minister condemns intimidation of police, encourages officers to file complaints, and announces a consultation on a new criminal offence for doxing before the summer recess.
This is a societal problem that I am looking into with urgency.
Dit is een maatschappelijk probleem waarnaar ik met urgentie naar ga kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Beruchte NSB’ers kochten Joodse huizen op in Arnhem’

Two PVV MPs asked ministers about reports that NSB members bought up Jewish houses in Arnhem during the war, asking how much property Arnhem seized, for a full restitution overview, for restitution of looted property, and for investigation of municipal and professional roles. The government answered that Arnhem's own investigation is ongoing, that no federal additional research or restitution is planned, and that post-war restitution was already addressed through the 2000 compensation fund.
This investigation is complex because much administration was lost, partly due to the destruction of Arnhem in the last year of the war.
Dit onderzoek is complex, omdat veel administratie verloren is gegaan, onder meer door de verwoesting van Arnhem in het laatste oorlogsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat criminelen infiltreren in de Rotterdamse haven

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice about reports of criminal infiltration of Rotterdam port companies, drug seizure follow-up capacity (HARC team), replacing staff with cameras, private security versus a security risk area, TFOC cooperation, and why the integrity report on customs was not published. The minister answers that capacity is being reviewed and an integrated plan for gateways is in preparation, cites existing teams and cameras as supplements, and declines to publish the report because the researchers own the copyright and do not want publication.
The researchers are the owners of the report, to which copyright applies.
De onderzoekers zijn de eigenaren van het rapport, waarop het auteursrecht van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma  en Van Nispen over de uitvoering van motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2283) over Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the implementation of the motions on the Poch Committee archive, including whether a Cabinet minutes passage and the Omtzigt motion on article 68 of the Constitution bear on parliamentary access to documents. The minister confirmed the awareness of these matters, said the committee archive was transferred to the department on 4 June and is being reviewed under article 68, and that disclosure will happen as quickly as possible.
As I also indicated in my answers to written parliamentary questions, my starting point remains that this disclosure will take place as soon as possible.
Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in mijn antwoorden op schriftelijke Kamervragen, is mijn uitgangspunt daarbij nog steeds dat deze verstrekking zo spoedig mogelijk zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de meeste Nederlandse bedrijven niet voldoen aan privacywetgeving

MP Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that most Dutch companies do not comply with GDPR/AVG privacy rules, and whether the burden unfairly falls on European firms dependent on non-European tech giants. The minister answered that the AVG divides responsibilities between controllers and processors, acknowledged that smaller firms struggle to negotiate compliant cloud contracts, and pointed to government DPIAs, supervisory-authority involvement, and European cloud initiatives such as GAIA-X as remedies.
Currently, the possibilities are being explored to broaden this approach to the other strategic suppliers of the central government.
Momenteel worden de mogelijkheden verkend om deze aanpak te verbreden tot de andere strategische leveranciers van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over uitleveringen en uitzettingen aan Rwanda

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about extraditions and expulsions to Rwanda, citing a critical Nederlands Juristenblad article on the country's human rights and fair-trial situation. The government replied that it sees no reason to change policy, points to ICJ monitoring of the 2016 extraditees' trials and to the lack of found due-process violations, and says it shares some NGO concerns while engaging Rwanda on them.
The cabinet sees no reason in this article to adopt different policy regarding extradition to Rwanda.
Het kabinet ziet in dit artikel geen reden om tot een ander beleid met betrekking tot uitlevering naar Rwanda te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Criminelen infiltreren in rederijen in de Rotterdamse haven'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports of criminals infiltrating shipping companies in the Rotterdam port, including corruption, drop-off smuggling methods, information sharing, staffing of the drugs investigation teams and cooperation with Latin America. Minister Grapperhaus answered at length, describing existing public-private cooperation, an integrated plan under preparation, a WODC study on corruption risks, and information-sharing reforms, while stating that some measures lie outside his or other bodies' powers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sjoerdsma over het onder de radar verdwijnen van Syriëgangers

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about Dutch Syria travellers who may have escaped Syrian camps unnoticed, including questions on numbers, monitoring, consular contact and repatriation. The government largely refused to discuss individual cases, gave aggregate figures from public AIVD data, and described existing measures and cooperation with Turkey and other European states without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Boswijk over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Boswijk asked about the Maritime Protection Act (Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij), including the use of Vessel Protection Detachments, piracy in the Gulf of Guinea, and ILT oversight. The government answered in detail, giving request statistics, budget figures, and a reasoned refusal to designate the Gulf of Guinea as a risk area, while promising an EU pilot evaluation and ongoing ILT-Defence arrangements.
Once the results of that are known, your House will be informed about them.
Zodra de resultaten daarvan bekend zijn, zal uw Kamer daarover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Nederland verliest controle op beveiliging van het internet’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Rajkowski asked about the Cyber Security Council's warning that the Netherlands is losing control over internet security and growing dependence on foreign technology, including whether vital processes depend on foreign providers and how much EU recovery funds will support digital investment. The minister answered that digital autonomy is a means rather than a goal, that a full inventory of foreign-provider dependence is not realistic so a risk-based approach is used, and that the telecom sector has a structural approach with other vital sectors to be assessed later.
It is not systematically tracked to what extent service provision within vital processes takes place by, or depends on, foreign providers.
Er wordt niet integraal bijgehouden in hoeverre de dienstverlening binnen vitale processen plaatsvindt door of afhankelijk is van buitenlandse aanbieders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over aparte looproutes voor statushouders in Oegstgeest

The MP asks whether the government accepts a local proposal to route asylum status holders away from a park in Oegstgeest, and whether it violates the constitutional non-discrimination clause, and what tools exist to intervene. The minister answers that the municipality confirmed no obligation or ban on routes exists, that discrimination is unacceptable, and that intervention options are limited, with no existing comparable measures known.
The COA can and will never require or prohibit a route, except in situations where a restrictive measure has been imposed under the approach to nuisance behaviour.
Het COA kan en zal nooit een route verplichten dan wel verbieden, behoudens situaties waarin in het kader van de aanpak van overlastgevend gedrag een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht dat het CBS gaat stoppen met onderscheid maken tussen een ‘westerse’ en ‘niet-westerse’ achtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether abandoning the 'western' versus 'non-western' background classification by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) hides immigration problems, and urged the CBS to be called to order. The government replied that the CBS will keep recording origin and migration background, that the categories lost meaning, and that the minister will not interfere with the CBS's statistical categorisation because it is an independent administrative body.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van nudismewebsites die een toevluchtsoord voor pedoseksuelen zouden zijn

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether nudism websites with images of naked children serve as havens for paedophiles, whether they are hosted in the Netherlands, how consent is verified, where the line with child pornography lies, and what can be done. The minister said some such sites are hosted in the Netherlands, that images of nudism are not automatically illegal and are assessed case by case under article 240b, and pointed to ongoing internet-cleaning measures, a planned administrative enforcement regime for companies, and a planned low-threshold takedown facility for unlawful content.

For companies that do not cooperate sufficiently with this, I have started a legislative process so that in future an authority can intervene under administrative law with penalty payments and administrative fines.
Voor bedrijven die hier onvoldoende aan meewerken ben ik een wetgevingstraject gestart zodat in toekomst een autoriteit bestuursrechtelijke kan ingrijpen met dwangsommen en bestuurlijke boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen en Kathmann over overleveringen aan Polen

MPs Van Nispen and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands still extradites suspects to Poland despite rule-of-law concerns, whether judges can suspend extraditions, and what safeguards and alternatives exist. The minister answered that each extradition request is individually tested by the Amsterdam court under CJEU case law, that suspension requires a systemic breach finding, and that guarantees and return arrangements are possible but limited.
Surrender can only be refused if there are grounds for it in the individual case.
Overlevering kan alleen worden geweigerd als daar in het individuele geval gronden voor bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht ‘Powering pandemic response in the Netherlands’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Palantir pilot for pandemic response in southern Dutch safety regions, covering who signed, contract disclosure, the absence of a DPIA, data access, Palantir's reputation and future agreements. The minister answered that six southern safety regions signed a pilot contract with Palantir, the contracts are marked confidential but could be disclosed, no DPIA was done because only public data was used, and no future agreements exist.
Although these agreements were given the status 'confidential' for competition reasons, the director of the Limburg-Noord Safety Region has informed me that they can be made public if necessary.

Hoewel deze overeenkomsten om concurrentieredenen de status «vertrouwelijk» hebben gekregen, heeft de directeur van de Veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord mij gemeld dat ze indien nodig openbaar gemaakt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over negatieve publieke uitlatingen van een hoge ambtenaar van de NCTV over Pieter Omtzigt

Two SP MPs asked why a senior NCTV official's public tweets criticising Pieter Omtzigt were permissible and whether they breach the civil service conduct norm, and whether that official was involved in threat assessments for him. The ministers answered that the freedom of expression of officials is weighed against functioning-based criteria, that two fact-finding inquiries are ongoing so no conclusions can be pre-empted, and that the official had no direct or indirect role in threat analysis for Omtzigt.
While these investigations are ongoing, we can and will not anticipate those conclusions, given the duty of care we must observe as employer.
Lopende deze onderzoeken kunnen en willen wij niet vooruitlopen op die conclusies, mede gelet op de eisen van zorgvuldigheid die als werkgever in acht zijn te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vermelding van ‘Uitgeverij de Blauwe Tijger’ in het ‘Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 53’ van de NCTV en de mogelijke schending van de grondwettelijke vrijheid van d

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the NCTV threat assessment named the publisher De Blauwe Tijger, whether this threatens press freedom, and whether it could justify monitoring or detaining its journalists after an arrest. The minister replied that the publisher is mentioned only as an illustration of polarisation linked to anti-government sentiment, not as violent or dangerous, and declined to comment on individual cases or on whether the mention could trigger surveillance.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de pedofilie activist Nelson M. die onvindbaar zou zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the pedophilia activist Nelson M. was on an international wanted list and unfindable, and why the probation service's reports of non-compliance led to no action.
