The Minister confirmed the suspect was arrested on 17 May and released under conditions on 19 May, but declined to discuss the individual case further, saying the Public Prosecution Service is responsible for prosecution and he has no involvement in individual criminal cases.
Regarding this individual case, in which the criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot provide further substantive information.
Over deze individuele zaak, waarin het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt, kan ik verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Azarkan over de huidige stand van zaken met betrekking tot discriminatie en racisme in Nederland

MPs Van Baarle and Azarkan asked about the current state of discrimination and racism in the Netherlands, covering complaint and prosecution figures over ten years, reporting willingness, and government measures on housing, labour, education, healthcare and spending. The minister answered with detailed statistics on antidiscrimination-service complaints, police reports, prosecutions, sentences and sanctions, and described planned measures including a National Coordinator and a State Commission on discrimination and racism.
The approach to discrimination will receive an important and substantial boost in the coming period.
De aanpak van discriminatie zal in de komende periode een belangrijke en wezenlijke impuls krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Amsterdam over de onafhankelijkheid van advocaten bij “zelfonderzoeken” en het verschoningsrecht

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a Amsterdam Court of Appeal ruling, allowing a lawyer to invoke legal privilege while conducting an 'independent' internal fraud investigation for a client, undermines the independence of such self-investigations and whether they should be stopped. The minister replied that existing professional rules and disciplinary law sufficiently address the tension, the Bar revised its guidance, and a WODC study on self-investigations will start after summer 2021 and finish in March 2022.
As I have indicated before, the applicable professional and conduct rules and disciplinary law in my view provide sufficient means to address a possible tension between partiality and independence.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven bieden de geldende beroeps- en gedragsregels en het tuchtrecht naar mijn mening voldoende mogelijkheden om een mogelijke spanning tussen partijdigheid en onafhankelijkheid het hoofd te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitstel van de invoering van het verbod op lachgas en designerdrugs en het bericht ‘Woede om uitstel drugswet: ‘Echt grote onzin’’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Health ministers why enforcement of a ban on nitrous oxide and designer drugs such as 3-MMC was postponed, and why such substances remain easily available. The government answered that the delay stems from a lack of financing for police, prosecution and forensic enforcement costs, so the decision is left to a new cabinet, while it is preparing a separate 3-MMC ban and prevention measures.
The decision on both initiatives is therefore left to a new cabinet, as stated in the letter of 31 March on this subject.
Het besluit over beide initiatieven wordt dus overgelaten aan een nieuw kabinet, zoals vermeld in de brief van 31 maart jl. over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over voedselvoorziening als vitale infrastructuur

MP Kathmann asked the Justice and Security Minister whether food supply should be designated critical infrastructure, its criteria, NCSC support, and cyberattack risks and detection rates. The government explained that designation follows objective impact criteria reviewed every four years, that a food-sector assessment is planned later this year, and that cybercrime detection is complex and being addressed through broader measures.
Such a vitality assessment of food supply will take place later this year within this framework by the responsible ministry (Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality).
Een dergelijke vitaliteitsbeoordeling van de voedselvoorziening vindt in het kader hiervan later dit jaar plaats door het verantwoordelijke Ministerie (Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een OM-schikking

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice about a prosecutor's settlement with SHV subsidiaries, including how cooperation discounts are calculated, why fines were so low relative to turnover, and why the investigation took 4.5 years. The minister answers that discounts are case-by-case, the settlement was not turnover-based, self-reporting discounts were denied for facts not self-reported, and resources were adequate, while giving only partial detail on methodology.
In this context, the WODC study on the pros and cons of self-investigation by lawyers is also examining how other countries handle self-reporting by companies in financial-economic crime.

Hierbij merk ik op dat, in het kader van het onderzoek van het WODC naar de voor- en nadelen van zelfonderzoek door advocaten, ook wordt onderzocht hoe in een aantal andere landen wordt omgegaan met zelfmeldingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Van der Werf over het bericht 'Persfotograaf en vriendin aangevallen bij opnames: 'Met shovel aangereden''

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about the attack on a press photographer and his companion during filming of a car fire, and about press freedom, Persveilig.nl, a forthcoming report and enforcement against violence against journalists. The minister condemned the violence, said three suspects were arrested with an investigation ongoing, noted the Netherlands fell one place in the RSF index, and pointed to planned research and the agreement with police and prosecutors while giving limited detail on case numbers.
The investigation by the police and the public prosecution service is still in full swing. As is known, I cannot go into further detail on an ongoing investigation.
Het onderzoek van politie en OM is nog in volle gang. Zoals bekend kan ik niet nader ingaan op een lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Zware kritiek op leiding van geheime politiedienst'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports of distrust, alleged manipulation, dismissals of agents, and inadequate aftercare within the undercover team WOD of the National Unit, and about the leadership's response. The minister answered that the Inspectorate is currently examining the unit, a programmatic approach is being set up, and an independent commission under Oebele Brouwer will investigate the death of a DSO employee and possible links to working conditions.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the investigation. Insofar as confidentiality permits, I will inform your House of the outcomes of the investigation.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek. Voor zover de vertrouwelijkheid het toelaat, zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er crisis is binnen het undercoverteam van de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of turmoil in the police undercover team, including sick leave levels, whistleblowers transferred after reporting misconduct, and who investigates and whether the work is endangered. The minister answered that an independent commission under Oebele Brouwer will investigate the circumstances of an officer's death and possible links to working conditions, that sick leave figures are 4.6% and 5.9%, and that the police has a whistleblower scheme while individual cases cannot be discussed.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Grapperhaus informeerde Kamer verkeerd over dode informant en de brief van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid d.d. 16 april 2021 aan de korpschef

An MP asks the Justice Minister why he told parliament the Rijksrecherche investigated police informant deaths when the Inspectorate says no criminal investigation was done, and whether he was misled and will act against the Landelijke Eenheid officials responsible. The minister acknowledges the Inspectorate's finding, has asked police and the Openbaar Ministerie to start an independent fact-finding inquiry, will inform parliament of results as far as confidentiality allows, and says the Inspectorate found no concealment of information by the Landelijke Eenheid.
Now that it has become clear that no investigation took place, I have asked the police and the OM to commission an independent fact-finding inquiry.
Nu is gebleken dat er geen onderzoek heeft plaatsgevonden, heb ik de politie en het OM alsnog verzocht een onafhankelijk feitenonderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de miljoenenboete voor ABN AMRO en de wijze waarop deze is vastgesteld

An MP asks the Justice Minister why ABN AMRO's 480 million euro settlement was set as it was, how it compares to ING's, how the 300 million fine and disgorgement were determined, and whether the Hoge Transacties review regime and judicial review will be made more transparent. The minister explains the calculation methods, the 5% turnover-based fine, the lack of uniform guidelines, and that a draft bill giving courts a role in reviewing high transactions is in consultation.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Slachtoffers bloedbad Alphen aan den Rijn strijden na 10 jaar nog altijd om schadevergoeding’

An MP asks the Justice Minister why compensation for victims of the Alphen aan den Rijn shooting is so slow, with only 19 claims settled after the Supreme Court ruling, and what will speed it up. The minister answers that the police and insurer's foundation VSSA handle claims, that 32 cases are now settled of 71 registered, that incomplete dossiers from some victims' representatives cause the delay, and that talks with those representatives are planned with escalation if no breakthrough follows.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over de berichten ‘Dreigbrief bezorgd bij meerdere moskeeën in Nederland’ en ‘Brandstichting bij moskee in aanbouw in Gouda’

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Justice about reports of threatening letters and parcels sent to multiple mosques and an arson attack on a mosque under construction in Gouda. The minister condemned the actions, said at least 24 mosques received parcels, one suspect was arrested for the Gouda fire, and that the incidents are under investigation, while referring the national discrimination coordinator and mosque security guidance to other bodies.
Because this concerns an ongoing investigation, I cannot go into further details of the threats.
Omdat het hier een lopend onderzoek betreft, kan ik niet ingaan op de verdere details van de bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de politietop luxe vluchten boekt

Parliamentarian Van Nispen asked whether senior police officials booking business-class flights is inappropriate, how many earn over 150,000 euro, whether independent investigation is warranted, the state of the Dienst Landelijke Informatieorganisatie, and why a Wob request took 1.5 years. The minister answered that business class is allowed with valid reasons, an internal investigation found the travel lawful though efficiency was not sufficiently checked, 34 officers earned over 150,000 euro in 2020, a programmatic approach was set up, and the delay was regretted with the chief informed.
Handling the Wob request in question was very labour-intensive and there was understaffing.
Het afhandelen van het wob-verzoek in kwestie was zeer arbeidsintensief en er was sprake van onderbezetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Tien (ex)jihadisten komen dit jaar op vrije voeten: vormen ze een gevaar?'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether ten ex-jihadists being released this year pose a danger, and about deradicalisation, supervision capacity, the Wet Langdurig Toezicht amendment and prevention. The minister answered that the exact number of releases is hard to state, that effects of deradicalisation cannot yet be measured, that a legislative amendment is in preparation, and that current capacity is sufficient.
Due to tailored trajectories, the complexity of effect measurement and the small target group, it cannot yet be established what the effect is on extremist thinking and the risk of recidivism.

Vanwege maatwerktrajecten, de complexiteit van effectmetingen en de kleine doelgroep, kan op dit moment nog niet worden vastgesteld wat het effect is op extremistische gedachten en het risico op recidive.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inning van verkeersboetes voor buitenlandse kentekens

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether unpaid traffic fines for foreign-registered vehicles can be collected, why collection rates differ by country, and what action has been taken; the Minister says he agrees fines should be paid regardless of origin, reports stable collection rates around 82.5% for non-residents, and states that enforcement is not selective by plate and that the EU CBE directive should be extended to parking offences.
Over recent years the collection rate of traffic fines issued to non-residents shows a constant picture: the weighted collection rate lies around 82.5% in the period 2015–2019.
Over de afgelopen jaren laat het inningspercentage van verkeersboetes gericht aan niet-ingezetenen een constant beeld zien: het gewogen inningspercentage ligt in de periode 2015–2019 rond de 82,5%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de 'Reactie van de Kamer van Koophandel (KVK) op de petitie de Goede Zaak over privacy'

Two VVD MPs asked why the government is consulting on privacy of home addresses in the Trade Register rather than simply implementing their motion to shield residential addresses from public view, and whether the consultation scope and timeline are adequate. The state secretary answered that full implementation is not possible under EU law and Wwft obligations, that the motion is only partly feasible, that a broad consultation will explore all interests, and that a first indication of solutions is expected before the summer recess.
The motion cannot, as stated, be implemented in full because that is not (fully) possible.
De motie kan, zoals gezegd, niet onverkort worden uitgevoerd omdat dat niet (volledig) mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat een fout in de nieuwe gokwet zorgt voor meer risico op matchfixing

An MP asked whether the Wwft reporting regime (unusual transactions go to the FIU-Nederland, not directly to sports bodies) weakens sports bodies' information position on matchfixing, and what the government will do. The minister replies that event-level signals still reach the SBIU and sports bodies, that the sport's position has not worsened, and that a 'fast lane' for FIU information sharing will be set up, but rejects amending the Wwft.
All in all, I conclude that the information position of the sport has not worsened.
Ik concludeer al met al dat de informatiepositie van de sport niet slechter is geworden.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt hebben gesteld over de witwaspraktijken bij ING

MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked the Finance and Justice ministers about money-laundering practices at ING, including whether DNB re-tested the top leadership's fitness after the settlement, what conditions attached to the state capital injection, what DNB, ECB or prosecutors told ING's board, and whether ING's compliance department was cut. The minister declined to comment on individual prosecution and supervisory matters, citing supervisory confidentiality, and said the archive shows no such letters to the ministry, while promising to check officials' mailboxes and report back.

Under the legally anchored supervisory confidentiality, the competent supervisor cannot and may not make statements, not even to me, on whether re-testing in individual cases was considered, takes place or has taken place.

Op grond van de wettelijk verankerde toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan en mag de bevoegde toezichthouder geen uitspraken doen, ook niet naar mij, over de vraag of hertoetsing in individuele gevallen is overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei toegang had tot gegevens van miljoenen Telfort-klanten

MPs Buitenweg and others asked whether Huawei had access to millions of Telfort customers' data, as revealed by a 2011 internal KPN audit, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the vulnerable legacy system was retired in 2018, that Huawei had only maintenance access with no known data theft, that the government will require mobile operators to use only trusted vendors in critical network parts, and that it declined to say which parts are critical.
The cabinet makes no public statements about which parts have been designated as critical.
Het kabinet doet geen openbare uitspraken welke onderdelen als kritiek zijn aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie jarenlang onterecht informatie met de belastingdienst heeft gedeeld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers why police in Oost-Nederland shared suspects' data with the Tax Authority for years allegedly without proper basis, and what was done about it. The government answers that a legal basis exists under the Bpg and RIEC convention but its practical application needs attention, that police suspended sharing in Oost-Nederland, is developing a uniform working method with the Tax Authority and RIEC's, and that the Data Protection Authority would be consulted later if needed.
In addition, the police will work with the Tax Authority and the RIEC's to develop a uniform working method that guarantees careful information sharing.
Daarnaast gaat de politie samen met de Belastingdienst en de RIEC’s een uniforme werkwijze ontwikkelen waarbij een zorgvuldige informatiedeling gegarandeerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over anonieme bedreiging en intimidatie op huisadressen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether anonymous intimidation at home addresses by groups such as Vizier op Links is punishable and how victims will be protected. The government said 51 reports and ten complaints have been filed, that the Public Prosecution Service is assessing whether criminal offences occurred, and pointed to local security measures and support for politicians.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently investigating whether the actions in question qualify as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Groothuizen en Verhoeven over de intimidatie van historicus Nadia Bouras

MPs from D66 asked the Justice and Security minister how the government views intimidation of historian Nadia Bouras by the anonymous group Vizier op Links, whether doxing should be tackled specifically, whether the Trade Register should better protect addresses of entrepreneurs, and whether platforms should bear more responsibility. The minister condemned the intimidation, said police and the Public Prosecution Service have tools, that a criminal-law option for doxing is being explored, that a proposal to shield sole-trader home addresses is in preparation, and that he intends further agreements with platforms.
I will examine this together with the internet bullying policy framework that has been developed and whose various steps are currently being implemented.
Ik ga dit onderzoeken in samenhang met het beleidskader internetpesten dat is ontwikkeld en waarvan de verschillende stappen momenteel worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het intimideren van linkse politici

The MP Kuiken asked the ministers whether intimidating stickers and visits at private addresses targeting left-wing politicians are unacceptable, how many complaints have been filed, what the Data Protection Authority can do about doxing, and when an internet-bullying policy framework will be ready. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such intimidation is unacceptable, that ten complaints were filed with four still under investigation, that the Data Protection Authority can act against doxing, and that the framework was delivered in February 2021.
Aggression and intimidation are therefore completely unacceptable.
Agressie en intimidatie zijn daarom volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Özütok over intimidaties door Vizier op Links

MPs Van den Berge and Özütok asked whether the government considers the intimidation of public figures by the anonymous group Vizier op Links at their home addresses unacceptable, whether it is criminal, whether AIVD is aware of it, and what measures will be taken. The minister condemned the conduct as intimidating, said he cannot comment on individual cases, reported ten complaints with six closed and four pending, and described existing police and local-triangle protection mechanisms.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently examining whether the conduct in question qualifies as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht dat online discriminatie geen prioriteit heeft

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether online discrimination deserves tackling, how many reports and prosecutions occurred in 2019–2020, how much police capacity is devoted to it, and whether platforms take enough responsibility. The minister agreed it deserves tackling, said no separate online figures exist, noted no dedicated police FTE, called for stronger platform action and promised a renewed approach to online discrimination before the summer recess.
No figures are available that show the number of criminal convictions for online discrimination or the number of expressions made inaccessible by providers and platforms.

Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die inzicht geven in het aantal strafrechtelijke veroordelingen van online discriminatie dan wel het aantal uitingen dat door providers en platformen ontoegankelijk is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over sancties voor racisme en discriminatie binnen de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the mild disciplinary sanctions for racism and discrimination within the police and whether the sanctioning model should be tightened. The Minister answered that the police leadership will review the sanctioning system, hold dialogue with the police and stakeholders, but rejected an external disciplinary tribunal for the police, citing the existing internal system and the AGFA advisory commission.
Partially removing the responsibility to determine disciplinary measures for improper conduct and placing it externally does not, in the police's view, contribute to an open, transparent climate.

Het – gedeeltelijk – weghalen van de verantwoordelijkheid om disciplinaire maatregelen te bepalen bij ongeoorloofd gedrag en deze extern neerleggen, draagt naar het oordeel van de politie niet bij aan een open, transparant klimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het NFI de komende jaren minder onderzoeken kan doen door financiële tekorten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) faces financial shortfalls that will reduce its investigations for police and prosecutors, and whether its budget is being cut and extra funds withheld. The minister confirmed that investigation output will fall by roughly 0.6 to 1.0 million euro in 2021 despite an extra 1 million euro, attributing this to needed investment in IT and lab equipment, and said no further budget is available within the current ministerial budget.
It is correct, however, that in the coming years the NFI will be able to carry out fewer investigations for the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Het klopt echter dat het NFI de komende jaren minder onderzoeken uit kan voeren voor politie en OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Nieuw anti-misdaadteam wekt wrevel bij de politie'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a new multidisciplinary anti-crime team (MIT) was causing resentment in the police, including its rationale, its relation to existing units, staffing, budget and risks to other services. The minister answered that the MIT complements existing services, is funded structurally, is being built in phases, and that work will continue without pausing the rollout.
I will keep your House informed of the progress of building the MIT in my regular letters on the approach to undermining crime.
Ik zal uw Kamer op de hoogte blijven houden van de voortgang van de bouw van het MIT in mijn reguliere brieven over de aanpak ondermijning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, El Yassini en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Journalisten aangevallen bij kerkdiensten Urk en Krimpen: ‘Dit is een aantasting van de rechtsstaat''

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Security minister about attacks on journalists at church services on Urk and in Krimpen aan den IJssel, police and prosecution handling, PersVeilig complaint figures, the 200% sentencing uplift for violence against journalists, a team for threatened journalists, support for freelance journalists, and COVID-era church gatherings. The minister answered in detail, stating that suspects were processed with proces-verbaal, that the police and local tripartite were responsible for risk assessment, and that research on violence against journalists and taskforce options were underway.
In the first 3 months of 2021, journalists reported threats, assault and intimidation to the PersVeilig reporting point 73 times.
Journalisten hebben in de eerste 3 maanden van 2021 73 keer melding gemaakt van bedreiging, mishandeling en intimidatie bij (het meldpunt) PersVeilig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de belaging van journalisten in Urk en Krimpen aan den IJssel

An MP asked about police inaction against threats and violence toward journalists in Urk and Krimpen aan den IJssel and whether the PersVeilig protocol works as intended. The minister condemned the violence, said police de-escalation kept the situation manageable, and stated the protocol is expected to function, with awareness and additional measures for freelance journalists being pursued.
We have said it before and we say it again: keep your hands off journalists.
Wij hebben het eerder gezegd en zeggen het nu weer: blijf met je handen van journalisten af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat brandweerpersoneel al jaren waarschuwt voor onveilige situaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that fire service personnel have long warned of unsafe conditions, including whether dive teams are life-saving and whether a minimum number of dive teams per area should be set. The Minister confirmed dive teams can save lives, said the number of dive teams has been roughly constant at about 50, and rejected a national minimum norm, leaving staffing to regional safety boards.
Data on the number of dive teams are not registered by me myself.
Gegevens over het aantal duikteams worden niet door mijzelf geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Klappen en stroomstoten: politiehonden bij training mishandeld'

An MP from the PVV asks the Justice Minister about reports that police dogs are abused during private training, that police still buy such dogs, and that the police use dogs previously trained with electric collars. The Minister acknowledges the abuse, says a criminal investigation into one association is underway, and states the police no longer buy from trainers who abuse dogs and plan to phase out e-collar-trained dogs.
Following the Zembla broadcast, the police, on behalf of the public prosecutor, are currently investigating at one association whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Zembla wordt momenteel door de politie, in opdracht van het OM, bij één vereniging onderzocht of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de structurele mishandeling van honden in training bij leden van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Politiehonden Vereniging (KNPV)

An MP from PvdD asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about structural animal abuse in training of police dogs by KNPV members, including demands to suspend ties, halt exports, ban electric equipment, and review the dogs' use as force. The minister acknowledged the abuse reports, said a criminal investigation is ongoing, refused to suspend the relationship with the KNPV as a whole, and promised a law to ban electric training equipment.
A bill is being prepared to introduce such a ban.
Er wordt gewerkt aan een wetsvoorstel om een dergelijk verbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Weverling over het bericht 'Politiehonden in opleiding nog steeds mishandeld'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Weverling asked about media reports of mistreatment of police dogs in training at a private KNPV club, including contracts, sanctions and reporting duties. The minister said police are examining whether criminal investigation is warranted, that the problem does not appear structural, and promised tighter contract penalties and no further purchases from trainers convicted of animal cruelty, but said a ban on keeping animals cannot apply to the KNPV as an umbrella body.
Based on this broadcast, the police, on the instruction of the Public Prosecution Service, are examining whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Op grond van deze uitzending wordt door de politie, in opdracht van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), onderzocht of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een malafide hostingbedrijf waartegen niet wordt opgetreden

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a hosting company suspected of cybercrime, malware and child pornography hosting was not prosecuted for years, and what the government's analysis and plans are. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, cited liability limits for hosting providers under Dutch and EU law, pointed to capacity investments and to pending legislation (an online child abuse enforcement authority and the EU Digital Services Act) plus sector initiatives.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend ga ik niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de toegenomen geweldscriminaliteit onder jongeren

MP Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why the number of minors suspected of serious violent crime rose for two years running, whether this reflects better visibility, and what broader approach is planned. Minister Grapperhaus answered that juvenile crime overall is falling but that a worrying rise in serious violence is being monitored, that a fuller explanation needs further research, and that prevention, the Wapens en Jongeren action plan and neighbourhood approaches are being pursued, while committing to inform parliament before summer.
The Minister for Legal Protection will inform your House further about developments in juvenile crime before the summer.
De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming zal uw Kamer voor de zomer nader informeren over de ontwikkelingen in de jeugdcriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “het advies van het Veiligheidsberaad met betrekking tot het openen van de terrassen met Pasen”

Van Haga asked the Justice Minister why the unanimous advice of the 25 safety regions to open terraces at Easter was not adopted, and requested OMT advice and modelling. Minister Grapperhaus explained that the cabinet weighed multiple advices, postponed loosening after R-number and hospital figures did not stabilise, and referred to already-published OMT advices, with partial terrace opening later allowed under conditions.
All OMT advices are public and are being presented to your House.
Alle adviezen van het OMT zijn openbaar en worden aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het inbouwen van verborgen ruimtes in auto’s voor criminele activiteiten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the legal construction of hidden compartments in cars used by criminals, police calls to criminalise it, and garage obligations, capacity and international cooperation. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a criminalisation proposal is under review without commitment, and noted there is no mandatory reporting duty and no structural police-garage cooperation.
At present it is being examined whether the proposal to criminally prohibit building hidden compartments is the best solution to this problem.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken of het voorstel om het inbouwen van verborgen ruimtes strafrechtelijk te verbieden de beste oplossing is voor deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het inreisverbod vanuit landen buiten Europa, en dan met name Zuid-Afrika

An MP from FvD asked the Justice Minister whether travel bans from outside Europe, particularly South Africa, apply equally to all countries, why the UK ban was lifted, and why family and long-distance partner visits are treated differently. The government explained the EU entry ban plus the national flight ban for listed countries including South Africa, the advice behind lifting the UK flight ban, and that family visits qualify for exceptions only under the EU ban, not the flight ban.
The flight ban is a supplementary measure and was introduced for countries where VOCs, including the South African variant, occur more often than in the Netherlands.
Het vliegverbod is een aanvullende maatregel en is ingesteld voor landen waar VOCs, waaronder de Zuid-Afrikaanse variant, meer voorkomen dan in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van Nispen over het stopzetten van AMBER Alert

MPs Kathmann and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the police are ending the AMBER Alert contract for missing-child alerts and moving them into Burgernet, questioning its effectiveness, cost, consultation and the minister's earlier praise. Minister Grapperhaus answered all eleven questions, defending the move as lawful and cost-efficient while stating that missing-child alerts continue and the minister remains convinced of their value.
The police decided not to extend the commercial contract with Netpresenter B.V. for the service for this functionality, currently branded AMBER Alert.
De politie heeft besloten het commerciële contract met het bedrijf Netpresenter B.V. voor de dienstverlening voor deze functionaliteit, die momenteel de merknaam AMBER Alert draagt, niet te verlengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het stopzetten van de samenwerking met AMBER Alert

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about the cost, performance, tendering and legal basis of the AMBER Alert contract with Netpresenter, and why the child-missing alert function is being moved into Burgernet. The minister answered that the roughly 1.1 million euro yearly contract was unlawful to extend, the tender was postponed by litigation, and integration into Burgernet was chosen for control, privacy and efficiency reasons, with a one-off 200,000 euro investment.
The police have commissioned the supplier of the Burgernet system to integrate the missing-child alert function into Burgernet.
De politie heeft aan de leverancier van het Burgernetsysteem opdracht verstrekt voor de integratie van de functionaliteit vermist-kind-alertering bij Burgernet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht lijkschennis

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether necrophilia and desecration of corpses should be made a criminal offence in the Netherlands, given that similar acts are punishable in neighbouring countries. Minister Grapperhaus answered that necrophilia is not directly punishable but can be prosecuted under other provisions, that no societal demand for a separate offence has been found, and that he will ask the WODC to explore the question and report this year.
I will ask the WODC to conduct an exploration of the possibilities for criminalising necrophilia
Ik zal het WODC vragen een verkenning te doen van de mogelijkheden tot strafbaarstelling van necrofilie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de operationalisering en instrumentalisering van de IHRA-definitie van antisemitisme

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the European Commission's handbook on the IHRA antisemitism definition, its authors, use in funding and the appointment of the national antisemitism coordinator Eddo Verdoner, including his former board role at CIDI. The Minister answers that the Commission decides its own publications, that the IHRA definition is a non-legally binding working definition, that funding conditions require a statutory basis, and that Verdoner has resigned his prior functions and is suitable for the post.
The European Commission itself decides on the texts it publishes.
De Europese Commissie beslist zelf over de teksten die zij publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Smeets over functionaliteit vermist-kind-alertering

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about the planned discontinuation of the AMBER Alert child-abduction alert service and its integration into Burgernet 2.0, including technical readiness, reach, international searches, safeguards, costs and loss of expertise. The minister answered that the switch rests on Burgernet 2.0's national messaging and image capabilities, that continuity and quality will be maintained, that a transition period with some manual linking is planned, and that Netpresenter's cooperation is uncertain.
The starting point of the integration is that the current quality, continuity and functionality of the missing-child service will be maintained.
Uitgangspunt bij de integratie is dat de huidige kwaliteit, continuïteit en functionaliteit van de vermist-kind-voorziening gehandhaafd blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Buitenweg over het advies van de politie om na intimidatie online onder een andere naam verder te gaan

MPs Paternotte and Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether police advised a local politician to change his Twitter name after reporting intimidation, and how that fits with protecting free expression and with police policy on reporting online intimidation. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed the case, said police may advise victims to adjust their behaviour to end a threatening situation quickly, that the victim decides whether to follow it, and that such advice is consistent with putting victim safety first.
This advice is given on the consideration that the safety of the victim comes first or may be at risk.
Dit advies wordt gegeven uit de overweging dat de veiligheid van het slachtoffer voorop staat of mogelijkerwijs gevaar loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Gemeente Meppel gaat in gesprek met bewoners over uitbreiding prostitutiegebied’

An SGP MP asked the government about Meppel's plans to expand a prostitution zone and the claimed effects on neighbourhood liveability, drug problems, and whether municipalities can exclude prostitution businesses. The State Secretary replied that local matters lie with municipal councils, refused to make general claims about liveability or drugs, said a municipal 'zero option' is not yet legally possible until the Wrs takes effect, and declined further legal frameworks.
On questions about local situations, the central government exercises great restraint.
Bij vragen over lokale situaties past de rijksoverheid grote terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over vrijwilligheid bij de brandweer

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the exclusion of the volunteer firefighters' union from a task-differentiation think tank, the claimed impact on all volunteer posts, and EU rules on volunteers, and whether the Chamber will be consulted before irreversible steps. The minister answers that the union joined the think tank in its final stage, that EU working-time and part-time rules apply regardless of the employer, that the veiligheidsregio's decide the organisation within existing law, and that details of the next phase will be reported to the Chamber later.
I will inform the Chamber about this at a later moment.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover op een later moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over spanningen en mogelijke integriteitskwesties in de vakbond van justitieambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reported tensions, integrity allegations and high expense claims within the justice officials' trade union, and how many complaints had been filed. The Minister declined substantive comment, saying the union has its own statutes and that internal investigation is for its members, while explaining that internal reports at his ministry are investigated and that a confidential reporting point exists.
The alleged conduct concerns members and/or board members in their capacity within a trade union, and for that reason I must exercise restraint.
Het gaat om vermeende gedragingen in de hoedanigheid van lid en/of bestuurder van een vakbond en om die reden dien ik hier terughoudendheid te betrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Amsterdam stoot Londen van de troon als Europees handelscentrum’

MPs Groothuizen asked whether the shift of share trading from London to Amsterdam raises the risk of illicit money entering the Dutch capital market, and about the FIOD's leadership and innovation. The government answered that AFM supervision and anti-money-laundering rules cover trading venues, that no signals of increased laundering have been received, that an interim director has led the FIOD since February 2021, and that anti-laundering measures continue.
The AFM therefore indicates that possible money-laundering risks are sufficiently covered by this and that there is sufficient insight into these risks.
De AFM geeft daarom aan dat hiermee mogelijke witwasrisico’s voldoende ondervangen zijn en dat er hiermee voldoende zicht bestaat op deze risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een klokkenluider bij de politie ernstig gepest werd

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a police whistleblower in the Rotterdam appgroup case was transferred because of the pressure, whether whistleblowers deserve protection, and how the force responds to racist remarks and the mild sanction given. The minister answered that the officer moved voluntarily for a career step, that the whistleblower protection ban and complaint procedures exist, and that disciplinary measures were imposed after advice from an independent committee.
I agree that police officers who become aware of conduct or activities within the organisation that may harm or threaten the public interest should be protected when they report this.

Ik ben het ermee eens dat politiemedewerkers die op de hoogte zijn van gedragingen of activiteiten binnen de organisatie die het algemeen belang kunnen schaden of bedreigen, dienen te worden beschermd als zij dit melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'onduidelijkheid bij gemaakte afspraken door banken inzake het vergoeden van spoofingfraude'

MP Van Nispen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the current state of compensation for spoofing fraud victims, the banks' agreement on what counts as gross negligence, and whether differing bank assessments are acceptable. The minister answered that banks have compensated about 96% of telephone-number spoofing cases, that a joint framework defining gross negligence is being finalised, and that a further letter will follow in May.
To be able to assess future cases of spoofing properly, it is important that the banks quickly establish the definition of the coulance assessment criteria.
Om ook toekomstige gevallen van spoofing goed te kunnen beoordelen is het belangrijk dat de banken snel de definitie van de toetsingscriteria voor coulance vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Politie: in vijf jaar moet 35 procent agenten migratieachtergrond hebben’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that the national police aims for 35 percent officers with a migrant background within five years, raising concerns about capacity, quality of selection, handling of discrimination complaints, and police diversity networks. The Minister acknowledges the capacity shortfall until 2024, states that selection remains objective and quality-based, sets a 35 percent intake target for four Randstad units by 2025 while promising periodic reporting to parliament, and defends diversity networks.
Parliament will be informed about this periodically.
De Kamer zal hierover periodiek worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht 'Vrees voor Chinese spionage via douanescanners in haven Rotterdam'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports of Chinese espionage risks from Nuctech X-ray scanners used by Dutch customs at Rotterdam port, airports and distribution centres. The government confirmed the deployment, said risk assessments are case-by-case with an external security audit underway, and stated it would consider proportionate measures without committing to halting use of the scanners.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the Intelligence and Security Services.
Over het kennisniveau van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over kwetsbaarheden in de cybersecurity van scanners in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the government about cybersecurity vulnerabilities in Nuctech cargo scanners at the Rotterdam port, including Chinese state links, supplier screening, remote maintenance access and server separation. The ministers answered that a Douane external audit is underway, that the remote maintenance connection will not be shut off pending the audit, and that existing procurement and national security rules apply.
The remote connection for maintenance will not be shut down pending the external investigation, because ending it carries the risk that scanning equipment remains broken for a long time.

De remote verbinding voor onderhoud wordt in afwachting van het extern onderzoek niet stilgezet, omdat het opheffen hiervan het risico met zich meebrengt dat scanapparatuur langdurig in storing blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kritiek op peperdure advocaten van politieagenten en de onderbetaling van sociaal advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asks why the police paid about 1.3 million euros in lawyers' fees to defend officers in one case, whether those rates are justified, and why legal aid lawyers are underpaid. The ministers say the fees cover 26 officers over about three years, reflect market rates, and that the state is a paying client; they also outline a plan to increase legal aid fees and a structural reform programme.

Disclosure of information may be withheld to the extent that the interest does not outweigh the interest in avoiding undue advantage or disadvantage to natural or legal persons involved or third parties.

Openbaarmaking van gegevens mag achterwege blijven voor zover het belang niet opweegt tegen het belang van onevenredige bevoordeling of benadeling van bij de aangelegenheid betrokken natuurlijke personen of rechtspersonen danwel derden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de verkoop van Nederlandse MP5’s in een Maltese wapenhandel

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Defence about the sale of 2,084 surplus Dutch firearms (Glock pistols, m2.50 and MP5 submachine guns) to a Dutch dealer apparently destined for a Maltese arms shop, questioning the sale method, export implications and EU compliance. The government answered that the sale was lawful under EU and Dutch rules, that policy is being tightened to exclude sales of firearms to private parties, and that it bought back only the unsold weapons, arguing it lacks a legal basis to recover the rest.

That is why I have instructed that a new assessment framework be drawn up for disposing of surplus Defence materiel, tightening policy by excluding sales of firearms to private parties other than the manufacturer or a manufacturer's licence holder.

Daarom heb ik ook opdracht gegeven om een nieuw afwegingskader op te stellen voor het afstoten van overtollig Defensiematerieel, waarin het beleid wordt aangescherpt door de verkoop van handvuurwapens aan private partijen, niet zijnde de fabrikant of een licentiehouder van de fabrikant, uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Leraar Khalid A. had meiden dansschool ‘volledig in de greep’: ‘Naar de top in ruil voor seks’'

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a dance teacher who allegedly abused girls was able to act for so long, whether screening tools suffice to keep abusers out of sports and youth settings, and what the 15 million euro structural funding for sex-crime capacity has achieved. The government answered that it cannot comment on ongoing criminal investigations, relies on the VOG screening and the abuser register, sees no added value in a dedicated prosecutor for cross-database pattern searches, and reports about 90 new detectives phased in.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over buitensporig geweld door politie en ME bij demonstraties

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice about anonymous BPOC2020 interview transcripts with police officers and about alleged excessive force by police and ME riot units against peaceful demonstrators, asking who is ultimately responsible. The Minister acknowledged the interviews but said their source and validity cannot be established, declined to judge the force used (a matter for other authorities or the courts), explained the statutory safeguards and the mayor's and police chief's responsibilities, and said he is politically responsible for police functioning.
It is for other authorities, where appropriate the courts, to make that assessment.
Het is aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om die beoordeling te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat sekswerkers tijdens de lockdown met meer geweld te maken krijgen

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked why sex workers, many outside the income-support schemes during the lockdown, face more violence and financial distress and whether a special support measure and police assurances for victims are planned. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained which schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW, bijstand, TONK) may apply depending on employment status, said the police will not fine victims reporting crime, and promised to raise the signals with municipalities.
The cabinet has asked municipalities to apply the TONK generously.
Het kabinet heeft gemeenten verzocht de TONK ruimhartig toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei in technologie investeert voor de etnische profilering van Oeigoeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Huawei and other Chinese tech firms are developing facial recognition to identify Uyghurs, and what Dutch and EU responses, export controls and standards safeguards could address this. The government answered that it cannot confirm Huawei's denial, raised the issue with the company, noted that Dutch export controls do not cover ethnic-identification technology, and said it will consider EU human rights sanctions and due diligence obligations.
The cabinet cannot confirm this explanation from Huawei on the basis of its own information.
Het kabinet kan deze uitleg van Huawei op basis van eigen informatie niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over grootschalige en onrechtmatige verzameling van data van burgers door de krijgsmacht, de politie, de Belastingdienst, de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten en andere overhei

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about large-scale and unlawful data collection on citizens by the armed forces (LIMC), police systems, UWV (SONAR), the Tax Service, and COA-police data sharing, including whether these comply with GDPR and oversight rules. The ministers acknowledged shortcomings, described remediation steps such as stopping LIMC collection pending an internal review, phasing out SONAR, and ending COA data sharing, while deferring some matters to ongoing investigations and to a future cabinet on AP funding.
If it turns out that government organisations are not or insufficiently able to do so, the cabinet will discuss this with the relevant body.
Indien blijkt dat overheidsorganisaties hier niet of onvoldoende toe in staat zijn, dan gaat het kabinet hierover met het desbetreffende onderdeel in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over politiegeweld bij een demonstratie op het Malieveld

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about alleged disproportionate police violence at a COVID protest on the Malieveld, including baton strikes, police dog use and water cannon hits on journalists, and whether an independent investigation would be carried out. The minister answered that the police and the Public Prosecution Service are assessing the use of force under existing rules, that no separate investigation is planned, and that the police dog deployment criteria have been tightened in a recent amendment to the Ambtsinstructie.
Whether or not there was disproportionate use of force is not for me to judge but for the authorities that investigate and assess that use of force.
Het oordeel of er wel of niet sprake is geweest van disproportioneel geweldgebruik is niet aan mij maar aan de autoriteiten die dat geweldgebruik onderzoeken en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Omstreden imam Fawaz Jneid blijft ‘ongewenst’, maar gemeente kan hem geen strobreed in de weg leggen'

MP Becker (VVD) asks why the minister extended a area ban on Fawaz Jneid, whether he will appeal a court ruling lifting the ban for two Den Haag neighbourhoods, and how he weighs local concerns about radicalisation. The minister says no appeal was filed because new facts are needed and the court found insufficient link to those neighbourhoods, and that a new ban would require fresh facts, while local monitoring and prevention continue.
Given the information in the administrative report underlying the area ban in relation to the court's ruling, I consider an appeal to have no prospect of success.

Gelet op de informatie in de bestuurlijke rapportage die ten grondslag ligt aan het betreffende gebiedsverbod in relatie tot de uitspraak van de rechtbank acht ik een hoger beroep geen kans van slagen te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat president Erdogan een grote rol speelt in opkomst salafisme in Nederland

An MP asked ministers about reports that Erdogan plays a major role in the rise of Salafism in the Netherlands, citing a leaked confidential NCTV analysis. The minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's content, pointed to existing government positions and a forthcoming analysis, and described existing measures against online terrorist content.
As indicated, I cannot go into the content of the draft analysis.
Zoals aangegeven kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Erdogan volgens uitgelekt vertrouwelijk NCTV-rapport een grote rol speelt bij de opkomst van het salafisme in Nederland

MP Van Kooten-Arissen asked about reports of a leaked confidential NCTV draft analysis on Erdogan's role in the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and on government conduct toward Turkey, Milli Görüş, Diyanet and the Utrecht tram attacker's associates. The government answered that it cannot discuss the content of the unfinished, confidential draft, which is not policy, that a definitive analysis will follow before summer 2021, and that existing policy and positions remain unchanged.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Geheime ‘Turkije analyse’ NCTV lekt uit: grote rol Erdogan bij opkomst salafisme in Nederland'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the government about a leaked confidential NCTV analysis linking Erdogan to the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and about follow-up on related motions. The Minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's contents, referred to existing policy and a forthcoming final analysis, and answered the remaining questions largely by pointing to ongoing work and existing frameworks.
At this moment I cannot address the questions posed by your House about the content of the draft analysis.
Ik kan op dit moment niet ingaan op door uw Kamer gestelde vragen over de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de verlenging van de jachtakte

An MP asked why hunting licence holders were required to mail their documents and pay leges again for 2020/2021 when licences had been automatically extended, and whether this amounted to double payment. The Minister answered that the approach was changed so licences are automatically extended to 1 July 2021, that leges are a legal condition for issuing the licence and cover structural police costs, and that hunters may continue hunting with a copy.
Paying leges is a legal requirement for issuing the hunting licence.
Het betalen van leges is een wettelijk vereiste voor de afgifte van de jachtakte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over marktkooplieden in de non-food sector, die nog steeds niet open mogen

An MP asked the Justice, Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers why non-food market traders may still not reopen, why they are excluded from click & collect, NOW and TVL support, and whether the Tozo partner-income test and market fees can be relaxed. The minister answered that epidemiological conditions do not yet allow reopening, that the partner-income test will be kept for capacity and equality reasons, and that municipalities decide on market fees without a separate compensation scheme.
The cabinet does not intend to abolish the partner income test in the Tozo.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de partnerinkomenstoets in de Tozo af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Justitie deelt kritieke informatie over hacks niet met bedrijven’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the NCSC does not share critical threat information about cyberattacks with companies, and about the legal basis, OKTT status for the Digital Trust Center, and possible contact with the UK. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says a bill amending the Wbni is being prepared for consultation around summer, and says the DTC will be designated as an OKTT after further steps.
I am therefore working on a bill to ensure that more of the aforementioned data can reach those other providers.
Ik werk daarom aan een wetsvoorstel om ervoor te zorgen dat meer van de hiervoor genoemde gegevens bij die andere aanbieders terecht kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de artikel 7-procedure tegen EU-lidstaten Polen en Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether it shares the Portuguese presidency's view that Article 7 proceedings against Poland and Hungary cannot proceed without physical hearings, and whether it will help organise them. The government agreed the procedure should not stall, explained that video meetings are informal and risk later annulment challenges, and said it will press for regular agenda items and welcomes the presidency's plan to table the procedures in a physical General Affairs Council.
The cabinet agrees that stagnation of both Article 7 procedures would be undesirable.
Het kabinet is het er mee eens dat stagnatie van beide artikel 7-procedures onwenselijk zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Postma over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans and Postma asked the Justice minister about the delayed implementation of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij (armed protection of Dutch merchant ships against piracy), including the status of the repair bill, ILT preparations, stakeholder engagement, the 2022 deadline and extending coverage to the Gulf of Guinea. The minister replied that the repair bill and draft decree will be submitted shortly, ILT is preparing enforcement and extra testing is planned, stakeholders are consulted regularly, the target remains entry into force this year but the new cabinet must decide, and that armed guards cannot help in coastal waters so Gulf of Guinea coverage remains under review alongside EU initiatives.
It is my aim to submit the Reparatiewetsvoorstel bescherming koopvaardij to the Council of Ministers this month and to submit it to your House as soon as possible thereafter.
Het is mijn streven het Reparatiewetsvoorstel bescherming koopvaardij nog deze maand ter behandeling aan te bieden bij de ministerraad en zo spoedig mogelijk daarna in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Dam over wachttijden bij het opvolgen van aangiftes over verkrachtingen

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dam asked about long waiting times before police act on rape reports, including delays in questioning suspects, whether this weakens prosecution, and whether victims are advised to stay silent during investigations. The Minister acknowledged high workloads and 798 open cases over six months, outlined extra capacity funding and a six-month target, and said victims are heard quickly to limit influence and support referral.
The police are working hard to improve the performance of the vice squad's duties.
De politie werkt hard aan verbetering in de taakuitvoering van de zedenpolitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de blijvende achterstand bij het behandelen van ernstige zedendelicten

An MP asks the Justice Minister why rape reports wait up to a year for police attention, and whether the 6-month target for sending files to the prosecutor is being met. The Minister acknowledges the problem, points to the Inspectorate report, the 15 million euro investment, staffing increases and improvement measures, but gives no guarantee on timelines and notes that the capacity is still insufficient.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het inschakelen van burgers bij de bestrijding van ondermijning

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how citizens can report signals of undermining crime, how false suspicions can be prevented, and whether a single central reporting point should be created. The Minister described existing reporting channels (police, Meld Misdaad Anoniem, municipalities, FIOD), campaigns to raise reporting willingness, and safeguards requiring suspicions to rest on facts, while rejecting the need for one central reporting point.
A suspicion must be based on facts and circumstances.
Een verdenking moet zijn gebaseerd op feiten en omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Helvert over de ongeregeldheden bij Marokkaanse consulaten

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about protests and intimidation at Moroccan consulates in the Netherlands, including the desecration of the Moroccan flag in Utrecht. The ministers condemned the incidents, said police and the Public Prosecution Service act on criminal offences, and described contacts and extra security alertness, while stating that demonstrations are a local matter for mayors.
As your House knows, we cannot make statements about the nature of the measures.
Over de aard van de maatregelen kunnen wij, zoals uw Kamer weet, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat strafrechtdeskundigen het rapport van de commissie Machielse kraken

MPs Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Justice Minister why legal experts reached different conclusions than the Machielse commission on the Poch case, and whether the commission's underlying documents would be shared. The minister declined to change his view, deferred to the commission's own response, and said the commission's archive will be reviewed for release to parliament once transferred to his department.
Once the archive has been transferred to my department, these documents will be reviewed to assess which documents can be provided to your House under Article 68 of the Constitution.

Zodra het archief is overgedragen aan mijn departement, zullen deze documenten worden doorgenomen om te beoordelen welke documenten op grond van artikel 68 Grondwet aan uw Kamer kunnen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland inzake de e-screener

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Finance ministers about a court ruling on the e-screener and how many firearms have been deactivated in the Netherlands and exported abroad for deactivation. The Minister of Justice answered that 182 firearms were submitted to police since around September 2019 through 1 February 2021, 107 of which were checked and certified, and that export figures cannot be made transparent because customs loses sight of firearms once they leave the country.
Customs only grants export licences covering the movement of firearms across the border out of the Netherlands.
De douane verleent alleen exportvergunningen die zien op de beweging van vuurwapens naar buiten Nederland (de grensoverschrijding).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de onderhandelingen over de politie-cao

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police unions' threatened action over the police collective labour agreement signals that pay must rise, and whether recruitment problems require better terms. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government values police work and seeks pay development following the private sector, and that the police have no general recruitment problem beyond specialist roles.
In this light, a good offer on wage development has been put forward during the negotiations with the police unions.
In dit licht is er tijdens de onderhandelingen met de politievakbonden een goed bod voor loonontwikkeling neergelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders terrorismepolitie: er zijn “wandelende tijdbommen” die zomaar aanslag kunnen plegen’

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked the Justice Minister about reports of mismanagement at the counterterrorism police unit CTER, including unsupervised radicalised returnees, understaffing and whistleblower complaints ignored by leadership. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Inspectorate of Justice and Security has started an exploratory investigation, that no earlier signals had reached him, that CTER has 17 vacancies out of 128 fte, and that he will inform parliament once the Inspectorate concludes.
The Inspectorate operates independently. Therefore it is up to them to determine when the investigation is concluded.
De Inspectie opereert onafhankelijk. Daarom is het aan hen te bepalen wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zonder kleding voor de klas in nieuw NPO-Zappprogramma’

An MP asked the ministers whether a children's NPO Zapp programme showing nude adults to primary-school pupils is pedagogically acceptable, whether it conforms to the Kijkwijzer classification and parental consent, and whether the broadcast should be stopped. The minister replied that media content is for the public broadcaster and parents to judge, that the programme was classified 'Alle Leeftijden' by NICAM with Rutgers input and consent obtained, and that the government cannot ask the NPO to refrain from broadcasting because prior review is prohibited.
It is therefore not appropriate for the government to appeal to the NPO or the broadcasters to refrain from broadcasting.
Het past dan ook niet dat de overheid een appél doet op de NPO of de omroepen om van uitzending af te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Buitenweg over het onderzoek naar taakdifferentiatie bij de brandweer

Two MPs (Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Buitenweg) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the consequences of task differentiation in the fire service, including effects on volunteers and whether EU working-time and part-time rules can be met. The minister answered that consequences were analysed for all 25 safety regions, that task differentiation is feasible but needs organisational change, and that volunteer status will be preserved while EU compliance steps will be taken.
I consider it necessary that the safety regions, as employers of fire service personnel, quickly take concrete steps to arrange that.
Ik vind het noodzakelijk dat de veiligheidsregio’s als werkgevers van het brandweerpersoneel snel concrete stappen zetten om dat te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de boete voor een kapitein na een grote olielekkage in de Rotterdamse haven

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why a captain was fined only 1,000 euros after a major oil spill in the Rotterdam port, and about liability, sentencing and environmental criminal law. The minister answered that the courts decide sentencing, that the shipowner's liability-limitation request was rejected and is pending before the Supreme Court, and that work on speeding up environmental enforcement is underway, without committing to new criminal-law measures.
I do not intervene in the decision of the criminal judge.
Ik treed niet in de beslissing van de strafrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over ongeregeldheden in Urk

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about riots and arson in Urk linked to COVID-19 measures, whether the violence was unacceptable, why it escalated despite police reinforcements, and whether the mayor was supported and enough enforcement was in place. The minister condemned the violence, said enforcement is the mayor's responsibility under the municipal council, described contacts with the mayor and support networks, and said the situation had calmed.
The mayor is responsible for maintaining public order and is accountable to the municipal council for this.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de openbare orde en legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat verzekeraars mogelijk meer dan 1 miljoen euro schade door de avondklokrellen gaan vergoeden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about estimated insured damage from the curfew riots, whether insurers pay out fairly rather than referring claimants to the government damage fund, and whether oversight or recovery of fund costs from insurers is possible. Minister Grapperhaus replied that insured damage is estimated at 1 million euro, that claims are primarily a matter between insurer and insured with no government role or steekproef planned, and that the government will monitor the split between insurers and the fund and speak to the insurers' association if complaints arise.
I see no role for the government in this and see no reason to carry out a sample-based check.
Ik zie hierin geen rol voor de overheid en zie geen aanleiding om een steekproefsgewijze controle uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het verzwakken van encryptie door de minister van Justitie en Veiligheid

The MP Verhoeven asks whether the caretaker cabinet is working to weaken encryption by amending the Telecommunications Act to allow interception of OTT services like WhatsApp, and asks it to stop such work and reconcile it with motions against weakening encryption. The minister confirms the government is examining access to OTT communications, notes the difficulty given end-to-end encryption, reaffirms the 2016 encryption standpoint, and says a ban on encryption will not be supported and the topic will be addressed only after the elections.
Effectively introducing such an obligation is not simple, among other things because several OTT services use end-to-end encryption.
Het effectief invoeren van een dergelijke verplichting niet eenvoudig is, onder andere omdat meerdere OTT-diensten gebruik maken van end-to-end versleuteling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over miljoenenfraude bij de landsadvocaat

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about large-scale fraud by a former top figure at the state's legal advisory firm, questioning oversight capacity, the four-eyes principle, the state's reliance on the firm, and when the minister was informed. Minister Grapperhaus largely declined to address specifics pending ongoing criminal, supervisory and internal investigations, while defending the arrangement and promising to seek further information from the firm and to inform the House later.
Since various investigations are still ongoing on this matter, I cannot go into more detail on this at the present moment.
Aangezien ter zake nog diverse onderzoeken lopen, kan ik hier op dit moment nog niet inhoudelijk nader op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de toename van seksueel geweld tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked ministers whether reported rises in sexual violence during the coronavirus crisis, based on a Rutgers study, are alarming and how they relate to domestic violence, police and prosecution data, and youth sexual health. The government answered that the Rutgers study does not show an increase in sexual violence, that police and prosecution data show fewer reports in 2020, and it pointed to existing campaigns and prevention programmes for youth.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten 'Dronter gezin al jaren bedreigd vanwege geografische coördinaten' en 'Hoe boze demonstranten door Google en CIA bij deze onschuldige familie in Dronten terechtkom

An MP asks the Justice and Security minister about reports that a Dronten family has been repeatedly threatened because online maps link their IP address to the geographic centre of the Netherlands, and what the government will do. The minister says police are already acting on criminal threats, commits to facilitating contacts with US bodies and Google at the municipality's request, and points to broader online-harm measures, while noting that linking an IP address to coordinates is not a crime.
The municipality of Dronten has sent me a letter requesting support to restore normality to the situation.
Vanuit de gemeente Dronten heb ik inmiddels per brief het verzoek gekregen om ondersteuning te bieden om de ontstane situatie weer te normaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Ondernemers beschermen zaak tegen relschoppers en krijgen boete'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice whether it is unjust that entrepreneurs who defended their shops against rioters received fines for breaching curfew, and what would be done to waive them. The Minister replied that the curfew regulation has an emergency exception assessed case by case by the public prosecution service, that fines can be contested in court, and that it is not for him to intervene in individual cases.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in individuele zaken te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van politiepaarden en -honden bij oproerbeheersing

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Justice Minister about police horse and dog injuries and welfare during crowd control at unlawful demonstrations in Amsterdam and Eindhoven, and whether alternatives are being investigated. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed the incidents and injuries, argued the animals' deterrent role is an acceptable risk with welfare measures in place, and said no suitable alternative exists yet while developments are monitored.
To date there is no suitable alternative to the deployment of police horses and dogs for crowd control, crowd management and riot control.
Er is tot op heden nog geen geschikt alternatief voor de inzet van politiepaarden en -honden ten aanzien van crowd control , crowd management en riot control .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitvoering van de motie van de leden Van Raak en Van der Molen over een pilotproject voor klokkenluiders

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked how the motion on a pilot project for whistleblowers has been implemented. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Secretary-General had proposed a special adviser for internal reporters but withdrew the plan after the unions and the departmental works council objected, and the minister declined to force it through.
Because of the convincing argument of the joint unions and the DOR, the Secretary-General decided to withdraw his plan.
Vanwege het overtuigende betoog van gezamenlijke vakbonden en DOR, heeft de secretaris-generaal besloten zijn voornemen in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Regterschot over de Kamerbrief 'Aanpak personen met verward gedrag, street-triage, GGZ- triage en passend vervoer'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the minister's letter on street triage and care for people with confused behaviour properly fulfilled a unanimously adopted motion calling for street triage pilots in the municipalities with the most reports, and why the Twente pilot only offered care for limited hours. The minister says the motion is being honoured through pilots in Amsterdam and a follow-up ZonMw programme, promising a further letter with the State Secretary of VWS before April 2021.
My intention was indeed to honour your motion with this.
