Mijn intentie was inderdaad om uw motie hiermee gestand te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de IHRA-definitie van antisemitisme

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the non-binding IHRA definition of antisemitism plays a role in prosecution and whether it is used by the Public Prosecution Service, and how the government monitors its use. The Minister answered that the definition is not legally binding, that the OM uses it only as a signalling aid within the existing legal framework, and that he shares ECRI's concern about misuse to stigmatise criticism of Israel.
The Public Prosecution Service takes the view that the definition and its indicators can be helpful in staying alert to facts and circumstances that may indicate discriminatory expressions.

Het OM stelt zich op het standpunt dat de definitie zelf en de indicatoren behorende bij de IHRA-definitie behulpzaam kunnen zijn om alert te zijn op feiten en omstandigheden die een indicatie zouden kunnen vormen van discriminerende uitingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het verrekenen van schadevergoeding op grond van artikel 6:1:13 van het Wetboek van Strafvordering

An MP asked how compensation for unlawful pre-trial detention is offset against outstanding fines and debts under article 6:1:13 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, including 2020 figures per court and whether the practice works well. The Minister explained the court-based offsetting procedure, gave 2020 compensation totals per court (4,584 awards, about 5.68 million euros), and said information exchange with the CJIB is being examined nationally and the CJIB-contact suggestion will be discussed.

Given the positive experiences with this approach, the Judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service are currently examining whether and how this exchange of information can be optimally organised nationwide.

Gelet op de positieve ervaringen van deze werkwijze wordt momenteel door Rechtspraak en Openbaar Ministerie bezien of en hoe deze uitwisseling van informatie landelijk optimaal vorm kan worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Tbs met dwangverpleging geëist tegen moordenaar van Rik van de Rakt

MP Markuszower asks why the Public Prosecution Service demanded a treatment order rather than prison for the killer of 18-year-old Rik van de Rakt, whether officials who failed should be dismissed, and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister replies that the prosecution is independent, that TBS aims at treatment and safe reintegration, that the municipality's inquiry found information was shared within legal limits, that various reforms have been implemented, and that minimum sentences are rejected to protect judicial discretion.
The Public Prosecution Service is independent in determining the sentencing demand in criminal cases.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (hierna: OM) is onafhankelijk in het bepalen van de strafeis in strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Eerst Assads strijder, nu asiel in Nederland’?

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether IND granted residence to Assad regime affiliates, why few 1F exclusions were applied, why prosecution has lagged behind Germany, why reports from the Syrian community went unanswered, and how victims are protected from threats. The minister declines to discuss individual cases, defends the existing 1F policy and the Team Internationale Misdrijven, admits one unanswered report due to an error, and points to existing protection measures without new commitments.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet in gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de nieuwe Bob-campagne in België om rijden onder invloed tegen te gaan.

An MP asked the ministers about a Belgian drink-driving campaign in which intoxicated drivers receive a keyring bearing the name of a child killed in a crash, and whether it could be adopted in the Netherlands with more alcohol checks. The minister said the Belgian action is a private add-on to the regular campaign, that no evaluation is planned, that the idea will be considered in the next campaign strategy with a letter to parliament after the summer, and that Dutch enforcement already intensifies alcohol checks during campaign periods.
I will include the idea and its evaluation in the strategy determination for the coming version of the BOB campaign to see whether it is a good idea to do this in the Netherlands too.
Ik zal het idee en de evaluatie hiervan meenemen bij de strategiebepaling voor de komende versie van de BOB-Campagne om te kijken of het een goed idee is dit ook in Nederland te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over het bericht 'Beschermenswaardige partijen: bescherming van het daderdier'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about dangerous fighting dogs, including unrestricted ownership, medical and police costs, shelters rehoming such dogs, breeding restrictions and the Amsterdam appeal court ruling on liability. Minister Schouten answered that existing criminal and municipal powers are sufficient, that breeding restrictions and a risk test exist or are being developed, and that rehoming is possible depending on behavioural testing.
Criminal law provisions apply that impose restrictions on keepers of dangerous dogs.
Er gelden strafrechtelijke voorschriften die beperkingen opleggen aan houders van gevaarlijke honden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'OM: Incident Akwasi heeft geen juridische gevolgen'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether public prosecutors should pursue presenter Akwasi for theft, threats and intimidation over a media incident, and accused the prosecution service of political and corrupt non-prosecution. The Minister replied that the prosecution service decided independently not to prosecute, citing the broadcaster's refusal to cooperate and insufficient evidence, and rejected the suggestion of political bias.
The decision of the Public Prosecution Service not to prosecute Mr Akwasi is an autonomous decision.
De beslissing van het Openbaar Ministerie om de heer Akwasi niet te vervolgen betreft een autonome beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Huisartsen 'niet onder de indruk' van brief Viruswaarheid'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about threats to doctors at their home addresses by the Viruswaarheid group, whether a criminal complaint was filed, and how the motion to shield private addresses in public registers is being implemented. The minister said no complaint is known, the Chamber of Commerce cannot refuse to supply addresses, and a Trade Register amendment to hide residential addresses will be sent for advice shortly, with a further update before the summer recess.

The shielding of registered residential addresses will be implemented through an amendment to the Trade Register Decree, which will shortly be submitted for advice to the Dutch Data Protection Authority and then to the Council of State.

De afscherming van als zodanig geregistreerde woonadressen wordt geëffectueerd door een wijziging in het Handelsregisterbesluit die op korte termijn voor advies wordt voorgelegd aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens en vervolgens aan de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over uitlevering van oorlogsmisdadiger en wapenhandelaar Kouwenhoven aan Nederland

SP MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the extradition of convicted war criminal and arms dealer Kouwenhoven from South Africa, including a December 2020 High Court ruling and whether his assets are being pursued. The Minister said the matter is before South African courts, that Dutch authorities remain in close contact with South Africa and that Nederland continues to seek extradition, and that no asset confiscation order exists in the Dutch case so no asset investigation arises.
It is not for me to further interpret rulings of foreign judges, nor how the extradition procedure relates to any other procedures concerning Mr. Kouwenhoven.

Het is niet aan mij om verdere duiding te geven aan uitspraken van buitenlandse rechters, noch hoe de uitleveringsprocedure zich verhoudt tot eventuele andere procedures in relatie tot dhr. Kouwenhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de ontheffing van de avondklok voor de jacht op zwijnen en vossen

An MP asked the government whether hunting wild boar and foxes at night is exempt from the curfew, why night hunting is allowed, and whether local permits were centrally requested. The minister replied that hunting is not a curfew exemption, only the necessary management of wild boar (to prevent African swine fever) and handling of road-killed wildlife is treated as essential work, agreed with the provinces.
In the third week of January, before the curfew was introduced, the ministry received requests from, among others, the KNJV about being able to carry out necessary wildlife management at night.

Het ministerie heeft in de derde week van januari, voorafgaand aan de invoering van de avondklok, verzoeken ontvangen van onder andere de KNJV over het in de nacht kunnen uitvoeren van noodzakelijk wildbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen het bezoek van predikanten beperken

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether hospitals restricting visits by chaplains conflicts with agreements and legal rights, and whether patients may receive pastoral visits outside visiting hours. The minister replied that hospitals may limit visits for infection control, that no distinction is made between visitor types, that he disagrees with the claim of non-compliance, and that he will only alert hospital associations to a guidance document; he declined to answer question 8 and could not answer in time.
It is up to the care institution to weigh this, in which the safety of all patients and staff counts alongside the interest of the individual patient.
Het is aan de zorginstelling om een afweging te maken, waarbij naast het belang van de individuele patiënt de veiligheid van alle patiënten en personeel meetelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de avondklok in de praktijk

An SP MP asked whether grandparents may babysit after 21:00 when parents must work, and whether an exception should exist for parents in vital professions without other childcare options. The Minister replied that the curfew deliberately contains few exceptions, that parents should first seek alternatives, and that in truly unavoidable cases the babysitter can invoke the 'someone urgently needs my help' exception on the Eigen Verklaring form with an explanation.
In designing the curfew, it was deliberately chosen to make as few exceptions as possible.
Bij de vormgeving van de avondklok is er bewust voor gekozen om zo min mogelijk uitzonderingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Fors meer scholieren geschorst voor wapenbezit op school

MPs asked the ministers about the rise in school suspensions for weapon possession, the number of police reports by schools, and whether schools can check pupils and what sanctions apply. The minister confirmed the increase is worrying, cited rising suspension counts and police incident figures, said no data explain the rise, and pointed to the existing Actieplan Wapens en Jongeren for local cooperation with youth work.
Police systems cannot automatically generate how many schools have filed reports.
Antwoord 4 Uit de politiesystemen valt niet automatisch to genereren door hoeveel scholen aangifte is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het kerkbezoek van de minister van Defensie

An MP asked whether the Minister of Defence's attendance at an in-person church service, and the Justice Minister's earlier call to stay home over Christmas, were consistent with government policy and the example expected of cabinet members. The government answered that the church visit was a personal choice, that Covid rules cannot ban collective worship under the constitutional freedom of religion, and that a minister's individual faith is a personal matter.
Visiting a physical church service by the Minister of Defence was a personal choice.
Het bezoeken van een fysieke kerkdienst door de Minister van Defensie was een persoonlijke keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Groot vuur, auto’s erin, dat is de Haagse traditie. Maar wij kunnen niet overal zijn'

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether a police commander's newspaper remarks that large groups on the street and the fireworks ban are not top priorities reflect official local policy, how New Year's Eve enforcement guidelines are set, and why The Hague's Duindorp saw widespread disorder. The minister replies that the police propose guidelines which the local triangle sets, that the remarks were a subjective summary, that the minister plays no role in formulating them, and that the local mayor will report figures, while committing to nothing new.
I play no role in the formulation of the policy principles.
Ik speel geen rol bij de formulering van de beleidsuitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de second opinion voor nabestaanden

MP Van Nispen asked about the second opinion pilot for bereaved relatives at the Openbaar Ministerie, whether treatment of relatives has improved, and whether relatives and their experts can get a second inspection of the police file. The minister said the pilot ended in December 2020 and will be reported in the spring 2021 letter, that the OM is open to a second file inspection in principle, but experts' access is decided case by case.
The Public Prosecution Service in principle deals generously with requests for inspection from relatives.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat in beginsel ruimhartig om met verzoeken tot inzage van nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Brandbom bij Syrisch gezin in Heerlen’

MP Kuiken asked the Justice minister about a firebomb attack on a Syrian family in Heerlen, including prior police reports, whether police and local authorities acted early, whether the family received protection, and what steps will improve neighbourhood safety. Minister Grapperhaus said local authorities hold primary responsibility, the municipality led the response with camera surveillance and temporary rehousing, a review will be started, and he declined to comment on individual police investigations.
Local liveability and safety are primarily the responsibility of the local government.
De lokale leefbaarheid en veiligheid is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Brandbom bij Syrisch gezin in Heerlen: burenruzie of racisme’

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about a Syrian family in Heerlen subjected to months of threats, intimidation and violence, including a reported firebomb, and about the roles of the municipality, police, housing corporation Vincio Wonen and its past discrimination record. The minister answers that investigations are ongoing and declines to discuss the specific incidents, states that local authorities are primarily responsible for safety and housing, and says the corporation's discrimination matter was previously prosecuted and dismissed while a new review of social media is underway.
While this investigation is ongoing, I do not wish to go into the substance of this specific case and the possible incidents.
Lopende dit onderzoek wil ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus en de eventuele incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over stalking

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a stalking case in Vogelenzang, the rising number of stalking cases, reports that victims were discouraged from filing complaints, spy-apps, the SASH risk tool, planned policy changes, police capacity, and whether contact and location bans could be imposed more easily. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of stalking, described measures taken after the inspectorate report (SASH use, revised prosecution guidelines effective 1 March 2021, casus coordinators), and argued that existing tools already allow fast contact and location bans, so no legal change is needed.
As the police themselves also state in this report, the police initially did not act adequately in this case.
Zoals de politie zelf ook aangeeft in dit bericht, heeft de politie in deze zaak in eerste instantie niet adequaat gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over de artikelen ‘Arabische lessen op de werkvloer’ en ‘Politie Weert geslaagd voor Arabische taal en cultuur’

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that police in Weert took Arabic language and culture lessons, arguing police time should go to public order and Dutch should be the working language. The Minister answered that basic Arabic and culture knowledge was needed given the asylum centres in the Weert district, that the course was taken in personal time and paid from GGP reinforcement funds, and that one of the two asylum centres has since closed so the course is no longer followed.
Given the composition of the Weert basic team's service area, with two asylum reception centres at the time, the team had a need for basic knowledge of Arabic and Arab culture.
Gezien de samenstelling van het verzorgingsgebied van het basisteam Weert, met destijds twee AZC’s, was er in dit team behoefte aan basiskennis van het Arabisch en de Arabische cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gevraagd losgeld om gehackte gemeentedata terug te krijgen

An SP MP asked whether the government agrees with a mayor refusing to pay ransom for hacked municipal data, whether public bodies have paid ransoms, how other municipalities are protected, and how many ransomware extortionists have been convicted. The government agreed that paying ransom is undesirable, said it does not register public-body cases separately and that there is no full picture of ransom payments, described existing cyber-resilience measures and a 2021 exercise on ransomware, and said ransomware is not a separate offence so convictions cannot be counted directly.
There is no complete picture of cases in which public institutions have paid ransom.
Er is geen volledig beeld van gevallen waarbij er door publieke instellingen losgeld is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'We gaan niet de hele dag meekijken'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security how police access to systems is monitored for unusual search behaviour, whether this is legally permitted, and how officers may consult information in personal-conflict situations. The minister answered that a monitoring system flags anomalies for human review, that logging is required under data-protection law though the logging obligation is not yet in force, and that officers may only use police information for operational purposes and must discuss personal conflicts with their supervisor.
To ensure there is no automated decision-making and that a human always looks on and decides, an indication is analysed and weighed by specialists.
Om te zorgen dat er geen sprake is van automatische besluitvorming en er altijd een mens meekijkt en beslist, wordt een indicatie door specialisten geanalyseerd en gewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over aanslagen op drie Poolse winkels

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether three bomb attacks on Polish-owned Biedronka shops in Aalsmeer, Heeswijk-Dinther and Beverwijk were linked, whether they amount to terrorism, what the motives are, and whether all threatened premises can obtain state protection. The minister replied that a broad criminal investigation is under way led by the public prosecutor, that terrorism cannot be established for now and the link to Polish people is unclear, and that security is a shared responsibility with the state providing tailored protection.
The police, under the direction of the public prosecution service, have started an extensive criminal investigation.
De recherche is onder leiding van het openbaar ministerie een uitgebreid opsporingsonderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ''Illegale pokeravonden in de voetbalkantine: 'Dan is dus je hele club naar de Filistijnen''

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how the government will tackle criminal interference in amateur sports clubs and what steps it will take. The minister answers that a broad study confirmed such interference, points to existing cooperation (RIEC's, awareness campaigns, planned guidance and local sports agreements) and says criminal law is a last resort, while not answering question 8 about the committee meeting.
I therefore want to examine whether additional information campaigns could play a role here.
Ik wil dan ook bezien of extra voorlichting hier een rol kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgen om bedreigde advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about threats against lawyers, including shootings at offices, and proposals for better protection, address shielding and transport of criminal lawyers, and a 'safe house' retreat. Minister Grapperhaus replied that EUR 55 million is invested structurally in protection systems, that a resilience programme for lawyers and journalists is underway, and that a safe-house concept will be assessed with the professional groups before any state co-funding is considered.
When there are concrete plans, I am willing to look at whether and how the government can support this financially.
Wanneer er concrete plannen liggen, ben ik bereid om te kijken of en op welke wijze de overheid dit (financieel) kan ondersteunen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meerdere OMT-leden bedreigd en thuis opgezocht'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked the government about reports that several OMT members were threatened and visited at home, and about protection, public address data and doxing. Minister Grapperhaus said threats are unacceptable, police are investigating, protective measures are available where needed, and the address-shielding and doxing policy work is ongoing.
As your House knows, I cannot go into further detail on ongoing matters.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik over lopende zaken niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en De Groot over het bericht dat er wensballonnen in omloop zijn die niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen.

Two D66 MPs asked ministers whether sales of wish balloons that fail safety rules are rising during the fireworks ban, and what enforcement and public information exist. The government replied that it has no data on rising sales, that the NVWA enforces product safety rules and that municipalities may ban releases, while placing responsibility for safe use on consumers.
I am not aware whether sales of these products are increasing, because the NVWA has not carried out any research into this.
Het is mij niet bekend of er een toename is in de verkoop van deze producten omdat daar door de NVWA geen onderzoek naar gedaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen transpersonen houdt aan: ‘We moeten dit niet accepteren’’

Three MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how they will tackle violence against transgender people, whether police capacity via Roze in Blauw is adequate, and whether consultation with TNN will produce concrete measures. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited existing measures (equal treatment law, Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI, a 2021 congress, police diversity networks) and said concrete new measures would be communicated to the House if warranted.
OCW has regular contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) to see how the position of transgender people can be improved in various areas.
Vanuit OCW is er geregeld contact met Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) om te zien hoe de positie van transgender personen op verschillende vlakken verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet tijdens de jaarwisseling

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about police deployment over New Year's Eve, including extra staffing, possible union actions, readiness against disorder, and whether municipalities may organise alternatives. The minister answered that deployment varies by unit with extra officers where needed, no union actions had been announced, police are prepared at regional and national level, and municipalities are free to organise alternatives.
How many officers are precisely scheduled differs per unit.
Hoeveel agenten er precies zijn ingeroosterd verschilt per eenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over de uitzending het interview met burgemeester Aboutaleb van Rotterdam

Two CDA MPs asked whether people awaiting or with a positive COVID-19 test should be obliged to stay home, and whether mayors can enforce this under the Public Health Act. The minister agreed that such people should stay home, confirmed that stay-at-home is currently voluntary, and explained that mandatory quarantine lies with the safety region chair under the Wpg, not the mayor, so mayors cannot enforce it without amending the law.
Without amending the Wpg, mayors therefore have no powers to make staying at home mandatory after a positive test result and to enforce that obligation.
Zonder aanpassing van de Wpg zijn er dus geen mogelijkheden voor burgemeesters om thuisblijven verplicht te stellen bij een positieve testuitslag en om deze verplichting te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Lachen om vuurwerkverbod: Wij knallen gewoon door’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Ziengs asked the Justice Minister about illegal fireworks sales and use during the COVID-era fireworks ban, including arrests, prosecution, online trade, border controls and police equipment. Minister Grapperhaus answered in detail on prosecution guidelines, Halt referrals, online policing and police preparations, without new structural commitments.
No statements can be made about which routes these are.
Over welke routes dit zijn kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de inzet van diensthonden

MPs Groothuizen and Van Beukering-Huijbregts (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police dog deployment, prompted by a Zembla broadcast on dog bites, covering the rules, codification, registration, unit differences, certifications, complaints and evaluation of incidents. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dog use is governed by the force instruction and proportionality rules, that a draft amendment to the Ambtsinstructie tightens criteria, and that registration and evaluation procedures exist and were tightened.
It is not possible to break this down further, because other data on the deployment of the dog (including following commands or the number of bites) are not registered.
Het is niet mogelijk hier een verdere uitsplitsing in te maken, omdat andere gegevens over de inzet van de hond (waaronder het opvolgen van commando's of het aantal beten) niet worden geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de Regeling aanwijzing consumenten- en theatervuurwerk (Ract), het tijdelijke vuurwerkverbod en de handhaving van het vuurwerkverbod door gemeentelijke handhavers (domein 1) bo

MP Van Dam asks whether a 2020 regulation reclassifying F3 and other fireworks as illegal, and the temporary New Year's fireworks ban, leave municipal enforcement officers (boa's domain 1) without power to act on illegal fireworks, leaving only the police. The government replies that boa's can enforce the lighting of fireworks but not possession or transport, may stop people until police arrive, and that the non-intervention in dangerous settings is a deliberate choice governed by local agreements.
That is not a legal gap, but a deliberate and responsible choice.
Dat is geen juridisch gat, maar een bewuste en verantwoorde keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Pedojagers slaan weer toe: hoofd tegen de stoeprand'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of vigilante 'pedo-hunters' (pedojagers) who lure and confront suspected offenders, and about whether such incidents are registered, whether citizen participation should play a role, and whether capacity at the prosecution service is adequate. The minister answered that these incidents are not separately registered, rejected vigilantism while leaving room for citizen assistance within the law, said the police lure-teen power will be kept and talks will follow, and declined to detail online communities for operational reasons.
I reject, as should be clear, any form of taking the law into one's own hands.
Ik wijs, dat moge duidelijk zijn, iedere vorm van eigenrichting af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het niet willen toelichten van de voorgenomen blokkade van de benoeming van een capabele jurist tot de regionale toetsingscommissie euthanasie (RTE).

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister why he blocked the appointment of a qualified jurist to the regional euthanasia review committee (RTE), and about the selection process, consultation with the Health ministry, and parliamentary control. The ministers answered in detail on the procedure and timeline but declined to share the substance of the individual case, citing privacy of the candidate.

We consider it undesirable, in the interest of protecting the privacy of those involved in appointment procedures, to substantively disclose the preparation and motivation of decisions regarding proposed candidate members.

Wij vinden het in het belang van de bescherming van de privacy van de betrokkenen bij benoemingsprocedures onwenselijk om over de voorbereiding en motivering van beslissingen ten aanzien van voorgedragen kandidaat-leden inhoudelijk mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Grapperhaus blokkeert benoeming van rechter in euthanasiecommissie‘

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that Minister Grapperhaus blocked the appointment of a judge to the euthanasia review committee, and whether this was a first, on what grounds, and what follow-up is planned. The ministers confirmed a prior non-appointment in 2007, declined to give the reasons citing privacy of candidates, said appeal lies only to the civil court, and refused to share the motivation with the House beyond the confidential letter to the committee chair.

Regarding the preparation and motivation of decisions on proposed candidate members, as usual, no substantive statements are made in the interest of protecting the privacy of those involved in appointment procedures.

Over de voorbereiding en motivering van beslissingen ten aanzien van voorgedragen kandidaat-leden worden, zoals gebruikelijk, in het belang van de bescherming van de privacy van de betrokkenen bij benoemingsprocedures geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Nederlandse sekteleider (58) verdacht van gijzeling en misbruik kinderen'

MPs Lodders and Van Wijngaarden asked about a report on a cult leader suspected of abuse and whether the tax authority can revoke the ANBI charity status of such organisations, including the Orde der Transformanten. The State Secretary answered that the status can be revoked via the existing integrity test or the new VOG requirement from 1 January 2021, that enforcement is risk-based, and that he will inform parliament in early 2021.

Following MP Lodders' question during Question Hour of 13 October about organisations offering homosexuality 'healing' therapies, I asked for a review of whether and what the Tax Authority can do regarding the ANBI status of such organisations and whether a legal amendment is needed.

Naar aanleiding van de vraag van het lid Lodders (VVD) tijdens het Vragenuur van 13 oktober jl. over organisaties die homogenezingstherapieën aanbieden, heb ik verzocht om nader te bezien of en wat de Belastingdienst kan doen met de ANBI-status van dergelijke organisaties en of daarvoor wetswijziging nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘The GRU's MH17 Disinformation Operations Part 1: The Bonanza Media Project’

MPs Koopmans and Van Wijngaarden asked the ministers about a Bellingcat article on GRU disinformation operations linked to MH17, including legal options, a possible espionage offence, and mandatory registration of foreign influence agents. The government called such foreign interference undesirable, said it is preparing a new espionage offence, and considered mandatory registration not clearly effective or proportionate, favouring awareness-raising instead.
The cabinet has established that an additional criminal offence is desirable and will examine how to give it shape and then start a legislative process.
Het kabinet heeft vastgesteld dat een aanvullende strafbaarstelling wenselijk is en zal onderzoeken op welke wijze daaraan vorm kan worden gegeven en vervolgens een wetstraject opstarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over algemene dreigingsniveaus en de concrete bedreigingen van joodse instellingen

MP Buitenweg asked whether the NCTV's general threat level, lowered from 4 to 3, reflects the concrete threat to Jewish institutions, whether security measures were scaled back on the basis of general analyses, and whether specific threat levels should be stated. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the threat level is a general indication only, that security decisions are based on concrete threat and risk, that responsibility for protecting religious institutions is decentralised, and that the DTN will not be changed, though he gave no commitment to a concrete new step.
Regarding how security measures were built up, I cannot make statements, as your House knows.
Over de wijze waarop beveiligingsmaatregelen zijn opgebouwd, kan ik zoals uw Kamer weet, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de beveiliging van joodse gemeenschappen in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Jewish community in the Netherlands faces a heightened terror threat, whether Austria's tripled security spending should be matched, and why the government should or should not better protect Jewish institutions. The minister confirmed the threat level is 3 of 5, said Jewish institutions are a potential target, and stated that security measures are appropriate, that the 2014 extra funding ended in 2017, that responsibility lies primarily with organisations and locally, and that no reconsideration of funding is planned.
As your House is aware, I cannot make statements about which security measures are being taken.
Over welke beveiligingsmaatregelen getroffen worden, kan ik zoals bij uw Kamer bekend geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Verhoeven over het gebruik van discriminerende algoritmes en massasurveillance door de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about predictive policing, the Roermond Sensing trial against mobile banditry, privacy and discrimination safeguards, and Amnesty's criticism. The minister replied that the trial is not predictive policing, that profiles and human officer decisions limit discrimination risks, and rejected stopping the project while noting it is now largely inactive.
The Roermond Operational Testing Ground (OPTR) does not use predictive policing.
De Operationele Proeftuin Roermond (OPTR) maakt geen gebruik van «predictive policing».

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het rapport van Amnesty International rapport ‘We sense trouble: Automated discrimination and mass surveillance in predictive policing in the Netherlands’

Parliamentary questions from MP Buitenweg (GroenLinks) about the Amnesty International report on predictive policing and the Sensing project in Roermond asked about selection criteria, effectiveness, feedback loops, discrimination, privacy, legal basis and oversight. The Minister answered that the Operational Testing Ground Roermond targets mobile banditry, that criteria cannot be disclosed for investigative reasons, that effectiveness cannot yet be assessed, that oversight lies with the steering group, the data protection officer, the Dutch Data Protection Authority and the Inspectorate, and that he does not consider the project to violate rights and will not stop it.
I have had access to the list, but I cannot make this information public. This would undermine investigative and enforcement interests.
Ik heb inzage gehad in de lijst, maar ik kan deze informatie niet openbaar maken. Dit zou het opsporings- en handhavingsbelang doorkruizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over schadevergoedingen door banken bij spoofing

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked ministers about bank compensation for spoofing victims, whether banks should be obliged to compensate as with phishing, and how police can trace stolen funds. The minister replied that banks are legally bound to compensate only bancaire fraude, that spoofing falls outside this, and that he is negotiating with banks and exploring legal changes with reports due in early 2021.
I will inform the House in the first quarter of 2021 on progress on both points.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 over de voortgang op beide punten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Steen door de ruit en dreigbrief Molukse wijk in Elst'

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about reports of a stone through a window and a threatening letter in a Moluccan neighbourhood in Elst, and about the allocation policy giving Moluccans priority for housing in such neighbourhoods. The government explained the historical basis of the arrangements, said they exist in about 45 municipalities, denied that tensions are a recurring pattern, and said it sees no reason to revisit the agreement.
Apart from the incidents reported by the Gelderlander and the NOS, I am not aware of any signals so far that give cause to revisit this agreement.
Buiten de incidenten waarvan de Gelderlander en de NOS melding hebben gemaakt, zijn mij vooralsnog geen signalen bekend die aanleiding geven tot een herijking van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kröger over het mogelijk instellen van een (regionale) avondklok-maatregel

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would use the Coordination Act on states of emergency or the Act on extraordinary powers of civil authority to impose a (regional) evening curfew during the COVID-19 pandemic, and why it now considered this after earlier saying a state of emergency was not necessary. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a curfew is not currently on the table, that it would be based on article 8 of the Wbbbg without declaring a state of emergency, that parliament would be informed in advance by royal decree, and that no substantive weighing of curfew measures has yet been made.
Of an intention to do so, notice will be given to the States General, so that views can be exchanged between government and States General if desired, unless urgency prevents it.

Van een voornemen daartoe zal mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld, tenzij de vereiste spoed zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over langeafstandsrelaties in tijden van corona

An SP MP asked the Justice, and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rules and practical obstacles for long-distance partners seeking to meet during COVID-19, including visa problems. The government described the temporary long-distance partner scheme, acknowledged difficulties abroad due to consular scaling-down and local restrictions, and said it is working with EU partners on exceptional visa facilitation.
I am aware of this problem and can imagine it has been very difficult for the affected couples that they could not be reunited as quickly as desired.
Ik ben bekend met dit probleem en kan me voorstellen dat het voor de getroffen koppels erg moeilijk is geweest dat zij niet zo snel herenigd konden worden als gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte fatale mishandeling Jan (73) uit Arnhem sloeg ook oud-dominee (68) in elkaar: ‘Hij haalde vol uit’’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice why a suspect in a fatal assault on a 73-year-old man had earlier been a suspect in a case involving an 68-year-old former minister, why police visited the victim only after seven weeks, and whether the prosecution's dropping of that case was a blunder, and asks for harsher treatment of juvenile violent offenders. The minister confirms the earlier case was dismissed and that police contacted the victim promptly, declines to comment on the individual case, and rejects abolishing juvenile criminal law or introducing minimum sentences.
As Minister, I must exercise restraint in answering parliamentary questions that concern an individual case.
Als Minister past mij terughoudendheid bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen die een individuele zaak betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bolkestein over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug 3-MMC duikt op in Zeeland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the new drug 3-MMC, its users, legal status, precursors, production, and government response. The minister answered that use data are limited but rising, 3-MMC is still legal and sold online, a NPS bill will ban it, and the CAM will review evidence and consider next steps.
Once the cathinones fall under the Opium Act, production of and trade in 3-MMC will be illegal.
Zodra de cathinonen onder de Opiumwet vallen zal productie van en handel in 3-MMC illegaal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het uitblijven van een vervolgingsbeslissing in de strafzaak tegen de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked why the public prosecutor has still not decided on prosecuting the NAM five years after the Groninger Bodem Beweging filed its complaint, despite the investigation being completed in September 2019, and whether the delay amounts to a de facto refusal to prosecute. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the investigation and assessment were complex, that the NAM's response period and COVID-19 caused further delay, and that the prosecution service will publish its outcome and position soon, while declining to comment on the Court of Appeal's findings or on the merits of pending decisions.

Moreover, the prosecution service has informed me that it will soon make the outcome of the investigation public, and at that point the position the prosecution service takes in this case will also be made public.

Overigens heeft het OM mij bericht dat zij binnen afzienbare tijd naar buiten komen met de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en dan zal tevens het standpunt dat het OM in deze zaak inneemt, naar buiten worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Brits Parlement overtuigd van samenwerking tussen Huawei en China'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Justice about a British parliamentary report on Huawei, China-state ties, subsidies and 5G security. The government said it makes its own assessment of 5G security, outlined existing telecom security measures and EU-level action, and acknowledged close state involvement in Chinese firms without commenting on the report's conclusions.
I closely follow developments in policy on the security and integrity of 5G networks in other countries, including the United Kingdom.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in het beleid ten aanzien van de veiligheid en integriteit van 5G-netwerken in andere landen, waaronder het Verenigd Koninkrijk, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Staatsvijand Nr.1’

A Minister's written answers to MP Yeşilgöz-Zegerius's questions about the documentary 'Staatsvijand Nr. 1' on terrorist Samir A., covering the effectiveness of deradicalisation tracks, the numbers in such tracks, intelligence services' handling of individuals, terrorism financing and hawala banking, and public alertness. The government answers substantively on numbers and monitoring, but declines to comment on the specific case and on intelligence-service decisions, citing security and source protection.
I obviously cannot go into this specific case or the statements of the person concerned.
Ik kan uiteraard niet ingaan op deze specifieke casus of de uitlatingen van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Falende screening: racende agent kon gewoon doorwerken’

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked the Minister of Justice and Security how a police trainee whose relatives were reportedly in Syria, possibly involved in terrorism, could complete training, and what would be done about the resulting damage to trust. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss the case, explained the current screening instruments, said integrity remains a core value and that VIK reforms and the new screening law are underway.
I do not wish to go into concrete case details.
Ik wil niet ingaan op concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht Providers gaan bedrijven waarschuwen voor beveiligingslekken'

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked whether the NBIP, designated as an OKTT, can receive threat information from the NCSC and why the Digital Trust Center cannot yet do so for non-vital businesses. The government answers that NCSC can already share threat information with NBIP within legal limits, that a DTC designation is being prepared with a target start early next year, and that a WODC study on the landelijk dekkend stelsel has been commissioned.
The Ministry of EZK is working on the preparatory work for this. The aim is for this new service to start early next year.
Het Ministerie van EZK is bezig met de voorbereidende werkzaamheden hiervoor. Het streven is dat deze nieuwe dienstverlening begin volgend jaar kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Screening politie

An SP MP asked whether police officers' personal circumstances (their environment and criminal convictions in private time) can be screened and reported to employers, and whether screening standards will hold as recruitment expands. The Minister replied that environmental screening is currently limited to security-clearance posts, that a new law on screening police officers takes effect 1 July 2021 enabling environmental checks and continuous JDS-based screening, and that screening standards will not be lowered.
From that moment on, police officers performing work with an elevated integrity risk can be subjected to an environmental check at the start of their work and during their work.

Vanaf dat moment kunnen politieambtenaren die werkzaamheden met een verhoogd integriteitsrisico verrichten, worden onderworpen aan een omgevingsonderzoek bij aanvang van de werkzaamheden en gedurende de werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Sekte-alarm niet gehoord’

MP Van Nispen asked whether Justice neglected warnings about the Orde der Transformanten, whether cutting the Sektesignaal reporting point hindered action against sects, and what the police and prosecution did with reports of abuse. Minister Grapperhaus said an independent investigation is underway, that Sektesignaal's role has been taken over by RIEC cooperation, that police and prosecution never disclose details of reports, and that every report is handled and existing archives will be checked.
The police and the prosecution never give substantive information about reports or complaints made, out of confidentiality and to protect the privacy of possible perpetrators and victims.
Politie en het OM geven nooit inhoudelijke informatie over meldingen of aangiftes die zijn gedaan vanwege vertrouwelijkheid en om de privacy van mogelijke daders en slachtoffers te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over georganiseerde criminaliteit in de Noordelijke zeehavens

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether organised crime is shifting to the Northern seaports due to weak oversight and information positions, and what will be done to improve this. The Minister replied that the study confirmed the information position is inadequate, that the extent of organised crime there is still unclear, and listed initiatives such as information-sharing agreements, training, and specialised investigation teams.
The research showed that the extent to which organised, undermining crime occurs in the Northern seaports is still insufficiently clear.
Het onderzoek heeft uitgewezen dat de mate waarin georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit in de Noordelijke zeehavens voorkomt nog onvoldoende duidelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over de berichten ‘Nederlands vaardocument gebruikt bij grootschalige drugssmokkel’ en ‘Nederlandse schepen aan ketting in Italië door omstreden bootpaspoort’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked the ministers whether the Dutch ICP pleasure-craft certificate is facilitating international drug smuggling and what registration reforms are planned. The minister acknowledged misuse of the ICP, said procedures will be tightened via a new convenant from 1 January 2021, and said a broader boat-ownership registration needs further study with the Justice ministry.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Machteloze agent waker in gevecht met verwarde mensen’ en ‘Verwarde mensen drijven de agent tot wanhoop’

Mr Helder (PVV) asks why police are still left with transporting and handling confused people despite the Wvggz taking effect in January 2020, and what concrete steps will be taken. The ministers reply that the Wvggz protects patients' rights rather than reducing reports, point to an integrated approach with five national priorities, improved police training, a mobile care quality framework for transport, and promise further action in autumn.
It is not an aim of the Wvggz to reduce the number of reports about people with confused behaviour.
Het is geen doel van de Wvggz om te zorgen voor een afname van het aantal meldingen over personen met verward gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Poland’s National Public Prosecutor is going to war with the Netherlands’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Polish National Prosecutor instruction to find grounds to refuse Dutch European arrest warrants, its link to the Amsterdam court's suspension of Polish surrenders, and possible responses. The minister said the instruction is worrying and conflicts with mutual trust, that the Netherlands is not violating EU law, that the Dutch judiciary's independence is not in doubt, and that the government will raise the matter with the Commission and in bilateral and EU channels.
It is a worrying signal that the Polish National Prosecutor instructs Polish prosecutors to search for grounds to refuse Dutch surrender requests.

Het is een verontrustend signaal dat de Poolse nationale aanklager aan Poolse officieren van justitie een opdracht geeft om op zoek te gaan naar gronden om Nederlandse overleveringsverzoeken te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het Ontwerpbesluit houdende wijziging van het Besluit verdeling sterkte en middelen politie in verband met de flexibilisering van de operationele inzet

An MP (Van Dam, CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a draft decree letting the police chief leave up to 2% of operational strength unfilled and redirect the freed funds, including questions on trainee staffing, safeguards for basic teams, and reporting. The minister answered that the 2% margin is temporary, excludes trainees, requires agreement with mayors and the chief prosecutor for regional units, and will be reported in the police annual report and evaluated after three years.
The draft decree regulates the so-called bandwidth.
Het ontwerpbesluit regelt de zogenoemde bandbreedte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over het bericht ‘Van Vollenhoven wil vertrekken bij ‘koninklijke’ Vereniging politiehonden door vermeende dierenmishandeling’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Prince Bernhard Jr. wanted to leave the KNPV police dog association over alleged animal abuse, and whether members had been suspended and were suspects. The Minister confirmed a police investigation has concluded with eight suspects in the file sent to the Public Prosecution Service, declined to say how they relate to the KNPV for privacy reasons, and stressed that the KNPV is a private association.
For privacy reasons, no statement can be made about the relationship between those suspects and the KNPV.
Vanuit privacyoverwegingen kan hier geen uitspraak worden gedaan over de relatie tussen die verdachten en de KNPV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Doneeractie voor Mani die leven redt, maar zelf opdraait voor de kosten’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Van Nispen asked why a citizen who rescued someone in a cardiac arrest was left with a large bill for damages, and what the government would do about burgerhulpverleners' losses and insurers. The minister answered with statistics on civilian rescuers, said police and ambulance arrival times are not tracked for this specific situation, and noted that Utrecht municipality is working to compensate the rescuer, while stating that Slachtofferhulp is not the right route.
On the mayor's instruction, a solution is being examined in consultation with Mr Chawoshey to compensate him for the costs incurred.
In opdracht van de burgemeester wordt er in overleg met de heer Chawoshey gekeken naar een oplossing om hem te compenseren in de gemaakte kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht veel agenten thuiszitten in afwachting van een coronatest

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police teams are understaffed because officers await COVID tests, whether officers get priority testing, and how enforcement can continue. The minister acknowledged officers in quarantine or awaiting results add strain but said no whole teams are unable to function, that police get only limited priority access to testing, and that local shortages are absorbed within regional units or by asking other units for help.
The Ministry of Justice and Security and the police leadership consult intensively and frequently with the unions on various subjects.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de korpsleiding spreken intensief en veelvuldig met de bonden over diverse onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, El Yassini, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het bericht dat de NOS na aanhoudende bedreiging van journalisten de logo’s van de auto’s haalt

MPs asked the government about the NOS removing vehicle logos after persistent threats against journalists, and what concrete steps protect press freedom. The minister condemned the threats, described the PersVeilig and protocol measures and reports rising incident numbers, but gave no confirmed prosecution-effect data and committed only to a letter on the scheme's operation.

Because this registration option has only been available for a relatively short time, it cannot yet be established whether there is an increase in the number of cases in which prosecution was instituted for aggression against journalists.

Omdat deze registratiemogelijkheid nog maar relatief korte tijd beschikbaar is, kan nog niet worden vastgesteld of er sprake is van een toename van het aantal zaken waarin vervolging is ingesteld wegens agressie tegen journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘NOS haalt na aanhoudende bedreigingen logo van satellietwagens’

Two MPs asked the government about the NOS removing logos from its satellite vans after threats, the state of press freedom, measures in other countries, and online disinformation. The ministers answered that press freedom is a serious concern, pointed to existing protocols and prosecutions, and described existing measures against disinformation without announcing new structural steps.
In our democratic society it is of crucial importance that the press can carry out its work in freedom, safety and independence.
In onze democratische samenleving is het van cruciaal belang dat de pers haar werk in vrijheid, veiligheid en onafhankelijkheid kan uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bieden van perspectief aan ondernemers na de gedeeltelijke lockdown en het onderzoek naar aanleiding van het OMT-advies over restaurants

An MP from the VVD asked the government how it would respond to the OMT advice on restaurants and the promised talks with hospitality and events sectors about prospects after the partial lockdown, including progress on FieldLab initiatives. The government answered that talks with sector representatives are ongoing, that segmented measures are being discussed, that FieldLab programmes for events are being developed with a possible start in January, and that the RIVM advice on the events FieldLab is pending.
The cabinet would like sectors to come forward with new initiatives if these can offer new prospects.
Het kabinet ziet graag dat sectoren zich melden met nieuwe initiatieven als die nieuwe perspectieven kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Smeulders en Buitenweg over Coronatestlijn

MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that staff of the coronavirus testing helpline could access personal data beyond what their tasks required, about WhatsApp data sharing, training, outsourcing to Teleperformance, unpaid hours and working conditions. The government answered that access is necessary for the job, that logging and confidentiality agreements safeguard privacy, that GGD-GHOR is responsible, and that labour conditions are for employers and social partners, with the Inspectie SZW available for complaints.
Care in handling personal data is of course of great importance.
Zorgvuldigheid is bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens uiteraard van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Gent over Demonstratie tegen omstreden pedopartij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Gent asked whether the Dutch party PVND, seen as a successor to the banned Martijn association, should be banned, whether it violates children's rights, and whether convicted offenders could be stripped of passive voting rights. The Minister of Justice answered that the OM is investigating and will not comment on ongoing inquiries, that deprivation of voting rights is only possible as a court-imposed sanction for serious offences against the state, and that a Political Parties Act is in preparation.
The Public Prosecution Service is conducting an investigation. No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doet onderzoek. Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Geheim telefoonverkeer legt ernstige corruptie bij politie bloot’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of serious corruption in the police revealed through EncroChat investigations, including whether the minister knew of police concerns, what is being done, and how screening is being tightened. The minister confirmed being informed by the prosecution service, described a special anti-corruption team and integrity measures such as the screening bill and LaaS logging, but declined to give details on ongoing investigations.
I cannot provide further information on this, as it concerns an ongoing investigation.
Ik kan geen nadere mededelingen doen hierover, omdat het een lopend onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Grapperhaus zit ernaast met verbod op gebruik softdrugs, stelt RUG-hoogleraar Jan Brouwer'

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Justice Minister whether his 19 October 2020 letter on soft drugs rested on a Supreme Court ruling, whether it wrongly implied users could be prosecuted for possession, and whether he would correct it; she also asked whether a motion on a night-time ban in public spaces adds anything to existing local powers. Minister Grapperhaus said the letter was not based on a misreading, use itself is not made punishable, the letter is clear, and municipalities already have APV powers, so the motion adds little beyond existing instruments.
No. The letter neither states nor intends that use of soft drugs is punishable.
Er is in de brief 4 niet geschreven noch bedoeld dat gebruik van softdrugs strafbaar zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over handhavingsacties op het NS-station Arnhem centraal

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about enforcement actions by rail-station inspectors at Arnhem Centraal, including whether they involve public-order or criminal-investigation grounds, ethnic profiling and the use-of-force framework. The minister answered that actions are intelligence-led, carried out by NS transport inspectors under the statutory framework without mayoral or prosecutorial authority, denied ethnic profiling, and described the limited force powers and the review of force use by the direct supervisor.
When the force powers are used during an enforcement action, the direct supervisor, among others, checks whether the inspector's conduct took place within the applicable legal framework.

Wanneer tijdens een handhavingsactie gebruik wordt gemaakt van de geweldsbevoegdheid, wordt door o.a. de direct toezichthouder getoetst of het optreden van de boa heeft plaatsgevonden binnen het geldend wettelijk kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Omroepen voor het karretje misdaad’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Media ministers about reports that broadcasters serve criminals, including the OM's reaction to the series Cannabis, a police officer being discredited, a secretly recorded prosecutor-lawyer call, and payments to a convicted drug trafficker. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing case, referred to the OM for its own view, pointed to tightened NPO payment rules, and stated that the broadcaster said no payment was made to the drug trafficker.
Moreover, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal case.
Daarnaast past het mij niet inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopende strafzaak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Laçin over onvoldoende mogelijkheden voor de politie om verkeershufters aan te pakken

MPs Van Nispen and Laçin asked how police could better catch extreme-speed drivers who post their offences online, including more trajectory controls, a speed limiter, platform takedowns and wider investigative powers. The minister said enforcement has been stepped up and trajectory controls are being installed on N-roads, but admitted investigation from video alone is hard and said that making Article 5a Wvw a provisional-detention offence is being prepared in a draft omnibus bill.
I expect the bill can be submitted to the Council of State for advice early next year.
Ik verwacht dat het wetsvoorstel naar verwachting begin volgend jaar ter advisering aan de Raad van State kan worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Tovenaars met rommel’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about reports that failed waste-processing firms caused large public costs and that criminals operate in the sector. The government confirmed cost estimates in general terms, declined to give criminal records of owners, and announced a planned Omgevingsbesluit change allowing authorities to require financial security before granting permits.

This question cannot be answered. The criminal records of the natural persons referred to in the question who are in any way linked to companies prosecuted for environmental offences cannot be retrieved with an automated search.

Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De antecedenten van de in de vraag bedoelde natuurlijke personen die op enigerlei wijze zijn gelieerd aan bedrijven die strafrechtelijk zijn vervolgd voor milieudelicten, zijn niet met een geautomatiseerde zoekslag op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Kuiken over het legaal naar Nederland reizen van partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Kuiken asked why partners of Dutch or EU citizens cannot travel to the Netherlands when embassies are closed, and urged measures such as cooperation with other EU embassies and digital or border-issued permits. Minister Blok replied that consular services are largely being restored, that the long-distance lovers scheme stays limited to Dutch and EU citizens, and that alternative issuance methods are incompatible with the MVV requirement.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no insight into figures on the number of partners of Dutch nationals or EU citizens who currently cannot travel.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen dat op dit moment niet kan reizen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen inzake het bericht 'Advocaten slijpen messen na de bruiloftsfoto's en Grapperhaus verweer'

An MP asked the Justice Minister how intent figures in enforcing the 1.5-metre rule, whether the OM's internal 'three-step' enforcement framework is binding, and asked for statistics on fines, objections and payments. The minister answered that the framework is internal, non-binding and gives no rights to citizens, and supplied figures on fines, objections and collections, while noting the fine was lowered to 95 euro and that such fines were removed from criminal records.
No, the policy framework, unlike OM directives and prosecution guidelines, has no third-party effect; citizens cannot derive any rights from it.
Nee, het beleidskader heeft, anders dan OM-Aanwijzingen en strafvorderingsrichtlijnen, geen derdenwerking; burgers kunnen er geen rechten aan ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over verzetzaken tegen coronaboetes en de drieslag voor boa’s

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government's claim of a three-step enforcement approach (warn, then fine) for corona fines holds, given that the Public Prosecution Service found no such mandatory sequence in its policy and a court ruled intent plays no role. The minister answered that the OM's enforcement framework leaves officers discretion, is not binding, grants no rights to citizens, and that enforcement will be intensified.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over diverse recente berichten over de (strafrecht)advocatuur

An MP asked about recent reports on criminal-law advocates, including conflicts of interest when representing several co-suspects, cash payments, and police shadowing of lawyers. The minister said existing conduct rules are adequate, that the Bar's dean supervises compliance, that cash payments are limited to 5,000 euro, and that surveillance of lawyers is subject to special care, while promising to raise the conflict-of-interest dilemma with those involved.
I undertake to address this dilemma with those involved.
Ik zeg u toe om dit dilemma bij betrokkenen te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Forse stijging aantal slachtoffers van kindermishandeling en seksueel geweld op chat tijdens corona'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security and the State Secretary for Health about a reported sharp rise in child abuse and sexual violence reports via chat during the coronavirus crisis, and how this relates to other data showing no increase. The State Secretary answered that the increase is mainly in advice requests and chat contacts, that it cannot be confirmed that abuse actually rose, and listed measures, research and lessons learned, but could not answer all questions in time for the committee meeting.
It is not known whether child abuse and sexual violence actually increased during the coronavirus measures this spring.
Het is niet bekend of kindermishandeling en seksueel geweld daadwerkelijk is toegenomen tijdens de corona-maatregelen dit voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de Circulaire wapens en munitie

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Circulaire Wapens en Munitie 2019, including the omission of traditional-shooting calibres from Annex C8, the minimum age of 18 for introducees, and difficulties the KNTS faces in getting its concerns addressed. The Minister acknowledged the calibre omission and promised correction at the next revision, said the age threshold is in line with the majority age and is being explored for revision with stakeholders without a commitment to change it, and offered a possible site visit when conditions allow.
This will be corrected at the next revision of the Circulaire wapens en munitie.
Dit zal bij een eerstvolgende herziening van de Circulaire wapens en munitie gecorrigeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over geheime belangen die leidden tot niet-ontvankelijk verklaring op verzoek van het OM zelf

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister why the prosecution service requested its own inadmissibility in an attempted-homicide case despite an internal advice rejecting that option, and why the victim cannot obtain the case files. The minister answers that the prosecution weighed serious interests and found no other viable option, refuses to disclose those interests or the internal deliberations, and says a procurator-general inquiry is being considered.
The interests to be protected are so weighty that no clarity can be provided about the reasons for the prosecution service requesting its own inadmissibility.
De te beschermen belangen zijn zo zwaarwegend, dat geen duidelijkheid kan worden verschaft over de redenen voor het vorderen van de eigen niet-ontvankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Kuiken over het bericht 'Geheim telefoonverkeer legt ernstige corruptie bij politie bloot'

MPs Van Dam, Van Toorenburg and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about reports that EncroChat communications revealed serious police corruption, including in the Landelijke Eenheid, and about the scale, staffing, integrity measures, privacy limits and the new MIT team. The minister declined to analyse or disclose details of ongoing investigations, while describing a Team Aanpak Corruptie under the Rijksrecherche, integrity and access-control measures, a pilot for detecting abnormal data use, and the ongoing setup of the MIT.
No, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Nee, ik doe geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over de beroerde informatievoorziening aan de Tweede Kamer inzake de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

PVV MPs asked the Justice, Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why information on the Dutch navy's boarding of a merchant ship (Zr. Ms. De Ruyter) was withheld, and asked about the legal basis, the cargo, sanctions and links to Operation Irini. Minister Grapperhaus refused details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, cited the Criminal Code as legal basis, denied any link to Irini, and promised to inform parliament once possible.
As is customary, your House will be informed as soon as the still ongoing criminal investigation allows for this.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd zodra daar gezien het thans nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek de mogelijkheid toe bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de Europese aanbestedingen van diensten van tolken en vertalers in de strafrechtketen

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the effects of EU-wide tendering of interpreting and translation services in criminal justice, citing problems in other member states such as Denmark and the German approach of in-house provision. The minister answers that the Dutch situation differs, that the new system stimulates many intermediaries and binding tender conditions protect interpreters, and that no EU-level exemption is needed.
I have chosen a solution suited to the Dutch situation.
Ik heb gekozen voor een bij de Nederlandse situatie passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie in kamp al Hol

An MP from D66 asked the Justice Minister about reports that Al Hol camp in Syria is a breeding ground for IS radicalisation, whether Dutch nationals are being re-recruited, the repatriation of Dutch nationals and an arrest warrant. The minister answered that some camp residents remain radicalised, that IS is regaining some activity but not its former strength, that a few Dutch women may have escaped, and that repatriation is being assessed case by case with Schengen partners.
The investigation into the possibilities of bringing the suspect to the Netherlands is ongoing. If there are new developments, this will be reported.
Het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden om de verdachte naar Nederland te brengen loopt. Indien er nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn zal hierover gerapporteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Uitgaan is nu een avondje zitten’

An MP asked several ministers about illegal parties during COVID restrictions, enforcement numbers, the option of controlled reopening of venues, and support for the sector. The government answered that enforcement data cannot be split by party type, that nightclubs stay closed due to infection risk, that a ventilation pilot is being prepared, and that financial support schemes continue.
Unfortunately, a breakdown by illegal parties and festivals cannot be made.
Een uitsplitsing naar illegale feesten en festivals is helaas niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Koerden gaan Syrische vrouwen en kinderen vrijlaten uit Al Hol kamp'

MPs Koopmans and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked about reports that Kurdish authorities would release Syrian women and children from Al Hol camp, and about the handling of Dutch jihadist returnees, including local prosecution, citizenship revocation, and repatriation. The ministers answered that about 40 Dutch fighters remain in Syria, outlined prosecution options in the region and in the Netherlands, and committed to informing parliament before any repatriation decisions.
The cabinet will involve the House in advance, in line with the motion, if there are plans to bring back Syria fighters or their wives or children.
Het kabinet zal de de Kamer conform de motie vooraf betrekken als er voornemens zijn ten aanzien van terughalen van Syriëgangers, hun vrouwen of kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Culturele instellingen in chaos na coronamaatregelen

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.
With these tougher measures, the possibility for the Safety Regions to grant exemptions has lapsed.
Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Brutale roof Congolees beeld als protest in Afrika Museum’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Van Dam asked whether politically motivated thefts and threats against Dutch museums are increasing and how art crime is handled by police, including the Team Kunst- en Antiekcriminaliteit and cooperation with the Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed. The minister answered that sector data are insufficient for a firm conclusion, described the organisation of art crime enforcement and the existing cooperation, but gave no commitments on new action.

There is insufficient data available in the sector to make a concrete statement, based on a sound analysis, about the nature and number of threats to collections in museums and other public institutions in the Netherlands.

Er zijn in de sector onvoldoende gegevens voorhanden om op basis van een gedegen analyse een concrete uitspraak te doen over aard en aantal van de dreigingen richting collecties in musea en andere publieke instellingen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’.
