MPs asked why Huawei is partly excluded from critical 5G infrastructure in the Netherlands but not from university research cooperation with UvA and VU, and what framework governs cooperation with foreign-state-influenced companies. The government replied that universities are autonomous under the WHW and that the cooperation falls outside vital infrastructure, that authorities advised universities on risks, and that an investment screening and export-control framework is being developed, without committing to new binding rules on university cooperation.

Under their autonomy pursuant to the WHW, the universities themselves are responsible for deciding whether or not to enter a particular (international) research cooperation, within the frameworks of existing laws and regulations.

De universiteiten zijn vanuit hun autonomie op grond van de WHW zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit om – binnen de kaders van bestaande wet- en regelgeving – al dan niet een bepaalde (internationale) onderzoekssamenwerking aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het interview met de broer van kroongetuige Nabil B.

An MP asks the Justice Minister about an interview with the brother of a crown witness who complains about inadequate protection and not being taken seriously by the prosecution, and about whether the deal was concluded before family protection was arranged. The minister acknowledges family interests could have been weighed more heavily, says protection measures were in place at presentation, and points to limited protection capacity while leaving detailed responses on the family's concerns to the coordinating prosecutor.

The statement referred to in question 5 means that in decision-making on a crown witness deal, the possible position of family members and other involved parties could have been more explicitly weighed in the considerations.

Met de uitspraak waarop wordt gedoeld in vraag 5, is bedoeld dat in de besluitvorming over een deal met een kroongetuige nadrukkelijker de mogelijke positie van familieleden en andere betrokkenen in de afwegingen hadden kunnen worden betrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de beveiliging van raadslieden en familieleden van bedreigde (kroon)getuigen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the protection of relatives and legal representatives of threatened crown witnesses, following a reported conflict with the public prosecution service over the brother of crown witness Nabil B.; the questions covered the procedure for deciding and monitoring protection, whether family interests were weighed, the meaning of 'changing insight', relocation abroad, refusal of a meeting, and other conflicts. The minister answered that protection is assessed case by case and monitored periodically, that family interests could have been weighed more explicitly in the deal, that specific measures and the decision on a meeting rest with the coordinating prosecutor, and that details of measures will not be disclosed for the protected persons' sake.
Regarding the concrete nature and extent of measures already taken and yet to be taken, in the interest of the persons to be protected I will not provide further details.
Over de concrete aard en omvang van reeds genomen en nog te nemen maatregelen, doe ik in het belang van de te beveiligen personen geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Buitenweg over ex-partnergeweld

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how ex-partner violence is registered, how many women were stalked, victimised or killed by an ex-partner in 2017-2019, and what protocols, evaluation and expertise exist. The minister answered that ex-partner violence is not registered separately within the partner category, that stalking was not measured in the prevalence study with a new survey pending, and that specific protocols, the impact monitor and calamity-based learning are in place.
Ex-partner violence is not registered separately.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de documentaire ´De Kroongetuigeadvocaat´

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the documentary on the crown witness lawyer, including the timing of the crown witness deal, the threat assessment and evaluation after the murder of the witness's brother, protection measures, and whether lawyers can see their own threat analyses. The minister answered that protection measures were in place before the presentation, that threat analyses are classified and not shared with the protected person, but that protected persons are informed in general terms, and that structural reinforcement of the protection system is underway.
Because of the classification level, the origin and the major risks linked to disclosure, the threat analysis is not shared with the person concerned and it is not desirable to do so in the future.

Vanwege het niveau van rubricering alsmede de herkomst en grote risico´s die samenhangen met openbaarmaking daarvan wordt de dreigingsanalyse niet gedeeld met de betrokkene en is het niet wenselijk om dat in de toekomst wel te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Wijngaarden het bericht het bericht ‘Ik ben een schim geworden omdat het OM zo nodig die deal moest sluiten’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a newspaper report in which the brother of a crown witness, an innocent person, complained of inadequate protection and a lack of insight into threat assessments. The Minister acknowledged repeated complaints, said threat analyses are classified and cannot be disclosed, admitted the murder of a relative was not foreseen and an internal evaluation led to improvements, and committed to further structural investment and a report before the budget debate.
Given the sensitivity of this information, these threat analyses have been classified at the state secret confidential level and higher.
Gezien de gevoeligheid van deze informatie zijn deze dreigingsanalyses gerubriceerd tot het niveau van staatsgeheim confidentieel en hoger
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de totstandkoming van een nieuwe EU drugsstrategie

The MP asks whether the Commission's new EU drug agenda was properly prepared with consultation, what it means for the Dutch approach, and whether the government will press the Commission to withdraw it. The minister says there was public and civil society consultation but no member state consultation on content, that the proposals are not binding but lack balance on health and human rights, and that the government has raised the issue and will ensure NGOs are heard in the new strategy.
The Netherlands, like several other member states, has raised this with the European Commission and brought the problem up in the relevant council working group.
Nederland heeft, net als verschillende andere lidstaten, de Europese Commissie hierop aangesproken en het probleem in de betreffende raadswerkgroep aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Walgelijk, maar ook nuttig?; Justitie zint op maatregelen tegen kindersexpoppen’

The MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asks the Minister of Justice whether child sex dolls appearing on the Dutch market are a concern, whether they could be a gateway or a deterrent, whether an import ban and confiscation or customer registration are possible, and whether a ban should be included in the planned law against paedophile handbooks. The Minister answers that the issue is serious, that the department is examining legal options and a possible ban by analogy with the ban on virtual child pornography, that confiscation without suspicion of a crime is not currently possible, and that he will inform the House of the results.
I will inform the House of the results of the exploration.
Ik zal de Kamer over de resultaten van de verkenning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Exclusive: Cyprus sold passports to criminals and fugitives’

MP Groothuizen asked the government about reports that Cyprus and Malta sold golden passports to criminals and fugitives, and whether the Dutch scheme should be abolished, whether EU action or an infringement procedure is possible, and whether due diligence could be transferred to Europol. The State Secretary answered that such schemes can facilitate crime, that Cyprus is abolishing its scheme, Malta has tightened its checks, the Dutch scheme will be reviewed after a year, and that the Commission is primarily responsible for any infringement procedure.
If after one year it appears that the scheme does not have this potential, it will be abolished.
Mocht na één jaar blijken dat de regeling deze potentie niet heeft, dan wordt zij afgeschaft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Beukering-Huijbrechts over de berichten ‘Slachthuis mocht openblijven ondanks vele coronabesmettingen’ en ‘Dit is waarom slachthuis Vion open mocht blijven ondanks de vele

Two D66 MPs asked why slaughterhouses Vion and Rooi Meat were allowed to stay open despite many COVID-19 infections, including why the safety region did not intervene at Rooi Meat when staffing exceeded the agreed level and why the NVWA did not stop slaughter. The minister answered that the safety region weighed the case, issued a warning rather than a sanction, deemed the situation safe, and that NVWA had no reason to halt operations, while promising to inform parliament on sector talks and noting a new national coordination platform.
The chair of the safety region weighed the situation and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction.
De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Greenpeace gooit opnieuw keien op zeebodem: 'Levensgevaarlijke actie''

PVV MPs asked whether Greenpeace dumping boulders on the North Sea bed endangers fishers, whether this should be prosecuted as attempted murder or manslaughter, why the Dutch flag can be kept, and whether Greenpeace can be banned. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, which is examining the matter, that the flag cannot be withdrawn under Dutch law, and that only a court on Public Prosecution Service request can dissolve an organisation.
A judgement on the criminality of this conduct is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Een oordeel over de strafbaarheid van dit handelen is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over de nieuwe veiligheidswet die de autoriteiten in Beijing opgelegd hebben aan Hong Kong

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Beijing-imposed national security law for Hong Kong, its effects on freedoms and judicial independence, and whether the extradition treaty with Hong Kong should be reconsidered. The government condemned the law's effects on autonomy and rule of law, and announced it would suspend the extradition treaty with Hong Kong as part of coordinated EU action.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Tilburger met drugs en inbrekersspullen na wilde achtervolging twee agenten meegesleurd’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about a case where police officers were dragged by a suspect, and about the number of assaults on public-facing workers and the definition and use of expedited (snelrecht) criminal procedure. The minister provides counts of assaults on public-task workers, explains that snelrecht is not registered uniformly and no national definition exists, and states that eligibility is decided case by case.
The judiciary's systems do not routinely record whether a case was handled under expedited procedure.
In de rechtspraaksystemen wordt niet standaard geregistreerd of een zaak met toepassing van snelrecht is behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Jonge meiden over feestjes bij hockeytrainers: ‘Megaveel drank en dan bed in lokken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rudmer Heerema asked about press reports of sexual misconduct by hockey coaches and what could keep such coaches out of sport, including data-sharing powers and a dedicated prosecutor. The minister answered that the government supports sports bodies' prevention efforts, screening tools such as the VOG and the disciplinary registry, and reporting campaigns, but declined to extend the football violence law or appoint a special prosecutor.
No. The Football Violence Measures Act grants powers to mayors, public prosecutors and criminal judges to prevent disturbances of public order.

Nee. De Wet Maatregelen bestrijding voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast kent bevoegdheden toe aan burgemeesters, officieren van justitie en strafrechters die zij kunnen inzetten ter voorkoming van verstoringen van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland inzake de e-screener

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a district court interim ruling that the e-screener's reliability for assessing psychological fitness was not established, and about the cost, fairness and suitability of the counter-expertise route for gun licence applicants. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case and does not change general use, that a TNO report and a police instruction are attached, and that an evaluation is planned, while answering many follow-up questions on dyslexia, older applicants, deactivated firearms and transferring licensing to Justis.
To give stakeholders more insight into how the e-screener works, I asked TNO at an earlier stage to prepare a report on how the e-screener works and what it is for.

Om belanghebbenden meer inzicht te verschaffen in de werking van de e-screener heb ik TNO reeds in een eerder stadium gevraagd, een rapport op te stellen over de wijze waarop de e-screener werkt en waar het toe dient.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht dat de prestatie-eisen het bestrijden van misdaad dwarsbomen

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether performance-based funding for the Public Prosecution Service, courts and police creates financial pressure to prosecute certain cases and undermines fighting crime. The minister replied that local authorities set priorities, denied that funding forces prosecution choices, described the current funding systems, and said an independent WODC study on financing will be reported in March 2021.
There is no question of performance agreements that force a choice for criminal prosecution of specific cases.
Er is geen sprake van prestatieafspraken die dwingen tot een keuze voor strafrechtelijke afdoening van specifieke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Özütok en Bergkamp over het voortbestaan van het Roze in Blauw politieteam

MPs Van den Hul, Özütok and Bergkamp asked whether police agents' workload threatens the Roze in Blauw LHBTI network, and what the government will do to protect it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Amsterdam unit is in talks with the network, that the government will monitor developments and stay in consultation with the police leadership, and that the network's expertise is secured through the Netwerk Divers Vakmanschap.
I consider it of great importance that the work of RiB continues in a meaningful way.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat het werk van RiB op een zinvolle wijze wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over effectief toezicht op opsporing

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about judicial and internal oversight of police and prosecution investigations, including the shadowing of lawyers in the Ridouan T. case and the weak application of Article 359a Sv. The minister answered that courts retain review of investigative powers, that the Procureur-generaal's expanded oversight is being set up with extra capacity from autumn 2020, and that the new Wetboek van Strafvordering will revise procedural sanctions and be sent to Parliament after the new cabinet takes office.

By letter of 29 June, I informed the House of the state of affairs regarding the expansion of the Procureur-generaal bij de Hoge Raad's oversight of incidents in which the prosecution service played a role.
Bij brief van 29 juni jongstleden informeerde ik uw Kamer over de stand van zaken ten aanzien van de verruiming van het toezicht door de Procureur-generaal bij de Hoge Raad
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'WhatsApp-fraude explodeert: 'Ik snap niet hoe ik erin ben getrapt''

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about the rise of WhatsApp 'friend in need' fraud, its scale, perpetrators, bank liability, prevention and FIU information. The minister replied that reports have surged since 2019 but exact numbers are unknown, outlined prevention campaigns, bank security rules and new financial investigation tools, and said banks are generally not liable for authorised payments.
The exact scale of 'friend in need' fraud is not known, because not all victims report to the police, their bank or the Fraud Helpdesk.

De exacte omvang van hulpvraagfraude (ook wel vriend-in-nood-fraude genoemd), is niet bekend, omdat niet alle slachtoffers aangifte doen bij de politie of een melding maken bij hun bank of de Fraudehelpdesk (FHD).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht 'Na corona komt het foute geld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers how the government protects businesses weakened by COVID-19 against criminal 'foute helpers' and dirty money, and what has been done after a RIEC survey found about 10 percent of entrepreneurs had been approached by an unknown investor. Minister Grapperhaus replied that awareness campaigns, public-private platforms and the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen are under way, that EU-level work is being pursued, and that the topic will be raised at the December JBZ Council, but the answer was late and gives no concrete new legislative or oversight measures.
I acknowledge that as a result of the coronavirus pandemic, the risks of abuse by criminals towards businesses are increasing.
Ik onderken dat als gevolg van de coronapandemie risico’s van misbruik door criminelen richting het bedrijfsleven toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'New forms of terrorism inspired by conspiracy theories may emerge after pandemic, warns EU counter-terror chief'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the EU counter-terrorism coordinator's warning about possible new conspiracy-inspired terrorism applies to the Netherlands, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered that such phenomena do not currently amount to a new form of terrorism in the Netherlands, that they are monitored and included in threat assessments where relevant, and that no specific measures are currently deemed necessary.
At present no terrorism is observed within the so-called new phenomena, and there is therefore no reason to take specific measures.
Op dit moment wordt er binnen de zogenoemde nieuwe fenomenen geen terrorisme waargenomen en is er derhalve geen aanleiding om specifieke maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Bewapening boa stelselmatig afgewezen: Groene boa’s te vaak zonder bewapening het bos ingestuurd’

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister why nature-area enforcement officers (groene boa's) are often denied renewal of armament, including firearms, despite facing drug crime and poaching, and why coding of armament differs across regions. The Minister replied that a new regulation is being drafted to give more uniform, risk-based armament decisions, that armament remains optional with individual case assessment, and that groene boa's can still obtain weapons, including an extendable baton added in July 2020.
A new decision on arming and equipping boa's is currently being drafted, in which security risks will carry more weight.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een nieuw besluit bewapening en uitrusting boa's, waarin veiligheidsrisico's meer maatgevend zullen zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Hack bij Apollo Vredestein toont zwakke cyberbeveiliging Nederlandse bedrijven' en het bericht 'Overheid wist wie kwetsbaar was, maar liet bedrij

Two MPs (Van den Berg and Amhaouch, CDA) asked the ministers about reports of a hack at Apollo Vredestein and claims that government knew which firms were vulnerable but did not warn them, raising questions on SME cyber-security, incident reporting duties and NCSC mandate limits. The government answered that cyber-security is a priority, that voluntary measures and the Digital Trust Center cover non-vital firms, and that the NCSC could not lawfully share certain threat data at the time, with a planned DTC expansion and a review of government powers in digital crises.

In addition, the NCSC has a statutory task, insofar as necessary to prevent adverse societal consequences, to pass on information about threats and incidents concerning network and information systems of other organisations, including personal data obtained from analyses for its primary task.

Daarnaast heeft het NCSC, voor zover noodzakelijk ter voorkoming van nadelige maatschappelijke gevolgen, krachtens de wet als taak om informatie over dreigingen en incidenten met betrekking tot netwerk- en informatiesystemen van andere organisaties (waaronder ook persoonsgegevens), die is verkregen bij analyses ten behoeve van de primaire taak, door te verstrekken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Visumplicht tussen de Schengenzone en Suriname

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Schengen visa requirement for travel to and from Suriname has exceptions, how many visa applications are filed and approved, and what steps would lead toward visa liberalisation. The minister answered that the requirement applies with limited exceptions, that visa approval rates are around 90 to 95 percent, that the EU Commission holds exclusive competence over visa liberalisation, and that Suriname must first request a study and improve readmission cooperation and biometric passports.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have figures on visa applications submitted by Dutch travellers for Suriname.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt niet over cijfers van visumaanvragen die door Nederlandse reizigers voor Suriname worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de brandweer in Epe een man tekort kwam om uit te rukken

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about reports that Epe's fire service could not dispatch a crew due to a shortage of one volunteer, and about volunteer availability and alternative business models. The minister acknowledged daytime availability concerns, pointed to ongoing regional programmes, said the safety region would enforce agreements more strictly, and provided volunteer numbers from 2010 to 2019 showing a decline.

The Noord- en Oost-Gelderland safety region has informed me that existing agreements will be followed more strictly and additional agreements will be made to prevent such an incident from happening again.

Veiligheidsregio Noord- en Oost-Gelderland heeft mij gemeld dat gemaakte afspraken stringenter zullen worden nageleefd en er aanvullende afspraken worden gemaakt om te voorkomen dat een dergelijke incident zich nogmaals zal voordoen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de persverklaring van Hizb ut Tharir dat vervolging voor de aanbeveling tot vrouwenbesnijdenis een poging zou zijn om moslims te criminaliseren

MPs Becker and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hizb ut Tahrir press statement calling prosecution for recommending female genital mutilation an attempt to criminalise Muslims, and asked whether the government would act against the group, ban it, or have the task force examine it. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the statement is unacceptable, that FGM is criminal and prosecuted, that Hizb ut Tahrir is a radical movement not calling for violence but he sees no reason for further measures now, that a dissolution bill is before parliament, and that the task force will monitor developments.
I currently see no reason to take further measures against the organisation.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilligers woedend om schrappen opleidingen’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Justice and Security why police volunteer training has been postponed to 2022 despite coalition commitments and earlier promises, and why volunteers are not allowed to carry firearms without further training. The Minister answers that priority goes to training new police recruits and renewing basic training, that volunteer upgrade courses run until 2021, and that the level-4 course starts in 2022.
Police volunteers previously had no possibility to take an upgrade training to level 4.
Politievrijwilligers hadden niet eerder de mogelijkheid een doorstroomopleiding naar niveau 4 te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over non-consensuele naaktbeelden en pornografie, kinder- en wraakporno op pornosites

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about non-consensual intimate images, child and revenge porn on porn sites, the platforms' responsibility, and whether a consent-verification duty should be introduced. The minister answered that victims have removal routes, that platforms have a growing responsibility and legal exposure, but that he opposes a separate statutory consent-verification duty, instead favouring a low-threshold removal procedure and Europe-level agreements.
The cabinet has no insight into the absolute number of victims of online sexual violence.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in het absolute aantal slachtoffers van online seksueel geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘‘Ga naar Holland’ is trending als homofobe sneer in Turkije’

Two MPs (Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, VVD) asked the ministers about a Turkish religious official's remarks linking homosexuality to population decline, the hashtag campaign that followed, threats, and Diyanet's influence in Dutch mosques. The minister condemned the remarks, said no criminal complaint was filed, referred to existing integration, monitoring and diaspora-policy measures, and declined to change those measures on the basis of this single statement.
A single statement by Mr Erbas in Turkey, however reprehensible, is not for the cabinet a reason to revise this approach at this moment.
Een enkele uitspraak van de heer Erbas in Turkije, hoe verwerpelijk dan ook, vormt voor het kabinet geen aanleiding om deze aanpak op dit moment te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het aanbestedingsplan van de politie Nederland voor Push-to-Talk dienst

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police tender for a Push-to-Talk back-up service, whether it signals structural problems with the new C2000 network, and where coverage gaps exist. The minister answered that the tender is a standard back-up requirement unrelated to the remaining connection problems, that the details of the network problems and coverage maps are deferred to a separate letter to parliament, and that coverage issues are handled through a regular prioritisation procedure.
For a detailed explanation of the state of the renewed voice network, I refer you to the letter about the network that I promised to send to your House last month, which I am sending today.

2 Voor een uitgebreide toelichting op de stand van zaken van het vernieuwde spraaknetwerk verwijs ik u naar de brief over het netwerk die ik uw Kamer, zoals ik vorige maand heb toegezegd, 3 vandaag doe toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de rol, taken en verantwoordelijkheden van de Landelijke Expertisegroep Bijzondere Zedenzaken

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the role, tasks and responsibilities of the LEBZ expert group on sexual offence cases, the removal of a website sentence about it, and calls for an independent investigation into ritual abuse networks. The minister explained that the LEBZ advises the public prosecutor non-bindingly, that the website change did not alter its role, and that he sees no reason for a new investigation while offering to contact German counterparts.
The advice of the LEBZ is not binding.
De adviezen van de LEBZ zijn niet bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de malafide puppyhandel vanuit Hongarije naar Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers about illegal puppy trafficking from Hungary, including prosecution numbers, penalties, border controls, EU registration, and enforcement against criminal networks. The minister responds that enforcement is being strengthened through a task force and a pending houding-ban bill, while stating that penalties are adequate, border checks rely on mutual trust between member states, and the bill is delayed.
The OM's registration systems therefore cannot establish how many cases related to illegal dog trade were processed by the OM in recent years or whether they led to a conviction.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM kan derhalve niet achterhaald worden hoeveel zaken gerelateerd aan illegale hondenhandel de afgelopen jaren door het OM zijn verwerkt en of dit tot een veroordeling heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Wijngaarden en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verdachten zaak sushiketen Sumo krijgen geen straf vanwege inbreuk op hun privacy’

MPs asked the government about a court ruling that suspects in the Sumo sushi case received no sentence because their privacy was violated by a KRO-NCRV documentary filmed with the FIOD and the public prosecutor's cooperation, and about the prosecutor's role in the documentary's content and non-disclosure. The Minister of Justice answered that the prosecution has appealed, that the prosecutor had a media contract allowing review of footage, and that the revised prosecution guidelines of September 2020 aim to prevent similar cases.
As long as the case has not become final, I do not wish to anticipate the possible consequences of (part of) the judgment for other criminal cases of the OM.
Zolang de zaak niet onherroepelijk is geworden wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke gevolgen van (een deel van) het vonnis voor andere strafzaken van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over de berichten 'Geweld door drillrappers verheerlijkt' en 'Ingewijden: Rotterdammer (19) doodgestoken door lid Amsterdamse drillrapgroep'

Two CDA MPs asked whether drill rap glorifying violence is linked to youth knife incidents, whether a causal link has been studied, and whether public broadcaster BNNVARA should have published violent drill videos on its platform. The minister said a national action plan on youth weapon possession is being drafted, that research on Rotterdam is awaited, that broadcasters are editorially independent and BNNVARA removed two videos and added warnings and classification.
The action plan is expected to be ready by early November.
Het actieplan zal naar verwachting begin november gereed zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over internationale drugshandel per post

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag ask about the growing international trade in hard drugs by post, foreign complaints about Dutch mail shipments, the scale of detections, enforcement gaps, and whether sender identification or opening powers should be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus answers that data are limited, customs pilots show positive results, public-private cooperation is being mapped, and a planned reform would let investigators open parcels without a rechter-commissaris.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be authorised to independently seize postal parcels and then open them and examine the contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nederland internationaal onder vuur om drugshandel per post’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about reports that Dutch dealers send about 9,000 drug parcels a month abroad, and about the scale, destinations and controls on outbound postal drug shipments. The Minister answered with seizure figures from 2017 to 2020, stated the 9,000 figure was an extrapolation from a pilot that warrants caution, noted no national statistics on drug parcels intercepted abroad, and said that customs can open parcels without a rechter-commissaris but that reform of the Strafvordering will simplify this and that the government is engaging in international efforts.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be empowered to seize postal parcels independently and then open the parcel and inspect its contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over drugspakketjes die vanuit Nederland naar het buitenland worden verzonden

MP Van Nispen asks the Justice Minister about drug parcels sent from the Netherlands abroad: complaints from other countries, slower responses to mutual legal assistance requests, why Dutch customs cannot stop the drugs, whether PostNL and customs have enough capacity to screen parcels, and whether intra-EU parcels are under-checked. The Minister refers to earlier answers, says customs and police check risk-based rather than opening all parcels, and states that customs' control capacity in postal flows will be expanded.
To further shape that approach, the control capacity of Customs in letter and parcel post will be expanded.
Om die aanpak nog beter in te vullen zal de controle-capaciteit van de Douane in de brief- en pakketpost worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de impact van coronabeperkingen op visumverlening aan buitenlandse geliefden van Nederlanders

MPs asked the government about the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on visa processing for foreign partners of Dutch nationals, including closed embassies, cancelled civic integration exams abroad, and whether alternative routes such as online exams or post-arrival testing are possible. The minister answered that most posts now offer the basic integration exam, that online testing is ruled out to prevent fraud, that post-arrival testing is incompatible with the MVV process, and that the government will keep working with posts and EU partners but cannot quantify affected families.
There is no insight into figures on the number of Dutch nationals currently forced to live apart because their partner cannot take the basic civic integration exam abroad.
Er is geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal Nederlandse staatsburgers dat op dit moment gescheiden moet leven vanwege het niet kunnen afleggen van een basisexamen inburgering buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'A. broedt op derde aanval'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a Syrian asylum seeker who had twice attacked a Jewish restaurant could be deported, whether prosecutors were too lenient in the first case, and what measures would prevent a third attack. The Minister said the residence permit will be reviewed by the IND after conviction and deportation is not currently possible due to the Syrian security situation, declined to comment on the pending case, and pointed to existing police and municipal measures.
Moreover, I understand that the Public Prosecution Service is currently still investigating whether there is reason to also charge a terrorist intent in the current trial.
Overigens heb ik begrepen dat het OM op dit moment nog onderzoekt of er aanleiding bestaat om in de huidige rechtszaak ook een terroristisch oogmerk ten laste te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de aanvraag erkenning Orthodoxe Zendende Instantie als zendende instantie

An MP asked why the government has not yet decided on the Orthodox Sending Agency's application, filed in November 2019, to be recognised as a sending body and a separate eighth denomination within the prison chaplaincy service. The Minister answered that the question is unprecedented, that independent advice has been commissioned and is expected in early 2021, and that no assessment framework yet exists, which will also be drafted.

Given the importance of the separation of church and state and the procedure followed in earlier applications for recognition as a sending body, I have decided, in consultation with my colleague the Minister of Justice and Security, to seek independent advice on this matter.

Gezien het belang van scheiding tussen kerk en staat en de gevolgde procedure bij eerdere aanvragen tot erkenning als zendende instantie heb ik, in overleg met mijn collega de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, besloten onafhankelijk advies in te winnen inzake dit vraagstuk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over illegale veelplegers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about illegal repeat offenders, including a Moroccan man with nearly 600 police contacts who has stayed in the Netherlands for fifty years without a residence permit, and whether failing return policy and reluctant countries of origin explain this. The State Secretary rejects that return policy has failed, acknowledges the need for improvement, explains the procedural and detention obstacles, describes EU-coordinated diplomatic and visa instruments, and says dialogue with Morocco is ongoing but was hampered by COVID-19.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases in public answers.
Zoals u weet ga ik in openbare beantwoording niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat VWS maaltijdbezorgers onder druk zet om de corona-app te gebruiken

An MP asked whether the Health Ministry pressuring meal delivery workers to use the CoronaMelder app violates the Tijdelijke wet notificatieapplicatie's ban on indirect obligation via employers. The minister admits the ministry's email should not have suggested asking couriers to download the app, stresses that use must remain voluntary, and says such conduct could be a criminal offence for which the courts would decide.
Although this email was written with the best intentions, the suggestion to 'ask couriers to download the app' should not have been made.
Hoewel deze mail met de beste bedoelingen is geschreven, had de suggestie om «bezorgers te vragen de app te downloaden» niet gedaan mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘'Terrorbuurman' slaat opnieuw toe, Kees D. zorgt dagelijks voor angst en overlast’

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked about a neighbour causing fear and nuisance, reportedly ignoring a court-ordered outpatient care order and a contact ban, and asked what action can be taken. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, explained the probation and prosecution route for breaches of conditions, the Wvggz and Wfz coercive-care options, and a new national reporting line, without committing to a specific new action.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onderwaardering van speciale politieteams

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why observation and technical (O&T) police teams have not received recognition or higher pay despite repeated requests since 2015, and whether their special allowances were abolished and their pay will be revised. The minister replied that the police are reviewing allowances and pay for special groups, with completion targeted by year-end, and that the outcome will determine whether any pay increase is warranted.
The police will, based on the outcome of the research, determine whether there is reason to increase the pay of O&T employees.
De politie zal op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bepalen of er aanleiding is voor de verhoging van de beloning van de medewerkers van O&T.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat Achterhoekse burgemeesters boos zijn om het sluiten van cellen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police cells in the Achterhoek region are closing, forcing officers to travel further with arrestees despite a shortage of police capacity, and what this means for social lawyers. The minister answered that closing four cell complexes frees up about 60 FTE of police capacity, that mitigating measures such as shared transport and a new facility in Elst limit extra travel, that all mayors now support the decision, and that the Legal Aid Council and bar have been informed and travel allowances exist for lawyers.

Furthermore, now that the assessment and decision-making process within the Oost-Nederland police unit has recently been concluded, I will, in line with an earlier request from your House, send the requested AEF analysis to your House on a confidential basis.

Tevens zal ik, nu het proces van beoordeling en besluitvorming binnen de politie-eenheid Oost-Nederland recentelijk is afgesloten, alsnog, conform eerder verzoek van uw Kamer, de gevraagde AEF-analyse vertrouwelijk aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opkomende criminaliteit en toenemende kansenongelijkheid in achterstandswijken

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about rising crime and inequality of opportunity in deprived neighbourhoods, including Zaandam, and whether an integrated approach like Rotterdam-Zuid would be extended. The government acknowledged the problems, pointed to prevention programmes and the Interbestuurlijk Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid, but gave no new budget and said the approach is still being explored with municipalities.
In this cabinet period, as I indicated in my letter of 18 June 2020, the further development of the preventive approach to undermining crime will be linked to this exploration.

In deze kabinetsperiode zal, zoals ik aangaf in mijn brief d.d. 18 juni 2020, voor de verdere uitwerking van de preventieve aanpak van ondermijnende criminaliteit bij deze verkenning worden aangesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Hoe beveiligers van Thierry Baudet met geweld een demonstrant onschadelijk maken’

MPs Özütok and Buitenweg asked whether private security guards of Thierry Baudet used physical force to stop a lone demonstrator, whether demonstration freedom may only be restricted by authorities under the Wom, and whether measures would be taken against repeat offending security firms. The Minister replied that private guards have no force powers beyond any citizen, that the complainant filed a police report, that such incidents are not separately registered, and that the Wpbr allows fines and licence withdrawal.
Private security guards, like any other citizen, have no authority to use force.
Particuliere beveiligers hebben, net als iedere andere burger, geen bevoegdheid tot het aanwenden van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gang van zaken rondom de demonstratie d.d. 21 juni 2020 op het Malieveld tegen de anderhalvemetersamenleving

MP Baudet asked the Interior and Justice ministers about the handling of the 21 June 2020 Malieveld demonstration against the 1.5-metre society, including the ban, police conduct and differential treatment of protests. Minister Ollongren answered that the local authority (the safety region chair) is responsible for demonstration decisions and must account to the municipal council, so ministers decline substantive answers, while stating the 1.5m rule is not a restriction of the right to demonstrate.
The local authority is accountable for that decision to the municipal council and, where appropriate, to the courts.
Het lokale gezag legt over die beslissing verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad en eventueel aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sneller over de gevaarlijke situaties als gevolg van ‘boerenprotesten’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Sneller asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Interior about dangerous situations caused by farmers' tractor blockades of motorways and airports, including whether police acted and what risk assessments applied. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no counts of tractors are available, that protest rights are primarily assessed by local authorities, that police prioritised ending the blockade, and that the government does not see unequal treatment compared with climate protests.
No figures are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het slachtproces ten tijde van COVID-19 en het Offerfeest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether the NVWA (food safety and consumer authority) had reached a real agreement with two Harderwijk and Nijkerk slaughterhouses on stunning during the 2020 Eid festival, how inspection and sanctions would apply, and whether unstunned slaughter could respect RIVM distancing rules. The minister answered that after a court case the slaughterhouses submitted revised plans, that stunned slaughter was agreed, that vets would use masks where distancing was impossible, and that normal supervision and enforcement applied.
I have worked to send the answers to your House as quickly as possible.
Ik heb mij ingezet om de antwoorden zo snel mogelijk aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Neonazi Heerlen’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether the German-Iraqi neo-Nazi Fadi J. and his party, who called for killing Jews, should be prosecuted, expelled, and whether the government tolerates violence against Jews. The minister answered that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, expulsion for the courts, and that a general conclusion cannot be drawn from one case.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to make such decisions, not for me as Minister of Justice and Security.
Het is aan het OM om dergelijke beslissingen te nemen, niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bedreigen van agenten

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a threat of physical violence against a police officer, made in front of his family, could not be prosecuted, and whether all threats of violence against police should be punishable. The minister replied that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, that threats of simple assault fall outside the legal threshold of Article 285 of the Criminal Code, and that the existing toolkit already offers broad scope for criminalisation without committing to a legislative change.
Ultimately, it is up to the Public Prosecution Service to determine whether a set of facts falls within that scope.
Het is uiteindelijk aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen of een feitencomplex daarbinnen valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Martin Bosma over het bericht 'Bol.com verkoopt geen producten en boeken meer waarop Zwarte Piet staat'

MPs Helder and Martin Bosma asked the Justice Minister about Bol.com's decision to stop selling items depicting Zwarte Piet and whether the ministry advised the company, and whether it finds it odd that Mein Kampf and the Koran remain on sale. The minister answered that it is not for him to judge a commercial company's range within the law, that Bol.com only contacted the ministry on its own initiative and was told no general guidelines exist, and pointed to the relevant criminal and civil law provisions.
It is not for me, in my capacity as Minister of Justice and Security, to take a position on the range offered by a commercial company that operates within the limits of the law.

Het is niet aan mij in mijn hoedanigheid als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om een positie te bepalen ten aanzien van het aanbod van een commercieel bedrijf dat opereert binnen de grenzen van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het vervolgingsbeleid bij verbaal geweld tegen publieke dienstverleners

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the prosecution policy for verbal and physical threats against public service workers, including why many such cases are dropped and whether the legal definition of threat hinders prosecution. The Minister says the Openbaar Ministerie assessed the case and found prosecution not feasible, gives the breakdown of dismissal grounds, and states the legal definition of threat does not in general stand in the way of prosecution, so no amendment is planned.
In general, reports of threats of physical violence are given priority.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat meldingen van bedreiging met fysiek geweld met voorrang worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat een agent vervolging wil afdwingen van man die hem bedreigde met fysiek geweld

Members Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether the Public Prosecution Service was right to drop a case where a police officer sought prosecution of a man who threatened him with violence, and about protection and reporting of violence against police. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the OM judged the threat did not qualify under the relevant offences, that agents are encouraged to report incidents, and that the bill extending the community-service prohibition is on track.
On this individual case, which is now before the judge, I cannot go into further detail.
Op deze individuele casus, die thans aan de rechter is voorgelegd, kan ik verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht dat journalisten bedreigd zijn na berichtgeving over boerenprotesten

MPs Sneller and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked the government how it views threats and blockades against journalists covering farmer protests, whether complaints were filed, and whether it will engage with the affected media. The Minister answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the PersVeilig initiative and prosecution protocols, reported no fines or known complaints for the Best incident, and said the government stands for a free press without committing to new talks.
Aggression and violence against journalists is unacceptable.
Agressie en geweld tegen journalisten is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilligers woedend om schrappen opleidingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police academy training for volunteer police officers would not start in 2020 or 2021 and that the volunteers' organisation feared losing specialist volunteers. The Minister answered that 168 new volunteers start a part-time course in 2020–2021, that a new step-up training from level 2 to level 4 will be developed and that the volunteer training will be aligned with the new basic police training from 2022, while acknowledging fewer places than foreseen due to prioritising recruit training.
Unfortunately, fewer training places for police volunteers have in total been made available than previously foreseen.
Helaas zijn er in totaal wel minder opleidingsplaatsen voor politievrijwilligers beschikbaar gesteld dan eerder voorzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Justice Minister could take enforcement action against the As Soennah mosque after Femmes for Freedom's enforcement request, which the Hague mayor rejected and an appeal is pending. The minister answered that enforcement is for the mayor and the courts, that the anti-terrorism measures law does not apply, and that he will not intervene or revisit joint enforcement.
It is up to the mayor to assess such an enforcement request and decide on it after weighing all relevant facts and circumstances.
Het is aan de burgemeester om een dergelijk handhavingsverzoek te beoordelen en daarop, na afweging van alle relevante feiten en omstandigheden, een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘paspoort blijft op zak Controle op Schiphol verdwijnt’

An MP asked the government about reports that Schiphol border checks would disappear in favour of technology such as facial recognition, and about data, privacy, and legal safeguards. The State Secretary said the pilots (Seamless Flow, KTDI) are at concept/pilot stage, no structural decision has been taken, the Chamber will be informed before any implementation decision, and privacy analyses are part of the projects, while declining to provide some surveillance-technology overviews and deferring others to later letters.
If the cabinet intends to implement one or both of these concepts in regular border control, the Chamber will be informed of the intended decision, including the safeguards regarding privacy.

Indien het kabinet het voornemen heeft één van deze of beide concepten in het reguliere grenstoezicht te implementeren, zal de Kamer over het voorgenomen besluit geïnformeerd worden, inclusief over de waarborgen met betrekking tot privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Diplomaten uit de bocht'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers about diplomats involved in traffic offences and other crimes who escape prosecution due to immunity, including whether immunity was lifted, how traffic checks and compensation work, and why countries of origin are not published. The minister replied that traffic violations fell by 51.8%, immunity was lifted only four times with prosecution pursued where possible, and naming countries would not be appropriate at present.
The number of other criminal offences committed by diplomats (i.e. embassy, consulate and international organisation staff with some form of immunity) is low relative to the size of the population.

Het aantal overige strafbare feiten, begaan door diplomaten (i.c. medewerkers van ambassades, consulaten en internationale organisaties die over een vorm van immuniteit beschikken) is laag, afgezet tegen de omvang van de populatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Postma over valetparkeerbedrijven n.a.v. de uitzending van ‘MAX Vakantieman’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about valet parking company abuses after a TV broadcast and whether police, prosecutors, certification schemes and a licensing system could address them. The minister answered that there is a coordinated local approach around Schiphol, that civil and traffic-fine rules apply, and that a national licensing scheme would be too burdensome for now.
Complaints against valet parking companies are not registered separately in police systems.
Aangiftes tegen valetparkingbedrijven worden niet apart geregistreerd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Dam over het toenemende verzet tegen geluidsoverlast door motorrijders

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Justice about rising public opposition to motorcycle noise, including enforcement, noise limits, foreign rules, flash cameras, seizure powers, and municipal authority to close roads. The government answered that it will study noise-reduction options, that enforcement and existing noise norms apply, and that municipalities may temporarily close roads to motorcycles if the traffic-law interests are served and the balancing is proportionate.
The Ministry of IenW will start a study into options to reduce noise nuisance from motorcycles.
Vanuit het Ministerie van IenW zal een onderzoek starten naar de mogelijkheden om geluidoverlast door motorfietsen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Bommelding bij Amsterdamse kerk om doop ex-moslims’

MPs Van der Graaf and Voordewind asked the Justice Minister about threats against people who convert or leave Islam, including a bomb threat at an Amsterdam church, and about police registration and COA handling of such threats. The minister agreed the problem is serious and not limited to Amsterdam, said he would await Amsterdam's study before commissioning his own, described police anti-discrimination screening and COA preventive and reporting procedures.
I will have myself informed about the outcomes of the Amsterdam municipality's study before considering conducting my own investigation.
Ik zal mij laten informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de gemeente Amsterdam alvorens zelf een onderzoek te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over geweldsaanwending door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about how police use of force is recorded, the neck-hold technique and its strawling risk, and implementation of a motion on periodic cross-case review of police force. The minister answered that force types are not separately recorded or automatically extractable, that the neck-hold control technique is taught while strangulation is not, and that cross-case review is being set up with first results expected in spring 2021.
Within the category of physical force, no distinction is made between the different forms of physical force.
Binnen de categorie fysiek geweld wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen de verschillende vormen van fysiek geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP from FvD asked the ministers of health, interior and justice about second-wave preparedness, IC capacity, AstraZeneca conflict-of-interest concerns, hydroxychloroquine research, social media censorship, face-mask experiments and a minister's holiday in Sweden. The government answered that capacity expansion and PPE stockpiles are underway, denied any conflict of interest, and defended the local face-mask experiments as proportionate.
I see no risks in the fact that we have entered into a deal with AstraZeneca.
Ik zie geen risico's in het feit dat we met AstraZeneca in zee zijn gegaan.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'De aanpak van milieucriminaliteit dreigt vast te lopen'

An MP from D66 asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers how environmental crime enforcement can be given more urgency, whether it is falling into the margins of criminal law, how sanctions relate to subsidies, and when an action plan will be sent. The government agrees more urgency is needed, promises a full action plan by year-end and further information later, but gives no firm numbers on case durations or subsidy recipients and says it does not record that data.
The full action plan on environmental crime will be sent to your House before the end of this year.
Het volledige actieplan Milieucriminaliteit zal voor het einde van dit jaar aan uw Kamer worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Hoe een PGP-hack narcostaat Nederland feilloos blootlegt’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a report on the PGP/Encro hack exposing Dutch drug trafficking, asking about seized criminal cash, police cyber capacity, prosecution capacity, reliance on volunteers and international cooperation. The minister answered that he cannot comment on individual cases, pointed to a June 2020 letter and a planned autumn study on drug producers, cited 120 FTE in high-tech crime teams, said analysing decrypted messages needs more work, and promised only to examine information-sharing bottlenecks with partners.
As you know, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet, kan ik mij over individuele zaken niet uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Kuiken over gedwongen gescheiden lange-afstandskoppels door corona

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked whether the government would relax the COVID-19 entry ban for long-distance unmarried partners, including a Danish-style exception, and clarified entry rules for EU citizens' non-EU partners and the online information. The minister answered that a temporary scheme for long-distance partners, in force since 27 July 2020, was introduced within health limits, that a marriage certificate is not the only way to prove a relationship, and that he will check the government online information.

In a letter of 16 July 2020 I informed your House that the cabinet, within the health frameworks relating to Covid-19, found a possibility to arrive at a temporary adjusted scheme for partners in long-distance relationships.

Bij brief van 16 juli 2020 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat het kabinet, binnen de gezondheidskaders met betrekking tot Covid-19, een mogelijkheid heeft gevonden om te komen tot een tijdelijke aangepaste regeling voor geliefden in een langeafstandsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert, Van Dam inzake het bericht ‘Activist Zarza neergestoken in Leeuwarden, familie vermoedt politiek motief’

Three CDA MPs asked whether the stabbing of Iranian activist Sadegh Zarza in Leeuwarden had a political motive, whether Iranian academics should face broader screening, and what steps the government had taken regarding Iranian involvement in liquidations in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service leads the investigation and no substantive statements can be made yet, that screening is limited to sensitive technical research areas under sanctions rules, and that no further action is currently planned.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to lead the criminal investigation into the offence and any possible motive.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om leiding te geven aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het strafbare feit en het eventuele motief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hoe een Haagse moskee een verzamelplaats voor jihadisten werd,’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why a The Hague mosque allegedly became a gathering place for jihadists, whether the municipality's radicalisation approach is evidence-based, and whether the mosque should be closed and administrative detention introduced. The minister defended the persoonsgerichte aanpak as evidence-supported, declined to name individuals, rejected closing the mosque and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een landelijk cold cases team

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a national cold case team should be created, why cold case capacity differs per region and why media attention influences which old cases are reopened. Minister Grapperhaus answered that each police unit has a structural cold case facility with no fixed size, that about 1700 cold cases exist, that selection criteria are being reviewed, and that media attention is not a formal criterion for opening cases.

In addition, I informed you by letter of 24 February that the Public Prosecution Service and the police have found that the current cold case criteria leave too much room for interpretation, and that they will examine this year whether and how these selection criteria can be adjusted.

Daarnaast heb ik u per brief van 24 februari jl. bericht dat het OM en de politie hebben geconstateerd dat de huidige criteria voor cold cases te veel ruimte laten voor interpretatie en dat ze dit jaar gaan onderzoeken of en hoe deze selectiecriteria aangepast kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep voor meer geld voor het Europees Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister whether he pleaded for more money for the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) at the JBZ Council, and why, given the EPPO is not yet operational. The minister denied it was on the agenda, said he only stated after the meeting that Europol, Eurojust and the EPPO should be adequately equipped, and answered the budget and MFF questions by referring to earlier letters and the European Council conclusions.
No, the EPPO was not on the agenda and was also not discussed at the JBZ Council of 7 July 2020.
Nee, het EOM stond niet geagendeerd en is ook niet besproken op de JBZ-raad van 7 juli 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ruit ingeslagen bij restaurant HaCarmel: ‘Het begint bijna gewoon te worden’’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the 100-metre exclusion order on the Syrian asylum-seeker suspected of attacking restaurant HaCarmel was apparently not enforced, and whether the government was responsible. Minister Grapperhaus replied that police did enforce the order with intensive surveillance when warranted and municipal cameras, that the suspect is in pre-trial detention, and that any residence-permit withdrawal and deportation will follow normal procedures, with forced return currently not possible due to the Syrian security situation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de verkoop van Nederlandse MP5’s in een Maltese wapenhandel

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked about Dutch MP5 submachine guns reportedly sold by a Maltese arms dealer, whether the sale involved a batch of 850 ministry weapons, what rules apply to resale, and oversight of onward sales. The state secretary answered that no weapons were sold to that firm, that 850 surplus MP5s went to the Dutch defence supplier TBM, and that Defence has no sight of further resale by the manufacturer or its partners.
Defence does not keep track of further (onward) sales by the manufacturer or an authorised trading partner of the manufacturer.
Defensie houdt geen zicht op de verdere (door-)verkoop door de fabrikant of erkende (handels)partner van de fabrikant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het besluit van de Britse regering om Huawei volledig uit te sluiten van het Britse 5G-netwerk

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the UK decision to fully exclude Huawei from its 5G network, the value of UK intelligence insight, US sanctions, updating the Dutch 5G risk analysis, EU/NATO coordination, the timing of ministerial rules on trusted suppliers, and the implications of Hong Kong's national security law for Chinese firms. The government answered that it makes its own assessment through a structural process reviewing threats and technology, that the 5G supplier ministerial regulation is expected in early 2021, and that there is no direct link between the Hong Kong law and trust in Chinese firms.
No public statements are made about the knowledge position of intelligence services.
Over de kennispositie van inlichtingendiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte werkte vlak voor arrestatie met kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how a terror suspect convicted of a terrorism offence could work in three youth care institutions under a false identity, and about screening, information sharing and oversight of care staff. The minister answered that the screening failure cannot be fully reconstructed, that VOG responsibility lies with employers and staffing agencies, that the IGJ found no irregularities in recent visits, and that a criminal investigation and the WODC study will inform future screening policy.
Unfortunately, it can no longer be established why this went wrong at the staffing agency or at the three institutions in 2018.
Het is helaas niet meer na te gaan waarom dat bij het uitzendbureau of bij de drie instellingen in 2018 verkeerd is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de uitzending van Argos over ritueel misbruik

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about an Argos broadcast on ritual abuse, including whether the LEBZ receives such reports, why an advisory working group's recommendation was not followed, whether new research is needed, and whether a helpline like Sektesignaal should be restored. The minister answered that ritual abuse cannot be excluded but prior investigations found no supporting evidence, that the LEBZ has handled about 25 such cases with no prosecutions, that the consultation obligation was lifted in 2016, that no new research is planned, and that Sektesignaal's role is now covered by other partners.
Since a new Directive in 2016 this obligation no longer applies, given the very small number of reported cases with aspects of ritual abuse.
Sinds een nieuwe Aanwijzing in 2016 geldt deze verplichting niet meer gezien het zeer geringe aantal aangifte van zaken met aspecten van ritueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht over een grote Duitse zaak van kindermisbruik

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch suspects or Dutch justice authorities are involved in a large German child sexual abuse case, and what the Netherlands does against international networks. The minister answered that no Dutch suspects are known, Dutch authorities are not involved, and described existing international police cooperation and a liaison officer appointed since November 2019.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the police have received no signals about this case from the German authorities.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie hebben over deze zaak geen signalen ontvangen van de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de aanhouding van tientallen boeren bij vreedzame demonstratie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of 62 farmers at a demonstration in Wijster, the regional ban on tractor protests, the detention of minors, the handling of arrestees and corona measures. The minister answered that the ban decisions belong to the safety-region chairs, arrests were made for breaching the demonstration rules under local tolerance limits, and withheld details on individual fingerprinting cases.
It is not for me to pass judgement on the temporary blanket bans on demonstrating with tractors in the three northernmost safety regions that you mention.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de door u genoemde tijdelijke algehele verboden om met tractoren te demonstreren in de drie meest noordelijke veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Je bent niet altijd een held als je een misdaad meldt’ en het bericht dat Arie den Dekker inmiddels is overleden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government protects a civilian witness who reported a murder and was later killed, and what protocols and witness-protection measures apply. The minister expressed sympathy, declined to comment on the individual case pending an independent inquiry and an Inspectorate orientation, described general witness-protection rules, and announced reforms to the protection system.
Pending the outcome of the announced independent inquiry and the orientation, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about this case.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van het aangekondigd onafhankelijk onderzoek en de oriëntatie past het mij niet om inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Spionnen op de loer: “vooral China aast op vaccinkennis”’

MPs Wiersma and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked whether signals of Chinese digital espionage against vaccine research institutes were known, what was being done, and whether a broader knowledge-security framework was coming. The government answered that digital espionage by state actors is a persistent threat, that institutions bear primary responsibility for their own security, that a fast-track bill lets the NCSC assist vaccine research centres, and that a broad knowledge-security regulation and new consultations with institutions are in preparation with reports promised in autumn.
However, no concrete statements are made publicly about specific case matters.
In het openbaar worden echter geen concrete uitspraken gedaan over specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het voortdurende mishandeling van jonge turnsters

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the ministers about reported abuse of young gymnasts in Dutch gymnastics and what the government would do, including on the independence of the reporting point, the top-sport culture, statute of limitations, and criminal reporting. The minister answered that an independent study on the scope of boundary-crossing behaviour in gym sport is funded and due around end 2020, that the CVSN and ISR provide independence and disciplinary oversight, that the limitation period was already extended, and that the outcomes will be followed up.
For that reason, the Ministry of VWS is funding an independent study into the nature, scope and approach of boundary-crossing behaviour in gymnastics and gym sport.
Om die reden financiert het Ministerie van VWS een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en aanpak van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de turn- en gymsport
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over een massale vechtpartij in AZC Budel

PVV MPs asked why only one asylum seeker was arrested after a mass brawl at AZC Budel involving about 100 residents, whether all rioters would be jailed and deported, and whether the centre and all AZCs should be closed and an asylum stop imposed. The State Secretary said about 15 people were directly or indirectly involved, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and rejected closing the centres or borders, noting COA can impose sanctions under the ROV.
While the criminal investigation is ongoing, I cannot provide further information on the outcome of this investigation.
Gedurende het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Haga over het bericht dat een man die de dochter van een columnist bedreigde een taakstraf van twintig uur kreeg opgelegd

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Haga asked whether a light community service sentence for threatening a columnist's daughter with rape and murder was acceptable and whether the OM's threat guideline should be tightened. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such threats are unacceptable, that sentencing is for the prosecutor and judge, and that the existing OM guideline and LOVS orientation points already allow higher sentences for aggravating factors, without committing to revise them.
Whether there is reason to impose a sentence in a particular case and, if so, which one, is determined by the public prosecutor or by the judge.
Of er in een bepaald geval aanleiding is om een straf op te leggen en zo ja, welke, wordt bepaald door de officier van justitie of door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Markuszower over een inspectie door het marineschip Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

MPs De Roon, Popken and Markuszower asked whether the frigate De Ruyter carried out a ship inspection over a possible sanctions violation, which vessel and flag were involved, what evidence existed, and with whom findings were shared. The government confirmed the inspection, said details could not be disclosed because a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and shared findings only with that service, and declined to give operational details of the ship's operations.
As you know, as Minister of Justice and Security I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Zoals bij u bekend doe ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar daders van geweld tegen LHBTI’s

An MP (D66) asked ministers of Justice and of Education about a planned study into perpetrators of violence against LHBTI people, school diversity education, and online hate speech enforcement. The ministers committed to an updated study focused on the G4 municipalities, but declined to judge teaching materials and deferred to schools and the Public Prosecution Service on capacity and enforcement.
Given freedom of education and expression, the school autonomy and the professional space of teachers, the government does not consider it appropriate to judge teaching materials.
Het past de regering, gezien de vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren, niet een oordeel te geven over leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de afhandeling van de zaak van een agent die door zijn eigen collega’s ten onrechte werd gearresteerd
