An MP asked why the Public Prosecution Service's judgement in the case of a police officer wrongly arrested by colleagues could be overturned by an internal police advisory committee, and about related disciplinary handling, integrity culture and measures against ethnic profiling. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case as it is before the court and still under internal review, explained the separate criminal and disciplinary procedures, and pointed to ongoing measures and a forthcoming CBS study and motion follow-up.
Because it concerns an individual case that is still before the court, I cannot make statements about it.
Omdat het een individuele casus betreft die nog onder de rechter is kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Hoe moet het verder? Politieonderzoek ter discussie’

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a published critique of police research and how police-relevant scientific research is steered and commissioned, including whether a research agenda and visions exist. The Minister answered that research is governed by the Police Act 2012 through a four-yearly Strategic Research Agenda, that the Police Academy and Police Education Council commission research, and that a new What Works in Policing programme with NWO-i NSCR is planned, with half of it left unbound.
Over the next five years the Police Academy, the police and I will together pursue a scientific research programme evaluating the effects of police action.
De komende vijf jaar zetten de Politieacademie, de politie en ik samen in op een wetenschappelijk onderzoeksprogramma dat ziet op de evaluatie van de effecten van politieoptreden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat een slachthuis medewerkers heeft aangezet tot het afleggen van valse gezondheidsverklaringen

An MP asked ministers about reports that a slaughterhouse pressured workers to fill in false health declarations, and whether the company withheld declarations from the GGD and why oversight was not tighter. The government said it had no signals of withholding, that the Inspectie SZW found no irregularities in one site, that additional oversight measures were taken, and that the NVWA could halt slaughter work if worker safety is not assured; criminal investigation is for the Openbaar Ministerie.
If the safety of NVWA and KDS staff is not assured, the NVWA will halt its work in slaughterhouses.
Als de veiligheid van NVWA en KDS medewerkers niet geborgd is, staakt de NVWA de werkzaamheden in slachterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Mondkapjesplicht in grote steden

Three D66 MPs asked whether local mask-wearing requirements in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, imposed via emergency ordinances, are compatible with Article 10 of the Constitution, their enforceability and sanctions, and why voluntary wearing was not chosen. The ministers answered that the experiments are a temporary, proportionate, locally motivated response to non-compliance with the 1.5-metre rule, that violations are punishable with a 95-euro fine, and that courts remain available for objections, while acknowledging the legal uncertainty and offering a temporary bill to shorten the emergency situation.
It is not for the government to intervene in any assessment of the sanction by the court.
Het is niet aan de regering om te treden in de eventuele beoordeling van de sanctie door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat politieagenten worden verdacht van zeer zware mishandeling van een hond

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers are suspected of severely abusing a dog (Tommy) during an arrest-team operation, including the timing of the internal investigation, suspension, possible criminal probe, and whether such force is tolerated. The Minister confirmed the investigation by VIK is ongoing, stated that force must be proportionate, said no officers are yet suspected of criminal offences, and gave limited detail citing the ongoing procedure.
Because the investigation into the use of force is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about the nature of the use of force and the content of the force report.
Omdat het onderzoek naar de geweldsaanwending nog loopt, kan ik geen verdere uitspraken doen over de aard van de geweldsaanwending en de inhoud van de geweldsmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over het bericht 'Politieteam tasert en schopt hond in Duiven, rol agenten onderzocht'

MPs Helder and Graus asked the Justice Minister whether police use of a Taser and kicking against a dog in Duiven was reported, why a stun weapon was used on a tied-up dog, and whether the officers' conduct and the reported force had been reviewed. The minister confirmed a use-of-force report was filed, said an internal investigation was opened after the owner's letter, and declined to give details, forward case files to the lawyer, or state a timeline or suspension status while the investigation runs.
Because the investigation into the use of force is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about the nature of the use of force and the content of the use-of-force report.
Omdat het onderzoek naar de geweldsaanwending nog loopt kan ik geen verdere uitspraken doen over de aard van de geweldsaanwending en de inhoud van de geweldsmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: dreiging door extreme afsplitsing van IS’

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report on the Hazimi movement, a jihadist offshoot of IS with an estimated 100 Dutch followers, including its threat level, the number of former IS members involved, local government handling, online activity, and future coverage in the threat assessment. The minister answered that Hazimi followers are more sectarian but not more violent than IS-oriented jihadists, numbers are stable at a few dozen, local care-based approaches apply, online activity is monitored, and the DTN will address the movement if developments warrant.
I cannot make statements about individual persons.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er een dreiging is van een extreme tak van IS

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about warnings that local authorities underestimate the Hazimi movement, the number of its adherents, coordination with municipalities on reintegration and deradicalisation, national steering after Arnhem, and any foundations linked to the movement. The Minister replied that Hazimi adherents are more hostile to other Muslims but not a higher violent threat than ISIS supporters, that numbers are stable at a few dozen, that municipalities are supported and consulted, that the national strategy is under evaluation, and that no known foundations are run by adherents.
There are currently no known institutions or foundations run by adherents of the Hazimi current that promote the Hazimi ideology.
Er zijn op dit moment geen instanties of stichtingen bekend die bestuurd worden door aanhangers van de Hazimi-stroming en die het Hazimi-gedachtegoed uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over de aangeboden petitie/brandbrief draf- en rensport

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked the ministers whether there is sound justification to keep banning trotting and racing selection trials, given a tested protocol, outdoor activities, no spectators and permission elsewhere in Europe, and whether the ban can be lifted soon. Minister Schouten answered that the planned easing of measures from 1 July removes any medical reasons to ban races, including selection trials, and that she sees no need for further action now.
With the announced easing of measures from 1 July, there are no longer any medical-substantive reasons to prohibit races.
Met de aangekondigde versoepeling van maatregelen per 1 juli zijn er geen medisch-inhoudelijke redenen meer om wedstrijden te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over inzake de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked about delays in the entry into force of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij against piracy, the date, consultation with the maritime sector, a task force, the 48-hour response period for the Coast Guard, and including the Gulf of Guinea. Minister Grapperhaus replied that entry into force is now expected by 1 January 2022 at the latest, that existing coordination is sufficient without a new task force, and that the Gulf of Guinea could be explored while noting that naval protection under the VPD-first principle would be needed.

Based on current insights and taking into account the fixed dates for entry into force of legislation (1 January or 1 July), the cabinet assumes that the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij will enter into force by 1 January 2022 at the latest.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten en rekening houdend met de vaste data van inwerkingtreding van wet- en regelgeving (1 januari, dan wel 1 juli), gaat het kabinet er vanuit dat inwerkingtreding van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij uiterlijk per 1 januari 2022 zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Willekeur van coronaregels ondermijnt het vertrouwen’ en ‘Advocaten roepen mensen op: kom in verzet tegen coronaboete’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether corona fines can be challenged in court, given that kanton court hearings are largely suspended until 1 September 2020. The minister replied that objections (verzet) are possible and reviewed by the kantonrechter, but such cases were not yet heard, and the OM and Rechtspraak will bring a representative selection of objection cases to court before 1 September.
In principle this does not yet apply to criminal law kanton hearings (until 1 September 2020), which also include objection cases.
In beginsel geldt dit nog niet voor strafrecht kantonzittingen (tot 1 september 2020), waar ook de verzetszaken onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two MPs asked the government to clarify how many people gathering at 1.5 metres constitutes a breach of the emergency ordinances, and why the Prime Minister's statements on group size, and the definition of an event, seemed inconsistent with fines and enforcement practice. The minister explained the successive rules for public spaces and gatherings, said the definition of event and the distinction with gatherings is clarified in an ordinance, and noted that a bill in preparation will address gathering norms.
In general, an emergency ordinance must contain sufficiently precise provisions to be complied with and enforced.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat een noodverordening voldoende bepaalde voorschriften moet bevatten om te kunnen worden nageleefd en gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘cyberbeveiliger Fox-IT schorst drie directieleden’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Fox-IT suspended three board members and what this means for government cybersecurity services and encryption of state secrets. The minister answered that cooperation is unchanged, that special safeguards from the 2015 takeover by NCC Group keep crypto work in a separate Dutch-registered subsidiary, and that the national crypto strategy aims to reduce supply risk.
Cooperation between the government and Fox-IT is for now unchanged, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
De samenwerking tussen de overheid en Fox-IT is vooralsnog onveranderd, wel houden wij de situatie nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over drugssmokkel op zee

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked the Justice, Agriculture and Transport ministers about drug smuggling by fishing vessels, including subsidies, detection odds, licence withdrawal and Bibob screening. The government acknowledged the financial pressure link, said subsidies should exclude convicted fishers while EU rules limit this, and promised investigations into licence withdrawal and Bibob use while noting limited data on detection.
The Minister of LNV will investigate what options exist to exclude fishers who have committed criminal offences from these funds.
De Minister van LNV zal onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om vissers die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd uit te sluiten van deze middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Dreiging extreemrechts 'grote blinde vlek'” en het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 52

An MP from D66 asked the Justice Minister about reports that far-right extremism is a blind spot, the threat it poses, its networks, government responses and the farmers' protest group FDF. The minister answered that the threat is marginal and mostly from lone actors, that enforcement and prevention measures are in place, and that FDF's rhetoric is polarising.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of motives linked to criminal cases.
De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie houden geen registratie bij van motieven gekoppeld aan strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het eerder openen van coffeeshops

An MP asked why coffeeshops were not allowed to reopen with full hospitality like other catering businesses on 1 June 2020, and whether this caused nuisance or illegal trade. The minister explained that gradual reopening was needed to control the virus, that coffeeshops were allowed to reopen from 1 July under the same conditions as regular hospitality, and that no signals of nuisance or illegal trade had been received.
This means coffeeshops may also open from 1 July, including for the hospitality function, under the same conditions as regular hospitality.
Dit betekent dat de coffeeshops ook per 1 juli open mogen, ook voor de horecafunctie, onder dezelfde voorwaarden als de reguliere horeca.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bruins over veilige evenementen

MPs Schonis and Bruins asked why event organisers cannot obtain permits for safe events such as drive-in venues under the general ban, and why Dutch rules differ from Germany and Denmark. The minister replied that the ban was lifted from 1 July, that local authorities now decide case by case, and that economic support schemes exist, but declined to give a detailed rationale for why safe events were not permitted earlier.
It is up to the local authorities to determine whether organisers can adequately arrange their activity at 1.5 metres and meet the other applicable measures.

Het is aan de lokale autoriteiten om te bepalen of organisatoren hun activiteit voldoende op anderhalve meter in kunnen richten en tevens aan andere van toepassing zijnde maatregelen kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat er in Oekraïne honderden draagmoederbaby’s wachten tot ze opgehaald worden door hun wensouders

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Justice and Foreign Trade ministers about reports of hundreds of surrogacy babies in Ukraine waiting to be collected by intended parents, asking about child welfare, coercion, trafficking, Dutch involvement, nationality and whether Dutch rules can be tightened. Minister Dekker answered that Ukraine is responsible for the facts and prosecution, that Dutch surrogacy legislation is in preparation with safeguards and a ban on child-buying, and that Dutch involvement in the Hague Conference expert group continues.
It is not for me or the Netherlands but for the Ukrainian authorities to establish the actual circumstances and, where relevant, investigate and prosecute criminal offences.
Het is niet aan mij of Nederland maar aan de Oekraïense autoriteiten om de feitelijke omstandigheden vast te stellen en waar relevant strafbare feiten te onderzoeken en te vervolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van der Graaf inzake het bericht ‘Ruit ingeslagen bij restaurant HaCarmel: ‘Het begint bijna gewoon te worden’'

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Van der Graaf asked about repeated antisemitic vandalism at restaurant HaCarmel, the recidivism assessment of the suspect, the 100-metre exclusion zone and police enforcement. Minister Grapperhaus gave a detailed incident overview and described court and police handling, but declined a substantive judgement on the 8 May 2020 case because criminal investigation is ongoing.
Because the criminal investigation into the incident of 8 May 2020 is still ongoing, I refrain from giving a substantive judgement on this case.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het incident op 8 mei 2020 nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over beperkingen begrafenissen en kerkdiensten in het licht van de Grondwettelijke vrijheden

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether COVID-19 caps on attendance at church services and funerals (30 persons) fit the constitutional freedom of religion, and whether emergency decrees are a suitable instrument for such restrictions. The minister answered that worship exemptions, streaming and a 'reasonable interpretation' of article 6 justify the temporary limits, that church bodies set their own protocols, and that a bill on fundamental-rights restrictions is in preparation.

A reasonable interpretation of freedom of religion means that this right does not extend so far that, under current circumstances, it covers an unlimited number of participants in religious gatherings.

Een redelijke uitleg van de vrijheid van godsdienst brengt dan met zich dat dit recht niet zó ver reikt dat het onder de huidige omstandigheden een onbeperkt aantal deelnemers aan religieuze bijeenkomsten omvat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Macron gaat buitenlandse imams weren’

MPs Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Heerema asked the government about France's plan to restrict foreign imams, about radical religious influence in Dutch neighbourhoods, closing institutions, foreign-trained imams, an imam certification system, an imam training programme, informal education oversight and French-language rules in schools. The minister answered that the government will act against antidemocratic conduct without targeting any religion, points to a taskforce and a bill on dissolving legal persons, and promises an exploratory report on informal education before summer.
Due to signals of possible antidemocratic or intolerant elements within a number of organisations offering informal education, I have announced a broad exploration.
Vanwege signalen van mogelijke antidemocratische of onverdraagzame elementen binnen een aantal organisaties die informele scholing aanbieden, heb ik een brede verkenning aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de strafrechtspleging in Coronatijd

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked about the state of criminal justice during the COVID-19 period, including police capacity, legal aid, backlogs, courtroom access, detainee participation and tbs (forensic psychiatric) leave. The minister replied that physical hearings were gradually resumed from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, backlogs are being addressed through an integrated approach, and various measures on legal aid, video hearings and probation were described, mostly without concrete new commitments beyond promised letters.
Your House will be informed in writing about the approach once it is ready.
Uw Kamer wordt schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de aanpak zodra deze gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Defensie en politie willen samen personeel werven'

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about a bilateral agreement between the police and Defence on workforce cooperation, including career-path exchange, and whether Defence staff moving to the police lose substantial net pay that should be compensated. The minister confirmed the April 2019 agreement and joint labour market research, said he could not judge individual motives or the claimed pay gap, saw no reason to compensate transfers, and noted the police still manage to recruit enough staff.
Without further clarification of function, rank and age, the alleged salary difference cannot be confirmed or refuted.
Zonder een nadere duiding van functie, rang en leeftijd is het vermeende verschil in salaris onmogelijk te onderschrijven of te weerleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de wenselijkheid van zelfonderzoek in fraudezaken

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether the professional rules for lawyers guarantee objectivity when they conduct self-investigations in fraud cases, including the risk of perverse financial incentives and the lack of licensing. Minister Grapperhaus answered that lawyers remain bound by professional conduct rules and disciplinary law, that the OM and FIOD verify such self-investigations, and that no specific new rules are needed.
The OM has indicated it is open in future to self-investigation by professionals, including lawyers or (forensic) accountants, hired by suspect companies themselves.
Het OM heeft te kennen gegeven in de toekomst open te staan voor zelfonderzoek door professionals, waaronder advocaten of (forensisch) accountants
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht dat een groep externe deskundigen zich niet serieus genomen voelt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security to respond to external experts who feel ignored after the government adopted the Fire Safety Institute's (IFV) position on fireworks, and whether he would reconsider, conduct additional research on subclass 1.4, or re-examine the fire adviser's expertise. The minister stood by the IFV-based report, said the dissenting experts' view was insufficiently substantiated, and refused further research or talks.
The researchers concluded that this opinion was insufficiently substantiated.
Door de onderzoekers is geconcludeerd dat die mening onvoldoende is onderbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Politie luidt noodklok over toename crystalmethlabs’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rising crystal meth lab busts, the sources and destination markets, Mexican cartel involvement, and measures against Dutch enablers and designer drugs. The minister gave detailed figures on labs and seizures, said location data could harm investigations, and outlined enforcement, prevention and a forthcoming bill banning groups of new psychoactive substances.
The police indicate that making public the locations where production sites were dismantled could harm the investigative interest.
De politie geeft aan dat het inzichtelijk maken van de locaties waar productieplaatsen zijn opgerold het opsporingsbelang kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over ‘de waarschuwing van de Nationale Ombudsman het stroomstootwapen terughoudend te gebruiken’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he views the Ombudsman's warning to use Taser weapons restrainedly, including their use against an elderly dementia patient and a young man in psychosis, and about health risks, training and monitoring. The Minister says use is assessed afterwards on proportionality and subsidiarity, that the training was extended from two to three days, and that the wider rollout will be accompanied by medical research whose set-up will be reported later this year.
I will not go further into specific cases in which the Taser was used.
Ik ga verder niet in op specifieke casussen waarbij het stroomstootwapen is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Paternotte en Van Eijs over de berichten dat studenten boetes ontvangen voor groepsvorming in eigen huis

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether fines for student house gatherings under emergency COVID-19 ordinances are proportionate, consistent and correctly applied. The minister answered that the ban applies only to public space, that the Leiden fines were withdrawn, that enforcement guidance is national but allows local discretion, and that a bill is being prepared to clarify household definitions.
The fines imposed in Leiden mentioned above have been withdrawn, because it later became clear that the emergency ordinance was not applied correctly.
De bovengenoemde boetes die zijn opgelegd in Leiden zijn ingetrokken, omdat achteraf is gebleken dat de noodverordening niet op juiste wijze is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie inzake geen coronaboetes voor studenten in hun eigen studentenhuis

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he would implement the adopted motion that students should not receive corona fines for group gatherings in their own student house, whether already issued fines would be reversed, and whether the definition of a shared household should be regulated nationally. The minister answered that the emergency ordinance now explicitly limits the group-gathering ban to public spaces, that fined persons can contest the penalty order before a judge, and that the definition will be addressed in forthcoming legislation.
If someone believes a fine was wrongly imposed for group gathering outside the public space, that person can object to the OM penalty order before the judge.
Als men van mening is dat ten onrechte een boete is opgelegd voor groepsvorming buiten de publieke ruimte, dan kan de betrokkene tegen de opgelegde OM-strafbeschikking in verzet gaan bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de toename van agressie tegen agenten

An MP asks the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why assaults on police officers rose, whether the taakstraf ban bill and mental-health plan are delayed, and whether courts are too lenient. The ministers answer that no clear cause is visible in the data, the taakstraf bill is with the Raad van State and expected before summer recess, the mental-health approach is led by municipalities, and courts generally follow prosecutors' demands.
The taakstraf ban bill is currently pending advice from the Council of State's advisory division.
Het wetsvoorstel Taakstrafverbod is op dit moment voor advies aanhangig bij de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de politieke verantwoordelijkheid in gevoelige zaken en de lopende strafzaak tegen Shell

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister how sensitive criminal cases are flagged to the minister, how the high-transaction procedure works, and what contact the ministry had with Shell over the Nigeria prosecution and a possible settlement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecution service informs him under the statutory duty of Article 129 RO, that he refrains from substantive comment on ongoing cases out of respect for prosecutorial independence and separation of powers, and that there was no ministry contact with Shell beyond seeking its view under the Wob request.
Part of this restraint is that I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal case.
Onderdeel van de terughoudendheid is dat ik over een lopende strafzaak geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht '“Zero tolerance” is needed across Europe as figures show it’s a world hub for hosting child sexual abuse material'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about an IWF report that 71% of child sexual abuse material found worldwide is hosted in the Netherlands, and about enforcement against webhosts that fail to remove it. The minister said the figures reflect reporting and crawler effects, outlined cooperation with EOKM and the EU, and said a bestuursrechtelijk enforcement bill is being prepared but cannot take effect before summer.
Once TU Delft has delivered its complete measurement in a report, I intend to send it to the House of Representatives, thereby making the names and performance of companies transparent.
Wanneer de TU Delft haar complete meting in een rapport heeft opgeleverd, ben ik voornemens deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden en daarmee namen en prestaties van bedrijven transparant te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Hof moet na hardhandige arrestatie Michael P. weer kijken naar straf’

An MP asked the Justice Minister to act against an advocate-general who advised a reduced sentence for Michael P. after his violent arrest, and asked whether police officers should be prosecuted or honoured. The minister answered that the advocate-general acts independently, that the prosecution service decides on prosecution and sentencing demands, and that dismissal is outside his role.
Given the separation of powers, it is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to judge the independent advice of an advocate-general at the Supreme Court.
Gelet op de scheiding der machten is het niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om te oordelen over onafhankelijke adviezen van een advocaat-generaal bij de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Volop onbegrip tussen politie en ggz'

MPs Van Dam and Van den Berg asked about reported failures by the police control room and the GGZ-police handover in a fatal Wageningen incident involving a person with confused behaviour. The minister answered that an internal evaluation was published, the handbook was reissued, a new protocol and training were introduced, and a national non-urgent reporting number is due around July 2020.
The police had an initial factual investigation carried out immediately after the incident.
De politie heeft direct na het incident een oriënterend feitenonderzoek laten uitvoeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het rapport "Digitalisering aan de grens; Cybersecurity van het grenstoezicht door de Koninklijke Marechaussee op Schiphol" van de Algemene Rekenkamer (20

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about the Court of Audit's report on cybersecurity of border control at Schiphol, covering approval procedures, security testing, critical systems, crisis exercises and transfer of the self-service system to Schiphol. The government answered that approvals and added security measures are underway with full implementation expected by end 2020, that annual testing is not feasible given staffing, that not all critical systems are yet connected to the SOC, that an exercise and an update of guidelines will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before any transfer of the self-service system.
The cabinet will inform the Chamber further about the intended decision and the conditions under which it takes place before the transfer takes place.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer nader informeren over het voorgenomen besluit en de voorwaarden waaronder dit gebeurt voordat overdracht plaatsvindt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Digitalisering aan de grens; Cybersecurity van het grenstoezicht door de Koninklijke Marechaussee op Schiphol'

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the Court of Audit report on cybersecurity of border control systems at Schiphol run by the Royal Marechaussee, including data ownership, transfer of the self-service system to Schiphol N.V., security approval, testing frequency and monitoring. The government answered in detail, acknowledging delays in approval and resource limits, while withholding some test results as classified and promising further measures on protecting vital infrastructure.
The research results of the counter system are classified and therefore cannot be shared.
De onderzoeksresultaten van het baliesysteem zijn gerubriceerd en kunnen daarom niet gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie stelt onderzoek in naar misstanden binnen Landelijke Eenheid’

An MP asks the Justice Minister about reported misconduct and a research investigation within the National Police's Landelijke Eenheid, including who investigates, the duration of suspensions, disciplinary procedures and the independence of internal oversight. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate of Justice and Security is conducting an independent study, gives counts of disciplinary and criminal investigations and suspended staff, and declines to discuss individual cases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tolk- en vertaaldiensten die door het Openbaar Ministerie via bemiddelaars worden verdeeld

MP Van Nispen asked why the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has been procuring interpreting and translation services via intermediaries, whether this disadvantages interpreters, and when the government will respond to the Parliamentary Advocate's advice on tendering. Minister Grapperhaus replied that direct contracting of interpreters is no longer lawful after the Aanbestedingswet, that intermediary use is incidental existing practice, that interpreters will get a minimum tariff in future tenders, and that the response to the Parliamentary Advocate was sent on 20 May 2020.
As I explained in that response, it is not an option to continue contracting interpreting and translation services directly through the OM and courts.
Zoals ik in deze reactie heb toegelicht is het geen optie om tolk- en vertaaldiensten door OM en rechtbanken rechtstreeks in te blijven schakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Strategie voor gendergelijkheid: streven naar een Unie van gelijkheid’

An MP asked the government about the European Commission's gender equality strategy 2020-2025, including violence against women, underreporting, ratification of the Istanbul Convention, EU criminal harmonisation, online violence and the Beijing Platform. The minister welcomed the strategy, described existing Dutch programmes on domestic violence and planned legislation on sexual offences, and said Istanbul Convention ratification is stalled in the Council pending a Court of Justice opinion.
The cabinet welcomes this gender strategy and shares the goals formulated in the gender equality strategy.
Het kabinet verwelkomt deze genderstrategie en deelt de doelen die in de strategie voor gendergelijkheid worden geformuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over aanbestedingen van tolk- en vertaaldiensten

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Minister of Justice whether preparatory steps for the interpreter and translation procurement programme (Tolken in de Toekomst), such as early registration and online tender notices, were irreversible given his earlier commitment. The Minister answered that these steps are not irreversible, that tendering is required by law, and that he would reply to the parliamentary advocate's advice by letter, which was already sent on 20 May 2020.
Yes, pending the advice of the parliamentary advocate, I have not taken any irreversible steps.
Ja, ik heb in afwachting van het advies van de parlementair advocaat geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Vuurwapens, explosieven en cocaïne: schoolkoepels slaan alarm over criminele leerlingen' en de uitzending van Jinek van 21 februari 2020

MPs Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked ministers about reports that school federations see rising serious incidents involving weapons and drugs, underreporting to police, and conflicting ministerial statements on filing criminal complaints. The government says there is no national incident registry, points to the Veiligheidsmonitor and existing police and municipal partnerships, stresses the importance of filing complaints for serious offences, and promises to discuss cooperation with partners and to publish the evaluation of the Wet veiligheid op school in summer 2020.
There is no national registration of the number of incidents that have occurred at schools.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van het aantal incidenten dat zich op scholen heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Te koop: openbare orde en veiligheid; Onderzoek Beveiligingsmultinational G4S en de VVD-lobby’

MPs Van Dam (CDA) and Verhoeven (D66) asked about a 2016 intention statement on sharing sensor data between G4S-type security firms, police and prosecutors, the legal basis for camera footage sharing, camera rules for municipalities, facial recognition, and the conduct of a former OVV chair holding a G4S advisory role. The minister answered that the document is a non-binding intention statement with no follow-up, that legal frameworks (Wpg, Wjsg, AVG) govern data sharing, and that the former chair complied with reporting rules as far as known.
There is no question of a covenant.
Er is geen sprake van een convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat openbare orde en veiligheid te koop is

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about alleged close ties between former VVD politicians and security multinational G4S, the scale of public-private projects and sensing projects with public money, and why the House was not informed. The minister answered that post-ministerial lobbying rules were not breached, gave no exhaustive overview of projects, stated that the police have no sensing cooperation with private parties, and rejected the idea that the government should curb security firms, while noting the government invested in policing.
I do not have an exhaustive overview of the public-private projects in which G4S is involved.
Ik beschik niet over een uitputtend overzicht van de publiek-private projecten waar G4S bij betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS op de weg terug’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a press report that IS is making a comeback in Syria, Iraq and Europe, and what this means for threat levels and border policy. The minister answered that the jihadist threat to Europe has fallen since 2017 but remains significant, that closing borders to all Muslims or asylum seekers is not a realistic solution, and that counter-terrorism cooperation continues.
The cabinet considers permanently closing the borders to immigrants from Islamic countries not a realistic solution.
Het kabinet acht het voorgoed sluiten van de grenzen voor immigranten uit islamitische landen geen realistische oplossing
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Toorenburg over het bericht dat in de Haagse wijk Valkenbos-Regentes een dodelijke steekpartij heeft plaatsgevonden

MPs Van Dam and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked about a fatal stabbing in The Hague's Valkenbos-Regentes area, police and prosecution enforcement against drug crime, coffeeshop concentration and school proximity, and whether a new coffeeshop concentration criterion should be added. Minister Grapperhaus answered that enforcement and local measures are in place, that a national concentration criterion is not needed because municipalities can set local rules, and that the municipality is handling the neighbourhood transformation.
I see no added value in adding an extra national criterion for the following reasons.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in het toevoegen van een extra landelijk criterium om de volgende redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over ‘Wapenbranche dreigt met claim tegen politie om gesloten loket’ en ‘Politie bezorgd over florerende wapenhandel’

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister about police counter closures halting firearms licensing, the police's concern over legal ammunition ending up in crime, the capacity of the Controlerende Autoriteit for deactivated weapons, and inspectorate findings on capacity. The minister answered that closures were a necessary COVID measure with counters reopening from 25 May, that about 75-85% of capacity goes to administrative tasks, that a business case on transferring licensing to Justis is underway, and that the CA is processing about 25 weapons per week with no sign it is underperforming.
A business case is currently being prepared on the extent to which it is desirable and feasible to transfer part of the licensing tasks to Justis.
Momenteel wordt bijvoorbeeld een businesscase gemaakt naar in hoeverre het wenselijk en haalbaar is om een deel van de vergunningverlenende taken over te hevelen naar Justis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de bestrijding van mensenhandel

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Justice and Security ministers why police missed the 2019 target of 190 OM suspects for human trafficking (only 145 registered) and about related issues including Dublin claimants, the webcrawler, lure profiles, minors and a Tilburg campaign. The ministers acknowledge the shortfall, attribute it largely to the influx of Dublin claimants and AVIM staffing pressures, promise a recalibration of the target, and defer several questions to later letters or the WODC study.
In 2019 not the agreed 190 but 145 suspects were registered with the OM for prosecution.
In 2019 werden niet de afgesproken 190, maar 145 verdachten ter vervolging ingeschreven bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about legal objections that COVID-19 emergency ordinances (noodverordeningen) based on the Public Health Act lack basis, bypass the constitutional state-of-emergency regime, restrict constitutional rights without grounds, and lack democratic control. The government defended the ordinances as lawful, pointed to Ministerial instructions as subject to parliamentary oversight and to council information duties, and announced temporary specific legislation with consultation of local bodies.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it desirable that the measures to be taken after the acute crisis phase be developed in consultation with parliament.
Wel acht het kabinet het gewenst dat de maatregelen die moeten worden getroffen na de fase van acute crisisbeheersing in samenspraak met het parlement tot stand worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen en Kuiken over de omvang en aanpak van seksuele intimidatie en geweld jegens meisjes en vrouwen in Amsterdam

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers about the scale of sexual harassment and violence against girls and women in Amsterdam, the city's measures, and whether a national gender-sensitive approach and VNG coordination are needed. The government welcomed Amsterdam's measures, pointed to national research, a pending review of the Istanbul Convention recommendations, VNG coordination work and planned extensions of the Veilige Steden programme, and noted new sex offence legislation and extra funding for vice teams.
Together with the other relevant departments, NGOs and experts, I will in the coming period discuss the recommendations in the evaluation report, including this one.
Samen met de andere betrokken departementen, NGO's en experts ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek over aanbevelingen in het evaluatierapport, waaronder deze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Paternotte over het in gevaar brengen van Nederlanders door het in brand steken van zendmasten

MPs Verhoeven and Paternotte asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Justice and Security about arson attacks on mobile telecom masts linked to 5G conspiracy theories, including the number of incidents, impact on emergency services, protective measures and EU coordination. The government reported 29 registered arson incidents, no prior precedent in the Netherlands, that emergency number 1-1-2 was affected at least once, that the most critical C2000 masts will be secured within about three months, and that the matter was raised at an informal EU Telecom Council.
For security reasons I will not go into the specific protective measures.
Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt ga ik niet in op de specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Wéér twee gsm-masten in brand, terrorismebestrijder bezorgd'

MPs Van den Berg and Van Dam asked whether arson on phone masts threatens residents' safety and emergency number 112, and how the government will protect masts and 5G infrastructure. The state secretary answered that residents' safety was not known to be at risk, that 112 remains reachable, that 29 arson incidents are registered and the investigation is ongoing, and that ministries are consulting the sector on possible additional measures.
It is currently too early to go into specific security measures.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om in te gaan op specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat de politieopleiding wordt verkort tot twee jaar

Parliamentary questions from MP Den Boer (D66) ask the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police training course is being shortened to two years, and about its effects on quality, cybercrime and discrimination content, financing, accreditation, consultation and timing. The minister answers that the shortening is a structural, education-driven change within existing law, that quality is not compromised, that the Chamber was informed in earlier letters, and that the new basic training starts in 2021.
With my letters of 13 November 2019, 17 December 2019, 4 February 2020 and 28 March 2020 I informed your House about the intention to revise basic police education and a possible shortening.

Antwoord 9 Met mijn brieven van 13 november 2019 2 , 17 december 2019 3 , 4 februari 2020 4 en 28 maart 2020 5 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over het voornemen tot een herziening van het basispolitieonderwijs en een mogelijke verkorting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het in brand steken van C2000 masten

An MP asked whether arson attacks on C2000 emergency radio masts had disrupted 112 access, threatened the network, and what protection was planned for the 525 masts. The government said 112 remained reachable, C2000 impact was limited, the most critical masts would be secured first over roughly three months, but withheld specific security measures for reasons of security.
For security reasons, I will not go into the specific protective measures.
Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt ga ik niet in op de specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over vrouwenonderdrukking

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about oppression of women in marriages with migrants, including a case where a woman was killed shortly after arriving, and about isolation of partners of knowledge migrants. The government says such practices are unacceptable, points to the action agenda on harmful practices and the Rotterdam pilot, but declines a national study and says it cannot bar sponsors from bringing partners under EU family reunification rules.
Because every case of forced isolation is one too many, it has not been chosen to set up a national study into the extent of forced isolation of marriage migrants.
Omdat elk geval van gedwongen isolement er één te veel is, wordt er niet voor gekozen om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar de omvang van gedwongen isolement van huwelijksmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz–Zegerius over het bericht ‘Zussen kroongetuige Nabil B. halen uit: ‘Arrestatie Taghi voor ons te laat’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the family of crown witness Nabil B. had a security plan before testimony and after his brother's murder, and whether crown-witness protection rules should be professionalised. The Minister replied that security measures were taken for family members as needed, that operational details cannot be disclosed for their safety, and that a working group is exploring broader crown-witness arrangements to be reported by Q3 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Wassenberg en Van Esch over een alomvattend aanvalsplan om het risico op toekomstige overspringende zoönotische infectieziekten drastisch te verkleinen

MPs Ouwehand, Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about zoonotic disease risks, intensive livestock farming, wildlife trade, deforestation and a comprehensive action plan to reduce spillover risk. The ministers answered that risks are recognised and managed through the Dutch zoonosis structure, but declined to commit to new bans, a dedicated action plan or additional wildlife-trade enforcement, saying existing measures are sufficient.
The cabinet will continue to work to keep the risks as small as possible or make them smaller.
Het kabinet zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat de risico's zo klein mogelijk zijn of kleiner worden.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Wilders over de demonstratie van afgelopen maandag

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security to send the complete app exchange between the minister and the Amsterdam mayor about a demonstration before a parliamentary debate that afternoon. The minister's response is a reference to a separate letter answering the request, with no substance in this item itself.

Will you send the complete app exchange between the Minister of Justice and Security and the Amsterdam mayor about last Monday's demonstration to the House before the plenary debate on the coronavirus developments begins at 14:00 this afternoon?

Wilt u voor het begin van het plenaire debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus hedenmiddag 14.00 uur de complete app-wisseling tussen de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en de burgemeester van Amsterdam inzake de demonstratie van afgelopen maandag naar de Kamer sturen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Özütok en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Van 2 uitvaarten per week naar 2 per dag: uitvaartondernemer Marjan Damen draait overuren’

MPs asked the ministers about reports that funeral directors were overstretched by rising COVID-19 deaths, including capacity in mortuaries, the role of Defence and coordination, protective equipment, coffin supply and Islamic and Jewish burial rights. The minister answered that the sector is coping, that a coordination point and Defence support can be arranged if needed, that mortuary and coffin capacity is sufficient with contingency plans, and that burial options exist.
I indeed receive questions from the funeral sector about the Corona crisis, including about the cabinet's measures and RIVM guidelines.
Ik ontvang inderdaad vragen uit de uitvaartsector over de Corona-crisis, waaronder ook over de maatregelen van het kabinet en de richtlijnen van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het bericht ‘Amsterdams homokoppel uitgescholden en bespuugd’

MPs Bergkamp, Van den Hul and Özütok asked the Justice Minister about a reported homophobic attack in Amsterdam, underreporting of hate crime, the use of specialised discrimination detectives, and the training of police officers on discrimination. Minister Grapperhaus said such discrimination is unacceptable, announced a publicity campaign and a national police coordination function, but rejected creating specialised hate crime units and left the police training curriculum largely unchanged.
I intend to conclude this process with a public campaign aimed at the willingness of LHBTI people to report and file complaints.
Ik ben voornemens dit traject af te ronden met een publiekscampagne gericht op de meldings- en aangiftebereidheid van LHBTI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een toename van geweld door verwarde personen

An MP asked whether violence by people with psychological problems has increased during the coronavirus crisis, its causes, and the status of a Trimbos Institute study. The government answered that no increase in violence by this group can be established, though police reports of disturbances involving confused persons have risen, and it promised to share forthcoming research results with parliament.
As soon as the results of these studies are available, I will share them with the House.
Zodra de opbrengsten van deze onderzoeken beschikbaar zijn zal ik deze met Uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Kwint over het bericht 'FunX-dj stopte met Ramadan late Night: 'Niet alleen ik werd met dood bedreigd''

MPs El Yassini and Kwint asked whether the government considers it unacceptable that a FunX DJ needed protection and stopped his Ramadan programme after death threats, and what is being done about press safety. The minister calls the threats unacceptable, says the programme ended for editorial reasons, declines to comment on a criminal investigation, and points to existing press-safety initiatives such as PersVeilig and a protocol with police and prosecutors.
Freedom of expression and press freedom are a great good and an important pillar of our society in a democratic constitutional state like the Netherlands.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid zijn in een democratische rechtsstaat als Nederland een groot goed en een belangrijke pijler van onze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een radioprogramma stopt na doodsbedreigingen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a public radio programme ending after death threats was acceptable, whether the Stuurgroep Agressie en Geweld tegen Journalisten had been contacted, whether police protection was adequate, and whether the affected staff had been offered help. The minister called the threats unacceptable, said the broadcaster decided to end the programme for editorial reasons, reported contact with the NPO and PersVeilig, and stated that staff had not reported feeling unsafe.
Freedom of expression and press freedom are a great good and an important pillar of our society in a democratic constitutional state like the Netherlands.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid zijn in een democratische rechtsstaat als Nederland een groot goed en een belangrijke pijler van onze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over richtlijnen voor begrafenissen en kerkdiensten

MP Van der Staaij asks why large department stores may admit hundreds of visitors while religious services and funerals are capped at 30 people, and on what basis the restrictions are justified. The minister answers that stores are not closed by government and may operate under 1.5-metre rules, that the 30-person cap for services and funerals will be reviewed for 100 persons from 1 July on OMT advice, and that the measures will be placed on temporary legislation rather than emergency ordinances.
In a state governed by the rule of law, emergency ordinances cannot last too long, partly in view of the ongoing consequences for everyone's freedoms and fundamental rights.
In een rechtstaat kunnen noodverordeningen niet te lang duren, mede met het oog op de voortdurende gevolgen voor de vrijheden en grondrechten van eenieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de juridische basis van de beperkende maatregelen tegen verspreiding van het Coronavirus en de gevolgen van de opgelegde boetes

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the legal basis of COVID-19 emergency ordinances, whether fines for breaching distancing rules and the resulting criminal record could affect VOG certificates, and related enforcement concerns. The government answered that a temporary statute will replace the ordinances to strengthen democratic legitimacy, that a single COVID fine would generally not block a VOG, and that enforcement follows a set framework with warnings first.
With legislation in the formal sense, democratic legitimacy is strengthened.
Met wetgeving in formele zin wordt de democratische legitimatie versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het kraakbeleid

An MP asks the Justice Minister why police did not intervene during a squatting of a house on Stadhouderskade in Amsterdam, whether Amsterdam is ignoring the squatting ban, and what the national government will do. The minister answers that local police priorities are for the local triangle, that Amsterdam denies any standing instruction not to intervene, that there is no basis for national intervention, and that Amsterdam has tightened enforcement.
It is further up to the local triangle whether and to what extent the police act when a property is or has been squatted.
Het is verder aan de lokale driehoek, of en in hoeverre de politie optreedt wanneer een pand gekraakt is of wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de mishandeling van honden, in training bij leden van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Politiehonden Vereniging (KNPV)

An MP asked the ministers about abuse of dogs in training by members of the KNPV police dog association, shown on television, and whether trainers would be prosecuted, banned from keeping dogs, and whether training should be brought under government control. The ministers answered that an investigation is ongoing, a standalone dog-keeping ban bill is being prepared, police buys mostly from KNPV-affiliated private schools, and they declined to make training a regulated profession or bring it fully under government.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police have started a criminal investigation.
Het OM en de politie zijn een opsporingsonderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over het programma Undercover in Nederland inzake de training van politiehonden

MPs Graus and Helder asked about an SBS6 Undercover broadcast showing alleged mistreatment of police dogs during training, and whether the KNPV and police should act. The Minister of Justice replied that animal abuse is a criminal offence, an investigation is ongoing so no details can be given, police will stop buying from abusive trainers, and stricter supervision and purchase contracts are being explored.
The public prosecution service and the police have started a criminal investigation, as with every report of animal abuse.
Het OM en de politie zijn een opsporingsonderzoek gestart, zoals bij iedere melding van dierenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtspraak in tijden van coronacrisis

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked how the judiciary during the COVID-19 crisis can resume physical hearings, reduce case backlogs, adjust financing and protect indebted citizens. The ministers answer that hearings resume from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, that backlogs will be addressed without yet presenting a plan, and that they will examine the proposed changes to police-judge powers and evaluate emergency measures later.
In our letter of 23 April we indicated that courthouses can also be opened outside office hours and hold hearings.
In onze brief van 23 april jl. hebben we aangegeven dat er de mogelijkheid is om gerechtsgebouwen ook buiten kantoortijden te openen en zittingen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen inzake fundamentele rechten in het strafrecht

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about fundamental procedural rights in criminal law during COVID-19 measures, including phone-only lawyer consultation, video hearings, detainee access to hearings, public access to trials, and cell placement. The ministers largely answered that rights are safeguarded, that measures are proportionate and temporary, and that they are monitoring and adjusting practice, while committing to some reviews and expansions.
In taking all measures, the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights are safeguarded, subject to the restrictions arising from the necessary public health measures.

Bij het treffen van alle maatregelen worden de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten geborgd met in achtneming van de beperkingen die voortvloeien uit de noodzakelijke maatregelen ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het verbieden van samenkomsten buiten de publieke ruimte

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a ban on gatherings outside public space, under COVID-19 emergency ordinances, unduly intrudes on private life and the home, and how it fits Articles 10 and 12 of the Constitution and Article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that the ban rests on public health law, that proportionality and judicial review by courts apply case by case, and that temporary formal legislation with safeguards is planned.
Ultimately it is up to the criminal or administrative court to judge the ban and whether enforcement in a concrete situation affects the private sphere.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de strafrechter of de bestuursrechter om te oordelen over het verbod en of het optreden in een concrete situatie de persoonlijke levenssfeer raakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de extreem-rechtse organisatie Feuertag Division

MP Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about the extreme-right group Feuertag Division, including reports it is led from the Netherlands, plans to attack politicians and spread COVID-19, and what the government will do about it. Minister Grapperhaus largely declined to comment on ongoing cases, citing OM, police and AIVD policy, and described the threat in general terms and the existing local, persons-focused approach.
The OM, the National Police nor the General Intelligence and Security Service make statements about ongoing cases or not.
Het OM, de Nationale Politie noch de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst doet mededelingen over al dan niet lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Politie waarschuwt voor vals geld met carnaval, mogelijk via AliExpress gekocht'

MPs Aartsen and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about police warnings on counterfeit 50-euro notes possibly bought via AliExpress, and what is being done about such platforms and fraud. The minister answers that counterfeit sales are illegal and monitored by customs, police and DNB, that DNB has asked several Dutch parties to stop offering unauthorised reproductions, that a meeting with Alibaba is pending, and that public information already exists so no extra campaign is planned.
I therefore cannot report (monthly) on the offer on an individual platform.
Ik kan daarom niet (maandelijks) rapporteren over het aanbod op een individueel platform.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Europees Parlement pleit voor een noodfonds voor overzeese gebieden’

An MP asked the ministers whether the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom have applied for, and how they would access, a possible EU emergency fund for overseas territories adopted in a European Parliament resolution. The government replied that no such fund exists yet since the Commission has not acted on the call, but that the Commission has redirected existing funds (about EUR 10 million via RESEMBID and access to the B-envelope), and that the Kingdom is working to facilitate access.
The European Commission has so far not acted on this call.
De Europese Commissie (de Commissie) heeft tot op heden geen gevolg gegeven aan deze oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de aanhoudende intimidatie van vrouwen buiten abortusklinieken

MP Ploumen asked ministers why intimidation of women outside abortion clinics continues despite earlier debates and motions, and what measures are being taken, including whether municipalities have sufficient powers, buffer zones, group bans, and criminal law changes. The government answers that it finds such intimidation undesirable but that demonstration rights are constitutionally protected, that municipalities report sufficient powers under the Wom, that criminal law can address misconduct, and that it will keep consulting municipalities and clinics and inform parliament annually without proposing legislative change.
Municipalities have indicated that they have sufficient powers to steer the demonstrations in the right direction.
Gemeenten hebben aangeven dat zij over genoeg bevoegdheden beschikken om de demonstraties in goede banen te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen overde gevolgen van de Luanda Leaks voor Nederlandse bedrijven en beleid

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the consequences of the Luanda Leaks for Dutch firms and policy, including trust offices, Dutch shell companies, consultancy due diligence and anti-corruption enforcement. The minister answered most questions substantively but declined to say whether investigations are ongoing, citing the prosecution service and FIOD procedures, and promised to study trust-sector evasion and the government procurement leverage.
I cannot go into questions concerning what the Public Prosecution Service, the FIOD and supervisors are doing in terms of (whether or not) ongoing investigations.
Ik kan niet ingaan op vragen die zien op hetgeen door het OM, de FIOD en toezichthouders wordt gedaan in de zin van (al dan niet) lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het controleren van de Nederlandse grenzen inzake de coronacrisis

Two MPs from FvD asked the Health and Justice ministers how Dutch border controls operate during the COVID-19 crisis, including checks on arrivals, flight bans, and border checks with Germany and Belgium. The government answered that policy aims to control COVID-19 maximally, that travellers from high-risk countries must quarantine for 14 days, that border checks are sample-based and arrival numbers are not tracked, and that no land-border controls or travel bans are currently needed.
Insight into the number of persons travelling from abroad to the Netherlands cannot be provided.
Inzicht in het aantal personen dat vanuit het buitenland naar Nederland reist, is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma  over de aangenomen noodwet van de Hongaarse president Orbán

Two D66 MPs asked the Dutch ministers about Hungary's emergency law allowing rule by decree without time limit and criminal penalties for disinformation, and what the Netherlands would do regarding rule of law. The government called the Hungarian law worrying, said it raised rule-of-law concerns, and described raising it with Hungary, in the Foreign Affairs Council, through the Article 7 procedure, conditionality in the EU budget and the annual rule-of-law review.
The cabinet finds the steps taken by the Hungarian government and parliament worrying.
Het kabinet vindt de door de Hongaarse regering en parlement gezette stappen verontrustend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over een terugkeerder uit Somalië

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister about a terror suspect returned from Oman to the Netherlands, including how he was brought back, what charges apply, and how the risk he poses will be managed. The minister refused to discuss case details because of the ongoing criminal case, but explained the general policy on controlled return, prosecution, and possible citizenship withdrawal.
Because of the ongoing criminal case against this person, I cannot go into the details of this specific case.
In verband met de lopend strafzaak naar deze persoon kan ik niet ingaan op de details van deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het testen van politieagenten op corona

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether police officers, boa's and enforcement staff know they can be tested for COVID-19 after work incidents, whether testing is available without a spitting or coughing incident, and whether GGD capacity suffices. The minister answered that information is provided through internal channels, that testing is possible after a work incident or with symptoms on advice of the occupational doctor, that testing is being broadened from 18 May and 1 June, and that GGD capacity is sufficient.

That is why it has been agreed that professionals in enforcement and supervision (including police officers, boa's and other enforcers) can also be tested if a work incident (spitting, coughing, resuscitation, fight or forcible arrest) has possibly exposed them to infection.

Daarom is afgesproken dat professionals in handhaving en toezicht (waaronder o.a. agenten, boa’s en andere handhavers) ook getest kunnen worden als zij door een incident tijdens het werk (spugen, hoesten, reanimatie, vechtpartij of aanhouding met geweld) een mogelijke besmetting hebben opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de (sociale) advocatuur

An MP asks the Justice ministers how the Covid-19 crisis affects the legal aid sector, including advance payment schemes, arrests and piket calls, lawyers' income, and whether court scheduling takes lawyers' agendas into account. The minister answers that an extra advance payment scheme and related measures are in place, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand monitors case numbers per field, and that further targeted measures may follow.
Your House will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Uw Kamer zal hierover zo spoedig mogelijk nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Canada en Nederland testen trans-Atlantische vluchten zonder paspoort’

D66 MPs asked about a Canada-Netherlands pilot testing passport-free transatlantic travel via facial recognition and a digital traveller identity, including its origins, necessity, duration, privacy safeguards, data use and function creep. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot is voluntary, governed by a data protection impact assessment, will be evaluated and shared with parliament, but gave only general or deferred answers on several points and no firm plans for other countries.
The outcomes and evaluation of the test will be published and I will share them with your House.
De uitkomsten en evaluatie van de test worden gepubliceerd en deel ik met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Justitie wil coronahoesters verplicht laten testen of ze willen of niet'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice whether suspects who spit or cough on victims while claiming to have COVID-19 can be compelled to submit to testing, and whether the Besluit bloedtest in strafzaken should be amended. Minister Grapperhaus answered that COVID-19 was not yet listed, that he is willing and intends to amend the decree to allow compulsory testing, and that the charge depends on the circumstances.
For this reason, the relevant laws and regulations, including the Besluit bloedtest in strafzaken in geval van een ernstige besmettelijke ziekte, will be amended accordingly.
Daarom wordt de relevante wet- en regelgeving, waaronder het Besluit bloedtest in strafzaken in geval van een ernstige besmettelijke ziekte, hierop aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de zaak Julio Poch

An MP from D66 asks the Justice Minister why the Machielse inquiry into the Julio Poch case is taking so long, whether a deadline will be set, who destroyed a travel report, whether the second travel report will be disclosed under Article 68 of the Constitution, and related archive questions. The Minister says the inquiry needs room to work, the travel report could not be found but other documents were recovered and handed to the inquiry, and he declines further public disclosure of documents for now while promising a progress update in June.
However, I am of the opinion that the Committee Dossier J.A. Poch must first be given room to carry out its investigation.
Ik ben echter van mening dat de Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch nu eerst de ruimte moet krijgen om haar onderzoek uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de dwangsom bij niet tijdig beslissen door de overheid

SP MPs asked whether the government should decide on time, whether the penalty-for-delay (dwangsom) regime still works as intended, why the Tax Administration has a different regime, and how much penalties were paid out in 2015-2019 per organisation. The minister agreed timely decisions matter, reported the regime has a preventive effect with some side effects, explained the Tax Administration's separate rules, and gave incomplete, non-uniform payment figures while noting the IND's sharp rise.
It turned out that these figures are not kept everywhere or in a uniform way.
Gebleken is dat deze cijfers niet overal en niet uniform worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Toorenburg over de uitspraak van het Kifid: ‘Softdrug niet illegaal, schade door beroving wel gedekt’

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether preparatory acts for soft-drug dealing are punishable, and how to respond to a Kifid complaints-body ruling that a robbery-related damage claim was covered and soft drugs were not illegal. The minister confirmed that preparatory acts for soft-drug trade are punishable under the Opium Act when commercial or large-quantity, but declined to comment on or engage with Kifid's individual ruling, citing its independence.
I do not intervene in the assessment of Kifid rulings in individual disputes.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van uitspraken van Kifid in individuele geschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vastlopen van de rechtspraak

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why the courts were stalling, whether the government knew the figures before the debate, what it would do to shorten case durations and how it would better inform victims. The ministers answered that the capacity shortfall was foreseen, that an internal analysis showed a backlog and that a joint OM-judiciary analysis and extra measures were underway, while acknowledging victims suffer from delays and agreeing to explore proactive victim updates.
We consider this a good suggestion and will consult with the OM on how this can be shaped.
Wij vinden dit een goede suggestie en gaan met het OM in overleg hoe dit vormgegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Dam en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker: we moeten meer begrip hebben voor ‘morele verwondingen’ bij ex-militairen’

MPs Van Dam and Van Raak asked the Justice and Security Minister about moral injury among police and ex-military and about PTSD compensation for police officers, including restschade procedures, the Beroepsincidenten Regeling, and volunteer police. The minister answered in detail on the current compensation and procedural framework, acknowledged difficulties in the process and promised a reform of the system, while not addressing moral injury beyond a definition.

Within the framework of improving the system for occupational diseases, occupational incidents and service accidents, the system of compensation for pain and suffering and residual damage is being revised.
In het kader van de verbetering van het stelsel beroepsziekten, beroepsincidenten en dienstongevallen wordt het systeem van smartengeld en restschade herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren in Bladel krijgen massaal drugsbrieven: ‘Mijn cliënt zoekt ruimte voor hennepplanten”
