MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about fake drug-crime letters sent to farmers in Bladel and whether similar letters circulate elsewhere, and about reporting channels and vacant farm buildings. The minister says the letters were part of a municipal awareness campaign, that similar initiatives exist nationwide, and that reporting is possible via police and Meld Misdaad Anoniem, while promising to inform parliament on the broader offensive later.
A clear picture of the precise extent is lacking, but it can be assumed that such practices occur throughout the country.
Een duidelijk en helder beeld over de precieze omvang ontbreekt, maar aangenomen kan worden dat dit soort praktijken in het hele land voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Getraumatiseerde agenten die schade claimen jarenlang ‘juridisch tegengewerkt’ door de politie’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that police-officer PTSS claimants were legally obstructed by the police, including the role of the 'Buitensporigheid' commission, its composition and funding, and why few cases were judged excessive. The minister answered that the commission advises the insurer (and the police) on whether incidents are excessive under case law, that it has few mandates or formal rules beyond that, and that the police and insurer share a law firm and no difference in treatment has been found.
Within the framework of improving the system for occupational diseases, occupational incidents and service accidents, the position of the commission is being examined.
In het kader van de verbetering van het stelsel beroepsziekten, beroepsincidenten en dienstongevallen wordt de positie van de commissie bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over politieagenten met PTSS

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police officers with PTSD, including the independence of the Achmea-funded Buitensporigheid commission, the handling of complaints, reports of the police opposing claims through lawyers, and forced resignations. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the commission is needed for expertise, that a independent police ombudsman was installed in January 2020, that the compensation system is being revised, and that no concrete evidence of forced resignations was found.
Since 1 January 2020 an independent police ombudsman has been installed.
Er is sinds 1 januari 2020 een onafhankelijke ombudsfunctionaris voor de politie geïnstalleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Toegang tot politieopleiding te krap afgesteld’

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that access to police training is too restricted, given the plan to recruit 17,000 officers, and about entry routes, a pilot evaluation and a transitional career-path rule. The Minister says the training is being shortened and reviewed, the entry test for candidates without a regular vooropleiding is still in force but barely used, the pilot report is still a draft, and the transitional rule is aimed at serving staff rather than returners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het afschermen van de gegevens van advocaten in het kadaster

An MP asked whether lawyers' addresses in the land registry (Kadaster) can be shielded for safety, and whether this should be made easier. The minister answered that shielding is possible under article 37a of the Kadasterbesluit only for persons in the protection system, that the current openness will remain, and that no simplification is planned.
No, I do not share this view. The current practice of openness of cadastral information provided by the Kadaster will remain as it is.
Nee deze mening deel ik niet. De huidige praktijk van openbaarheid van kadasterinformatie (informatieverstrekking) van het Kadaster zal zo blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Justitie laat het bedrijfsleven lelijk in de steek bij corruptiezaken'

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister about reports that Dutch prosecutors leave companies exposed in corruption cases, including how many firms were prosecuted or settled, whether Dutch anti-corruption law is fragmented or outdated, and how it compares with UK and French law. Minister Grapperhaus answered that exact counts are unavailable, about five firms settled in five years, Dutch law is adequate and needs no modernisation now, though a judicial review of high transactions is being introduced.
An exact figure for the number of criminal cases in which prosecution was instituted cannot be given.
Een exact cijfer van het aantal strafzaken waarin vervolging is ingesteld niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Een schriftelijke wilsverklaring is nog geen euthanasieverzoek’

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij asked the health and justice ministers about an article arguing that a written advance euthanasia declaration is not a concrete request, and about verification, the role of the Regional Review Committees, and transparency of closed case files. Minister De Jonge answered that a written request can replace an oral one only if it is explicit and concrete, that other due-diligence rules still apply, that the Supreme Court case on dementia verification precludes substantive comment for now, and that the fourth evaluation will examine transparency.
I therefore consider it appropriate to exercise restraint in responding substantively until the Supreme Court's judgment is known.
Mij past daarom terughoudendheid om hier inhoudelijk op te reageren tot het oordeel van de Hoge Raad bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Buitenweg over de berichtgeving ‘Ook in Nederland gezichtsherkenning met omstreden programma Clearview‘

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch public or semi-public bodies used Clearview AI's facial recognition software, whether it is compatible with GDPR and human rights, and related questions. The minister said he was not aware of any Dutch government use or agreements with Clearview, that the police had confirmed no contact or purchases, and that the Interior Minister would look further and inform parliament, with separate letters on facial recognition promised.

The Minister of the Interior stated during the Digitalisation committee meeting of 11 March that he would examine more broadly whether government bodies use or have used Clearview and inform the House.

De Minister van BZK heeft tijdens het AO Digitalisering van 11 maart jl. op vragen van het lid Verhoeven toegezegd breder bij de overheid te bezien of er gebruik wordt of is gemaakt van Clearview en uw Kamer hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Neergestoken taxichauffeur knokt voor gerechtigheid'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how a suspect released after an assessment by the Opvang Verwarde Personen (OVP) could later stab a taxi driver while fully insane, who was responsible, whether the driver received compensation, and whether the taxi driver was warned. The Minister answered that the OVP found insufficient grounds for detention, that police cannot inform taxi drivers about passengers for privacy reasons, and that the victim may apply to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, without discussing the individual case in detail.
I cannot go into an individual case. Civil proceedings are also still ongoing.
Ik kan niet op een individuele zaak ingaan. Ook lopen de civiele procedures nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het niet kunnen vervolgen van Syriëgangers

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether a court's refusal to continue prosecuting a Syria returnee who is not in the Netherlands means serious crimes go unpunished, and whether government policy on repatriation will change. The government answered that the court has postponed its decision to 2 June 2020, that courts judge each case on its circumstances, and that it is studying the effects of the ruling and will inform the House if policy changes.
If the current policy changes, the House will be informed about this.
Indien verandering van het huidige beleid plaatsvindt, zal de Kamer hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de betrokkenheid van de minister bij een mogelijke megaschikking met Shell voor corruptie in Nigeria

MP Van Nispen asked why the Minister of Justice referred earlier questions about his involvement in a possible Shell settlement over Nigerian corruption to documents published under the Wob, and asked for direct answers. The Minister replied that the documents were already public, that Wob and the information right under Article 68 of the Constitution are a separate matter, and that he was briefed by the Public Prosecution Service on the criminal investigation, but cannot discuss the content of those briefings because the investigation is ongoing.
Because the criminal investigation in this case is ongoing, I cannot make statements about the content of what was discussed.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze zaak lopende is, kan ik over de inhoud van het besprokene geen uitlatingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de beantwoording tijdens het mondelinge vragenuur van dinsdag 18 februari 2020 over het bericht ‘Meeste antisemitische incidenten in Nederland in dertig ja

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Segers asked the Justice Minister to explain his remarks in parliament that a 2019 Albert Cuyp market stabbing and the 2017 HaCarmel restaurant vandalism were antisemitic/terrorist-related, despite prosecutors and courts finding no discriminatory or terrorist motive. The minister answered that he meant to keep open the possibility of an antisemitic motive, that the word 'aanslag' expressed victims' feelings, and outlined measures such as the Jewish police network and the prosecution's expertise centre to improve recognition of antisemitism.
I made my statement in answer to a question from MP Van Dijk, who asked how I would ensure that every report of antisemitism would be taken seriously.
Ik deed mijn uitspraak in antwoord op een vraag van het Kamerlid Van Dijk, die vroeg hoe ik ervoor ging zorgen dat elke melding van antisemitisme serieus zou worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over gevaarlijke honden

Two MPs asked whether a mayor can neutralise a dangerous dog and whether a mayor may have a biting dog euthanised, and whether a dog-keeping ban should be created for owners of repeatedly aggressive dogs. The government answers that mayors have existing powers under the Gemeentewet, local bylaws and bestuursdwang, that euthanasia is only possible in extreme cases after seizure, and that a standalone dog-keeping ban is being prepared with the Justice Minister.
In addition, a bill is being prepared with the Minister of Justice and Security to introduce a dog-keeping ban as a standalone measure.
In aanvulling hierop wordt in samenwerking met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid een wetsvoorstel voorbereid waarmee een houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel wordt geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘het ontbreken van een meldpunt voor slachtoffers en familieleden van sektes’

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why the Sektesignaal reporting point for cult victims was discontinued, and whether it would be restored. The minister denied that victims are poorly served, stated that Sektesignaal was only a referral service, commissioned a WODC study, and refused to restore the reporting point.
Following the Van Nispen motion, I have asked the WODC to conduct a study examining whether ending the subsidy to Sektesignaal has created a gap in the available instruments.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Van Nispen heb ik het WODC verzocht een onderzoek uit te voeren waarbij bezien wordt of het beëindigen van de subsidie aan Sektesignaal heeft geleid tot een lacune
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de tolkcontactapp

MP Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the Tolkcontact app enabling deaf and hard-of-hearing people to reach 112, covering costs, tourists, chat options and a UK silent-solution system. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the app and Total Conversation software are available, insurance may cover costs, the police are developing a free 112 app expected in autumn 2020, and no UK-style system is planned.
I regard good accessibility and availability of emergency communication between emergency services and citizens as an important task.
Ik zie goede bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van noodhulpcommunicatie tussen de hulpdiensten en burgers als een belangrijke taak.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verkoop van nazi-boeken op Bol.com

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Bol.com's sale of Nazi-era books (by Streicher, Rosenberg, Himmler) is unacceptable, whether it is punishable, whether a complaint was filed, and whether the Jewish community should be consulted. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the sale is highly undesirable, that criminal liability depends on case-by-case assessment, that a complaint was filed against Bol.com and the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that he consulted the Central Jewish Consultation.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide whether prosecution will follow.
Het is aan het OM om te beslissen of er tot vervolging wordt over gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het weigeren door Knab van religieuze organisaties als zakelijke klant

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked whether Knab's policy of refusing religious organisations as business clients complies with Dutch and European anti-discrimination and anti-money-laundering rules, and what can be done for those affected. The government answered that the Wwft does not allow refusing a whole category of clients without an individual risk assessment, that assessing discrimination is not for the cabinet, and that affected organisations can use the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, anti-discrimination bodies, courts or Kifid.
Under the Wwft, banks are not permitted to refuse an entire type of organisation as a client across the board.
Het is banken op grond van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme (Wwft) niet toegestaan om een bepaald type organisatie integraal als klant te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de noodzaak van het uitbreiden van de lijst met vitale beroepen met dierenartsen en dierverzorgers

MP Wassenberg asked whether veterinarians and animal carers should be added to the government's list of critical occupations during COVID-19, citing staff shortages at shelters and animal care organisations. Minister Schouten replied that the list is deliberately kept narrow to limit exceptions to measures, that veterinary work for the food chain is covered, that animal carers are not listed but local solutions should be sought, and that she is monitoring the situation in consultation with sector bodies.
The list of critical occupations and vital processes has been kept limited in order to restrict the spread of COVID-19 as much as possible.
De lijst met cruciale beroepen en vitale processen is beperkt gehouden om de verspreiding van COVID-19 zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Sneller en Groothuizen over de implementatie van noodverordeningen ten behoeve van de ‘intelligente lockdown’

MPs Den Boer, Sneller and Groothuizen asked why the legal basis for new COVID-19 'intelligent lockdown' measures was not communicated, why emergency ordinances took days to draft, whether enforcement before legal force was lawful, and when the ordinances will be withdrawn. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the legal bases were in the Minister of Health's directive to safety regions, acknowledged the omission for future letters, defended announcing measures before the ordinances existed, explained the drafting complexity, and said the measures stay in force until the health minister's directive is withdrawn, with review before 28 April.
In future, care will be taken that these legal bases are also stated when informing the House.
In het vervolg zal erop worden gelet dat deze grondslagen ook worden vermeld bij het informeren van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Ondernemers durven politie niet in te schakelen en zwijgen over afpersing‘

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked about reports that entrepreneurs do not report extortion to police, including how many reported cases and advice-line contacts exist and what will be done to raise reporting and protection. Minister Grapperhaus answered with registration figures, advice-line statistics, outreach efforts and a promise to inform the Chamber further on a public-private approach.
I am consulting with partners on how reports from entrepreneurs can be handled in an accessible and safe way.
Ik ga met partners in overleg over hoe meldingen van ondernemers op een toegankelijke en veilige manier kunnen worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een-tweetjes tussen ministers en Kamerleden en onenigheid daarover tussen ministers

An SP MP asked whether a TV-and-press plan by a VVD justice spokesperson, offered to the minister of his own party, was an appropriate one-to-one arrangement, and whether the minister represents the government or his party. The minister answered that MPs may appear in the media, that the ministry only gave a general reply to a press inquiry, and that ministers must respect collective government policy and not announce plans outside agreed policy.
Ministers, as members of the government, observe the unity of government policy (Article 45, paragraph 3, of the Constitution).
Ministers nemen als lid van de regering de eenheid van het regeringsbeleid in acht (artikel 45, derde lid, Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de berichtgeving omtrent de bewapening van boa’s

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the role of buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren (boas) in enforcing COVID-19 emergency measures, their equipment, cooperation with police, radio communication, the possibility of arming them with pepper spray, training, and the progress of a motion on the future of policing. The minister answered that enforcement powers were extended via regulation, equipment is primarily the employers' responsibility, weapons are granted case by case, and the motion is being pursued with the WRR.
The theme of cooperation between boas and the police is part of the policy and implementation agenda to be formed.
Het thema samenwerking tussen boa`s met de politie is onderdeel van de te vormen beleids- en uitvoeringsagenda
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Kuiken over het artikel ‘Burgemeesters roepen na gewelddadig weekeinde op tot messenverbod voor minderjarigen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about mayors' calls for a knife ban for minors after violent incidents, including the effectiveness of the ban on certain knives, licence numbers, consultations with police and mayors, and whether the ban on carrying knives should be tightened. The Minister said effectiveness cannot be measured, reported seven knife-collector exemptions and three refusals, defended the existing general carrying prohibition, and promised to inform parliament of the consultation outcomes in spring.
As promised during the aforementioned question hour and in the letter of 3 February, I will inform your House of the outcomes in the spring.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het genoemde vragenuur en in de brief van 3 februari informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Overheid voor rechter om etnische profileren: ‘Zo vernederend dat je kleur bepalend is’

An MP asked about reports of ethnic profiling by the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee (KMar) at Eindhoven Airport, including the use of ethnicity as a risk indicator in mobile border checks, its proportionality, complaints and evaluations. The government answered that ethnicity is never a standalone indicator and is used only with other objective indicators, that no legal changes are needed, and that complaints are handled through an independent committee while evaluations and optimisation of profiling methods continue.
Ethnicity is never a standalone risk factor, but is always applied as an indicator in combination with other indicators.
Etniciteit is nooit een op zichzelf staande risicofactor, maar wordt als indicator altijd in combinatie met andere indicatoren toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de betrouwbaarheid en volledigheid van zelfonderzoek door eigen advocaten van bedrijven

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether company self-investigations by their own lawyers in criminal fraud cases are reliable, whether the OM keeps track of them, and whether this risks truth-finding. The Minister answered that the OM sets no specific framework, that the FIOD checks and the OM verifies such investigations, that the OM plans to use them more often, and that the risks are adequately mitigated.
The number of criminal investigations in which self-investigations were submitted, and in how many cases this led to sentence reduction, is not registered as such by the OM.

Het aantal strafrechtelijke onderzoekszaken waarbij zelfstandige onderzoeken zijn aangedragen en in hoeveel gevallen dit heeft geleid tot strafvermindering, worden niet als zodanig geregistreerd bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de uitzending ‘WNL op Zaterdag‘ d.d. 7 maart 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert (CDA) asked whether the government is doing enough to collect testimony from Yazidi women and others who suffered under ISIS, so it can be used as evidence in prosecutions. The government answered that it supports NGOs and UN and IIIM mechanisms that collect evidence, stresses victim choice and careful interviewing, and says it is funding Yazda, UNITAD and other programmes, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands is concretely committed to actively reaching the Yazidi community through, among other things, the support mentioned above for Yazda, UNITAD and the IIIM.
Nederland zet concreet in op het actief benaderen van de Jezidi-gemeenschap door onder meer bovengenoemde steun aan Yazda, UNITAD en het IIIM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Kröger en Buitenweg over geweld en seksuele intimidatie in de trein en op het spoor

MPs asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers about sexual harassment in trains and on platforms, including the number of incidents, advice to travellers, cooperation with international carriers and use of expertise from the national sexual violence centre. The government answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers in 2019 but figures may be incomplete, that there is no specific traveller advice beyond general reporting channels, and that NS cooperates internationally and with specialist organisations, with no specific new commitments.
The police currently have no additional figures on sexual harassment specifically in trains and on platforms.
De politie heeft op dit moment geen aanvullende cijfers met betrekking tot seksuele intimidatie specifiek in de trein en op het perron.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over antisemitische uitingen tijdens Ajax-PSV

MPs Kerstens, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Health ministers about antisemitic chants at the Ajax-PSV match, whether they are punishable, why the match was not stopped, whether stadium bans will follow, and the status of the anti-racism action plan. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the chants were condemned, PSV stewards intervened, one person was handed to police and the public prosecutor is reviewing the file, and that the KNVB and partners are implementing the action plan including a persoonsgerichte aanpak and a smart-technology challenge.
No report is known to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Er is geen aangifte bekend bij het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het stakingsrecht van tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice whether interpreters and translators' strike action is understandable given reforms and outdated rates, and whether Openbaar Ministerie letters warning strikers of contract breach are intimidating. The Minister acknowledged concerns, defended the reform as necessary, said the letters were factual reminders that accepted assignments must be honoured, and stated refusing assignments has no effect on business relations.
We will closely monitor the operation of the new system and adjust it further if necessary.
De werking van de nieuwe systematiek zullen we nauwlettend gaan monitoren en verder bijstellen als dat nodig zou blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Agressie tegen verkeersregelaars in Twente neemt toe: we zijn tandeloze tijgers’

An MP asked ministers whether aggression against traffic controllers is rising and whether they fall under the joint police-prosecution agreements on violence against public-task workers, and whether they should get enforcement powers. The minister answers that no registration data exists, that traffic controllers are covered by the agreements, but that giving them special investigative-officer status is not appropriate under the current division of tasks.
There are no registration figures available for the occupational group of traffic controllers on aggression and violence in their sector.
Er zijn geen registratiecijfers beschikbaar van de beroepsgroep verkeersregelaars over agressie en geweld in hun branche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sneller over de lokale noodverordeningen in verband met de bestrijding van het coronavirus

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about the legal basis, decision-making, democratic oversight and publication of local COVID-19 emergency ordinances, and about Latvia's suspension of ECHR rights. The minister acknowledged the omitted legal basis, described the regional chairs' emergency ordinances and the accountability route via municipal councils, and said current measures fit within ECHR limitation clauses.
Omitting the legal basis was an oversight.
Het niet vermelden van de wettelijke grondslag was een omissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Slachtoffers misdrijven willen meer privacy, angst voor wraak daders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that crime victims lack privacy protection and fear reprisals, including why victims are not always told about postal-address or anonymous-filing options. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained the limits of anonymous filing, said a generic anonymisation measure and process fixes are under review, and promised a progress letter in spring 2020.
I committed in that letter to inform the House in spring 2020 about the state of affairs of these actions.
Ik heb in deze brief toegezegd uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2020 te informeren over de stand van zaken van deze acties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weigeren van de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant locatie Breda om gedenkplaten te plaatsen

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the Zeeland-West-Brabant court (Breda location) refuses to install commemorative plaques for Jewish judges murdered in WWII, as exist in Amsterdam and The Hague. The Minister replied that the judiciary independently decides on such memorials, that the court found no evidence of Jewish staff victims in its archives, and that the Minister will not engage the court.
The judiciary has the authority to independently decide whether or not to place a memorial.
De Rechtspraak heeft de bevoegdheid om zelfstandig te beslissen over het al dan niet plaatsen van een gedenkteken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de berichtgeving ‘Zelden rechtszaak na verkrachting’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Justice Minister why sex-crime cases take so long, why many rape reports lead to no prosecution, and about victim care and the Inspectorate's review. The minister acknowledged the long delays and attributed them to complexity and workload, pointed to added police capacity, and said the Inspectorate's findings are expected before summer.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of the investigation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Overheid is te slap tegen witwassen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Justice and Finance Ministers whether the state is too weak against money laundering, citing criticism from the NOB and Transparency International, and questioned FIU capacity (19 FTE), the judicial capacity bottleneck and the implementation of a motion on stricter penalties. The minister replied that capacity has been increased through funding and public-private cooperation, that the extra funds were not used for structural FIU expansion, and that the motion will be considered in an ongoing evaluation of the Wet verruiming mogelijkheden bestrijding financieel-economische criminaliteit.

As also indicated in the progress letter on the money laundering action plan, the implementation of the motion will be taken into account in assessing the outcomes of the ongoing evaluation of the act.
Zoals ook in de voortgangsbrief over het plan van aanpak witwassen is aangegeven, zal de uitvoering van de motie worden betrokken bij de beoordeling van de uitkomsten van de lopende evaluatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Vrijwillig werken bij politie is ook al niet de oplossing’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Den Boer asked the Justice Minister about police volunteers: whether they are used to avoid displacing regular officers, how many there are, whether there is a central competence register, training and waiting lists, and the ideal balance. The Minister answered that volunteers are a valuable addition, that they must not be used to cover capacity shortages, that a Toetsingscommissie monitors displacement, and that the force is working on a national competence portal and expanded training, while providing the figures requested.
However, it is not intended that volunteers be deployed to cover capacity shortages.
Het is evenwel niet de bedoeling dat vrijwilligers worden ingezet om capaciteitstekorten op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Vlaamse verbod op de jacht in het kader van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will, like Flanders, ban hunting and angling during the COVID-19 measures, since trips for these hobbies are no longer considered justified. The minister answered that no additional measures beyond the existing stay-at-home advice are needed, noting hunting is closed until August and population control may continue under strict RIVM rules.
There is no reason to take additional measures for hunting and angling beyond the measures the cabinet has already announced.
Er is geen aanleiding om voor het jagen en het beoefenen van de hengelsport aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, bovenop de maatregelen die het kabinet al heeft afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'OM: verdachten alleen nog aangehouden bij ernstige feiten'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's temporary decision to arrest suspects only for serious offences during the coronavirus crisis, and whether crimes exploiting the crisis require tougher enforcement. The minister explains the scaled-back but continuing operations, stresses that prosecution is postponed rather than dropped, and commits to firm action and fast-track procedures against crisis-related fraud.
The Public Prosecution Service emphasises that this is a temporary working method and that it does not mean prosecution of criminal offences is cancelled, but postponed.
Het OM benadrukt dat het gaat om een tijdelijke werkwijze en dat het niet gaat om afstel van de vervolging van strafbare feiten, maar om uitstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de rechtspleging en de rechtsbescherming

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked how the Corona crisis affects criminal justice and legal protection, including the Public Prosecution Service's restricted approach, the Emergency Justice Act (Noodwet rechtspleging) and suspended community service sentences. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police, prosecutors, probation and courts have scaled back work to priority tasks, that remote legal aid is being organised and extra fees given, that the emergency act is not yet needed but would be decided via the Ministerial Crisis Committee, and that community service terms cannot currently be extended by law.
Applying the Emergency Justice Act is, given the exceptional measures it provides, not an instrument to be used lightly.
Het toepassen van de Noodwet rechtspleging is, mede gelet op de bijzondere voorzieningen die deze wet biedt, geen lichtzinnig in te zetten instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar het e-mailverkeer van maart 2014 tot 9 december 2016 over de uitspraken van de heer Wilders

MP Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether documents from a June 2014 reflection meeting and an August 2014 College of Procurators-General meeting exist, whether the e-mail traffic on the 2016 FOIA request will be released, and whether a dismissal (sepot) was planned for his March 2014 statements and whether former minister Opstelten knew of it. The minister answered that no such meeting documents or dismissal notices were found, that the court is the proper forum for disclosure of material in the pending case, and that the e-mail traffic on the 2016 FOIA request will be provided with confidential annexes made available for inspection.

When asked, the OM takes the position that for a request to disclose information and documents that touch on the content of the pending, and therefore ongoing, criminal case before the Court, the Court is the designated forum.

Desgevraagd stelt het OM zich op het standpunt dat voor een verzoek tot openbaarmaking van informatie en stukken die de inhoud van de bij het Hof aanhangige en dus lopende strafzaak raken, het Hof het aangewezen forum is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de flinke toename van het aantal gestolen of vermiste kentekenplaten

MP Postma asked the ministers about the sharp rise in stolen or missing number plates, including whether duplicated plates should be treated like stolen ones, whether Amsterdam should align with the CJIB, and the status of RFID plate pilots and Danish-style fastening. The minister acknowledged the concern, stated that existing law already covers duplication, described RDW oversight of plate makers, promised a letter to parliament on RFID and fastening, and said the Amsterdam issue is being addressed by the municipality.
Currently I am examining together with the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW whether RFID number plates could be a solution to combat plate fraud.
Momenteel bekijk ik samen met de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW, of de RFID-kentekenplaten een oplossing kunnen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het nieuws dat de politie extra auto’s aanschaft om de pakkans op snelheidsovertredingen te vergroten

Two PVV MPs asked whether police buying extra unmarked cars to catch speeders after the speed limit change is a waste of taxpayer money, and what it costs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the cars replace existing radar vehicles already in the police budget, involve no extra investment, and need no extra capacity, and that enforcement continues as before.
This replacement was already provided for in the police budgets. It is therefore not an extra investment.
Deze vervanging was reeds voorzien in de budgetten van de politie. Het gaat dus niet om een extra investering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de berichten ‘Universiteit Maastricht betaalde hackers losgeld’ en ‘Verzekeraars zorgen voor toename van ransomware-aanvallen’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Maastricht University paid ransomware hackers and that insurers covering ransom payments increase attacks. The minister confirmed awareness, gave 188 reported ransomware cases in 2019 without a breakdown by public institution, said no data exists on how often ransom is paid, and noted paying is expected to encourage attacks while insurers could reduce risk through security requirements.
I have no information on the number of cases in which it was chosen to pay ransomware, or on the various considerations involved in deciding to pay.
Ik heb geen informatie over het aantal gevallen waarin is gekozen ransomeware te betalen, danwel over de verschillende afwegingen die een rol spelen bij het overgaan tot betaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Computer zegt nee. Hoe Saskia twintig jaar vastliep in het systeem'

An SP MP asked ministers about a case in which a citizen was wrongly treated by government bodies over many years and whether she would be compensated and apologised to. The Minister of the Interior replied that a last attempt at a total solution failed, that the police acknowledged fault and apologised, and that he expressed regret in person; no concrete compensation offer was disclosed, citing privacy.
Partly because of the privacy of the person concerned, I am not free to disclose the amount of damages claimed by her and the proposal offered to her.
Het staat mij, mede gelet op de privacy van betrokkene, niet vrij om mededelingen te doen over de omvang van de door mevrouw gevorderde schade en het aan haar aangeboden voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over vrouwelijke slachtoffers van moord en doodslag

MP Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether the government will do more to protect women victims of murder and manslaughter, given that most female victims are killed by a partner or ex-partner, and what measures will improve prevention and training on stalking. The minister acknowledges the problem as serious but not new, points to the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme and stalking-specific measures following an Inspectorate report, and commits to police and ZSM training and regular working visits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten inzake CAF onderzoeken bij de inkomstenbelasting

SP MP Leijten asked about the CAF (Commissie Afzonderlijk Fiscaal?) fraud investigations at the tax authority, including the Hoorn case of tax consultants accused of systemic fraud, the reversed burden of proof, algorithmic risk selection, and remedies for consultants. The state secretary declined to discuss individual cases citing confidentiality, explained that risk signals are only starting points and are checked by staff, noted civil and criminal remedies and the 2019 algorithm oversight report, but did not commit to new measures.
Due to the confidentiality obligation in article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot address the specific circumstances of individual cases.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de concrete omstandigheden van specifieke gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Buitenweg over het interview ‘Politiechef Anja Schouten: Er moet een eerste hulp bij onbegrepen gedrag komen’ en het opinieartikel ‘Laat de politiegeen zorgtaken uitvoeren’

GroenLinks MPs Renkema and Buitenweg asked the state secretary for Health and the Justice minister about police chief Schouten's call for a first-aid response to 'confused behaviour' (E33 reports) and an op-ed against police doing care tasks. The government answered that the problem is multi-faceted and needs regional, personalised solutions, reported E33 incident counts for 2011–2019, and declined to adopt a national model or a mandatory crisis-point in every region.
A single national approach would also not do justice to the complexity of the problem and would leave insufficient room for local customisation.
Eén landelijke aanpak zou ook geen recht doen aan de complexiteit van de problematiek en onvoldoende ruimte bieden voor lokaal maatwerk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van ‘t Wout over het bericht ‘Einde van lintje voor brandweerlieden zorgt voor bittere smaak: “wij zetten een stap naar voren als anderen er een terug doen.”’

MPs Van der Graaf and Van 't Wout asked whether the end of automatic honours for long-serving volunteer firefighters, and the government's refusal to reconsider, undermines recruitment and retention, and whether the Royal Chancery would be consulted. The minister defended the decision, said volunteer firefighters can still be honoured on other grounds and that alternative brigade medals will be officially recognised this year.
I therefore see no reason to enter into discussion about this with the Chancery.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om hierover in gesprek te treden met de Kanselarij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitgifte van dode dieren vanuit vrachtwagens tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP asked the ministers whether the sale of slaughtered animal carcasses from trucks during the Eid al-Adha festival was legal, under what exemption, and how the NVWA supervises it. The government answered that a temporary, generic NVWA permission allowed transport of unchilled carcasses from approved slaughterhouses, with NVWA inspection of slaughter, and that the police tweet's wording was unfortunate.
On the basis of that authority, the NVWA granted a permanent generic permission for transport of not yet chilled carcasses during the Eid festival.
Op grond van die bevoegdheid heeft de NVWA een permanente generieke toestemming verleend voor vervoer van nog niet afgekoelde karkassen tijdens het offerfeest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over een bericht van het Operationeel Centrum van de politie-eenheid Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked why the Den Haag police unit tweeted that selling meat from vans during the Offerfeest was legal, and questioned the NVWA oversight, food safety and equal treatment behind it. The minister explained that the NVWA had granted a permanent general permission for transporting uncooled carcasses, that the tweet was meant to inform the public, and that the controls were sample-based, without committing to any new action.
That regulation also allows the competent authority, in this case the NVWA, to grant permission for transporting meat and delivering it to citizens via (mini) vans.
Deze verordening maakt het ook mogelijk dat de bevoegde autoriteit, in dit geval de NVWA, toestemming verleent voor het vervoer van vlees en aflevering aan burgers via (mini)vrachtwagens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en De Groot over rechtswetenschappelijke onderzoek naar de Habitatrichtlijn en Vogelrichtlijn

MPs Groothuizen and De Groot asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a legal study on domestic cats and the EU Birds and Habitats Directives, including whether cat predation is a significant threat and how permits for trap-neuter-return programmes are handled. The minister answered that cat predation is not shown to significantly affect protected species, that provinces are responsible for permits and nature measures, and that no ban on letting cats roam is considered necessary.
It is not known how many animals are killed by cats in the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel dieren in Nederland door katten worden gedood.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked about reports on the As Soennah mosque advocating female genital mutilation and violence against women, and about the Hague mayor's response to an enforcement request from Femmes for Freedom. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecutor is pursuing incitement charges, that enforcement lies with the mayor in an ongoing procedure, that the TWBMT cannot be applied without terrorism-related conduct, and that the municipality is already in contact with the mosque.
It is therefore not for me to make statements about this now, nor about the existence of limits for the college of mayor and aldermen when it comes to enforcement.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om hierover nu uitspraken te doen, noch over het bestaan van beperkingen voor het college van burgemeesters en wethouders als het gaat om handhavend optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Cartoonist Ruben L. Oppenheimer: “Ik radicaal? Ik hecht aan mijn vrijheid” en het bericht ‘Cartoonisten: “We zijn kanonnenvoer op de eerste ri

Two VVD MPs asked the government about threats against cartoonist Ruben Oppenheimer, apparent foreign pressure from Turkey and China, and whether the state will investigate undue foreign influence. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the reports were noted, that the police are investigating his complaints, that press freedom is protected under the Constitution and existing protocols, and that the government opposes foreign interference but sees no direct link between a Turkish block and threats in the Netherlands.
Mr. Oppenheimer's complaints are known and under investigation by the police.
De aangiften van de heer Oppenheimer zijn bekend en bij de politie in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Exclusief: Interview Citrix CISO, Fermín Sera, waar ging het mis?'

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice minister whether the Citrix vulnerability could have been prevented by timely application of the interim fix, why Dutch government bodies were affected, and whether a legal standoff period before public disclosure should be set. The minister answered that the NCSC advised quickly, government bodies were advised to apply mitigations, no misapplication by government was found, the case is being evaluated, and that a 60-day guideline exists but policy is left to vendors and organisations.
This case is being evaluated on the instructions of the Minister of Justice and Security.
Deze casus wordt geëvalueerd in opdracht van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over straatgeweld en het toenemend aantal steekincidenten

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Education ministers about rising street violence and knife incidents, including data, reporting by victims, camera technology and a plan of action. The minister answered that knife incidents are not separately registered, that targeted analyses are under way with results expected mid-2020, that police see hardening rather than increase in street violence, and that a broader plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2020.
Knife incidents and street violence are not registered as such in the police systems.
Steekincidenten en straatgeweld worden niet als zodanig geregistreerd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over hoe Nederlandse bedrijven een mogelijk zeer schadelijke rol spelen bij uitbuiten van Angola

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers how Dutch companies and shell companies may have helped drain Angolan state funds, and what tools exist to tackle foreign bribery, consultancy oversight, and corporate liability. The government answered that existing criminal law is adequate, that investigations are ongoing and cannot be discussed, that trust-office rules and consultancy regulation are under review, and that it will study a remediation programme for companies.
I cannot make statements about any ongoing investigations.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over eventuele lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over trajectcontroles op de A2

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why answers to earlier written questions on A2 speed trajectory controls took so long, whether analysis supported extending the controls, and whether extension should be suspended until parliament approves. The minister replied that coordination with the prosecution service, police and the infrastructure ministry took time, that pre-extension speed measurements justify the extra sections, and that the power to set control locations lies with the OM, police and Rijkswaterstaat, not parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van der Graaf over levenslanggestraften

MPs Groothuizen and Van der Graaf asked about the National Ombudsman's findings on the prosecution service's advice in a 2017 life-sentence pardon request, the duration of the procedure, the review framework for life sentences and the government's response to NGO submissions to the Council of Europe. The minister maintains the advice was sufficiently substantiated, the review framework complies with the ECHR, no statutory deadlines are needed, and the pardon decision remains a discretionary balancing by the Crown.
I therefore see no need to take measures on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om op dit punt maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Nispen, Kuiken en Van der Graaf over het onderzoekverloop naar de dood van Dascha Graafsma

MPs asked how the second opinion on the cause of Dascha Graafsma's death was set up, how bias was prevented, whether lessons would lead to rule changes, and what the government would do about the family's complaints. The minister answered that a separate police unit runs the forensic second opinion, reviewed by uninvolved prosecutors, that no rule changes are planned, and that the OM apologised and will keep communicating openly.
The OM and police have apologised for earlier communication that too firmly concluded this case was a suicide.
Het OM en politie hebben excuses gemaakt voor eerdere communicatie waarin te stellig werd geconcludeerd dat in deze zaak sprake was van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘de betrokkenheid van de minister bij een mogelijke megaschikking met Shell voor corruptie in Nigeria’

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how often and when he discussed a possible Shell settlement over Nigerian corruption with the Public Prosecution Service, whether this fits the separation of powers, and whether the same treatment applies to others. The minister answers that the prosecution service informed him repeatedly about this sensitive case under its reporting duty, that he cannot discuss the ongoing investigation's substance, and that such briefings are customary for sensitive cases.
As you know, I cannot make substantive statements about individual criminal cases in which the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Zoals bij u bekend, kan ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over individuele strafzaken waarin het strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de mogelijke schikking met Shell

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked whether the Justice Minister discussed a possible settlement with Shell over the Etosha bribery investigation in Nigeria with prosecutors, whether ministry officials pushed for a settlement, why the Royal Household inquired about the case in 2016, and how the Prime Minister assesses Shell's conduct. The Minister answered that he was only informed of the investigation's status, denied requesting or pushing for a settlement, said the 2016 inquiry concerned a planned royal visit and media attention, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal case.
Has the Minister asked the Public Prosecution Service to reach a settlement with Shell? If so, why did you do that and when did you do it?
Heeft de Minister het OM gevraagd een schikking te treffen met Shell? Zo ja, waarom heeft u dat gedaan en wanneer heeft u dat gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Ook ondernemingsraad politie slaat alarm over nieuw communicatienetwerk’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers cannot reliably reach the control room or colleagues on the new C2000 communication network, and why problems persist despite earlier warnings. The minister acknowledged police-specific connectivity problems, described an expanded aftercare team and daily monitoring, and committed to continued work on the network through at least 27 March.
I have myself informed daily about the state of affairs, the number of reports, the number of problems still to be solved and the actions the aftercare team takes.
Ik laat mij persoonlijk dagelijks informeren over de stand van zaken, het aantal meldingen, het aantal op te lossen problemen en de acties die daarop door het nazorgteam worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij WA- en VC-autoverzekeringen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance and Justice ministers about age-based surcharges and age limits in car insurance, citing evidence that older drivers cause less damage yet pay more premiums, and asked whether this is unlawful age discrimination and what action will be taken. The minister said insurers set their own risk models, that insurance is cancellable so consumers can switch, that the government will not judge insurer contracts or prescribe discounts, and that the discrimination question is for civil courts, Kifid or insurers' complaint procedures, not the Human Rights Commission.
It is not for me to assess whether there is unjustified distinction in car insurance.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of er bij autoverzekeringen sprake is van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Hackpoging ziekenhuis Leeuwarden, NCSC vreest aanvallers in meer systemen'

An MP asked the ministers about a hacking attempt at Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden, whether the hospital should have acted on NCSC warnings about Citrix servers, and how the new data-exchange law and other hospitals are affected. The minister answered that hospitals are primarily responsible for their own ICT, supported by Z-CERT, that the MCL did not timely implement mitigating measures and is investigating, and that the law will allow information-security requirements, while declining to say how many hospitals use vulnerable servers.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for their own ICT and which systems and/or servers they use.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen ICT en welke systemen en/of servers zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Tolken en vertalers staken ‘totdat de minister met ons in gesprek gaat’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about interpreters' strike and proposals to open the interpreter register to B2-level interpreters, citing scarcity and quality concerns. The minister answered that the renewed register aims to gain oversight of quality and integrity of all interpreters used by central government, keeps C1 as the norm for mandatory-use organisations, and that he met the action group.
To gain grip on the quality and integrity of all interpreters providing services to central government, a renewed Rbtv will be introduced in which all these interpreters must be registered.
Om grip te krijgen op de kwaliteit en integriteit van alle tolken die diensten verrichten voor de rijksoverheid, komt er een vernieuwd Rbtv, waarin al deze tolken ingeschreven moeten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onvrede en een staking onder tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about dissatisfaction and a strike among interpreters and translators, citing unchanged fees since 1981 and budget cuts threatening legal quality. The minister said the impact of the strike is limited, and announced tendering of all interpreting services with statutory minimum rates, while acknowledging the sector's concerns and promising monitoring and further consultation.
We are therefore moving to tender all interpreting and translation services and introduce minimum rates.
We gaan dan ook over tot het aanbesteden van alle tolk- en vertaaldiensten en de invoering van minimumtarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het vernieuwde communicatienetwerk C2000

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about problems with the renewed C2000 emergency radio network after its migration, including poor reachability, a brief outage in Noord-Holland, and whether safety was adequately planned for. The minister acknowledged start-up problems and a short outage caused by human error, said they were being addressed by a support team and updates, and that full settling of the network will take some time.
As time goes on, the remaining bottlenecks to be resolved will decrease in number and impact until a regular management situation arises.
Naarmate de tijd vordert nemen de nog in te regelen knelpunten in aantal en qua impact af totdat een reguliere beheersituatie ontstaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Dam over het voornemen van de Nationale Politie tot sluiting van de arrestantencomplexen van de politiebureaus van Doetinchem, Deventer, Ede en Tiel

MPs Van der Graaf and Van Dam asked whether the minister would send the external consultancy's future scenarios for closing police cell complexes in Eastern Netherlands and what the latest decision status is. The minister declined to send the scenarios, saying the decision process is still ongoing with local mayors and stakeholders, and that the current cells remain in use until a decision at a regional meeting in Q2 2020.
Because the decision-making process has not yet been completed, I do not consider it opportune at this stage to send the study with future scenarios.
Omdat het besluitvormingsproces nog niet is afgerond, acht ik het toesturen van het onderzoek met toekomstscenario’s in dit stadium niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Aantal ontvoeringen in West-Afrikaanse Golf van Guinee groeit hard’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about rising kidnappings and piracy in the Gulf of Guinea and why the Merchant Shipping Protection Act, passed in 2019, has not yet entered into force. The minister explained the delay (implementing regulations, consultation, and a small statutory amendment needed) and said he aims for entry into force in 2021.
I aim for the act (including the amending act) and the underlying subordinate regulations to enter into force as soon as possible in 2021.
Ik streef naar inwerkingtreding van de wet (inclusief de Wijzigingswet) en de onderliggende lagere regelgeving zo spoedig mogelijk in 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Wiersma over het arrest van de Hoge Raad der Nederlanden, het artikel ‘Salafistische scholen leren kinderen zich af te keren van Nederland’ en ‘Invoer hallucinerende aya

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Wiersma asked the Minister of Justice about a Supreme Court ruling on drug import and religious freedom, and about Salafist mosque schools teaching children punishments such as stoning and execution for apostates and homosexuals. The Minister said the ruling does not automatically apply to other offences, that the government will not tolerate such teaching and is tackling it through a taskforce and an informal-education review, and that he cannot judge whether specific statements are criminal, while listing existing offences and recent penalty increases.
It is not my task to rule on the criminality of specific statements or conduct.
Het is niet mijn taak om uitspraak te doen over de strafbaarheid van concrete uitingen of gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Slechts één supersnelrechtszaak, ondanks meer incidenten jaarwisseling’

An MP asked why only one super-fast-track (supersnelrecht) case reached court this year despite more New Year's Eve incidents, and whether more such cases could be handled. The Minister answered that only evidentially simple cases suit the fast track, that victims generally value it but complete dossiers and victim claims sometimes call for ordinary procedure, and that the fast track is not an end in itself.
This means that more complex cases requiring additional investigation generally do not qualify for the super-fast-track procedure.
Dat betekent dat complexere zaken waarin aanvullend onderzoek nodig is in het algemeen niet in aanmerking komen voor supersnelrecht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de stand van zaken in de processen tegen de door Nederland uitgeleverde Rwandezen I. en M. en de zaak tegen de moeder van de Rwandese oppositiepolitica Victoire Ingabire

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the progress of trials in Rwanda against two genocide suspects extradited from the Netherlands, the delay in their trials, and the case concerning the mother of Victoire Ingabire, including the confiscation of her passport. The ministers answered that trials are being monitored by the ICJ, that the High Court trial of one suspect is nearing conclusion while no end date is given for the other, that they see no unreasonable delay, and that they decline to comment on the passport case while defending extradition as responsible.
It is my custom to exercise restraint in my statements on ongoing cases.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de wijze waarop een vreedzame demonstratie op Schiphol werd beëindigd en het verschil met de boerendemonstraties

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked why a peaceful Greenpeace demonstration at Schiphol on 14 December 2019 was ended forcefully, with arrests and a 48-hour area ban, and why it was treated differently from farmers' protests and a KLM concert. The government answered that the mayor of Haarlemmermeer is responsible for demonstration management and emergency orders, that the matter is subject to council accountability and possible court review, and that it cannot judge the mayor's conduct.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over meer trajectcontroles

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether extending a trajectory speed control on the A2 between Utrecht and Amsterdam, to cover the gaps between existing sections, is justified by accident numbers, and whether it is really about revenue rather than road safety. The Minister answered that the extension targets speed limit violations on the uncontrolled sections that raise safety risks, that the revenue goes to the state budget, and that no new motorway trajectory controls are currently planned.
The definitive accident figures for the year 2019 will become available at the end of 2020.
De definitieve ongevallencijfers over het jaar 2019 komen eind 2020 beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vanaf vandaag twee extra trajectcontroles op de A2 omdat automobilisten de regels aan hun laars lappen’

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Justice and Security to send the study underlying the expansion of speed trajectory controls on the A2 to parliament before the 18 December debate. The minister explains that the two new sections were previously unenforced for technical reasons, cites speed measurements showing about three times more violations there, but the answer does not provide the study itself.
Before the intermediate sections of the trajectory control system went into enforcement, speed measurements were carried out.
Voordat de tussenliggende secties van het trajectcontrolesysteem in handhaving zijn gegaan, zijn er snelheidsmetingen verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag 'gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving', maar werd niet opgepakt'

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about a stabbing in The Hague by a man previously flagged as dangerous who was not detained, asking how oversight failed and whether mental health care cuts were to blame. The government answered that several investigations are ongoing, that the IGJ has ordered an independent inquiry at Parnassia and the Wmo supervisor is also investigating, and it declined to discuss specifics because of the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigations, I cannot currently go into specific aspects of this case.
Vanwege de lopende onderzoeken kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan op specifieke aspecten van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de veiligheid van het 5G netwerk

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about the security of 5G networks, including vendor screening, classification of high-risk network parts, human-rights principles and EU industrial capacity. The minister answered that vendors are assessed on intent and foreign legal obligations to share data, that the list of critical components is classified and cannot be shared, and that EU industrial policy is still under discussion.
The list of critical components has been classified as confidential and I therefore cannot share it with you.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is als vertrouwelijk geclassificeerd en kan ik daarom niet met u delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over de berichten ‘Trein stilgezet vanwege vrouw met nikab, politie geeft weer geen boete’ en ‘Conducteur aan schandpaal door nikabfans'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers how the NS and police handled a train stopped for a woman wearing a niqab who was not fined, whether the conductor was supported, and whether action was taken against online harassment of the conductor. The government defended the professionals' discretion, said the police acted in line with agreed procedures, condemned the social media campaign against the conductor, and noted that the NS reported no other incidents since the ban took effect.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to decide what criminal follow-up is given to a violation.
Het is aan politie en Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen welk strafrechtelijk vervolg aan een overtreding wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Minister Grapperhaus pleit bij Europese Unie voor achterdeur in encryptie’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that he urged the EU to create a backdoor in encryption, including the technical options for WhatsApp, Telegram and criminal platforms and whether encryption key length could be legally limited. The minister answered that broader encryption hampers investigations, that options for lawful access are being examined in consultation with public and private parties within the 2016 cabinet position, and that lawful interception of specific communications is being explored.
The options for lawful access to communications and their advantages and disadvantages are currently being examined.
De mogelijkheden om rechtmatige toegang tot communicatie te verkrijgen en de voor- en nadelen daarvan worden momenteel bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Politie arresteert klokkenluider die klaagde over machtsmisbruik’

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of two police officers suspected of leaking confidential police data, and whether this deters internal whistleblowing within the Dutch National Police. Minister Grapperhaus declined to comment on the individual criminal investigation, stated that whistleblowers following the prescribed internal procedure deserve protection while leaking confidential information is not whistleblowing, and pointed to internal procedures, an internal ombudsman and an ongoing evaluation.
As Minister of Justice and Security, it is not appropriate for me to comment on an individual criminal investigation.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid past het mij niet me uit te laten over een individueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Doofpot A.R. duurt voort. Hoe de politie voorkomt dat maatregelen tegen agenten uitgevoerd worden’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about a case of alleged ethnic profiling by police in Enschede, including a premature police press release naming the officer, the handling of internal and criminal investigations, and whether the case is used in police training. The minister declines to discuss individual casuistry given an ongoing criminal case, acknowledges the press release was premature, and promises an external evaluation of internal investigation processes with results expected in autumn 2020.
I do not go into individual casuistry. In addition, a criminal case is still ongoing, so as usual I cannot comment on it.
Ik ga niet in op individuele casuïstiek. Daarnaast loopt er op dit moment nog een strafzaak waardoor ik hier zoals gebruikelijk geen uitspraken over kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Erdogan die dreigt politieke tegenstanders in Europa te kidnappen of vermoorden

MPs De Roon, Markuszower and Wilders asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether Erdogan's reported threats to kidnap or kill political opponents in Europe were known, how many Turkish extradition requests Netherlands received since 2016, and what measures were taken. The government said it knows of reports on repatriation of Turkish nationals from third countries, has no indication of Turkish kidnapping teams active in the Netherlands, and that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to file complaints.
The cabinet currently has no indication that Turkish abduction teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzing dat er in Nederland Turkse ontvoeringsteams actief zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanwezigheid van de minister bij de algemene ledenvergadering (ALV) van de organisatie van varkenshouders, waar hij blijkens het twitterverslag boeren heeft opgeroepen tot

MP Ouwehand asked Justice Minister Grapperhaus about his attendance at a pig farmers' general meeting, where he reportedly urged farmers to steal activists' cars, suggested using high-pressure hoses on activists, and made claims about activists' finances and the Boxtel occupation. The minister replied that he attended at the POV's invitation to discuss activism guidance, denied calling for theft or violence, said courts act justly, and acknowledged receiving a meat package but denied promoting the meat industry.
I have in no way called into question the functioning of judges.
Ik heb op geen enkele wijze het functioneren van rechters in twijfel getrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Nijkerken-de Haan en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘schorsing om herkenbare leerlingen in bescherming te nemen’ en ‘drie jongens opgepakt voor mishandeling Gorinchem’

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers why students filmed in a violent assault in Gorinchem were suspended rather than arrested, whether the schools protected perpetrators, and whether parents should lose child benefit, plus questions on youth gangs and the number of suspects. The minister answered that police arrested fourteen suspects under sixteen, all six incidents were reported, suspensions were to protect school calm, child benefit cannot be cut for under-sixteens, no national overview of youth gangs exists, and he will report on administrative approaches to street terror before the recess.
Due to the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot make further statements about this case.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over recht op gezinshereniging

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether family reunification rights apply to Dutch children held in Syrian camps and whether their parents can be refused entry on public order or national security grounds. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult departees, that Dutch nationals have an unconditional right of entry, and that non-Dutch parents' cases require a case-by-case proportionality assessment in which national security can weigh heavily.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult departees and their possible children from the camps in Syria.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun eventuele kinderen uit de opvangkampen in Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Datacenters in Nederland raken in wurggreep van Amerikanen' en 'Nederlandse bouwer van datacenters failliet'

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch data centres and citizens' and companies' data risk falling under US control, who owns government-used data centres, and whether the planned investment screening should be accelerated. The government answered that data centre acquisitions above 40 MW will fall under the draft telecom control law, that the investment screening bill is planned for end-2020, and that the cabinet will examine whether data centres should become vital infrastructure, while deferring details on government-used data centres to a later letter.
At the AO Digitale Overheid of 4 December 2019, the Minister of the Interior committed to inform the House by letter about data centres used by central government.

In het AO Digitale Overheid van 4 december 2019 is door de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties toegezegd uw Kamer per brief te informeren over datacenters die door de rijksoverheid in gebruik zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Meer dan honderdduizend verkeersboetes onterecht: ‘Bezwaar maken loont’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that over 100,000 traffic fines were wrongly issued and whether objecting is futile, with questions on the share of objections, barriers to appeal and standard letters. The minister denied a discouragement policy, explained that many successful appeals come from leasing companies, and stated that all appeals receive substantive review.
If an appeal is lodged, a substantive assessment always takes place by the OM or the district judge, and not only at the Court of Appeal Arnhem-Leeuwarden.
Indien er in beroep wordt gegaan vindt er altijd een inhoudelijke beoordeling door het OM of de kantonrechter plaats en niet pas bij het Gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de dreigende gijzeling van een journalist

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about threatened detention of two journalists (NOS and AD) for refusing to testify as witnesses, and whether the source-protection law is clear enough. The minister answered that these were two separate court cases, the law leaves room for case-by-case weighing, and he sees no reason to amend the law or its criteria.
I regard these as two separate incidents.
Ik beschouw het als twee losse incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over straffen die collectief worden opgelegd aan groepen voetbalsupporters na het gebruik van vuurwerk door één of enkelen

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether collective closures of football stands after fireworks by a few supporters are fair and effective, and whether he will move to individual punishment. The minister answered that such sanctions are a matter for the KNVB and clubs, that stand closures are a last resort, that effectiveness cannot be established, that he does not share the fairness objection, and that he is implementing a person-focused approach with clubs and municipalities.
Imposing penalties for such incidents is a matter between the Royal Netherlands Football Association (KNVB) and the clubs.
Het opleggen van straffen bij dergelijke incidenten is een aangelegenheid tussen de Koninklijke Nederlandse Voetbalbond (hierna: KNVB) en de clubs.
