Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het rapport 'EU Drug Markets Report 2019'

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU Drug Markets Report 2019, covering the Netherlands' role in cannabis, cocaine, synthetic drug and darknet trade, Mexican cartels, port use, awareness campaigns and EU funding. The Minister answered that the Netherlands is a transit and distribution hub, outlined an offensive against organised crime, and promised further information in spring 2020 along with a strategic exploration of cocaine use.
I continually address users of hard drugs on the fact that with their lifestyle they finance crime that disrupts our society.
Ik spreek gebruikers van harddrugs voortdurend aan op het feit dat zij met hun levensstijl criminaliteit financieren die onze samenleving ontwricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk bericht 'Zet asielzoekers veilige landen apart'

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that Ter Apel wants asylum seekers from safe countries housed separately, and about related concerns on shop theft, police presence, bus transport and schooling. The State Secretary says overlast from this group is a priority, points to a separate reception form and transfer to the Hoogeveen supervision location, notes the police station is being kept in Ter Apel, and says schooling is covered by existing rules.
The COA, together with the parties involved, is looking for a suitable location for the separate form of reception.
Het COA is samen met betrokken partijen op zoek naar een geschikte locatie voor de separate opvangvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de groene BOA’s

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about the position of green enforcement officers (BOA's), including their numbers, violence against them, training, cooperation with police and radio equipment. The minister answered that numbers are not separately registered, violence is a matter for employers and is recorded irregularly, and that the government is working on a plan of action, with progress reports promised for early 2020.
There is no nationally uniform picture of the number of incidents involving green BOA's.
Er is geen landelijk uniform beeld van het aantal incidenten waar groene BOA's bij betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over Officieren van Justitie die in de fout zijn gegaan

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice about prosecutors (OM) who made errors, the adequacy of judicial review under article 359a Sv, disciplinary oversight and the Ombudsman complaint figures. The Minister replied that article 359a has a limited purpose, that a reflection chamber on OM quality was set up, that a letter on OM oversight and the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure will follow.
The article therefore has a limited purpose and does not aim to regulate comprehensive supervision of the OM.
Het artikel heeft derhalve een beperkt doel en beoogt geen alomvattend toezicht op het OM te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Misdaadregistratie loopt vast’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the OM's case-registration system GPS is unstable and slow, its consequences for prosecution and the criminal chain, and the digitisation plans. The Minister confirmed performance problems since August 2019, said a fallback to the older Compas system exists and is used selectively, and that capacity has been freed to fix the issues, while digital document exchange with police is not yet operational.
The College of Procurators-General has freed up capacity and budget to resolve the problems.
Door het College van procureurs-generaal is capaciteit en budget vrijgemaakt om de problemen op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de artikelen ‘Doe iets, anders is het wachten op de volgende dode’ en ‘We laten verwarde personen te lang vrijlopen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about newspaper reports on dangerous incidents involving confused persons, the lessons drawn, implementation of the person-centred approach, information sharing, a 24/7 hotline, mayors' emergency powers, rising incident numbers, police workload and whether a national approach is possible. The government answered that the approach is being implemented regionally, that the Wvggz and new privacy guidance improve information sharing, that a national hotline is expected in spring 2020, and that local tailoring rather than a single national approach is preferred.
The national reporting number is expected to be ready in spring 2020.
7 , zal het landelijk meldnummer naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2020 gereed zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Grote zorgen Tweede Kamer na onderzoek salafistische moskeescholen'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that salafist mosque schools and informal weekend schools are indoctrinating children, and what the government will do about it, including the role of inspection, funding and prosecution. The government answered that it is working through a taskforce and a study of informal education, pursuing transparency of foreign funding and a bill to widen the power to ban associations, but declined to rule on specific cases or prosecutions and said inspection of informal education is not fitting.
It is not appropriate to the task and mandate of the Inspectorate of Education to supervise such forms of informal education.
Het is niet passend bij de taak en opdracht van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs om op dergelijke vormen van informeel onderwijs toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de aanpak van seksuele intimidatie in het openbaar vervoer

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about sexual harassment on public transport, its prevalence, treatment of offenders to prevent escalation, and whether revising the sex-offence provisions of the Criminal Code would address this. The minister answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers last year (likely incomplete), that early treatment via existing criminal-law tools and risk assessment is available, and that a new criminal offence for sexual intimidation in public space is planned, with an evaluation of earlier measures due in spring 2020.

In my letter to the House of 22 May 2019, I therefore announced, also on behalf of the Minister for Legal Protection, my intention to include sexual intimidation in the Criminal Code as a new criminal offence.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 22 mei 2019 heb ik dan ook, mede namens de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, mijn voornemen aangekondigd om seksuele intimidatie in het Wetboek van Strafrecht als nieuwe strafbaarstelling op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het terugtrekken van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) uit een strafzaak wegens ‘belangen die beschermd moeten worden’

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service withdrew from a serious assault case and declared itself inadmissible without explaining why, leaving the court unable to rule on the merits. The Minister says the reasons cannot be disclosed without harming protected interests, that an evidentiary problem arose, and that the issue will be raised in the Reflectiekamer for learning.
Regarding the reasons, unfortunately no further explanation can be given in this special case without endangering the necessary protection of weighty interests.
Over de redenen kan in dit bijzondere geval helaas geen nadere opheldering worden gegeven zonder de noodzakelijke bescherming van zwaarwegende belangen in gevaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over onbetrouwbare hondengeurtesten

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether reports of unreliable, non-blind dog scent tests by Twente police handlers warrant invalidating pre-1997 scent tests, reopening convictions, and commissioning research. The minister answered that earlier investigations found non-blind testing by one group, that pre-1997 testing was not standardised so further research was not opportune, that revision is for the Supreme Court, and that no new research is planned since scent tests have not been used as evidence since 2011.

As indicated in that answer, for closed criminal cases the decision on the validity of evidence is reserved for the Supreme Court, which under article 457(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure decides on applications for revision.

Zoals aangegeven in die beantwoording, is ten aanzien van afgesloten strafzaken de beslissing omtrent geldigheid van bewijsmiddelen voorbehouden aan de Hoge Raad, die op grond van artikel 457, eerste lid, 1 van het Wetboek van Strafvordering beslist op aanvragen tot herziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Gratis deurbellen tegen criminaliteit: het twijfelachtige effect en de privacyzorgen'

An MP from CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about privacy and effectiveness concerns around free digital doorbell cameras used against burglary, including how pilot projects select suppliers, handle data retention and third-party access, inform participants, and protect privacy. The Minister answered that pilots are run by municipalities under the GDPR with a Programme of Requirements, data is viewable only by the user, footage is kept at most 28 days, and privacy compliance is the responsibility of municipalities and the Data Protection Authority.
For the pilot, all parties involved must comply with the General Data Protection Regulation.
Voor de pilot geldt dat alle betrokken partijen moeten voldoen aan de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen vrouwen vergt een Nationaal Coördinator’

An MP asked ministers about a report calling for a National Coordinator on violence against women, including prevalence figures, budgets, police stalking detection and coordination between ministries. The minister answered that the figures are known, that responsibility is shared across departments and municipalities with existing programmes and budgets, and that coordination is sufficient, promising a GREVIO-related review and a stalking-training trajectory.
I am of the view that coordination between the ministries is given sufficient shape with this.
Ik ben van mening dat de coördinatie tussen de ministeries hiermee voldoende vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de politie niet mag noteren of zakkenrollers asielzoekers zijn

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police may record the residence status of suspects after a report that police are not allowed to note whether pickpockets are asylum seekers, and whether this should be changed. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police verify identity via the BVV system, that recording residence status is not necessary for criminal law purposes, that the Top-X approach and existing measures address the problem, and that the government will explore stronger grounds for detaining and removing foreigners with criminal records.

To gain insight into which persons are involved in criminal activities, recording residence status is not relevant, and for that reason there is no statutory basis for police to record the legal residence status of suspects.

Om zicht te krijgen op welke personen betrokken zijn bij criminele activiteiten is het registreren van de verblijfsstatus niet relevant en om die reden is er voor de politie geen wettelijke grondslag voor het registreren van de juridische verblijfsstatus van verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij inzake het bericht dat coffeeshops sportverenigingen sponsoren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether coffeeshop sponsorship of sports clubs is unacceptable, whether it is already banned under the Opium Act and AHOJG criteria, and what measures will end financial ties. The minister replied that sponsorship is undesirable and can be prosecuted or enforced case by case, that no overview of sponsorship exists, and that an investigation into criminal influence in sports clubs will be carried out.
We do not have an overview of coffeeshop sponsorship of sports clubs.
Wij beschikken niet over een overzicht van de sponsoring van coffeeshops aan sportclubs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘70 amateurvoetbalclubs zien signalen van criminaliteit op de vereniging’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that 70 amateur football clubs see signs of criminal interference, and what action is planned. The minister acknowledged the signals as worrying, announced a joint investigation with the Health and Sport Minister into criminal interference in sports clubs, and pointed to prevention measures such as governance coaching and the Code Goed Bestuur.
Together with the Minister for Medical Care and Sport, I am going to conduct research into the interference of criminals in sports associations.
Samen met de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport ga ik onderzoek doen naar de inmenging van criminelen bij sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken inzake de invloed van criminelen op het amateurvoetbal

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about criminal influence in amateur football, including whether reported signals in 70 clubs understate the problem, whether sponsors should need a VOG, whether municipalities should routinely apply the Bibob test, and the KNVB's role. The minister said a national study will be carried out with the Minister of Medical Care and Sport, declined to make VOG mandatory, left Bibob use to municipalities' discretion, and pointed to KNVB rules and prevention support.
To properly map this problem, I will, together with the Minister of Medical Care and Sport, carry out research into the interference of criminals in sports associations.
Om deze problematiek goed in kaart te brengen ga ik samen met de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport onderzoek doen naar de inmenging van criminelen bij sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Van Raak over de politie-inzet in verschillende gemeenten

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Justice Minister about police capacity shortages forcing cities such as Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht to scale back services, and whether further erosion of primary police tasks is acceptable and whether capacity will fall further. The minister acknowledges workload concerns, says local authorities must manage demand within available capacity, cites €91m plus €10m in funding and structural strengthening, and expects pressure to persist for the coming year before recruitment effects are felt from 2021.
The cabinet has made €91 million available to relieve the pressure on deployability in the coming years.
Het kabinet heeft € 91 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld om de druk op de inzetbaarheid in de komende jaren te verlichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht ‘Politie vernietigde cruciaal document in zaak oud-Transavia piloot Julio Poch’

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Justice Minister about reports that police destroyed a key report of a 2008 trip in the Julio Poch case, and whether ministers and the prosecution's advisory reports were kept from the public. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the report is possibly lost or destroyed, declined to publish advisory reports or the report, and pointed to an independent inquiry by Machielse without a fixed deadline.
No, in advisory reports the College informs the Minister of Justice and Security in full confidence about certain sensitive matters and subjects.
Nee, in ambtsberichten informeert het College de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid in alle vertrouwelijkheid over bepaalde gevoelige zaken en onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Weer hoofdofficier weg bij OM'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice about complaints concerning members of the College of Procureurs-Generaal and the procedure for handling them, following a press report on a prosecutor leaving the OM. The Minister answered that two complaints were filed since the Fokkens report, each handled by a separate ad hoc complaints committee, describing the committee's fact-gathering and the general complaints procedure while declining to discuss individual case details.
Since the publication of the Fokkens committee report, two complaints about conduct of members of the College have been filed with my ministry.
Sinds het verschijnen van het rapport van de commissie Fokkens zijn twee klachten tegen gedragingen van leden van het College bij mijn ministerie aanhangig gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jeugdzorg het kabinet verzoekt twee IS-kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether youth care had requested repatriation of two IS-linked children from Syria, how the government responded, and what happens to them and to other Dutch children in Syrian camps. The government confirmed receipt of a letter from a Dutch child protection organisation on 15 October, said it is in close contact with that organisation, but declined to disclose steps taken, citing no diplomatic presence and restraint on individual cases.
Beyond that, the cabinet cannot currently provide information on the steps being taken to implement this request.
Voor het overige geldt dat het kabinet op dit moment geen mededelingen kan doen over de stappen die worden gezet ter uitvoering van dit verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Dutch minister urges EU action to fight child pornography online’’

An MP asks the Justice Minister why he urged EU action against online child abuse material in a way that appears to weaken encryption, contrary to the 2016 cabinet position. The minister answers that he seeks solutions within the 2016 framework, acknowledges that encryption makes investigations harder, and denies advocating weakening encryption software.
I aim for solutions that, within the framework of the cabinet position, do justice to the interests of investigation and national security.
Ik streef naar oplossingen die binnen de kaders van het kabinetsstandpunt recht doen aan de belangen van de opsporing en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over corrupte douaniers

MP Groothuizen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about corruption among customs officers in Rotterdam and why a research report on it was not published, including whether the customs service obstructed the study. The ministers answered that the research was independent, referred to a separate letter on the customs service's cooperation, and said screening of customs staff will be strengthened, with a first assessment expected in 2020.
The Police Education Council is an independent advisory body of the Ministry of Justice and Security whose position and tasks are regulated by law.
De Politieonderwijsraad is een onafhankelijk adviesorgaan van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid waarvan positie en taken bij wet zijn geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht de uitspraken van de minister in de media inzake de strijd tegen georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice about media statements on a special brigade against organised crime, its staffing, funding, preventive measures, intelligence services' role and possible cuts to regional police. The minister answered that the team is additional to existing capacity, outlined a funding plan to be decided in spring, and said intelligence services have no role in the current design.
The expansion of police capacity for the multidisciplinary intervention team comes on top of the existing capacity.
De uitbreiding van de capaciteit (van politie) van het multidisciplinair interventieteam komt bovenop de bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Schonis over het bericht 'Veel meer ongevallen, veel minder politie op snelweg'

MPs Den Boer and Schonis asked ministers about a report linking reduced police presence on motorways to rising accidents, including the effectiveness of radar enforcement, the choice of enforcement locations, speed-trap apps, and seatbelt enforcement. The ministers acknowledged the rise in accidents and the importance of enforcement, but defended current enforcement practice, said no separate policy plan was needed, and promised modest follow-up such as the Analysetool Handhaving and trajectory controls.
The SWOV study 'Traffic enforcement on Dutch motorways' focuses on traffic enforcement.
Het onderzoek van SWOV «Verkeershandhaving op Nederlandse autosnelwegen» is gericht op de verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over dubbele functies bij veiligheidsregio’s

An MP asked whether it is desirable for a safety region director also to serve as regional fire chief, how many dual functions exist and whether rules govern them, and whether anyone exceeds the WNT pay cap through combined roles. The minister answered that the Bpv sets no rules on dual functions, that regional boards decide themselves (about 18 of 25 regions combine the roles), and that no WNT violations by safety region top officials have been reported.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Helder over piraterij in de Golf van Mexico

MPs De Roon, Popken and Helder asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Justice and Security about piracy in the Gulf of Mexico, including the reported rise in attacks, any signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, monitoring and cooperation, and whether armed private guards could be allowed on Dutch ships. The government answered that it cannot confirm the attack figures, has received no signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, relies on cooperation with the US and Mexico, and noted that armed guards may become possible under the new Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij in designated High Risk Areas, which the Gulf is not currently.
To date we have not yet received any signals that ships sailing under the Dutch flag were targeted by pirates in the Gulf of Mexico.
Tot op heden hebben wij nog geen signalen ontvangen dat schepen varende onder de Nederlandse vlag doelwit waren van piraten in de Golf van Mexico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de oproep dat veel meer jongerenwerkers nodig zijn in de strijd tegen drugsgeweld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to calls for far more youth workers to keep young people out of drug-related violence and whether this fits the government's public statements, and when concrete plans and funding would follow. The minister answered that youth work is primarily a municipal responsibility, that a broader anti-subversion plan including youth work is being developed with municipalities, that 110 million euro was set aside for the start of the approach, and that further preventive measures will be communicated later, but declined to answer the questions in time for the scheduled debate.
Youth work and the deployment of youth workers is primarily a task of municipalities.
Jongerenwerk en de inzet van jongerenwerkers is primair een taak van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Drugskartel waste opbrengsten wit: Nederlandse banken hadden moeten ingrijpen’

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether simple loanback money-laundering constructions are a serious problem, how often they occur, whether authorities have enough capacity, and how cooperation with the prosecution service and gatekeepers can improve. The ministers answered that the scale of money laundering is hard to pin down, that loanback constructions are a known phenomenon without data on their share, and pointed to the anti-money-laundering action plan, public-private cooperation pilots, extra funding and a new multidisciplinary intervention team.
The exact scale of money laundering flows through the Netherlands cannot be determined definitively.
De exacte omvang van witwasstromen door Nederland is niet definitief vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over illegalen die panden kraken

MPs Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk and Wilders asked why the "We are here" group of squatters can squat buildings unpunished, whether members have been prosecuted or removed from the Netherlands, and whether they will be evicted and expelled immediately. The Minister answered that no figures on prosecutions or removals of this group are kept, that arrest does not end unlawful squatting (eviction is the effective tool), that the OM applies its existing policy, and that most of the group refuses to cooperate with return.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep records of criminal offences committed by persons who count themselves as part of the "We are here" group.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van strafbare feiten die gepleegd zijn door personen die zich rekenen tot de «We are here» groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over handhaving van wet- en regelgeving, onder andere met betrekking tot kustvissers

MP Moorlag asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about enforcement of engine-power limits for coastal fishing vessels, following reports of tolerated overpowered engines and a 2019 EU study on electric-motor manipulation. Minister Schouten answered that inspections by NVWA, ILT and RVO take place year-round, that the government takes the EU study's signals seriously and will look at improving oversight, but withheld the internal protocols and signal details on control-technical grounds.
I take the signals identified in the report seriously, and based on the recommendations I will look at how oversight can also be improved for this type of engine.
De door het rapport geconstateerde signalen neem ik serieus, en op basis van de aanbevelingen ga ik kijken hoe toezicht ook voor dit type motoren kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Weer hoofdofficier weg bij het OM'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about a complaint over undesirable conduct filed by CVOM staff against a chief prosecutor, shortly after the Fokkens commission report. The minister confirmed the complaint, its handling via two separate advisory-committee procedures, and the appointment process, but declined to discuss its content because of the ongoing complaint procedure.
Regarding the nature and content of this complaint, I will not make any statements, given its confidentiality.
Over de aard en inhoud van deze klacht doe ik, in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid daarvan, geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het  brandveiligheidsrisico van elektrische auto’s

An FvD MP asked the Justice and Security and Housing ministers about fire safety risks of electric cars, including blaze-fighting difficulty, parking garage rules and research. The government answered that no extra fire risks are known, that electric cars are at least as safe as combustion cars per TNO, and that updated research and building norms are underway.
There are so far no known additional fire safety risks.
Er zijn vooralsnog geen extra brandveiligheidsrisico’s bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over de Nederlander die in Roemenië verdacht wordt van het misbruiken en vermoorden van een meisje en mogelijk andere vergelijkbare misdrijven

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked how Dutch authorities assisted Romania's investigation into a Dutch suspect in the abuse and killing of a girl, whether he had other offences, and why Romania lacked official confirmation of his death and was not alerted through European systems. The ministers answered that Dutch legal assistance was provided, that the suspect's death was officially communicated, that he was not registered in SIS II, SIENA or ECRIS, and that he had served his earlier sentences, though they declined to give details of his past convictions and did not answer the questions within three weeks.
I will not go into the exact convictions or sentences that Johannes V. received earlier.
Ik ga niet in op de exacte veroordelingen dan wel straffen die Johannes V. eerder heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Zeker drie EU-lidstaten gaan Syriëgangers uit eigen lang terughalen’?

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether reports that Belgium, Germany and France would repatriate IS detainees from Syria were true, how the government cooperates with allies and the US, and whether Iraq would prosecute European fighters. The minister denied the repatriation reports, described existing measures against returning fighters, and said talks with Iraq continue on prosecution under conditions excluding the death penalty.
No. This reporting turned out to be incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over milieucriminaliteit

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about environmental crime, covering police expertise, illegal bird trapping and eel poaching, illegal waste transport, subsidy and manure fraud, and air-gun regulation. The government answered that police capacity is adequate, that some enforcement data are not registered or fall under provincial responsibility, and that a bill requiring permits for high-power air guns is nearly ready.
Control over bird trapping has been the responsibility of the provinces since 2017, so I will not give a picture or figures on this.
De controle op het vangen van vogels ligt sinds 2017 bij de provincies, daarom zal ik hier geen beeld of cijfers voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de daling van de meldingen van mensenhandel vanwege een onjuiste interpretatie van de privacywetgeving

MP Van Nispen asks the Justice Minister whether the drop in reported human trafficking cases is due to a misreading of privacy law, and what will be done about information sharing and CoMensha funding. The State Secretary acknowledges the decline, attributes it partly to the GDPR and partly to capacity pressure and police reorganisation, promises a policy response in Q1 2020 and a programme on information sharing, but says CoMensha's basic subsidy is not being cut.
I aim to inform the House about this in the first quarter of 2020.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover in het eerste kwartaal van 2020 te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het opnemen van gegevens van een MOT-melder in het strafdossier

MP Van Nispen asked whether the name of an MOT (unusual transaction) reporter, such as a notary, is still routinely included in criminal case files, given threat risks, and asked for measures to prevent this. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the reporter's firm name is included because prosecutors must be able to verify the transaction and the defence and judiciary must be able to test the basis for an investigation, with exceptions and witness protection possible in threatening cases; he agreed to consult the KNB on improving the reporting process.

Without stating the business or office name of the reporting institution in the criminal file, the defence and the sitting judiciary cannot test on the basis of which specific information an investigation was started.

Zonder vermelding van de bedrijfs- of kantoornaam van de meldende instelling in het strafdossier kan niet door de verdediging en de zittende magistratuur, worden getoetst op basis van welke specifieke informatie een opsporingsonderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Harddrugs gevonden bij een militair op marineschip Curaçao’

Members of parliament asked whether cocaine was found on a navy ship in Curaçao, about the zero-tolerance drug policy, drug seizures from Curaçao, and the working of drug scanners at Curaçao's airport and port. The government confirmed about 11 kg of suspected cocaine found with a soldier, explained its zero-tolerance policy and seizure figures, and said border controls on Curaçao are an autonomous matter, with Schiphol applying 100% Customs checks on arrivals.
Two incidents are still under criminal investigation and no further information can be given on them at this time.
Twee incidenten worden nog strafrechtelijk onderzocht en daarover kan op dit moment geen nadere informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de sluiting van arrestantencellen in de politiebureaus van Doetinchem, Deventer, Ede en Tiel

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether closing police custody cells in Doetinchem, Deventer, Ede and Tiel would reduce police availability for emergency response and whether a separate transport service should be created first. Minister Grapperhaus answered that spoedmeldingen take priority, that the cell closures are under impact analysis with the local authorities and a final decision is expected in spring 2020, and that he does not consider a separate transport service a precondition, though it may be a flanking measure.
In spring 2020 a final decision will be submitted to the board of the Oost-Nederland police unit.
In het voorjaar van 2020 zal een definitief besluit aan het bestuur in de eenheid Oost-Nederland worden voorgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Dam over het voornemen van de nationale politie tot sluiting van de arrestantencomplexen van de politiebureaus van Deventer, Doetinchem, Ede en Tiel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the national police's plan to close the custody facilities at four police stations in Eastern Netherlands, citing longer transport times and reduced police capacity. The Minister replied that the police and the local authority are responsible for how operations are organised, that an external study is ongoing with a decision not yet taken, and that the police will consult local authorities without committing to preserving the cells.
It is up to the police and the local authorities to ensure that, with proposed changes to operations, basic police care remains in order.
Het is aan de politie en het lokale gezag om er bij voorgenomen wijzigingen ten aanzien van de bedrijfsvoering voor te zorgen dat de basispolitiezorg op orde blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bosman over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb: kapotte drugsscanners Curaçao gevaarlijk voor Nederland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that most drug scanners at Curaçao's port and airport have been broken for years, and what this means for drug flows to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the port scanners have been defective for about two years, that the airport has a working but not fully deployable body scanner, that Schiphol keeps 100% checks on passengers from Curaçao, and that the issue will be raised at the January 2020 Justice Four-Party Consultation, and provided seizure statistics from 2015 to 2019.
The Curaçao authorities state they cannot share operational information about when the scanner is or is not deployed and the reasons for this.
Tevens geven Curaçaose autoriteiten aan geen operationele informatie te kunnen delen over wanneer de scanner al dan niet wordt ingezet en wat de redenen daarvan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over de MEOS-app Proactief Controleren

MP Van den Berge asks whether the police academy's evaluation of the MEOS app for proactive checks is ready, why the summer 2019 deadline was missed, and whether the pilot reduces ethnic profiling. The minister says the research is still being processed and will be sent to parliament when complete, that the pilots justify wider rollout in 2020, and that the app is expected to counter ethnic profiling alongside awareness training.
As soon as the research is completed, I will inform your House of this.
Zodra het onderzoek gereed is zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het fenomeen ‘voorgenomen beslissing’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the 'voorgenomen beslissing' practice and whether suspects are generally given a chance to present their view before a summons is issued. The minister answered that a suspect is usually heard (verhoor) before summons across nearly all criminal investigations, with exceptions such as an unfindable suspect, and clarified that 'zienswijze' refers to a response to the facts underlying the suspicion.
Following these questions, the OM has again informed me that it is customary that, in (nearly) all criminal investigations, the suspect is heard before the summons is issued.

Naar aanleiding van onderhavige vragen heeft het OM mij nogmaals laten weten dat het gebruikelijk is dat ten aanzien van (vrijwel) alle strafrechtelijke onderzoeken voorafgaand aan het uitbrengen van de dagvaarding de verdachte wordt verhoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over hondengevechten in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why authorities acted only now against dogfight organisers, whether penalties are too low, and whether lifetime breeding and keeping bans should apply. The government replied that local authorities set priorities, that current maximum penalties match the seriousness of the offences and courts decide sentences, and that a bill allowing immediate enforcement of keeping bans is planned.
The bill is expected to be sent to the Council of State for advice in spring 2020.
Het wetsvoorstel wordt naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2020 ter advisering aan de Raad van State verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de aanwezigheid van informatie op ministeries over de burgerdoden bij het Nederlandse bombardement op Hawija

MP Diks asked ministers whether ministries had been informed about the outcome of the CENTCOM investigation into civilian deaths at Hawija and whether the Defence Minister misinformed parliament in 2015. The government answers that ministries received only general, non-numerical information in 2015 meetings, the initial CENTCOM report was not shared with other departments, and the 2015 statements to parliament were found to be incorrect.
The initial CENTCOM report as such was never provided to other departments, in line with standing practice.
Het initiële CENTCOM-rapport als zodanig is nooit verstrekt aan andere departementen, conform staande praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over dodelijk geweld in het Koerdische kamp al-Hol in Syrië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about lethal violence and unrest in the al-Hol camp in Syria, including the presence of Dutch women and children, conditions in the Annex section, risks of radicalisation and escape, and Dutch responsibility. The government answered that it has no control over the camps, cannot confirm Dutch nationals among the victims, raised escape risks with Turkey and NATO, and maintains its policy of not actively retrieving Dutch IS-travellers while pursuing prosecution.
The cabinet has no authority over reception and detention locations in north-east Syria and cannot exert influence over the situation there.
Het kabinet heeft geen zeggenschap over opvang- en detentielocaties in Noordoost-Syrië en kan geen invloed uitoefenen op de situatie daar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het intrekken van paspoorten Syriëgangers en beleid Buitenlandse Zaken inzake ‘gematigde’ rebellen

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about passport and citizenship revocations for Syria fighters and the government's stance on 'moderate' rebel groups supported under the Dutch Non-Lethal Assistance programme, including why Ahrar al-Sham is not on Dutch terrorism lists. The ministers answered largely by referring to legal frameworks, declining to comment on individual cases, and explaining that the listing criteria for the national-security list and the national sanctions list were not met.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Kabinet geeft groen licht voor volledig vuurwerkverbod in Apeldoorn, maar Raad van State twijfelt’

An MP asked whether the Raad van State's advice on the Vuurwerkbesluit allows municipalities to impose a full fireworks ban, and how this squares with its reported doubts. The government answered that the Vuurwerkbesluit is not exhaustive, so municipalities can use their autonomous ordinance powers to ban fireworks in zones or their whole territory, citing the 2016 Raad van State ruling.
The Vuurwerkbesluit does not stand in the way of such a municipal fireworks ban.
Het Vuurwerkbesluit staat niet in de weg aan een dergelijk gemeentelijk vuurwerkverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Minister bezorgd om versleuteling Facebook’

MP Verhoeven asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that the minister was concerned about Facebook's encryption plans, whether the minister would raise cabinet's encryption position in Washington, and whether weakening encryption exposes private communication to foreign powers and criminals. The minister confirmed awareness, said his concerns do not conflict with the 2016 cabinet position, and stressed the value of strong encryption while seeking solutions balancing investigation and national security interests.

I will bring the various interests involved and the conclusion from the cabinet position that it is not desirable to take restrictive legal measures regarding the development, availability and use of encryption within the Netherlands to attention.

Ik zal de diverse betrokken belangen en de conclusie uit het kabinetsstandpunt dat het niet wenselijk is om beperkende wettelijke maatregelen te nemen ten aanzien van de ontwikkeling, de beschikbaarheid en het gebruik van encryptie binnen Nederland onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Protestmars in Beverwijk om geweld jongerenbende’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Van Wijngaarden asked the Justice Minister about the Pilotenbende, a group of 60 to 80 youths causing vandalism, threats and intimidation in Beverwijk, and about police and municipal capacity to tackle it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the municipality and police have used cameras, an assembly ban, area bans and prosecutions, that the problem is decreasing but not over, that the matter is a local responsibility, and that ministry-municipality consultation on further help is ongoing.

Although this is a local responsibility of the local triangle, consultation is already taking place between the Ministry of Justice and Security and the municipality of Beverwijk on help with the further approach.

Hoewel het hier om een lokale verantwoordelijkheid gaat van de lokale driehoek, vindt er reeds overleg plaats tussen het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de gemeente Beverwijk over hulp bij de verdere aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Jagers: voorlopig geen e-screening voor wapenvergunning’

MPs Van Dam and Von Martels (CDA) asked Minister Grapperhaus about the suspension of the e-screener for hunters and sport shooters, the seizure of weapons after negative results, and the legal protection available to licence holders. The minister said only new applicants will be screened with the e-screener for two years, that weapons will be returned case by case under a three-category approach, and that objection and appeal procedures remain available, while declining to meet the one-week deadline.
As I indicated in my letter of 29 October, it is being examined promptly, case by case, whether weapons are returned.
Zoals ik aangaf in mijn brief van 29 oktober wordt voortvarend van geval tot geval bekeken of wapens worden teruggegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Den Boer over de laatste stand van zaken rondom de aanschaf van tweeduizend bodycams

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about the status of the purchase of 2,000 police bodycams, including procurement progress, evidence on effects, privacy safeguards, ethnic profiling and the Ombudsman's role. The minister answered that procurement is underway with operational use expected by end 2020, that privacy rules and a 28-day review regime exist, and that bodycams are not used to combat ethnic profiling.
We are currently having that examined and will inform your House in the second police half-yearly report of 2019 about the outcome of that study.
Ik laat dat op dit moment onderzoeken en zal uw Kamer in het tweede halfjaarbericht politie van 2019 informeren over de uitkomst van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Syriëgangers op ambassade Ankara’

Two PVV MPs asked the government how two women who joined IS and their children reached the Dutch embassy in Ankara, and whether such returnees should be permanently barred from Dutch soil. The government said the women escaped the Al Hol camp weeks earlier and reported at the embassy, declined individual details, and explained that Dutch nationals are normally returned in a controlled way for prosecution, with arrest, terrorism detention and possible nationality revocation.
Beyond that, we cannot go into individual cases.
Voor de rest kunnen wij hier niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in het kamp Al-Hol in Syrisch Koerdistan

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked about the situation in Al-Hol camp, the repatriation of Dutch IS women and children (including a court order to make efforts for their return) and Iraq's reported demands for payment to prosecute foreign fighters. The government referred to earlier letters, said the detention orders cannot currently be carried out safely, stated it is seeking solutions with Schengen partners including prosecution in the region, and said it is too early to discuss compensation for Iraq.
The examination of the possibility of executing the detention orders issued by the Rotterdam court is ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid van de uitvoering van de bevelen gevangenneming van de rechtbank van Rotterdam duurt voort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een teamchef van de politie Leiden die naar huis is gestuurd

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a police team chief in Leiden was sent home for criticising racism and bullying within the police, and whether the police can accept public criticism on discrimination. The Minister replied that the chief was not placed on non-active duty, that the leadership welcomes criticism, and listed internal channels for reporting misconduct, including a new complaints committee and an ombudsman function.
The police leadership has informed me that the team chief has not been placed on non-active duty.
De korpsleiding heeft mij gemeld dat de teamchef niet op non-actief is gezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Commotie na hard optreden politie Utrecht tegen dronken studenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police arrest of intoxicated students in Utrecht filmed on video, questioning its proportionality, police learning and training, and use-of-force statistics. The minister's supplementary answer corrects earlier incomplete figures on registered police use-of-force incidents for 2016 to 2018 and refers to the police website for the data.

In my answer to the parliamentary questions from MP Den Boer (D66) about the report 'Commotion after heavy-handed police action in Utrecht against drunk students', incomplete figures were mistakenly included regarding the number of registered police use-of-force incidents.

Nader antwoord In mijn beantwoording 3 van de Kamervragen van het lid Den Boer (D66) over het bericht «Commotie na hard optreden politie Utrecht tegen dronken studenten» ( 2019Z16725 ) zijn abusievelijk onvolledige cijfers opgenomen met betrekking tot het aantal registraties van geweldsaanwending door politieagenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Discriminatie en wangedrag bij politie Den Haag

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of discrimination, excessive force and a poor culture at a Den Haag police unit, and why internal signals were not acted upon. The minister answered that the police chief handles such reports, that an investigation and an ombudsman post are in place, and that he will inform parliament in a spring 2020 report, while seeing no need for further measures now.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the aforementioned processes within the police (see my letters of 9 and 15 October).
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van de eerder genoemde trajecten bij de politie (zie mijn brieven van 9 en 15 oktober jl.) af.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Man na arrestatie overleden in het ziekenhuis’ van Omroep West

Deputy Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about a man who died in hospital after a police arrest, including proportionality of force, the handling of evidence, and oversight of police violence. The minister declined substantive comment while the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, but gave statistics, described disciplinary procedures, and rejected a new independent complaints body.
In the first instance it is for the public prosecutor to assess whether the police officers involved acted in accordance with the rules.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de officier van justitie om te beoordelen of de betrokken politieambtenaren volgens de regels hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een klokkenluider bij de politie naar huis is gestuurd

An SP MP asked the Justice minister whether a Leiden police team chief was suspended after raising concerns, how that squares with whistleblower protection, and whether independent investigation of workplace safety is warranted. The minister denied any suspension, said the chief will not return to her unit with an independent mediator offered, and declined an independent inquiry while stating the force chief has full latitude.
Are you now willing to have an independent investigation carried out into workplace safety at the police? If not, why not?
Bent u nu wel bereid onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar veiligheid op de werkvloer bij de politie? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Den Boer, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Politiechef die racisme aankaartte weggestuurd’

MPs Den Boer, Van den Berge and Buitenweg asked whether the Leiden team chief who raised racism and bullying in the police was sidelined by the police leadership, and how the force handles such reports. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the team chief was not placed on non-active duty, that the force says all reports of misconduct are taken seriously, and that he will discuss police culture with the chief commissioner but will not comment on individual personnel cases.
Like your House, I believe we should exercise great restraint in commenting on individual cases.
Met uw Kamer ben ik van mening dat ons grote terughoudendheid past in te gaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over Brabantse boeren die worden lastiggevallen door drugscriminelen maar geen aangifte doen

MP Krol asked the Minister of Justice and Security why Brabant farmers harassed by drug criminals do not file reports, whether police have been withdrawn from rural areas, whether reports will be prioritised, and whether the army and a multidisciplinary pilot could help. Minister Grapperhaus denied police withdrawal, described existing prevention and reporting channels and a funded anti-undermining offensive, rejected a military role, and promised a later letter on the army proposal.
No, the claim that the police have largely been cut back in rural Brabant is not correct.
Nee, dat de politie grotendeels is wegbezuinigd op het Brabantse platteland klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Teamchef politie niet meer welkom in Den Haag’

MP Den Boer (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a police team chief, Ms Aboulouafa, was no longer welcome in The Hague after raising misconduct internally, and about social safety within the police. The Minister answered that complaints must be addressed, declined to discuss individual cases because the police chief is responsible for personnel policy, pointed to internal complaint channels, said the trust breakdown is separate from her criticism, and said a broader evaluation and an update in spring 2020 would follow.
Therefore I will not go into the substance of individual cases in my answer.
Daarom zal ik in de beantwoording niet inhoudelijk ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de berichten ‘Ik walg van politieagenten die zich Marokkanenverdelgers noemen’ en ‘Burgemeesters regio Den Haag: geen verziekte cultuur bij politie’

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that eleven Hague-region mayors concluded there is no 'rotten culture' in the Hague police regarding discrimination and racism, while an internal investigation into the Hoefkade unit was still running, and about dismissals, a letter from police leadership on an 'undesirable culture', and the treatment of a former team chief who spoke out. The Minister declined to comment on the ongoing case and individual personnel matters, said the police chief takes reports seriously, pointed to an ombudsman post and existing reporting channels, and saw no need for further structural measures for now.
In view of the ongoing investigation at the Hoefkade team, I will not go further into this case.
Gelet op het lopende onderzoek bij het team Hoefkade ga ik verder niet op deze casuïstiek in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Supersnelle politie-Audi’s staan stil’

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether police Audis bought to pursue criminals are largely idle for months due to a training backlog of 200 officers, and whether the minister was informed. Minister Grapperhaus denied the idle-fleet claim, said all vehicles are in regular use, that no 200-officer waiting list exists, and that the korpschef is responsible for operations.
The quality of business operations is the primary responsibility of the chief of police. That is why I was not informed about this subject.
De kwaliteit van de bedrijfsvoering is een eerste verantwoordelijkheid van de korpschef. Daarom ben ik over dit onderwerp niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht Gedwongen uitgehuwelijkte Fatima: ‘Meisjes zoals ik worden verkocht als golden tickets’ van Hart van Nederland

MPs asked the ministers how forced marriage of young women with a non-Western migrant background is measured, what protection and legal tools exist, and how the vrouwenopvang shortage affects victims. The government answered that reliable figures are lacking, pointed to existing reporting channels, laws and an action agenda due end 2019, and said it would evaluate the Wet tegengaan huwelijksdwang and study the shelter capacity problem.
Precise and reliable figures on the scale of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Von Martels en Palland over het bericht 'Brandweer dreigt alle vrijwilligers kwijt te raken'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about reports that the volunteer fire service risks losing its volunteers due to the Wnra civil service law, and about recruitment, diversity and the working group. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Wnra does not itself threaten volunteerism, that a working group and recruitment programme are underway, and that the Wnra's entry into force for fire services is postponed pending clarity.
It is not correct that the Wnra civil service law causes the fire service to risk losing its volunteer character.
Het klopt niet dat de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra) ervoor zorgt dat de brandweer haar vrijwillige karakter dreigt te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van kunstmatige intelligentie in zedenzaken

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Maastricht University chatbot for victims of sexual harassment, including whether government might use it, what data trained it, and who is liable for errors. The minister said the chatbot is only being monitored, the training data was anonymised and mostly from India, and liability follows general civil law, with the Justice Ministry committing to watch AI developments without firm action.
I find developments in this area interesting and I follow them.
De ontwikkelingen op dit gebied zijn interessant en die volg ik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over foto’s gemaakt kort na de moordaanslag op Kelvin Maynard op 18 september 2019 in Amsterdam

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice and Security about photos of the dying Kelvin Maynard, taken by firefighters and circulated in the media, and about police exclusion of press. The Minister acknowledged the photos were taken by fire service personnel and are being investigated by an external bureau, with measures to follow, and explained the police's press policy and cautions for responders.
On the region's instruction, an external bureau is conducting an investigation into the making and distribution of the photos taken at the crime scene.
In opdracht van de veiligheidsregio voert een extern bureau een onderzoek uit naar het maken en het verspreiden van de foto's die op de plaats delict zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de politie niet op tijd is bij spoedmeldingen

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police response times to urgent calls had not improved in the first half of 2019, whether system-technical registration explained longer times in rural areas, and what would ensure timely arrival. Minister Grapperhaus answered that response times are published as targets rather than statutory norms, that local authorities and police manage improvements, and that the system itself had not changed.
The response times the police publish on their website are target figures and not statutory prescribed response or arrival times.
De reactietijden die de politie op haar website publiceert zijn streefcijfers en geen wettelijke voorgeschreven reactie- of aanrijtijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Ik heb een paar mannen pissed off gemaakt , interview Fatima Aboulouafa teamchef politie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police team chief's interview, requested an overview of the current police top leadership with names and appointment dates, and asked about the Strategic Positions leadership programme. The minister confirmed knowledge of the interview, provided a full list of the police top with appointment dates, and described the programme's start, duration and participant outcomes.
Attached to this you will find an overview of this public information.
Hierbij treft u een overzicht aan van deze openbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuiken, Laan-Geselschap, Van Toorenburg en Den Boer over terrorismeverdachten die airsoft speelden als mogelijke voorbereiding op een aanslag

MPs from SP, PvdA, VVD, CDA and D66 asked the Justice Minister how airsoft, which RTL reported terrorism suspects played as possible attack training, is controlled, including whether introduced guests need a certificate of conduct (VOG). The minister said current oversight is adequate, that screening looks back eight years, and that he will discuss how to combat misuse with the airsoft association but sees no reason to change the rules now.
I do not comment on individual case matters.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Gezichtendatabase van politie bevat foto’s van 1,3 miljoen mensen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police facial recognition: other systems in use, use in public space, scraping, why privacy audits do not examine specific systems, and whether exceeding legal retention periods is a breach reportable to the DPA. The minister said the Catch system is also used for immigration tasks, that camera stills are being examined for facial matching, that audits focus on the data protection framework rather than specific systems, and that exceeding retention periods is not a legal data breach but is a risk he is addressing through a Wpg/Wjsg revision and interim measures.
During this audit, specific working methods or systems are not examined.
Tijdens deze audit wordt niet gekeken naar specifieke werkwijzen of systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de moord op de Maltese journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the independence of the Maltese public inquiry into journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia's murder, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and pending libel suits against her. Minister Blok answered that the inquiry is for Malta to organise independently, the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally, Malta is following the Venice Commission recommendations, and the libel cases are for the Maltese courts to decide.
It is for the inquiry commission to shape the investigation in an independent manner.
Het is aan de onderzoekscommissie om het onderzoek op onafhankelijke wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Wapenopslagplaatsen vol: Nederland voldoet niet aan wapenregels EU’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Dutch firearms storage was full and that the country was not meeting EU weapons rules on deactivated firearms. The minister said he was unaware of full storage, that the police became the competent authority on 23 July and began issuing certificates from 1 October, and that the Verona system and extra funding were in place.
I am not aware that weapons storage facilities are full.
Mij is niet bekend dat wapenopslagplaatsen vol zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Taakstrafverbod voor geweld tegen agenten is onzinnig’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether police figures show rising violence against police officers, whether the claim of one incident per hour is accurate, whether the rise is a registration effect, and how such incidents are recorded. The Minister confirms the reported figures, says a registration effect cannot be established on available information, explains the recording systems and provides incident counts, while noting that the breakdown by occupational group is not possible.
Whether there is a registration effect and whether it explains the increase in GTPA registrations (wholly or partly) cannot be established on the basis of the available information.
Of er sprake is van een registratie-effect en of dit de toename in GTPA registraties (geheel, of gedeeltelijk) verklaart, is op basis van de beschikbare informatie niet vast te stellen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over bemoeienis van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister on what legal basis and with what content the ministry gave the prosecution points on possible defence arguments in the Wilders case, and why this was not disclosed earlier. The minister repeatedly refused substantive answers, citing ongoing court proceedings and his internal investigation, and promised to inform parliament once the investigation is complete.
As reported, I will inform the House of the outcomes when the investigation is complete.
Zoals gemeld zal ik uw Kamer wanneer het onderzoek gereed is over de uitkomsten informeren.
Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Topambtenaren eisten harde aanpak in proces tegen 'kwaadaardige' Wilders'

MPs Kuiken, Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why ministry officials were involved in the substance of the prosecution of Wilders, whether the OM requested this, and how independence of the OM is protected. The minister mostly referred back to earlier answers, while noting he had sent the documents requested by the OM to parliament.
I refer to the answers given above to the questions from members Groothuizen (D66) and Van Nispen (SP) on the involvement of the Ministry of Justice and Security in the Wilders case.
Ik verwijs naar de hierboven gegeven antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Groothuizen (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) over bemoeienis van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the costs of (non-Western) immigrant-background residents across justice and security spending, and to say how it compares with revenues from fees. The minister answered that police, terrorism, prison, and immigration services do not record costs or outcomes by migration background, so the requested breakdowns and estimates cannot be provided.
Data on the costs of police deployment with regard to citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het tappen van de klokkenluider in de WODC-affaire

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the wiretapping of whistleblower Van Ooyen in the WODC affair, whether he knew of it, and why he filed a criminal complaint in a case that could implicate her. The minister answered that the investigation is for the Public Prosecution Service and the Rijksrecherche, that he filed the complaint on the prosecutor's advice, expressly stated the leak was not against her, and that talks on compensation are ongoing.
I cannot go into the details of an individual criminal investigation.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de details van een individueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Voordewind en Kuiken over het artikel ‘De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders’

MPs asked the government about shipowners' difficulties finding safe ports for rescued migrants in the Mediterranean, the suspension of EU naval mission Sophia, disembarkation platforms in North Africa, and Libya returns. The government agreed safe ports are needed, said a causal link to Sophia cannot be established, noted some North African ports have accepted rescued migrants, and pointed to ongoing EU negotiations and an informal JHA Council without a concrete mechanism.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra inzake het nieuwsbericht ‘Drones van klimaatactivisten weigeren op te stijgen bij Heathrow’

An MP asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Justice about reports that climate-activist drones disrupted flights at Heathrow, and whether similar action could occur in the Netherlands and how it would be prevented and sanctioned. The minister answered that such actions cannot be ruled out, pointed to upcoming EU drone rules, registration and identification requirements, a counter-drone knowledge programme, existing fines up to 7,800 euro, and a commitment to keep the policy under review.
It cannot be ruled out that actions by climate activists with drones at and around airports could also take place in the Netherlands.
Het valt niet uit te sluiten dat er ook in Nederland acties van klimaatactivisten met drones op en rondom luchthavens kunnen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Commotie na hard optreden politie Utrecht tegen dronken studenten’

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a police arrest of drunk students in Utrecht, filmed and shared online, was proportionate, and about police training, use-of-force data and comparisons with other European countries. The Minister defended police discretion in use of force, cited registered figures on assaults on officers and police force use, said some data on injuries is not centrally recorded, and pointed to a planned reform of the use-of-force framework.
Both injuries to police officers and injuries to arrested persons are not recorded centrally.
Zowel verwondingen bij politieambtenaren als verwondingen bij aangehouden personen worden niet op centrale basis geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de situatie op Curaçao

MPs Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma and Diertens asked about the situation on Curaçao, including the Article 3 ECHR protection procedure, detention conditions for Venezuelan migrants, border and drug and arms smuggling controls, and funding. The government answered that the procedure was revised and adopted, that detention upgrades are being funded, and that border controls and support measures are being strengthened, while stressing that law enforcement is Curaçao's autonomous responsibility.
It is primarily up to the country of Curaçao to ensure that the procedure is properly implemented and to ensure that effective legal remedies and the necessary capacity exist.

Het is primair aan het land Curaçao om erop toe te zien dat op goede wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan de procedure en zorg te dragen voor het bestaan van effectieve rechtsmiddelen en de daarbij benodigde capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘bewijs voor bemoeienis proces Wilders, PVV leider overweegt stappen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the 2014 decision to prosecute Geert Wilders was a provisional rather than final decision, and whether the ministry or its predecessor influenced it. The minister explained that a 'voorgenomen' decision is standard before a suspect is heard, and that the former minister had no formal instruction and no evident opinion on prosecution before the decision was announced.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de "bemoeienis van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders"

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked on what legal basis the Ministry of Justice and Security gave the prosecution points on possible defence arguments in the Wilders case, and why officials analysed the prosecution's report. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he cannot go into the content of the documents because they are now part of the court file, and promised a full account to parliament once the case is no longer before the court.
This means that as Minister of Justice and Security I must be extremely restrained and at this stage I cannot go into the substance of the documents.
Dit maakt dat ik mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid uiterst terughoudend dien op te stellen en ik in dit stadium niet inhoudelijk op de (inhoud van de) documenten kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht  ‘Topambtenaren eisten harde aanpak in proces tegen 'kwaadaardige' Wilders’

MPs Kuiken, Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether ministry officials improperly advised the public prosecution service (OM) on prosecuting Wilders, citing reports that officials urged a tough approach and wanted to read the requisitoir in advance. Minister Grapperhaus largely refers to earlier answers and a letter sending documents to the Chamber, while stating the College of procurators-general must provide information the minister needs.
I refer you to my answer to questions 1 through 6 today on the questions from members Groothuizen and Van Nispen about the involvement of the Ministry of Justice and Security in the Wilders case.

Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 1 tot en met 6 van heden op de vragen van de leden Groothuizen (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) over bemoeienis van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de inbeslagname van twee wietplanten voor medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether patients may keep up to five cannabis plants for medicinal use after police seized two plants from an elderly man, and whether the policy on cannabis is unclear. The government answered that medicinal cannabis is available via pharmacies on prescription, home cultivation remains prohibited (five plants or fewer are low enforcement priority but seizures still happen), no change is planned, and the cannabis experiment will inform future policy.
The possession and cultivation of cannabis plants for one's own medicinal use is prohibited.
Het bezit en het telen van cannabisplanten voor eigen medicinaal gebruik is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Ojik over garantstelling sprekers De Balie

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether the IND's demand for a financial guarantee for Turkish and Sri Lankan guest speakers at De Balie hinders free public debate, and whether such demands could be dropped for debate-centre invitees. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said EU Schengen visa rules allow a guarantee as one way to show sufficient means, and argued the motion on event security does not override those rules.
I cannot, however, go into the individual case, also for reasons of protecting personal data.
Ik kan evenwel niet op de individuele casus ingaan, ook om redenen van bescherming van persoonsgegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag inzake de specialist ouderengeneeskunde die verdacht werd van onzorgvuldige euthanasie op een demente patiënte

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the ministers about a district court ruling acquitting a geriatric specialist accused of careless euthanasia on a dementia patient, and its effects on review bodies and the Euthanasia Act. The government answered that the Public Prosecution Service will not appeal but the Procurator-General will seek a cassation ruling in the interest of the law, that review practice should follow the Supreme Court decision once issued, and that current law already covers taking the current situation into account, while declining to comment further on a possible amendment.
However, the Public Prosecution Service has asked the Procurator-General at the Supreme Court to file a cassation appeal in the interest of the law in the above case.
Wel heeft het OM de Procureur-Generaal bij de Hoge Raad verzocht om cassatie in het belang der wet in te stellen in bovengenoemde zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over dode dieren die gedumpt zijn in het buitengebied van Haaren

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the ministers about dead hares and a wild boar dumped in the Haaren countryside, possible use as prey in illegal dog betting, and rising illegal activity and enforcement gaps in rural areas. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police received no report, no examination has taken place so cause of death is unknown, dog-prey betting is not legal, and the rural enforcement action plan is still being implemented with a progress report promised for early 2020.
I have promised the House to report on the progress of the elaboration of the action plan in early 2020.
Ik heb de Kamer toegezegd begin 2020 te rapporteren over de voortgang van de uitwerking van het plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het berechten van Nederlandse Syrië-gangers door de Koerdische autoriteiten in Noord-Syrië

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they would support local trials of Dutch jihadists by Kurdish authorities in northern Syria, including financial and legal support and detention facilities.
