The government said it is exploring regional prosecution with international partners but is reluctant to deal with non-state Kurdish authorities, offers only indirect support through UNITAD and IIIM, and will not fund local detention centres.

The cabinet is reluctant to make agreements or cooperate with non-state entities that actually exercise authority over an area where the government in question effectively no longer exercises authority.

Het kabinet is terughoudend met het maken van afspraken of samenwerken met niet-statelijke entiteiten die feitelijk gezag uitoefenen over een gebied waar de betreffende regering effectief geen gezag meer uitoefent.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Duitse kinderen uit Syrië door Duitsland

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Dutch ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government knew in advance of Germany's repatriation of children from Syria, how many Dutch children remain in Syrian camps, and why the Netherlands does not repatriate them. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not informed beforehand, that active repatriation is not government policy except possibly for orphans, that about 85 children with a Dutch link are in SDF camps, and that the government will study the return of orphans.
It is unknown how many Dutch children are currently in Syrian camps.
Het is onbekend hoeveel Nederlandse kinderen zich momenteel in Syrische kampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Coöperatie Laatste Wil een handleiding online heeft gezet waarmee het mogelijk is om een leven te beëindigen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the government would act against the Coöperatie Laatste Wil after it posted online a manual naming chemicals usable for ending life, and whether a criminal investigation should be reopened. The government called the manual undesirable and said it was in talks with the CLW, but stated that the Public Prosecution Service independently decides whether to investigate and will inform parliament only once it has decided.
The OM makes an independent, autonomous assessment of whether or not to start a criminal investigation.
Het OM maakt een eigenstandige, onafhankelijke afweging over het al dan niet starten van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over berichten ‘Invloed IS op Haags jeugdwerk’ en ‘De Marokkanen nemen in de buurthuis de boel over’

PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of IS influence in Hague youth work and Moroccan takeover of a neighbourhood centre, and proposed measures including dismissals, closures, preventive detention, denaturalisation, mosque closures and ending diversity policy. The minister rejected the far-reaching proposals as disproportionate or contrary to the rule of law, while confirming a youth worker with radical views was dismissed and that deradicalisation funding continues.

Administrative detention, in the sense of a kind of preventive detention, is not one of the cases listed in Article 5 of the European Convention on Human Rights in which deprivation of liberty is possible.

Administratieve detentie, in de zin van een soort preventieve detentie, is niet één van de in artikel 5 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) genoemde gevallen waarin vrijheidsontneming mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de positie van een slachtoffer in een lopende zedenzaak

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the treatment of victims in sexual offence cases, including how victims for the Inspectorate's study were selected and how a forensic psychiatric clinic handled internal checks after a rape by a patient on leave. The Minister explains a random sample of 130 victims was drawn, that no standard investigation of tbs patients is done after nearby offences unless there are indications, and that the clinic conducted an internal incident investigation which was halted once an external suspect was arrested.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security informed me that it drew a random sample in a scientifically sound manner to select the victims.
de Inspectie) heeft mij geïnformeerd dat zij op wetenschappelijk verantwoorde wijze een a-selectieve steekproef heeft getrokken om de slachtoffers te selecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet controleren van diplomaten op alcoholgebruik na ongevallen

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether diplomats involved in accidents are exempt from alcohol testing while ordinary drivers are tested, and whether this difference should be ended. The minister replied that diplomatic immunity under international law can bar breath tests, that a criminal investigation continues where immunity is later found not to apply, and that since May 2019 the CJIB notifies immune persons of traffic fines via the Foreign Ministry.
Diplomats, and often also staff of international organisations of comparable rank, enjoy immunity from the Dutch courts so that they can function effectively and independently.

Diplomaten, en vaak ook medewerkers van internationale organisaties met een vergelijkbare rang, beschikken in verband met het effectief en onafhankelijk kunnen functioneren over immuniteit voor de Nederlandse rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de gevolgen van lachgas in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about rising nitrous oxide (lachgas) use among drivers, its effects, casualty figures, enforcement options and whether recreational use should be banned. The state secretary answered that casualty data are not available, that existing criminal and CBR administrative tools can already be used, that a risk assessment is pending, and that a youth awareness campaign is planned, but did not fully answer the deadline request.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over Nederlandse kinderen die vastzitten in Syrische opvangkampen.

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers about Dutch children held in Syrian camps, including how many have trauma, what support they receive, and whether the government will bring them home. The government answered that at least 85 such children are in Kurdish-run camps, that aid agencies decide where help goes, and that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children, while promising care and a multidisciplinary team for children who return.

Government policy, as confirmed in the Minister of Justice and Security's letter to the House of 21 February 2019, is still that the Netherlands does not help travellers leave unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq.

Het kabinetsbeleid, zoals ook bevestigd in de brief van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid aan uw Kamer van 21 februari 2019, is nog steeds dat Nederland uitreizigers niet helpt bij het verlaten van onveilig gebied in Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the government recognises that Polish prosecutions of critical academics, including professor Wojciech Sadurski, continue despite an earlier answer that a prosecution was withdrawn. The government replied that the earlier answer concerned threatened prosecutions against jurists, that the Sadurski case concerns private and party complaints over a tweet and remains with the Polish courts, and that it will monitor the case and raise rule-of-law concerns in EU and bilateral channels.
It does not befit the Netherlands to actively interfere in cases that are still before the courts and/or to make statements about them.
Het past Nederland niet om zich actief te mengen in zaken die nog onder de rechter zijn en/of daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

An MP asked the government about sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners, including the status of a victim-reporting campaign, numbers of reports and prosecutions, whether tantra massage should be licensed or regulated, and the handling of a reported case at The New Tantra. The minister answered that tantra massage is not a protected profession, the health inspectorate found no jurisdiction, licensing is only required for commercial sexual services, and no further regulation is planned, while a victim-reporting campaign starts in November 2019.
I currently see no reason to regulate the profession of tantra massage practitioner by law.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding om het beroep van tantramasseur wettelijk te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuwe record: ministeries geven 25 miljoen euro uit aan inhuur van de landsadvocaat

Van Nispen (SP) asks why ministries spent a record 25 million euro on the state's external counsel (landsadvocaat) in 2018, whether this conflicts with the government's aim to reduce juridification and procedures, and why this contrasts with underfunded legal aid for citizens. The minister answers that the costs are being critically reviewed, mainly reflect mandatory civil representation where the state is defendant, and that legal aid and state counsel spending are distinct; he also details Defence and Justice spending, the Groningen claims procedures, and aims to reduce unnecessary government litigation.
It is difficult to say why the costs of hiring the state counsel were higher in 2018 than in previous years.
Het is moeilijk aan te geven waarom de kosten van inhuur van de landsadvocaat in 2018 hoger zijn uitgevallen dan in voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Apple deelde herleidbare, persoonlijke gegevens bij opnames Siri-gebruikers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether Apple's sharing of identifiable Siri recordings violated privacy, what the Dutch privacy regulator AP had done, which law applies and where citizens should complain, and what the government would do about privacy risks in tech. The ministers answered that the AP is a concerned authority while the Irish regulator leads, that AVG complaint routes exist, that current law is largely adequate with the AVG evaluation to address data volume and profiling, and that a public campaign on privacy will start in spring 2020.
It is up to the competent privacy supervisors in the EU to start an investigation into Apple's conduct.
Het is aan de bevoegde privacytoezichthouders in de EU om een onderzoek te starten naar het handelen van Apple.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Gedode Albanees Lato had eigen leger in Gelders dorp’

MPs Van Dam and Van Wijngaarden asked whether Festim Lato, shot dead in the Netherlands, had a private army, whether authorities ignored signals, and whether residents were endangered. The minister denied the private-army characterisation, said police monitored the address and seized weapons, and that no action was needed against a private army absent evidence of one.
I share the view that it would be an unacceptable situation if someone were to maintain an (armed) private army there.
Ik deel de mening dat het een onacceptabele situatie zou zijn indien iemand er een (bewapend) privéleger op zou nahouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het aanpakken van pro-anorexia websites en ‘anorexiacoaches’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about pro-anorexia websites, the scale of such online communities, and the 'anorexia coaches' who solicit sexual images from vulnerable girls. The government said a research study by CKM and GGZ Rivierduinen is ongoing with results due in autumn, that a ban on pro-ana sites would be ineffective and could reinforce stigma, and pointed to existing criminal law, grooming provisions and the K-EET care chain initiative as its response.
It has not been mapped how extensive the pro-anorexia websites are in the Netherlands, and there is no overall picture of the websites, forums and social media channels.
Er is niet in kaart gebracht hoe omvangrijk de pro-anorexia websites zijn in Nederland en er is geen totaalbeeld van de websites, fora en sociale mediakanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland nog niet akkoord met migrantendeal’

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about reports that the Netherlands had not agreed to a Franco-German plan for rapid assessment and distribution of migrants arriving in Europe, and about alternatives such as regional reception facilities. The State Secretary referred to the informal JHA council report, saying the talks produced no temporary mechanism acceptable to the cabinet, and that it will keep pushing for shared responsibility including arrival states and a border procedure; she added there is no EU majority for externalised asylum procedures.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility, including the arrival states.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over een bericht op Twitter van het Operationeel Centrum van de politie Den Haag

MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Justice Minister why a Den Haag police control room tweet called sales of slaughtered animals from vans legal and whether it was offensive and should be stopped. The Minister said the police checked locations after reports, found a municipal permit for an incidental stand, deferred the permit conditions to the Agriculture Minister, and said the tweet was meant to clarify matters for citizens.
It is up to the police to ensure social media use stays within the legal frameworks and agreements.
Het is aan de politie om zorg te dragen voor social media-gebruik binnen de wettelijke kaders en afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de politie

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked the Justice Minister about police diversity policy, including how diversity is defined and measured, recruitment targets, and a Muslim slaughter-offering meat sale. The Minister defends diversity as necessary for police legitimacy, explains the 25% recruitment target and CBS measurements, and largely answers on substance while declining to provide breakdowns by religion or ethnicity citing lack of legal basis.
There is no legal basis for linking personnel data to cultural background.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag om personeelsgegevens te koppelen aan culturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ' Flaws in Cellphone Evidence Prompt Review of 10,000 Verdicts in Denmark '

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch use of telecom data as evidence could suffer from errors like those found in Denmark, and whether verdicts could be affected. The government answered that Dutch conversion tools are not used as evidence, that no concrete reason exists to assume inaccurate data is used, and that it will ask police to check the Danish findings against the Dutch situation after the Danish inquiry concludes.

However, after the Danish investigation is concluded I will ask the police to project all the 'uncertainties and sources of error' identified by the Danes onto the Dutch situation and report their findings to me.

Wel zal ik na de afronding van het Deense onderzoek de politie vragen om alle door de Denen aangegeven «onzekerheden en bronnen van fouten» op de Nederlandse situatie te projecteren en mij over de bevindingen te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de aanbeveling van het VN-Mensenrechtencomité 2019 om de waarborgen voor de euthanasiepraktijk te versterken door toetsing vooraf

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether the government will respond to the 2019 UN Human Rights Committee recommendation to strengthen ex ante review of euthanasia, including an independent ethics commission. Minister De Jonge replied that he sees no reason to change the Wtl, citing broad public support, six careful-practice criteria and post-hoc review by regional committees, and that this answer serves as an early response.
I see no reason to amend the current euthanasia legislation, for the following reasons.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de huidige euthanasiewetgeving aan te passen, om de volgende redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over de brief ‘Uitvoering motie van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Van Toorenburg over de intrekking van het Nederlanderschap’

An MP asked whether sources beyond AIVD reports or in-absentia verdicts could support stripping Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers, how trial in absentia and the right to be present interact with that, and why prosecution interests are weighed against national security. The minister answered that other sources such as open-source material can be used, that presence rights are not absolute and temporary lifting of the entry ban can be requested, and that intelligence material may be withheld but is available to courts.
An official report is always based on underlying data.
Een ambtsbericht is altijd gebaseerd op onderliggende gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Laan-Geselschap over het artikel ‘Speciale opvang voor jihad-kinderen bij terugkeer in Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Parool report on special reception for children returning from IS territory, and whether such children pose a security threat. The government answered that the children are primarily victims, that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming did not set up locations, that children are placed in specialised trauma care and observed, and that the youth court decides on protective measures based on multidisciplinary advice.
The RvdK has not set up any locations.
De RvdK heeft geen locaties opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Ministerie onduidelijk over omstreden software’

MP Verhoeven asked whether Kaspersky antivirus software is still used in central government IT systems and critical infrastructure after a news report about unclear ministry positions. The minister could not confirm full phase-out in central government, pointing to an ongoing inventory due end 2019, and said that for critical infrastructure the decision to phase out rests with the organisations themselves.
Currently the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations has an inventory underway across central government to obtain a full picture, with results expected at the end of 2019.
Momenteel heeft het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor een volledig beeld hiervan een uitvraag lopen voor de rijksoverheid waarvan de resultaten eind 2019 verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over een  slachtoffer van homofobe bedreigingen dat  zelf de dader moest opsporen

MPs asked the Justice Minister how police could ignore long-running homophobic threats even after the victim supplied the offender's details, and what policy will raise reporting and prosecution of discrimination and strengthen the Roze in Blauw network and LHBTI training. The minister agreed the case should have been handled more carefully, said he cannot comment on individual cases, and listed an action plan, a WODC study on hate crime, and planned police training measures.
I am of the view that this case should have been handled more carefully; the police share this view.
Ik ben van mening dat deze zaak zorgvuldiger had moeten worden behandeld, de politie deelt deze mening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de positie van de nieuwe voorzitter van de OVV

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the newly appointed OVV chair was known to be a candidate for an IMF post when the appointment was made, and whether this undermines the OVV's independence. The minister answered that no IMF vacancy existed at the time of the appointment and that the chair remains suitable, with the candidacy not affecting his position at the OVV.
At the time of the decision on appointing a new chair of the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) in April 2019, there was not yet a vacancy for the position of director at the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

Op het moment van het besluit over de benoeming van een nieuwe voorzitter van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) in april 2019 was er nog geen sprake van een vacature voor de positie van directeur van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘All-points alert out for “most dangerous Portuguese terrorist of them all’

An MP asked whether the government would press Portugal to bar a Dutch-Portuguese dual national who joined ISIS from entering Portugal or Schengen, and whether her Dutch rights had been forfeited. The government declined to comment on individual cases, explained the conditions under which Dutch nationality can be revoked, and said it has no jurisdiction over other states' nationality decisions.
Furthermore, the cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Verder gaat het kabinet niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden en Kuiken over het bericht 'Relatie zorgfraude en terrorisme onderzocht'

Two MPs asked whether suspicious financial transactions linked to care fraud, and a possible link with terrorism financing, were detected and acted upon by the FIU-Nederland, including how many transactions there were and whether earlier years were investigated. The minister replied that over 1,300 unusual transactions related to care fraud were reported in 2018, that many remain under investigation so no concrete figures are yet available, and that no further retrospective investigation is planned.
As a result, no concrete statements can yet be made about the number of transactions declared suspicious by the FIU-Nederland that may be related to care fraud, or the amount involved.

Hierdoor kunnen er nog geen concrete uitspraken worden gedaan over het aantal door de FIU-Nederland verdacht verklaarde transacties dat mogelijk te relateren is aan zorgfraude alsmede het bedrag dat daarmee gemoeid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het wegpesten van een transgenderstel in Heerlen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government whether local authorities and police have enough tools to stop harassment of LGBTI people, as in the Heerlen case of a transgender couple who moved out, and whether further action or consultation is planned. The minister answered that existing tools are sufficient, that Heerlen used a range of measures including an area ban, and that no additional instruments or consultation are needed, while pointing to the existing Action Plan.
Yes, local administrators and police have sufficient powers to address and tackle persons who harass LGBTI people to the point of driving them out.
Ja, de lokale bestuurders en politie beschikken over voldoende mogelijkheden om personen, die LHBTI's lastig vallen tot wegpesten aan toe, aan te spreken en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een tekort aan politieagenten in Brabant

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police staff shortages in Brabant, including wijkagenten being redeployed to emergency response and whether this undermines the statutory neighbourhood-officer norm. The minister acknowledged temporary pressure, said the norm is unaffected because the formation is unchanged, and pointed to incoming recruits and extra funding without committing to new structural measures.
By temporarily deploying neighbourhood officers differently, the composition of a unit's establishment is not changed.
Door het tijdelijk anders inzetten van wijkagenten wordt de samenstelling van de formatie van een eenheid niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht ‘sterke groei van dwangsommen voor de Nationale Politie’

An MP asked why the national police had to pay penalty payments (dwangsommen) to over 500 officers in 2018 for late handling of internal objections, and whether staffing shortages were to blame. The minister acknowledged limited legal capacity and attributed the 2017–2018 peak to reorganisation procedures, which are now concluded, and promised process improvements.
The police organisation is keen to handle objections within the stipulated deadlines as a good employer.
De politieorganisatie is er veel aan gelegen om als goed werkgever de bezwaren binnen de gestelde termijn te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Oekraïne laat belangrijke MH17 verdachte vrij”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Dam asked whether an MH17 suspect released by a Ukrainian court could still be held available for the Dutch investigation and what the government had done to prevent his release and transfer in a prisoner exchange. The minister answered that the Ukrainian court released him in an unrelated case, that diplomatic efforts were made at the highest level, and that after the exchange the Public Prosecution Service requested his detention with a view to extradition from Russia.
The Dutch Public Prosecution Service has indicated it wants Mr Tsemach kept available for the investigation into the downing of flight MH17.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft aangegeven de heer Tsemach beschikbaar te willen houden voor het onderzoek naar het neerhalen van vlucht MH17.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht dat Justitie de integriteitsproblemen te lijf gaat met een tarotlezeres

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice about a press report that the ministry used a tarot reader in a 'Week of Unblemished Conduct' integrity programme, and whether such activities were justified. The minister defended the week as a way to make integrity discussable, gave its costs and themes, said such sessions will recur, and rejected the complaints by anonymous officials while acknowledging the top must set the example.
Next year there will again be a Week of Unblemished Conduct organised.
Volgend jaar zal er weer een Week van het Onbesproken Gedrag georganiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het optreden van KMar- en douanemedewerkers op Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport en Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asks ministers about alleged ethnic profiling and discriminatory treatment by Customs and the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee at Schiphol and Eindhoven airports, including an Ombudsman finding on Customs cash checks. The government denies systematic profiling, acknowledges shortcomings in information provision and one inappropriate remark, cites ongoing complaint procedures, and declines a separate investigation while awaiting the Ombudsman's own inquiry.
Yes, Customs acknowledges that at the time of the complaint the provision of information at Eindhoven Airport was insufficient
Ja, de Douane erkent dat ten tijde van de klacht de informatieverstrekking op Eindhoven Airport onvoldoende was
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van twee wietplanten uit de tuin van een ouder echtpaar door de politie

An MP asked the ministers about police removal of two cannabis plants from an elderly couple's garden, the proportionality of medicinal cannabis policy, the availability and cost of medicinal cannabis oil, and whether individual exemptions could be granted. The minister answered that policy is set within international and national frameworks, that five plants or fewer are generally not prosecuted but are seized, that no individual exemptions will be granted beyond legal needs, and that the BMC will discuss further steps with patients and analyse samples.
We cannot go into the content of an individual report to Meld Misdaad Anoniem.
Wij kunnen niet ingaan op de inhoud van een individuele melding bij Meld Misdaad Anoniem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over het advies van de AIVD over de nationale veiligheid en veiling 5G

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the AIVD advice on 5G and national security of 4 February 2019 was not sent to parliament earlier or attached to the 1 July letter, and whether the government will adopt the AIVD recommendations on phasing out high-risk suppliers and on open source software. The government answered that the advice was weighed in the Taskforce risk analysis and shared confidentially with parliament, that its 5G approach is country-neutral, that it adopts the AIVD advice for C2000 with a verification study, and that open source software is a long-term option to be pursued at European level.
Because the AIVD and MIVD letter is one part of the Taskforce's analytical process, it was decided not to send the letter separately and outside the context of the report to the House.
Omdat de brief van de AIVD en de MIVD één onderdeel is van het analyseproces van de Taskforce is er voor gekozen de brief niet los en buiten de context van de rapportage aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de humanitaire noodsituatie waarin vluchtelingen in Libië verkeren

MPs asked the government about the humanitarian crisis facing migrants in Libyan detention centres near the conflict zone, including reports of an airstrike on the Tajoura centre, forced labour, and whether the Netherlands would evacuate migrants or offer asylum. The minister answered that the centres are unsafe, that Libya's GNA government agreed to close three centres including Tajoura, that Nederland supports IOM/UNHCR evacuations and ETM resettlement from Niger, but that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission route like Italy's and direct evacuation to the Netherlands is not possible.
The Netherlands has no admission on humanitarian grounds, unlike Italy. Direct evacuation from Libya to the Netherlands is therefore not among the possibilities.
Nederland kent geen toegang op humanitaire gronden, zoals Italië. Directe evacuatie vanuit Libië naar Nederland behoort dan ook niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over de berichten ‘Verkeerde afslag politie’ en ‘OV-bedrijven gaan boerkaverbod niet handhaven’

CDA MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked the ministers how enforcement of the face-covering ban in public transport and public buildings is working after police statements suggested reluctance to prioritise it. The minister replied that the ban must be enforced, that police have aligned their communication with the law, that police can be called in via escalation, and that the law will be evaluated three years after entry into force.
De wet dient te worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Laan-Geselschap en Worfsdorfer over het bericht ‘Deze nieuwe en gevaarlijke cyberaanval wordt gewoon met de post bezorgd’

Four VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about 'warshipping', a reported cyberattack using parcels to plant devices that breach local wifi networks, and how it could be detected, handled and countered. The government answered that it knows the technique but has no known cases in the Netherlands or abroad, that organisations can screen parcels, and that the NCTV and NCSC are aware of the risk and would advise if needed.
I am not aware of any cases in which warshipping has been detected in the Netherlands.
Er zijn mij geen gevallen bekend waarin «warshipping» is geconstateerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het ongevraagd ontvangen van seksueel getinte afbeeldingen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether unsolicited sending of sexually explicit images ('dickpics') is criminal, how many complaints were filed, and whether police would investigate single cases. The minister confirmed such sending can fall under article 240 Sr. and related provisions, said complaint numbers are not recorded, and stated that all sexual offence reports are taken seriously but prioritised case by case, with child abuse given precedence.
Unsolicited sending of sexually explicit images to adults, which are offensive to the decency of persons, is not recorded as such by the police.

Het ongevraagd toesturen van seksueel getinte afbeeldingen naar volwassenen, die aanstootgevend zijn voor de eerbaarheid van personen (zoals dergelijke afbeelding) wordt bij de politie niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Van der Molen over het niet handhaven van het verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

MPs De Pater-Postma and Van der Molen asked why a bus driver in Limburg was reprimanded and police and employer did not support him after enforcing the partial ban on face-covering clothing in public transport, and how enforcement would be made effective. The minister replied that enforcement under the law rests with police and the Public Prosecution Service, that transport staff only address passengers and escalate, that the driver and police acted per the law, and that police response times and a conduct guideline have been agreed.
In the incident on a bus in Stein, both the bus driver and the police officer acted in accordance with the law.
Bij het voorval in een bus in Stein hebben zowel de buschauffeur als de politiemedewerker conform de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen door de leden Van Aalst, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat Arriva haar personeel afvalt als zij het boerkaverbod in de bus handhaven

PVV MPs asked whether the government would condemn Arriva for dismissing a bus driver who enforced the face-covering ban, and whether they would act against transport operators refusing to enforce it. The minister answered that both driver and police acted lawfully, that enforcement is a police and prosecutor task, that operators must only ask riders to remove face coverings, and that no operator currently refuses to comply, so no action is planned yet.
Contacts with public transport companies currently do not show that they refuse to comply with the law.
Uit de contacten met de openbaar vervoer bedrijven blijkt op dit moment niet dat zij de wet weigeren na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het rapport ‘Zorg voor kinderen bij aanhouding van ouders’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a report on child welfare when parents are arrested, including whether police procedures, child checks and reporting should be formalised. The minister largely agreed on the importance of protecting children, said police are examining formalising the approach and possible care reports, but declined to register how many arrests involve children.
Registering such figures is currently not on the agenda.
Het registreren van dergelijke cijfers is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de baby en peuter van een Nederlandse vader die zich zonder ouders in een kamp in Noord-Syrië bevinden

Two MPs from the PvdA ask about two young children of a Dutch jihadist without parents in a camp in northern Syria, including their health, why they were not brought back, and whether consular help can be requested. The government says it cannot comment on individual cases, denies diplomats visited the camp, distinguishes this case from the French repatriation, and notes consular assistance requires a request from the Dutch national or their representative.
As you know, the cabinet cannot go into individual cases in more detail.
Zoals u weet kan het kabinet hier niet nader ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Gezichtendatabase van politie bevat foto’s van 1,3 miljoen mensen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a police facial-image database holds photos of 1.3 million people, including questions on legal basis, scraping, retention periods, proportionality and security. The minister answered that the photos come from suspects under Article 55c Sv (or earlier Article 61a), that scraping is not used, that retention rules overlap and are unclear with a modernisation of the law planned, and that a privacy audit results are expected this autumn.
Complying with the letter of the law would only be possible through a crude selection method that would also destroy data that could contribute to investigating cold cases.
Het alsnog voldoen aan de letter van de wet zou alleen kunnen via een grove selectiemethode waardoor ook gegevens worden vernietigd die kunnen bijdragen aan de opsporing in cold case zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over onevenredige consequenties van het strafblad

An MP asked the Justice Minister about disproportionate consequences of criminal records, including a case where a settlement for a sexual offence stayed on a doctor's record and questions on police interrogation pressure, OM transaction offers and VOG implications. The Minister explained the objection procedure under the WJsg (art. 26) decided by Justid with appeal possible, said OM cannot amend records, and declined to comment on individual cases.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bedrijven feitenonderzoek kunnen doen naar fraude en corruptie

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether companies investigating their own fraud and corruption, with lawyers they hire, is acceptable and how it is controlled, including sentence reductions, transparency and the lawyers' privilege. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the OM and FIOD check such investigations for depth, completeness and accuracy, that the OM does not register the number of cases involving company-led investigations, and that transactions are published with a press release and fact summary.
The number of cases in which company-led fact-finding into fraud and/or corruption played any role is not registered as such by the OM.
Het aantal zaken waarin het feitenonderzoek naar fraude en/of corruptie door bedrijven op enigerlei wijze een rol heeft gespeeld, wordt niet als zodanig geregistreerd bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Westerveld over geweld in de jeugdzorg

MPs Buitenweg and Westerveld asked whether psychological child abuse is punishable under Dutch criminal law and how prosecutors handle it, and what measures the government will take. The minister answered that Article 300 Sr can cover psychological abuse, that the Public Prosecution Service examines such cases case by case, that no Criminal Code revision is currently considered opportune, and listed ongoing programmes and a pending bill strengthening child abuse liability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Geef burger ook veteranenstatus’

An MP asked whether civilian personnel (diplomats, police, aid workers) deployed alongside soldiers in mission areas should receive veteran status and access to the same care. The government answered that civilians receive recognition via the Herinneringsmedaille and existing care arrangements, but that veteran status under the Veteranenwet is tied to the special legal position of military personnel and is therefore not appropriate for civilians.
On the basis of the Veterans Act and the provisions based on it, granting veteran status to diplomats, police officers and aid workers is therefore not appropriate.
Op basis van de Veteranenwet en de daarop berustende bepalingen is het toekennen van de veteranenstatus aan diplomaten, politieagenten en hulpverleners derhalve niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over proces- en vonnisafspraken

The MP asks whether the Public Prosecution Service deliberately experimented with procedural agreements in a criminal case, how the handover failure was handled, and whether a legal basis and a more active policy approach are needed. The Minister says the agreements were not meant as an experiment, transparency was maintained, and a broader inventory and discussion with stakeholders is underway without committing to specific legislation.
The Public Prosecution Service has been transparent about the procedural agreements made with the defence.
Het OM is transparant geweest over de gemaakte procesafspraken met de verdediging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Alziend oog voor politie’

MPs Den Boer and Verhoeven asked the Justice Minister about reports that police use a private foundation, RTR-NL, to watch and link camera footage in a regional surveillance room, raising privacy, discrimination and GDPR concerns. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the police keep operational control, the foundation acts as processor under the Police Data Act, staff are vetted and trained, footage is retained for 7 or 28 days, and no new ICT system or tender was involved.
The police have operational control over the viewing of the footage.
De politie heeft de operationele regie op het uitkijken van de beelden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over duizenden jonge varkens en kippen die in hun stal zijn gestorven door de hitte en de afhankelijkheid van de brandweer om oververhitting van stallen te voorkomen

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the ministers about thousands of pigs and chickens dying from heat in closed stalls after ventilation failures, and about reliance on the fire brigade to cool stalls. Minister Schouten answered that the NVWA handled incidents, that the veterinarian is responsible for emergency and alarm systems, and that many questions could not be answered because the specific farms were not identified; she said the regional safety body decides on fire brigade cooling and that incident reporting will be made mandatory.
I will arrange for such incidents to always be reported to the NVWA.
Ik ga regelen dat dergelijke incidenten altijd gemeld moeten worden bij de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het werkbezoek School en Veiligheid (Oost-Brabant)

An MP asked whether minor juvenile offences, including soft-drug possession, can be referred to Halt quickly without a full official report, and whether the restriction lies in law, policy or local agreements. The Minister explains that Halt referrals for offences via a mutation or simple report are locally arranged, that soft-drug possession is a misdemeanour requiring a report and prosecutor consent, and that a nationally uniform ZSM referral process is being decided in autumn 2019.
In the autumn a decision will be taken on a nationally uniform ZSM process for Halt.
In het najaar vindt besluitvorming plaats over een landelijk uniform ZSM-proces Halt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over de ‘bewapening van boswachters’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked why green BOA rangers at Recreatie Noord-Holland lost their baton and pepper spray, and whether the procedure is clear enough. Minister Grapperhaus explained that the extension was granted with handcuffs only after negative advice from police and prosecutors, that the weapons decision still needs careful review, and that the procedures are clear enough, with the issue to be raised with the BOA unions.
Because the procedure regarding a possible award of these weapons is still ongoing, I refrain from further explanation of this case.
Omdat de procedure ten aanzien van een eventuele toekenning van deze geweldsmiddelen nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een nadere toelichting op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘De mobiele lokdoos werkt niet met 5G’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that IMSI-catchers (mobile 'lokdoos' interception devices) do not work with 5G, and about Europol's concerns over identifying and locating suspects on 5G networks. The government answered that a working group is adapting investigative procedures and rules for 5G, that it is in contact with telecom providers and foreign counterparts, and that private possession of IMSI-catchers remains prohibited.

At present, the interdepartmental working group '5G and investigation', chaired by the police and including the Public Prosecution Service, Agentschap Telecom and the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Justice and Security, is working out which changes in procedure are needed to enable identification and localisation of persons on the 5G network.

Op dit moment wordt in de ambtelijke werkgroep «5G en opsporing» onder voorzitterschap van de politie met daarin het Openbaar Ministerie, Agentschap Telecom en de Ministeries van Economische Zaken en Klimaat en van Justitie en Veiligheid uitgewerkt welke aanpassingen in werkwijze noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘U.S. State Department issues travel advisory for Netherlands due to terrorism concerns’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why the Dutch public is not informed about terrorism risks as the US State Department issued a travel advisory for the Netherlands, and whether the threat is increasing, and proposed closing borders and administrative detention. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the threat level remains level 4 of 5 (substantial), that the US advisory is unchanged rather than raised, and that the NCTV informs the public periodically.
The U.S. Department of State re-issued the travel advisory for American travellers to the Netherlands on 19 July 2019, without changes from the previous period.
De U.S. Department of State heeft het reisadvies voor Amerikaanse reizigers in Nederland op 19 juli 2019 opnieuw vastgesteld, zonder wijzigingen ten opzichte van de vorige periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de uitzending ‘Ruim 350 zedenzaken blijven maanden liggen door onderbezetting’ van Nieuwsuur van 21 augustus

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Nieuwsuur report that serious sex-crime cases wait months or up to a year before police investigate, blaming understaffing, and asked about staffing, consequences and acceptable timelines. The minister acknowledged the delays are unacceptable, cited rising caseloads and capacity fluctuations, and said an Inspectorate study on victim treatment is expected in early 2020.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security is currently investigating the treatment of sex-crime victims in sex-crime cases.
Op dit moment doet de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid onderzoek naar de bejegening van zedenslachtoffers in zedenzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Westerveld over het bericht 'Vijf stenen door de ramen bij journalist Willem Groeneveld van stadsblog Sikkom'

MPs Smeulders and Westerveld asked about the stone-throwing attack on journalist Willem Groeneveld, whether a landlord could be barred from the housing market if linked to it, what is being done to protect journalists, and how malicious landlords are targeted. The minister condemned threats against journalists, deferred on the landlord question until police and prosecutors finish, listed press-freedom and journalist-protection measures, and described pilots and ongoing work against bad landlords without committing to a keurmerk or mystery-guest checks.
Once the investigation is complete, I will consider whether further action on my part is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek zal ik bekijken of verdere actie van mijn kant gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Politiechef Fatima stelt dat ‘klokkenluiders’ intern tegen muur lopen’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers who raise internal misconduct such as intimidation, racism and abuse of power face a 'blue wall of silence', and about monitoring, discipline, exit interviews and independent investigation. The minister said such conduct has no place in the police, that complaints are investigated, that existing programmes and monitoring are in place, and that he sees no reason for an independent investigation.
I currently see no reason for an independent investigation.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het minder Marokkanen proces heeft beïnvloed

Wilders (PVV) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that former minister Opstelten influenced the prosecution decision against Wilders, including a 25 September 2014 meeting, contacts between the ministry and the Public Prosecution Service, draft prosecutorial advice, and a Wob decision. The minister answers largely that no minutes exist, the prosecution service decided independently, and the matter is before the court, providing a timeline and promising no consequences for a whistleblower under the applicable rules.
The OM has since repeatedly stated that it reached this decision independently.
Het OM heeft nadien zoals bekend meermaals aangegeven zelfstandig tot deze beslissing te zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de top van de Nationale Politie interne meldingen over discriminatie, intimidatie en ander ongewenst gedrag zou negeren

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the police leadership ignores internal reports of discrimination and intimidation, and whether it is distant from the workforce, how many officers were reprimanded, whether a team chief was gagged, and whether independent research into workplace safety will be done. The minister denied tolerance of such conduct, pointed to existing internal channels and planned publication of disciplinary figures from 2020, but declined independent research, citing the MedewerkersMonitor.
I have informed your House that the police aims to publish an anonymised annual overview of imposed disciplinary measures starting in 2019.
Ik heb uw Kamer aangegeven dat de politie ernaar streeft om met ingang van 2019 jaarlijks een geanonimiseerd overzicht van opgelegde disciplinaire maatregelen te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over moslimfobie en intimidatie bij de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reported Islamophobia, intimidation and discriminatory language within the police, including alleged leadership inaction, handling of complaints, disciplinary practice and diversity in top positions. The minister condemned discrimination, said the police chief takes all reports seriously, promised a future overview of disciplinary measures from 2020, but declined to comment on individual cases.
I have no insight into police app groups.
Ik heb geen inzicht in politie-appgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over moslimfobie en intimidatie bij de politie

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of racist and discriminatory messages by police officers, intimidation of Muslim colleagues, and a gag order on a team chief, asking whether the minister will sanction, investigate, or set up an inquiry. The minister condemns discrimination in principle, explains disciplinary procedures and existing diversity and reporting measures, declines to give details on individual cases or statistics not in the registrations, and refers to a letter to parliament without committing to an independent inquiry.
I therefore see no reason at this time for an independent investigation.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de politie niet diverser wordt

The MP asks why police attrition among officers with a migration background is high and whether police culture and handling of discrimination complaints contribute, and what will be done to make the force more diverse. The minister agrees diversity improves effectiveness, reports low overall attrition with migrant-background exit share below their intake share, says exit interviews are being developed and discrimination complaints are not recorded, and lists culture measures and recruitment steps including a 25% target.
It cannot currently be determined whether the handling of discrimination complaints is a reason for leaving the organisation.
Het is nu niet te achterhalen of de omgang met klachten over discriminatie een reden voor het verlaten van de organisatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilliger in ruil voor een weekje aan zee’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police capacity shortages in holiday areas, including reports that municipalities rent holiday accommodation for volunteer police officers. The minister answered that seasonal peaks are common across holiday regions, that police units support each other and mayors can request assistance, and that the municipal arrangements are an innovative solution he praised, while promising to explore further cooperation with partners such as DJI for prisoner transport.
If local cooperation partners see options for more intensive cooperation, I will investigate what is legally possible.
Indien lokale samenwerkingspartners opties voor intensievere samenwerking zien, dan zal ik onderzoek doen naar wat er wettelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Raak over het dat agenten op werkvakantie gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police capacity planning accounts for large tourist influxes, such as in Amsterdam and Zeeland, and whether volunteer police deployments solve shortages caused by the hiring freeze. The minister denied any planning gap, described peaks as handled through burgomaster requests and existing capacity, and presented volunteer deployments as an innovative, temporary measure to continue.
No. When allocating strength, account is taken of the average workload and the related need for police capacity.
Nee. Bij de toedeling van sterkte wordt rekening gehouden met de gemiddelde werkdruk en de daaraan gerelateerde behoefte aan politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over ‘Politie wordt niet diverser door afhakers’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether young police officers with a migration background leave within two years, why, and what is being done to make the force more diverse. The minister answered that no legal basis exists to link staff records to cultural background, that CBS data show a 13% share of staff with migration background and a 12% share of leavers, and listed recruitment and retention measures without confirming a causal link.
There is no legal basis for linking personnel data to cultural background.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag om personeelsgegevens te koppelen aan culturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat ruim 200 gemeenten drugsgebruik op straat verbieden terwijl het van de wet mag

An MP asked whether municipal bans on drug use in public spaces conflict with the Opium Act, which does not criminalise use, and whether a general ban is preferable to area-specific bans. The minister replied that municipalities may ban public drug use under their local ordinances without conflicting with the Opium Act, and that the choice of approach is for local authorities to make.
Municipalities are competent under articles 121 and 149 of the Municipalities Act to make (supplementary) ordinances, insofar as these do not conflict with higher regulations.
Gemeenten zijn op grond van artikel 121 en 149 van de Gemeentewet bevoegd tot het maken van (aanvullende) verordeningen, voor zover deze niet in strijd zijn met hogere regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de onrust op het ministerie naar aanleiding van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in de WODC-affaire

Opposition MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked Justice Minister Grapperhaus about the works council's criticism of the ministry's criminal complaint over a leak in the WODC affair, and about interviews of staff by the deputy Secretary-General looking for leakers. The minister defended the complaint as not contrary to the whistleblower scheme, admitted the interviews should not have covered the subject under criminal investigation and that the deputy SG resigned, but gave no records and did not rule out other leak inquiries.
Those conversations therefore should not have been held on that subject.
Deze gesprekken hadden daarom over dat onderwerp niet moeten worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het melden van seksueel geweld

An MP asked whether sexual violence victims report sooner after the offence, whether police and prosecution figures reflect this, whether Centra Seksueel Geweld (CSG) have enough capacity and name recognition, and how the government will encourage reporting. The minister replies that police and prosecution figures show only a slight rise in reports and a fall in suspect inflow, that CSG capacity is adequate, and announces a pilot covering CSG visit costs and a multi-year awareness campaign.
In the autumn I will start a multi-year campaign to increase the willingness of victims of sexual violence to report.
In het najaar start ik een meerjarige campagne om de meldingsbereidheid van slachtoffers van seksueel geweld te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de brief van de minister van Justitie en Veiligheid 'Zaak Julio Poch'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the handling of the Julio Poch case, including whether travel reports from 2008 would be published and whether discussions about extradition to Argentina preceded Argentine investigation. The Minister answered that the May 2008 travel report was released to an independent investigator (Machielse) and promised to inform Parliament of his findings, while maintaining that the discussions were exploratory and not improper.
I have provided the travel report to Mr. Machielse for his investigation and informed your House about it.
Ik heb het reisverslag ten behoeve van zijn onderzoek aan dhr. Machielse verstrekt en uw Kamer erover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over ‘Amper beleid bij forse groei buurtpreventie door burgers'

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the rapid growth of neighbourhood watch apps and patrol teams and the lack of national rules or oversight of them. The minister answered that municipalities handle this locally, that citizens may act within legal limits, that no incident or crime-reduction overview exists, and that the issues (including ethnic profiling and vigilantism) will be raised with the VNG and Interior Ministry.
Vigilantism by citizens cannot be tolerated.
Eigenrichting door burgers kan niet worden getolereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Justitie blundert met persoonlijke brief aan vermoorde Hümeyra’

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Justice about the OM sending a personal victim letter to the murdered Hümeyra, and about protection and handling of stalking reports. The Minister acknowledged a serious error, apologised via letter and a conversation with the family, and said the Inspectorate's investigation is ongoing with results to follow.
The Minister for Legal Protection and I will inform your House as soon as possible after delivery about the outcomes of this Inspectorate investigation.
De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik zullen uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk na oplevering berichten over de uitkomsten van dit Inspectieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er tientallen schorsingen zijn bij de politie om integriteitszaken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether dozens of police suspensions over integrity cases were only the tip of the iceberg, whether the 'Wie praat, die gaat' report could be sent to parliament, whether the Rijksrecherche lacks capacity for integrity cases, and what training is planned against criminal influence. The minister replied that the report concerns drug crime in Central Netherlands and not police suspensions, that it is public and is being sent, that the Rijksrecherche is coping through cooperation and case transfers, and listed existing police integrity training measures.
The report, including the passage the Algemeen Dagblad relied on, gives a picture of the scale of undermining drug crime, which has no relation to police suspensions for integrity matters.
Het rapport geeft, onder andere in de passage waarop het Algemeen Dagblad zich baseert, een weergave van de omvang van het probleem van ondermijnende drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het niet naleven van het hitteprotocol voor dierentransporten door de veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister why pig and poultry farmers kept sending animals to slaughter above the 35°C limit in the heat protocol, and why the NVWA did not intervene at Vion Boxtel despite activist footage. The minister acknowledged the footage, said the NVWA found no violations on the morning in question, reported fines and sanctions issued in the July heat period, and announced the 35°C limit will be codified in law.
As you can read in my letter, I will now legally establish this 35-degree limit for transports taking place exclusively on Dutch territory.
Zoals u in mijn brief kunt lezen ga ik deze grens van 35 graden nu wettelijk vastleggen voor transporten die uitsluitend op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de inspanningen van de Belastingdienst om bij te dragen aan het bestrijden van georganiseerde criminaliteit en het afpakken van misdaadgeld

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked about the Tax Authority's contribution to fighting organised crime and seizing criminal proceeds, including why its EUR 7 million funding request from the Ondermijningsfonds was not honoured and whether regions can set their own priorities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the request was declined due to uncertainty over a pilot, that Tax Authority priorities are set nationally within regional LIEC/RIEC structures, that extra structural funding is planned with details due on Prinsjesdag, and that asset-seizure ambitions are being pursued jointly with the Public Prosecution Service.
Given the operational nature of the spending proposals submitted by the other partners, I will not make the reinforcement plans public.
Gezien de operationele aard van de bestedingsvoorstellen die door de overige partners zijn ingediend zal ik de versterkingsplannen niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Tientallen foute agenten geschorst’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports of dozens of corrupt police officers being suspended, the handling of integrity cases, and Rijksrecherche capacity. The minister answered that the cited report concerns drug crime networks rather than police corruption, that disciplinary statistics are not yet available in a specific form, that the Rijksrecherche is working to increase output, and that integrity measures and registration improvements are being pursued.
At this moment it is still too labour-intensive to generate the total number for specific disciplinary measures.
Op dit moment is het nog te arbeidsintensief om het totaal aantal voor specifieke disciplinaire maatregelen te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over een onderzoek naar de veiligheid van constructies in publieke gebouwen

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked whether public buildings are regularly checked for structural safety, why wind loads are not studied, and how the findings of the 2016 football stadium safety audit were followed up. The minister replied that building owners and municipalities are responsible, that no mandatory periodic inspection exists, that targeted inspection duties are used for specific building types, and that the stadium audit was discussed with clubs and municipalities without new specific standards.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the collapse of the roof of the AZ stadium.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht “Recordvangst crystal meth in Rotterdam ter waarde van honderden miljoenen”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a record crystal meth seizure in Rotterdam, police concern, Mexican cartel involvement, European cooperation, user numbers and convictions. The minister answered that no suspects were arrested, three to four labs were found in the Netherlands in 2019, there is no concrete evidence of cartels gaining a foothold, and cooperation with Mexico and Europe is good, while conviction and user figures are not specifically recorded.
The investigation is still ongoing and, in its interest, no further statements can be made at this time.
Op dit moment is het onderzoek nog in volle gang en kunnen in het belang daarvan geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en Fritsma over het bericht dat bij een Duits-Nederlandse grenscontrole 27 overtredingen van de Vreemdelingenwet zijn geconstateerd

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of 27 Immigration Act violations found at a joint German-Dutch border check, including nationalities, criminal records, Islamic background, detentions and deportations, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers and Islamic-country migrants. The government answered that 10 Dutch-side cases involved persons without residence permits (nationalities listed, no criminal records found, religion not registered), rejected categorical border closure as unrealistic, and noted the Marechaussee already performs border surveillance.
Based on information and registers available to the Marechaussee, no criminal records were found for the 10 persons named.
Op basis van bij de KMar beschikbare informatie en registers zijn bij de 10 genoemde personen geen criminele antecedenten gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Inlichtingendiensten: stop je intimiderende bezoekjes’

MPs Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether intelligence and police informant recruitment targeting climate activists was intimidating, disproportionate and lawful, and how citizens can hold the state to account on climate and rights. Minister Grapperhaus replied that individual cases cannot be discussed for confidentiality reasons, that police must act within legal frameworks and handle complaints, and that the government shares concern about climate policy pace.
As I stated in my letter of 18 June (Kamerstuk 29 628, no. 885), given the confidentiality, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Zoals ik gemeld heb in mijn brief van 18 juni jl. (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr. 885 ), kan er gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat criminelen amateurvoetbalclubs infiltreren

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that criminals are infiltrating amateur football clubs, including their motives, what clubs and local authorities can require from sponsors (such as certificates of conduct and Bibob screening), and whether Bibob can be extended. The minister answered that criminal motives vary, pointed to existing tools and guidance, said he will discuss the findings and a related motion with the health and sport minister, but left the clubs and municipalities largely responsible for vetting sponsors.
I will discuss the findings of the study commissioned by the Taskforce Brabant Zeeland with my colleague at VWS, though these are not yet available.
Ik zal met mijn ambtgenoot van VWS de uitkomsten van het onderzoek dat in opdracht van de Taskforce Brabant Zeeland is uitgevoerd – die overigens thans nog niet beschikbaar zijn – bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over tbs voor verkrachters

The MP Kuiken asks whether a psychiatric disorder should be presumed for the most serious rapists so that TBS can be imposed without a forensic PJ report, and whether this would resolve the problem of suspects refusing observation. The minister answers that not every rapist has a disorder, that the EUR report advises against presumption as disproportionate, and that the government is pursuing other measures to reduce refusals and their effect.
I have committed to mapping, together with the Public Prosecution Service, the practice of carrying out PJ reports in serious sexual offence cases.
Ik heb daarbij toegezegd dat ik met het Openbaar Ministerie de praktijk van het uitvoeren van PJ-rapportages bij ernstige zedenzaken in kaart zal brengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Te veel beperkingen voor Bijbelstudie in azc’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a group Bible study by asylum seekers in their own room at the Gilze-Rijen reception centre, which COA had not allowed, is consistent with freedom of religion and with COA rules. The State Secretary answered that group religious or political gatherings beyond the family are not permitted to protect other residents' privacy, that individuals may practise religion privately, and that no further talks with COA are planned.
Political and/or religious (organised) group gatherings, larger than the family unit, are not permitted.
Politieke en of religieuze (georganiseerde) groepsbijeenkomsten, groter dan het gezinsverband, zijn niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over tbs voor verkrachters

An MP asks whether a legal rule should require a rape court to consider TBS (compulsory psychiatric treatment) for the most serious rape cases, unless the suspect proves no psychiatric disorder, and asks for a study of this with results before year-end. The minister refers to the answer to earlier Kamervragen rather than addressing the proposal directly.
For the answer to this question I refer you to the answer to questions 3 and 4 of the parliamentary questions submitted on 28 May 2019.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar het antwoord op vraag 3 en 4 van de Kamervragen ingezonden op 28 mei 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Actieve handel in privégegevens uit kentekenregister: ‘Schokkend en gevaarlijk’’

An MP asked the ministers about an RTL Nieuws report that vehicle register data including names and home addresses was being sold online, and how the leak occurred, who can access the data, and what is being done. The minister answered that the RDW had no prior knowledge of misuse, a police investigation and an external review of extra safeguards are underway, and the RDW logs access and audits its security annually.
Until the outcomes of that investigation are known, I cannot make any statements about it.
Totdat de uitkomsten daarvan bekend zijn, kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de stevige kritiek van de commissaris van de Koning in Noord-Brabant op de staat van de strafrechtketen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about sharp criticism from the Brabant commissaris van de Koning of the criminal justice chain, including understaffing, bureaucracy and digital backlog, and whether crime pays and police recruitment will meet targets. The Minister largely agrees with the criticism, points to chain cooperation priorities, anti-money-laundering and asset-recovery measures, extra funding, and monitoring of police recruitment, committing to keep the House informed.
I am closely monitoring developments and will of course keep your House informed.
Ik monitor de ontwikkelingen nauw, en houd uw Kamer hier vanzelfsprekend van op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat er minder festivals georganiseerd moeten worden om drugsgebruik tegen te gaan

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister whether he still stands by his remark that fewer festivals should be organised to curb drug use, and whether festivals are a municipal matter. The minister said he does not advocate fewer festivals but that organisers and local authorities should weigh whether the ban on hard drugs can be enforced before a festival is permitted, and that he will consult the parties on a more uniform approach.
I am not advocating a reduction in the number of festivals as such.
Ik pleit niet voor een afname van het aantal festivals als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers about reports that Poland was prosecuting critical academics, the rule-of-law procedure against Poland, and the Commission's rule-of-law communication. The government answered that the threatened prosecution was dropped, that it will voice concern about Poland's rule of law at EU level, and that it will study the Commission's proposals before reporting further.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Politie jaagt nabestaanden onnodig op kosten na een overlijden: Bedragen lopen op tot zeshonderd euro'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police pass costs of transporting bodies to mortuaries on to bereaved families when death proves natural. The minister explained the cost-allocation scheme, the 2017 tender for transport, and that the next tender is planned for 2025 under the then-current scheme.
I understand that bereaved families may find this unpleasant in some cases.
Ik begrijp dat de nabestaanden dit in sommige gevallen als vervelend kunnen ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘WhatsApp Rushes to Fix Security Flaw Exposed in Hacking of Lawyer’s Phone’

An MP asked ministers about a report that WhatsApp rushed to fix a security flaw exposed in the hacking of a lawyer's phone, and about NSO Group's hacking software being used against dissidents and journalists. The minister said vulnerabilities should be reported to vendors, that export controls and screening of suppliers apply, but declined to say which regimes bought NSO software.
I have no insight into the customer base of NSO Group and therefore cannot make statements about NSO Group's sales policy.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het klantenbestand van de NSO Group en kan dus geen uitspraken doen over het verkoopbeleid van de NSO Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘De voorzitter van moskeekoepel CMO houdt er alweer mee op’

MPs Van Dam and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government engages with the Contactorgaan Moslims en Overheid (CMO), its membership, representativeness and agenda, after reports that its chairman was stepping down. The ministers answered that the CMO is the government's contact body for Muslim communities, lists its member organisations, and state that the government has no specific agenda with the CMO and that representation is up to the organisations themselves.
The cabinet has no specific agenda in advance for contact with the CMO.
Het kabinet heeft op voorhand geen specifieke agenda voor het contact met de CMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vergelijking van rechtsstelsels en de methode van het World Justice Project

An SP MP asks the Ministers of Justice and Security and for Legal Protection why the government relies on the World Justice Project rule of law ranking, questioning its survey method, the expert sample, the unclear identity of the fieldwork company and whether firm conclusions about Dutch courts can be drawn. The Minister for Legal Protection defends the index as one of several indicators, says the 21 experts and the fieldwork contractors are as disclosed by the WJP, and maintains that the Dutch rule of law functions well.
As previously indicated, the World Justice Project has informed me that it contracted YouGov to carry out the population survey.
Zoals ook al eerder aangeven heeft het World Justice Project mij laten weten dat zij YouGov gecontracteerd hebben om het bevolkingsonderzoek uit te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Onderwereld beraamt weer aanslag op Brabantse agent'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the criminal underworld plotted another attack on a Brabant police officer, why a January death-threat case is still under investigation, and how threats against police are prosecuted and protected against. The minister declined to discuss ongoing investigations, described the prosecution approach and a proposed higher maximum penalty for threats, and outlined existing protection and aftercare measures for officers.
No, I cannot provide information about ongoing criminal investigations.
Nee, over lopende opsporingsonderzoeken kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Geleijnse en Krol over leeftijd-onderscheid bij verzekeringen

Three MPs from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Finance Ministers about a 75-year age ceiling in an American Express travel insurance policy linked to Flying Blue, and whether it amounts to age discrimination and insufficient disclosure. The government declined to judge the contracts, noted that American Express has removed the age ceiling, and pointed to complaint routes and the AFM's supervisory role over information duties.
It is not for me to pass judgement on the assessment of contracts.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er woede is over de woekerhandel in kaartjes voor een voetbalwedstrijd

An SP MP asked the government about ticket scalping for the Feyenoord-Ajax match, including enforcement, a national ban, ACM action, EU initiatives, and transparency obligations for ticket resellers. The Staatssecretaris answered that a national ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, that clubs block scalped tickets under KNVB conditions, and that the government will not pursue further national rules given the cross-border nature of the problem.
I do not have the means at my disposal to map the total extent of this problem, since it is a cross-border matter.
Ik heb niet de middelen tot mijn beschikking om de totale omvang van deze problematiek in kaart te brengen, aangezien het hier gaat om een grensoverschrijdende aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de dood van een Nederlands echtpaar in de Caribische zee

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the death of a Dutch couple at sea near Colombia, including whether the families are kept informed, whether capacity and Colombian cooperation are adequate, and the role of the Dutch liaison officer. The minister answered that families are kept regularly informed, that the investigation team has sufficient capacity, that Colombian execution times are not exceptionally long, and that cooperation is of good quality.
The investigation team regularly and continuously keeps the next of kin informed of the status of the criminal investigation.
Het onderzoeksteam houdt de nabestaanden regelmatig en doorlopend op de hoogte van de stand van zaken van het strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over de statushouder die een 68 jarige vrouw doodmartelde
