MPs from the PVV asked whether the statushouder (refugee status holder) suspected of a fatal assault on a 68-year-old woman would have his residence permit revoked and be deported, how screening failed to catch him, and whether asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries should be barred. The minister replied that individual cases are not discussed, outlined the screening and monitoring process, said revocation is limited by EU and refugee-convention rules and that the government will not categorically close borders.
In principle I make no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in beginsel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel schade door ‘bitcoin-advertenties’ met nepuitspraken BN’ers’

MPs from the VVD asked ministers about misleading bitcoin advertisements using fake quotes from well-known Dutch people, the scale of resulting harm, whether police, prosecutors, the AFM and social media platforms can act, and what tools exist to identify advertisers and protect consumers and the persons whose names are misused. The government answered that the advertisers are unknown, reported about 1.7 million euro in reported damage, explained existing criminal, consumer-law and civil remedies, and said crypto-assets generally fall outside AFM supervision and no new national regulation is advised.
It is not known who or which organisations commissioned the placement of these misleading advertisements.
Het is niet bekend wie of welke organisaties opdrachtgever zijn van plaatsing van deze misleidende advertenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlanders parkeerboetes ontlopen

An MP asked why foreign drivers avoid parking fines and whether Germany and Poland hide behind EU rules to withhold residents' data. The minister agreed foreign visitors should follow the same parking rules, explained that unpaid parking charges are municipal tax assessments outside the EU cross-border enforcement directive, and said municipalities may use wheel clamps while the government will consult Germany about resuming data exchange.
I will, together with my colleague at BZK, consult with my German counterparts to see how we can resume this exchange.
Ik zal samen met mijn ambtsgenoot van BZK met mijn Duitse collega’s in overleg treden om te bezien, hoe we deze uitwisseling weer kunnen hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verkoop van nazipropaganda via internet

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether selling Nazi propaganda online is prohibited and whether it promotes antisemitism and extremist circulation. The minister answered that such sales may fall under article 137e of the Penal Code but must be judged case by case under case law, and that the Public Prosecution Service will act under its discrimination guidelines where appropriate.
Where appropriate, the Public Prosecution Service will act in accordance with the discrimination guidelines when such material is distributed.
In voorkomende gevallen zal het Openbaar Ministerie bij de verspreiding van dergelijk materiaal conform de aanwijzing discriminatie 5 optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Buitenlanders ontlopen parkeerboete, landen willen adressen niet geven’

Two VVD MPs asked why foreign drivers escape parking fines because some countries, notably Germany, no longer provide registered-keeper addresses, and what can be done. The minister acknowledged the problem (roughly tens of thousands of unpaid fines, at least EUR 1 million a year), explained that EU cross-border rules cover only traffic offences not parking, and committed to exploring bilateral data exchange, starting with Germany.

Together with my colleagues at the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, I will examine what options exist for reaching a similar exchange with other countries.

Ik zal, samen met mijn collega´s van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om met andere landen tot een soortgelijke uitwisseling te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het online bestellen van wapens en drugs

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether weapons and drugs can be ordered easily online, whether the government knew of this, and what it will do about parcel checks and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the problem, said parcel legitimation is not warranted, pointed to the EU firearms directive and a forthcoming letter and action programme, but gave no concrete new measures.
This investigation by the Inside programme maker gives no reason to reconsider the identification requirement for sending postal parcels.
Dit onderzoek van de programmamaker van Inside geeft geen aanleiding om legitimatieplicht bij het versturen van postpakketten te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Nederlandse kinderen uit Syrië

Two PvdA MPs asked whether MIVD staff or Dutch diplomats regularly visit the Al-Roj camp in Syria to prepare repatriation, how often delegations have visited, and whether the Netherlands prepares for returning children and their parents. The ministers declined to comment publicly on intelligence service methods, called the report of biweekly diplomatic visits incorrect, and stated that returnees will be brought back in a controlled manner for prosecution while children are treated as victims and childcare plans are ready.
No public statements are made about the working methods of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over de werkwijze van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de uitzending van Radar over drugsdumpingen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about drug waste dumpings on private land, including whether owners should be expected to take preventive measures, whether full compensation for clean-up costs is warranted, and whether convicted dumpers could fund a victims' fund. The government answered that owners need not take preventive measures, that full compensation for direct clean-up costs for private owners will be provided through provincial schemes and structural funding, and that a victims' fund and separate co-financing arrangements are still being explored by the intergovernmental working group.
In connection with drug dumpings, citizens who have committed no offence are not obliged to take measures to prevent the dumping of drug waste, nor to clean up dumped drug waste.

In samenhang met drugsdumpingen zijn burgers die geen overtreding hebben begaan, niet verplicht om maatregelen te nemen om dumping van drugsafval tegen te gaan en ook niet om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked how much of the earlier co-financing budget for drug waste clean-up remained unspent, whether private owners should be compensated for clean-up costs, and what the government will do to provide structural funding. The government answered that EUR 1.2 million remained unspent and is available to provinces, that EUR 1 million per year is now structurally reserved for 2019-2024, and that responsibility for clean-up lies with regional and local authorities, with private owners to be compensated where they bear no fault.
The cabinet now makes available structurally another EUR 1 million per year for 2019 to 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked whether innocent private landowners should not have to pay for clearing drug waste dumped on their land, following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences the government draws. The Staatssecretaris replied that regional and local authorities are primarily responsible, notes provincial subsidy schemes, and announces a structural 1 million euro per year from 2019 to 2024 so that private owners are fully compensated for direct clean-up costs and municipalities partly compensated.

The cabinet now makes available structurally another 1 million euro per year for 2019 through 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over illegale drugsdumpingen

Two SP MPs asked who is responsible for cleaning up illegal drug waste after the Raad van State ruled that landowners need not pay, and asked about the status of inter-governmental talks, funding, and urgency. The Minister answered that regional and local authorities bear responsibility, that the cabinet will provide EUR 1 million per year structurally for co-financing direct clean-up costs, and that proposals for a structural co-financing scheme will come before the summer recess.

The cabinet now makes available structurally EUR 1 million per year for the period 2019 through 2024 on the budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security to (co)finance the direct costs of clean-up of drug dumping.
Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 mln. per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het programma Medialogica

An SP MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the Medialogica broadcast and earlier government cooperation with the programme Ontvoerd on child abduction cases, including an emergency passport, internal official doubts, and police information sharing. The minister defended the passport decision, acknowledged that police and prosecutors have contacted programme makers case by case, and announced a stricter police instruction and an ongoing investigation into a leaked arrest warrant.
Going forward, the June 2018 email from the Legal Affairs department has been developed into a more detailed instruction.
Naar de toekomst toe is het e-mailbericht van de afdeling Juridische Zaken uit juni 2018 uitgewerkt tot een nadere instructie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over de aanpak van mestfraude

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about the government's approach to manure fraud, including reporting channels, how reports are registered and handled, and cross-border enforcement with Belgium. Minister Schouten answered that no single body collects all reports, that reports via official channels are registered, and that 63 processes-verbaal from 2017 led to mostly convictions and some transactions, while declining to give full regional report counts for the police.
There is no body that collects all reports, including those from all other bodies.
Er is geen instantie die alle meldingen, ook van alle andere instanties, verzamelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Eritreeër verdacht van verkrachting in Oisterwijk: ‘Het is opgelost, we gaan trouwen’'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice and Security Minister about a news report on an Eritrean suspect in a rape case in Oisterwijk, including whether such cases are common and whether the suspect should be prosecuted and expelled. The Minister condemned sexual violence, noted police capacity, declined to comment on the ongoing case, said figures on comparable cases are not registered, and left prosecution decisions to the Public Prosecution Service.
It does not befit me as Minister to make statements about the case at this time.
Het past mij als Minister niet op dit moment uitspraken te doen over de betreffende zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de Nederlandse drugsaanpak

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Dutch drug approach is still adequate against organised crime, whether a research commission on regulation or legalisation should be set up, and whether prevention should be strengthened. The minister answered that the approach is reviewed regularly, rejected a new research commission on hard drugs given the international consensus, and pointed to an ongoing cannabis experiment and new prevention measures.
Establishing a committee to conduct research as proposed is therefore not, in my view, appropriate.
Het in het leven roepen van een commissie die onderzoek gaat doen zoals wordt voorgesteld, acht ik dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat een varkenshouder met beroepsverbod in Duitsland zijn varkensstal in Nederland gewoon uit mag breiden

An MP asks the Ministers of Agriculture and Justice how a pig farmer banned from practising in Germany can still expand his Dutch stables, and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The minister replies that the German ban does not apply in the Netherlands, that NVWA has inspected the farm 22 times with interventions, and that a tightened enforcement bill is planned, while the EU blacklist exploration is still in progress.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat repressie niet meer voldoende is in drugsaanpak

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice and Health ministers how they view claims that repression alone is insufficient for drug policy, including criminal recruitment into the drug market, the normalisation of drug use, and calls for evaluation or an expert commission. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch policy balances health and justice, points to prevention measures, the ondermijning funding and a closed cannabis chain experiment, and declined to set up a commission.
Setting up a committee is therefore not, in my view, opportune.
Het in het leven roepen van een commissie acht ik dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over de middelen die het notariaat ter beschikking heeft om fraude te bestrijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether the notariat has enough tools to combat fraud, including BV fraud after the removal of preventive checks, EU digital incorporation, a VAT-number pre-check scheme and a central shareholder register. The minister acknowledges the notary's gatekeeper role, is in talks with the KNB, denies a clear causal link to simplified BV law, rejects the VAT pre-check idea because of the fiscal confidentiality duty, and says the government will prepare a position on the shareholder register initiative.
I am in discussion with the KNB about the instruments the notariat needs, given its gatekeeper role.
Ik ben in gesprek met de KNB over het instrumentarium dat voor het notariaat, vanwege diens poortwachtersrol, nodig en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht '1600 kinderen verdwenen uit de asielopvang'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that 1,600 unaccompanied minors disappeared from asylum reception, including origin countries, possible trafficking networks, investigation, and detention options. The state secretary confirmed the figure but said it is unverified, pointed to two pending investigations (an analysis of migration-chain data and an EMM study due in autumn), explained existing measures, and announced a planned policy change adding a fourth detention ground.

Depending on the findings, it will be examined which additional measures, including at international level, need to be taken to prevent as far as possible the departure of unaccompanied minors to unknown destinations.

Afhankelijk van de bevindingen daarvan zal gekeken worden welke aanvullende maatregelen, ook in internationaal verband, genomen moeten worden om het vertrek met onbekende bestemming van amv's zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 1600 kinderen die verdwenen zijn uit asielopvang

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that 1,600 children disappeared from asylum reception, including whether those placed with Nidos and those leaving before registration are counted, and what protection and police action will follow. The state secretary said the figures are unverified and centrally unrecorded, pointed to pending analyses and an EMM study due in autumn, and noted police procedures and expanded trafficking investigation capacity.

On the basis of the data provided by COA and Nidos, no statement can be made about the number of unaccompanied minors who leave for an unknown destination before arriving in Ter Apel, because no central registration of this takes place.

Op basis van de verschafte gegevens van het COA en Nidos kan geen uitspraak gedaan worden over het aantal amv's dat nog vóór aankomst in Ter Apel vertrekt met onbekende bestemming, omdat hiervan geen centrale registratie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat Nederland met kinderlevens speelt

MP Buitenweg asks whether Dutch children in Kurdish camps without parental care should be repatriated, and what the consequences of revoking a parent's Dutch nationality are for the children. The government answers that about 90 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that revocation does not affect already-born children's nationality, that it sees no treaty obligation to repatriate, and that it assesses orphan cases case by case without sending people into unsafe areas.
The cabinet continues to assess cases of Dutch orphaned children on a case-by-case basis and to explore the possibilities.
Het kabinet blijft gevallen van Nederlandse weeskinderen van zaak tot zaak beoordelen en de mogelijkheden verkennen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht ‘Te weinig tijd, te veel moeite, te veel geld: IND stuurde criminelen niet weg’

Becker (VVD) asked whether IND staff, under workload and management pressure, deliberately chose non-revocation of residence permits for criminal asylum seekers instead of pursuing revocation, and whether the government would tighten discretion and reassess such cases. The state secretary answered that the internal reports show no such deliberate steering, that prioritisation under workload is normal, that revocation follows when legally warranted, and that no reassessment is needed; she is still examining how much extra capacity the revocation team needs.

From the two reports it has not appeared to me that, due to workload and management pressure, there was a deliberate increase in non-revocations of residence permits and closing of files of criminal asylum seekers.

Uit de twee verslagen is mij niet gebleken dat vanwege werkdruk en druk vanuit het management bewust is overgegaan tot het opvoeren van niet-intrekkingen van de verblijfsvergunning en het afsluiten van dossiers van criminele asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de rapportage vreemdelingenketen 2018

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister about the 2018 asylum chain report, including why serious crimes were filed under 'other' and why police and prosecution were gagged. The state secretary largely deferred to a pending evaluation, agreed that the nuance between suspect registration and conviction matters, and pointed to ongoing ministry change programmes.

As I indicated in my letter to the House of 1 July 2019, an evaluation of the preparation and decision-making process that led to the incident overview in the 2018 Asylum Chain Report is currently underway.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 1 juli 2019 vindt op dit moment een evaluatie plaats van het proces van voorbereiding en besluitvorming dat heeft geleid tot incidentenoverzicht in de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Meer  migranten claimen slachtoffer van mensenhandel te zijn’

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked whether rising numbers of African migrants claiming to be trafficking victims undermine the trafficking regime and asylum procedures, and whether the law could be changed. The State Secretary confirmed a sharp rise in trafficking reports, especially from Nigerian Dublin claimants, said this overloads police and prosecution and that the Dublin claim lapses when a residence permit is granted, and said a package of measures would follow.
By letter of 28 June 2019 I informed your House about an integrated package of measures addressing the above problems.
Bij brief van 28 juni 2019 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over een integraal pakket aan maatregelen die bovengenoemde problematiek adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over intimidatie van toezichthouders door de vee- en vleessector

An MP asked the ministers about the assault on an NVWA veterinary inspector at an abattoir, the abattoir's prior violations, and the safety of inspectors working alone, including incident figures and transport and market controls. The minister condemned the violence, explained the suspension and its conditions (owner absent during inspections, two-person inspections at the company's cost), and answered many questions with incident data, while stating that many incident figures are not recorded.
Unfortunately, aggression and violence against NVWA inspectors do occur more often.
Het komt helaas vaker voor dat agressie en geweld tegen NVWA-inspecteurs wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de brandbrief van het Strategisch Overleg Mensenhandel (SOM) aan Tweede Kamer inzake de tijdelijke werkwijze Dublinoverdrachten

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked the Minister about an SOM/ZoCo letter claiming a de facto stop on human trafficking reports because Dublin transfers proceed before victims can file complaints, and about links to Operation Koolvis. The State Secretary replied that no new procedure exists, that transfers of claimants who could not report are rare, that police are working to handle reports faster, and that a new working method and further steps are being developed.
There is no new, temporary working method.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuwe, tijdelijke, werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de erkenning van gevangenisstraffen uit andere EU-landen

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister why Hungary refuses to take over enforcement of a Dutch national's sentence that the Netherlands had agreed to, and about the EU framework rules, typical durations, resocialisation effects and whether the minister will raise this with other states. The minister answers that the framework decision creates no obligation for the sentencing state to request transfer, that the Dutch procedure was not unusually long, that roughly half of transfers finish within deadlines, that Bureau Buitenland and municipal aftercare support returnees, and that no action with counterparts is planned.
In principle there is no obligation for the sentencing state to submit a request for recognition.
Er bestaat in beginsel geen verplichting voor de staat van veroordeling om een verzoek tot erkenning in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council of Europe’

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the ministers whether the government was aware of, and shocked by, the Council of Europe Commissioner's report on Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food, and whether it had raised this with Hungary or the EU. The government answered that it knows the report, shares the concerns, raises them bilaterally and in the EU, notes Commission infringement procedures, and supports a formal Article 7 dialogue with Hungary.
The cabinet will continue to raise the concerns both bilaterally and at European level with the Hungarian authorities.
Het kabinet blijft de zorgen in zowel bilateraal als Europees verband uitspreken richting de Hongaarse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘U.S. sanctions Congo election officials, says they obstructed vote’

MP Ploumen asks the government whether it knows of US sanctions on Congolese election officials for obstructing the vote, and about corruption, the effects of EU and US sanctions, network-based sanctioning and criminal money flows in the DRC. Minister Blok answers that the Netherlands is in contact with the US, that EU and US sanctions target individuals obstructing the election, that network-based sanctions were not an EU criterion, and that tracing illicit money flows is being pursued with partners such as The Sentry.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over blokkeermoslims’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service acted quickly against 'blokkeerfriezen' but not against 'blokkeermoslims' who disrupted a demonstration, and whether he would instruct prosecution and guarantee the right to demonstrate. The Minister said a criminal investigation is ongoing and declined to comment on the case, refused to instruct prosecutors in individual cases, and stated that mayors are responsible for maintaining public order under the Public Assembly Act.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation. While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot comment on this criminal case.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek. Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitlatingen doen over deze strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Betoging Pegida in Eindhoven opnieuw verboden'

Two PVV MPs asked why a Pegida demonstration in Eindhoven was banned again and whether all mayors would be reminded that Dutch law, not sharia, applies. The minister answered that protest management is a mayoral responsibility, that demonstrations may only be banned as a last resort and never because of their content, and that no letter to all mayors is planned.
Banning or ending a (peaceful) demonstration is a last resort and only applies when necessary to protect public health, traffic, or to prevent or combat public disorder.

Daarbij geldt dat het verbieden of beëindigen van een (vreedzame) demonstratie een uiterst middel is en uitsluitend aan de orde is als dat noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid, in het belang van het verkeer of ter bestrijding of voorkoming van wanordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Syriëstrijder opgepakt in Kapelle’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Syria fighter arrested in Kapelle, asking how many such persons entered the Netherlands, how screening failed, and whether they would stop admitting asylum seekers from Islamic countries and denaturalise terrorists. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said screening and signal-reporting procedures exist, rejected closing borders as unrealistic, and noted nationality can only be revoked for convicted terrorists who hold another nationality.
I cannot go into the facts and circumstances of this individual case.
Op de feiten en omstandigheden in dit individuele geval kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Politieacademie past fitheidstest aan na klachten'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister whether adjusting the police Professioneel Fit test relates to the police recruitment shortage, whether the VU study will be shared, which changes were made, and whether rejected candidates will be re-invited. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the changes aim at fairness and objectivity rather than easing the test, that the full VU report is expected after summer 2019, and that previously rejected candidates will not be re-invited, though they may retake the test.
Yes, the full research report is expected after the summer of 2019 and will be made available to you as soon as it is ready.
Ja, het volledige onderzoekrapport wordt na de zomer van 2019 verwacht en u ter beschikking gesteld zodra gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost, Voordewind en Segers over de berichten 'Iraans anti-Israëlprotest bereikt ook westerse steden' en 'CIDI: Stop haatdemonstraties Iraans regime in Nederland'

MPs Drost, Voordewind and Segers asked whether calls to destroy Israel and the United States at a demonstration in The Hague were incitement to hatred, whether police should have ended it, whether an interpreter was present, and whether Iran was behind it. The minister answered that the demonstration right allows offensive speech, police found no criminal offences, an interpreter was present, and the cabinet has no concrete indication of Iranian involvement.
The right to demonstrate also includes publicly expressing opinions or statements that may be experienced as annoying, offensive or shocking.
Het demonstratierecht omvat ook het publiekelijk uiten van meningen of uitlatingen die als hinderlijk, aanstootgevend of choquerend kunnen worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Markuszower over de aanpak van een Algerijn die bijna een Groningse held doodstak

PVV MPs Fritsma and Markuszower asked why an Algerian offender who nearly killed a Groningen victim was released rather than deported, and why the victim was given unclear information about the case. The State Secretary acknowledged a Dublin transfer deadline was missed during detention, leading to release after the sentence, and said the offender was later re-detained with a return decision issued, while refusing to rule out an asylum stop and declining to report more on the individual case citing privacy.
Mistakenly, a request for postponement was not made in time to the EU member state responsible, so the transfer could not proceed.
Abusievelijk is nagelaten om tijdig aan de verantwoordelijke EU-lidstaat om uitstel te vragen, waardoor de overdracht geen doorgang kon vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Staatsvijand nummer één deradicaliseert maar niet’

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about press reports that a convicted jihadist (Samir A.) was not deradicalised despite a government-supported trajectory, and about how agencies coordinate, who leads, whether financing of terrorism is prosecuted, and what happens to those who are not receptive. The minister acknowledged the trajectory failed, defended the TER team's effectiveness, described the coordination mechanisms and roles, and stated that prosecution is an opportunity decision for the OM, but gave no concrete new commitment.
When in 2015 it appeared that the intended goal, demonstrable deradicalisation of A., was not achieved, the deployment of this expert was ended.
Toen in 2015 bleek dat het beoogde doel, aantoonbare deradicalisering van A., niet werd behaald, is de inzet van deze expert beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap, Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Venlo hotspot voor snelwegcrimineel’

MPs asked about rising cargo theft and mobile banditry targeting truck drivers near Venlo, including secure parking, EU action and prosecution of foreign suspects. The minister answered that incidents are falling, cited secure truck parking projects, joint task forces and prosecution measures, and committed to continued talks with the transport sector.
Compared with other European countries, the number of registered reports of transport crime in the Netherlands is relatively higher.
Vergeleken met andere Europese landen is het aantal geregistreerde meldingen van transportcriminaliteit in Nederland relatief hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Lege tank niet beboet’

Deputy Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether drivers who run out of fuel and stop on motorway hard shoulders should be fined, given that such stops are avoidable and the Leeuwarden court treated fuel shortage as an emergency. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no data on such stops or related accidents are registered, that running out of fuel is in principle avoidable but hard to prove negligence on, and that a fine reintroduction is not preferred, with Article 5 of the Road Traffic Act available for genuinely dangerous conduct.
No, that data is not known.
Nee, die gegevens zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Top politieschool moet weg wegens gebrek aan chemie’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Police Academy's top leadership must leave due to insufficient chemistry, and about how this affects leadership continuity, teacher workload and recruitment of 17,000 new officers. The minister confirmed the director stays until a successor is found, an interim operations head was appointed, a recruitment procedure will include external candidates, and extra teachers and a temporary Leusden location are being funded.
An interim head of operations has been appointed with extensive police experience in both operations and business management.
Er is een interim hoofd bedrijfsvoering benoemd met ruime ervaring binnen de politie, zowel in de operatiën als in de bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de aanbesteding van het CJIB

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked about the CJIB tendering of debt collection to bailiffs, including who takes over existing debts, costs for debtors, the abandoned postcode-based allocation model, protection of debtors' interests and the link with the Rijksincassovisie. The minister answered that the minimum subsistence amount is reset after 12 months, bailiff tariffs are statutory and unchanged, the old arrondissement-based model was dropped in 2001 to promote competition, and tendering allows bundling of one debtor's claims and selection of bailiffs aligned with the Rijksincassovisie.
The CJIB is committed to socially responsible collection and enforcement in line with cabinet policy.
Het CJIB zet zich in voor het sociaal-maatschappelijk verantwoord innen en incasseren conform het kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Koppen rollen door crisis Politieacademie'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a press report on leadership turmoil at the Police Academy, whether governance gaps contributed, and how candidates can contest recruitment decisions. The minister confirmed the governance gaps contributed, said a new mandate arrangement is being prepared, and explained that candidates cannot appeal selection decisions but can object and request reconsideration.
The identified lack of integrality did indeed influence the situation within the management team of the Police Academy.
Het geconstateerde gebrek aan integraliteit is inderdaad beïnvloedend geweest op de ontstane situatie binnen het directieteam van de Politieacademie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Blauwe Moskee biedt podium aan radicale prediker’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether it could bar a Dutch-national hate preacher from speaking at the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, whether his hateful statements could be prosecuted or sanctioned, and how the Blue Mosque could be sanctioned for hosting him. The Minister of Justice replied that Dutch nationals cannot be excluded from the Netherlands, that the government relies on a three-track approach with municipalities, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that a bill to expand the ban on radical organisations is being prepared.
In general, it is not possible to exclude Dutch citizens from the Netherlands.
In het algemeen geldt dat het niet mogelijk is Nederlandse staatsburgers te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken, Krol, Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Minister in de strafzaak tegen het lid Wilders

MPs from D66, SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice about possible contacts between his predecessor Opstelten or ministry staff and the Public Prosecution Service over the case against MP Wilders, including a timeline of contacts and why ambtsberichten are kept confidential. The Minister says he cannot vouch for all contacts, will not comment on individual prosecutions, and provides a partial timeline with confidentiality grounds for withholding the advisory reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de beantwoording van vragen over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het minder Marokkanen-proces heeft beïnvloed

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a 25 September 2014 meeting between the then Minister and the Chair of the College of Procurators-General concerning the Wilders prosecution, why it was not disclosed earlier, and whether witnesses and records can be made available. The Minister answers that the earlier questions did not explicitly ask about that meeting, that no minutes were kept, that internal advisory reports are withheld to protect prosecution and departmental communication, and that the case itself cannot be discussed.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to judge an individual criminal case.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, te oordelen over een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht dat er nu toch een strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt naar de klokkenluiders van de WODC-affaire

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen ask why a criminal investigation now targets the sources of journalists in the WODC affair, after the minister earlier praised the whistleblower and why the ministry filed a complaint only in this case. The minister answers that the public prosecutor found grounds for investigation, that the ministry was obliged to file the complaint under the official secrecy provisions, and that the whistleblower deserves protection while leaking of confidential information is unacceptable.
As Minister of Justice and Security I have no involvement in individual criminal cases.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heb ik geen bemoeienis met individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Huawei kan bij vertrouwelijke klantdata KPN’

An MP asked whether the interdepartmental Taskforce assessing risks from Huawei access to KPN customer data covers software supply and IT development by tech vendors, and whether government reviews telecom suppliers' access arrangements and security policy. The government answered yes on scope, pointed to the Telecommunications Act duty and Agentschap Telecom oversight, and said the Taskforce has delivered its findings with the cabinet still deliberating and the Chamber to be informed.
The Taskforce has now delivered its findings. The cabinet is currently deliberating on these findings. The Chamber will be informed about this.
De Taskforce heeft inmiddels haar uitkomsten opgeleverd. Op dit moment beraadt het kabinet zich op deze uitkomsten. De Kamer wordt hierover geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep van burgemeesters meer te investeren in de handhavingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the government would respond to mayors' calls for more Tax Authority capacity to fight organised crime, and what it would concretely do to prevent a capacity shortfall. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Tax Authority commits a substantial share of capacity to the integrated approach, that the requested extra funding for its enforcement bid was not granted, but that €1 million (2019) and €0.85 million (2020 onward) go to analysis capacity and a further increase of about €29 million structurally was decided.
The Tax Authority cannot currently always make the requested contribution.
De Belastingdienst kan op dit moment niet altijd de gevraagde bijdrage leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Den Boer over het bericht ««Helft vrouwelijke journalisten heeft met bedreigingen te maken» NRC checkt»

MPs Sneller and Den Boer asked the government about an NRC report finding that nearly half of female journalists face threats, and about the recommendations to protect them, including freelancers and journalists with a migration background. Minister Slob answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the Stuurgroep agreement and the PersVeilig project, and said the specific position of female and minority journalists will be addressed in a safety plan due in autumn.
It is unacceptable that journalists carrying out their work are hindered in doing so by the actions of others.
Het is onaanvaardbaar dat journalisten die hun werk uitvoeren, belemmerd worden in de uitvoering hiervan door de acties van anderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht 'Ter Apel wil van opvangcentrum af wil, tenzij er meer politie komt'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security ministers about reports that Westerwolde wanted to end its reception centre contract unless more police were deployed, and about the police capacity agreed for Ter Apel. The minister answered that police allocation is handled regionally and nationally, outlined the 2010 agreement and the current capacity arrangements, and committed to a meeting with the regional mayor and the Westerwolde mayor and a further letter before the summer recess.

As I also reported to your House in the Police committee meeting on 4 June, I have nonetheless arranged a separate meeting in the short term with the regional mayor of Noord-Nederland and the mayor of Westerwolde to discuss this problem.

Zoals ik uw Kamer ook in het AO Politie op 4 juni jl. heb gemeld, heb ik desalniettemin op korte termijn een aparte afspraak met de regioburgemeester Noord-Nederland en de burgemeester van Westerwolde om over deze problematiek te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Vuurwerk afgestoken bij ArenA ondanks verbod'

Member Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police did not intervene when fireworks were set off at the ArenA despite a ban, and how the football fireworks programme and enforcement procedures work. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police weigh escalation risks against direct intervention, that the mayor chose not to act in this crowd situation, and that clubs, KNVB, police and prosecutors follow set procedures and stadium bans.
At every police intervention a weighing is made between the importance of direct and visible action and the risk of escalation.
Bij elk politieoptreden wordt een afweging gemaakt tussen het belang van direct en zichtbaar optreden en het risico op escalatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Alsof het journaal in het Frans wordt voorgelezen’

Two MPs asked whether the government had noticed reports that deaf and hard-of-hearing people could not follow broadcast news, and whether sign-language interpreters would be used in live crisis communication. The ministers confirmed awareness and said a plan of action to improve crisis communication for vulnerable groups, including sign-language interpreting, would be sent to parliament after the summer.
For the concrete elaboration we are drawing up a plan of action, in line with the request of the House of Representatives.
Voor de concrete uitwerking maken we een plan van aanpak, conform het verzoek van de Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsinformatie voor mensen met een auditieve beperking ook in crisissituaties

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about whether government information during crises is accessible to people with hearing impairments, citing an EU resolution, the UN disability convention and a WODC study. The ministers listed steps taken on NL-Alert channels and promised a plan of action on crisis communication for deaf and hard-of-hearing people to be sent to parliament after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van der Molen en Van Dam over de inzet van een gebarentolk bij crisiscommunicatie door de overheid en bij persconferenties van de overheid

CDA MPs asked whether sign-language interpreters should be used in government crisis communication and press conferences, after the Utrecht attack gave deaf people no interpretation. The ministers answered that a plan of action will be sent to parliament after the summer, that transcripts of post-cabinet press conferences are published, and that the government does not consider the UN disability convention breached.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het ‘minder Marokkanen-proces heeft beïnvloed’

MP Wilders asked the Minister of Justice whether former minister Opstelten gave any opinion or instruction to the Public Prosecution Service about prosecuting Wilders, and about the handling of related documents, witness support and the Pechtold case. The minister answered that no directive, request or opinion from Opstelten was found, but withheld the advisory notes and internal correspondence citing ongoing criminal proceedings and the confidentiality of internal advice.
Therefore I generally do not provide information about a criminal procedure that is still ongoing.
Daarom verstrek ik in het algemeen geen informatie over een strafrechtelijke procedure die nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Vrijwillige brandweer onder druk: ‘Geluk als we met zes man uitrukken’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that volunteer fire brigades are under strain and struggling to recruit, and about possible responses. The minister says there is no mass exodus but regional signals of reduced daytime availability, points to the Veiligheidsberaad programme Vrijwilligheid and international exchange, and says the veiligheidsregio's bear primary responsibility for staffing.
The board of a safety region is the employer of the safety region's staff and therefore also of the firefighters.
Het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio is de werkgever van het personeel van de veiligheidsregio en daarmee ook van de brandweerlieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Amby wil ‘jihadbruid’ Aïcha niet in de buurt’ en het Limburg programma Avondgasten ‘Jihadbruid’ Aïcha uit Maastricht

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Becker (VVD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a returned foreign-fighter woman would live in a Maastricht neighbourhood, including whether mandatory deradicalisation, notification of residents and municipal supervision apply. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no mandatory deradicalisation is imposed in such cases, that location restrictions are possible via conditions or a temporary anti-terror order, that the BIJ notification scheme does not yet cover terrorism convicts, and that a multidisciplinary case consultation monitors individuals.
A improvement plan for the BIJ scheme is currently being drawn up.
Op dit moment wordt er een verbeterplan voor de BIJ-regeling gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het  uitbreiden van burgeropsporing en het aanleveren van complete dossiers aan de politie en het openbaar ministerie door mensen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister what 'citizen investigation' in the Oost-Nederland prosecution service's annual plan means, why citizens are being asked to compile complete case files, whether budget cuts play a role, and whether citizens should bear investigative tasks. The Minister answered that the pilot is within the investigation agenda, citizens stay within legal limits without investigative powers, and investigation remains a government task.
Citizens cannot and will not be expected to carry out 'investigative acts' within the meaning of the Code of Criminal Procedure; they do not have formal investigative powers.

Van burgers kan en zal niet worden verwacht dat zij zelf «opsporingshandelingen» verrichten in de zin van het Wetboek van Strafvordering; zij beschikken immers niet over formele opsporingsbevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Automobilisten hebben lak aan rode kruizen A16’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Remco Dijkstra asked about drivers ignoring red crosses on the A16, the legal basis for penalising them, and whether pilots and camera enforcement by road inspectors could be accelerated. The minister replied that ignoring red crosses is now criminal, that a bill would raise penalties, that enforcement staff and pilots are being expanded, and that camera enforcement on inspectors' vehicles was not pursued because of safety and role concerns.
Ignoring a red cross was transferred a few years ago from the administrative enforcement act for traffic rules to criminal law.
Het negeren van een rood kruis is een paar jaar geleden overgebracht van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften naar het strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laan-Geselschap en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Opgesloten terrorist moet kunnen verdienen’

MPs Van Laan-Geselschap and Van Wijngaarden asked why prison authorities would let frozen-asset terrorist detainees earn and receive money, and whether this undermines the sanctions regime. The minister replied that only a capped internal prison account (500 euro, one contact person) is exempt, other frozen accounts stay blocked, the sanctions rationale still holds, and sanctions beyond asset freezing (travel and contact bans, supervision, nationality deprivation) exist.

By making the exemption possible only for limited amounts on the internal prison current account intended for activities within the penal institution, the exemption does not detract from the risk reduction intended by the sanction measure.

Door de ontheffing alleen mogelijk te maken voor beperkte geldbedragen op de interne rekening courant die bestemd zijn voor activiteiten binnen de penitentiaire inrichting, doet de ontheffing geen afbreuk aan de risicoverkleining zoals bedoeld in de sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten rond Rinus Otte

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether a reclassering report rating Michael P.'s recidivism risk as high was available to the appeal judge Rinus Otte, whether Otte should be dismissed, and how he can now protect the public. The Minister replies that a report rating risk as high-moderate existed, that the judiciary is independent so he will not judge the verdict, and that judges cannot be held personally accountable for collegial rulings.
It does not befit me as Minister to judge a verdict or the deliberation that took place in that context.
Het past mij als Minister niet om te oordelen over een vonnis of de beraadslaging die in dat kader heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Tielen over de berichten 'Bij hoogleraar B. moesten de vrouwen hakken dragen' en 'Van seksueel wangedrag tot sabotage van je onderzoek'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Education and Justice about press reports of harassment and an unsafe culture at the University of Amsterdam law faculty and academia more broadly. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that the UvA has taken steps such as external investigation, interim management, a review of confidential advisers and a planned ombudsman, while stating that a broader cultural change across academia is needed.
I will examine together with the LNVH and the VSNU which further steps can be taken.
Ik zal samen met het LNVH en de VSNU bekijken welke stappen er verder genomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Nieuwe procedure voor benoemingen topstructuur OM’

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about a new OM procedure for appointing top prosecution posts, including whether it opens recruitment from outside and promotes diversity and rotation. The minister answered that the procedure was agreed with the central works council, that vacancies are opened more widely with external advisory committees, and that the Fokkens report was sent to parliament on 25 April.
A new element is that the committees are supported by an external process facilitator.
Een nieuw element is dat de commissies worden begeleid door een externe procesbegeleider.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat in 2017 Nederland bijstand verleende aan Nederlandse uitreizigers in Syrië

An MP asked whether Dutch diplomats in 2016-2017 sought to retrieve Dutch jihadist travellers from Syria via the Free Syrian Army and Turkey, and how this squares with earlier answers denying any assistance policy. The minister answers that contacts were limited to verifying identity and location of four cases in non-combat areas at family request, that no retrieval was requested, and that the policy on not assisting travellers inside the combat zone was unchanged, though the answers did not disclose the 2016 internal policy note and the earlier answer's omissions are acknowledged in part.
It is not customary to share internal policy views with the House, such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs memorandum referred to in the NOS article.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om interne beleidsopvattingen met de Kamer te delen, zoals de nota van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken waaraan het NOS-artikel refereert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Jihadboeken in bajesbieb/Haatlectuur op bestelling'

Three PVV MPs asked whether Islamic books inciting hatred and violence are available in prisons, how many Islamic chaplains and Muslim prisoners there are, and whether Islamic books should be banned and imams dismissed. The minister answered that detainees may read religious literature unless it threatens order or security, that the director may refuse books inciting discrimination or violence, that DJI employs 43 FTE Islamic chaplains without central registration of detainees' religion, and rejected banning books or dismissing imams.
Detainees are not centrally registered by religion or belief.
Gedetineerden worden niet centraal geregistreerd op religie of levensbeschouwing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘AIVD: zorgen over radicalisme bij naschoolse Arabische lessen’

MPs Becker and Laan-Geselschap asked about AIVD concerns over radicalism at informal Arabic-language after-school lessons and whether supervision of such informal education should be broadened. The minister answered that the government lacks full insight into informal schooling, will commission an independent exploration in three stages including possible supervision and intervention options, and pointed to the evaluation of the Wet op de Jeugdverblijven due in summer 2019.
Therefore the cabinet will commission an exploration of forms of informal schooling in the Netherlands to gain more insight into their nature and scope.
Daarom gaat het kabinet een verkenning laten uitvoeren naar vormen van informele scholing in Nederland om meer inzicht in aard en omvang ervan te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er actie nodig is om brandweerposten open te houden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reduced fire-brigade staffing and crewing changes in Midden- and West-Brabant, including whether these fit the Besluit veiligheidsregio's and whether budget cuts or late arrivals occurred. The minister said the region is exploring alternative operating models while keeping service and safety guaranteed, found no signs of a mass exodus of volunteers, reported budget cuts of about 7.9 million euro in 2013–2016 but no late-arrival overview, and noted the inspectorate monitors follow-up.
I do not have an overview that links understaffing to fire units arriving late.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht waarin de relatie wordt gelegd tussen onderbezetting en te laat arriveren van brandweereenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het onderzoek ‘Naar een efficiëntere noodhulp’ van Politie en Wetenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Police and Science study on more efficient emergency response, including the leadership role of operational coordinators and whether there is structural overcapacity in police basic teams. The Minister agreed there is room for more efficient deployment, said the study is too small for general conclusions, and pointed to ongoing police work on the GGP development agenda and a leadership review.
I do point out that the study was limited in scope and is therefore less suitable for drawing general conclusions about organising more efficient emergency response.
Ik wijs er wel op dat het onderzoek een beperkte omvang had, en daarom minder geschikt is voor het trekken van algemene conclusies over de organisatie van een efficiëntere noodhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over inzake het bericht ‘Belgische politie gaat bolides van roekeloze autopatsers direct in beslag nemen’

MPs Dijkstra and Laan-Geselschap asked whether Dutch law can seize cars from reckless drivers as Belgian police do, and how reckless driving is currently tackled. The minister replied that existing criminal and administrative powers already allow strong action, that car seizure is limited to specific grounds with prosecutor consultation and court review, and that no administrative seizure system like Belgium's is planned, pointing instead to two pending bills.
I therefore see no reason to introduce a seizure system such as the one described in the article.
Ik zie daarom geen redenen om een systeem van inbeslagname zoals in het bewuste artikel wordt beschreven te invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een onafhankelijke inspectie onderzoek zou moeten doen naar een brand

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether an independent inspectorate should investigate the 2016 fire in Hellevoetsluis, and whether the Wet Veiligheidsregio's evaluation will cover the Weesp and Hellevoetsluis cases. The minister declined an independent investigation, saying the safety region investigated itself, the Inspectorate found no further study necessary, and the evaluation is conducted by an independent commission that sets its own scope.
A further investigation it did not consider necessary.
Een nader onderzoek achtte zij niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese spionnen stelen kostbare bedrijfsgeheimen van ASML'

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked the ministers about reports that Chinese spies stole trade secrets from ASML, and whether this threatens national security and calls for new measures. The minister answered that the theft by ex-employees of ASML's US subsidiary was serious but showed no direct foreign government involvement, outlined existing legal and advisory protections, and promised an investment screening law in 2019 and a new China strategy.
The aim is to bring such a bill into procedure in 2019 as part of a broader package of measures.
Inzet is om een dergelijk wetsvoorstel in 2019 in procedure te kunnen brengen als onderdeel van een breder palet aan maatregelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Segers over het bericht ‘Ombudsman slaat alarm: 'Het centrum van Amsterdam is 's nachts een wetteloze jungle’ en daarbij het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman van Amsterdam

MPs Drost and Segers asked ministers about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's draft report on lawlessness, nightlife, ATMs, prostitution and tourism in the city centre. The government replied that these are mainly local matters, outlined police capacity increases, RIEC cooperation, ATM oversight limits, and exit programmes, while declining to take a national lead on most suggested measures.
The draft report of the Ombudsman metropolitan Amsterdam concerns a local matter.
Het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman metropool Amsterdam betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de falende aanpak van hondengevechten

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why dog fighting enforcement fails, citing a report on criminal networks and high-risk dog trade, and asked about prosecutions, sentences, cooperation between enforcement bodies and policy changes. The minister answered that an ongoing investigation prevents disclosure of details, that no data on earlier cases is available, outlined existing penalties and enforcement frameworks, and pointed to pending legislation and measures without committing to new policy changes.
Since this concerns an ongoing investigation, no further statements can be made.
Aangezien dit een lopend onderzoek betreft, kunnen er geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat meisjes met een migratie-achtergrond al in de basisschoolleeftijd worden ontvoerd en uitgehuwelijkt

MPs Becker, Rudmer Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked whether girls with a migration background are abducted and married off from primary school age, how many cases exist, how schools report them, and what legal and consular tools exist. The minister answered that no 2018 reports involved primary-school-age victims, gave case counts, pointed to existing reporting and court-intervention routes, and promised further steps in a June progress report.
Exact figures on the abandonment of minors abroad are currently not available, as figures on this specific subject cannot be derived from the current registration system.

Exacte cijfers over achterlating van minderjarigen in het buitenland, zijn momenteel niet beschikbaar aangezien cijfers over dit specifieke onderwerp niet te herleiden zijn uit het huidige registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Laçin over het bericht dat er een kwart miljoen verkeersboetes zijn uitgeschreven voor 1 kilometer te hard rijden

MPs Van Raak and Laçin asked whether nearly a quarter million speeding fines for exceeding the limit by 1 km/h were issued since 2012, and whether this undermines support and resembles a fine quota. The minister confirmed the figure over seven years, explained measurement corrections and the 4 km/h threshold, rejected the quota claim since its 2011 abolition, and guaranteed fines serve road safety rather than revenue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Kwart miljoen boetes voor 1 km/u te hard: 'Dit riekt naar spekken staatskas'

VVD MPs asked the government whether fining drivers for speeding just 1 km/h over is justified, given that administration costs (9 euro) nearly equal the fine, and raised questions about the 130 km/h lower tolerance, foreign offenders and camera-based enforcement. The Justice Minister defended enforcement of small speeding offences for road safety, explained the cost breakdown and the abolition of the lower tolerance on 130 km/h roads, and reported on cross-border enforcement and the start of camera use by the tax authority.
Traffic enforcement exists to promote compliance with traffic rules and thereby safeguard road safety.
Verkeershandhaving is er om de naleving van de verkeersregels te bevorderen en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat de politie in Limburg negen islamitische nachtmaaltijden organiseert

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is absurd that the Limburg police organise nine Islamic night meals and whether these should be cancelled in favour of fighting crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police units decide locally on community activities across many groups, that police should remain neutral and connected to all groups, and that he supports such activities as strengthening community ties and authority.
The way in which policy can best be given form locally and which activities accompany it, I leave to the police units themselves.
De wijze waarop het beleid lokaal het beste vorm gegeven kan worden en met welke activiteiten dat gepaard gaat, laat ik aan de politie-eenheden zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe onthullingen rond het Haga Lyceum

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether reports about a Haga Lyceum linked to radical preachers, gender segregation, and possible terror financing were true, and whether the school should be closed or its board dismissed. The minister declined to comment on substance, citing the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation and the Bibob screening, while stating that intimidation of inspectors is unacceptable and that Article 23 must not block firm intervention.
In the interest of these ongoing investigations, I cannot go into this further.
In het belang van deze lopende onderzoeken kan ik hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het statement gemaakt door de (werkgroep Legal Affairs en Human Rights van de) Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Council of Europe PACE working group statement on prosecutions facing Laura Codruța Kövesi, a candidate for European Public Prosecutor, and whether the government would seek clarification from Romania and condemn it. The minister replied that the government greatly values her anti-corruption work and wants all candidates treated fairly, that it is closely following the case, and that the Romanian courts must first rule on the cases.
However, it is first and foremost for the Romanian judge to rule on the cases brought against Ms Kövesi.
Het is nu echter allereerst aan de Roemeense rechter om zich uit te spreken over de zaken die zijn aangespannen tegen mevrouw Kövesi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de inzet van private beveiligers bij de arrestantenzorg in Oost-Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the use of private security staff in custody care in the Oost-Nederland police unit and the chronic understaffing behind it. The minister answered that external hires are a temporary measure for support tasks only, that they do not perform official acts, and that the unit is working on a structural solution, while giving no measurable targets.
External hiring for custody care in the Oost-Nederland police unit is only used for support tasks and is a temporary measure
De externe inhuur voor de arrestantenzorg in de politie-eenheid Oost-Nederland wordt alleen ingezet voor ondersteunende taken en is een tijdelijke maatregel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de betrouwbaarheid en bruikbaarheid van de vergelijkingen tussen rechtsstelsels en het World Justice Project

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the reliability and usefulness of the World Justice Project Rule of Law Index as a comparison of Dutch judiciary quality, given criticism of survey methods, contractor identity and funding. The Minister defended the index as one of several indicators, acknowledged differing methods, and answered the funding and survey questions while maintaining the index remains meaningful.

As I indicated in answering your earlier parliamentary questions, the WJP is one of several indicators from which it is derived that the Netherlands has a well-functioning legal system compared with other countries.

Zoals ik bij de beantwoording van uw eerdere Kamervragen heb aangegeven is het WJP één van meerdere indicatoren waaraan wordt ontleend dat Nederland beschikt over een in vergelijking met andere landen goed functionerend rechtsstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Nijkerken-de Haan en Laan-Geselschap over ‘Politie Limburg wil DNA-onderzoeken onderbrengen bij een commercieel forensisch instituut’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a plan by Limburg police and the prosecution to have DNA and digital trace examinations carried out by a commercial institute (TMFI) rather than the NFI, asking about capacity, delays, the expected acceleration, and data protection. The minister replied that the trial is still in its research phase, that such arrangements are already possible via the NFI's One Stop Shop, that effects can only be measured after about three years, and that private partners must meet NFI and GDPR privacy requirements.
It is unclear which traces the article refers to; the article does not distinguish between digital traces and DNA traces.
Het is onduidelijk op welke sporen in het artikel wordt gedoeld, het artikel maakt geen onderscheid tussen digitale sporen en DNA-sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Onze veiligheid in eigen hand houden’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about a proposed national secure communications network (NVC) and whether it is needed for critical infrastructure, emergency services and C2000 back-up, and about security audits of C2000 technology. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not see the need for an NVC, that vital providers bear primary responsibility, and that a study into a C2000 solution independent of states with offensive cyber programmes will be reported after the summer.
In this letter I committed to carry out an exploration of a solution that does not depend on countries that have been established to run offensive cyber programmes against Dutch interests.

In deze brief heb ik toegezegd een verkenning uit te voeren naar een oplossing die niet afhankelijk is van landen waarvan is vastgesteld dat ze een offensief cyberprogramma voeren tegen Nederlandse belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Haatpreek wint terrein'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about salafist hate preachers in mosques and online, and about counter-strategies, sanctions and closing mosques. The government answered that it applies criminal prosecution, travel bans, the Twbmt, a planned civil-law route to ban radical organisations, and an integrated approach, while declining to comment on specific individuals or to commission a further investigation into online platforms.
I cannot make statements about possible ongoing actions against the spiritual leaders mentioned in the article.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over mogelijk lopende acties tegen de in het artikel genoemde voormannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Wetenschappelijke studie laat zien: hoe sterker de wiet, des te groter de kans op psychose'

An MP asked the ministers how a study linking cannabis potency to psychosis risk affects care, prevention policy, THC limits for the cannabis experiment and the definition of softdrugs. The minister answered that the causal link is contested, that care aims to stop cannabis use, that labelling and information requirements are being set for coffeeshops, and that no upper THC limit is set for now pending more research.
Partly on the basis of the Knottnerus committee's advice, we for now set no upper limit on the THC content of Dutch cannabis and hashish to be produced within the closed coffeeshop experiment.

Mede op basis van het advies van de commissie Knottnerus in deze, stellen wij vooralsnog geen bovengrens aan het THC-gehalte van Nederwiet en Nederhasj die in het kader van het experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen zal worden geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het verband tussen wietgebruik en psychoses

An MP asked the government about a Lancet Psychiatry study linking strong cannabis use to psychosis, and whether this should end the closed coffeeshop cannabis experiment, cap THC levels, and cost implications. The minister answered that causality is scientifically uncertain, that further research is needed, that the experiment will continue, and that cost estimates cannot be given.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de Deventer moordzaak

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the status of the Supreme Court's review of the Deventer murder case, whether a CD-ROM of police material was newly available, and what consequences irregularities in past police investigations could have. Minister Grapperhaus described the procedural history and ongoing DNA research, said the handling of evidence carriers was outside the review's scope, and stated that consequences for officials depend on circumstances and that the Supreme Court decides whether irregularities amount to a novum.
It is for the Supreme Court to assess whether there are irregularities and whether these must be treated as a novum.
Het is aan de Hoge Raad om te beoordelen of sprake is van onregelmatigheden en of die als novum moeten worden aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dochtertje van Nederlandse Syriëganger overleden in vluchtelingenkamp’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about reports that a Dutch Syria-returnee's young daughter died in the Al Hol camp, the camp conditions, and whether Dutch women and children would be brought back. The ministers acknowledged the dire humanitarian conditions and the child deaths, but said the Netherlands does not actively repatriate its nationals from Syria, separating children from parents is undesirable and legally complex, and consular assistance is only given if they report to a Dutch mission in the region.
The Netherlands takes no action aimed at or supporting the active repatriation of Dutch travellers to Syria.
Nederland onderneemt geen actie gericht op of ondersteunend aan het actief terughalen van Nederlandse uitreizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) niets doet met een aantal doodsbedreigingen vanuit het buitenland op een Nederlandse politicus

MP Markuszower asks whether the Public Prosecution Service is failing to act on death threats from abroad against an opposition politician, and whether this signals tolerance of such threats. Minister Grapperhaus replies that the threats were investigated by the Team Bedreigde Politici, that there are no indications the senders will come to the Netherlands, and that each case is assessed for all available options.
The Public Prosecution Service has stated that the investigation found no indications at this time that the senders of the threats will come to the Netherlands.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten dat uit het onderzoek is gekomen dat er op dit moment geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de afzenders van de bedreigingen naar Nederland zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Rechts-radicalen trainen in Frankrijk voor ‘nieuwe burgeroorlog’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that far-right groups such as Identitair Verzet send supporters to combat-training camps in France in preparation for a 'race war', and what the government will do about it. The minister said the AIVD sees no recent indications of such trips, that unlawful violence by any group is unacceptable and monitored, and pointed to existing structures, online-content measures and EU legislation without committing to a new dedicated action plan.
There are no indications that this has also happened recently.
Er zijn geen indicaties dat dit recent ook is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Heel zuur dat er door de politie niets aan gedaan wordt’

MPs Van Dam and Van den Berg asked the Justice Minister why police in Zeeland do not pursue thefts of farmers' GPS systems, and how often and where such thefts occur. The minister answered that theft of GPS systems is not separately registered, that investigations follow prioritisation under the Public Prosecution Service and depend on evidence, and that farmers may rely on insurance.
Theft of GPS systems is not registered under a separate code.
