Diefstal van GPS-systemen wordt niet onder een aparte code geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Onrust in Maastrichtse wijk om komst 'jihadbruid' Aïcha''

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports of unrest in a Maastricht neighbourhood over the expected return of a woman who had travelled to IS territory, and whether she should be permanently barred, preventively detained and stripped of Dutch nationality. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch nationals cannot be denied entry, returnees are questioned and may be prosecuted, a multidisciplinary case consultation is used, preventive detention without reasonable suspicion is not permissible, and nationality can be revoked only after a terrorism conviction or, for dual nationals, for joining a terrorist organisation.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Tweede ondernemer zwicht na dreigbrief van windmolenactivisten: 'U krijgt 48 uur'’

MPs Sienot and Groothuizen asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about a newspaper report of a second entrepreneur giving in to threats from wind-turbine activists, and what the government does against intimidation and to protect businesses. Minister Grapperhaus answered that intimidation is unacceptable, that police do not record wind-related offences separately, that local protest is largely lawful, and that businesses are primarily responsible for their own security with local authorities adding measures when risk warrants, while pointing to regional energy strategies and co-ownership to build support.
As previously indicated in answers to parliamentary questions, offences committed in relation to wind turbines are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Antwoord 3 Zoals eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen 2 , worden delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de hulp aan achterblijvers van vermiste personen in het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether families of people missing abroad should receive better and more standardised help, including a 24-hour help desk, and whether it is absurd that they are advised to crowdfund searches. The minister answered that the local authorities bear primary responsibility, that the ministry keeps families informed via a contact person, and that a dedicated search fund would undermine local responsibility, so the government will not set one up.
By setting up a search fund and creating the impression that the Dutch government can and wants to take over a case, that responsibility is actually undermined and undesirable effects can arise.

Door het instellen van een fonds voor opsporing en de indruk te wekken dat de Nederlandse overheid een zaak kan en wil overnemen, wordt die verantwoordelijkheid juist ontkracht en kunnen ongewenste effecten ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over hoe de Pauselijke Geheimhoudingsplicht seksueel misbruik in de Rooms Katholieke Kerk mogelijk in de hand werkt

MP Bergkamp asked whether the papal confidentiality obligation in the Normae de gravioribus delictis could enable a cover-up of child sexual abuse by clergy in the Catholic Church, and whether the Crimen sollicitationis still applies. Minister Dekker answered that Crimen sollicitationis was replaced in 2001, that the Normae remain in force, that canon law cannot override Dutch criminal law and requires reporting to the authorities, and that the Dutch Church applies a reporting duty and zero-tolerance policy.
The papal confidentiality obligation applies to the handling of complaints of sexual abuse of a minor under canon criminal law and procedure by the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith.

De pauselijke geheimhoudingsplicht geldt voor de behandeling van aanklachten wegens seksueel misbruik van een minderjarige volgens het canonieke strafrecht en strafprocesrecht door de Congregatie voor de Geloofsleer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het misbruikschandaal bij ProDemos

An MP asked the ministers about a sexual abuse scandal at ProDemos, a publicly funded democracy-education foundation, including whether the organisation had taken proper steps, whether an independent inquiry was warranted, and how former staff were supported and protected in deciding whether to file complaints. The minister reported the dismissal of a leader, internal and external investigations, aftercare offers, and an independent committee under Tjibbe Joustra to report before the summer recess.
I am of the view that everyone should feel free to file a complaint, without fear of repercussions.
Ik ben van mening dat eenieder zich vrij moet voelen om aangifte te doen, zonder angst voor repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Toezegging van minister voor volwaardig politiebureau in Noordwijk’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police team office in Noordwijk would close, whether this conflicts with the 2025 housing list and the 2012 implementation plan, and what it means for response times and service. The Minister confirmed the office will close once a smaller replacement with public counter opens, stated the housing list is not binding and that merging three basic teams into two is a management matter agreed with local authorities, with the Chamber's role limited to later budget scrutiny.
Police housing locations are closed only in agreement with the local authority, taking into account police accessibility as well as the quality of police work and service.

Het sluiten van huisvestingslocaties gebeurt uitsluitend in overeenstemming met het gezag, daarbij wordt rekening gehouden met de bereikbaarheid van de politie alsook de kwaliteit van het politiewerk en de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Krol over drugsdumpingen in de natuur

MPs Bergkamp and Krol asked about drug-waste dumping in nature and residential areas, its costs, health and environmental effects, and whether a legal drop-off point should be allowed. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dumping cannot be broken down by location, costs fall largely on regional and local authorities supported by national funds, and he rejects a 'drugsluikje' as facilitating crime.
It is not possible to break these registrations down by location; on the basis of the registrations it cannot be stated how often it concerned a residential area or nature area.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze registraties uit te splitsen naar locatie; het valt op basis van de registraties niet aan te geven hoe vaak het een woonwijk of natuurgebied betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert

VVD MPs Azmani and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the US preacher Steve Anderson, who has made hateful statements about LGBT people, could be barred from the Netherlands, whether Dutch authorities could prevent his public appearances, and whether the EU could jointly blacklist such preachers. The government referred the core questions to earlier answers, said the EU partner states had been informed at official level, and said it will keep raising the issue in the EU ministers' group on extremist speakers.
I refer you for these questions to the answers to the questions from MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen (PvdA) on refusing a hate preacher entry to the Netherlands.
Ik verwijs u voor deze vragen naar de beantwoording van de vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen (PvdA) over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de aanbesteding van het CJIB

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether a new CJIB tender for bailiff debt collection contradicts the Rijksincassovisie, why it was started, and whether debtors bear extra costs when a new bailiff must re-establish the debt. The minister denied any conflict with the policy vision, explained the tender is needed because current two-year contracts are ending, and said ongoing files stay with the original bailiff.
No, the tender round does not conflict with the Rijksincassovisie.
Nee, de aanbestedingsronde is niet in strijd met de Rijksincassovisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over reclassering voor veroordeelde bedrijven

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister about a probation-style improvement programme for convicted companies, drawing on US and UK monitor arrangements, and whether companies that self-report could get lower fines. The minister was positive in principle, said the current Dutch transaction rules do not allow compliance conditions, and promised to explore an explicit high-transaction regulation including compliance and judicial involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over foute verkeersboetes op de A29

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about erroneous speed fines on the A29, including whether the government will refund around 18,000 fines after a court ruling. The Minister answers that the ruling does not require refunds, that a NMi study found the speed measurements reliable, and that collection of the fines will resume.
After investigation it has indeed emerged that the speed measurements were reliable and therefore there is no need to doubt the basis of the fines.
Na onderzoek is immers gebleken dat de snelheidsmetingen betrouwbaar waren en derhalve niet aan de grondslag van de boetes hoeft te worden getwijfeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ondernemer zwicht voor bedreigingen en stapt uit windmolenproject De Monden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice about a report that an entrepreneur withdrew from the De Monden wind farm after threats, asking about condemnation, prosecution, NCTV classification, victim support and lessons learned. The government condemned threats, said a police and prosecution investigation is ongoing, and gave limited operational detail while noting a very small group breaks the law.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are currently conducting a criminal investigation, so I cannot go into the substance of the case.
Politie en OM doen momenteel strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waardoor ik inhoudelijk niet op de zaak kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat woedende Urker jongeren het huis van Soufyan (18) binnendringen en ‘Geertje Wilders!’ roepen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that angry youths on Urk entered the home of an 18-year-old and chanted a discriminatory slogan, and about threats to the family and the safety response. The minister declined to give details because criminal investigations are ongoing, confirmed arrests and protection measures, and said a possible penalty-enhancement ground for discrimination-related offences is under study.
Given that the questions above are the subject of the criminal investigation into this incident, no further statements can be made about them.
Gelet op het feit dat de hierboven gestelde vragen onderwerp zijn van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar dit incident, kunnen hier geen verdere mededelingen over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijk strafrechtelijke karakter van het sluiten van drugspanden door de burgemeester

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether mayoral closure of drug premises under article 13b Opiumwet may be a criminal charge that bars prosecution, and whether closures are being used too broadly. The minister answers that closure is a restorative, not punitive, measure, that mayors need only justify necessity and proportionality, that a monitoring motion will report by 2021, and that repressive action is for justice.
The decision must show an assessment of the concrete circumstances of the case as a whole, including an assessment of the proportionality of the consequences of closure for those involved.
Het besluit moet blijk geven van een beoordeling van de concrete omstandigheden van het geval in samenhang bezien, waaronder een beoordeling van de evenredigheid van de gevolgen van de sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over uitspraken van de Raad van State inzake jihadisten

The MP asks whether the Dutch government is sure two jihadists identified in Raad van State rulings are not in the Netherlands, and whether it will ensure they never return and are imprisoned and deported if they do. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, says the State Secretary is examining the rulings' consequences for citizenship revocations, and describes the steps for returnees including arrest, prosecution and possible revocation of Dutch nationality.
The State Secretary is currently examining the Raad van State ruling to see what it means for these and other already taken decisions to revoke Dutch nationality.
Momenteel onderzoekt de Staatssecretaris de uitspraak van de Raad van State om te bezien wat dit betekent voor deze en andere reeds genomen besluiten tot intrekking Nederlanderschap
Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan’

Two MPs (Van Dam, CDA, and Laan-Geselschap, VVD) asked the Justice minister whether his earlier answers, which called the police's ammunition prices commercially confidential, were correct, and whether he would let the House inspect that information. The minister replies that he will share the price paid by the police and the estimated cost difference for training ammunition in a confidential annex, available to MPs for inspection until the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over meldingen van bedreiging door journalisten

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked whether journalists find it hard to file complaints about threats and violence, and how many reports and complaints were made. The minister replied that a 2018 accord with police and prosecutors gives journalists priority protection, that complaints are indicatively counted at about 21 in 2018, and that the government will not comment on individual cases.
These figures are indicative, because the police do not record the victim's profession.
Deze cijfers zijn indicatief, omdat de politie het beroep van het slachtoffer niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘OM Eist 45 maanden cel tegen corrupte aspirant-agent‘

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a case in which a corrupt police trainee accessed confidential criminal investigation information, and how access, logging and new police systems are controlled. The minister answered that authorisation follows screening and role-based access, that logging and a pilot to detect atypical use exist, and that new systems will be logged centrally, while pointing to a bill to expand screening.
The authorisation policy was renewed several years ago and applies to the entire police organisation.
Het autorisatiebeleid is een aantal jaren geleden vernieuwd en geldt voor de gehele politieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Zelfstandige tolken met uitsluiting bedreigd'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that independent interpreters are being excluded by a shift to tendered, intermediary-based interpreting services, and whether interpreters can bid directly. The minister confirmed the process, said direct contracting is no longer permitted under EU procurement rules, and promised quality requirements and monitoring in the new tenders.
Clear quality requirements will be formulated in the tender, and quality weighs more heavily than price in the award.
Er worden heldere kwaliteitseisen geformuleerd bij de aanbesteding en kwaliteit weegt zwaarder dan prijs bij gunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over antidrone maatregelen bij vliegvelden

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Defence and Justice and Security about counter-drone measures at airports, covering current capabilities, near-term additions, a knowledge programme, cooperation with partners and other countries. The minister answered that Defence has radar and electronic jamming capabilities but use within the Netherlands is limited by legal frameworks, that procurement and a 2019-2022 knowledge programme are underway, and that cooperation with the Justice and Security ministry and foreign partners continues, withholding operational details for sensitivity reasons.
Regarding the number of systems and specifications, I cannot make a statement due to operational sensitivity.
Over aantallen systemen en specificaties kan ik vanwege de operationele gevoeligheid geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Moorlag en Nijboer over meer banen in Oost-Groningen

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers whether the Opiumwet's ban on industrial use of hemp tops, which blocks CBD extraction at HempFlax in Oost-Groningen, should be relaxed to create jobs, and how Germany regulates this. The minister answered that the law only exempts fibre hemp for fibre or seed, that the juridical options are still being explored, and that talks with the businesses will follow.
At this moment I am exploring the legal possibilities.
Op dit moment ben ik de juridische mogelijkheden aan het verkennen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politiegeweld in zicht: zijn nieuwe geweldsmiddelen nodig?’ en het onderzoeksrapport van Olga Timmer ‘Een onderzoek naar hoe de politie Amsterdam omgaat in GGZ-ins

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police lack a clear power to use force in compulsory mental health care and about a report on police handling of confused persons in Amsterdam GGZ institutions. The Minister answered that police may use force only to end an immediate serious danger to persons, not to assist compulsory care, that the legal framework is known to police, and that the new Ambtsinstructie reporting rules apply.
The authority of the police to use force in a GGZ institution is in the above case limited to ending a serious and immediate danger to persons and is not aimed at assisting compulsory care.

De bevoegdheid tot het gebruik van geweld door de politie in een GGZ-instelling is in vorenstaand geval beperkt tot het beëindigen van een ernstig en onmiddellijk gevaar voor personen en niet gericht op hulp aan gedwongen hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie de mogelijkheid zou willen om vaker met criminelen deals en afspraken te maken in grote strafzaken

An SP MP asked whether the government supports the Public Prosecution Service's idea of more plea and sentence agreements with suspects in serious cases, and objected to lower sentences for serious criminals, risks of wrongful confessions, reduced public visibility and victims' rights. The Minister says he is in principle positive about exploring such agreements under a clear statutory framework, while guarding sentence severity, victims' position and a full public trial for serious cases.
I therefore in principle welcome further exploring the possibility of process and sentence agreements, based on further input from the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik sta dan ook in beginsel positief tegenover het verder verkennen van de mogelijkheid van proces- en vonnisafspraken, aan de hand van nadere inbreng van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over zich ADO-supporters noemende personen die onder ander het monument De Dokwerker in Amsterdam hebben beklad

MPs Kuiken, Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about ADO Den Haag supporters who defaced the De Dokwerker monument in Amsterdam, including criminal investigation, camera footage, administrative measures, stadium bans and antisemitism in sport. The government answered that a report was filed and is with the Public Prosecution Service, declined to discuss the investigation or evidence, pointed to the mayor's powers and the KNVB's private-law stadium bans, and described existing anti-discrimination policy in football.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Rudmer Heerema en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘ADO supporters bekladden Amsterdam’

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that ADO Den Haag supporters defaced Amsterdam monuments, including the Dokwerker, with anti-Jewish slogans, asking about arrests, club responsibility, and nationwide stadium bans. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that a complaint is under review by the Public Prosecution Service, that the KNVB and clubs can impose stadium bans as a private-law measure, and that he will discuss antisemitism in football with the KNVB.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Het nieuwe bekostigingssysteem van het Openbaar Ministerie'

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the new funding system for the Public Prosecution Service, covering how TGO teams are financed, whether a time-recording study is planned, how surplus or shortfall in output is handled, open-ended budgets and innovation costs. The minister answered in detail, explaining the lump-sum versus product funding split, that a time-recording study may be considered, the reserve mechanism, and that special budgets are monitored closely.

For that reason, the OM and I will certainly consider whether a time-recording study – weighing the necessary costs and time burden for those involved – has sufficient added value for the price negotiations.

Om die reden zullen het OM en ik zeker bezien of een tijdschrijfonderzoek – daarbij meewegend de noodzakelijke kosten en tijdbeslag van betrokkenen – voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft voor de prijsonderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het opleggen van strafbeschikkingen

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security, in 12 questions, about whether staff at the central OM processing centre (CVOM) had lacked legal competence to issue criminal penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) before a 2017 statutory amendment. The minister answered that a formal defect in delegation existed before the amendment, that the orders were in substance issued by qualified prosecutors and staff, and that the defect was remedied by the 2017 law effective 1 January 2019.

Regarding the passage in section 4.6, stating that no indications were found of decisions taken without authority, the report considers that there is little reason to assume that in those cases OM criminal penalty orders were issued by persons who were not public prosecutors, prosecution secretaries or AJM staff.

Met betrekking tot de passage in paragraaf 4.6, waarin wordt gesteld dat geen aanwijzingen zijn gevonden voor onbevoegd genomen beslissingen, wordt in het rapport overwogen dat er weinig reden is te veronderstellen dat in die gevallen OM-strafbeschikkingen door personen zijn uitgevaardigd die geen officier van justitie, parketsecretaris of AJM’er waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over een oppositieleider die vastzit in een Tadzjiekse gevangenis

MPs from D66 asked the government about opposition leader Gadojev, detained in Tajikistan after apparently being arrested in Russia, and whether Interpol listings are being misused against political critics. The government replied that Gadojev returned to the Netherlands with consular help via the German embassy, that Interpol's rules forbid political interventions but full guarantees cannot be given, and that human rights are raised regularly in bilateral and multilateral settings.
However, I cannot speculate on the circumstances in individual cases listed on the Interpol list.
Ik kan echter niet speculeren over de toedracht in individuele casussen die op de Interpol-lijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Incidenten verwarde mensen heftiger’

MPs De Lange and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Justice and Health ministers about a report that incidents involving people with confused behaviour were becoming more severe and that police registrations had doubled. The minister answered that E33 registrations are not diagnoses, that the rise cannot yet be explained, and pointed to a person-centred approach, regional support teams, and planned information-sharing legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht over legitimatieplicht voor verzenders van postpakketten

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about a proposed identification requirement for senders of parcels, following a Taskforce Brabant-Zeeland call, and whether existing measures against drug trafficking via post are adequate. The Minister answers that existing measures (drug-dog checks, sensing, public-private cooperation with PostNL and other carriers) are part of an integrated approach, and that an ID requirement is not proportionate given parcel volumes, privacy and administrative burden.
Given the total volume of parcel post, the intrusion on privacy and the increase in administrative burden, we consider an identification requirement not proportionate to combat drug crime.

Een legitimatieplicht achten wij gelet op het totale volume aan pakketpost, de inbreuk op de privacy en de verzwaring van de administratieve lasten niet proportioneel om drugscriminaliteit tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over de verzending van drugs via brievenpost

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked whether the government knows how much drugs are mailed from the Netherlands by letter post, whether Dutch businesses and individuals are being misused as senders, whether the Postinterventieteam acts on letter post, and how innocent recipients can avoid being treated as suspects. The Minister answered that volumes are unknown and being studied with partners, that letter post is not structurally checked, that interventions such as taking down darknet sites are desirable, and that people receiving unsolicited drugs should report them to police.
The cabinet is considering with its partners whether the nature and scale can be mapped.
Het kabinet bekijkt met de partners of de aard en omvang in kaart is te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de gevolgen van overbelasting van het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut voor strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in ernstige zedenzaken

MP Buitenweg asked whether police were limited to five sexual-offence DNA kits per department per month at the Netherlands Forensic Institute, and what consequences any such limit had for prosecuting serious sex crimes. The Minister denied any limit, explaining that five extra kits per week can be sent for urgent outsourced analysis on top of existing NFI urgent capacity, and that the police and prosecution expect NFI capacity to suffice.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, this is not a limitation but an expansion of urgent capacity for DNA investigations in sexual offence cases.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 1 gaat het niet om een beperking, maar om een uitbreiding van de spoedcapaciteit voor de DNA-onderzoeken in zedenzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Taskforce drugsbestrijding wil legitimatieplicht voor afzender postpakket'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the anti-drug taskforce wants an identification requirement for parcel senders and an end to letter secrecy for PostNL parcels. The minister answers that an ID requirement is disproportionate and would be easily circumvented, and that abolishing letter secrecy would add limited value under current law, while noting an ongoing draft reform and international efforts.
I consider an identification requirement disproportionate for combating drug crime, given the total volume of parcel post, the privacy intrusion and the added administrative burden.
acht ik een legitimatieplicht gelet op het totale volume aan pakketpost, de inbreuk op de privacy en de verzwaring van de administratieve lasten niet proportioneel om drugscriminaliteit tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het kweken van wiet als medicijn

MPs Van Nispen, Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked why home cultivation of medicinal cannabis should remain illegal for patients who cannot get adequate relief from the five pharmacy-available varieties, and about the Tilburg case and the court ruling in Jeffrey's favour. The minister answered that the five varieties largely meet need, that home-grown cannabis cannot guarantee consistent quality and dosage, that the appeal against the ruling prevents comment, and that no talks with Tilburg are planned.
An urgent appeal has been lodged against this ruling. I therefore cannot respond to it.
Tegen deze uitspraak is spoedappèl ingesteld. Ik kan hier derhalve geen reactie op geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Onverbeterlijke criminele asielzoeker heeft vrij spel’

CDA MPs asked whether criminal asylum seekers move between reception centres without follow-up or shared records, and whether a national database should be created, citing police criticism. The State Secretary said existing registration and information-sharing have been improved and that a new database would take long, so existing structures will be used in the short term, and he denied that transfers merely shift the problem.
At the JBZ committee meeting on 6 March I indicated that I am willing to examine whether an additional database would add value.
Tijdens het AO JBZ op 6 maart jl. heb ik aangegeven dat ik bereid ben te kijken of een additionele databank meerwaarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Aruba op zwarte lijst EU belastingontwijking’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether Aruba was placed on the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why it was moved from the grey list, what measures Aruba must take, and whether the Netherlands supported Aruba. The State Secretary confirmed the listing, said Aruba committed to repeal its transparency regime and is expected to be delisted at the 16 May Ecofin, and stated no figures are available on Dutch persons using Aruban tax arrangements and that Aruba bears responsibility for its own tax rules.
No figures are known about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het Landelijk Meldpunt Misstanden bij de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the internal whistleblower body (LMM) of the National Police: how many cases it handled in 2017 and 2018, what kinds of matters it receives, how it relates to the Huis voor Klokkenluiders, and how reporters are involved and satisfied. The minister answered in detail, confirming the 31 cases of 2017 (20 in 2018), explaining the procedure and that most matters were individual labour disputes rather than misstanden, and committing to report 2018 figures in the annual report.
The annual report of the police for 2018 will show the number of reports and advice requests for 2018.
In de Jaarverantwoording politie 2018 zullen het aantal meldingen c.q. adviesaanvragen over 2018 worden weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Den Boer, Van der Graaf en Laan-Geselschap over leren van geweld

MPs asked whether the attacks on mosques in New Zealand warranted revising protection policy for mosques and religious institutions, and whether threat levels had changed. The Minister answered that there are no concrete indications the threat to religious institutions has risen, that existing policy and local measures are sufficient, and pointed to guidance documents and his letter of 21 March 2019.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to revise the existing policy.
Op dit moment zie ik daarom geen aanleiding om het bestaande beleid te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet goed aansluiten van strafmaxima bij delicten omtrent het nalaten van hulpverlening bij levensgevaar

The MP asks whether the penalties for failing to render aid in mortal danger (art. 450 Sr, an overtreding carrying at most three months' detention) fit with the penalty for death by negligence (art. 307 Sr), following the death of a Rotterdam teenager. The Minister answers that the current system is logical and consistent, that the aid duty is a moral-to-legal duty with a lighter sanction because intent need not be proven, and sees no reason for legislative change.
I therefore see no reason to initiate a legislative amendment on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om op dit punt een wetswijziging te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over etnisch profileren door de politie

Parliamentarian Buitenweg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of stops without clear cause and ethnic profiling by police, including what measures exist, how prevalence is measured, where anti-profiling goals are recorded, what concrete commitments the police have made and how they are monitored. The minister answered that a package of measures (the Kracht van het Verschil programme, a proactive-checks framework, awareness training and an app study) is in place, that no measurement instrument for ethnic profiling exists because ethnicity is not recorded, and that results will be reported in summer 2019 with the possibility of further measures.

A package of measures to address distinction in police action without objective justification is in place, and a set of efforts, activities and projects is being carried out under the multi-year programme 'De Kracht van het Verschil'.
Er is en wordt – met het meerjarige programma «De Kracht van het Verschil – een set aan inspanningen, activiteiten en projecten verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebrek aan onderzoekscapaciteit naar mogelijke politiefraude

An MP asked whether a complaint against police over a major tender has lain idle with the Rijksrecherche for six months, whether understaffing leaves police misconduct unexamined, and whether threats against mayors are blocking corruption investigations. The minister confirms the complaint was filed earlier, with later filings and a Article 12 complaint causing delay, and now sits with the Public Prosecution Service; he acknowledges capacity limits forcing scaled-back or dropped investigations, and denies that threats against mayors are the cause.
The file is now under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service.
Inmiddels ligt het dossier ter beoordeling voor aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Albanese moordenaar ontloopt uitlevering’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the rule of law is failing because a convicted Albanian murderer may avoid extradition, and whether the ECHR should be denounced. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said he is still in extradition detention pending a court procedure, and refused to denounce the ECHR, calling human rights essential to the rule of law.
I do not go into details of individual cases.
Op details van individuele zaken ga ik niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Pon-affaire op herhaling’

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked about reports of a new complaint over a tender by the national police, and about the capacity, workload and prioritisation of the Rijksrecherche. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a new complaint was taken up in September 2018 and handed to the Rijksrecherche in December 2018, that capacity has been a long-standing constraint, and that integrity policy is being strengthened.

After a thorough analysis of the new complaint and review of the extensive documents later submitted, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the Rijksrecherche, decided in September 2018 to take up the complaint.

Na een uitvoerige analyse van de nieuwe aangifte en na bestudering van de naderhand toegezonden omvangrijke stukken, heeft het Openbaar Ministerie in afstemming met de Rijksrecherche in september 2018 besloten de aangifte op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het artikel 'Behoefte aan echte reflectie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a newspaper interview with a police officer and about how the national objection and advisory committee (BAC) advice on disciplinary measures against police officers is handled by the police chief. The minister confirmed the facts, gave objection counts for 2016-2018, and reported that in a review of 66 BAC cases the authority departed fully from the advice in six and partly in eight, while declining full statistics without manual file review.
Answering questions 4, 5 and 6 requires manual file research.
Het beantwoorden van de vragen 4, 5 en 6 vergt handmatig dossieronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Laan-Geselschap en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Tienduizenden boetes trajectcontrole A2-tunnel bij Maastricht zijn onterecht'

MPs asked whether unclear signage at the A2 tunnel near Maastricht made tens of thousands of average-speed fines invalid after a court ruling, and how affected drivers would be compensated. The minister replied that the signage met the rules, was clarified in late 2017, that the court only set one fine to zero on its facts, and that no collective correction is planned.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that the signage on the A2 meets the requirements for traffic signs. There is therefore no question of wrongly imposed fines.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven dat de bebording op de A2 voldoet aan de eisen inzake verkeerstekens. Er is dan ook geen sprake van onterecht opgelegde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over te lage tarieven voor pleegzorg, jeugdbescherming en jeugdhulp

An MP asked ministers about allegedly too-low tariffs for foster care, child protection and youth care, and about related cost and funding issues. The minister answered that no broad cost study is planned, that tariffs are a matter for municipalities and providers with escalation routes available, and that a progress report on the youth care action programme will follow in May 2019.
It is primarily up to municipalities and providers to reach agreement on the realistic tariff given the specific circumstances and wishes.
Het is primair aan gemeenten en aanbieders om tot overeenstemming te komen over het reële tarief gegeven de specifieke omstandigheden en wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schokkende beelden van een hondenshow in Eindhoven

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the ministers about videos showing men touching dogs' genitals at a Eindhoven dog show, asking whether this is criminal, whether organisers must report it, and whether dog shows inherently harm welfare and should be restricted. Minister Schouten condemns the conduct as very inappropriate, notes a report has been filed with prosecution left to the Openbaar Ministerie, rejects a ban on dog shows arguing welfare can be safeguarded by supervision, and refers to earlier letters for enforcement plans.
Prosecution falls to the Public Prosecution Service.
Over de strafvervolging gaat het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vergoeden van schade na fouten door het Openbaar Ministerie

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister why a Berkel entrepreneur, whose seized equipment and administration were allegedly lost through Public Prosecution Service errors, has not received compensation, and about the court fee hardship clause. Minister Grapperhaus refused to comment on the specific case pending before the appeal court, pointed to the district court's 2 May 2018 ruling that the State had not been shown to have caused the damage, and explained that the hardship clause in the Dutch civil procedure code is available for the courts to apply case by case.
Since the case you ask about is still pending before the Court of Appeal in The Hague, a restrained answer to your questions is appropriate.
Nu de zaak waar u naar vraagt nog aanhangig is bij het gerechtshof Den Haag, past een terughoudende beantwoording van uw vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vrouwelijke IS’er wil naar Nederland’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a female IS member wanting to return to the Netherlands could be permanently denied residence, citizenship and entry. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases and only set out general naturalisation, residence and Schengen entry conditions, including refusal on public order or national security grounds.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet op individuele zaken in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat notarissen jarenlang Kadastergeld in eigen zak staken

MP Van Nispen asked whether notaries overcharged clients for Kadaster fees and why this went unnoticed, and questioned a disciplinary panel that found fraud but imposed no sanction. Minister Dekker answered that the notarial profession's oversight bodies found no evidence of a structural problem, that the disciplinary judge found the billing non-transparent but imposed no sanction given the circumstances, and that the professional body urged notaries to compensate clients.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over zwijgcontract in de jeugdbescherming

An MP asked whether a gag contract in youth protection prevented a victim from reporting abuse, whether pleegzorg screening and gag-contract bans would be pursued, and whether investigations into a silence culture were planned. The minister answered that the contract did not prevent reporting, that such contracts are undesirable and a legal change is being considered, that screening improvements are underway, and that no further investigation into a silence culture is currently warranted.
Concluding such a contract between a victim and a youth institution is something I consider very undesirable.
Het afsluiten van een dergelijk contract tussen een slachtoffer en een jeugdinstelling vind ik zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Omtzigt over de coreper-vergaderingen

Two CDA MPs asked the Interior Minister whether the Netherlands consistently argued in EU negotiations on the whistleblower directive that whistleblowers may always use the external channel directly, and for an overview of meetings and votes. The minister answered that Dutch practice allows direct external reporting where internal reporting cannot reasonably be expected, that the Netherlands actively promoted this flexible system at EU level, and that it acted consistently in all negotiating meetings.
During the negotiations the Netherlands actively and prominently worked to introduce this flexible system at European level as well.
Gedurende de onderhandelingen heeft Nederland zich actief en prominent ingezet om dit flexibele systeem ook op Europees niveau te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Twee Amsterdammers aangehouden na reeks plofkraken'

MPs Van Dam and Laan-Geselschap asked the Justice Minister about the trend in ATM explosive robberies (plofkraken), clearance rates, bank and government prevention, pilot approaches, and risks from the new Geldmaat ATM rollout. The minister reported the Dutch count rose in 2015-2016, fell in 2017-2018, and recent data show 13 cases in early 2019, with stricter prosecution guidelines, bank-police-prosecution cooperation, and pilots extended to end 2019.
Because of the large number of ongoing investigations in which further arrests are expected, the number of solved cases will still rise.
Vanwege het grote aantal lopende onderzoeken waarin nog aanhoudingen zijn te verwachten, zal het aantal opgeloste zaken nog stijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de concrete aanpak van bedreigingen van boeren

MPs Buitenweg and Bromet asked the Justice, Interior and Agriculture ministers how threats against farmers by violent animal activists are being tackled, including the scale, reporting and prosecution figures and the AIVD's assessment. The minister condemned the intimidation, said such threats are not separately registered, stressed reporting and existing police and prosecution responses, and did not commit to new measures.
Threats against farmers or vandalism of barns motivated by animal activism are not as such registered by the Public Prosecution Service and the police.
Bedreiging van boeren of vernieling van stallen vanuit dieren-activistische motieven, wordt niet als zodanig door het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over illegale bewoning op vakantieparken

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about illegal residence on holiday parks, including ZKA findings that a third of parks lack a tourist future and about ten percent face serious safety problems. Minister Ollongren answered that an action agenda 2018-2020 is being implemented, pilots will report by end 2020, an information base with the Kadaster will help municipalities, and conversion to housing is possible locally.
I will inform you about the results after the pilots are completed.
Ik zal u na afronding van de pilots over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg, De Roon en Markuszower over de financiering van een aanval op onafhankelijke Israëlische rechtspraak

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch government financed a critical B'Tselem report on Israel's High Court and whether this undermines judicial independence. The minister answered that the EUR 176,000 grant was given under a strategic plan with B'Tselem setting its own research aims and conclusions, that Nederland did not steer the report, and that it does not regard the funding as undermining judicial independence.
There has been no substantive steering by the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake geweest van inhoudelijke sturing door Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de controle van Nederlanders bij aankomst op Bonaire

An SP MP asked whether Dutch passport holders arriving on Bonaire are subjected to a thorough Marechaussee check counting their days of stay, and whether this is lawful given that the WTU-BES only allows a thorough check of aliens. The Staatssecretaris confirmed that European Dutch are checked on maximum stay, acknowledged the statutory gap, and announced a legislative amendment and expanded database checks while continuing current practice meanwhile.
I am preparing an amendment to the WTU-BES that proposes adapting the law on this point.
Ik bereid een wijziging van de WTU-BES voor waarin wordt voorgesteld de wet op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een uitleg van de Bibob-toets

An MP asks whether municipalities should be able to refuse environmental building permits under the Bibob integrity test when applicants commit criminal offences during construction, following a Council of State ruling that such offences are not a ground for refusal. The Minister replies that the legislator intended the ground to cover offences connected to the building activities, that the ruling distinguishes these from use of the finished building, and that no legislative change is planned while case law develops.
In view of the above, I see no reason to amend the law and will await further developments in case law.
Gelet op het bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding om de wet aan te passen en wacht ik de verdere ontwikkelingen in de jurisprudentie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Aartsen en Laan-Geselschap over het kraken van het Fort bij Velsen in de gemeente Beverwijk door oud-ADM-krakers

VVD MPs asked whether the government will act against squatters who occupied the listed Fort bij Velsen, whether the owner filed a complaint, and whether monumental buildings should get priority for eviction and damage recovery. Minister Grapperhaus said squatting is illegal, the owner filed a report, a court allowed eviction, and no change to prosecutorial priorities for monuments is planned, while withholding details on individual cases.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een schikking met KPMG

An MP asked ministers why KPMG's Curaçao affiliate received a small settlement for facilitating money laundering, whether the settlement should have waited for ongoing cases, and whether the Dutch prosecution service was involved. The minister answered that the decision lies with the Curaçao prosecution service, which is outside Dutch responsibility, and gave no further commitment.

In this case it is for the Curaçao prosecution service to decide whether to proceed to prosecution of the suspect in an individual criminal case and which disposal modality is appropriate and warranted.
Het is in dit geval aan het OM Curaçao om te beslissen of in een individuele strafzaak tot vervolging van de verdachte wordt overgegaan en welke afdoeningsmodaliteit passend en geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Cyberaanval kopen lijkt kattenkwaad, maar is een misdaad’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about cybercrime-as-a-service platforms selling malware, exploit kits and DDoS attacks, including their legal status, enforcement, the difficulty of tracing anonymous providers, and sentencing of providers versus users. The Minister answered that offering and using such services is punishable under the Criminal Code, that police and prosecutors investigate them with international partners, that the Computercriminaliteit III law enables takedown of such services, and that the prosecution guideline allows heavier sentences for providers, while no obligation exists for data centres to keep customer registers.
Criminal action is possible through investigation and prosecution, and by making online marketplaces, websites or parts of them inaccessible.
Strafrechtelijk optreden is mogelijk door opsporing en vervolging, en door het ontoegankelijk maken van online marktplaatsen, websites of delen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de praktijk van het opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het OM

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice how the public prosecution service (OM) delegates to staff the power to impose penal orders (strafbeschikking), how supervision by prosecutors works, and how often delegation was wrongly granted. Minister Grapperhaus answered that delegation follows legal rules and differs by function group and case type, that supervision is general in nature with case-specific pre-consultation, and that no cases of wrongful delegation are known in the past three years.
In the past three years, no cases are known in which delegation to OM staff was wrongly granted.
In de afgelopen drie jaar zijn geen gevallen bekend waarin ten onrechte aan medewerkers van het OM is gemandateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Vrouwelijke IS’er wil naar Nederland’

An MP from the CDA asked how a female IS member married to a Dutch citizen could obtain Dutch nationality, whether marriages in IS-controlled areas are recognised, whether her children could secure residence, and whether Dutch nationality can be blocked or withdrawn in national security cases. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, set out the general naturalisation conditions and the national security grounds for refusal, and said information from other countries will be considered where possible.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security to explain why the price police pay for ammunition is withheld, after a report about costly ammunition at the training range. The minister confirmed the price is commercially confidential, given an ongoing tender, but offered to make it available to the House confidentially under usual conditions.
I am willing to make the information you requested available for confidential inspection by your House under the usual conditions.
Ik ben bereid de door u gevraagde informatie – volgens de gebruikelijke voorwaarden – vertrouwelijk bij uw Kamer ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

MP Ouwehand asked the Justice Minister about the Week zonder vlees: whether the public would be urged to take part again, whether the Justice Ministry would serve meat-free canteen meals, the government's role in the campaign, and its response to external costs of meat production. The government answered via a joint reply stating the questions were answered in a separate Aanhangsel document, so no substantive answers were given here.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03360, on a week without meat, have been answered by means of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03360 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het plegen van identiteitsfraude

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked how easy it still is to commit identity fraud, how banks verify identity when opening accounts and granting credit, and whether remote and outsourced checks are adequately supervised. The minister explained the Wwft verification rules, DNB's supervision and the fraud-prevention initiatives, but gave no commitment to new measures.
DNB supervises banks' compliance with the Wwft and has named preventing institutions' involvement in financial-economic crime as a priority of its supervision.

De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wwft door banken, en heeft het voorkomen van betrokkenheid van instellingen bij financieel-economische criminaliteit benoemd als speerpunt van haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het artikel ‘Lijst van haatincidenten tegen moskeeën’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a list of hate incidents against mosques, the implementation of the 'Veilige Moskee' guidance, the threat picture and funding for mosque security. The minister condemned the incidents, said responsibility lies mainly with mosques and municipalities, declined to keep central records of measures or to fund extra security, and pointed to existing threat assessments.
I therefore see no reason to keep a central overview of the measures taken; in my view this does not contribute to the safety of mosques.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om op centraal niveau een overzicht bij te houden van de genomen maatregelen; dit levert mijns inziens geen bijdrage aan de veiligheid van de moskeeën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Is Interpol being manipulated by authoritarian regimes’

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether Interpol is being manipulated by authoritarian states through red notices and diffusions, and about rising diffusion numbers, safeguards, and private funding. The Minister denies a demonstrable trend of political misuse, points to added control mechanisms such as a task force and the CCF, and says Interpol funding is not dependent on private donors.
I am of the view that it must be strictly monitored that Interpol's constitution and rules for processing data, including the use of red notices and diffusions, are correctly applied.

Ik ben van mening dat er strikt op moet worden toegezien dat de constitutie en de regels voor het verwerken van gegeven van Interpol, en dus ook het gebruik van red notices en diffusions correct worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inspanningen van de Nederlandse Overheid om misstanden bij sektes tegen te gaan en het voortbestaan van Sektesignaal

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister whether the government will take additional measures against abuses in sects, including whether to keep the Sektesignaal reporting service after 2019. The Minister replies that the existing legal framework is adequate, rejects stricter laws and a new study, and ends Sektesignaal's funding, pointing to an online referral function instead.
I consider this set of instruments appropriate and adequate and therefore see no reason to tighten the legislation or intensify policy on abuses in sects.
Ik beschouw dit instrumentarium als passend en toereikend en zie daarom geen reden om de wetgeving aan te scherpen of het beleid inzake misstanden bij sekten te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van sektes in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice Minister about dangers and abuses in sects in the Netherlands, citing a 2013 WODC study and a newspaper report calling for government action. The minister answered that recent data show 76 dossiers in 2017, that the existing instruments are adequate, and that no new legislation or intensified policy is needed.
I consider these instruments adequate and therefore see no reason to tighten the legislation or intensify policy on abuses in sects.
Ik beschouw dit instrumentarium als toereikend en zie daarom geen reden om de wetgeving aan te scherpen of het beleid inzake misstanden bij sekten te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Krol over het bericht 'Raadslid: Jongeren gooiden mij in de sloot'

MPs Van Dam and Krol asked the Justice Minister why a councillor reporting an assault had to wait two weeks to file a complaint, and whether such delays hinder investigations. The minister answered that police aim for fast, low-threshold reporting, offer aangifte within 48 hours, and that the individual case cannot be discussed while the service is being improved.
I cannot go into the circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over nieuw onderzoek in de zaak-Poch

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about new investigation into the Poch case, including whether earlier unanswered questions would be addressed. The Minister answered that former Advocate-General Machielse has been asked to conduct an independent inquiry with a broad mandate covering ministerial involvement, reasons for the Argentina decision and contacts with foreign authorities, but gave no timeline for its outcome.
I will forward the answers to both sets of questions to Mr Machielse.
Ik zal de beantwoording van beide sets vragen doen toekomen aan de heer Machielse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Van Oosten over het bericht Fikse straffen bij geweld tegen hulpverleners? Rechters blijken milder dan OM

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Van Oosten asked the Justice Minister why courts impose lower sentence increases than the prosecution's 200% guideline for violence against public-service workers, and about snelrecht use and a reporting obligation for New Year's Eve offenders. The minister answered that the 200% is one factor within a case-specific demand, that courts largely follow prosecution demands, that the courts cannot quantify such figures, and that new measures are under discussion with relevant bodies.
When asked, the Council for the Judiciary informed me that it cannot generate overviews.
Desgevraagd heeft de Raad voor de Rechtspraak mij bericht geen overzichten te kunnen genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Ellemeet over demonstranten die vrouwen intimideren voor abortusklinieken

Three MPs asked whether anti-abortion demonstrators intimidating women outside clinics is acceptable, how far demonstration rights extend, whether such conduct is criminal, and whether the government will meet clinics and municipalities. The minister said such intimidation is undesirable, that demonstrations are widespread but usually not intimidating, that municipalities can impose conditions and APV rules may cover the conduct, and that a joint meeting with clinics and municipalities will be held before the summer recess.
With due regard to the substantive responsibilities of local government, I will invite the municipalities concerned and the abortion clinics to a joint consultation before the summer recess.
Met inachtneming van de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheden van het lokale gezag, zal ik voor het zomerreces de betrokken gemeenten en de abortusklinieken uitnodigen voor een gezamenlijk overleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat vliegmaatschappijen privédata van passagiers gaan delen met de overheid

MP Azarkan asked whether airlines sharing passenger data (PNR) with the government would record halal meal orders as a proxy for religion, and whether this should be made impossible. Minister Grapperhaus answered that halal meal preferences are not in the bill, are not among the limitative PNR data elements, that any such data sent in error would be destroyed immediately, and that special personal data is prohibited and overseen by a data protection officer and the Data Protection Authority.
Information on meal preferences such as ordering a halal meal is not provided to the passenger information unit (Pi-NL) and therefore is not stored either.
Informatie over maaltijdvoorkeuren zoals het bestellen van een halal-maaltijd wordt niet verstrekt aan de passagiersinformatie-eenheid (Pi–NL) en dus ook niet opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en lid Groothuizen over ‘het nieuwe bekostigingssysteem van het Openbaar Ministerie’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the new funding system for the Public Prosecution Service (OM), including the output/lump-sum split, treatment of innovation and overtime costs, whether a time-recording study was done, and evaluation plans. The minister answered that about 43% of the OM budget is output-funded, that no time-recording study underpinned the system, and that a periodic evaluation including staff input will be carried out.
The system provides for periodic evaluation. This will be taken up jointly by the OM and the department.
Het systeem voorziet in een periodieke evaluatie. Dit zal door het OM en het departement gezamenlijk worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een in Nederland veroordeelde pedofiel kon emigreren naar Kenia en zich daar jarenlang kon vergrijpen aan minderjarige meisjes

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security how a convicted child abuser could emigrate to Kenya and abuse girls there for years, and what can prevent such travel. The minister answered that existing legal options are sufficient, that agencies will be reminded to use them, that Interpol Green Notice use is being explored, and that a letter on travel restrictions was sent.
I am of the view that there are sufficient legal possibilities to restrict the travel behaviour of convicted child abusers.
Ik ben van mening dat er voldoende juridische mogelijkheden zijn om het reisgedrag van veroordeelden van kindermisbruik te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in nagelsalons

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about abuses in nail salons, including the National Rapporteur's call for more investigation, victims' reluctance to report, and police and Inspectorate capacity. The government answered by listing the 'Samen tegen mensenhandel' programme measures, reduced reporting barriers, and additional funding for the Inspectorate, while noting few signals have reached the authorities.
In addition, the Inspectorate SZW will receive a national human trafficking expert who will form the link between the investigative service and chain partners.
Bovendien krijgt de Inspectie SZW een landelijke expert mensenhandel die de verbinding vormt tussen de opsporingsdienst en ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht: “Konijnenfokkers bedreigd: Ik ben bang voor een kogel door mijn raam”

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about threats against rabbit farmers, inspection and offence figures, and police and government protection measures. The minister condemns all threats, reports that 15 of 45 inspections found violations (none classed as serious), and says the police do not register victims by occupation, so no figures on reports or convictions are available.
The police do not register victims by their profession and therefore have no figures available on this.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op het beroep van slachtoffers en heeft hierover dan ook geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Politie zoekt getuigen van levensgevaarlijke rit over wielerparcours’

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked about police escort of cycling races, the legality of volunteer 'motards' directing traffic, and whether organisers should fund police presence. The minister answered that motards may not direct traffic while riding, that the police role is supervisory, and that the government will consult the KNWU and other parties on possible problems if police involvement is reduced.
Yes. I consider it important to get the possible problems clearly in view and to jointly explore possible solutions, including regarding the deployment of motards.
Ja. Ik vind het belangrijk om de mogelijke problemen goed in beeld te krijgen en gezamenlijk mogelijke oplossingen te verkennen, ook waar het gaat om de inzet van motards.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het artikel 'Doe altijd aangifte! Maar waarom doen hulpverleners het zelf dan niet?'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that police officers do not file reports when assaulted during New Year's Eve, and whether they fear reprisals. The minister said no data supports the claim, the fear-of-reprisals claim is not recognised, and that all public-service workers should file reports, while noting that assault incidents against police rose from 38 to 58 and total incidents from 51 to 59.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Dief gaat in Duindorp met een auto aan de haal'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether publishing stolen-car plates is usual, how the police share information with citizens and neighbourhood watch groups, and why practice varies between municipalities. The minister answered that such disclosure is not standard, that information sharing is a case-by-case local judgement under the Wet Politiegegevens, and that a national framework for citizen initiatives is being developed.
The police do not routinely provide such data to the media, unless there is a need to do so, for example for establishing the truth.
De politie verstrekt dergelijke gegevens niet standaard aan de media, tenzij hier een noodzaak toe is met het oog op bijvoorbeeld waarheidsvinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het fenomeen breast ironing

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether breast ironing, a reported ritual practice affecting girls in Britain, occurs in the Netherlands, whether it constitutes child abuse, and whether a prevention campaign is planned. The minister answered that such cases are not known to Veilig Thuis or the police, saw no reason for research, stated that breast ironing is punishable as mistreatment, and said coordination of harmful traditional practices now sits with the Ministry of Health, with follow-up actions to be developed.
Neither Veilig Thuis nor the police are aware of such cases.
Zowel bij Veilig Thuis als bij de politie zijn dergelijke gevallen niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het feit dat slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die een beroep doen op het Centrum Seksueel Geweld daarvoor hun eigen risico moeten aanspreken

Two PvdA MPs asked why sexual violence victims using Centrum Seksueel Geweld must pay their Zvw deductible and whether this deters reporting. The government confirms the deductible applies to medical care, points to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven compensation and a planned one-year temporary arrangement to reimburse the deductible in the acute phase, but does not abolish the deductible.
The deductible does not relate to the criminal law aspect of sexual violence, but to the provision of care.
Het eigen risico heeft geen betrekking op het strafrechtelijk aspect van seksueel geweld, maar op de zorgverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Meldingen seksueel overschrijdend gedrag in sport vorig jaar verdubbeld’

An MP asked whether the doubling of reported sexual misconduct in sport reflects more abuse or greater awareness, what steps are needed, how sports bodies, police and prosecutors share information, and progress on the De Vries commission recommendations. The minister says rising reports mainly reflect greater attention, outlines a mandatory reporting duty for sports club leaders due by 2020, a convenant and work document with police and prosecutors, and annual progress reports to parliament.
In addition, the Minister of Medical Care and Sport will inform you annually, prior to the WGO sport, about the progress of implementing the De Vries commission recommendations.
Daarnaast zal de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport u jaarlijks, voorafgaand aan het WGO sport, informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van de aanbevelingen Commissie de Vries.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police use expensive operational ammunition for training and whether separate practice ammunition would save 1.5 to 2 million euros a year. The minister answered that operational ammunition is used for training to avoid mix-ups and over-penetration risks, that the price difference is small, and that separate practice ammunition would add storage and administration costs, so the police deliberately chose not to use it.
The price the police pay for its ammunition is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public, partly in light of the ongoing tender.
De prijs die de politie betaalt voor haar munitie is commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom, mede in het licht van de lopende aanbesteding, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Dutch police waste millions on expensive special bullets during training instead of cheaper practice ammunition. The Minister defended the special police ammunition on technical grounds, stated that lead-free practice ammunition would cost much less than the article claimed, and said the current policy of using operational ammunition for training will remain in the new tender, while withholding exact prices as commercially confidential.
The price the police pays for its ammunition is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public, partly in light of the ongoing tender.
De prijs die de politie betaalt voor haar munitie is commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom, mede in het licht van de lopende aanbesteding, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over grensoverschrijdende oefening in verband met een kernongeval

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether cross-border exercises with Germany were needed after a fire at a fuel fabrication plant near the Emsland nuclear plant, whether information to residents was adequate, and whether border crisis plans address cross-border issues. The state secretary answered that the fire posed no risk to the nuclear plant or the Dutch population, that cross-border exercises take place regularly with a major GEDEX exercise planned for 2020, and that the crisis plan is being updated with cross-border liaisons.
Both good information provision and cross-border exercises by emergency services and other involved bodies are of great importance.
Zowel goede informatievoorziening als ook grensoverschrijdende oefening van hulpdiensten en andere betrokken instanties is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over praktijkproblemen en rechtsbescherming bij de uitvoering van een Europees onderzoeksbevel

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about legal protection when property is seized under a European Investigation Order, including notification of the appeal deadline, confidentiality, public hearings and whether courts meet the 30-day decision deadline. The minister replied that notification practice is adequate, confidentiality is compatible with mutual recognition, a technical amendment on cassation will be added via a nota van wijziging, and no structural problem with the 30-day deadline is evident.

Why did the legislation implementing the directive choose to provide in Article 5.4.10(3) Sv that only the first and third paragraphs of Article 552d Sv apply, but not the second paragraph, which provides for cassation within fourteen days?

Vraag 7 Waarom is er in de wetgeving bij de implementatie van de richtlijn voor gekozen in artikel 5.4.10, derde lid, Wetboek van Strafvordering (Sv) op te nemen dat slechts het eerste en het derde lid van artikel 552d Sv van toepassing zijn, maar niet ook het tweede lid, waarin de mogelijkheid van cassatie binnen veertien dagen is opgenomen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Het is politie-eigen'

MP Helder asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that leaking police information is common, why investigations into leaks go wrong, and why the integrity and complaints units (VIK) handle files inconsistently. The minister says the integrity of the police is high, the report on the investigations is not yet final so he cannot discuss its conclusions, and he will send it to parliament when available and prepare a bill to expand police screening powers.
Since the conclusions of the report are not yet final, I cannot go into the substance further.
Aangezien de conclusies van het rapport nog niet definitief zijn, kan ik op de inhoud niet verder ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat duizenden mensen illegaal op een vakantiepark wonen

Two VVD MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that thousands of people live illegally on Veluwe holiday parks, including whether the government will prevent criminal groups from exploiting them and whether it will publish quantitative and per-park overviews. The minister answered that no national data exists on permanent occupancy and deferred enforcement to municipalities, while promising support, a learning network, pilots and better data.
No quantitative overview is available at national level of holiday parks where permanent residence takes place.
Op landelijk niveau is geen kwantitatief overzicht beschikbaar van vakantieparken waar permanente bewoning plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de praktijk van het opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het OM

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice about OM penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen): backlogs causing non-admissibility claims, funding, quality problems, criminal records without proper guilt establishment, statistics on objections, staff levels and clarity of CJIB letters. Minister Grapperhaus answered substantively on most points, acknowledging implementation problems, providing figures and committing to revise CJIB letters with the OM in early 2019.
It is important that the OM continues to prioritise improving quality and, through measurements and audits, measures the effect of the measures taken.
Het is van belang dat het OM blijvend prioriteit geeft aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit en door middel van metingen en audits het effect meet van de genomen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Het rommelt in de straffabrieken van het OM’

Opposition MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice about a NRC report that the Public Prosecution Service (OM) imposed penalties in ways that were not properly justified, including penalty orders issued without adequate proof of guilt, missing case files, high reversal rates, and backlogs leading to mass dismissals. Minister Grapperhaus answers that the cited figures came from an internal quality check that does not show improper guilt findings, acknowledges incomplete internal registration identified in 2014 and improved since, but declines a new independent inquiry and any halt to penalty orders.
