I fully endorse the improvements and measures taken by the OM.
Ik onderschrijf de verbeteringen en genomen maatregelen door het OM volledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Boeven vrij op straat door lange reistijd agenten'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about media reports that long transport times for police officers let suspects go free, and whether closing police stations is a cost-cutting measure that should be reversed. The minister denies known cases, defends police housing policy as balancing interests, and points to transport solutions while not committing to reverse the closures.
The unit's leadership is aware of no cases in which suspects were not arrested because of the longer travel time to a detention complex.
Bij de leiding van die eenheid zijn geen gevallen bekend van aan te houden personen die niet werden aangehouden, vanwege de langere reistijd naar een cellencomplex.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een dreigende schikking tussen het Nederlandse openbaar ministerie en Shell vanwege haar handelen in Nigeria

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service is working toward a settlement with Shell over its conduct in Nigeria, whether settlements should require admission of guilt and prosecution of managers, whether Shell's size and royal title play a role, and for an update on a motion on prosecuting executives in high settlements. The minister answered that a transaction does not imply admission of guilt in criminal law, that the prosecution service expects responsibility-taking by the company, that size and royal title are irrelevant, and that the policy guideline will be revised to include prosecution of managers where possible.
It does not befit me to say that managers should be convicted where there is evidence of personal involvement.
Het past mij niet om te zeggen dat bij bewijs van persoonlijke betrokkenheid managers veroordeeld moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de training van politieagenten op het gebied van geweld tegen vrouwen

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police training on violence against women, domestic violence statistics, ex-partner stalking and whether new approaches are needed. The minister answered that police training on domestic violence is being intensified in 2019-2020, that the Veiligheidsagenda and the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme address the issue, and that reliable stalking figures cannot be given because registrations are not unambiguous.
This means that police registrations of harassment by (ex-)partners are not always unambiguous and it is not possible to provide reliable figures on this phenomenon.
Dit maakt dat de registraties van de politie over het lastigvallen door (ex-)partners niet altijd eenduidig zijn en het niet mogelijk is om betrouwbare cijfers op dit fenomeen te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Burgemeesters verbolgen over einde aan lintje voor brandweervrijwilligers’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the end of automatic royal honours for volunteer firefighters with 20 years of service, and whether the government would reverse the decision. The minister answered that the honours policy no longer fits current practice, pointed to alternative recognitions such as Brandweer Nederland's own awards and a 10-year volunteer medal, and declined to reconsider.
I understand this decision, which was taken after consultation with me as the minister responsible for the fire service system.
Ik heb begrip voor dit besluit dat na overleg met mij als verantwoordelijke voor het stelsel van de Brandweerzorg is genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijk negatieve effecten van de e-privacyrichtlijn op het werk van het Expertise Centrum Online Kindermisbruik

MP Van Nispen asked whether the ePrivacy Directive would prevent the EOKM and private parties from scanning uploads for child sexual abuse material without user consent, and whether the EOKM could keep using its hash database. The State Secretary answered that uploads are not preventively scanned, that ePrivacy rules stop applying once content reaches the host's server so hash-based removal remains possible, and that national exceptions for crime prevention may be explored.
Regarding the approach to child pornographic content, I am considering together with the Minister of Justice and Security to explore this option if the number of reports does not decline.
Voor wat betreft de aanpak van kinderpornografische inhoud overweeg ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid deze optie te verkennen wanneer het aantal meldingen niet daalt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de bruikbaarheid van de cijfers van het World Justice Project bij het vergelijken van rechtsstelsels

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice ministers how the World Justice Project Rule of Law Index is compiled, who funds and conducts the Dutch survey, how representative it is, and whether it justifies firm comparative conclusions. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the index is one of several indicators, that YouGov conducts the Dutch survey of about a thousand respondents in three cities, that the ministry does not fund it, and that the index is sufficiently reliable alongside other studies.
The World Justice Project is funded by, among others, foundations, governments, companies, individuals and national Bars of Lawyers.
Het World Justice Project wordt gefinancierd door onder andere stichtingen, overheden, bedrijven, individuen en nationale Ordes van Advocaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over een misbruikdrama in de atletiekwereld

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked why a 2009 report of boundary-crossing conduct by an athletics coach led to no investigation, whether the athletics federation should have reported to police, whether criminal complaints were filed, and whether tuchtrecht rulings should feed into criminal prosecution and VOG screening. The minister said the police-led investigation covers the earlier report and cannot be discussed, that criminal law takes precedence over disciplinary law, that the Centrum Seksueel Geweld and Slachtofferhulp can help victims, and that linking sports disciplinary lists to the VOG is not desirable.
To get a good picture of the matters at issue, the police investigation team led by the Public Prosecution Service gathers as much relevant information as possible.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de zaken die spelen en gespeeld hebben, vergaart het onderzoeksteam van politie onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) zoveel mogelijk relevante informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten betreffende het misbruikschandaal in de atletiekwereld

MP Markuszower asked the Minister of Justice and Security for a timeline of who knew what about abuse in athletics, whether failing to report abuse should be made a crime, and whether victims could report anonymously. The minister declined a timeline citing ongoing criminal investigations, pointed to existing reporting practices, a 2017 convenant and a planned study on widening reporting duties, and described existing and planned privacy measures for victims, though answers were delayed.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de bijna-ramp rond het vreugdevuur Scheveningen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether an independent investigation into the near-disaster at the Scheveningen New Year's bonfire would be requested from the Dutch Safety Board. The minister replied that he understood the Safety Board would start an investigation at the request of The Hague's mayor and declined to comment further at this stage.
I understand that the Dutch Safety Board, within the framework set by the Kingdom Act, will start an investigation into this local situation at the request of The Hague's mayor.

Ik heb begrepen dat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, binnen de kaders die de Rijkswet hiervoor geeft, op verzoek van de burgemeester van Den Haag een onderzoek zal opstarten naar deze lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de rol van instanties rond het langdurig misbruikschandaal in de atletiekwereld

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why police and the OM only started an investigation after publication, whether a Rotterdam athletics coach is in the sports misconduct register, and how registers, information-sharing agreements and public disclosure of disciplinary rulings are being developed. The minister answered that ongoing criminal investigations cannot be discussed, that the coach is listed in the register, that a separate sex-offence register is undesirable under the GDPR, and that a joint register and a cooperation document with police and the OM are in preparation.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom, Van Raan, Teunissen, Ouwehand en Wassenberg over de speech van Greta Thunberg tijdens de VN-klimaattop COP24 in Katowice, Polen

MPs Akerboom, Van Raan, Teunissen, Ouwehand and Wassenberg asked the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech and whether ministers would take radical climate measures. The government replied that its policy aims at the Paris targets, that it engages youth and business in the Klimaatakkoord, and that it is pursuing a range of climate measures across ministries.
Government policy is therefore aimed at meeting the targets of Paris.
Het kabinetsbeleid is dan ook gericht op het halen van de doelen van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Man uit Doornenburg verdacht van voorbereiden aanslag op moslims’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a suspect from Doornenburg accused of preparing an attack on Muslims, his alleged ties to an extreme-right group and past Defence service, and whether the security services and government monitor far-right groups and their possible links to police or Defence. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said far-right groups are fluid and monitored by AIVD/MIVD where threats arise, and stated that jihadism has long been the dominant threat, while far-right violence is seen as coming mainly from small radicalising groups or individuals.
I do not make statements about individual criminal cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie registreert bewust de afkomst van agenten' en het interview met de nieuwe portefeuillehouder diversiteit

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police's diversity programme manager was quoted correctly, why diversity should be pursued, what the 25% target covers, and whether police should tolerate jokes. The Minister confirmed the quote, argued that a diverse force strengthens legitimacy and effective policing, clarified the 25% target concerns recruits with a dual cultural background, and said humour is acceptable but discrimination is not.
A diverse composition of the police force contributes to the legitimacy and therefore the authority of the police.
Een diverse samenstelling van het politiekorps draagt bij aan de legitimiteit en daarmee het gezag van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht dat criminelen misbruik maken van pakketbezorgers PostNL

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about reports that criminals exploit PostNL parcel delivery, the cooperation with police, prosecutors and tax authorities, intimidation of couriers, unlicensed courier firms, and whether subcontractor pay drives violations. The government describes the PIT team and seizures, notes the RIEC pilot, says licensing thresholds stay unchanged and that PostNL and subcontractors set their own terms, while liability for wage violations exists under existing law.
No information is given about further outcomes of this approach or follow-up in individual cases.
Over verdere uitkomsten van deze werkwijze en opvolging daarvan in individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het expertisecentrum CBRN-explosieven binnen de Landelijke Eenheid van de Politie

The MP asks about police encounters with explosives and CBRN hazards, how police CBRN expertise is organised, and whether the CENTREX CBRN-Explosives expertise centre will be dissolved. The minister confirms growing explosives use in ram and blast robberies, notes no rise in CBRN incidents, describes the CENTREX pilot as functioning as a multidisciplinary centre, and says a more durable organisational form is being worked on.
Securing the current tasks of the pilot project is the next important step in the process.
Borging van de huidige taken van het pilotproject is de volgende belangrijke stap in het proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over deals met kroongetuigen waarbij zij crimineel geld mogen houden

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how often deals with crown witnesses have allowed criminals to keep or reduce the proceeds of crime, what the costs are, and whether this is still justified. The minister answered that ten witness commitments were made from 2006 to 2018, that at most half of the confiscation claim was waived in one case, that the 2006 policy has been kept, and that he sees no reason to reconsider it.

I consider the arguments the then Minister of Justice set out in his letter of 12 April 2005 to support extending permissible commitments to reducing the confiscation claim for unlawfully obtained benefit still valid today.

Ik acht de argumenten die de toenmalige Minister van Justitie in zijn brief van 12 april 2005 uiteen heeft gezet ter onderbouwing van de uitbreiding van toelaatbare toezeggingen met de mogelijkheid tot het doen van de toezegging tot het verminderen van de vordering tot ontneming van wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel, ook nu nog valide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bewapening van boa’s bij Oud en Nieuw

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether municipal enforcement officers (boa's) face growing insecurity during New Year's Eve when local fireworks-free zones are enforced, and what protects them. The minister acknowledges unsafe situations can arise, says no central data is kept, leaves enforcement and risk assessment to local authorities, and points to an announced independent evaluation and the Veilige Publieke Taak approach.
Data on the (un)safety of boa's, whether or not in relation to local fireworks-free zones, is not kept centrally.
Gegevens omtrent de (on)veiligheid van boa’s, al dan niet in relatie tot lokale vuurwerkvrije zones, worden niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked whether differences in unusual-transaction reporting between banks, and ING's sharp rise in 2017, prompted DNB to check other banks' monitoring systems. The minister answered that reports are not comparable across banks, that DNB conducts risk-based AML supervision and thematic investigations (2016 and 2018) that found weaknesses at several institutions, and that enforcement follows where violations occur.
DNB continuously conducts risk-based Wwft supervision of banks, including the effectiveness of transaction monitoring.
DNB houdt doorlopend risicogebaseerd Wwft-toezicht op banken, met inbegrip van de effectiviteit van de transactiemonitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het RST op Curaçao

An MP asks whether internal management problems at the RST recherche team in the Caribbean Netherlands delayed or affected investigations, including the murder of politician Helmin Wiels, and why signals from whistleblowers were not acted on sooner. The minister replies that cooperation with partners is in order, that the police chief says the Wiels investigation was not frustrated, that signals were followed up with talks, a team coach and harmonised labour rules, and that an interim team leader has been appointed while the RST's future positioning is to be decided.
I will of course continue to keep your House informed about relevant developments regarding the functioning of the RST.
Over relevante ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot het functioneren van het RST zal ik uw Kamer uiteraard blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over betere communicatie rondom de experimenten gesloten coffeeshopketen

An MP asked the ministers whether misunderstandings about the closed coffeeshop experiment, such as the belief that it automatically ends after four years, were causing declining municipal interest, and how these would be corrected. The minister denied direct signals of declining interest, acknowledged differing municipal preferences, and promised information meetings, written information to all municipalities and a registration procedure with the VNG.
We assume that municipalities will have sufficient clarity about the design and framework of the experiment once the bill has been adopted by the House of Representatives.
Wij gaan ervan uit dat voor gemeenten voldoende duidelijkheid bestaat over de invulling en kaders van het experiment als het wetsvoorstel eenmaal door de Tweede Kamer is aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kuik over de uitzending ‘Voodoo maffia’

MPs Segers and Kuik asked the Justice Minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on undocumented Nigerian trafficking victims bound by voodoo rituals, and whether police should specialise in Nigerian trafficking networks. The State Secretary answered that a dedicated police specialism is not desirable, pointing to existing specialised teams, international cooperation with Nigeria, Italy, Belgium and the EMPACT framework, and expecting better radar on networks through these measures.
A specialised team within the police focused solely on this target group is not something I consider desirable.
Een specialistisch team dat zich binnen de politie alleen op deze doelgroep richt acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Den Boer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat een Rus waarschijnlijk de nieuwe baas van Interpol wordt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Den Boer and Van Toorenburg asked whether Russian candidate Alexander Prokopchuk would become Interpol president, whether the Netherlands would vote against him, and whether he was linked to politically motivated Red Notices against Kremlin critics. The Minister answered that Mr Kim was elected president on 21 November 2018, that Red Notice procedures are bound by Interpol's constitution, and that the questions arrived after the vote.
These questions reached me after the election of Mr KIM as the new president of the INTERPOL Executive Committee.
Deze vragen hebben mij bereikt na afloop van de verkiezing van de heer KIM als nieuwe president van het INTERPOL Executief Comité.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Vergunning in strijd tegen criminaliteit’

Two VVD MPs asked whether a licensing requirement with financial checks for certain branches or streets, as used in Rotterdam, could help fight undermining crime, and whether mayors have a factsheet of administrative tools. The minister answered that municipalities may introduce such licensing within the limits of higher law and that existing information for mayors is sufficient, so no factsheet or new guidance is planned.
No, there is already sufficient information available for municipalities.
Nee, er is voor gemeenten al voldoende informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Rookgordijnen rond Bilal L.’

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they would strip Bilal L. and Abderrazak A.O. of Dutch nationality and expel them, and whether they would clear the Stopera of Islamist criminal and jihad-facilitating elements. The Minister replied that nationality can be withdrawn only for terrorist convictions or threats to national security and not if the person would become stateless, and rejected the depicted picture, pointing to Amsterdam municipality's responsibility for the local jihadism approach.
I do not recognise the picture you have sketched. The municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for the Amsterdam local approach to jihadism and its implementation.
Ik herken me niet in het door u geschetste beeld. De gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de Amsterdamse lokale aanpak jihadisme en de uitvoering daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Jongeren veroordeeld voor geweld tegen homo’s Dordrecht’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that youths were convicted for violence against gay people in Dordrecht, the gap between roughly 1,300 yearly reports and very few convictions, how many cases reach the prosecutor and lead to prosecution, possibilities to increase prosecutions, and when insults like 'kankerhomo' count as anti-gay discrimination. The minister answered with 2017 statistics, explained why reports fall away before prosecution, pointed to an forthcoming LHBTI safety action plan, and described the legal test for discriminatory insults.
Together with the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, I will send a Safety Action Plan for LHBTI to your House in the first quarter of 2019.
Samen met de Minister van OCW zal ik in het eerste kwartaal van 2019 een Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Rode Kruis: “Stop met filmen, ga liever helpen”’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister whether bystanders filming accident victims and obstructing rescuers, including 25 fines issued on the A58 for phone use while driving, are adequately addressed and whether privacy is harmed. The minister said filming in public is generally lawful but morally wrong when victims are filmed, that phone use while driving is punishable, and that the government will propose a separate offence for obstructing rescuers and rely on existing portrait-right protections.
Therefore the cabinet proposes to make obstructing rescue workers a standalone criminal offence in the Criminal Code, regardless of where it takes place.
Daarom stelt het kabinet voor om het hinderen van hulpverleners als zelfstandig delict strafbaar te stellen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht, ongeacht waar dit plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Aartsen over het bericht dat John van den Heuvel wegens dreiging niet meer in de studio van RTL kan verschijnen

MPs Sneller and Aartsen asked why journalist John van den Heuvel could no longer appear in the RTL studio due to threats and how this squares with the agreement on protecting journalists. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the decision was a proportionate local security assessment by the Amsterdam triangle, that press freedom is not curtailed, and that the agreed journalist-protection measures are being implemented.
There is, however, no question of Mr Van den Heuvel being denied the right to speak or being advised against expressing himself (on television).
Er is echter geen sprake van dat dhr. van den Heuvel het woord wordt ontnomen of hem wordt afgeraden zich (op televisie) te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Examenlek nieuwkomers via besloten netwerken’

An MP from the PVV asked ministers whether participants in an alleged leak of exam questions via social media should be treated as criminals, deported, and whether asylum-route arrivals should be returned. The government answered that sharing recollections of exam questions is not criminal fraud, that deportation applies only under specific legal criteria after conviction, and that asylum status holders cannot generally be returned via safe countries.
Sharing information about the exam questions based on recollections does not qualify as fraud in the criminal sense.
Dit delen van informatie over de examenopgaven, gebaseerd op herinneringen, kwalificeert zich niet als fraude in de strafrechtelijke betekenis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Overlast door bruiloftsstoet: de feiten’

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether wedding convoys disrupting traffic with antisocial manoeuvres, including a Rotterdam convoy throwing fireworks, are being tackled, how many such incidents occurred, and whether rental-car operators could be blacklisted. The minister replied that police act on reports and issue fines, that no separate registration exists, that investigation of the Rotterdam incidents is ongoing, and that no blacklist is considered necessary.
The police have informed me that no separate registration of these is kept.
De politie heeft mij laten weten dat hiervan geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘BOA wacht lang op politiehulp’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that BOAs (special investigating officers) wait long for police assistance, and about the division of tasks and powers in the security chain. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the roles of police, BOAs and private security, said the monopoly on force stays with police, and pointed to a forthcoming WRR exploration of the police function in 2020.
I have committed to sending this study, with a policy response, to your House.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd dit onderzoek, voorzien van een beleidsreactie, toe te sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Jihad-opruier Mounim A. komt vrij’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he would act against judges who released a jihad-inciter and urged administrative detention of jihadists. The minister defended the independence of judges, refused to intervene in individual cases, and rejected administrative detention as unjustified, pointing to criminal-law and other measures instead.
Administrative detention, in the sense of preventive detention without a reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.
Administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, is geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over aangifte van een geweldsmisdrijf op het Leidseplein in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a victim of a violent crime on the Leidseplein in Amsterdam could report it much sooner than the one-week wait mentioned on social media, and about waiting lists and differences between police units. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, said police aim for fast, low-threshold contact, estimated a two-to-five-day wait in Amsterdam based on practice, and noted that reporting is arranged by appointment with capacity planned in advance.
I will not go into individual cases. That is a matter for the local authority.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken. Dat is aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Tilburgs zwembad doet deuren dicht tijdens feestje, vier meisjes mogelijk aangerand’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a Tilburg swimming pool locked its doors during a party where four girls were possibly assaulted, and about measures such as finger scanning for entry. The minister answered that pool order is a local matter, that the mayor has informed the council, that no criminal complaint has been filed so far, and that camera footage was handed to police.
Enforcing order and rules in swimming pools is a local matter.
De handhaving van de orde en regels in zwembaden is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het witwassen van miljarden euro’s door criminelen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about estimates that some 16 billion euros is laundered yearly in the Netherlands, and whether banks can keep criminal money out, including the ING Curaçao transactions. The minister acknowledged the scale, pointed to DNB's supervision and deficiencies at banks, listed ongoing anti-money-laundering legislation and EU initiatives, and promised an integral policy response in Q1 2019.
It has already been promised to the House that an integral policy response will be sent in the first quarter of 2019.
Aan uw Kamer is reeds toegezegd dat een integrale beleidsreactie in het eerste kwartaal van 2019 zal worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het eenvoudig uitgeven van zwart geld in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the ease of spending black money in the Netherlands after an undercover broadcast showed many shopkeepers accepting suspicious cash, and asked about FIU outreach, sector supervision and the chance of SME audits. The government answered that kitchen and bathroom sellers only came under Wwft supervision recently, outlined risk-based supervision and an integral policy response due in early 2019, and declined to give a percentage chance that an SME is audited.
The Wwft Supervision Bureau will pay attention to this.
Het Bureau Toezicht Wwft zal hier aandacht voor houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat de veiligheid van vuurpijlen niet gegarandeerd kan worden

MP Teunissen asked about reports that firework launch stands failed safety tests and whether the sale of rockets should be banned if no safe stands are found. The Staatssecretaris confirmed the test failures, said TNO is researching alternative stands and that the trade must supply safe ones, and declined to commit to a ban for now.
Firework sellers bear a statutory responsibility for a launch stand that meets the requirements.
De verkopers van vuurwerk dragen een bij wet vastgelegde verantwoordelijkheid voor een lanceerstandaard die voldoet aan de eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘EU zet bij grenscontrole dubieuze leugendetectie in’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about an EU pilot (IBORDER CTRL) using a lie-detection system at external borders, questioning its scientific basis, ethical review, and whether the Netherlands would take part. The Minister answered that the pilot runs until August 2019 so effects cannot yet be judged, that the Netherlands does not participate, and that deployment must respect Schengen Borders Code and GDPR rules, while detailed conditions are unknown to him.
The concrete arrangements and conditions for implementing this pilot are not known to me.
De concrete invulling en voorwaarden voor de implementatie van deze pilot zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Helder over het bericht ‘Crimineel liever niet te snel storen’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister how the rule of law and public safety can be defended when police and prosecutors intervene early against criminals planning violence, and whether preparatory offences should be tightened. The minister answered that police and prosecutors weigh effectiveness and timing case by case, that existing preparation offences (art. 46 Sr) are adequate, and that a bill raises penalties for automatic firearms and criminal organisations.
Are you prepared to amend the law and sharpen the punishable preparatory acts?
Bent u bereid de wet te wijzigen en de strafbare voorbereidingshandelingen aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘112 onbereikbaar door accudieven’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that battery theft from telecom masts threatens 112 availability, and whether it is being tackled. The minister answered that emergency calls are largely protected by roaming and call priority, that police registered 136 theft reports in 2018 with few arrests, that no data exists on outages caused by theft, and that police prioritise theft by seriousness and indicators, with regional consultations possible.
Theft of emergency power batteries therefore does not directly lead to reduced availability.
Diefstal van noodstroomaccu’s leidt dan ook niet direct tot een verminderde bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en andere Nederlandse havens

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Trade, Finance and Justice about fines on airlines at Schiphol for illegally transporting strategic goods, prosecution figures, Customs capacity and procedures, and an alleged shipment of Dagaie missile defence parts to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that courts have fined some transporters since 2013 but that OM does not register such cases by sector, that Customs stopped 19 military shipments to Saudi Arabia since 2014 (two illegal exports found), that the current enforcement approach has been policy since 2013, and that carriers are legally obliged to assist Customs.

It is not possible to provide an overview of convictions by sector (such as transport companies) or an overview of the number of investigations per year, because the illegal transit of military goods is not registered as such in the OM's systems.

Het is niet mogelijk een overzicht te geven van veroordelingen per branche (zoals die van vervoersbedrijven) dan wel een overzicht van het aantal onderzoeken per jaar, omdat het illegaal doorvoeren van militaire goederen niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd in de systemen van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Aanpak illegaal vuurwerk in gevaar’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about reports that the police were not arranging for seized illegal fireworks to be removed or guarded before the new year, and whether controls at parcel services had stalled. The minister answered that a robust storage and transport process is being designed with safety as the priority, that controls at parcel services do take place, and that the approach depends on the circumstances and quantity found.
In my letter of 14 November I informed your House of how the work process for storage and transport of illegal fireworks is being given a robust and sustainable form.
In mijn brief van 14 november jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop het werkproces met betrekking tot opslag en vervoer van illegaal vuurwerk robuust en duurzaam wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Van Dam over het bericht ‘So werden Erdogan-Kritiker in Deutschland per App denunziert’

MPs Heerma and Van Dam asked whether a Turkish police reporting app used to denounce Erdogan critics in Germany is also used in the Netherlands and whether it can be banned from app stores. The government said it is unknown whether the app is used this way in the Netherlands, that such use would be unacceptable, that Turkey would be addressed if it encouraged it, and that app store vetting is primarily the providers' responsibility.
If the app is indeed used for this purpose, it is totally undesirable.
Als de app inderdaad voor dit doeleinde wordt gebruikt, dan is dit volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel 'Beroepsgroep gynaecologen: IVF-draagmoederschap ook mogelijk voor homostellen'

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked nine questions about the NVOG's 2016 position allowing IVF surrogacy with donor gametes, including its medical, legal and privacy implications and costs. The Minister answered that the position was grounded in a careful assessment, that surrogacy is already possible, that costs for non-medical cases are not covered by basic insurance, and that the government is not responsible for clinic decisions, offering limited commitments.
Offering IVF surrogacy is separate from a decision on a legal framework and from the research on this in the context of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap advice.
Het aanbieden van ivf-draagmoederschap staat los van een besluit tot een juridische regeling en de onderzoeken daarnaar in het kader van het advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van den Bosch over de aftakeling van vakantieparken

VVD MPs Van Oosten and Van den Bosch asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about crime and decline on small holiday parks, including the action agenda, enforcement powers, anonymous reporting, owner responsibility and registration of addresses. The minister acknowledged the problem, described the 2018-2020 action agenda and coordination role, said existing laws are in principle sufficient, and pointed to a legal framework to be drafted and address-quality work.
There is no national picture available of the total number of holiday parks undermined by crime and their geographic spread.
Er is geen landelijk beeld beschikbaar van het totale aantal vakantieparken dat door criminaliteit wordt ondermijnd en de geografische spreiding daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ruim duizend automobilisten onder invloed van drugs’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the backlog of over a thousand drug-driving cases, sentencing levels, drug-test practice and enforcement capacity. The Minister said cases are being scheduled in stages, sentences follow the prosecutors' guideline with a higher penalty proposed in a pending bill, and the police are reviewing how they register test results.
I intend to speak with the police about options for more separate registration, and this point will also be addressed.
Ik ben voornemens met de politie te spreken over mogelijkheden voor meer afzonderlijke registratie, waarbij ook dit punt aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de registratie van incidenten met vuurwapens

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether firearms incidents are poorly recorded, whether the creation of the National Police has worsened this, and what concrete steps will curb firearms among schoolchildren. The minister acknowledged that firearms incidents are not easily retrievable in statistics, described an experimental free-text search model, and listed existing school checklists, police training, local campaigns and a planned amnesty, without committing to a specific new statistical or legislative change.
When a firearm was used in such a case, this is recorded in the free-text fields of the systems, but to date it cannot be easily retrieved when generating statistical data.
Als hierbij een vuurwapen is gebruikt, wordt dit wel in de vrije tekstvelden in de systemen vastgelegd, maar dit is tot op heden niet goed terug te vinden bij het genereren van statistische gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet gebruiken van de digitale meldplicht rondom voetbalwedstrijden

Senator-level MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice minister why the digital reporting obligation (digitale meldplicht) for football banned persons is apparently not used, and what the status is of the promised person-focused approach and mandatory linking of reporting duties to stadium bans. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the tool has been used little, the OM knows of no cases since 2016 because no serious incidents justified it, and he will raise its use and technological options in a later evaluation and in a spring 2019 update.

At an evaluation, at a time yet to be determined, of the statutory measures against football hooliganism, I will ask for attention to the use of the digital reporting obligation and the reasons for whether or not it is applied.

Ik zal bij een evaluatie, op een nog nader te bepalen moment, van de wettelijke maatregelen ter bestrijding van voetbalvandalisme aandacht vragen voor de toepassing van de maatregel digitale meldplicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het ‘minder Marokkanen-proces’ zou hebben beïnvloed

PVV MP Wilders asked whether former minister Opstelten influenced the decision to prosecute him for his 2014 remarks about Moroccans, and why RTL Nieuws's information requests and FOIA request received incomplete answers. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Public Prosecution Service took an independent prosecution decision, that searches found no formal instruction or request from the minister, that the minister's communications with the College are confidential ambtsberichten not disclosed, and that no notes or minutes showing ministerial involvement were found.
I will therefore not provide a copy of this official report.
Ik zal daarom geen afschrift doen van dit ambtsbericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Wel vragen, geen zorgen over breken politiehandboeien’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how an arrestee could break police handcuffs in two, whether the equipment is sound, and whether the cause would be investigated. The minister answered that handcuffs must not break, that the manufacturer is investigating the cause, that police see no reason for extra measures now, and that the broken pair belonged to the old series being replaced gradually.
Handcuffs, after all, should not break.
Handboeien horen immers niet te breken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over internet langs de grens in Schinveld

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked why residents of Schinveld lost internet access despite permits, and whether a cross-border solution would be pursued. The State Secretary replied that the government did not cut any existing connection, explained the wiretap and 112 conditions for a new network, and said talks with Agentschap Telecom and residents are ongoing with a progress update promised.
However, there has been no question of the government cutting the existing internet connection, nor any intention to do so.
Van het verbreken van de (bestaande) verbinding met internet door de Nederlandse overheid is echter geen sprake geweest, evenmin van een intentie daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over lessen uit het Belgisch voetbalschandaal

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about lessons from the Belgian match-fixing scandal, including Dutch measures, links to other crime, the role of agents and international cooperation. The minister answered that a national match-fixing platform exists, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot, there are no concrete signals of spread to the Netherlands, and an in-depth study of agents is not planned though international cooperation continues.
To improve this, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot period.
Om hierin verbetering aan te brengen, wordt voor een pilotperiode van twee jaar een informatiecoördinator benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het onderzoek van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) naar medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the government whether WHO evidence on medicinal cannabis should change Dutch policy, including home cultivation for patients, and what position the Netherlands will take at the UN. The minister answered that home cultivation remains prohibited under the Opium Act, that only a contracted grower may supply quality-controlled medicinal cannabis, and that the Dutch position will depend on the WHO conclusions to be presented in December.
Cultivating cannabis under unconditioned conditions (such as home cultivation) will result in the composition and concentration of various substances in the end product varying continuously.

Het telen van cannabis onder ongeconditioneerde omstandigheden (zoals thuisteelt) zal tot gevolg hebben dat de samenstelling en concentratie van verschillende stoffen in het eindproduct steeds verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘De Nederlandsche Bank laat bewust leemte in toezicht op witwaswet’

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Dam asked about the ING money-laundering settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, DNB's supervision of ING's remediation plan, IFI system use, unusual-transaction reporting figures by major bank, accountants' comments, and criminal liability of managers for omissions. The government answered that DNB monitors ING's remediation closely and will use supervisory tools if needed, withheld DNB information on ING's IFI use citing confidentiality, provided reporting statistics, and rejected the view that the criminal law is too focused on active conduct, declining a scientific study.
If it appears that ING has not implemented the imposed improvements in a timely and complete manner, DNB will use its supervisory instruments.
Indien blijkt dat ING niet tijdig en volledig de opgelegde verbeteringen heeft doorgevoerd, zal DNB haar toezichtinstrumentarium benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell kinderen wurgcontracten zou hebben laten ondertekenen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked ministers about reports that Shell had children sign contracts with broad rights waivers, English-law jurisdiction and confidentiality clauses for Generation Discover 2018, and about related questions on the Hogeschool Leiden and the festival. The government answered that the forms were sent in error, were replaced, and that affected children were not photographed, declined to answer questions 3 to 25 because Shell will destroy the contracts, and did not consider the other issues reason for action beyond general comments.
Because Shell will destroy the agreements you refer to and will therefore not rely on them, I will not address questions 3 through 25, as you yourself suggest.
Omdat Shell de overeenkomsten waar u naar verwijst, zal vernietigen en daar dus geen beroep op zal doen ga ik, zoals u zelf voorstelt, niet in op de vragen 3 tot en met 25.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de verdeling van extra politiecapaciteit binnen de politie-eenheid Midden-Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the extra police capacity for the Midden-Nederland unit was really going to strengthen neighbourhood teams, as the minister had said, and who decides on the allocation. The minister replied that the extra capacity is targeted at neighbourhood work, organised crime and cybercrime, that mayors and the chief public prosecutor decide the allocation under the Police Act, and that he has no formal power to order a reallocation unless a mayor appeals and the threshold of unacceptable harm is met.
Because formal decision-making has not been completed in most units, I do not yet have a precise overview of the allocation of this extra operational strength.
Omdat formele besluitvorming in de meeste eenheden nog niet is afgerond heb ik nog geen precies overzicht van de verdeling van deze extra operationele sterkte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onduidelijkheid over de verdeling van het geld voor de strafrechtketen

MP Van Nispen asks why the Justice Minister did not inform parliament in time before the 2019 budget debate about how the coalition-agreement funds for criminal justice chain capacity are divided, and why the 2018 split and multi-year figures are unclear. Minister Grapperhaus answers that the funds are released only after approved spending plans, that a plan for 2018 is approved (2.3m to prosecution, 1.3m judiciary, 0.8m NFI, 0.6m legislative capacity), and that the 2019 and later plan was only recently approved and will be added by amendment, while declining to provide a full cross-chain overview of past cuts.

Yes. As discussed and promised during the General Consultation on criminal law matters on 8 November and the General Consultation on organised crime on 14 November, I hereby inform you, before the budget debate, of the precise distribution of these funds for 2018 and the process toward a distribution for 2019 and later.

Ja. Zoals besproken en toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg strafrechtelijke onderwerpen op 8 november jongstleden en het AO georganiseerde criminaliteit op 14 november jongstleden heb ik u hierbij nog vóór de begrotingsbehandelingnader geïnformeerd over de precieze verdeling van deze middelen over het jaar 2018 en het proces om te komen tot een verdeling voor 2019 en later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de reactie van de klokkenluider op het onderzoek naar beïnvloeding van WODC-onderzoeken

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister how to respond to whistleblower Van Ooyen's criticism of the Overgaauw commission's findings on alleged influence over WODC drug reports, and what will be done so whistleblowers are protected. Minister Grapperhaus defended the commission's conclusion that the reports were reliable, said confidential interview records are not available to him, and announced a standing integrity committee and independent reporting point for misconduct reports.
This permanent JenV integrity committee will consist of independent experts who will receive and investigate reports of suspected misconduct and non-integrity conduct by managers.

Deze vaste integriteitscommissie JenV zal gaan bestaan uit onafhankelijke deskundigen die meldingen van een vermoeden van een misstand en niet integere gedragingen van managers in behandeling neemt en onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het rapport Integraal Appel over de wietteelt in Tilburg is gebaseerd op drijfzand

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers whether the report 'Integraal Appel' on cannabis cultivation in Tilburg, reportedly based on a dubious single criminal-circuit source, is scientifically sound and whether its figures still shape policy. The Minister declines to judge the report's scientific quality, says it was commissioned regionally and not by the ministries, and states that the broader picture of drug crime rests on multiple sources and that policy does not depend on this specific calculation.
This concerns a confidential report that was not drawn up by or commissioned by the Ministries of Justice and Security or of Health, Welfare and Sport.
Het betreft hier een vertrouwelijk rapport dat niet door of in opdracht van de ministeries van Justitie en Veiligheid of Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het groeiende drugsafvalprobleem

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the growing problem of drug waste dumping, including its cost, a possible link to repressive drug policy, and MDMA use and risks. The minister said he lacked data to confirm the waste figures, gave only partial cost data from a co-financing fund, cited CBS figures on MDMA users, and promised a letter from the health state secretary on normalisation of drug use in early 2019.
I do not have data to confirm these claims exactly.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens om deze stellingen exact te staven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de toename van synthetische drugscriminaliteit

The MP Van der Staaij asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the rise in synthetic drug crime, its effects, whether police and prosecutors have enough powers and capacity, information sharing, and protection of officials. The Minister says the picture is mixed, that drug crime has fallen overall, but lab takedowns and dumps are rising, and that the government is investing extra money and capacity and will inform parliament further on funding and information sharing.
I am currently consulting with my colleague of Finance on an agreement regarding the spending plans.
Ik ben nu in afstemming over een akkoord van mijn collega van Financiën over de bestedingsplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘drugsdumpingen in Zuid-Nederland’

An MP from D66 asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about the rise in drug waste dumpings and synthetic drug labs in the south of the Netherlands, including police data, investigative capacity, legal instruments and the ondermijningskamer. The Minister answered with regional counts, explained limits in ERISSP registration and LFO capacity, and said existing laws are adequate and that a strategic advisory report is expected by year end.
I cannot go into this specific incident, because it forms part of operational information.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit specifieke incident, omdat dit onderdeel is van operationele informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de berichten 'Criminelen achter drugsafvaldumpingen wanen zich onaantastbaar' en 'Spoor van negen kilometer drugsafval leidt naar gedumpt busje in Nijmegen'

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice Minister about reports of escalating drug-waste dumping near homes, including the rise in incidents, prosecutions, the penalty for criminal organisations, public awareness campaigns, and who pays for clean-up. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, cited court sentences, said data cannot be fully generated, rejected raising the penalty for dumping itself, and noted that a sustainable clean-up funding solution is still being explored by an interadministrative working group.
A complete overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste cannot be generated from the Public Prosecution Service's registration systems.
Uit de registratiesystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) is geen volledig overzicht te genereren van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld voor het dumpen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de politieverhoren en een mogelijke gerechtelijke dwaling in de Arnhemse Villamoord

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about police interrogation practices and possible miscarriage of justice in the Arnhem Villamoord case, including whether the novum-based review regime and interrogation rules need changing. The minister declined to judge the case pending the procurator-general's inquiry, pointed to ongoing professionalisation of interrogations and an upcoming evaluation and WODC monitor, and promised policy responses to the House.
It is still too early to conclude that this is the case here.
Het is nog te vroeg om de conclusie te trekken dat daarvan in deze zaak sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over mogelijke betutteling in de rechtspraak na de verwijdering van het schilderij uit de rechtbank Almelo

An FvD MP asked whether the removal of the painting 'Regelrecht' from the Almelo court reception hall reflected puritanical overreaction that undermines public trust in judicial impartiality, and asked the minister to press for its return. The minister replied that building arrangements are the judiciary's responsibility, that the court board must decide on the complaints, and that the minister sees no threat to judicial independence in the decision.
The arrangement of a court building is a responsibility of the judiciary.
De inrichting van een gerechtsgebouw is een verantwoordelijkheid van de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de capaciteit ten behoeve van het oplossen van cold cases

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the number and handling of cold cases, the regional disparity in how they are pursued, the role of the missing persons bureau, and whether a national cold case team is needed. The minister reports about 1,774 cold cases, says prioritisation is a local matter and each unit has at least 3 FTE for cold cases, and rejects a national team as undesirable.
Prioritising the pursuit of criminal investigations, including cold cases, is reserved for the local competent authority, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the police.
Het prioriteren van het oppakken van opsporingsonderzoeken, waaronder cold cases, is voorbehouden aan het lokale bevoegd gezag, het Openbaar Ministerie, in afstemming met de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de organisatie van cold case teams

MP Buitenweg asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether police units devote too little capacity and expertise to cold cases, whether dedicated teams should be centralised, and what professionalisation steps are planned. The Minister says capacity must be prioritised, opposes a national cold case team, and points to a cold case calendar and AI experiments as innovation.
I am not in favour of a national team for conducting criminal investigations into cold cases.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een landelijk team voor het uitvoeren van opsporingsonderzoeken naar cold cases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht een voortvluchtige Amerikaanse verdachte

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how a US fugitive suspected of sexual offences against minors could live and work in the Netherlands undisturbed, and what legal options remain. The minister answered that extradition was refused because the offences were already time-barred under Dutch law, that current law no longer allows such limitation for these offences, and that the Americans may use international alerts instead.
Furthermore, I cannot make substantive statements about this individual case.
Verder kan ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport ‘Waar een klein land groot in kan zijn. Nederland en synthetische drugs in de afgelopen 50 jaar’ van de Politieacademie

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Politieacademie report placing the Netherlands at the top of synthetic drug production rests on sound data, given that its volume and consumption figures seem implausibly high, and whether the 18.9 billion euro estimate is credible. The ministers reply that several European reports reach similar conclusions, that the authors are responsible for their own method, that a new advisory body (SBO) will advise by year-end, and that enforcement is being strengthened while the government keeps a balanced drug policy.
The report by Mr Tops and colleagues is not the first or only report pointing to the Netherlands' prominent position regarding the production of and trade in synthetic drugs.
Het rapport van de heer Tops en collegae is niet het eerste noch het enige rapport dat wijst op de prominente plek van Nederland waar het de productie van en handel in synthetische drugs betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over loverboypraktijken in jeugdinstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers about alleged loverboy practices in youth institutions, including a suspect formerly employed by Hoenderloo Groep and unsafe situations at several facilities. The government answered that the criminal case is pending, that the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care is investigating the signals and monitoring Juzt, and that it has no other current signals beyond these institutions, while the national rapporteur reports on trafficking and a programme against trafficking is forthcoming.
Because the case is still before the court, I cannot make further statements about this case.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik over deze zaak geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘IS-gangers welkom in El Tawheed-moskee’

MPs Rutte and Becker asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that jihadist-linked persons were welcome at the El Tawheed mosque in Amsterdam, and whether police access and enforcement could be ensured. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no criminal offences have been established, that police may enter a place of worship only in limited circumstances under the Constitution and the Algemene wet op het binnentreden, that seven travellers' Dutch nationality was revoked, and that Amsterdam will inform the council of any decisions.
During a religious service, the police may only enter a mosque upon discovery in the act (on the spot).
De politie mag tijdens een religieuze dienst alleen een moskee binnentreden bij ontdekking op heterdaad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht ‘honderden oude moord- en zedenzaken kunnen worden opgelost’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that hundreds of old murder and sex cases could be solved using about 20,000 blood samples held by the NFI, including samples from convicted offenders, and whether consent could be sought to extract DNA. The minister said about 26,000 samples are held, that many were taken without a DNA-testing legal basis, and that the legal and practical feasibility of asking consent is still being examined, with no concrete action yet.
I understand the wish to use the blood samples in question for DNA research after all, and in this way possibly to contribute further to the investigation of serious violent or sexual offences.

Ik begrijp de wens om de betreffende bloedmonsters alsnog voor DNA-onderzoek te benutten en deze op die manier mogelijk verder bij te laten dragen aan de opsporing van ernstige geweld- of zedenmisdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘NCTV: Windmolenhaters radicaliseren, boeren gesaboteerd’

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Laan-Geselschap asked about reports that opponents of wind turbines are radicalising, including threats, intimidation and sabotage, and what protection and data exist. The minister condemns such acts, says individuals and employers are first responsible for their own safety, notes police do not record windmill-related offences separately, and cites the DTN 48 threat assessment.
Offences committed in relation to windmills are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens worden door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politiebureau Leidschenveen-Ypenburg sluit voor onbepaalde tijd’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Brigantijnlaan police station in The Hague would close, why, and how this fits the 2015 housing plan and a motion on easy access to reporting crimes. The minister answered that the station is not permanently closing but will be renovated, that the 2015 plan lists it, that any deviation from the location list requires alignment with local authorities, and that alternative policing arrangements during renovation are being explored.
There is no question of a definitive closure of the station.
Er is geen sprake van definitieve sluiting van het bureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Groothuizen over het artikel dat zestig moordzaken zouden zijn besmet door NFI-ruzie

MPs Van Oosten and Groothuizen asked whether about sixty murder cases were tainted by irregularities and internal conflict at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI). The Minister replied that the figure was not confirmed, that an independent commission found six reports not or partly reviewed with no consequences for cases, and that corrective measures and a culture-change programme were underway.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Buitenweg en Groothuizen inzake het bericht ‘Het sluiten van woningen op grond van de Wet Damocles’

MPs Van Nispen, Buitenweg and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act after a case where a tenant was evicted for 14 grams of cannabis. The minister said closure data are not centrally held, cited a study finding courts upheld appeals in 30% of published cases, noted a monitoring motion, and stated that closure is a measure to end violations rather than a punishment.
It is for the court to assess whether the mayor could reasonably use his closure power and, if so, whether the way the power was applied is proportionate.

Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de burgemeester in redelijkheid van zijn sluitingsbevoegdheid gebruik heeft kunnen maken en, zo ja, of de wijze waarop de bevoegdheid is toegepast evenredig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Gemeenten volgen 160 radicale moslims'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how the government handles hundreds of jihadists and thousands of sympathisers not under monitoring, why administrative detention is not introduced, how deradicalisation success is measured, how many are placed in work or schooling obligations, and expected costs. Minister Grapperhaus answered that local multidisciplinary case consultations and existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not justified and will not be introduced, that deradicalisation programmes are evaluated but numbers are too small for conclusions, and that the local approach receives about EUR 6.5 million annually.
Case law and treaty obligations show that administrative detention, meaning preventive detention without reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.

Uit de rechtspraak en verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen volgt dat administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Seksofficier werkt nu bij advocatenkantoor'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether it is acceptable that a former public prosecutor linked to fraud cases and a sex-offence suspicion moved to a law firm handling similar cases, and whether rules or personnel policy should change. The minister said the confidentiality duty binds former prosecutors indefinitely, that no non-compete applies, and that he sees no reason to change rules or policy.
This confidentiality duty always applies, so also after leaving the OM (public prosecution service).
Deze geheimhoudingsplicht geldt altijd, dus ook na het vertrek bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over agressie tegen toezichthouders van Staatsbosbeheer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about violence against Staatsbosbeheer supervisors by hunters, including tougher sentencing, the maximum penalty, a lifetime hunting ban and a Zuid-Holland training initiative for hunters. The ministers answered that aggravating factors and prosecution guidelines already apply, that training hunters in handling aggression is justified, and that current rules on hunting licence refusal after violent convictions are proportionate, so no tightening is planned.
I consider the current regulations proportionate and at this moment see no reason to tighten the regulations on this point.
Ik acht de huidige regelgeving proportioneel en zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de regelgeving op dit punt aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked whether sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners persists and what authorities are doing about it, including reports, prosecutions, municipal permit requirements and enforcement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sexual abuse is unacceptable, municipalities can enforce permit rules, a victim awareness campaign is planned, and provided limited figures while stating that specific data on prosecutions for tantra abuse is not registered.
Furthermore, I do not have information on the number of prosecutions or criminal sanctions, as cases of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs are not specifically registered.

Verder beschik ik niet over informatie ten aanzien van het aantal gevallen van vervolging of strafrechtelijke sancties aangezien er niet specifiek wordt geregistreerd op gevallen van seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Staat wil deal met Volkert van der Graaf'

An MP from the PVV asks why the Public Prosecution Service negotiates with Volkert van der Graaf, the convicted killer of Pim Fortuyn, and why he was released early and may leave the country, and whether he should be re-jailed or expelled. The minister answers that the court and prosecution agreed a new reporting arrangement without judicial intervention, that early release and conditions are for the judge to decide, that emigration would be subject to ordinary rules, and that re-arrest or expulsion will not be pursued.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether conditional release should be withheld.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling (v.i.) achterwege moet worden gelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de beperkte openbaarheid van het Centraal Archief Bijzondere Rechtspleging

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Central Archive for Special Criminal Justice (CABR) is restricted from public access until 2025, how the advice of the Chief State Archivist shaped those restrictions, and whether copying and anonymising records could be eased. The Minister answered that restrictions protect personal privacy under data protection rules, that copies are generally not provided following a 2012 court ruling, and that the archive's document-based system does not allow anonymising records before viewing.
When the CABR was transferred in 2000, it was determined that, to protect the privacy of living persons, the archival records, inventory and access tools were not to be public before 1 January 2025.

Bij de overbrenging van het CABR is in 2000 bepaald dat, met het oog op de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van nog levende personen, de archiefbescheiden, alsmede de inventaris en de nadere toegangen (database en kaartsystemen) op dit archief niet openbaar zijn vóór 1 januari 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Azmani over het bericht ‘Verblijfsvergunning brengt verantwoordelijkheid met zich mee’

MPs Van Oosten and Azmani asked whether courts weigh the loss of a residence permit when sentencing offenders, and whether revocation should follow automatically after serious convictions. The minister answered that judges weigh all circumstances without binding guidelines on this point, that IND revocation uses a sliding scale with individual assessment reviewable by the administrative court, and that no change of policy is planned though signals will be monitored.
It is for the independent judge to weigh all facts and circumstances in the individual case and reach a judgment.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke rechter om in het individuele geval alle feiten en omstandigheden te wegen en tot een oordeel te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Vader van omgekomen Dascha start petitie voor camerabeelden’

An MP asked whether closed criminal investigations into possible homicide and sexual offences should be reopened when new facts emerge, whether a Dutch duty to investigate like Germany's should exist, and how the government views the lack of an external oversight body for prosecution and police. The Minister replied that Dutch prosecutors have discretion under the opportunity principle, so reopening is decided case by case with a court authorisation needed where a suspect was already notified, and that oversight is being considered in the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, while Article 6 ECHR protects the accused rather than relatives.
Legally prescribing in general terms that the public prosecutor must start or stop an investigation does not fit within our criminal justice system.
Antwoord 2, 3 en 4 Het (wettelijk) in algemene zin voorschrijven dat de officier van justitie een onderzoek moet starten of stoppen past niet in ons strafrechtelijk systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het onderzoek van de commissie Fokkens naar mogelijke integriteitsschendingen binnen de top van het openbaar ministerie

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the delayed completion of the independent Fokkens inquiry into alleged integrity violations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service, and whether new facts or a wider circle of subjects explained the delay. The minister confirmed the delay is due to new documents and new reports prompting more interviews, but said the inquiry is independent and he will relay the parliament's wish for completion by year-end to the College of Procurators-General.
I will relay the wish of your House to the College.
Ik zal de wens van uw Kamer doorgeleiden naar het College.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over omkoping door Nederlandse bedrijven in het buitenland

An MP asked the government about bribery by Dutch companies abroad, the weak enforcement criticized by Transparency International, and the lack of independent judicial review and transparency of OM settlements (transacties). The Minister says enforcement has increased with new FIOD and OM capacity, and that the high-transaction practice and Aanwijzing will be reviewed and made more transparent within the Wet OM-afdoening evaluation.
At present the current practice is being reviewed.
Op dit moment wordt de huidige praktijk tegen het licht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een verwoestende nieuwe drug in webshops te koop is

Two PvdA MPs asked whether phenibut, a highly addictive substance sold as a food supplement in webshops, could be bought by minors and why it is not banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary for Health answered that minors cannot be excluded from access, that a CAM risk study is underway with results expected this year, and that measures including a possible ban will be considered afterwards.
Based on the research results and the CAM advice, I will consider measures to take, such as a possible ban.
Op basis van de onderzoeksresultaten en het advies van het CAM zal ik mij beraden op te treffen maatregelen, zoals een eventueel verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de politieperskaart

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press card access to crime scenes, press alarm failures and police publication of their own photos, citing reports of many unanswered complaints. The Minister said police do not keep figures, that automatic press alarm paging is being introduced, and that police social media use is discussed with the NVJ, while noting the Rotterdam Persmonitor model.
The police do not keep figures on this subject, so I cannot say how often a journalist is refused access to a crime scene.
De politie houdt zelf geen cijfers bij over dit onderwerp, dus ik kan niet zeggen hoe vaak het voorkomt dat een journalist de toegang tot een plaats delict wordt geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over een mogelijk incorrect politie voorschrift en de schijnbare willekeur bij het handhaven van een omgangsregeling

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked about an internal police instruction that wrongly stated a custodial parent withholding a child from court-ordered contact does not commit an offence under article 279 Penal Code, and about perceived arbitrariness in enforcement. The Minister acknowledged the instruction was incorrect, said it was removed and revised, and denied arbitrariness, noting police must establish an offence and consult the public prosecutor.
This is incorrect and not in line with article 279 of the Penal Code.
Dit is onjuist en niet in lijn met artikel 279 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over Albanese migranten die bij de gemeente Moerdijk in vrachtwagen klimmen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked about Albanian migrants climbing into trucks near Moerdijk bound for England, and about the mayor's plea for help. The State Secretary described the involved agencies, possible offences and removal procedures, said an inter-agency framework was being prepared, and promised to meet the mayor.
I will myself, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, enter into consultation with the mayor of Moerdijk.
Ik zal zelf eveneens, samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, in overleg treden met de burgemeester van Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over berechting Nederlandse terreurverdachten in Suriname

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows that two Surinamese-Dutch suspects are being prosecuted in Paramaribo for plotting a terror attack on the US ambassador, whether the Dutch embassy and police follow the trial and will report after each hearing, and whether Dutch roots of the plot are being investigated. The minister confirms awareness, says the embassy follows the case closely, notes one closed-door hearing, declines to send case reports to parliament, and declines to comment on an individual foreign case.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Justice and Security cannot send your House reports on individual foreign court cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid kunnen aan uw Kamer geen rapportages over individuele buitenlandse rechtszaken doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Australische overheid verbiedt Huawei en ZTE apparatuur te leveren voor 5g’

MP Verhoeven asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers whether they know of Australia's ban on Huawei and ZTE 5G equipment, whether the Netherlands will follow, and how such national-security decisions are made, including at EU level. The government answered that it assesses risks case by case on the basis of state-actor threats and legal duties to cooperate, declined to speculate on future measures, and said the existing framework is flexible enough and that national security remains a member-state responsibility.

Given the national security interests and the interests of business, there is no anticipating or speculating on which products, services or companies may or may not pose a risk to national security, or on possible future measures.
