Gezien de nationale veiligheidsbelangen en de belangen van het bedrijfsleven wordt niet vooruitgelopen op of gespeculeerd over welke producten, diensten of bedrijven al dan niet een risico zouden kunnen vormen voor de nationale veiligheid en over al dan niet mogelijke toekomstige maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Zedenzaak van Brech bleef te vaak onopgemerkt'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether destruction rules for prosecution files under the archive and justice data laws hamper crime detection, and whether those rules should change. The Minister said sex-crime files are kept for 80 years, that the OM reported no indication the retention rules hindered the investigation in the Verstappen case, and saw no reason to amend the law.
The investigation into the death of Nicky Verstappen is an ongoing criminal investigation, so I cannot go into the particulars of this case.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van Nicky Verstappen betreft een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, zodat ik niet kan ingaan op bijzonderheden van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Wonen naast een tbs-kliniek: Hoe een verkrachting het dorpje Oostrum opschudde’

PVV MPs Helder and Markuszower asked about police questioning of a rape victim in Oostrum, police requests for secrecy about a tbs-detainee perpetrator, compensation, sentencing and tbs leave policy. Minister Grapperhaus defended police handling in general terms, declined to comment on the individual case, and said the leave system is a necessary part of tbs treatment with an Inspectorate study pending.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de wijze waarop een aangifte van een verkrachting is behandeld door de politie

MP Kuiken asked the Justice Minister how police handled a rape complaint in the Hoorn sex case, including victim treatment, whether victims are pressured not to report, and whether interrogators approach victims with suspicion. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss the individual case, pointed to existing police and prosecution instructions and an Inspectorate investigation under way, and listed planned victim-protection measures.
I cannot go into this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over malafide slotenmakers

Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about malicious locksmiths who overcharge locked-out customers, including data on scale, victims, prosecution, a mandatory quality mark and a maximum tariff. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police and prosecutors do not register such cases separately, that only some conduct qualifies as fraud, that he opposes a mandatory quality mark in a free market, and that a maximum tariff is not the solution.
The police do not register specifically on the profession of suspects and therefore have no figures available on this.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op het beroep van verdachten en heeft hierover dan ook geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat 'de naam van de kerk boven het welzijn van de mens komt'

An MP asked the ministers whether the 'crimen sollicitationis' instruction still applies in the Dutch Catholic Church, how it relates to Dutch criminal procedure and human rights, and whether the church's secrecy could enable cover-ups, and asked for talks with the bishops. The minister answered that the instruction has not been in force since 2001, announced a WODC study on broadening the reporting duty (art. 160 Sv), said the church's procedures are subordinate to Dutch criminal law, and declined a new meeting with the bishops as unnecessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM te vaak boetes uitdeelt

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister how he would respond to research suggesting the public prosecution service issues too many fines and that judges worry about truth-finding, and whether rights protection and dialogue with the Council for the Judiciary would be pursued. Minister Grapperhaus answered that neither the Procurator-General's supervision nor the evaluation of the OM-settlement law shows a shortfall in truth-finding, attributed the decline in criminal cases heard by judges to crime trends and other factors, and said talks with the OM and Council for the Judiciary are planned with the wider government response due in autumn.
Neither this supervision nor the evaluation research shows that truth-finding is lacking in out-of-court settlement by the public prosecutor.
Uit dit toezicht noch uit het evaluatieonderzoek blijkt dat het bij de buitengerechtelijke afdoening door de officier van justitie schort aan de waarheidsvinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het gebruik van handgranaten door criminelen als dreigmiddel

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security how often hand grenades were found at or exploded in business premises, whether mayors close premises after such finds, and whether criminals might use grenades to pressure entrepreneurs into closure. The minister reported 16 incidents with 9 explosions between 2017 and September 2018, said closure data is not registered, and stated that mayors decide case by case while local authorities set investigative priorities.
Can you indicate how often a mayor in the past two years has closed a business premises due to a hand grenade finding?
Vraag 2 Kunt u aangeven hoe vaak een burgemeester in de afgelopen twee jaren een pand van een onderneming heeft gesloten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker'

MPs Becker and Rutte asked whether Milli Görüs organised trips of young people to a radical preacher in Turkey, who funds them, whether security services are aware, and whether mosque financing and imam training should be supervised. The government says such trips are lawful and not monitored, that it is unacceptable to radicalise youth but no concrete action on the trips is announced, and that the imam training falls outside higher education supervision.
If persons or organisations, through their aims or activities, give rise to a serious suspicion that they pose a threat to national security, the AIVD can conduct an investigation.

Indien personen of organisaties door de doelen die zij nastreven, dan wel door hun activiteiten aanleiding geven tot het ernstige vermoeden dat dat zij een gevaar vormen voor de nationale veiligheid, dan kan de AIVD onderzoek doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over courtsiding en matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the Justice Minister about courtsiding (information gathering at tennis courts for betting) and its links to matchfixing, and whether illegal gambling is facilitated. The government answered that courtsiding has declined internationally, Dutch tournaments have tightened enforcement, the Kansspelautoriteit does not act against it as it is not illegal gambling, and it points to a pending online gambling bill with match-manipulation safeguards.
Given the international decline of the problem and the fact that the tennis organisations' approach works, there is currently no reason to research the nature and scale of courtsiding.

Gezien de internationale afname van de problematiek en het feit dat de aanpak van tennisorganisaties werkt, is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van «courtsiding».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over illegale praktijken rondom recycling van kunstgras

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Justice Minister about illegal artificial turf recycling practices, including municipalities paying recyclers who leave pitches unprocessed, lack of enforcement, and bankruptcy used to dodge costs. The State Secretary answered that enforcement and permitting lie with provinces and municipalities, that the ILT issued warnings to inspected firms, and that no additional national measures are planned while monitoring the local follow-up.
It is the responsibility of provinces and municipalities to take these requirements into account when granting permits to waste companies.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van provincies en gemeenten om bij vergunningverlening aan afvalbedrijven rekening te houden met deze voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over terugkeer van Nederlandse vrouwen en minderjarige kinderen in slechte gezondheid in IS-gebied

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether the prosecution service asked Kurdish authorities to release three Dutch women from camps for prosecution in the Netherlands, whether returns of women and children are being actively pursued, and whether consular assistance and cooperation with Kurdish authorities will be offered. The minister answers that the government does not actively pursue return of adult travellers and their children, that arrest warrants were handed to Kurdish representatives without response, and that the government considers no obligation under the CRC to repatriate the children.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult travellers and their minor children.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over seksuele uitbuiting in een jeugdzorginstelling

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked about sexual exploitation of girls in a closed youth care institution in Zetten and whether the inspectorate's assessment framework is adequate. The minister said the case is before court, that the inspectorates have requested an in-depth independent investigation by the foundation, and that the framework will be reflected on after that investigation.
The inspectorates want to be informed about the facts and any shortcomings in the care provided to the young people concerned.
De inspecties willen geïnformeerd worden over de feiten en eventuele tekortkomingen in de hulp aan zowel de betreffende jeugdigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Kopje onder in Nijmegen? Dan heb je pech'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a newspaper report on the lack of fire brigade diving teams in some regions, and about the survival window for people in the water. The minister answered that diving teams serve both rescue and recovery, that the regional safety boards decide on their deployment within the Wet veiligheidsregio's, and that the reduction of teams reflects regional organisation and occupational safety rules.
The board of the safety region sets the response time of a diving team based on, among other things, the risk profile.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio stelt op basis van onder andere het risicoprofiel de opkomsttijd van een duikteam vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over het aandeel van de asieladvocatuur binnen de gefinancierde rechtshulp

An FvD MP asked how much publicly funded legal aid goes to asylum and immigration procedures, what lawyers are paid in those cases, and whether lawyers in hopeless asylum cases could be denied legal-aid payment via court ruling. The minister answered that data for 2000-2001 are unavailable, pointed to a table for the budget figures, and declined to investigate court-based denial of lawyers' income, citing the ongoing asylum procedure review.
Figures for the years 2000 and 2001 are not available, because this was not separately registered in the Justice budget.
De cijfers voor de jaren 2000 en 2001 zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat dit niet apart geregistreerd werd in de Justitiebegroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politiebureau verdwijnt uit het straatbeeld: bijna 200 bureaus gesloten'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that nearly 200 police stations are closing, questioning police accessibility for citizens and whether the closures are a cost-cutting measure of 76 million euros. The Minister responds that police are modernising, that closures are part of a shift toward presence in neighbourhoods via alternative points of contact, and that service quality is not compromised.
The move to be more present in the neighbourhoods and less at police stations does not come at the expense of service quality.
De beweging om meer aanwezig te zijn in de wijken en minder op bureaus gaat niet ten koste van de kwaliteit van dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het artikel ‘New defense bill bans the U.S. government from using Huawei and ZTE tech’

MP Arno Rutte asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would follow the US ban on Chinese Huawei/ZTE equipment and Hytera technology, and how national security of the C2000 emergency communications network is guaranteed. The minister answered that the Netherlands assesses risks case by case with its own balance, that C2000 traffic is encrypted with security audits and AIVD advice underway, and that no future measures are being speculated on.
Given the national security interests and the interests of the business sector, no anticipation or speculation is made about possible future measures.
Gezien de nationale veiligheidsbelangen en de belangen van het bedrijfsleven wordt niet vooruitgelopen of gespeculeerd over al dan niet mogelijke toekomstige maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de verdeling van de extra politiecapaciteit

The MP asks how the 1,111 additional FTE of police capacity is divided across the ten regional units and the National Unit, on what criteria, how chiefs and mayors were involved, and how the 2% flexibility, ministerial trekkingsrechten, 171 FTE for undermining crime and 769 neighbourhood officers are allocated, plus recruitment intake per unit. The Minister answers in detail with allocation tables, explains a three-step distribution based on the Besluit verdeling sterkte en middelen politie, and commits to a WODC study and forthcoming regulation for the 2% flexibility, but leaves the post-2020 intake breakdown unset.
The WODC has therefore been asked to carry out further research on this.
Het WODC is daarom verzocht hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘OM moet tienduizenden flitsboetes A29 terugbetalen’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that the OM must refund tens of thousands of speeding fines on the A29 at Heinenoord, and when the OM knew of the doubts, whether the fines will be refunded and when, whether other locations are affected, and whether small-speed fine margins should change. The minister answered that the measurements were considered reliable until a court ruling of 16 July 2018, that the OM has appealed and is awaiting the outcome, that refunds will follow only if the appeal court finds the measurement unreliable, and that the fines policy will be addressed to parliament in autumn.
The OM has lodged an appeal. The outcome of this will first have to be awaited.
Het OM heeft hoger beroep ingesteld. De uitkomst hiervan zal eerst moeten worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Nieuwe baas Amsterdamse brandweer wilde machocultuur aanpakken. Hij kreeg oorlog’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of dismissals, conflict with the works council, and a culture problem at the Amsterdam-Amstelland fire service, including diversity, selection and pay of fire chiefs. The minister answered that these are regional responsibilities, declined to comment on the dismissals, saw no national pattern, and promised to put the workforce-turnover question to the parties involved and to inform parliament further.
Under the Safety Regions Act the regional board is responsible for organising the fire service among other things. It is therefore not for me to make further statements about this.
Op grond van de Wet veiligheidsregio’s is het regionaal bestuur belast met de organisatie van onder meer brandweer. Het is daarom ook niet aan mij om hier nadere uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Oosten over het tegengaan van winkeldiefstal

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Oosten asked about the scale of shop theft, use of collective shop bans, and whether filing a police report is required for civil settlements and information sharing. The minister said reliable damage figures cannot yet be given and a follow-up study is underway, that bans are used with few obstacles, that police are improving the reporting process, and that a report is needed for the standard civil charge but not for sharing information within the ban system.
A follow-up study is currently being carried out to answer whether it is possible to achieve proper registration and reliable data.
Op dit moment wordt een vervolgonderzoek uitgevoerd dat antwoord moet geven op de vraag of het mogelijk is tot een goede registratie en betrouwbare gegevens te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de berichten ‘Politie wil vooraanstaande functionarissen bestraffen om plichtsverzuim’, ‘Agenten willen meer transparantie over sanctiebeleid’ en ‘Politiekorps onder druk na b

MP Den Boer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports on unequal police disciplinary sanctions, including a dismissal of an Amsterdam police commander for misuse of police funds while other senior officers received small fines, and calls for more transparency. The minister replied that sanctions are assessed case by case under the force's integrity policy, that individual cases are not discussed for privacy reasons, and that the police will publish an anonymised annual overview of disciplinary measures from 2019.

However, I consider it undesirable to make visible at function or individual level which sanctions have been imposed, given the large and, in my view, disproportionate intrusion this would make into the personal privacy of these employees.

Ik vind het echter onwenselijk om op functie of individueel niveau inzichtelijk te maken welke sancties zijn opgelegd, gezien de grote en naar mijn opvatting onevenredige inbreuk die dit zou maken op de persoonlijke levenssfeer van deze medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘'Duitse inlichtingendienst getipt dat Jawed S. radicaliseerde'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers whether German intelligence had warned about the radicalisation of an asylum seeker, whether information sharing with foreign services is adequate, how Dutch and German authorities cooperate on asylum radicalisation, and whether such information reaches municipalities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the person did not appear in German threat systems, described existing international intelligence-sharing channels and migration-chain reporting structures, and said information can be shared with municipalities as permitted by the WIV 2017.
In the context of counterterrorism, information is shared internationally fully and quickly.
In het kader van contraterrorisme wordt informatie internationaal volledig en snel gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat Russische trollen ook actief zijn in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether Russian troll activity in the Netherlands is a concern, whether it is criminal, and whether the government will act with platforms and at EU level against foreign influence on public opinion. The government says foreign interference is serious, points to an interdepartmental approach and EU work on online disinformation, and says whether speech is criminal is for the prosecutor to decide, while keeping talks with platforms ongoing.

The cabinet considers unwanted foreign interference very objectionable as it can undermine the political and social system and touches the foundation of the Dutch democratic legal order and open society.

Het kabinet vindt ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging zeer kwalijk aangezien dit het politieke en maatschappelijke systeem kan ondergraven en raakt aan het fundament van de Nederlandse democratische rechtsorde en open samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Linde over het bericht ‘ING sluit een megaschikking met OM in witwaszaken’

Parliamentarian Van der Linde asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the ING settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how it occurred, whether other banks are being engaged, why individuals were not prosecuted, and when the WODC report will be sent. The ministers answered that the case is exemplary for ING's shortcomings, that they will discuss integrity with the sector and will issue a policy response by year-end, and that individual prosecution was not possible under Dutch case law.
The Public Prosecution Service therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het bericht 'ING treft miljoenenschikking met OM in witwaszaken' (Herdruk)

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about ING's record 775 million euro settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how the amount was set, why prosecution was avoided, and whether individuals and the bank's leadership face consequences. The ministers answered that the settlement combined a 665 million fine with 100 million in disgorgement, that the OM chose a transaction for its enforceable compliance measures under DNB supervision, and that individual criminal liability could not be established, while the bank's supervisory board has announced personnel consequences at board level.
The OM therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de afname van het aantal duikteams bij de brandweer

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the halving of fire brigade diving teams in fifteen years endangers lives on the water, and whether every safety region should have a diving team. The minister replied that no clear link can be drawn, that the number of teams is a regional matter for safety region boards, and that he sees no reason to change the rules or act.
It is up to the board of a safety region to determine whether additional measures are needed.
Het is aan het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio om te bepalen of er aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Aantal duikteams brandweer in 15 jaar gehalveerd’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that the number of fire brigade diving teams has halved in fifteen years, asking about causes, regional norms, and training. The minister confirmed the halving, attributed it mainly to regionalisation, stricter safety rules and reorganisation, said no national norm exists for diving teams or a definition of water accidents, and left recruitment and training to regional boards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de bronbescherming van journalisten

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service has adequately safeguarded internal procedures protecting journalists' source protection after recent cases where a journalist's call was wiretapped. The Minister answered that the directive is being updated to match the new source protection law, training will be expanded, and no extra measures are currently considered necessary.
The new directive will be widely communicated within the OM, and the OM's training courses will devote even more attention to this subject.
De nieuwe aanwijzing zal binnen het OM breed worden uitgedragen en in de leergangen van het OM zal nog meer aandacht worden besteed aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Openbaar Ministerie luistert journalist af in moordzaak broer kroongetuige'

MPs Van Oosten and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the Public Prosecution Service secretly recorded a journalist in the murder investigation of a crown witness's brother, and what safeguards exist. The Minister acknowledged the recording was ordered with rechter-commissaris authorisation, was never listened to, and was destroyed, admitting internal review was missed; he pointed to the press source-protection bill and revised directive as reforms.

Prior to the order concerning this measure, the required internal review did not take place, and the OM considered that in this specific case the recording was an impermissible infringement on journalists' source protection.

Voorafgaand aan het bevel ten aanzien van dit middel heeft niet de vereiste interne toetsing plaatsgevonden en het OM was van oordeel dat in dit specifieke geval de opname een ontoelaatbare inbreuk was op de bronbescherming van journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Jihadist Maastricht verdacht van betrokkenheid bij ontvoering Zuid-Afrika’

MPs Markuszower and De Graaf asked the Justice Minister about reports that a convicted jihadist from Maastricht, under supervision with an ankle monitor, may have been linked to a kidnapping in South Africa, questioning the adequacy of the supervision and whether terrorists should be stripped of Dutch nationality. The minister said courts decide on sanctions and conditions, declined to comment on an individual case still before a judge, and explained the legal basis for nationality revocation and related measures.
Since this concerns an individual criminal case still before the judge, I cannot respond to this question.
Aangezien het hier gaat om een individuele strafzaak die nog onder de rechter is, kan ik niet op deze vraag ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over cold case teams

MPs Van Oosten and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about variation in cold case team capacity across police units, OM coordination, involvement of families and outsiders, and the use of new DNA techniques on old blood samples. Minister Grapperhaus answered that each unit has at least 3 fte for cold cases, that the Public Prosecution Service and police coordinate through portfolio holders without central direction, that families are kept informed on request, and that DNA-linking old samples requires consent under the law, with an evaluation due in spring 2019.
The decision to set up a cold case investigation is taken regionally by the competent authority.
Het besluit tot instelling van een cold case onderzoek wordt regionaal genomen door het bevoegd gezag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten en Van der Graaf over de verklaring (nr. 2) van het bestuur van de Stichting Vliegramp MH17 inzake meldingen en publiciteit over lichamelijke resten op MH17-crashsite

MPs asked whether recent YouTube videos and a foundation statement about bone fragments found at the MH17 crash site show that remains were planted to undermine the JIT investigation, and what action the government has taken. The minister answered that remains may still be found but the claimed location is unlikely, that no reports of new finds came in to official contacts, that the JIT has no concrete evidence of planting, and that Nederland has asked the OVSE and Grieving Nations to press the de facto authorities to hand over remains.
Contact will be made with the journalist with an urgent request to hand over all bone fragments to the authorities.
Er zal contact met de journalist worden opgenomen met het dringende verzoek alle botfragmenten aan de autoriteiten over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie werkt in asbestpand, rapport werd ‘stilgehouden’'

MP Helder (PVV) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether reports that police staff work in an asbestos-containing building, and that a report was withheld, are true, and whether the health risk and the timing of roof replacement are acceptable. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged that the asbestos report was known only within police facility management, that communication with staff and the works council was lacking, and that the asbestos roofs will be removed in the short term, possibly in 2018.
Unfortunately, communication about the measurements and the need to replace the roofs did not immediately take place with the employees; this was careless.
Helaas heeft over de metingen en de noodzaak om de daken te vervangen niet meteen communicatie met de medewerkers plaatsgevonden, dit was onzorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over de berichten: 'Discriminatie ouderen in vacatureteksten' en 'vacature sluit ouderen uit'

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the government about reports that job advertisements still exclude older workers through age-related wording, and about enforcement, sanctions and possible criminal law. The State Secretary answered that age-related wording can be direct or indirect discrimination, pointed to the Inspectie SZW review, the 2018-2021 action plan and voluntary tools, and declined to commit to criminal prosecution or to a separate letter before Prinsjesdag.

As announced in my letter on tackling labour market discrimination in the temporary employment sector of 1 May 2018 and in the outline letter on the 2018-2021 Action Plan of 19 July 2018, among other effective alternatives, the possibilities to strengthen the enforcement role of the Inspectorate SZW in supervising discrimination in recruitment and selection are being explored.

Zoals is aangekondigd in mijn brief «Aanpak arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie in uitzendsector» 7 van 1 mei 2018 en in de «Hoofdlijnenbrief Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie 2018–2021» 8 van 19 juli 2018, wordt, naast andere effectieve alternatieven, verkernt wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de handhavende rol van de Inspectie SZW met betrekking tot toezicht op discriminatie bij werving en selectie te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht dat de Koerden Nederlandse vrouwen naar IS-gebied terugsturen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether Kurdish authorities are sending Dutch women and children back to IS-held territory and what the government will do to prevent this. Minister Grapperhaus said such reports could not be confirmed, that the government does not actively pursue repatriation from Syria and Iraq given diplomatic and security considerations, and that contact with Kurdish authorities via their Benelux representation has been ongoing.
This weighing leads the cabinet not to actively pursue the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria and Iraq.
Deze afweging leidt ertoe dat het kabinet niet actief inzet op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het boek ‘Dagboek van een getuige’ en ‘Slachtoffer mislukte liquidatie Breda krijgt geen huurwoning’

An MP asked whether the promised letter on the protection system (stelsel bewaken en beveiligen) would address the budget and cost registration, and whether the steering group should be tasked with mapping costs and the 1% norm. The Minister answered that the 5 June 2018 letter is the promised letter, that costs are funded from the police budget with routine planning and control, and that he will await the steering group's findings before adding tasks.
I want to first await the outcomes and recommendations of this assignment before adding assignments.
Ik wil de uitkomsten en aanbevelingen van deze opdracht eerst afwachten voordat ik opdrachten toevoeg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de korpsleiding agenten verbiedt actie te voeren voor een betere cao

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police leaders were told not to support union cao actions and whether all police staff may join such actions. The minister answered that all police staff, including leaders, have the right to take part, that participation is an individual choice, and that the strategic leadership agreed among themselves not to take part directly.
All police employees, including managers, have the right to take part in actions announced by their union; that right is not up for discussion.
Alle politiemedewerkers, inclusief leidinggevenden, hebben het recht om door hun vakbond aangezegde acties te voeren; dat recht staat niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Arno Rutte en Bisschop over het bericht ‘Leren van geweld’

MPs Van Dam, Rutte and Bisschop asked whether police officers acquitted of criminal charges for use of force can be denied a VOG certificate and travel to the US, whether the new use-of-force rules apply retroactively, and whether protections can be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus said he does not recognise the described case, received no other signals of such problems, and that the new investigation framework could in principle apply to earlier cases while no change to VOG rules is planned.
I have received no other signals indicating that police officers face obstacles in obtaining a VOG because of a previous use of force.
Mij hebben geen andere signalen bereikt waaruit blijkt dat politieambtenaren vanwege een eerdere geweldsaanwending hinder ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van een VOG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Te weinig nieuwe wapenstokken voor politie.’

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether a shortage of new extendable batons for police, and an apparently botched procurement, left trained officers carrying old batons, and whether the new batons would be delivered by end of August 2018. The minister answered that deliveries are phased per the manufacturer agreement, that local shortages may occur where training runs faster than planned, and that officers may swap for the new baton if their unit is short.
The delivery of the extendable batons proceeds in phases and in line with the planning and agreement with the manufacturer.
De levering van de uitschuifbare wapenstokken verloopt gefaseerd en conform planning en afspraak met de fabrikant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Meisjes zwijgen liever’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Justice about a newspaper report that girls are reluctant to report sexual exploitation and whether reporting rates are falling, and asked what will be done to lower barriers and prioritise these cases. The Minister acknowledges the seriousness of sexual exploitation, says reporting barriers are being addressed through existing measures, denies evidence that reporting is falling, and promises a plan of action on human trafficking after the summer.
After the summer I will send your House the action plan on human trafficking.
Na de zomer zal ik uw Kamer het plan van aanpak voor mensenhandel toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Remco Dijkstra, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht 'Nederlands rijbewijs online te koop via Poolse website'

MPs from VVD and SP asked whether fake Dutch driving licences sold via a Polish website endanger road safety, how often forgeries are found and prosecuted, what is being done to take the site down, and whether employers check licences. The minister answered that forgeries are rare and prosecuted under existing law, that Poland lacks a legal basis to act against the site until a pending bill takes effect, and that the site's removal depends on Polish authorities.
The Polish Ministry said the relevant Polish authorities are aware of the site's activities, but without a legal expansion there is no basis to act against these practices.

Het Poolse Ministerie liet weten dat de relevante Poolse autoriteiten aandacht hebben voor de activiteiten van de bewuste site, maar dat zonder wettelijke verruiming er geen grond is voor optreden tegen deze praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hiddema en Baudet over het bericht 'extreemlinkse activisten blijven meestal onbestraft'

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister whether left-wing extremist activists enjoy de facto impunity, as suggested by a WODC report, and what the government will do about it. The minister disagreed with that conclusion, citing difficulties of proof and that in three of seven cases the suspect was convicted, and said extremism of any kind is prosecuted case by case.
Where extremist conduct constitutes a criminal offence, the Public Prosecution Service will investigate as far as possible and assess whether to prosecute.

Wanneer er sprake is van extremistische gedragingen die een strafbaar feit opleveren, zal het OM voor zover mogelijk onderzoek instellen en beoordelen of tot strafrechtelijke vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Extreem links vaak vrijuit'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice why the public prosecution service does not prosecute far-left extremists reported as often going unpunished, and whether the minister would instruct prosecutors to pursue them. The minister answered that far-left extremism is not treated differently from other extremism, that lawful activism is permitted and police and prosecutors act where the law is broken, and that he does not interfere in prosecutorial decisions, referring to earlier answers.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I do not interfere in the independent judgment and responsibilities of the public prosecutor.
Ik treed als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet in de onafhankelijke oordeelsvorming en verantwoordelijkheden van de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het lot van Nederlandse IS-kinderen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Justice Minister whether the government would actively seek the return of Dutch women and their children held in Kurdish camps in Syria, including after arrest warrants were issued for three women. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children, citing child welfare alongside security, diplomatic and regional considerations, and only passed the warrants to local authorities.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult travellers and their minor children.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam, Ten Broeke en Arno Rutte over terreurvlaggen Hezbollah bij de Tweede Kamer

MPs asked whether Hezbollah flags shown at a June 2018 Quds Day demonstration outside parliament were punishable and why police did not act, and whether the OM enforcement framework or local coordination should change. The minister answers that the flag is punishable under article 131 Sr (incitement) in principle, that no arrest was made for lack of hard investigative indications, and that current frameworks suffice, with each case judged on its own.
Displaying the Hezbollah flag would in principle constitute a punishable offence under article 131 of the Criminal Code, incitement, an offence against public order.
Het tonen van de Hezbollah-vlag zal in beginsel strafbaarheid op grond van artikel 131 Sr, opruiing, opleveren, een misdrijf tegen de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politiecellen Tilburg tijdelijk dicht: dit is schrijnend'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about police cells in Tilburg being temporarily closed, forcing an arrestee to spend a night in a police station, and whether this can be avoided. The minister explained a miscommunication caused the one-hour stay, said Tilburg cells close for renovation from 29 July to 18 August with transfers to Breda or other complexes, and said police housing policy is being revised.
These arrangements have been brought again to the attention of the officers.
Deze afspraken zijn opnieuw onder de aandacht gebracht van de agenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie: witwassen via boot is kinderspel'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why there is still no mandatory registration of boats despite police warnings since 2015, and whether the government is responsible for boat-related fraud and money laundering and will legislate. The minister replied that only fast motorboats require registration, that rules were recently tightened on ownership details, and that an evaluation next year will assess whether the improvements suffice.
An evaluation next year must make clear whether the improvements are sufficient from the police's point of view.
Een evaluatie volgend jaar moet duidelijk maken of de verbeteringen uit oogpunt van de politie voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Yesilgöz-Zegerius  over het bericht 'Wijkagent: 'Haal dat bord met Joodse huizen weg''

MPs Rutte and Yesilgöz asked whether a neighbourhood police officer in Amsterdam asked a business to remove a sign reading 'Open Joodse huizen', how police advise on Jewish and other religious symbols, and how they tackle antisemitism. The minister says police discussed security scenarios with the business, including removal of the sign as one option, outlines existing anti-discrimination screening and networks, and sees no current growth in antisemitism.
In this case the police considered security with the business, discussing various scenarios openly.
In onderhavige casus heeft de politie meegedacht met de ondernemer over de veiligheid, waarbij verschillende scenario's in openheid zijn besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan huurders van boerenschuren screenen’

MPs Van Oosten and Rutte asked whether the government supports municipalities screening tenants of farm barns for criminal records to prevent drug labs or cannabis grow sites, and about reviving the 'stoplight model' for police advice to private landlords. The minister welcomed local initiatives against undermining crime, said the stoplight model lacked a legal basis and was stopped, and that the government is studying the problem.
Data protection law provides no room to restart the implementation of the stoplight model.
Het gegevensbeschermingsrecht biedt geen ruimte om een doorstart te maken met de uitvoering van het stoplichtmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het stilleggen van een strafzaak omdat de voortgang door toedoen van het openbaar ministerie te traag verliep

MPs Van Oosten and Arno Rutte asked why a criminal case was halted because prosecution delays, and what measures prevent repetition. The Minister acknowledged backlog at two prosecution offices, attributed it partly to a court-room shortage, and pointed to a joint review and planned measures, while the court itself ruled the delay violated due process.
The court ruled that the public prosecution service acted contrary to the principles of due process, so the suspect faced an unreasonably long period of uncertainty about the outcome of his case.
De rechtbank heeft hierop geoordeeld dat het openbaar ministerie in strijd heeft gehandeld met de beginselen van een behoorlijke procesorde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘OM ziet opvallende stijging aantal corruptiezaken binnen politie en douane en het Jaarbericht OM 2017’

MP Helder asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Public Prosecution Service's 2017 annual report noted a rise in corruption and leak cases without giving reasons, and whether research would be done. The minister answered that Rijksrecherche cases rose from 31 in 2011 to 45 in 2017, pointed to a 2017 WODC report finding no significant increase in integrity violations, and declined further study while noting the report was already sent to Parliament.
I see no reason to conduct further research in addition to the report mentioned in the answer to question 2.
Ik zie geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen in aanvulling op het in het antwoord op vraag 2 genoemde rapport
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over de terugkeer van het alcoholslot

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether the government will reconsider reintroducing the alcohol lock after the Council of State and Supreme Court rulings, and whether it will amend the law to do so. The ministers answered that the alcohol lock under administrative law is no longer feasible, that placing it in criminal law was examined and found costly and rarely applicable, and that they will not re-investigate or legislate now but await the results of the Alcoholmeter pilot.
The rulings mean that the alcohol lock programme as it was arranged is no longer possible, and that any new programme must take these rulings into account.
De uitspraken betekenen dat het ASP zoals dat was geregeld niet meer mogelijk is en dat bij het ontwerp van een nieuw ASP rekening met deze uitspraken moet worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van den Berg over de steekpartij in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister why a Den Haag stabbing was quickly attributed to confused behaviour, what the asylum status of the suspect was, what support exists for asylum seekers with confused behaviour, and what the state of policy on such persons is. The minister answered that the suspect has a residence permit with no prior IND warning signs, described existing care and reception facilities, and promised a letter on the policy this autumn.
The foreign-national legal aspects of this individual case will not be discussed further.
Er wordt niet verder ingegaan op de vreemdelingrechtelijke aspecten van deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Anticorruptieteam nodig'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether he agrees with an expert that a dedicated anti-corruption and anti-drug-smuggling team conducting proactive investigations is needed in the Rotterdam port. The minister replied that current investigative tools are sufficient, that a special team would add no value according to the prosecution service and police, and pointed to broader measures against undermining crime.
According to the OM and the police, the current investigative tools are sufficient to tackle official and non-official corruption, and setting up a special team currently adds no value.

Volgens het OM en de politie zijn de huidige opsporingsmiddelen daarbij voldoende om ambtelijke en niet-ambtelijke corruptie aan te pakken en heeft het inrichten van een speciaal team op dit moment geen meerwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over verwarde personen

An FvD MP asked the Justice Minister how police define 'confused persons', whether the May 2018 Hague stabbing was terrorism, and why police incident figures on confused persons rose sharply while GGZ figures did not. The minister answered that police cannot determine confusion, that the Schakelteam definition is used, that causes of the rise are unclear, and that the term 'verward' is increasingly inflated.
Whether someone is actually confused cannot be determined by the police.
Of iemand daadwerkelijk verward is kan niet door de politie worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Wapens niet meer onklaar gemaakt’

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the EU firearms directive has not yet been implemented, whether arms dealers are no longer accepting weapons for destruction, and who will be responsible for deactivating weapons. The minister replied that the implementing bill was submitted on 29 June 2018, that the police will be the central supervisory body with budget reserved, and that it does not track what happens to surrendered firearms.
It is not recorded what has happened to firearms when they were offered to be deactivated.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden wat er met vuurwapens is gebeurd als deze aangeboden zijn om onklaar te worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Kustwacht Bonaire niet versterkt'

MP Bosman asked ministers whether the coast guard presence around Bonaire should be expanded amid Venezuelan migration, and what the Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving report implies. The government answers that the Kustwachtcommissie presidium found extra deployment not currently needed, that the coast guard already operates about 309 presence days in 2017 and intercepted 99 illegal migrants in early 2018, and that a contingency plan exists.
The presidium of the Kustwachtcommissie discussed the governor's letter at two of its meetings and concluded that additional deployment is currently not necessary.
Het presidium van de Kustwachtcommissie heeft in twee van zijn vergaderingen over de brief van de gezaghebber gesproken en geconcludeerd dat extra inzet thans niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over de berichten ‘Ander huis gezocht voor bedreigde christelijke Syriër’ en ‘Syrische christen uit Overijssel krijgt dreigbrief, van IS’

Two MPs asked how citizens threatened for their faith or views, such as a Syrian Christian receiving a threat letter, can obtain adequate protection quickly, and how such cases are registered and countered. The government answered that local authorities are responsible for protection and risk assessment, that threats should be reported to police and are registered as discrimination or threats, and that a local multidisciplinary approach to radicalisation exists.
The local authority generally bears responsibility for the safety and well-being of its citizens.
Het lokale gezag draagt in het algemeen zorg voor de veiligheid en het welzijn van haar burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de schietincidenten in Delft

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a series of shootings and grenade intimidation against Delft hospitality businesses, including whether there is a trend, extortion, sufficient investigative capacity, and tools available to mayors. The minister confirmed the seriousness of the crimes, said the cases are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, and left operational and local safety measures to the mayor, police and prosecutors.
The cases are currently still under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
De zaken zijn momenteel nog in onderzoek bij het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over een vonnis waarbij een taakstraf wordt opgelegd na (poging tot) mishandeling van een agent

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a community sentence after an assault (or attempted assault) on a police officer adequately reflects the seriousness of attacks on public servants, and what steps would ensure custodial sentences and higher arrest rates. The Minister declined to comment on the judge's sentence, stated that violence against public servants is aggravating under sentencing guidelines, pointed to an evaluation of the 2012 restriction on community sentences with a policy response to come, and said the ELA enforcement agreements remain in force with no known signs of low arrest rates.
It is for the judge to decide on the finding of guilt, and on a finding of guilt, on the sanction to be imposed.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over de schuldigverklaring, en bij een schuldigverklaring over de op te leggen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht '’Ik kan wel huilen’, Delft schrikt van weer een geweldsincident'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether recent violent and shooting incidents in Delft and elsewhere form a trend of extortion of hospitality businesses, and on what basis and purpose premises are closed after such incidents. The Minister said the cases are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, that mayors decide case by case on order-maintenance grounds, that closure is not standard policy, and that alternatives such as extra supervision or camera surveillance are considered first.

The mayor will have to motivate each decision separately; generally, considerations concerning the restoration of public order and fear of further disruption of public order will underlie his decision-making.

De burgemeester zal ieder besluit afzonderlijk moeten motiveren; doorgaans zullen overwegingen rondom het herstel van de openbare orde en vrees voor verdere verstoring van de openbare orde aan zijn besluitvorming ten grondslag liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat er opnieuw politie-uniformen zijn gestolen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of stolen police uniforms, including whether the thefts were targeted, why they were not publicised, and whether theft of uniforms is registered and how delivery tracking could be extended. The minister declined operational detail due to an ongoing investigation, said uniform theft is registered only indirectly (116 new-item requests in 2017 due to theft or loss), and saw no need for further measures given that only two of 88,068 parcels went missing.
An investigation into the thefts in question is ongoing. For the sake of the investigation's interests, I will not provide any updates on its progress.
Naar de betreffende diefstallen is een opsporingsonderzoek gaande. Omwille van het opsporingsbelang doe ik over de voortgang daarvan geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Agenten bezorgd over privacy: uniformen nog steeds thuis bezorgd'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether centralised pickup of police uniforms by unit or station, rather than home delivery, would be safer, following reports of officers' privacy concerns. The minister answered that since July 2017 officers choose between home or police-station delivery by tracked, screened courier, and that most parcels (88,068) went to homes versus 7,471 to stations.
Since 1 July 2017, the receiving police officer can choose between delivery of a parcel to the home address or to a police station.
Sinds die datum kan de ontvangende politieambtenaar kiezen tussen het afleveren van een postpakket op het huisadres of op een politiebureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Extra budget is al op’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the extra NFI budget was already exhausted, forcing police and prosecutors to choose which forensic samples to submit, and about alternatives such as outsourcing autopsies to universities, cutting NFI management, and costs of a professor, a letter-dating technique and the NFI Academy. The Minister acknowledged rising demand and capacity limits, said choices remain necessary, rejected outsourcing autopsies to universities on infrastructure and expertise grounds, and promised a new vision on forensic research to the House in autumn 2018.
I will inform your House about that in autumn 2018.
Ik zal uw Kamer daar in het najaar van 2018 over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het pleidooi van gemeenten voor een landelijk vuurwerkverbod

The MP asks whether the government will adopt a nationwide fireworks ban as urged by municipalities and the Safety Board, whether the VVD blocked it, and how it views local measures and the 'waterbed effect'. The ministers answer by referring to their 8 June letter explaining why they chose not to implement the Safety Board's ban now, say they are consulting the VNG on local regulation, and state that a ban on certain fireworks is not excluded if the measures prove ineffective after evaluation.
Should it turn out that these measures do not lead to the desired result, a ban on certain types of fireworks is not ruled out.
Mocht blijken dat deze maatregelen niet tot het gewenste resultaat leiden, dan is een verbod op bepaalde typen vuurwerk niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het MH17 strafproces te voeren in de zittingslocatie Schiphol

The MP De Roon asked the Minister of Justice why the MH17 criminal trial was located at Schiphol, whether next of kin were consulted, and whether the location would be reconsidered. The Minister answered that the location was chosen on the basis of a programme of requirements set by the OM and judiciary, that Schiphol offers the needed facilities, and that the choice was carefully made, with next of kin able to follow the trial via live stream.
The decision on the hearing location was carefully prepared and made.
Het besluit over de zittingslocatie is zorgvuldig voorbereid en gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het toepassen van palliatieve sedatie bij mensen met dementie buiten de palliatieve fase

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about deep palliative sedation of people with dementia outside the terminal phase, including whether it is used as a means to control severe behavioural problems, its relation to euthanasia oversight and the Wet zorg en dwang, and whether guidelines are being revised. Minister De Jonge answered that the core condition of a life expectancy under two weeks still applies in principle, that professional bodies are revising guidelines and a ZonMw study on the rise in sedation is under way, and that the Wzd framework permits such care only after a strict necessity and subsidiarity assessment.
No figures are known on the number of continuous deep palliative sedations in patients with dementia or non-psychogeriatric conditions with a life expectancy longer than two weeks.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal continue en diepe palliatieve sedaties bij patiënten met dementie of niet-psychogeriatrische aandoeningen en een langere levensverwachting dan twee weken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over de uitvoering van het Besluit zorgvuldig onderzoek verweesde werken

Two MPs from D66 asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how Dutch archives may reproduce and publish copyrighted works, including online, and how the orphan works decree applies, in response to reports of municipal archives taking photos offline after a court ruling. The minister answers by setting out the copyright exceptions for archives and the orphan works diligence procedure, notes that no estimate exists for Dutch archives, and points to the EU EnDOW project and a pending EU proposal for extended collective licences as ways to reduce the administrative burden.
For the online publication of copyrighted standalone photographs, archives must in principle obtain permission from the relevant rightsholders.
Voor de online beschikbaarstelling van auteursrechtelijk beschermde losse foto's dienen archieven dus in beginsel toestemming van de desbetreffende rechthebbenden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een in Rotterdam werkzame imam in Engeland is veroordeeld voor kindermishandeling

Two MPs asked whether a Rotterdam imam convicted in England of child abuse was known to his mosque board, whether a VOG should be required for imams, whether he could obtain one, and about links to the Hijaz community. The government said the mosque board claims it was unaware, that VOG is an employer responsibility with a recommended VOG for child-related work, that a foreign conviction would appear in Dutch records and normally block a VOG, and that it cannot judge specific links but relies on the driesporen approach and transparency measures on foreign funding.
We do not go into individual cases.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether a Belgian match-fixing investigation in tennis involves Dutch suspects, whether Dutch and Belgian authorities are in contact, and whether the Kansspelautoriteit or prosecutors will investigate Dutch parties. The minister confirmed contact with Belgian authorities via the Public Prosecution Service, said he cannot comment on foreign investigations, and explained that the Ksa only supervises detection and reporting of suspicious bets, with signals assessed for criminal investigation without confirming any ongoing investigations.
Each signal is also examined, as usual, for possible leads for criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
Elk signaal wordt daarnaast – zoals gebruikelijk – onderzocht op mogelijke aanknopingspunten voor strafrechtelijk onderzoek door het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over ontbrekende DNA-profielen van veroordeelde criminelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that tens of thousands of convicted criminals lack DNA profiles in the databank, and whether the backlog harms case solving and the ministry's legal compliance. The minister denied breaking the law, said the backlog clean-up is complete with 268,230 profiles stored, and announced plans to end mandatory DNA collection for juveniles given a 40-hour community service sentence following a UN Human Rights Committee ruling, via a law amendment to be put to consultation.
The Ministry complies with the law.
Het Ministerie houdt zich aan de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Agent kan fluiten naar feest'

An MP asked whether the Justice Minister would help a police officer reach his 50-year service jubilee, five working days away, and whether a gesture of thanks would be sent. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, praised the long service, described the police farewell guidelines and the rule that staff over pension age leave unless service interests require otherwise.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend is kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse president Erdogan campagne wil voeren in het buitenland voor de Turkse presidents- en parlementsverkiezingen in juni

VVD MPs Becker and Koopmans asked whether Erdogan would campaign abroad before the June 2018 Turkish elections, how the Netherlands would prevent such campaign visits, and whether a German-style ban on foreign politicians campaigning could be introduced. The government said Erdogan attended a rally in Sarajevo, that visits by Turkish government members are unwanted, that municipalities decide on other campaign activities, and that it will explore a general line on foreign politicians' campaigning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over een verbod op Denk

MPs from the PVV asked whether the government would arrest and deport a Denk party staffer who said he was proud to be an IS supporter, and whether it would seek a ban on the Denk party. The Minister answered that IS-linked conduct is criminal and that dissolving a party is an exceptional measure requiring high legal standards, which is for the public prosecutor to decide, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
It is for the public prosecutor to decide whether a request under article 2:20 of the Civil Code is opportune.
Het is aan het openbaar ministerie om te bepalen of een verzoek ex artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het terugsturen van vrouwen en kinderen naar IS-gebied

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Syrian Kurds were sending detained jihadi brides and their children back to IS-held territory, and whether Belgian intelligence had shared information and whether Dutch women and children were affected. The minister said the signals could not yet be confirmed, that European intelligence services cooperate and share information on travellers where necessary, but that he could not discuss specific cases.
I cannot go into specific cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Jong en Helder over het bericht 'Bizar probleem defensie: Schietende jassen'

MPs asked about a report that winter jackets issued to military and police personnel could accidentally fire weapons via loose cords, and about the injury, measures taken, the Inspectorate SZW investigation, and whether the jackets remain in use. The government said the injured soldier has recovered, the Marechaussee banned firing in these jackets, about 4000 soldiers still have them with elastic removal required, the police do not use them, and it announced a plan for a safer defence organisation while withholding the inspectorate's timing and dates.
Making working conditions safer is therefore a top priority for the coming years.
Het veiliger maken van de werkomstandigheden is dan ook topprioriteit voor de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het lot van Nederlandse IS-kinderen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the whereabouts and safety of Dutch children of IS members, including reports that some may be moved back into IS territory. The minister answered that at least 145 such children remain in the conflict zone and at least 30 elsewhere in the region, that contact with Kurdish authorities is structural but not formal with the groups running the camps, and that the government does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children while continuing to monitor the situation.
This weighing leads to the cabinet not actively pursuing the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria and Iraq.
Deze weging leidt ertoe dat dat het kabinet niet actief inzet op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het voorkomen van wangiri-fraude

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked how wangiri phone fraud via Dutch and foreign numbers can be prevented and whether operators can block high-tariff numbers. The government answered that no reliable figures exist, that operators and the ACM have some blocking and anti-fraud options, and that enforcement is difficult because it is international, while promising to inform the House if relevant developments arise.
I am willing to inform the House further if relevant developments occur in the consultations with the telecom sector.
Ik ben bereid de Kamer nader te informeren als zich relevante ontwikkelingen voordoen in het overleg met de telecomsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over crimineel geld in de Amsterdamse huizenmarkt

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether criminal money is entering the Amsterdam housing market, how large it is, what measures exist to keep it out, and whether police have enough capacity. The Minister replied that the reports describe risks rather than established facts, pointed to an upcoming WODC study, and listed existing anti-money-laundering and RIEC cooperation measures while acknowledging police capacity is scarce.
The article, like the police unit's 'Trends and developments' report, speaks of risks rather than established facts.
Het artikel spreekt, net als het rapport «Trends en ontwikkelingen» van de politie-eenheid Amsterdam over risico’s, niet over vastgestelde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Niemand zo vaak ziek thuis als agent in Haagse regio'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police sick-leave in the Den Haag unit, which is above the national average, and whether the 10% reduction target is ambitious enough. The minister acknowledged the high absence, promised a unit-level analysis including PTSS-related absence, and said targets will be set per unit with extra support for the highest-absence units.
However, it is not known how many of the 493 officers sitting at home in the Den Haag unit have PTSS symptoms.
Het is echter niet bekend hoeveel van de 493 agenten die thuis zitten in de eenheid Den Haag kampen met PTSS-symptomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Kunstmarkt schrikt van EU-regel tegen witwassen'

An MP asked the government about the EU anti-money-laundering directive lowering the cash-and-bank threshold for art and antiques dealers' customer due diligence to EUR 10,000, the reasons, implementation room, and burden. The Finance Minister answered that the threshold lowering and extension to buyers and freeports will be implemented within 18 months with limited national room, that regulatory burden will be assessed, and that the art trade will be involved, without a quantified impact assessment.
The room for national discretion in implementing the provisions concerning the art trade is therefore limited.
De ruimte voor een eigen invulling bij het implementeren van de bepalingen die betrekking hebben op de kunsthandel is daardoor beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: 'Honderden appende vrachtwagenchauffeurs betrapt vanuit touringcar'

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports that 440 drivers, many of them professional truck drivers, were fined for phone use while driving, and about campaigns, enforcement and sentencing. The minister acknowledged the figures as worrying, described an upcoming public campaign and a voluntary convenant with industry, noted rising handheld-phone violations, and said a sentencing bill on dangerous phone use would go to the Council of State and then parliament.
I expect to be able to send the bill to your House after the summer.
Ik verwacht het wetsvoorstel vervolgens na de zomer aan uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Lange over veiligheidshuizen en het delen van informatie tussen de ketenpartners

Two VVD MPs asked whether safety houses (veiligheidshuizen) lack a legal basis to share information needed for decisions on compulsory care, whether they will create one, and how medical confidentiality and the GDPR affect information sharing. The minister and state secretary answered that partners rely on their own legal bases, the Wvggz from 2020 provides sharing grounds, a bill on joint data processing is coming, and existing guidance and conflict-of-duties rules apply.
Soon the bill on data processing by cooperative partnerships will go into consultation.
Binnenkort gaat het wetsvoorstel gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat jihadist Victor Droste zich op Nederlandse bodem zou bevinden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether jihadist Victor Droste had returned to the Netherlands after reports to that effect. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to state Droste's whereabouts citing the ongoing criminal investigation, and explained that returnees are arrested on arrival and prosecuted.
The criminal investigation into the Dutch suspect Victor D. is still ongoing.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de Nederlandse verdachte Victor D. loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de oproep om voor meer beveiliging voor de familie van kroongetuigen te zorgen

MPs Buitenweg and Van Nispen asked whether the minister will heed a lawyer's call to strengthen protection of the family of crown witness Nabil B., and about the status of a motion on filling vacancies at the protection service. The minister declined to discuss case details or protection measures for security reasons, said crown witnesses are indispensable, and said additional measures are being taken to fill vacancies in the medium term.

As I also reported in my letter of 5 June following the debate on combating liquidation violence, and as is generally known to your House, I cannot go into the details of the case or into any security measures taken to protect persons.

5 juni naar aanleiding van het debat over de strijd tegen het liquidatiegeweld, en zoals in het algemeen bekend is bij uw Kamer, kan ik niet ingaan op de details van de casus noch op de eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen die worden genomen om personen te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bescherming van kroongetuigen en hun familie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether protection capacity for crown witnesses, their families and threatened local officials is sufficient, and what will be done to ensure optimal protection. The minister answered that capacity is under pressure, that protection is tailored and proportionate and full safety cannot be guaranteed, and that he has commissioned studies to optimise witness protection.

As also reported in the letter to parliament of 5 June, capacity is under pressure, due to on the one hand many security assignments and on the other a capacity shortage at the Dutch Royal and Diplomatic Protection Service (DKDB).

Zoals ook in de kamerbrief 3 d.d. 5 juni gemeld staat de capaciteit onder druk, door enerzijds veel beveiligingsopdrachten en anderzijds een capaciteitstekort bij de Dienst Koninklijke en Diplomatieke Beveiliging (DKDB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Dit keer dumpen de boswachters zelf afval, als statement’

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security, Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and Infrastructure and Water Management about fly-tipping in rural areas after rangers dumped waste as a protest. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a joint plan of action on supervision and enforcement in rural areas would be sent to parliament before the budget debates, and noted that cleanup costs and enforcement capacity are burdens but gave no national data on causes or environmental damage.
As promised in the Nature committee debate of 8 March 2018, I am working with the Minister of LNV on an action plan to improve supervision and enforcement in rural areas.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018 werk ik samen met de Minister van LNV aan een plan van aanpak om het toezicht en de handhaving in het buitengebied te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Buitenweg over het overwegen van strafverzwarende omstandigheden bij geweld met een racistisch, antisemitisch of homofoob oogmerk

Two MPs (Segers and Buitenweg) asked the Justice Minister about treating discriminatory motives (racist, antisemitic, homophobic) as aggravating circumstances in criminal sentencing, including whether prosecutors can go above the statutory maximum, how often courts do so, and whether ECRI's advice to legislate for this will be followed. Minister Grapperhaus explained the Dutch system of general offences with CODIS sentencing uplifts of 50-100% requested by prosecutors, said data on court treatment is unavailable, and announced renewed review through a letter to parliament.
So far it has not been possible to answer this question.
Het is tot op heden niet mogelijk gebleken deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Zorgen Staatsbosbeheer om veiligheid boswachters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about reported safety concerns for forest rangers (boswachters) and green enforcement officers, including incident numbers, whether rangers should receive handcuffs, batons and pepper spray, C2000 radio access, and a joint action plan with the police. The minister answered that no total incident figures exist because of a changed registration system, reported about 70 incidents at Staatsbosbeheer in 2017, said the equipment request is under advisory review, and promised an action plan to be shared around the budget debate.
No figures are available on the total number of incidents involving forest rangers and enforcement officers.
Over het totaal aantal incidenten van boswachters en boa’s zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Gevaarlijk pedohandboek ongestoord verspreid via internet'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a dangerous paedophile handbook circulating on the internet could be prosecuted, whether possession should be criminalised as in the UK, and what measures exist. The minister answered that the Darkweb makes perpetrators hard to trace, that the Netherlands' general criminal provisions already cover such material, and that a new law is not needed, while promising a progress letter in September.
Dutch criminal law therefore currently offers sufficient possibilities to act against the distribution or production of handbooks with criminal content on the internet.
Het Nederlandse strafrecht biedt vooralsnog dan ook voldoende mogelijkheden om te kunnen optreden tegen de verspreiding of vervaardiging van handboeken met strafbare inhoud op het internet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk 'pedohandboek' al jaren op internet te vinden’

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked whether a 'paedophile handbook' circulating online can be prosecuted, and whether Dutch law should be changed, including what other countries do. The Minister of Justice answered that possessing or distributing texts from such a handbook can already be prosecuted under existing provisions, so no new legislation is needed, and promised a progress letter on online child sexual abuse in September.

Since it has not so far been shown that the aforementioned criminal provisions would be inadequate to act criminally against the making, possession and distribution of such handbooks, I see no reason to introduce new legislation.
