Nu vooralsnog niet is gebleken dat de voormelde strafbepalingen ontoereikend zouden zijn om strafrechtelijk te kunnen optreden tegen het vervaardigen, voorhanden hebben en de verspreiding van dergelijke handboeken, zie ik voor de introductie van nieuwe wetgeving geen reden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP from D66 asked the Justice Minister about a criminal investigation into a former IAP secretary-general, the role of a prosecutor's attendance at an IAP congress in Bangkok, and whether the Board of Procurators General independently decided to transfer an official. The Minister confirmed the investigation is separate from the congress, said the Functioneel Parket's head attended at the Board's request, and referred the remaining questions to a pending committee inquiry.

Beyond that, the committee I mentioned in the answer to question 2 from MP Groothuizen (D66) on disrupted relations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service (submitted 17 May 2018, number 2018Z08990) can include this matter in its inquiry.

Voor het overige kan de commissie die ik noemde in het antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Groothuizen (D66) over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar Ministerie (ingezonden op 17 mei 2018, nummer 2018Z08990 ) deze kwestie in haar onderzoek betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht "Omstreden dienstreis voedt vertrouwenscrisis bij OM"

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice whether he was aware of press reports on a disputed business trip fuelling a trust crisis at the Public Prosecution Service, and whether he would order an independent fact-finding inquiry into undisclosed private relationships in the OM leadership and how the then leadership handled them. The Minister answered that the College of Procurators-General has already commissioned an independent inquiry, which will also examine the appointment of the Rotterdam chief prosecutor and possibly earlier events, and that he will discuss the outcome with the College after it is published.
As already indicated, the College of Procurators-General has commissioned an independent inquiry.
Zoals reeds aangegeven heeft het College van procureurs-generaal opdracht gegeven tot het uitvoeren van een onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat het bedrijf van familie van een in opspraak geraakte OM-topman

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the public prosecution service contracted for eight years with a company run by relatives of a senior prosecutor under scrutiny, and about that prosecutor's role and integrity. The minister confirmed a contract with a firm employing relatives of a College member created an appearance of conflict of interest, said it should not have happened, and deferred detailed answers until an independent commission reports.
The College has informed me that this should not have happened.
Het College heeft mij laten weten dat dit niet had mogen gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over integriteitsschendingen binnen het openbaar ministerie

MP Groothuizen asked whether a former member of the prosecution college's personnel portfolio contracted a firm where his younger sister was project manager, whether there was conflict of interest, who knew of the family tie, what the contract was worth, and whether the integrity commission would examine it. The minister confirmed a possible appearance of conflict of interest, said this should not have happened, and that the college asked the commission to investigate the contract's conclusion and extension, without answering the detailed questions on payments and internal knowledge.

For this reason, the College has asked the commission, as mentioned in the answer to question 2 from MP Groothuizen (D66) on disrupted relations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service (submitted 17 May 2018, number 2018Z08990), to investigate the course of events surrounding the conclusion and extension of the contract.

Daarom heeft het College de commissie, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Groothuizen (D66) over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar Ministerie (ingezonden op 17 mei 2018, nummer 2018Z08990 ), gevraagd om de gang van zaken rondom de totstandkoming en de verlenging van de overeenkomst te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar  Ministerie

MP Groothuizen asked the Minister of Justice about an alleged relationship between two senior prosecutors and whether integrity rules were breached and concealed. The Minister said the College of Procurators-General has commissioned an independent investigation, which will address the appointment, the handling of reports, and the integrity questions, and declined to answer substantively until its results are known.
The College of Procurators-General informed me that, following the reports, it has commissioned a broad independent investigation.
Het College van procureurs-generaal heeft mij meegedeeld naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving opdracht te hebben gegeven tot het uitvoeren van een breed onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Buitenweg over het horen van slachtoffers / getuigen in de strafzaak rond de Groningse gaswinning

MPs Van Tongeren and Buitenweg asked whether the investigating judge would hear witnesses and victims at their homes, in the presence of NAM's lawyers, in the criminal case on Groningen gas extraction, and how secondary victimisation could be avoided. The Minister answered that the suspect's counsel have a statutory right to attend, that the home-hearing request came from the witnesses themselves, that the Public Prosecution Service opposed it, and that the investigating judge had not yet authorised it, with each witness supported by a lawyer during questioning.
The Public Prosecution Service opposed hearing the witnesses on location.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft zich verzet tegen het horen van de getuigen op locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Veiligheidsregio verzweeg fout jodiumpillen in Limburg’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether errors in distributing potassium iodide tablets left some families without them, why the error was not communicated, and whether distribution and registration methods should change. The minister acknowledged distribution problems could not be fully traced, described a remedial scheme for affected Limburg households, and promised an evaluation by RIVM due in 2019 while rejecting a registration system.
Unfortunately I cannot determine where errors may have been made or how many families did not receive the tablets.
Ik kan helaas niet achterhalen waar mogelijk fouten zijn gemaakt en hoeveel gezinnen de tabletten niet hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ´Start nu met het opleiden van de politie van de toekomst’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a former police education council chair's call for the Police Academy to act as an education broker, and how police units can source training outside the Academy, including who pays and whether police staff may teach privately. The Minister answered that the Police Academy is the sole provider of police education, units can buy non-police training from their own budgets, and private teaching by staff is not allowed, with DSI instructors temporarily trained to fill a shortage.
Because these are public funds, these trainings may not be provided privately by teachers acting as private individuals.
Omdat het hierbij gaat om publieke gelden, mogen deze opleidingen niet privaat door docenten als privépersonen worden verzorgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Wijkagent als gatenvuller’

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police norm that neighbourhood officers spend at least 80% of their time in their neighbourhood is being met, and whether they are routinely diverted to other tasks. The Minister confirmed the norm and acknowledged such signals, but pointed to the development agenda for area-based policing and said the norm leaves room for practical implementation, without committing to a specific enforcement step.
In general terms, the signal that neighbourhood officers are also deployed for other tasks is known to me.
In algemene zin is het signaal dat wijkagenten ook voor andere werkzaamheden worden ingezet mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Jouw medicijnen worden straks misschien wel door een drone gebracht’

MPs Koopmans and Remco Dijkstra asked the ministers about news that drones may deliver medicines, and about drone innovation, timing of an integrated vision, privacy and airspace safety, miniaturised or camouflaged drones and drone swarms in private hands. The government answered that it keeps its drone policy course, that general privacy rules and EU safety regulation apply, that small camouflaged drones filming covertly may be criminal, and that swarm flights will need to meet safety requirements under forthcoming EU rules.
This cabinet maintains the course set earlier, as stated in the most recent progress letter on drone policy of 28 May 2018.
Dit kabinet houdt vast aan de eerder ingezette koers zoals verwoord in de meest recente voortgangsbrief dronebeleid van 28 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de blusinstructie voor de brandweer bij vuurwerk en vuurwerkopslagplaatsen

An MP asked the Justice and Interior and Infrastructure ministers about firefighting instructions for fireworks fires, including whether water can extinguish burning fireworks, safety distances, sprinklers, blast venting, and warnings after the Culemborg and 2005 European container tests. The minister answered that the 2005 circular governs firefighter conduct, that fireworks storage rules in the Vuurwerkbesluit were not changed, and that the government sees no reason to amend the current rules.
I see no reason to amend the current Vuurwerkbesluit regarding the existing pressure-relief provision via the door.
Ik zie geen reden om het vigerende Vuurwerkbesluit aan te passen rond de huidige druk ontlastende voorziening via de deur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat de politie vorig jaar 46 klachten heeft gekregen over etnisch profileren

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of 46 complaints against police for ethnic profiling in 2017, the complaint channels, handling, and whether an independent evaluation is needed. The minister gave detailed figures, described the complaints procedure, and declined an independent evaluation, citing existing reviews and ongoing research.
In 2017, a total of 46 complaints about ethnic profiling by the police were received.
In 2017 zijn in totaal 46 klachten ontvangen over etnisch profileren door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over meer arbeidsslaven in Europa dan sekswerkers

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of more labour exploitation than sex trafficking in Europe, the claimed halving of registered trafficking cases in the Netherlands, prosecution and sentencing statistics, and progress on the coalition agreement's plans to strengthen the fight against trafficking. The Secretary of State answered that the rise in labour exploitation is worrying, that registered victims fell from 1,256 in 2014 to 952 in 2016 with a slight recovery in 2017, provided statistics on victims, prosecutions and sentences, and said a pimping ban and a broader interdepartmental plan are in preparation.
There is no question of a halving.
Er is geen sprake van een halvering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht dat particulieren steeds vaker een privédetective inhuren

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the growing use of private detectives by individuals, the number of private investigation agencies, the police's role in overseeing them, and risks to the rule of law. The minister answered that no objective growth figures exist, that agencies are licensed by Justis and supervised by police and the Data Protection Authority, that sanctions were rare, and that the police bear legal oversight responsibility while balancing capacity against other tasks.
Compliance with the applicable rules is supervised by the police. Self-regulation is therefore only one part of the overall package of control mechanisms for the private investigation sector.

Op het naleven van de gestelde regels wordt door de politie toezicht gehouden. Zelfregulering is derhalve slechts een onderdeel van het totale pakket aan controle mechanismen voor de sector van particuliere recherchebureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maasvlakte: buitenlanders vrijuit op milieuzone’

An MP asks whether foreign trucks entering the Maasvlakte environmental zone face unequal treatment because their Euro emission class cannot be checked from the licence plate, and whether enforcement and fine collection abroad are assured. The government admits foreign vehicles can only be checked by roadside inspection, says it is exploring cross-border data exchange with the EU and other states, and promises to pursue a structural solution.
I would like to arrange the international exchange of vehicle data and keeper data.
Ik wil de internationale uitwisseling van voertuiggegevens en de gegevens van de kentekenhouder graag regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de mogelijke strafbaarheid van het vechten voor Turkije in Syrië

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether Turkish dual nationals could be mobilised for the Afrin offensive, whether Dutch citizens fighting for the Free Syrian Army or serving in Turkish forces are criminally liable, and whether the Turkish offensive is lawful. The ministers answered that no general mobilisation orders are known, that fighting in Syria is in principle punishable for Dutch nationals except for state-authorised action against IS, that serving in foreign armed forces is not in itself criminal, and that the government takes no active role in advising those called up; several questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or deferred.
Active participation other than on government orders in the fight against IS in Iraq and Syria is in principle punishable.
Actieve deelname anders dan in opdracht van de overheid aan de strijd tegen IS in Irak en Syrië is in beginsel strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over een mogelijke aanval van taxichauffeurs op het hoofdkantoor van Uber

An MP asked about a reported plan by taxi drivers to attack Uber's Amsterdam headquarters, prior warnings, illegal taxi complaints, and ILT inspection capacity and enforcement in Amsterdam. The government answered that police are alert, the ILT has 25 inspectors working on a risk-based approach, and cooperation with the municipality, police and prosecutors is set out in a convenant.
Do you think the ILT has sufficient capacity to ensure in Amsterdam that entrepreneurs and drivers in the taxi sector comply with the rules?
Bent u van mening dat de ILT voldoende capaciteit heeft om er in Amsterdam op toe te zien dat ondernemers en chauffeurs in de taxibranche de regels naleven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Verouderde strafwet BES hindert veroordeling seksuele delicten’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an outdated Penal Code for the Caribbean Netherlands (BES) caused an acquittal in a sexual offence case and why it was not modernised like the Caribbean Kingdom countries' codes. The minister confirmed one acquittal, admitted that articles 249 and 253 were mistakenly not updated in 2010, and said a bill to fix this will be submitted before the summer recess.
Correction of the omissions in articles 249 and 253 of the BES Penal Code will take place in the bill amending the BES Code of Criminal Procedure.
Herstel van de omissies in de artikelen 249 en 253 Wetboek van Strafrecht BES vindt plaats in het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van het Wetboek van Strafvordering BES
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Drie mishandelaars Praag veroordeeld en Tsjechië uitgezet’

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that three Dutch men were convicted in Prague for assault and expelled, including questions on reputational harm, prosecution in the Netherlands, police-officer involvement and compensation for the victim. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the case is individual, the Czech authorities handle it, the Netherlands will not investigate under Article 68 Sr, a Dutch police investigation has started, and compensation is not for the Dutch government.
I do not make statements about the individuals involved.
Over de betrokken individuen doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Arno Rutte en Beckerman over het gijzelen van een huurster in Groningen

Three MPs asked the ministers about a Groningen landlord who allegedly locked a tenant in her room by screwing the door shut, and whether such practices occur more widely. The minister declined to comment on the specific case pending investigation, called such confinement unacceptable, outlined planned action against bad landlords including sector agreements and possible legal changes, and noted that exact figures on such offences are not registered.
As long as not all the facts are known, I refrain from commenting on this specific case.
Zolang niet alle feiten bekend zijn onthoud ik mij van een reactie over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitspraken van korpschef Akerboom over partydrugs

An MP asked the ministers about police chief Akerboom's claims that drug-related deaths rose sharply and that drug use sustains extreme violence, and whether harder sentences raise drug prices. The government answered that the death figures are not yet reliable due to registration changes, that it knows of no evidence that harsher penalties make the market more lucrative, and that its drug policy distinguishes soft from hard drugs to protect public health.
At this moment, therefore, a reliable picture is lacking.
Op dit moment ontbreekt dus een betrouwbaar beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over Cambridge Analytica

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked ministers about Cambridge Analytica's methods, the number of Dutch Facebook users affected (up to 90,000), and whether Dutch parties use similar microtargeting. The minister answered that up to 89,373 Dutch people may have been affected, that no Dutch cases of Cambridge Analytica-style influence are known, that Dutch party microtargeting is not comparable and is subject to stricter privacy rules, and that the Raad voor het Openbaar Bestuur was asked to advise on digitalisation and democracy.
I am not aware of the exact methods of these companies, which data they had access to, or which social media platforms that personal data came from.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de exacte methodes van deze bedrijven, over welke gegevens zij de beschikking hadden, dan wel van welke sociale media platforms die persoonsgegevens afkomstig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de ondersteuning van nabestaanden van vliegramp MH17 bij de afwikkeling van schade

An MP asked the government how it can support relatives of MH17 victims in pursuing civil damages claims, given confusing advice and competing lawyers, and whether 'no cure no pay' fees suit the case. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, said the government cannot yet give unambiguous advice, referred emotional support to Slachtofferhulp Nederland, and said the deken supervises no-cure-no-pay arrangements.
Given the existing uncertainties, it is currently not possible to provide next of kin with unambiguous advice and assistance.
Gelet op de bestaande onduidelijkheden en onzekerheden is het echter op dit moment niet goed mogelijk om nabestaanden met eenduidige raad en daad terzijde te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Arabische inmenging in moskee Rotterdam’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports of Arab foreign influence over the Essalam mosque in Rotterdam, including the foreign funder's role and dismissal of Dutch staff, and about the status of a convenant and foreign-funding legislation. The minister replied that Rotterdam could not establish actual influence on the mosque's religious line, that the government is exploring ways to restrict undesirable foreign funding, and that the Chamber will be informed after summer 2018.
I share the urgency of this issue and your wish to have more instruments at hand to counter undesirable influence through foreign funding.
Ik onderschrijf de urgentie van deze problematiek en deel met u de wens om meer instrumenten voorhanden te hebben om onwenselijke beïnvloeding middels buitenlandse financiering tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verkoop van verboden nepvuurwapens

An SP MP asked whether the police campaign on imitation firearms had worked, whether incidents are rising, and whether the sale and possession of toy guns that are banned to carry should be restricted. The Minister says the first campaign was not measured but imitation weapon seizures fell 2015-2017, rejects restricting sales because the EU Toy Directive is binding and toy guns are not weapons under the Wet wapens en munitie, and states there is no prescribed government sales policy for toy guns.
Amending the Toy Directive requires an extensive procedure that is not currently on the agenda.
Het aanpassen van de Speelgoedrichtlijn vergt een uitgebreide procedure die op dit moment niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over de uitzending van Zembla “Zakendoen met justitie”

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice about high and special transactions by the Public Prosecution Service (OM) in 2016-2017, including prosecution of individuals, secrecy, fiscal treatment, equality and judicial review. The ministers answered that the OM prosecutes individuals in many cases, gave figures for 2016-2017, acknowledged that the Rabobank non-admission wording was unfortunate, and said the current practice is being reviewed.
At this moment the current practice is being reviewed.
Op dit moment wordt de huidige praktijk tegen het licht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het schikkingsbeleid van het Openbaar Ministerie

MP Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether mega-settlements with companies such as SBM Offshore, Rabobank and KPMG, which avoid prosecution, should require prior judicial approval, and asked for details of the SBM settlement terms. The ministers answered that the OM has discretion to reopen cases on new facts, that appeal to the Court of Appeal under art. 12 Sv is already possible, and that the high-transaction procedure will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet OM-afdoening.

As I wrote to your House in response to the 2016 annual report of the Council for the Judiciary, interested parties can lodge a complaint with the Court of Appeal under article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Zoals ik uw Kamer in de reactie op het jaarverslag over 2016 van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak heb geschreven, kunnen belanghebbenden op grond van artikel 12 Sv. beklag doen bij het Gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het afkopen van strafrechtelijke vervolging via schikkingen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about out-of-court settlements (hoge transacties) that let companies such as Rabobank and PON avoid prosecution, including whether individuals are spared, how publicity is handled, and whether the rules should change. The ministers defended the practice as efficient and effective, acknowledged that the 2013 Libor press release fell short of current standards, and said the practice is under review in the evaluation of the Wet OM-afdoening, with judicial review via beklag under art. 12 Sv. already possible.
With regard to all suspects, the OM made a prosecution decision based on all information that had become known.
Ten aanzien van alle verdachten heeft het OM op basis van alle bekend geworden informatie een vervolgingsbeslissing genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over het bericht ‘Rijbewijs honderden ouderen onterecht ingenomen’

MPs Van Brenk and Krol asked the Minister of Justice and Security how licences could be seized on the spot and how a driver found fit after examination could have had his licence taken, and about the marechaussee making medical judgements. The minister answered that the listed grounds for on-the-spot seizure are alcohol, speeding, dangerous driving and suspected insufficient fitness, but declined to address the specific case because it is an ongoing criminal investigation.
The case mentioned in the reporting concerns an ongoing criminal investigation.
De in de berichtgeving genoemde casus betreft een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de veroordeling van uitreiziger/jihadist Marouane Boulahyani

An MP asked the Minister whether he would revoke the citizenship of returned jihadist Marouane Boulahyani, bar his return, and place his network in administrative detention. The Minister said citizenship revocation under article 14(4) RWN is an option under active consideration but cannot be discussed publicly for this case, and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law, pointing to criminal prosecution and the Tijdelijke wet bestuurlijke maatregelen terrorismebestrijding instead.
Whether the relevant provision of the RWN applies to the case of Marouane Boulahyani I cannot comment on in public.
Of de betreffende bepaling uit de RWN van toepassing is op de casus van Marouane Boulahyani daar kan ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het investeren van afgepakt crimineel geld in wijken

The MP asked whether confiscated criminal assets should be returned to neighbourhoods, as suggested by the Rotterdam mayor, and whether data sharing rules should be widened to fight undermining crime. The minister rejects earmarking confiscated assets for neighbourhoods, citing selective enforcement and budget-process concerns, while pointing to a new 100 million euro undermining fund and planned legislation on information sharing.
Confiscated criminal assets should, in the first instance and where possible, be returned to the victims.
Afgepakt crimineel vermogen dient in eerste instantie, indien mogelijk, terug te worden gegeven aan de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de online handel in beschermde vogels en het nieuws dat rechercheurs hun handen vol hebben aan smokkel van bedreigde diersoorten

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about online trade in protected birds, reports that criminal organisations smuggle protected species, and whether enforcement capacity and CITES expertise are sufficient. The minister said illegal wildlife trade is opposed, outlined enforcement by RVO, customs, NVWA and the Public Prosecution Service, and stated that the NVWA natural team's capacity had not changed and that CITES training had moved to other courses.
The cabinet is opposed to every form of illegal trade in (protected) animals.
Het kabinet is tegen elke vorm van illegale handel van (beschermde) dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht “U-bocht in zaak Poch”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked about Dutch police and prosecution contacts with Argentine judicial authorities in the Poch case, including an unofficial 2008 trip and the role of intermediaries. The minister answered that two working visits took place in 2008 under the Dutch investigation, with knowledge of both states, that no minutes of the talks exist, and that such exploratory contacts are not unusual in complex cases.
I do not have records of these conversations.
Ik beschik niet over verslaglegging van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Voortman over het bericht 'Vluchtroutes voor mindervaliden op festivals te smal: ‘ik lig zo omver’'

MPs Ellemeet and Voortman asked whether the fire-safety rules for event venues (Bbgbop) adequately protect people with disabilities at festivals, and what the government will do about narrow escape routes. The minister replied that the national decree only sets minimum widths, that accessibility is the responsibility of organisers and municipalities, and that he will consult disability organisations on possible rule changes.
I will shortly contact the disability interest organisations to explain how the Bbgbop works and to explore together where improvements to the regulations are possible.

Ik zal op korte termijn met de belangenorganisaties voor personen met een beperking in contact treden om enerzijds de werking van het Bbgbop toe te lichten en anderzijds om samen met hen te bezien waar verbeteringen in regelgeving mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de politie tips niet kan gebruiken

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police tip-form technical problems meant tips and attachments were lost, and whether this was widespread and fixed. The minister replied that there were no technical faults, that the single case arose from a staff member not following the download protocol, and that the system cannot lose files, with renewed attention to working agreements promised.
In the case mentioned, an employee did not follow the download protocol and requested that the form be emailed.
In het genoemde geval heeft een medewerker het downloadprotocol niet gevolgd en verzocht om het formulier te mailen.

Antwoord op vragen van Helder en Beertema over het bericht op de website van de politie inzake 'Politie-iftar 2018' en het bericht op de Instagram-account van de jeugd-agent Apeldoorn inhoudende dat de politie Apeldoorn

PVV MPs Helder and Beertema asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police website item and an Apeldoorn youth-officer Instagram post promoting a police iftar, questioning police neutrality and the role of such events in tackling Moroccan-Dutch youth gangs. Minister Grapperhaus answered that local police units may organise community events such as iftars to stay connected with society, that police must keep lifestyle neutrality, and that no special target-group policy exists in youth crime prevention.
The police is for and of everyone and must, including when it organises meetings with population groups, maintain its neutrality.
De politie is van en voor iedereen en moet, ook als zij ontmoetingen met bevolkingsgroepen organiseert, haar neutraliteit bewaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht dat Meld Misdaad Anoniem gegevens doorverkoopt

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Justice Minister whether Meld Misdaad Anoniem sells anonymous tips, whether municipalities and agencies must pay per tip, and whether police should investigate before arrests based on anonymous tips. Minister Grapperhaus rejected the claim of selling tips, explained the subsidy and fee arrangement, and stated that anonymous tips are only guiding information requiring independent verification, while promising to review the public-private financing with the supervisory board.
There is no question of "sale of anonymous tips".
Er is geen sprake van «verkoop van anonieme tips».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over het bericht 'Heibel om afschieten honden op Bonaire'

MPs Helder and Graus asked whether the chief prosecutor on Bonaire acted unlawfully by telling police that loose dogs could be shot, and why Caribbean Netherlands lacks the animal welfare rules of Europe Netherlands. The Minister replied that the e-mail was a clumsy internal instruction about reporting, not an order to lie, and that European and Dutch animal welfare rules do not apply in Caribbean Netherlands, which relies on local regulation and the Penal Code BES.
The chief prosecutor in that e-mail certainly did not intend to create the suggestion that reporting should be done contrary to the truth.
De hoofdofficier heeft in het betreffende e-mailbericht dan ook geenszins de intentie gehad de suggestie te wekken dat er in strijd met de waarheid geverbaliseerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het afnemen van bloed van een overleden potentieel verdachte

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether blood can be taken from a deceased potential suspect of a fatal traffic incident so that surviving victims and relatives can get answers, and whether legislation prevents or permits this. The minister referred to an earlier answer and said the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure is examining whether examinations of deceased suspects or victims, such as autopsy, body scans or DNA sampling, can be explicitly allowed under set conditions.
That examination could consist, for example, of an autopsy, a body scan, taking cell material for DNA research or a dental examination.
Dat onderzoek kan bijvoorbeeld uit een sectie, een scan van het lichaam, het afnemen van celmateriaal voor DNA-onderzoek of een gebitsonderzoek bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de publicatie "Risicomanagement voor collecties" van de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

An MP asked the ministers about the RCE publication on collection risk management, incident registration in DICE, the end of the Mondriaan Fund security grant, and the tracing of stolen art and antiques. The minister answered that collection holders are primarily responsible for security, that DICE registration is voluntary so incident numbers are likely undercounted, and that the Erfgoedinspectie oversees security in state collections.
Registration of incidents in DICE is not mandatory and not all collection managers are connected.
Registratie van incidenten in DICE is niet verplicht en niet alle collectiebeheerders zijn aangesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Belhaj over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a court ruling that Schiphol must release about 2,500 slots, and about its consequences for passenger flows, border control queues, security and the 500,000-movement cap. The minister replied that the ruling has no policy consequences for the 2017/2018 season, that the cap through 2020 stands, and that Marechaussee capacity is being expanded, while declining to comment on Schiphol's reasoning.
I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the justification of this decision by Schiphol, because the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not a party in this case.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om commentaar te geven op de onderbouwing van dit besluit door Schiphol omdat het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen partij is in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bizarre oproep: ’Maak lawaai tijdens dodenherdenking’

MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked whether a online call to make noise during the Dutch national Remembrance Day two-minute silence should be prevented, and whether the minister would engage Amsterdam. The minister condemned the call as disrespectful but said the local security triangle has full attention and is responsible for deciding how to respond.
It is up to them to decide how to deal with this call.
Het is aan hen om te beslissen hoe met deze oproep moet worden omgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verkoop van euthanasieproducten via een website

MP Van der Staaij asked whether a website selling euthanasia products amounts to criminal assistance in suicide, whether the public prosecution service will investigate, who runs the site, and what powers exist to shut it down. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecution service decides independently on investigation and prosecution, declined to comment on this individual case, said the identity of the operators is unknown to him, and described the notice-and-take-down procedure and the prosecutor's power under article 54a Sr. to order internet providers to block access.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide independently, on the basis of the facts and circumstances, whether to open an investigation and possibly take a prosecution decision.
Het is aan het OM om op basis van de feiten en omstandigheden eigenstandig te beslissen of een opsporingsonderzoek wordt ingesteld en eventueel een vervolgingsbeslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het boek 'Dagboek van een getuige' en het bericht 'Slachtoffer mislukte liquidatie Breda krijgt geen huurwoning'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a book and a news report concerning a failed liquidation victim, including whether the 1% budget-threshold policy for protective security (bewaken en beveiligen) still applies and whether the police track its costs. The minister answered that the policy rule no longer applies since the national police was formed, that costs are not uniformly registered, and that a letter on the protection system will follow before summer.
The costs of deployment and measures in this context, such as personnel and resources, are currently not uniformly registered by the police.
De kosten van de inzet en maatregelen in dit kader, zoals personeel en middelen, worden op dit moment niet door de politie eenduidig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de positie van kwetsbare verdachten in het strafproces

An SP MP asks the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about protecting vulnerable suspects in criminal proceedings, including a dissertation on mentally ill defendants, the choice between prosecution and compulsory psychiatric admission, false confessions, screening at first interrogation, and audiovisual recording of interrogations. Minister Dekker answers that the new Sv Book 6 draft addresses most recommendations, that case-by-case judgement applies, that existing safeguards exist, and that screening of all suspects is not straightforward; recording is required only for specified serious offences and is still being expanded.
Efforts are aimed at expanding these facilities.
Er wordt naar gestreefd deze faciliteiten uit te breiden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam en Omtzigt over de aangenomen resolutie van de parlementaire assemblee van de Raad van Europa “Prosecuting and punishing the crimes against humanity or even possible g

MPs Van Helvert, Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the government will act on a Council of Europe resolution calling ISIS crimes genocide, including whether to appoint a specialised prosecutor and enable handover of evidence. The government confirmed its support for the resolution, described existing investigative cooperation, and promised to study the specialised prosecutor proposal and report back.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Over de resultaten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Weggepest en toch vervolgd'

An MP asks whether a shop owner who defended herself against attackers should be prosecuted and whether self-defence rules for citizens should be widened, and asks the minister to instruct the prosecutor to drop the case. The minister declines to discuss the facts because the case is before the court, explains the existing self-defence rules (proportionality and subsidiarity judged by courts), and says there is no reason to instruct the prosecutor to withdraw the case.
The case is still before the court. For that reason I will not go into the facts of the case as they have been described.
De zaak is nog onder de rechter. Om die reden ga ik niet in op de feiten van de zaak zoals die zijn geschetst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Diyanet, het Turkse ministerie voor geloofszaken met 140 moskeeën in Nederland, de uitspraak heeft gedaan dat kinderen in de puberteit, voor meisj

MPs Becker and Ten Broeke asked whether Diyanet, the Turkish religious affairs ministry operating 140 mosques in the Netherlands, issued a fatwa allowing child marriage and whether this fits a pattern of rights violations, and what it means for mosque leaders and children. The government answered that Diyanet distanced itself from the report and opposes child marriage, that child marriage under 18 is banned and punishable in the Netherlands, and that it is exploring ways to make foreign funding of religious organisations more transparent.
Diyanet issued a press statement explicitly distancing itself from this interpretation as described in the original article in the Turkish newspaper Sözcü.
Diyanet heeft een persverklaring afgegeven, waarin zij nadrukkelijk afstand doen van deze interpretatie zoals beschreven in het oorspronkelijke artikel in de Turkse krant Sözcü.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘De rechtspraak moet een slag maken naar etnische diversiteit’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether the Court of Appeal president's remarks that too few judges have a migration background and that more judges should understand 'their culture' undermine judicial neutrality, and whether they amount to advocacy for sharia justice. The Minister answered that judicial composition is the judiciary's own responsibility, that diversity does not affect impartiality, and that judges can separate personal views from their function.
The composition of judicial staff is the responsibility of the judiciary itself.
De samenstelling van het rechtspraakpersoneel is de verantwoordelijkheid van de rechtspraak zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over onveiligheid in een woonwijk in Rosmalen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about shootings in a Rosmalen residential area, prior police signals, how residents are involved in local crime prevention, and how to increase crime reporting. The minister declined to comment on the specific case due to an ongoing criminal investigation, pointed to municipal responsibility and existing citizen reporting channels, and referred to the regeerakkoord goal of raising reporting rates without specific new measures.
Regarding the case mentioned in the reporting, there is an ongoing (criminal) investigation.
Ten aanzien van de in de berichtgeving genoemde casus is sprake van een lopend (strafrechtelijk) onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Politiechef wil meer agenten in buitenland’

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether extra funding in the coalition agreement for deploying police officers abroad comes at the expense of the national police budget, and whether this burdens overstretched local police. The Minister confirms the structural 267 million euro investment, says it is not at the expense of other police budgets to be detailed in June 2018, and argues that deployment abroad benefits Dutch local safety.
In my letter of 20 December 2017 I already committed to informing the House in around June 2018 in more detail about these aspects.
In mijn brief van 20 december 2017 2 heb ik reeds toegezegd uw Kamer rond juni 2018 nader over deze aspecten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat de korpschef meer agenten naar het buitenland wil sturen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police chief's plan to send more officers abroad, including which countries and missions police are active in, their powers, immunity, funding and the review of the country programme. The minister answered in detail, listing liaison officer postings and missions, but gave no firm figures on the extra funding or new postings, deferring these to a letter around June 2018.
In my letter of 20 December 2017 I already committed to informing your House around June 2018 in more detail about these aspects.
In mijn brief van 20 december 2017 2 heb ik reeds toegezegd uw Kamer rond juni 2018 nader over deze aspecten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Jihadisten uit Syrië en Irak kunnen spil van nieuwe netwerken worden’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that jihadists returning from Syria and Iraq could become hubs of new networks, including whether detention and post-release monitoring prevent radicalisation and whether other countries share knowledge. The Minister confirms the threat persists, describes criminal investigations, terrorist-wing detention and risk assessment, and cooperation with EU and UN partners.
Both bilaterally and within the EU framework there is good contact with the surrounding countries about developments in the threat and approach, and such signals are not present now.
Zowel bilateraal als in EU-kader is sprake van goed contact met de omringende landen over ontwikkelingen in de dreiging en de aanpak en dit soort signalen zijn er nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de hoge onkostenvergoeding die het OM bij een schikking betaalde aan een witwasverdachte

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why the public prosecution service paid about 200,000 euro in cost compensation in a settlement with the widow of a money-laundering suspect, why this was not disclosed in the press release, and why a settlement rather than prosecution was chosen. The minister answered that the compensation covered legal and asset-realisation costs (about 156,418 euro paid after offsets), that the omission from the press release was a lack of openness acknowledged after reflection, and that settlements are the most effective way to seize the assets, while promising a letter on high transactions and an evaluation of the Wet OM-afdoening.
On reflection, the prosecution service has stated that insufficient openness was given at the time about this aspect of the transaction.
Bij nader inzien heeft het OM aangegeven dat destijds onvoldoende openheid is gegeven over dit aspect van de transactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verstrekken van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden bij twijfel over de doodsoorzaak

The SP MP Van Nispen asked whether relatives who doubt a death's cause should get copies of police/prosecution case files and whether access for their own investigation could be widened, as adopted in a motion. The Minister answered that prosecutors decide case by case, weighing confidentiality, third-party privacy and risks to future prosecution, and pointed to an earlier letter for the motion response.
Providing a file for the purpose of one's own investigation deserves a separate assessment, which the handling public prosecutor must make case by case.
Het verstrekken van een dossier ten behoeve van eigen onderzoek verdient een heel eigen afweging, die de behandelend officier van justitie per zaak moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Nederland opgepakte Marokkaanse Rif-activist

An SP MP asked whether a Moroccan Rif activist arrested in Rotterdam should be returned to Morocco given doubts about a fair trial there, and whether the government agrees. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said fair-trial concerns must be judged case by case, and noted the former foreign minister raised fair trial with Morocco.
As your House is aware, I in principle do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Winkeldiefstal daalt helemaal niet'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the CBS crime figures understate shoplifting, given industry claims that reporting is hard and that retailers have stopped filing reports. The minister acknowledged a gap between registered and actual crime, pointed to an ongoing WODC study due in May 2018 and to easier reporting channels, but said he could not verify the industry's sampling method and saw no need for a new measurement instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politie: wij hebben allochtonen nodig'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a report that police need allochtonen, questioning positive discrimination, the overrepresentation of people with migration backgrounds in integrity violations, dual nationality, Islam, and prayer time for officers. Minister Grapperhaus answered that diversity is operationally necessary, selection standards are unchanged and integrity risks are addressed through measures, while rejecting the idea that dual nationality is undesirable and stating there is no policy on prayer during duty hours.
Above all, the selection criteria and quality of the police are not compromised.
Voorop staat dat aan de selectiecriteria en kwaliteit van de politie niet getornd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about leasehold (erfpacht) disputes in Amsterdam, including court costs, the legal status of the Amsterdam switch scheme to perpetual leasehold, whether it amounts to an insurance product requiring AFM oversight, and the financial burden on homeowners. The minister answered that courts remain open at manageable cost, that the scheme is a contractual arrangement not an insurance product so the AFM has no role, and that the municipality offered a calculator tool and a financial safety net.
It is up to the leaseholder, possibly after obtaining legal advice on his case, to decide whether he wants to bring proceedings against the municipality.
Het is aan de erfpachter om – eventueel na het inwinnen van juridisch advies over zijn zaak – te beslissen of hij een procedure tegen de gemeente wil voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over incassofraude bij banken

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a reported gap in bank direct-debit systems that allows incasso fraud, including whether banks pre-fund transfers from intermediate accounts and whether they warn creditors of possible reversal. The minister replied that the system complies with EU rules, that incasso fraud is very small in value, that police do not register it separately, and that banks will be asked via the MOB to renew attention to the rules.
Via the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) I will ask the banks to give renewed attention to this in the coming period.
Via het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) zal ik de banken verzoeken hier de komende tijd hernieuwde aandacht aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over een hoge transactie of schikking

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a high settlement (transactie) and cost reimbursement the Public Prosecution Service paid to the widow of a criminal, who was herself suspected of money laundering, potentially avoiding prosecution. The Minister confirmed the payment, defended the settlement's legality, admitted insufficient public openness about the reimbursement, and said the PPS does not register settlements with cost reimbursements.
The PPS does not register settlements in which a cost reimbursement is also granted and therefore has indicated it cannot answer the question.
Het OM registreert niet op schikkingen waarbij tevens een onkostenvergoeding is toegekend en heeft derhalve aangegeven geen antwoord te kunnen geven op de vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over onlineoplichting via datingsites

MP Krol asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about online fraud via dating sites that use fake profiles, including the size of the problem, consumer disclosure duties, and protection of vulnerable users. The state secretary said data on the number of operators, victims and damage is unavailable, pointed to consumer law and ACM supervision, and to fraud prevention, Slachtofferhulp and the Veilig Daten keurmerk, while no registration of identity fraud via dating sites exists.
However, I do not have data on the basis of which I can estimate the number of companies operating dating sites with fake profiles.
Ik beschik echter niet over gegevens op basis waarvan ik een schatting kan maken van het aantal bedrijven dat dating sites met onechte profielen exploiteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de veiligheid van vrouwen op het internet

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about online safety for women, including whether complaints about sexism and threats to social media are recorded, whether platforms remove content as in France, whether platforms should proactively remove such content, and whether France's online sexual intimidation offence should be introduced in Dutch law. The Minister said such figures are not recorded, that the Netherlands lacks comparable removal data, that platforms bear responsibility under the voluntary Notice and Take Down code, and that a separate offence for misuse of sexual imagery will be proposed while the wider sex-offence review continues.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat schietbanen van de politie onveilig zijn

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police shooting ranges meet safety and health requirements, whether the work instruction is followed, and how many hearing damage reports exist. The minister answered that 2017 risk assessments found the ranges compliant when instructions are followed, that the 2015 work instruction was not fully implemented and will now be, and that the police do not track hearing damage reports.
The police do not have figures on reports of hearing damage among police officers.
De politie beschikt niet over aantallen van meldingen van gehoorbeschadiging bij politiemedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over een 14-jarig meisje, dat vanwege een hoofddoek van haar fiets werd geduwd en op de grond liggend het ziekenhuis in werd geslagen en geschopt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a 14-year-old girl wearing a headscarf was pushed off her bicycle and beaten and kicked, and about rising anti-Muslim incidents and government plans to combat them. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service closed its criminal investigation over doubts about the complaint, that discrimination figures fell in 2016, and that no separate action plan, budget or police unit targeting anti-Muslim hatred will be created because policy must apply to all groups.
The criminal investigation led by the Public Prosecution Service into the alleged assault on a 15-year-old girl from Emmeloord has been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie naar de vermeende mishandeling van een 15-jarig meisje uit Emmeloord is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Joods restaurant weer belaagd'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police found no anti-Jewish motive behind repeated vandalism of a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam, how such cases are investigated and registered, and what protection is provided. The minister replied that the investigation is ongoing, no suspect has been arrested, the prosecutor (OM) decides whether discrimination is involved, and referred to existing anti-discrimination policy and protection measures.
As is known to your House, I cannot make statements about individual criminal cases during the investigation.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan ik gedurende het onderzoek geen mededelingen doen over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Brandweer smijt met miljoenen'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the Amsterdam-Amstelland fire service paid out 3.9 million euro unlawfully, whether the amount is recoverable, how the former commander failed to intervene, and how to prevent such practices. The minister answered that the veiligheidsregio is the employer and accountable to its municipal councils, that the misconduct is unacceptable, and that the schemes have been stopped, while not addressing the recoverability question in substance.
The Amsterdam-Amstelland safety region is, under the Safety Regions Act, the employer of the fire service personnel.
De veiligheidsregio Amsterdam-Amstelland is volgens de Wet veiligheidsregio's werkgever van het brandweerpersoneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Joods restaurant weer belaagd'

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecutor would pursue an antisemitic motive for repeated vandalism of a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam and whether the acting mayor should be replaced for failing to protect it. The minister said prosecution is for the OM to decide, that a discrimination aspect would be raised as an aggravating factor, and that local authorities determine protective measures, with the acting mayor already reporting measures to the council.
Where there is reason to do so, the local authority takes additional measures to protect the entrepreneur, employees and those present.
Indien daartoe aanleiding is treft het lokale gezag aanvullende maatregelen ter bescherming van de ondernemer, de werknemers en aanwezigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over gestolen politie-uniformen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police uniforms stolen from a courier van and whether home delivery of uniforms to officers' private addresses exposes their personal data to risk. The minister said all uniforms were recovered, that theft is not separately recorded, that delivery now uses a Track & Trace secure-transport pilot with officers choosing home or station delivery, and that no new tender will occur while the pilot is evaluated.
By now all police clothing in this case has been recovered. I cannot make further statements about the ongoing investigation into it.
Inmiddels is alle politiekleding in deze zaak teruggevonden. Ik kan geen verdere uitspraken doen over het lopende onderzoek hiernaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de emotionele oproep van ouders na de dood van hun dochter om het zelfmoordpoeder te verbieden en het strafrechtelijk vervolgen, dan wel verbieden van de Coöperatie Laat

An SGP MP asked the Health and Justice ministers, after parents' emotional appeal following their daughter's suicide, whether they would ban the self-death powder sold by the CLW, pursue prosecution, and dissolve the cooperative under civil law, and whether a meeting with the CLW had taken place. The ministers answered that they will explore regulation options, that the Public Prosecution Service has started a criminal investigation and asked the CLW to cease its activities, that civil dissolution is being considered by the OM, and that a meeting with the CLW is not appropriate during the investigation.
Since the Cooperative Last Will is the subject of a criminal investigation, a conversation by me with this cooperative is not opportune and the commitment cannot be fulfilled.
Aangezien de Coöperatie Laatste Wil onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, is een gesprek van mij met deze coöperatie niet opportuun en kan de toezegging niet gestand worden gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het contrast tussen de torenhoge toegewezen declaratie van een politie-advocaat en de bezuinigingen op de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked why a police-officer defendant's lawyer was awarded a very high fee of about 144,000 euro in a relatively simple assault case, while legal aid fees are being cut, and what the government will do about it. The Minister said the court's decision is not for him to comment on, that the right to choose a lawyer applies and that courts decide what is a reasonable fee, and that the lawyer's hourly rate is unknown to him; he noted the police-officer compensation arrangement and that the state bears the cost via the court ruling, but committed to no concrete action.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on the Court of Appeal's decision.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op de beslissing van het Gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht Verantwoord gebruik van geweld moet bij agent 'inslijten'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about training hours for police use of force, the neck hold, registration of force, and complaints handling. The minister said police training is at least 32 hours (raised to 42 in the CAO), police cannot yet give reliable hours per unit, the neck hold was reviewed by the Inspectorate and a training framework adopted, and a new registration system and amended instructions are planned for 2019.
The police do not (yet) have reliable data on the training hours completed.
De politie beschikt (nog) niet over betrouwbare gegevens met betrekking tot de gevolgde trainingsuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Mister Cloud’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked the Justice Minister about a Blauw interview with police academy director Kuijs on a 'Kenniscloud' knowledge platform, its relation to the earlier PKN/KomPol, its business model, validation of knowledge, and police case-file quality. The minister answered that the Kenniscloud complements KomPol, that no commercial interests are involved, that validation rests with the responsible police portfolio holder, and that police and prosecutors are jointly implementing a file-quality standard.
There is no question of commercial interests.
Er is geen sprake van commerciële belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dam over onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwillige verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dam asked about burdensome rules for volunteer traffic controllers, including the annual e-learning requirement and rising costs for events. The minister answered that eligibility was simplified from October 2017, that annual refresher training is kept for quality reasons, and that the matter of extra professional controllers is for municipalities to decide.
The trade-off has certainly been considered to extend this period, but insufficient justification was found for it.
De afweging is zeker gemaakt om deze periode op te rekken, maar daar is onvoldoende onderbouwing voor gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Vertrouwenspersonen #metoo-slachtoffers gedwarsboomd door werkgevers'

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that employers obstruct workplace confidential advisers (vertrouwenspersonen) supporting #metoo victims, and how the government will strengthen their position. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, stressed adviser independence under the Arbowet, and pointed to a forthcoming study and policy response before summer.
A confidential adviser must indeed be sufficiently independent to be able to support victims of unwanted behaviour in confidence.
Een vertrouwenspersoon moet immers in voldoende mate onafhankelijk zijn om in vertrouwen slachtoffers van ongewenst gedrag bij te kunnen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht dat motorclubs zich naar België verplaatsen

D66 MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about reports that outlaw motorcycle gangs are shifting activities to Belgium to avoid Dutch measures, and about cross-border cooperation, a possible administrative ban, and EU anti-money-laundering tools. Minister Grapperhaus answered that cross-border cooperation with Belgium and Germany exists, that a bill for an administrative ban on legal persons is being prepared, and that further steps depend on operational needs.
As is known to your House, a law with an administrative ban is being prepared on the initiative of MP Kuiken (PvdA).
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, is er een wet met een bestuurlijk verbod in de maak op initiatief van het lid Kuiken (PvdA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Blussen? Dat doen we straks met een robot!’

Mr Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a newspaper report on firefighting robots, whether robot firefighting is a new specialism, which specialisms exist beyond basic fire service tasks and who decides them, and whether every regional fire service has a dive team. The Minister answered that robots are not a national specialism, that specialisms are set by safety regions under the Wvr and a national programme, and that 23 of 25 safety regions have their own dive team, with the rest leaving this to regional discretion.
It is up to the board of a safety region to determine how, within the existing legal framework, this task is implemented.
Het is aan het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio om te bepalen op welke wijze, binnen het vigerend kader van wet- en regelgeving, daaraan invulling wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het sociale mediagebruik van de politie

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about police social media posts that exposed personal data such as plates, faces and addresses, and about the rules, training and complaint procedures. The minister said the police are drafting new instructions, that 13 removal requests were received with eight still under review, and that talks on privacy in police videos are ongoing.
It is important that it does not make an unlawful intrusion on citizens' privacy, both for citizens and for the legitimacy of police conduct.
Het is van belang dat zij geen onrechtmatige inbreuk maakt op de privacy van burgers, zowel voor de burgers als voor de legitimiteit van het optreden van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ´Geruïneerd door het faillissement van iemand anders.’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a broadcast on a victim ruined by someone else's bankruptcy fraud, and about enforcing the civil bankruptcy director ban, cooperation among enforcement parties, and a person-focused approach. The minister answered that no civil director bans are yet final, that evaluation is planned for 2021, and that existing cooperation channels and prevention measures are in place, with ongoing consultation rather than a new targeted study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorg over groei geweld door verwarde mensen in Rotterdam’

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising incidents involving confused persons in Rotterdam and the police's role, training and the Schakelteam approach. The minister confirmed rising registered incidents (12% in 2017), said data cannot show unique persons or offences, and pointed to prevention, police training and Rotterdam's existing programmes without committing to new steps.
The police registration does not show the number of persons who committed or are suspected of a criminal offence while in a confused state.
Bij de politie is uit de registratie niet het aantal personen af te leiden dat in verwarde toestand een strafbaar feit heeft gepleegd of daarvan wordt verdacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Tielen over de Nieuwsuurreportage 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Health, Welfare and Sport about a Nieuwsuur report on Roma children exploited in criminal activity, including what is being done about multi-problem families, information sharing between municipalities and abroad, and why some municipalities dropped recommended approaches. The state secretary answered that knowledge has been gathered, that a national adviser has been appointed, and that inter-ministerial and cross-border cooperation exists, but declined to give figures on exploited children and said RvdK does not register ethnicity.
Because children are not registered by ethnicity at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, I cannot say whether or how often Roma children have been placed out of home.
Omdat kinderen bij de RvdK niet worden geregistreerd op etniciteit, kan ik niet aangeven of en hoe vaak Roma kinderen uit huis zijn geplaatst
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether police handling of Roma children used for theft is perpetuating their exploitation, and about investigative capacity, forced marriage and organised child trafficking. The state secretary answered that an internal police report will be shared with parliament though sensitive parts will be withheld, pointed to existing WODC research and ongoing intensification measures, and said further research would add little value.

Yes, I will send this to you soon. However, I will not make certain parts of the administrative signal public, because it concerns sensitive investigative information, criminal methods and other information that should not be made public.

Ja, ik zal u dit spoedig doen toekomen. Bepaalde delen van het bestuurlijk signaal zal ik echter niet openbaar maken, omdat het gevoelige (opsporings)informatie, criminele handelwijzen en andere niet openbaar te maken informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Agent na geweld steeds vaker in de kou'

MP Arno Rutte asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether there are fewer case managers available to support police officers after work-related violence, whether this is sufficient, and whether it links to persistently high police sick leave. The minister acknowledges that case management capacity is insufficient in some cases, says temporary extra capacity is being used, and states that a structural solution is being worked on, while saying sick-leave causes cannot be recorded under privacy rules.
It has emerged that with the current capacity the desired support is not provided in all cases.
Gebleken is dat met de huidige capaciteit niet in alle gevallen de gewenste ondersteuning geboden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat wietolie zo populair is dat gemeenten soepelere regels overwegen

An MP asked whether rising demand for medicinal cannabis oil and a Tilburg initiative easing enforcement for home growers warrant looser rules, and whether the government would consult the VNG. The minister answered that home cultivation remains illegal under the Opiumwet, that only the VWS minister can grant exemptions, and that no consultation with the VNG is planned because the regime is already well regulated.
Only the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS) can grant an exemption from this (Article 8 Opiumwet).
Alleen de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) kan hiervan ontheffing verlenen (artikel 8 Opiumwet).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat een Turks-Nederlandse vereniging in Rotterdam is besmeurd met PKK-leuzen door sympathisanten van de terroristische beweging PKK

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the graffiti of PKK slogans on a Turkish-Dutch association building in Rotterdam, measures to protect members, and PKK demonstrations with flags. Minister Grapperhaus replied that local authorities and police are handling protection, a criminal investigation has no suspects yet, the PKK is monitored and on the terrorism sanctions list, and flag displays are regulated under the right to demonstrate.
I have viewed the defacement with abhorrence.
Ik heb met afkeer kennisgenomen van de bekladding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de burgemeesters van de grote steden een verbod willen op knalvuurwerk en vuurpijlen

An MP asked the government whether it would act on the OVV report on New Year's fireworks and on the mayors' call for a national ban on rockets and banger fireworks, and whether it would tighten protection of emergency workers. The state secretary answered that a national approach is being prepared with partners, that the mayors' call will be considered, that a ban requires time and consultation, and that a letter on the approach is expected by end of March.
Currently I am working together with the Minister of Justice and Security and our partners on a national approach to the New Year's problem.
Momenteel werk ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en onze partners aan een landelijke aanpak van de jaarwisselingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘crimineel hoeft niet te betalen voor opruimen eigen drugsafval’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the costs of clearing drug waste left by criminals can be recovered from them, and whether the planned undermining fund could help, after police failed to recover cleanup costs in court. The minister says the offender should bear the damage, points to victim-claim routes in criminal and civil law and to the victim policy agenda, and says the police are considering a new claim on appeal and that details of the fund will follow around summer 2018.
I am of the view that the damage resulting from leaving behind drug raw materials and drug waste should be borne by the perpetrator.
Ik ben van oordeel dat de schade als gevolg van het achterlaten van grondstoffen voor drugs en drugsafval ten laste dient te komen van de dader
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Nederland is niet up-to-date’

MPs Dijkstra and Rutte asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch critical infrastructure is adequately protected against cyberattacks, whether attacks are increasing, and how the government keeps pace and funds cybersecurity. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he does not recognise the claim that critical infrastructure is inadequately protected, pointed to the Cybersecurity Act, the NCSC's role and EUR 95 million in structural funding, and promised the national Cybersecurity Agenda by end of April.
At the end of April this year, the Dutch Cybersecurity Agenda (NCSA) will be presented to your House.
Eind april van dit jaar zal de Nederlandse Cybersecurityagenda (NCSA) aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over de aankondiging van de extreem-linkse organisaties Anakbayan-Europe en Revolutionaire Eenheid, die de palestijnse veroordeelde terroriste/meervoudig moordenare

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he knows that Rasmea Odeh, a convicted Palestinian figure, was invited to speak in Amsterdam by two far-left groups and was deported from the US for immigration fraud, and whether he will refuse her entry. The minister says he cannot verify the US deportation, does not discuss individual cases, and explains that entry can be refused via Schengen SIS alerts based on factual information such as AIVD or police reports.
However, the Netherlands does not routinely exchange information with third countries about such immigration law decisions.
Nederland wisselt echter niet standaard informatie uit met derde landen over dergelijke vreemdelingrechtelijke besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over de berichten 'Rechercheur Den Haag lekte anderhalf jaar naar criminelen' en 'Foute agenten te vaak doodgezwegen'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of leaks by police officers in The Hague and whether there is a pattern of leaking and a taboo on discussing corrupt officers. The minister replied that the incidents are separate and no pattern can be established on current data, that a full overview of sanctions is not yet available, and that integrity efforts and a culture change process are ongoing.
On the basis of the available data, it cannot be said that there is a pattern.
Op basis van de beschikbare gegevens kan niet gezegd worden dat sprake is van een patroon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Flixbus wil met camera’s drugssmokkel bestrijden’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that Flixbus is installing cameras to fight drug smuggling and about police checks on international bus passengers, questioning their legal basis, effectiveness, and compatibility with EU free movement and Schengen. The Minister answered that the reported delays concern Germany, that checks are targeted at passengers showing suspicious behaviour, that no border controls are carried out, and that camera surveillance is Flixbus's private matter under data protection law with no government role.
I do not have data on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘het OM neemt minder in beslag van crimineel’

An MP asked whether the Public Prosecution Service is seizing less criminal assets, given a report of declining seizures and the 115.6 million euro target for 2018. The minister replied that the cited figures refer only to the Den Haag district, that national confiscation proceeds have not declined and exceeded targets, and saw no reason for an interim report.
The amounts mentioned in the article are correct, but only concern the value of goods seized by the Den Haag district prosecutor's office in the period 2014 to 2017.
De in het artikel genoemde bedragen kloppen, maar zien enkel op de waarde van de in beslag genomen goederen door het arrondissementsparket Den Haag in de periode 2014 tot 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Drankrijders gaan na cursus net zo vaak weer de fout in’

Parliamentary questions from MP Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a report showing that drink-driving education courses (LEMA, EMG, ASP) may not reduce reoffending, and whether sanctions and communication between CBR and the Public Prosecution Service should be improved. The minister replied that a WODC study found a falling reoffending trend but inconclusive effectiveness evidence, that additional research is being considered, that overlapping administrative and criminal measures can reduce effectiveness, and that a letter on improvements will follow.
I am still considering whether it is possible to carry out additional research into the LEMA.
Ik bezie nog of het mogelijk is aanvullend onderzoek naar de LEMA te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Experts: overheid moet ingrijpen bij internetapparaten’

Two MPs asked the ministers whether insecure internet-connected devices should be regulated, including a ban on proven insecure devices and a European certification mark, and what awareness campaigns and producer liability rules exist. The government acknowledged the threat, said a roadmap on secure hardware and software is being prepared with certification, awareness and liability as instruments, pointed to existing campaigns and to an EU review of product liability, and made no firm commitment to bans or a specific certification scheme.
