To promote better security for IoT devices, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, in consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, other departments and private parties, is currently drawing up a roadmap for secure hardware and software.

Om te bevorderen dat IoT-apparaten beter worden beveiligd, stelt het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat in samenspraak met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, andere departementen en private partijen thans een roadmap veilige hard- en software op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de YouTube-film ‘Vacature Politievlieger’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a police YouTube recruitment video for helicopter pilots and whether internal-only recruitment and costly in-house training of police pilots is a wise use of budget. The minister confirmed the vacancies, explained the 36-month, roughly 400,000 euro training path, and justified training internal officers for their operational experience.
The police choose to train two pilots from their own ranks because their executive background increases the quality of the work.
De politie kiest ervoor om twee vliegers uit eigen gelederen op te leiden, omdat hun executieve achtergrond de kwaliteit van de werkzaamheden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over locatiebepalingen bij 112 meldingen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Apple's planned support for Advanced Mobile Location would change 112 emergency location, why the Dutch system is not yet complete while neighbouring countries have location via Android ELS, why no EENA subsidy was applied for, and what privacy considerations apply. The minister answered that AML will be implemented, preferably in 2018, subject to technical preconditions and mobile operator cooperation, that the police will carry out a Data Protection Impact Assessment, and that the subsidy scheme did not fit Dutch needs.
Processing of personal data will, also after the introduction of AML, have to take place in line with the laws and regulations on the protection of personal data.
Verwerking van persoonsgegevens zal, ook na de invoering van AML, dienen te geschieden in lijn met de wet- en regelgeving omtrent bescherming van persoonsgegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Ulu moskee in Utrecht aangifte heeft gedaan tegen de PVV-lijsttrekker in Utrecht over zijn angstwekkende uitspraak over het afbr

MPs from DENK asked about a PVV lijsttrekker's remark that the Ulu mosque could burn, which made worshippers fearful, and about his employment as a municipal employee. The minister distanced himself from the remark, pointed to existing mosque security guidance and local contacts, and said the municipality of Nieuwegein must judge whether the employee's conduct breached the rules.

It is up to the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Nieuwegein, as employer and competent authority, to assess whether the political statements made by Mr Van Deún lead to the conclusion that the so-called performance norm has been exceeded.

Het is aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Nieuwegein als werkgever en bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of de door de heer Deún gedane (politieke) uitlatingen leiden tot de conclusie dat de zogenaamde functioneringsnorm is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke arrestatiebevelen tegen Nederlandse Marokkanen

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Morocco is planning arrest warrants against Dutch-Moroccans involved in the Rif protests, whether the government shares concern about treatment of detained demonstrators, and whether extradition is ruled out given doubts about fair trials. The government replied that Morocco described the matter as summonses to testify rather than arrest warrants, that the Dutch embassy and EU partners monitor detainees and raised concerns with Moroccan ministers, and that there are no indications of an extradition request.
As indicated under 2, there are no indications that the Moroccan authorities intend to request extradition of the persons named.
Zoals onder 2 is aangegeven, zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de Marokkaanse autoriteiten van plan zouden zijn om uitlevering te vragen van genoemde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het bericht 'EU rift over rule of law deepens’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the ministers about the European Commission's warnings to Romania over judicial reforms that could weaken the rule of law and shield corruption suspects, and about rule-of-law decline in several member states, EU justice cooperation, EU funds and Western Balkans accession. The minister confirmed awareness of the Commission's concerns, said the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism mainly signals problems without enforcement power, and stated that justice cooperation is based on mutual recognition with limited refusal grounds.
The Cooperation and Verification Mechanism (CVM) was designed after the accession of Bulgaria and Romania to monitor progress in judicial reform and the fight against corruption.

Het Coöperatie- en Verificatiemechanisme mechanisme (CVM) werd ontworpen na de toetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenië om voortgang te monitoren bij de hervorming van het rechtsstelsel, de bestrijding van corruptie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pedofielen delen massaal Nederlandse kinderfoto’s op openbare Russische site’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked whether the government would investigate a Russian website hosting child photos, including Dutch children, and whether Dutch police cooperate with Belgian investigators. The government answered that no joint investigation or Dutch-specific investigation is underway because no punishable images of Dutch children have been found, that the OM would open an investigation if such material is found, and that it will ask Russian authorities about action against the site.
At this moment there is no joint investigation with the Belgian authorities underway regarding the named Russian website, nor any investigation into images of Dutch children.
Op dit moment is er ten aanzien van de genoemde Russische website geen gezamenlijk onderzoek met de Belgische autoriteiten gaande of onderzoek gedaan naar afbeeldingen van Nederlandse kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de slechte omgang van de politie met zieken

The SP MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the National Police mistreats sick officers, fails to re-integrate them, and keeps receiving UWV wage sanctions, and how it will stop this. Minister Grapperhaus replied that good employer policy has full attention, that sanctions stem partly from past administrative failures, that a new re-integration policy and a plan to reduce sick leave will be sent to parliament before the May recess, and that over 80% of sick-leave files now meet the Poortwachter rules.
As promised, I will send you this action plan before the May recess.
Conform toezegging zal ik u dit plan van aanpak voor het mei-reces aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de beantwoorde vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de stijging van het aantal aangiften voor seksueel misbruik

Buitenweg (GreenLeft) asks whether the Minister accepts the 1-in-8 rape prevalence figure, what the 2017 Rutgers monitor on forced sex shows, and what measures will prevent sexual violence. The Minister says he is not aware of the 1-in-8 claim, cites newer Rutgers data (11% of women experienced forced intercourse), and points to existing prevention campaigns, the Soa/sexual health action plan and a planned consultation with the Centra Seksueel Geweld on a reporting campaign.
To examine how reporting willingness can be increased, consultation with the Centra Seksueel Geweld on a campaign to be set up will take place soon.
Om te bezien hoe die meldingsbereidheid kan worden bevorderd vindt binnenkort overleg plaats met de Centra Seksueel Geweld over een op te zetten campagne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de Amsterdamse politie niet toekomt aan het opsporen van grote drugsbazen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Amsterdam police lack capacity to pursue major drug traffickers, given reports that most of its resources go to liquidations and radicalisation or terrorism cases. The minister said deployment is set locally, acknowledged the capacity pressure, and pointed to 267 million euros in extra structural police funding and a planned review of deployment before summer.
The deployment of police is determined by the local authority and can best be assessed there.
De inzet van politie wordt door het lokale gezag bepaald en kan daar ook het beste worden ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie heeft Utrechtse verdachten plofkraak Friesland in het vizier’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the status of an experimental approach to ram and explosive robberies (plofkraken), including how cases are coordinated and how many investigations were launched in 2017. The minister answered that pilots started in autumn 2017 in Midden-Nederland and Rotterdam, that Amsterdam applies the Top-600 method, that 87 explosive robberies were reported in 2017, and that the national tactical team had 45 officers, though staffing from regional units varies with operational pressure.
Since these are ongoing operational matters, I cannot make statements about the nature and scope of the number of cases being handled.
Aangezien het gaat om lopende operationele zaken, kan ik geen uitspraken over de aard en omvang van het aantal in behandeling zijnde cases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een voor aanranding veroordeelde trainer die toch coach kon blijven

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers how a trainer convicted in absentia of indecent assault was able to keep coaching, what should change, and how cross-border screening of such coaches can be improved. The minister declined to go into the case because it is pending in cassation, but pointed to the KNVB's actions, the VOG screening policy for youth coaches, the ECRIS information exchange, and a forthcoming policy response to the De Vries report.
Because the person concerned has lodged an appeal in cassation and the case is therefore still before the courts, I cannot go into the details of this case.
Omdat betrokkene in cassatie is gegaan en de zaak dus nog onder de rechter is, kan ik niet in detail ingaan op deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'De beerput van Bilal L.'

PVV MPs asked whether the Amsterdam mayor could act outside council control on de-radicalisation, and whether a Rijksrecherche probe should examine the Amsterdam (de)radicalisation network around Bilal L. The minister answered that Amsterdam runs its own local jihadism policy, that the OM alone decides on such investigations and an existing criminal probe is ongoing, and that administrative detention is not justified.
During the investigation I will not comment on this case.
Gedurende het onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraak over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de strijd tegen seksuele uitbuiting van minderjarigen

Member Van Oosten (VVD) asked the Justice and Security ministers about combating sexual exploitation of minors, including boys, information sharing by youth care with police, the use of decoy operations by Terre des Hommes, and specialised victim care. The government answered that boys' victimisation is under-recognised, that an interdepartmental action plan is in preparation, that decoy use by private parties faces legal limits, and that the sexual offences law modernisation consultation is expected around summer 2018.
As announced in the answer to questions 2 and 4, an interdepartmental action plan is currently being developed.
Zoals aangekondigd in het antwoord op vraag 2 en 4, wordt er momenteel gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van een interdepartementaal plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van rechts-extremisme

An MP asked the Ministers of Interior and Justice whether the prosecutor had pursued an Erkenbrand visitor's statements under criminal provisions on group insult and incitement, whether a complaint had been filed, and whether AIVD informs political parties about candidates posing a threat to the democratic legal order. The Minister replied that a complaint is not known to the OM, that further investigation is for the prosecutor to decide independently, and that AIVD can inform a party chair via an official report, without commenting on individual cases.
The OM is, however, not aware of a complaint, so further (investigative) research is in principle not called for.
Het OM is echter niet bekend met een aangifte, zodat nader (opsporings)onderzoek in beginsel niet in de rede ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie kiest voor nieuwe definitie van etnisch profileren'

The MP asks about a police report stating that ethnicity plays a role in selecting suspicious situations, and about the police's new definition of ethnic profiling, questioning whether it is workable given the words 'mede' and 'zonder goede en geldige reden'. The Minister replies that the report does not claim deliberate structural ethnic profiling, that proactive checks must rest on objectifiable grounds, and that the police-developed handling framework, which the Minister presumes workable, sets the principles and definition.
Making distinctions without objective justification in (proactive) police action is unacceptable.
Onderscheid maken zonder objectieve rechtvaardiging bij (proactief) politieoptreden is ontoelaatbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over de recente geweldsgolf in Breda en de roep om extra rechercheurs

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about a wave of violence in Breda and calls for 250 extra detectives, including whether unresolved serious cases and the lack of police capacity are acceptable. Minister Grapperhaus said the government is investing in police capacity, that €100 million from the coalition agreement has been released, and that a review of police deployment and a flexibility agenda are underway, without addressing the 250-detective figure or the budget adequacy directly.
The first 100 million from the coalition agreement has already been released at my initiative.
De eerste 100 miljoen uit het Regeerakkoord is op mijn instignatie nu al vrijgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat Turks-Nederlandse gezinnen worden bedreigd met dreigbrieven met een hakenkruis en bloedspetters op hun voordeur

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of threatening letters with swastikas and blood-like splatters left on Turkish-Dutch families' doors, asking about victim support, suspects, anti-Muslim discrimination policy, mosque security and hate speech penalties. The minister condemned the threats, said no comparable cases are known to police, declined to comment on individual cases or ongoing investigations, pointed to existing discrimination and mosque security policy, and announced a bill to raise the penalty for hate speech in spring 2018.
As is known, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Zoals bekend doe ik geen mededelingen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Moordonderzoeken West-Brabant stilgelegd door onderbezetting’

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether murder and manslaughter investigations in the Zeeland-West-Brabant police unit have been halted due to very high pressure on detective capacity, and what mutual assistance between police units exists. The Minister acknowledges the report, cites high workloads from counter-terrorism, cyber and high-impact crime, points to extra funding and the Politiewet article 56 mechanism for requesting assistance from other units, and refers to answers given to other MPs.
The Police Act provides that under article 56 the Public Prosecutor may request the Chief of Police to obtain assistance from other units for criminal law enforcement.
In de Politiewet is vastgesteld dat op grond van artikel 56 de Officier van Justitie de Korpschef om bijstand kan verzoeken vanuit andere eenheden voor strafrechtelijke handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het artikel 'CDA wil wijkagent inkopen'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister whether municipalities should be allowed to buy extra police capacity such as neighbourhood officers for their own area. Minister Grapperhaus welcomed municipal willingness to invest in safety but rejected purchasing extra police strength, since funding decisions belong to Parliament via the budget and deployment must stay under the authority of mayors and the public prosecutor.

Municipalities buying existing or additional police capacity, including as neighbourhood officers, does not fit the principle of the police system that the States General, through the budget law of my ministry, decides on the level of funding for sufficient and adequately equipped police.

Het inkopen door gemeenten van bestaande of aanvullende politiesterkte, al dan niet in de vorm van wijkagenten, verhoudt zich echter niet met het uitgangspunt van het politiebestel dat de Staten-Generaal – via de begrotingswet van mijn ministerie – besluit over de omvang van de financiering van voldoende en voldoende geëquipeerde politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Tongeren over door de politie afgelegde huisbezoeken aan aardbevingsdemonstranten

MPs Buitenweg and Van Tongeren asked whether police home visits to earthquake protesters before a minister's Groningen visit were lawful, proportionate and compatible with the right to demonstrate, and what will prevent repetition. The minister defended the visits as normal police information-gathering under mayoral responsibility, saw no reason to change the practice, and noted the Groningen mayor said phoning could have been used instead.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkwijze van slotenmakers

The MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why locksmiths open doors and replace locks on request without checking whether the requester is the resident, and whether the government will act. The minister agreed a locksmith should verify the requester, said police knew of no burglary cases using this method, and committed to consulting the trade associations and CCV on raising awareness.
I will consult with the locksmiths' trade association(s) to point out that their members can ask the client for identification when commissioned to open a door.
Ik ga met de branchevereniging(en) van slotenmakers in overleg, om hen te wijzen op het feit dat hun leden bij een opdracht om een deur te openen de opdrachtgever om zijn legitimatie kunnen vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het onderzoek 'Veiligheidsrisico’s jaarwisseling'

Den Boer (D66) asked the Justice Minister about the OVV report on New Year's Eve safety risks, covering EU fireworks rules, enforcement, Europol/EMPACT cooperation, border controls and tracking technology. Minister Grapperhaus declined to answer the individual recommendations, deferring them to a forthcoming joint response and a new national approach, and promised a letter to parliament in spring 2018.

In this letter I indicated that I do not respond to the individual recommendations of the OVV and that, with the presentation of the new national approach to the New Year's problems, I will provide parliament with a joint response from the partners to the individual recommendations.

In deze brief heb ik aangegeven dat ik niet op de afzonderlijke aanbevelingen van de OVV reageer en dat ik met de presentatie van de nieuwe landelijke aanpak jaarwisselingsproblematiek uw Kamer een gezamenlijke reactie van de partners op de afzonderlijke aanbevelingen zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe zeer grote moskee in Noord - en nauwelijks protest’

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they would oppose the construction of a large mosque in Amsterdam-Noord and reduce the influence of Turkish President Erdogan, citing radicalisation concerns. The government answered that freedom of religion applies equally to all faiths, that foreign influence promoting anti-democratic behaviour will not be accepted, and that permitting the mosque is a matter for the local municipal government.
It is up to the local municipal government to grant permission for the construction.
Het is aan het lokale gemeentebestuur om toestemming voor de bouw te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Burgemeesters willen rol als crimefighter’

Helder (PVV) asked whether the minister knows of the ten regional mayors' proposal to give mayors an explicit role in combating undermining crime via the Municipalities Act and whether he agrees, and what he will do. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed he has read the proposal, said the government treats undermining crime as a priority, and said the signals and bottlenecks, including the proposal, will be taken into account in an upcoming action agenda rather than committing to specific changes now.
This action agenda will, among other things, provide information on the undermining legislation.
In deze actieagenda zal onder meer informatie worden verstrekt over de ondermijningswetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het boek ‘Dagboek van een getuige’ en ‘Slachtoffer mislukte liquidatie Breda krijgt geen huurwoning’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about Astrid Holleeder's book and a report that a victim of a failed Breda assassination could not get rental housing, including how protection under Bewaken en Beveiligen and the witness protection programme works, and how costs and responsibilities are divided. The minister answered all five questions in substance, explaining eligibility, the limits on forcing protected persons to cooperate, the separation of protection from criminal investigation, and that protection costs fall mainly on the police budget, while withholding exact cost figures for security reasons.
For security risks, these expenditures are not further broken down, because information about the protection of persons could be derived from them.
Vanwege veiligheidsrisico’s worden deze uitgaven niet nader toegerekend, omdat daar informatie over de beveiliging van personen aan zou kunnen worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'The impenetrable program transforming how courts treat DNA evidence'

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch courts and the NFI rely on probabilistic genotyping software with undisclosed algorithms, as reported for US courts, and whether that is acceptable and should be scientifically tested. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the NFI uses open-source probabilistic genotyping software that is transparent and independently checkable, that courts can call experts, and saw no need for further scientific study.
The judge assesses whether the submitted investigation report and the algorithms used are sufficiently reliable to reach a judgment on establishing the truth.
De rechter beoordeelt of het voorgelegde onderzoeksrapport en de daarvoor gebruikte algoritmen voldoende deugdelijk zijn om tot een oordeel omtrent de waarheidsvinding te kunnen komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht “Blunders Hoornse zedenzaak”

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Hoorn sex-crime case revealed structural problems in police handling of sex offences, whether understaffing and outdated ICT played a role, and how victims are supported. The minister answered that the Inspectorate's findings concern this case only, that staffing matched the 43 fte formation, and that a broader study on possible improvements will be commissioned.
As I promised your House, I will have a study carried out into which improvements in the police and further in the criminal process regarding sex offence cases are still desirable and feasible.
Zoals ik aan uw Kamer heb toegezegd, laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren welke verbeteringen bij politie en verder in het strafproces met betrekking tot zedenzaken nog verder wenselijk en haalbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de 'Hoornse zedenzaak'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Hoorn sexual-assault complaint was not handled promptly, why the suspect was not arrested sooner, why no neighbourhood investigation was held, and whether witnesses who concealed evidence would be prosecuted. The Minister declined detailed answers citing privacy and criminal-procedure reasons, acknowledged police shortcomings per the Inspectorate's findings, and committed to a study of obstacles victims face when reporting crimes.
The protection of the victim's personal privacy stands in the way of a concrete answer to your question.
De bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van het slachtoffer staat concrete beantwoording van uw vraag in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de controle op drank- c.q. drugsgebruik bij de overleden veroorzaker van een gruwelijk ongeval

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the deceased driver in a fatal crash was tested for alcohol or drugs, whether relatives can obtain this information, and whether the law should allow post-mortem blood or drug tests. The minister said the question fell outside the taskforce's scope, that relatives can ask the prosecutor for case outcomes, and that modernising the Criminal Procedure Code is examining post-mortem examinations, without committing to a concrete change.
It has turned out, however, that this question falls outside the scope of the Taskforce.
Gebleken is echter dat deze vraag de scope van de Taskforce te buiten gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over dreigend geweld tegen journalisten

An MP asked the ministers how the government and prosecutors respond to threats against journalists, whether they support a special protection scheme like that for public-task workers, and whether they will meet the prosecution service and the NVJ on an action plan. The government says threats are unacceptable and that talks on journalist protection are ongoing in a steering group, but it considers a scheme like Veilige Publieke Taak hard to realise for journalists.
A protection comparable to the Veilige Publieke Taak programme is, however, difficult to realise.
Een vergelijkbare bescherming zoals het programma Veilige Publieke Taak is echter lastig te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over coldcaseteams

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security how cold cases are selected, how many arise each year, and whether selection criteria and special teams are needed. The Minister answered that cold cases are chosen by OM and police using age and public-interest criteria, that no national registration exists (about 1500 cases now), and that each unit has a dedicated team, so no new elite teams are planned.
The OM and the police have indicated that there is no national registration of cold cases, making it impossible to show the precise development of their number.
Het OM en de politie hebben laten weten dat er geen landelijke registratie van cold cases plaatsvindt, waardoor het niet mogelijk is om de precieze ontwikkeling ervan weer te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minieme pakkans drugsrijder’

MPs Rutte and Dijkstra asked why drug-impaired drivers can go unpunished because the NFI lacks capacity to analyse blood samples, and what will be done about the backlog. The minister acknowledges the capacity shortfall, says analysis capacity will be expanded at short notice, that the most serious cases are prioritised, and that further information will follow in a letter at the end of January.
The analysis capacity will be substantially expanded in the short term.
De analysecapaciteit zal op korte termijn fors worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Drugstest wassen neus’

An MP asked whether police only conduct blood testing for serious traffic accidents with fatalities or serious injuries, and why, after a drug-driving law took effect on 1 July 2017. The minister confirmed a temporary measure limiting blood analyses to the most serious cases because demand exceeded NFI capacity, with capacity to be expanded and a letter promised for late January.
It concerns a temporary management measure aimed at limiting blood analyses to the most serious cases.
Het betreft een tijdelijke beheersmaatregel gericht op beperking van analyses van bloed tot de ernstigste gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Verhoeven en Den Boer over het bericht 'Burger ingezet bij opsporing'

MPs Groothuizen, Verhoeven and Den Boer (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a new OM directive allowing police publicity of suspects' identities to prevent serious crimes, including identifiable victims and witnesses, and about safeguards, subsidiarity, oversight and ECHR compliance. Minister Grapperhaus answered largely in substance, explaining the criteria and safeguards but declining to commit to annual reporting and saying no specific oversight was planned.
I see no reason to specifically exercise oversight over this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding daarop specifiek toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gebiedsverbod haatimam blijft’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether an imam judged by a court to threaten national security, and holding dual nationality, should be stripped of Dutch nationality, expelled, or preventively detained. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dual-nationality revocation requires a criminal court ruling or the national-security ground in Article 14(4), which does not apply here, and that a person cannot be expelled while holding Dutch nationality and preventive detention without reasonable suspicion is not justified.
Furthermore, I note that in this case the criteria of Article 14(4) of the Kingdom Act on Netherlands Nationality are also not met
Ten overvloede vermeld ik dat in deze zaak ook niet wordt voldaan aan de criteria van artikel 14, vierde lid Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aangifte tegen het brein achter de moord op Meesters

The SP member Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the family's complaint that no criminal investigation was opened against the alleged instigator of the murder of Meesters, and why the prosecution did not treat Robert D. as a suspect despite accusing him of commissioning the killing. The minister answers that the prosecution found insufficient legal and convincing evidence to prosecute D. and that police and prosecution have investigated the criminal organisation intensively, with two people convicted, and will review any new information.
As my predecessor has informed in the answers to parliamentary questions you cited, the prosecution saw insufficient lawful and convincing evidence to secure a conviction of D. for the commissioning.

Zoals mijn voorganger in de door u aangehaalde antwoorden op Kamervragen heeft laten weten zag het OM onvoldoende wettig en overtuigend bewijs om tot een veroordeling van D. voor de opdracht te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat politievrijwilligers zich ondergewaardeerd voelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether police volunteers are sufficiently valued, whether they receive proper training and conditions, and how the shortage of officers and the extra two million euros will be used. The minister said volunteer recognition and conditions are being improved through a nationwide policy due early 2018, training pathways are being funded, and the extra funds serve volunteer training rather than solving the officer shortage.
I am aware that the police will face a challenge in the coming years in replacing personnel due to large outflows.
Ik ben bekend met het feit dat de politie de komende jaren voor een uitdaging komt te staan bij de vervanging van personeel, als gevolg van grote uitstroombewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Niemand vertelt ons wat’

MPs Van Helvert and Van Dam asked how the government supports relatives of Dutch citizens who die abroad, how it supports the Malaysian police investigation into Ivana Smit's death, and why there is no dedicated contact person for such relatives. The minister replied that the ministry provides consular assistance on request, keeps contact with relatives and local authorities, and that Slachtofferhulp Nederland can offer support after return, while noting that the Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign police investigation.
The Netherlands cannot interfere in a police investigation by foreign authorities into a case that took place abroad.
Nederland kan zich niet mengen in een politieonderzoek door buitenlandse autoriteiten naar een zaak die zich in het buitenland heeft afgespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat een Marokkaans-Nederlandse vrouw en haar kinderen zijn bekogeld met uitwerpselen

An MP from DENK asked the Justice Minister about a report that a Moroccan-Dutch woman and her children were pelted with excrement, and about government measures against discrimination and anti-Muslim hatred. The government condemned discrimination, said no suspects had been identified, saw no reason for policy change from this incident, and declined to introduce mystery-guest tests, which it judged outside the Inspectorate's powers and undesirable.
For now I see no reason to make policy changes based on the incident you mention.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen aanleiding om op basis van het door u genoemde incident te komen tot beleidswijzigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Paternotte over het bericht 'Medewerkers maken zwartboek discriminatie'

MPs Den Boer and Paternotte asked the Justice Minister about reports of discrimination within the police, including by supervisors, and what measures, diversity efforts and monitoring are in place. The minister acknowledged that such conduct occurs, described leadership training, diversity recruitment and the Medewerkersmonitor, and promised an exit-interview exploration and an update in spring 2018 but declined to commission broader new research.
There is no legal basis for the police to register ethnicity.
Voor registratie van etniciteit door de politie is geen wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Bezoek aan Ertugrul Gazi CamiiMoskee'

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police neutrality was compromised by a Haaksbergen police visit to a mosque and whether this conflicts with anti-discrimination policy. The Minister confirmed the facts, reaffirmed the importance of police neutrality and a diverse police force, and said local activities are left to police units themselves, with no national ban on posing with Zwarte Piet.
Both the police and I remain steadfast in the neutrality of police officers in public contact.
Zowel de politie als ik hechten onverminderd aan de neutraliteit van de politieambtenaar in publiekscontact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat medewerkers van de politie een zwartboek discriminatie hebben gemaakt

Azarkan (DENK) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported 'black book' of police discrimination experiences, whether a large-scale culture study is needed, what measures exist, and whether they are effective. Minister Grapperhaus answered that discrimination occurs in the police as in other organisations, pointed to the De Kracht van het Verschil programme, said ethnicity is not registered and exit trends are not yet known, promised to discuss exit interviews with the Chief Constable and inform parliament in spring 2018, and rejected the claim that the programme is inadequate.
There is no legal basis for the police to register ethnicity.
Voor registratie van etniciteit door de politie is geen wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over naming and shaming op internet

An MP asked the Justice Minister what legal options victims of online shaming have to get videos removed and to pursue those who post them, and whether Dutch law protects better than Swedish law. The minister answered that criminal law (privacy and defamation offences), civil portrait-right claims and GDPR complaints to the Data Protection Authority are available, with platform takedown and a proposed prosecutorial removal order as practical tools, and that Dutch protection is comparable to Sweden.
The computer crime III bill, pending before the Senate, expands the public prosecutor's powers.
Het wetsvoorstel computercriminaliteit III, dat aanhangig is bij de Eerste Kamer, vergroot de mogelijkheden van de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over de antisemitische terreuractie tegen een Joods restaurant in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether the suspect in the antisemitic attack on a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam was known to the security services, whether he would be prosecuted for terrorism and deported, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The Minister said he cannot comment on individual cases, that prosecution and sentencing are for the prosecutor and judge, and that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not a legitimate deprivation of liberty, pointing to existing tools.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Het is aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Brede onrust na aanval op joods restaurant’

MPs of the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the suspect in an attack on a Jewish restaurant, who threw a burning liquid, was prosecuted only for vandalism and theft rather than a terrorist offence, and whether he could be deported. The Minister replied that prosecution and sentencing are for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts, that he would not comment on the individual case, and noted the court had adjourned the case for further investigation.
As you know, it is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Zoals bij u bekend is het aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de “achterdeurproblematiek” van coffeeshops

An MP from the Labour party asked the Justice Minister whether the court ruling not to sentence a coffeeshop owner, despite finding him guilty of possessing large quantities of cannabis, exposes the paradox of tolerating sales while the supply side ('back door') remains illegal, and whether legislation is needed. The Minister answered that the ruling does not change enforcement or law, that he does not intend to amend the law, and pointed to planned government-backed experiments with regulated supply to coffeeshops, to be evaluated afterward.
I do not intend to amend the law.
Ik ben niet voornemens de wet te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de woekerhandel in concertkaarten kan voortduren

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether the government would tackle large-scale secondary resale of concert tickets, including by Live Nation's platforms, and whether it would act against professional resale. The Staatssecretaris answered that resale is nuanced, that the ACM already has tools and has acted in specific cases, that talks with the sector will follow, and that any EU-level measures are preferable, without committing to new legislation yet.
As indicated in the answers to questions 3, 5 and 7, I first want to enter into discussion with the sector and then consider what may need to be done.
Zoals aangegeven in de antwoorden op de vragen 3, 5 en 7 wil ik nu eerst het gesprek met de sector aangaan en daarna bezien wat er eventueel moet gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Douane

Van Raak (SP) asked why customs (Douane) is not designated to use blue lights and sirens, despite earlier commitments and promises to align with the shop floor. The ministers answered that the application was rejected under the criteria because use would be too infrequent to guarantee safe driving, and that a speed-limit exemption and police cooperation are sufficient.
Based on assessment against the criteria used for this, however, this application was rejected.
Op basis van toetsing aan de criteria die hiervoor worden gehanteerd is deze aanvraag echter afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over digitale verkrachting

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether coercing sexual acts online, including digital rape, is punishable in the Netherlands, how this compares with Swedish law, and whether a separate digital rape offence will be introduced. The Minister replied that coercing online sexual acts can fall under assault, child sexual offences or child pornography provisions but not under rape as currently defined, that Dutch jurisdiction applies when acts are committed from the Netherlands, and that a modernisation of the sex offences law is being prepared with a consultation expected in 2018.
Within my ministry a bill to modernise the sex offences legislation is in preparation.
Binnen mijn ministerie is een wetsvoorstel tot modernisering van de zedenwetgeving in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opslag politie in beslag genomen vuurwerk onveilig’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security how police store, transport and destroy seized illegal fireworks and how officers' safety is guaranteed, and whether private firms could take over. The minister answered that police are intensifying direct ADR transport to a national storage facility, that specialists handle examination and destruction, and that options for a structural role for non-police parties will be reported in spring 2018.
I will inform your House further about this in spring 2018.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier in het voorjaar van 2018 nader over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Azmani over het bericht 'criminele Albanezen zijn de opkomende groep in de drugshandel'

MPs Van Oosten and Azmani asked the Justice Minister about reports that Albanian criminals are an emerging group in drug trafficking, and whether visa liberalisation for Albania should be reversed. The minister confirmed a rise in Albanian suspects, described ongoing enforcement and EU monitoring, and said the government will await the Commission's monitor before deciding on the emergency brake, while stating it has no reason to doubt Albanian authorities' cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over het pleidooi van gemeenten om meer soorten van de wietproef toe te staan

The MPs asked whether the government would allow several kinds of cannabis cultivation experiments as municipalities requested, rather than only one centrally supplied model, and whether they would consult the VNG. The minister said the experiments are still being designed in consultation with partners including municipalities and an independent evaluation committee, and aimed to submit the legislation in the second quarter of 2018.
We aim to submit the necessary legislation and regulations to your House in the second quarter of 2018.
Wij streven ernaar om de benodigde wet- en regelgeving in het tweede kwartaal van 2018 bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de strafrechtelijke aanpak van matchfixing

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether matchfixing should be made explicitly criminal, given evidence problems reported by prosecutors. Minister Grapperhaus replied that prosecutors have managed with existing law, that the Openbaar Ministerie will explore whether a separate offence adds value, and that a reporting duty and any sanction will be studied before further steps are taken.
The Public Prosecution Service will examine whether a separate criminal offence of matchfixing adds value to the current legal instruments for acting against fraud in sport.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat bekijken of zelfstandige strafbaarstelling van matchfixing meerwaarde heeft ten aanzien van het huidig wettelijk instrumentarium om op te treden tegen fraude in de sport.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Diertens en Voortman over de inzet van de politie in instellingen voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ), in het bijzonder het gebruik van het stroomstootwapen in GGZ-instellin

MPs Van Dam, Diertens and Voortman asked the Justice Minister about police use of stun guns inside GGZ mental health institutions, including whether the stun mode is effective given manufacturer warnings and how this was handled in the pilot. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the taser was used 15 times in care institutions (11 in GGZ settings, one in stun mode), that the stun mode has limited effect on persons unresponsive to pain, that an extra training and a final evaluation will follow, and that Parliament will be consulted before any decision on standard issue.
As promised in my letter, I will first give your House the opportunity to discuss this before a definitive decision is taken.
Zoals in mijn reeds genoemde brief is toegezegd zal ik uw Kamer eerst in de gelegenheid stellen hier over te spreken voordat een definitief besluit wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie heeft Utrechtse verdachten plofkraak Friesland in het vizier’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports on a coordinated, person-focused approach to armed robbery and ram/explosive raid suspects, including why suspects arrested in Friesland were released after interview and how national coordination works. The Minister confirmed the pilot approach, the involved partners, the coordination structure and that national coordination applies in each relevant case, but declined to comment on individual cases for investigative reasons.
In every case that fits this phenomenon there is national coordination and investigation.
In elke zaak die past binnen dit fenomeen is sprake van landelijke coördinatie en opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over aangiftes na misbruik door tantramasseurs

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports of sexual abuse by people posing as tantra masseurs, whether victims are reliably able to file complaints, how many reports the private Meldpunt Tantra Misbruik received, and whether municipalities can require licences for tantra massage. The minister condemned such abuse, explained victims can report to police or Centra voor Seksueel Geweld, described the police intake procedure, said the number of reports to the private platform is unknown, and noted most municipalities already require licences for sex-related services.
I will not go into the individual case.
Ik ga niet in op de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mislukken van een grote drugszaak door forse termijnoverschrijding door het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a large drug case collapsed after the Public Prosecution Service exceeded the prosecution time limit, leaving six suspects untried, and asked about causes, frequency, backlogs and measures. The Minister attributed the delay to staff turnover and case complexity, said the number of cases declared inadmissible is small, cited backlog figures, and promised only internal measures to prevent delays.
How much time the preparation took in total has not been registered as such.
Hoeveel tijd de voorbereiding in totaal in beslag heeft genomen, is niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Moordzaken gedwongen in de ijskast'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police had to halt investigations into four serious crimes due to lack of capacity, and what would be done. The minister confirmed that four of nineteen tactical investigations in the Limburg unit were temporarily suspended to free capacity for other serious cases, denied budget cuts to operational capacity, and said investigations are not fully stopped and new tips will still be followed up.

In this specific situation, the police and the Public Prosecution Service, given the number of serious offences in the Limburg unit, chose to temporarily halt the tactical investigation in four of the nineteen cases so that this capacity could be freed up for other serious cases.

In deze specifieke situatie hebben politie en OM, gelet op het aantal ernstige delicten in de eenheid Limburg, gekozen om het tactisch onderzoek in vier van de negentien zaken tijdelijk stil te leggen zodat deze capaciteit kon worden vrijgemaakt voor andere zware zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat de bouwplaats van een moskee in Enschede is besmeurd met varkensbloed

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Pegida action smearing pig's blood on a mosque construction site in Enschede, whether the threat picture has changed, what protection and coordination measures are taken, and whether Pegida can be banned. The minister answered that the action fits a pattern of intimidation without signs of violence, that existing advice and the 'Veilige Moskee' handbook remain in force, and that a ban requires high legal thresholds, so no extra general security measures or funding are planned.
An organisation cannot be banned merely because it is radical right-wing extremist.
Een organisatie kan niet verboden worden louter omdat zij radicaal rechts-extreem is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de arrestatie in een zaak van illegale hondenhandel

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why the police and regulators did not stop a dog trader sooner despite earlier findings of misconduct and zoning violations, and how many dogs were affected. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, pointed to NVWA's primary responsibility and to planned measures against illegal dog trade.
As for the rest, I cannot make further statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Voor wat betreft het overige kan ik geen nadere mededelingen doen over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de aanpak van ondermijning

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about low reporting by entrepreneurs of signs of undermining crime and how to involve businesses in the integrated approach. Minister Grapperhaus answered that entrepreneurs weigh costs and benefits before reporting, pointed to existing research, and committed to broader rollout of Ondernemers Alert meetings and continued public-private cooperation.
I will ensure a broader rollout of these meetings via the PVOs.
Ik ga zorgen voor een bredere uitrol van deze bijeenkomsten via de PVO’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de stijging van het aantal aangiften voor seksueel misbruik

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the Justice Minister about the rise in reports of sexual abuse following the #MeToo movement, whether police capacity is sufficient, and about low conviction numbers. The minister answered that reports and contacts rose in part, that police capacity is adequate, and that the link to #MeToo cannot be determined, and clarified conviction figures while disputing the one-in-eight statistic.
It cannot be determined how many reports, complaints and cases are directly related to the #MeToo movement.
Het is niet te duiden hoeveel meldingen, aangiften en zaken direct verband houden met de #MeToo-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Honderden IS-terroristen uit Raqqa ontsnapt onder geheime evacuatiedeal’

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether the government knew of a reported secret deal allowing hundreds of IS fighters to leave Raqqa, how many were freed and where they are, and how Nederland will prevent returnees from entering the country, including closing borders. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the cabinet was not informed in advance, that about 300 fighters left via tribal arrangements, that Dutch nationals cannot be barred from returning but are subject to criminal, intelligence and administrative measures including possible loss of citizenship, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
No, the cabinet was not aware of this agreement.
Nee, het kabinet was niet op de hoogte van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gedragsinterventie voor jongeren die zich misdragen hebben op het voetbalveld

Mr Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the 'Sport en Gedrag' training for youths who misbehaved on the football pitch will be discontinued for lack of funds and asked for support to keep it. Minister Bruins answered that the government funds the training through end-2018, that it is anchored in Halt's offer, and that talks with the KNVB and Halt on adapting it for other sports are ongoing.
Until the end of 2018 I support the Sport en Gedrag training, as part of the action plan 'Towards a Safe Sports Climate'.
Tot en met eind 2018 ondersteun ik de trainingen Sport en Gedrag, als onderdeel van het actieplan «Naar een Veilig Sportklimaat».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Terrorist krijgt slechts 4 jaar cel opgelegd’

MPs De Graaf and Markuszower asked the Justice Minister whether a four-year prison sentence for a terrorist, reported in the press, is too lenient and whether the government will raise sentences and deport and denaturalise such offenders. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sentencing is for the independent judiciary and prosecutors, and that denaturalisation is possible case by case for dual nationals with a 20-year entry ban.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecution and determine the sentencing demand.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te besluiten over de vervolging en het bepalen van de strafeis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Slachtoffer Chris vreest lagere straf door verstrijken van de tijd’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a victim fears a lower sentence due to delay in a kick-attack case, and whether the prosecution is responsible. The Minister replied that the hearing has not yet taken place, that the delay is due to scheduling with multiple suspects and lawyers, and that he cannot guarantee the sentence demand, as that belongs to the prosecution and the judge.
No, the sentence demand and the penalty to be imposed are for the prosecution and the judge respectively.
Nee, over de eis en de op te leggen straf gaan het OM respectievelijk de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over te lange doorlooptijden in de strafrechtketen

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister about long case-processing times in the criminal justice chain, including a victim's complaint, whether a hearing can be guaranteed within months, rising delays, and prosecution and court capacity. The Minister acknowledges the problem, refuses to guarantee hearings within months, cites improving average durations, and promises further information in 2018 and a WODC study.
No. The speed with which a report leads to prosecution and then to a conviction depends on so many circumstances that I cannot give that commitment.
Nee. De snelheid waarmee een aangifte tot vervolging en vervolgens tot een veroordeling leidt, is van zo veel omstandigheden afhankelijk dat ik die toezegging niet kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over opgelegde straffen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a study finding that courts impose lower sentences than prosecutors demand in organised crime cases, largely because of partial acquittals and long case durations. The minister agreed with the findings, pointed to ongoing efforts to shorten case duration, declined a separate quality study of case files, and said a national sentencing database is a judiciary decision, with the judiciary exploring one.
The Council for the Judiciary has informed the Minister for Legal Protection that it is currently examining the possibilities of creating its own national database for sentencing.
De Raad voor de Rechtspraak heeft de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming bericht dat zij op dit moment de mogelijkheden onderzoekt om te komen tot een eigen landelijke databank voor de straftoemeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de onveiligheid van 'Internet of Things' in Nederland

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security why Dutch smart-home devices score poorly on security, whether the government knew of the risks, what it will do to reduce them, and whether police records and expertise cover IoT-related hacking. The minister answered that a roadmap for secure hardware and software will be sent to parliament in spring 2018, that awareness campaigns and EUR 95 million for cybersecurity are being used, and that police records do not separately register IoT-device exploitation.

To promote better security of IoT devices, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, in consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security and other departments and private parties, is drawing up a roadmap for secure hardware and software.

Om te bevorderen dat IoT-apparaten beter worden beveiligd, stelt het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat in samenspraak met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en andere departementen en private partijen een roadmap veilige hard- en software op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat in korte tijd vijf Turkse Nederlanders zijn vermoord

Two DENK MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that five Turkish-Dutch men were killed in a short period, including whether the cases might be linked to the NSU murders and whether a special police unit should be set up. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said victims' families were offered victim support, and said no suspect had yet been identified, so he could not share further details such as possible motives; he described the police capacity deployed as flexibly scaled per case.
The criminal investigation into these cases has not yet led to the identification of a suspect. For that reason I cannot make further statements, such as about possible motives of suspects.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaken heeft nog niet geleid tot identificatie van een verdachte. Om die reden kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen, zoals over mogelijke motieven van verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Tellegen over het bericht 'Politie begint tóch met stopformulieren'

Two MPs asked whether the Den Haag police are joining a national pilot requiring officers to record why they stop people, how it works, and whether the government still opposes stop forms. The Minister says the pilot uses the MEOS app to log checks in the police system, runs December 2017 to May 2018 across nine teams, that stop forms remain excluded, and that results will be reported before autumn 2018.
I will inform your House before autumn 2018 about the outcomes of the pilots.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het najaar van 2018 informeren over de uitkomsten van de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Militairen mishandeld bij ontgroeningsritueel’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports of soldiers being abused during initiation rituals at the Schaarsbergen barracks, the union's call to abolish such rituals, and related reporting, measures, complaint channels, drugs use and prosecution. The government answered that a domestic investigation was conducted with prosecutor consent, rights-related measures were taken, an independent external inquiry is underway, and that it sees no reason to change prosecution policy.
The way reports and reporters are handled is part of the independent external investigation.
De wijze waarop met meldingen en melders wordt omgegaan maakt deel uit van het onafhankelijk externe onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over een arrestatiebevel tegen een Turkse journalist

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether journalist Can Dündar had cancelled a Netherlands visit because of a Turkish Interpol arrest request, and how the Netherlands handles such requests. The minister answered that he could not confirm the cancellation, that Dündar has since visited, that no Dutch government view on the foreign conviction is given, and that foreign Interpol requests are assessed case by case before registration.

A foreign arrest request or alert that the Netherlands receives via INTERPOL channels is not automatically acted upon: each is assessed case by case before being entered in the national investigation register.

Aan een buitenlands aanhoudingsverzoek of signalering dat Nederland via INTERPOL kanalen ontvangt, wordt niet automatisch gevolg gegeven: deze worden per geval beoordeeld alvorens deze worden ingevoerd in het nationale opsporingsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over een mogelijk uitgevaardigd arrestatiebevel tegen een naar Duitsland gevluchte voormalig hoofdredacteur van de Turkse krant Cumhuriyet

A GroenLinks MP asked whether an arrest warrant had been issued against Can Dündar, a former Cumhuriyet editor who fled to Germany, and how the Netherlands prevents abuse of INTERPOL and Turkish extradition requests. The Minister said no international arrest request was known, described the INTERPOL safeguards and Dutch case-by-case screening, declined to comment on a safe-conduct, and pointed to an EU-level initiative.
If there are indications that the person concerned will not be extradited by the Netherlands, the request is not registered and the person can enter and leave the Netherlands unhindered.
Indien er aanwijzingen zijn dat het gaat om een persoon die Nederland niet zal uitleveren, wordt het verzoek niet geregistreerd en kan de persoon in kwestie ongehinderd Nederland in- en uitreizen.
